We recently bought a bunch of taco mix and now we are buying the chili pouch!  keep it up guys - dont compromise.

title: wow, we have become a big fan of this company: quality and FRESH!
text: We have come around to like the products from this company.  we started with their salt products, then their taco seasoning and chili - and this herb is fresh and you can smell it when you open the packet.  it is small, but it is more than adequate for home cooks unless your culture uses a lot of turmeric in their cooking - we dont.  Hence this pouch size is perfect.  Going forward, we are are going to buy our spices from this company - we have become a believer and the quality is excellent.  highly recommend the taco mix and chili!

title: Prefer dry spice!
text: I prefer the dry spice, especially in small quantity versus the paste -much longer shelf life and taste is more fresh.  Trusted brand for general home cooking.

title: always good to have same quality that restaurants are using, especially if you cook on daily basis.
text: This is a lot of paprika for general household use - more for restaurants.  that said, the quality is very good and enhanced my home cooking.  i would buy one and share with a few households to make sure you can use it within the expiration date.  What you put in your cooking is what you get out of it and it is no mean feat cooking every day.  Hence, worth using good ingredients.  i would recommend that the supplier had these in 4oz containers to maintain level of freshness.

title: Gentle flavor.
text: Either the Chile nor the citrus is strong, but works great in marinade, coat in stir fry meat or stir fry sauce.  I like the little 1.4 oz size to keep it fresh as spices oxidize in air.

title: Meh, medium strength, but no distinct fresh flavor.
text: I am a big tea drinker, and love extra strong black tea [with milk].  I was curious to test this tea[not that TATA owns Tetley tea].  When you open the bag..I was little shocked to see ‘granules’ as well as some tea leaves.  When you buy loose tea, I expect to see ‘leaves’.  That said, these granules didn’t dissolve and I guess they are ‘mushed’ leaves.  In terms of taste: it is medium strength, but distinctive fresh tea taste wasn’t there for me. You will need a tea strainer to use this tea.  Better than Lipton though!

title: No taste. Brown gravy
text: It is just gravy..I couldn’t taste the orange or ginger.  A shame.  Otherwise, easy to prepare, and I recommend more than a cup of h20…quite a lot of corn starch.

title: Like the size for less wastage and eaten with marination and flat bread.
text: Great spice for chicken and Shawarma recipe and eaten with flat bread.  So easy to prepare with some yogurt to marinate the meat before cooking.  Also works great with fish - as taco seasoning.  I like these little spice as once they are exposed to ir - they start deteriorating - hence handy size and less waste.  It is not a hot/spicy spice.  So get generous with the quality.  Adds a really nice warm flavor to meat or vegetables too.

title: Wow, we found our favorite taco seasoning.
text: So yum.  We have found our favorite seasoning for tacos. We are really impressed with this company..we use their salt varieties.  The thoughtfulness on flavoring with both minced beef and chicken really came through.  A packet is ample for one pound of minced meat.  Not overwhelming, but flavorful.

title: Dried and little time to get use to the new flavor.
text: Natto is fermented soybean.  As with any fermentation, it is good for gut health.  It is like a dried peanut, but its taste is hard to name, and a little to get use to, initially.  A small packet is about the. Right amount, and it worked with afternoon tea/coffee.  Happy gut, happy me

title: very high protein % and yet good for your digestive track.
text: this is not Gf, but it is an ancient grain, which is much better for your digestion as our gene hasn't evolved and adapted fully to the modern grain [hence Celiac and gluten sensitive symptoms].  This flour has over 14% protein, which is great for gluten build.  I use about 30% of this flour with strong bread flour and rye flour combo.  Just know you need to treat this flour like WWF and hence add addition 10% [of its flour weight]of water to the recipe.  Love it for bread and making pasta.

title: tasty and with additional ingredients needed
text: a mild curry flavor and very easy to cook once you have prepared all the other ingredients [we used fresh tomatoes in lieu of can of tomatoes, just as good].  mild enough to pair with shrimps and yet still have a good spice kick.  tad expensive for a sachet.  that said - it made a good 4 cups batch of sauce.

title: top rated green tea
text: the quality is excellent and you can tell as soon as you open the package [resealable].  the taste is delicious and fresh.  very refreshing for an afternoon calm.  very happy with this brand and would buy this tea online again.

title: Not ivertly sweet and love the added sprouted grain in the diet
text: Great for sprinkling over yogurt for texture and added sprouted grain for nutrition. Sweetness is not detected, which was fine as I rather taste the yogurt.  Seal is great and small package means product stays fresher as you go through using the product.

title: Less plastic, but taste wasn’t smooth
text: Great to see less plastic in the design.  Taste wise: it was okay, but not smooth for my preference.  Great to grab a cuppa, but not for relaxing mode.

title: Love this berry flavored herbal tea. Clipper is the best
text: Oooh my, this is by far by favorite herbal tea flavor from Clipper.  I love the clipper brand for tea, and their herbal offerings are just as good. This one you can steep for good long 10 minutes an I love the berry and rose hip flavors.  Great to drink hot or cold, and this one is a lovely one for winding down from a hectic day.  So happy to see the offerings making into the US Amazon site…I miss getting my clipper tea.

title: Deep smooth tea.
text: I am a huge clipper fan,,especially the breakfast tea.  I love the caffeine free herbal tea to unwind in late afternoon.  This one you can steep for more than 5 minutes without being overpowered.  The lemon fl or is not that pronounced - but a smooth taste of more like chamomile tea.  Delicious and great hot, warm or cold.

title: Strong flavors: steep for 3 minutes max for best balance.
text: I love clipper tea, especially the breakfast tea…and this one is no exception, and if you steep it for more than 5 minutes: very deep liquorice flavor.  Best balance is 3 minutes with hot water.  Very soothing with the peppermint part.  Love drinking these caffeine free in the late afternoon when I am looking to unwind from the day.

title: Soothing tea.
text: One of my favorite brand for calming tea.  The night time one is one that you shouldnot steep for too long as it it heavy.  I love relaxing late in the afternoon or early evening with a relaxing tea.  All the flavors are palatable and are good whether hot or cold.  Very soothing.

title: Sized correctly for a healthy snack
text: Fun for vegans..a split in our household.  Texture varied from flaky to a little hard not crunch.  Pizza flavor was tasty, but I wouldn’t have identified it as pizza.  Small sized package was enough in one sitting with a cuppa tea.  If you are a health nut, you would like these, less so for non health conscious individuals in my household.

title: Fun colors, taste more coconut than chocolate though
text: Fun colors for cookie dough try bake.  They are very soft, sweet and taste more coconut [from the coconut milk powder] than chocolate.  Great for light yellow fairy cakes as the colors can be seen.  Adds sweetness, but not chocolate flavor.

title: Tasted like a refreshingly good drip coffee:  medium roast. Not bitter at all.
text: Wow, I wasn’t expecting it was going to be this good.  As good as a drip coffee with good coffee beans.  I love my good tea bags, but never conceived coffee could taste this good in a bag.  The bag is sizable large, and I steeped it for near 4 minutes, added some milk: tasted really good.  It gave me rnoon lift I needed.  Not bitter at all.  Great job as cleaning was ever so easy!

title: as a new brand for me: this product met my quality requirement needed in home baking.
text: we have moved to monk fruit sugar and coconut sugar for baking.  this one works as expected and no after taste, which some brands can leave.  it is a good substitute and as a new brand for my baking; I do recommend.  packaging was good with a seal that actually works.  although I tend to store them in large glass jars to minimize and moisture lost or entering into the package.

title: perfect for those who still love their jellies and want less of the added sugar.
text: great for those who dont want the added sugar, but still love the jelly dessert.  I don think the taste was compromised with the sugar free element.  Yes, you won't get the uber sweetness, but if you need it - i just added a tablespoon of monk fruit sugar or coconut sugar.  easy to make as the originals.

title: So easy to take
text: One of the trusted brands for my supplements.  Simple jelly gummies, no added sugar coating th/e outside, not overtly sweet.  Perfect and so easy to take as a supplement.  Can taste the apple and not much of the vinegar.

title: Lovely mix with cinnamon and ginger the top 2 ingredients
text: Great mix for lovely add to my banana cake recipe in lieu of just cinnamon and ginger.  It filled the kitchen with delicious warm spicy fragrance.  The top 2 ingredients are cinnamon and ginger, so having sprinkle of nutmeg, cloves, all spice are pluses for any baking.  Excited to use this in making pumpkin pie.

title: Weak coffee
text: Not sure what the hype is as I expected a strong bold flavor; instead I got a weak tasting coffee.  The beans smelt fresh and delicious and well within the expiration date.  High hopes, but a huge let down,  I had heard such a good thing about this brand.

title: Bold medium, smooth.  Not bitter at all.  Lovely cuppa.
text: Really lovely bold-medium flavor and smooth, not bitter at all.  I love it.  I grind it fine for my nespresso virtuoso machine.  Really great pick me up caffeine for morning or early afternoon.  The strength of the flavor is better than a major brand I just bought.

title: great for waffles. less so for other GF bake products
text: after trying a number of these pre-mixes for GF baking: they generally work best for the waffles recipes.  the differences between the gluten and the GF version are smaller and more palatable if you dont have to go GF.  the other products were too different and it was less playable if you are okay with gluten products.

title: Surprisingly yummy, wasn’t a rice cake until now.  Love chocolate layer.
text: Omg, this is delicious. On their own, rice cakes do nothing for me.  With a thin layer of dark chocolate- this healthier snack is transformed.  Great to have as you are running errands as it does not crumble.  Tad pricy, but worthy of consideration if you need to snack and want to keep a lower calorie count for the day.

title: Ample sweetness, but GF mix needed more raising agent.
text: Smelt delicious with full pumpkin spice as they were baking, but number of issues:  more cupcake size if you are aiming for 12 cups; needed more raising agent [it did have baking powder and soda] , and really a mix for those who need to go gluten free as the muffin texture was very moist from the eggs and oil, but you do notice the lack of structure afforded from gluten flour.  Nice little snack otherwise.  We use this brand for sugar and ample sweetness.

title: too much plastic and did it say 'bite' it to open the tube???
text: with the environment and dental issues in mind: I wasn't a fan.  to open each of the little tube - it recommends you 'bite' into it and effectively use one's teeth to open each tube.  well that isnt an option oof you want a dental bill later on.  I used scissors but you need to clean it after each use.  worth the effort? not really, the taste is okay honey, but I am generally use  manuka NZ honey.  also there is a lot of plastic here and I cant justify the convenience.  Each tube is  small quantity of honey.  I rather carry as small jar of honey with me if I really need some for the road.

title: perfect for baking and pastry
text: great for baking whether you warm it for chocolate ganache or for making chocolate croissants.  bot overly sweet, but lovely deep cocoa flavor.  creamy when mixed with butter to make ganache.

title: Strong flavor tea, yet soothing.
text: This is a strong deep flavored tea and I would recommend steeping it in hot water for maximum of 3 minutes.  Great flavor and soothing at the end of a day.  I tend not to use the tea bags snd remove the tea leaves and store them in glass.  The leaves are fresh.

title: Yes! Perfect snack.
text: I love salt and vinegar flavored savory goods and combine this with NO shell pistachios- love.  The vinegar is not that sharp and saltiness is just right. Fresh nuts in strongly sealed bag.  This is a winner.  Adding this onto our shopping basket!  Ingredients are few and recognizable.

title: Fresh and strong flavor even after cooking.
text: Fresh new strong pepper flavor.  We used it to season pork, beef and lamb for cooking.  I like that there is a grater in the cap, but the ground pepper is quite course and there is no way to adjust the grind.  Happy on how fresh the pepper is and you can taste it even after cooking.  It is best way to use pepper - freshly ground.

title: Great raw and unprocessed salt.
text: This is unprocessed and raw salt, which is huge focus with French cooking.  I used this to sprinkle over avocado toast, seasoning meat before cooking.  Such a healthy way to incorporating salt in your diet.  Grains are small and easy to add without cooking.  I am a big fan of sea salt for our body.

title: Moist and tasty for a non Asian version.
text: I am huge jerky fan and love the Chinese version.  So how does this jerky stack up?  Tasty and I like they way they cured it [similar to Asian versions] where the meat is still moist [not dry and too chewy].  Spicy good and yes you will be licking your fingers.  Not bad at all.  There are only 2 other non Asian brands that I like, this one comes in the top 3.

title: Deep honey flavor - great taste
text: I am a big Manuka honey consumer:  gut healing.  Whilst this is not manuka  honey, it still had a lovely deep honey flavor and I thoroughly enjoyed drinking a cup.  The color in the honey is dark.  The honey was packed in august 2020 and has 4 years expiration.  I wouldn’t take that long to use this product.  A lovely taste.  My first experience with Chilean mountain honey.

title: Simple and natural ingredients. Yum
text: Just love the simple and natural ingredients.  Love this has honey infused already as I often add honey in making a salad dressing.  Great for drizzling over fish like salmon and swordfish.  Nearly 2 years shelf life, which is great and decent size to avoid wastage once opened.  Taste is good with the expected tang form the balsamic vinegar.  The dark glass supports longer life of the product. Definitely keep in cool and dark place, we often put into the fridge once opened.

title: Strong and fresh accent.  Quantity si huge for typical active home baker
text: The biggest use I have for ginger powder is to make the famous British ginger cake.  I love this cake and need strong and fresh spices to make this recipe.  This brand provides a strong accent and arrive fresh.  It is a huge packet and my concern is that there will be wastage as I don’t need that much spice per recipe.  Hence, something to consider is smaller 8oz packages.  The sealant works, but once open and exposed to air, the product will deteriorate naturally.

title: 3.5 stars - for a baker - a little more ingredients than I wanted - but still a good cake.
text: i am a baker and I remember the rum cakes from the Caribbean islands.  So i was excited to  try this cake to evoke some memories.  Alas, since becoming a baker - I am aware of ingredients and whilst the cake will not last as long - oof good it wouldn't.  there is a lot of additives here, to be expected to prolong the shelf live of the cake.  it has very strong rum flavor in the cake, even though it is low down in the ingredients rap sheet.  the cake was moist and the vanilla was pronounced.  If you cant make your own and want to indulge in a rum flavored pound cake - this one I would recommend.  Alas for me ... it is time to find a good rum cake recipe ... it is cake and baking season now that the temperature is cooling.

title: less wastage with buying individual spices for pickling and corn beef,
text: great for pickling and for making briskets/cornbeef.  so easy to use as all the ingredients are already in there and I dont need to buy separate spices and hence less wastage overall.  this packet will last me a year of pickling projects and the occasional corn beef project.  I would add some salt for bit Erie taste, but try to first before addinging.

title: Taste great with fish.
text: Surprisingly yummy.  I sprinkled on some beautiful Norwegian salmon.  The seasoning was enough, as it has salt already and the chili flakes are not that hot.  Nice flavor- although no lemons in ingredients..I noticed a tad sharpness that went well with fish. Light and not overwhelming for delicate protein like fish.  I like that the seasoning is not in huge quantity as often you never use it all.  I sprinkled it and gentle low heat baked the fish.  Yum.  Next time will sprinkle on pizza before the bake and see how that taste.  Happy with the quality.

title: Mild, not a 9 intensity
text: Not a 9 intensity.  The flavor was not deep.  More of a 4/mild.  It was better as drip coffee.  Largely plastic, typical of none nespresso products.

title: Satisfying lunch,
text: This item does contain gluten.  I preferred to transfer the dry noodles to a big soup bowl, add hot water, cover with a saucepan lid for 7 to 10 minutes: noodles quadrupled in volume!  Spicy soup mix or you could add your own soup mix if you prefer less additives ingredients often found with these instant noodle pots.  Yummy.  Enough for a lunch.  Noodles was soft and yet chewy after a longer soak than the recommended time.  I will repurpose the container with seedlings.

title: Not hot at all
text: I was expecting a kick - nothing, maybe a slight twinge at first bite.  There was no heat at all.  Disappointed, as the combination of pineapple and mango seemed like a great combination.  Flavoring is fairly neutral - little pineapple.  The ingredients look great and hardly any additives.  I will use the reminder with tacos.  A shame.

title: Has glute, otherwise very yummy.
text: This does have wheat in the noodle, not gluten free.  I transferred the dry noodle to a bowl and added the sachet and added water to cover the noodle, put on a saucepan lid…and let it sit for 4 plus minutes.  I recommend swishing the noodle loose during the soak in hot water time as it made sure all the noodle were rehydrated.  The flavoring was yummy: most ingredients were dried vegetables and little strange ingredients.  Only neg was the foam bowl: reusing it as a seed tray.

title: fresh and greta for pickling
text: it's pickling time for so many great vegetables and these mustard seeds are fresh and did a great job with cucumbers and carrots.  if you picked a lot, it is worth getting a bag of mustard seeds.  the quality was consistent through out the whole bag.  the seeds are from turkey and the bag is labeled with both the manufacturing time and expiration date: 3 years all in.

title: A brand that loves their products and tad expensive, but worth it for a delicious finish.
text: I love this brand as I started sampling their flour and grain offering.  They do love their flour and grains.  I never tried pastry flour before. It has 9% protein, in line with all purpose plain flour and definitely not enough gluten for bread making unless you add vitae gluten.  The brand offers the ASH count for this flour 0.55%, which is an average high of bran that is kept in the flour.  I was curious on the sweet and savory pastry for my British baking…yum. Light and a soft crumble. Worked really well for quiche.

title: coconut sugar is better for you: very sweet this version.
text: this isnt nectar in the truest sense of the word.  however it is a combo of water and coconut sugar : coconut sugar in a liquid form.  I use coconut sugar in my baking and cooking and hence this was an easy option for waffles and pancakes.  very sweet relative to high end canadian maple syrup-  a tad too sweet for me.  coconut sugar does have a nuttier flavor and even though this description says 'caramel' - there is no other ingredient as provided on the label.  That said, given the simplicity, i might make my own coconut sugar syrup myself as I will know the quality of the sugar I am using .

title: lovely ,ix and such a stable in our household
text: lovely mix for marinade rubs [ribs],  ragu sauce and any meat sauce.  easy to use.  this mix is such a stable in our household and we love to cook.  the brand is as good as any brands we have used in the past [store brands and other major brands found in supermarkets].

title: low bitterness, and strikes a tone between a soak and medium roast.
text: the beans are gorgeously oily and smelt delicious when you opened the pack.  there were specks of 'sea salt'm, but seriously, it did not have a material impact.  whilst it is a dark roast - the taste was relatively more mellow between a dark roast tone and medium roast tone.  I 'fine' ground the beans for both a nesspresso coffee and drip over coffee.  given this blend, i highly recommend a fine grounding.  I tried a medium ground and it really didnt bring out the coffee flavor.  definitely low in 'bitter' flavor associated with the dark roast.  The flavoring aspect is less of feature in these beans.  more for afternoon brew.

title: Seriously good product.  Buy with confidence.
text: I was very impressed with this mild anchovy oil.  Great to add in some pasta sauces, stews and just a light drizzle over tofu.  Key ingredient with mn]any Thai recipes.  It has a lovely mild flavor.  Genuine product as often these can be more oil than the flavor you are seeking.  Good quality.  Would keep in cool me dark place once opened, but the glass is dark to keep longevity of the oil based product.

title: great quality brand.  uber pleased.
text: we have tried a number of salts from this brand and thus far this product did not disappoint.  I love the quality and reading the health benefits, we use this salt as part of our daily cooking and baking.  obviously, we have a grinder to refine the size of the crystals.  just grab to have healthy minerals to support the cells.  once you come down this path, you cant go back to any salt that isnt naturally produced and minimally changed with any 'additions' by human beings.

title: quality is excellent.
text: Follow the instructions so that when you cook them - they are softer to eat and digest.  I generally use them for making chili and they were delicious.  They came looking clean and ready to prep for cooking.  I rather use these dried beans than from cans.  very pleased with the quality.

title: the mix is yummy for white protein as great for tofu and vegetables.
text: Sprinkled in the flavor are white sesame seeds - and I used this to coat tofu - and it was so delicious.  not over powering [of course dependent on how much you sprinkle over the protein].  I am happy to use this on fish and chicken.  often I am unimpressed with seasoning mixes, but this one is a keeper.

title: seasoning was just right.  enough crispiness
text: i was surprised how yummy these crumbs were.  i used them on white fish fillets and tofu.  whilst they absorb the water from the tofu - once fried they retained a certain amount of crispiness.  the flavor was very good and the italian seasoning with a tad of salt was great.  the flavoring did not over power the fresh flavor of fish.  first GF bread crumbs with nice flavoring and nothing odd what I have found with other GF products.

title: Great heat, but not burning.
text: Very good heat.  Doesn’t linger and burn.  Great for noodles pasta.  Couldn’t really taste the salty kelp.  The kelp added smoothness and depth.  Yum

title: stronger than other brands, but greta scent.
text: I noticed that imported ginger powder from India are extra strong than the brands from local supermarkets.  hence, I reduced the quantity need in either baking or cooking to adjust for the strength.  otherwise, i was pleased with the quality, freshness and had an expiration date of 3 years.  the seal is okay, but with any herbs I tend to double bag them in containers to minimize any oxidation.

title: Best tea blend if you love strong. Smooth tea.
text: Love this brand and it’s the only one I drink for a good strong cuppa.  Other brands are way too weak.  Best flavor, just wished this was more affordable here.  As I am a tea drinker.

title: Great options and we love it for waffles
text: I love there are many baking options/recipes.  We tried the pancake, banana cake and waffle recipes and we love the waffle recipe.  We find many of the GF version aren’t fluffy enough for pancakes - and even adding bicarbonate soda still can’t get the lightness.  For the waffles we added little more water and vegetable oil than prescribed as we like a lighter batter.  The results were great and depending on your appliance, we left the lid on for extra mInute.  With baking soda in the ingredient: recommend you let the batter sit for at least 10 mins so it can activate.

title: Ancient grain and yummy with any sourdough recipes.
text: It’s like white whole wheat flour, but its ancient grain, which I love using in my sourdough baking.  I used it in sourdough pizza and it adds a great flavor and texture.  Always add 10% more water when you are dealing with whole grains.  Love this product as it’s quite hard to find this in any major supermarkets.  Plan to use this in my sourdough flour blend for my next bread.

title: flavoring was good, but noodles a little too thick for me.
text: I am a noodle lover and this one did not work for me on first try:  the noodle took longer than 4-5 mins as described to get the softness I wanted,  and the texture of the noodle was too starchy for me.  the thickness of the noodle is thicker than other brands I have eaten.  the flavoring is good and not overwhelming, and is already in the noodle cup [no separate sachet].  This cup is ample for either a snack or quick lunch size.  the cup was strong enough to hold the hot water and noodle without any collapse of the structure.

title: great flavor: merlot delicious
text: very fresh tea and you can see it as it assorts the hot water and in the taste.  if I could use the wine analogy: it would be a nice deep merlot depth to the flavor.  Steeped for 4 minutes and even if you forgot - it does not create an over bitter flavor.  the seal works and the amount is just perfect to keep freshness.  i am a huge tea drinker and hence would be using this in my daily tea drinking.

title: trusted quality.
text: I am warming up nicely with this brand and the sticks are uber fresh as soon as you open the bag.  the seal is not bad but often place my air sensitive spice in a tuber ware box.  Just the right amount amount for our uses.  I discovered how tasty chilis are with a stick if cinnamon in it,  and if I want really fresh cinnamon in my holiday bakings - grinding down these sticks are best way.  Happy with the brand and these fresh cinnamons .

title: easy access to tasty nuts /snack.
text: fresh. crunchy and healthy snack.  the packet didnt last long so the effect of the sealing bag was rather untested.  pleased with the freshness of the edible item.

title: Crystallized honey and description/picture should have been more honest
text:
the picture is deceptive as the honey is separated between liquid form and crystal form. I love trying raw honey from around the world, but this one left me a little puzzled - is this RAW RAW? i mean there is no honey comb and where does the crystal like honey come from? so this is what I found on the internet: ""The crystallization process is natural and spontaneous. Pure, raw and unheated honey has a natural tendency to crystallize over time with no effect on the honey other than color and texture."" I am not an expert, but i was reassured to try this in my tea.
Tasted like honey, but does have a distinct after taste that was fine. You really need to heat it to dissolve the crystal and I would recommend it for hot drinks and not for baking because of the concentration/cluster of the honey crystals. More 3.5 stars, but the picture and description should have been more honest.

title: pure ingredients and nice bitter deep flavor
text: quality is good and had deeper taste than my store brand.  very yummy with making triple chocolate muffins and brownies.  very happy that the ingredient is pure with added sugar of any sort - hence it will be more bitter, but if you use in baked goods, the sugar in the ingredients is more than enough.

title: excess taste - citrus tang - no additives
text: i love these fruit powder: i sprinkle them on top of yogurt, add to fruit smoothies.  they have a tang, but I love the 'citrus' sharpness in the morning.  ingredient is 100% pomegranate juice.

title: great high protein
text: great for pasta, pizza and sourdough bread.  Very nice quality and if you are using plain/APF flour, this is a great flour to add in the mix because of its high protein %, which is needed to get a decent oven rise and structure to your bread.  I really like this flour as part of a mix when making bread.  Semolina flour isnt was to find in general supermarkets.

title: just okay - better to use fresh or dried shiitake mushrooms
text: i sprinkle this on my pizza - yes!  it adds a creamy taste to the bite.  On its own it does not smell our taste like mushroom.  Also good for making mushroom broth/soup.  it's okay, and prefer to use dried or fresh shiitake.

title: good quality and greta taste
text: 250+ is at the lower end, but it is still an excellent honey, which I taking on a daily basis with hot water.  it is great for the body to manage inflammation in the body.  The honey has consistency of many of the 450+ honey and the taste is good.  I am biased towards NZ produced honey.  recommend.

title: Fabulous brand and '00' flour for fresh egg pasta
text: Love this brand of grains, pricy, but worth it.  this flour is equivalent to '00' flour and hence uber fine.  I used this flour with 30% of semolina flour to make fresh egg pasta; result was a big thumbs up.  Making fresh pasta is a little work, but worth it with the excellent chew and taste with fresh garlic and tomato sauce.  This brand is one of the understated producers out there and they need to get their products into some of the larger stores like WFs.

title: vacuum sealed and fresh
text: The toasting is light imho, and hence I do a quick toast before I use these nuts for baking purposes.  Very fresh and happy with the lovely flavor.  they come in vacuum sealed bag that buys you some time before you start using them.  I often save the nuts in the coffee vacuum sealed canisters to prolong life to any nuts.

title: Yum.
text: Yum.  I gave it a quick rinse, then cooked it in chicken mushroom bone broth and then added diced and sautéed couchettes…simple yum.  Didn’t take long to cook - less than 10 minutes.  Absorbed the flavored broth.  Didn’t fall apart even if you over cook it a bit, as I like my pasta/noodles soft.

title: Fresh tasting for great addition to freshly made pasta.
text: Finely grated and strong flavor, so no need to dump loads into any pasta dish.  Easy way to posh up a pasta dish and very tasty addition.  Also nice to sprinkle over a pizza.  This cheese combo is great for e Pepe pasta dish, which was yummy with freshly made pasta.  Great value form Happy Belly.

title: Thumbs up and highly recommend.
text: Thumbs up from hub. We have tried so many keto friendly mixes that were terrible, and I was hesitant to try another one.  In fact, I didn’t say a thing until I present it with French Gabon and Canadian grade A maple syrup.  You can tell it isn’t wheat gluten, but it is subtle and they still fluffed up [with a little help from the bicarbonate soda and resting the mix for 5 minutes].  I added more liquid  than recommended, I added the usual amount I would for a gluten wheat mix and threw in 2 tablespoons of flax.  Light and fluffy - very tasty. title: Taste good, not Swiss chocolate says a chocolate connoisseur
text: Premium milk chocolate it is not, but taste better than Hershey.  A bit of bad advertising that it is Swiss when it is produced in the states.  Solid ball of milk chocolate- nice decorative gold for festive holidays.

title: Great with strong cheese and fresh. Cant taste any salt.
text: His product reminded my hub of a childhood cracker under a different name/brand.  Great served with strong cheddar cheese!  Otherwise, personally, it is a wheat tasting cracker, rather bland on its own.  Not salty- so good if you are watching your salt intake in your diet.

title: Yum. Quality brand and ingredients.
text: King Arthur is such a great brand, which pretty covers my bread making etc.  the GF a product is just as good for those who wants to enjoy breakfast, but just want to reduce the gluten intake.  Follow instructions,  and you end up with a great product.  I also add flax seeds and easy to add frozen blueberries and bananas.  Yum

title: Simply love these herb mixes
text: We have tried a number of these rubs, they may come in small package, the flavor they add is quite a punch.  Seriously, a little is enough anf hence a smaller batch to avoid expired herbs.  I love how these spices change a simple chicken or beef steak into something so tasty with so little effort.  Authentic ingredients.

title: HOT sauce.. genuinely good
text: We have tried ghost peppers before...and yes, this hot sauce is HOT.  But no inedible, not burning on your tongues.  That said, I didn’t use much at all.  Genuine hot sauce.  Great to spice up a stew, guacamole..just test it before you splash your usual quantity!  The heat has that ghost pepper effect.

title: Uber healthy with soup.
text: I am used to hydrating many dried vegetables: these hydrate very quickly with hot water.  I love these sea mosses for Asian healing soups.  Adds lovely a lovely flavor - great for the skin and organs.

title: Great freshness, strong coffee
text: There are only a few brands that I will continue to,buy: this is one of them.  These are dark French roast and tends to have a bitter after taste.  With this brand, the bitterness is smooth and not as strong.  I am more of Italian roast.  Love this for my pour over coffee, first thing in the morning: super strong.

title: Essential for pastry, and a little fat is good for mental health.
text: Great for pastry.  Makes the pastry a little flakier, softer and just yum.  I am using lard for many of my savory and fruit pastry.  It is good fat - around kidneys.  Fat is essential for the brain and mental health. So I am treating my body to fat essential to pastry texture and taste.  The flavor imparted from this lard is just so tasty - as in all things natural.

title: Yummy, just love these crackers.
text: Yummy, love these crackers.  They puff up very quickly in the hot oil, so recommend you do a few at a time, or have a metal scooper to pick them up.

title: 100% dates - no other additives
text: yum, with the ingredient being pure dates - very happy with the taste: not overtly sweet other than from the dates themselves.  nice thick spread and great with sourdough toast.  if you love dates - then you will love this spread.

title: Moorish and yummy
text: So hard to find prawn crackers here, so happy to try this brand: puffs up easily and make sure your oil is HOT.  Keep these chips dry and in airtight container, as once they soften - impossible to get the puff.  Happy days are back as they are often served in Asian restaurants as appetizers.

title: Good animal fat for pastry works. Yum
text: It has been a year of my inner baking genius spirit.  Pastry was my next mountain, and I have been trying a number of shortening from vegetables, animal lard and suet.  The quality of this lard is at the top end, and create a warm and flaky puff pastry and short crust for my meat pies: so yum.  Lard is actually good for the boys, especially the brain [certainly helped my anxiety and depression].  Try an experiment: deprive your body of some animal fat: you will feel the overwhelming sadness.  Add some fat into your diet: happier mind set.

title: Yummy with pork chops.
text: Surprised how tasty pork chops tasted with just a little amount of rub [with vegetable oil mix] - no need to add any salt or pepper.  Marinated for two hours on the fridge and flavor is good.  I like the amount is small as you really don’t need much, plus I hate to throw away spices.  Container is tight.

title: Saucy!
text: Oooh, very saucy!  Nice and thick tomato goodness.  The garlic is pretty mute and that is fine as we like to do our our flavors.  Delicious.  Worth the price, which is tad high, but worth it.

title: Yum.
text: A splash of oil, strong fragrance and taste. Nice way to dress up a simple pasta or risotto.  Any more than a splash is too pungent.  Bottle is small. Just as well as oil doesn’t fresh for long.  Nice alternative to fresh truffle.  Although fresh truffle is unbeatable.

title: Meh, weak.
text: Fits conventional nespresso machine.  Not a medium roast. Weak coffee. Very disappointed.  Life is too short to drink weak coffee. Even weaker than an intensity 3 decaf.  I use 2 pods in my morning cuppa.

title: Meh, weak coffee for the intensity grade
text: Works with my nespresso machine. Plastic capsule with a thin cloth like top.  The grind is very weak - in color and in taste. I used 2 pods with my coffee plus milk.  Meh.  Not worth the money. I like my coffee at 6 or 7 with Italian roast.  This coffee did not give me the mojo I need in my first morning cuppa.

title: Another great brand.
text: This brand is great and we love this paprika, which I use for stews.  Lovely flavor and fresh.  Easy resealable bag.

title: More nutty than excessively sweet-prefers for babka recipe,
text: The tub is bigger than the content itself.  The spread is like Nutella, and taste mor e nutty than sweet- which is how I like it. I used it on the chocolate babka recipe...just the right amount of sweetness and applies just like Nutella.  I transferred the spread to a number of glass food containers and have kept well either at room temperature, fridge , it freezer.

title: Very tasty with fish or chicken. A little is more than enough
text: Needed surprisingly little amount added to vegetable oil as a rub on chicken thighs .  Delicious and tasty without overwhelming the palate.  Great little tin size, lid is tight to keep freshness.

title: Thumbs up on quality
text: I have become to love this value Amazon brand.  Fresh flavor and used with miso for black cod miso recipe.  I like the small size as you don’t use a lot generally and hence you are not wasting.

title: Delicious, love the light smokiness
text: I have started to love this value Amazon food brand.  Love the light smoky flavor for making Chinese wontons!  Or other Asian sauces.

title: It’s true, bread tastes better from freshly ground flour. Great for sourdough bread
text: First time I am grinding my whole flour.  I used a spare coffee grinder to intermittently grind 400g of flour to make my sourdough bread.  I am aware freshly grind berries to make bread has a higher protein level, and I noticed that during bulk fermentation - the gluten build was much faster than with KA’s bread flour.  I was very happy with the end result, the oven spring happened. The taste was yummy.  I will need to invest in a grain grinder - not cheap.  But I make all the bread at home now.

title: Medium roast with tad almond flavor at beginning.
text: The first gulp you can taste a little almond, thereafter it was lovely coffee.  The capsule worked well with my nespresso.  I also tried the granules in pour over coffee.  Either way, I enjoyed my morning coffee.  The flavor was rich, smooth, not that burnt French roast.  The capsule is plastic, and the lid is torn paper with thin inner plastic.

title: 13.3% protein.
text: 13.3% protein.  This is a little below king Arthur’s bread  flour and around the same as KA’s apf.  So I used the flour to make with my rye starter : sourdough bread.  The oven spring was good, and more closer to King Arthur’s apf.  One star down because this is expensive for an Apf.  Taste wise, the sourdough bread was good, but nothing exceptional.  Nonetheless, a lovely four to work with.  I will the flour for rolls and sandwich bread.

title: Top notice freshness aNd quality
text: The quality of the flaked fish is top notch.  Freshness is very good.  Great to see this available on amazon as access to Japanese grocery stores is not alway easy.  We use this with ramen, congee and baked fish.  Delicious and delicate flavor.

title: Low protein at 10%, better for none bread recipes.
text: I use this flour as a combination of other flour for my sourdough baking.  Note that the protein is 10%, which is weak for sourdough bread - I will add some vital gluten to supplement the lower protein.  The brand doesn’t recommend for yeasted bread.  I also recommend this for cookies, flatbread, and brownies recipes.  Otherwise, great flour blend to use in lieu of plain flour/all purpose flour.

title: Always impressed with freshness and quality.
text: Great fresh ingredients, although the amount is a lot unless you make a lot of curries. I guess we will now to avoiding wasting the ingredients. We have used a number of items from this brand, we remain impressed with the quality and freshness.  Made great curries at home.

title: Fresh, nice low heat: warm flavor
text: Fresh and nice to grind your own peppers. The heat is low, but gives a good low heat in curries.  I like the freshness of the dried chilies.  Just the right amount to keep the ingredients fresh and not end up throwing away.  Using this spice in marinades and rib rubs.

title: greta for gluten sensitivity - perfect for baking and sauce thickening.
text: an alternative for both gluten free baking and thickening of sauces.  the quality is great and as good as the regular brand I use to thicken my sauces.  I would use a 20% more of this over the requirement for xanthem - just enhances the performance of bread.

title: Very fresh and yummy with fish.
text: Great for fish dishes, but the cilantro had a bit of lemony tang to it.  All the flavors taste fresh and light.  Very fresh ingredients.  Works great with sword fish, bass and salmon.  Phew, I no longer struggle to come up with a new way to cook fish.

title: Yum.
text: Delicious.  Strong smooth roast.  Worked beautifully with pour over coffee.  No bitterness- just smooth tasting coffee.  What I needed in the morning.  Got my thumbs up.

title: love this brand - intensity is 9 to 10
text: very intense.  a lean towards french roast.  you dont need to have lavazza machine as I use the granules with pour over coffee.  I love this brand of coffee and one capsule is all you need per cup.  tasty and  definitely would qualify for my  first cuppa in the morning - strong and tasty.

title: okay coffee: 7 intensity with slight french bitterness.
text:
strong coffee, not smooth. leaning into French roast but not that bitter in taste. fits my nesspresso mini just fine.
a good punch for my second morning cuppa. great cream. I tried the granules with my pour over coffee contraption: it takes out the bitterness. The capsule is plastic except for the cover. Although I wish they moved towards an aluminum capsule. it is time for the environment.

title: 100% tasty [little heat and sweet].
text: holy molly - delicious.  the heat factor is 3/10 and with a sweetness [not sourness, as on the box].  We used this with homemade ramen and bonita flakes.  too yummy and tasty.  Ingredients are fairly healthy and no unpronounceable ingredients.  an easy ingredient to enhance a ramen experience.

title: Great quality and healing properties from manuka honey
text: Manuka honey was my mum’s go to for healing: sore throat, coughs, feeling run down,  or getting sleep.  A tablespoon with mug of hot water.  It does the trick.  The quality from NZ is what I always buy.  The quality of the honey was excellent at this honey grade and price point.  Highly recommend.

title: yum and healthy.
text: as an alternative to honey for plain almond milk yogurt - this is  quite delicious.  Given the healthy attributes associated with medjool dates: happy to intake this via liquid form.  ingredients are largely healthy.  easy to squeeze bottles.  another healthy addition to our healthy eating options.

title: Subtle flavors of the rosemary Nd lemon. Great for white meat and fish.
text: More salt than lemon aNd rosemary.  We tried it as part rub on baby back ribes.  Both the rosemary and lemon were subtle, but noticeable.  Definitely helped with the tenderizing before cooking.  I would use this for chicken, pork and fish.  I like the amount isn’t large, as spices can expire before you finish using it.  The magnetic bottom works! The lid is secure and hence you can tilt it without lid falling off; and magnetic power is strong enough to hold the tin, but not that strong you are yanking it off the fridge, for example.

title: Solid brand, and tasty soup for any noodles
text: Yummy, instant miso soup for our ramen noodles.  Very easy to prep and it’s a brand I prefer for this product.  Ingredients are decent, but does have flavoring on top of the other good ingredients.

title: Perfect little in between nibble.
text: Very moist, chewy, not overtly too sweet.  Nice small size to cover a moment of hunger.  Not too filling, and perfect to throw in the back pack.

title: Strong caffeine without the bitterness
text: Nice strong dark roasted bean smell upon opening the bag.  I ground it for pour over coffee [medium granules]- not that strong.  But good caffeine kick. The taste was not bitter,,but nice and smooth.  That is one thing about Pour over, the bitterness is often removed during the process.  I really like the taste of the coffee beans.

title: Great quality ingredients, lovely flavor.
text: This is one of my favorite brands for very interesting and healing tea. The quality of the ingredients is exceptional.  This taste has a good lemon zing and you can taste the tumeric and ginger.  I love drinking the tea cold and steeped for 10 minutes.  It’s a great late afternoon drink after an afternoon meditation.

title: Good medium [italian] roasted coffee.
text: Tried these granules via pour over method.  The taste is definitely medium roast...smooth.  Still had a good caffeine kick.  An Italian roast lean with no bitter after taste that often comes with French roast.  The granules are medium large, great for French press and pour over methods.  Not fine enough for nespresso machines-you would need to grind them some more.  Great value for great taste.  I like the ‘lower cost’ amazon brand [happy belly] - have bought a number of kitchen stables.

title: Another great product from Nature’s Way
text: Great brand for starters.  I love eating this with yogurt.  So delicious.  Taste and crunch are just right.  Great way to take tumeric, ginger, both a natural anti-inflammation agent.  Gluten free - important to know s gluten is inflammation inducing for certain individuals.  It’s a conscious choice, and having this granola mix with right anti-inflammation mix helps a busy person to know they are getting all the help in any meal intake.  Sugar used is coconut - great, as we are moving away from cane to monk fruit and coconut sugars in both our cooking and baking.

title: A winning way to enjoy ancient grains.
text: Great way to enjoy ancient grains with a pre-flavored ready to cook pack.  We love the sublime curry flavor, and would like a bit more raisins.  So easy to prepare and cook [10 mins, tops].  We had it with stewed chicken and the flavors blended well.  each pack serves 4..I would say a generous 3 servicings.  The grain would have minimal flavor without the mix, the grains were tiny. Loved trying out a new ancient grain [into my sourdough where ancient grains are a lot healthier for you.]. Will buy again.  The mixes added were all names I could read and recognize.

title: No expiration date. 1lb is a lot of spices.
text: Just made cinnamon buns.  The spice is fresh and delicious in the cake.  Lovely warm flavors.  My only pointer is that you need to use a lot of cinnamon to get through 1lb.  Also, no expiration date.  Whilst it states it is tested in CA, certified organic.  I don’t have enough background to assess.  Like all spices, you can smell when a spice has expired.  I wouldn’t use it beyond 2 years, and with no expiration date. I will note when I got this and smell it in 1 year.

title: Great tasting matcha.
text: It is strong, so I had to scale back the quantity I usually use in my big mug.  There are so many health benefits, and after my coffee cuppa in the morning, I shift towards tea to stay hydrated for the rest of the day. Very strong matcha and tastes fresh. There is a seal, but to keep freshness, I use a ‘breathable’ coffee canister to keep it fresh.

title: Very devious chicken rub.  All natural ingredients
text: Oooh, so yummy perfect.  We marinaded chicken thighs in this rub with some canola oil; baked it with potatoes.  The aroma from the oven was Devine-had an Indian curry aroma.  We didn’t add any salt, just the rub mix.  Man, the meat was so moist and the flavor was deliciously subtle with light smokiness.  Careful in opening the lid, just some spillage when tin is still full.  A keeper. Key ingredients: chilli pepper, paprika, brown sugar, salt, pepper, garlic and onion.  All natural ingredients.

title: Moorish aNd so good
text: I was hoping hub won’t like it as he ordinarily does not like seaweeds.  Heck, he loved them as much as I do.  Each bag has a seal, but it is not needed...too moorish to keep any in the bag once it is open!  Cookies or seaweed... both have calories, but a little seaweed is better than ingredients in a cookie, ha.

title: Yum yum. Great quality jasmine rice.
text: Yum yum.  The rice is very good - you can tell in the texture [we are big jasmine rice and Japanese rice consumers - these are the quality rice].  Cooked perfectly, didn’t go into mush shape.

title: Solid medium roast with a lean towards French roast after taste.
text: Good coffee flavor [used with my drip coffee apparatus]. The after taste leans towards French roast [bitter after taste].  Whilst I am not a fan of French roast, the fact this is medium roast, the after taste wasn’t off putting at all - still felt I had a great morning cuppa [ I drink 2 coffees in the morning, tea thereafter].  It is good to see more women involvement, but not sure at what level and whether they have any decision making capacity, or just worker bees.

title: Great medium roast coffee, not a fan of the pod design [still too much plastic]
text: I used 2 pods of coffee with my drip coffee filter:  nice smooth and yet good caffeine kick that I need in the morning.  The coffee bean was fine grind- and you can transfer to reusable nespresso pods.  On the design of the k-cup pods: whilst the overall idea to work with less plastic there is still plastic in the ring of the cup, and I noticed for the cover there is a thin layer of plastic facing the ground coffee.  My personal preference is use ground coffee, not these convenient pods unless you have metal reusable pods with aluminum Cover.

title: Yum, citrus light - great for fish/seafood
text: Oooh yum.  The citrus comes through in most delightful way:  applied it to sole, sword fish->. Really adds and not subtract when eating with fresh fish.  A keeper.  I can recognize all the ingredients except for two that were at the end...and ingredients weren’t modified.

title: A good alternative to frozen berries, takes up less storage space
text: I am happy there is no added sugar.  The apple juice is more a natural preservative.  I placed them in some hot water overnight, they plumped up somewhat and I used them in my apple and blueberry pie bake.  Tasted good given that blueberry season is over.  Happy to use these preserved berries as an alternative to frozen berries.  I store them in freezer/fridge once opened.

title: Bourbon hot on first bite
text: Woo, that is hot and you get a kick of the hour on right at the beginning. Not so hot that it lingers.  Great with guacamole, burgers, drizzle over skirt steaks.  Good heat.  I like the heat without any unusual taste that comes with other hot sauce.  Just pure hot sauce.

title: Lovely smooth coffee, no butter after taste. Great beans.
text: This is deliciously smooth and still had a good punch that I need in my morning cuppa.  I was surprised as I have tasted many non Nespresso branded coffee pods.  This is by far by top 5 at this moment.  I am not a great fan of plastic,,but in terms of coffee taste: great beans.  Not bitter after taste.

title: Devine.  Simple, pure.
text: When you can see the good chunky pieces of yellow fin tuna, and the only other ingredient is olive oil: it tasted, well, just yum.  We had it in its straight of the jar form with heirloom tomatoes and avocado:  joy.  We will get more as we love tuna and Mayo sandwiches [homemade brioche buns].  I am not wasting the oil as I will use it to drizzle over fish dishes with a little mix of either mustard or sweet white miso paste.

title: Calmer
text: It does not have a strong flavor, even after leaving the mixture to steep for 15 minutes. You can drink it warm or cold, and even add a dash of honey.  I drink a lot of tea so this tea became my afternoon cuppa.  I noticed my moods were better and generally better mental energy.  I do have anxiety and modest depression [severe at one point] that I manage on a daily basis through diet, meditation and exercise.  I am not on meditation, which is a choice even at height of my anxiety.  I drink this tea every other day and I feel calmer and able to process my day more smoothly.  I did not notice any side effects.

title: Worked just as well as leaves.
text: I want sure if a powdered leaves would work as well as dried leaves for my rendang curry.  I had nothing to worry about as the powder was very fresh and worked just as well. I would recommend to vacuum seal what you wouldn’t be using in next few months to keep a longer shelf life.

title: Good flavor, good quality
text: Made my rendang curry - delicious.  I rehydrated the root with some hot water before use.  The flavor was very good. Happy with this product for my Thai recipes.

title: Quality, quality, quality.  Yum.
text: Lovely quality matcha for tea consumption.  I also use matcha in my almond yogurt, and sometimes in my baking [sourdough bread, focaccia and cakes].  With the Hugh quality of this matcha, I will keep it for tea and yogurts!  Nice strong and warm flavor. Very happy to find this quality brand that I can now buy in line.

title: Deliciously fragrant and light, no milk or sugar needed
text: This was a favorite tea of my mum’s and she introduced it to me whenever we were in our family’s dim sum visits.  Deliciously light, beautiful fragrance and just calming to the soul.  So happy to find a brand that carries those memories for me. Even if you seep it too long, it still retains it light flavor and not a heaviness often associated with black tea leaves.

title: Delicious with freshly made sourdough bread.  Smokey goodness.
text: A little acquired taste if you usually like sugar, but we have been reducing the amount of sugar in cooking and baking and replacing it where needed with monk fruits.  That said, no sugar with this butter did not sacrifice the lovely peanut flavor - great with homemade sourdough bread.  I like food with minimum ingredients- so you enjoy its purest food.  We are happy to convert to no sugar peanut butter.

title: Strong coffee, not smooth, but does the job you need
text: Good strong coffee when using the bean granules as pour over, French press coffee. Not a smooth tasting coffee, but not dissimilar to the taste of mcD’s over the counter coffee.  I tried the granules in a vertuoso pod - coffee was too weak.  Good, grab and go coffee if you need a pick me up during afternoon.  I just need a smoother start to my morning.

title: Delicious jasmine tea.
text: Pu-erh tea is supposed to be high quality and this jasmine tea did not disappoint.  Even stewed for 10 minutes, the tea was still light.  Delicious light jasmine tea, very refreshing.  Comes in an individually sealed foiled bag.

title: Good GF alternative
text: Gluten free flour is best blended with other GF flour.  This is a soft flour and I made cheese biscuits with buckwheat combo, and tried a pancake mix with brown rice and almond flour.  It does not have a distinctive flavor, but does have a good texture with the end bakes.  Curious to try this with a GF loaf next.

title: Healing broth.
text: We are a family of brew and have made our own broth as part of regular health maintenance.  Nice to see a quality brand to make life a little less busy.  Taste yummy and you add your own seasoning to suit.  Great to drink as is or make a pho soup, matzo ball soup.  Just delicious.

title: Yum.
text: Yum for making fresh custards and cheesecakes.  Wow, it gives quite a punch, and a huge plus versus the liquid form.  Very pleased with the quality.

title: Fresh and great peppery taste for seasoning.
text: Very good quality peppercorns.  Has a lovely burst of spice and I love the smell of fresh peppercorn.  The quantity is huge for one house that cooks all the time. Comes in self sealing bag, and there was no sell by date.  But you can tell when peppercorns are no longer fresh to use, and these were not in that state.

title: Water, beet and lemon juice.
text: Easy to drink in small bite size bottles.  The taste is fine, and we are all trying to intake natural antioxidants.  Water, beet and lemon juice.  Could make it myself, but life gets busy enough with so much cooking at home re lockdown.

title: Yum with moussaka, shepherds pie great for red meat
text: Delicious spice for any red meat dishes.  We used it with beef tacos, shepherds pie, moussaka ... whilst combined with other herbs, marjoram adds a wee more sweetness.  We make our own mixed spice when doing any stew like dishes.  Quality is good, and two bags might seem a lot, you can never add too much of this healthy herb.

title: Great way to access pour over coffee on the go
text: I ordinarily love a dark Italian roast. This coffee is slightly on the lighter side, but still have a satisfactory punch that I need in the morning.  The contraption to creat the pour over coffee is pretty cool, and works with wide moth mugs.  The only thing is that due to the smaller mouth of the filter you need to be present to pour the amount of water you want.  A small inconvenience as there is less cleaning afterwards.  I definitely see this being useful for camping,,mobile, on the go environments.

title: Good quality salt.
text: Great salt, use it in a grinder and I couldn’t be happier with the quality.  It’s hard to find quality salt, and I rather use larger crystals than the already ground salt.

title: Natural antioxidants and fun for bread baking.
text: Either you eat it with your yogurt, which is my preference . I also tried it with baking focaccia - what fun to play with Natural coloring.  With level of stress in 2020, I am looking for natural antioxidants to incorporate into my daily life to reduce inflammation.  First time trying this product and I am impressed how easy to intake and some fun with my bread baking.

title: really??  the amount of plastic/packaging to enjoy a cup of coffee?
text:
crap - it came in a big white box with fancy big bow - each pod is individually wrapper in thick plastic. Okay - in this day and age of really: LETS TAKE CARE OF OUR EARTH. I did not like the excessive amount of packaging. the pods are plastic too. I am dinging this product for excess not earth friendly packaging - we should learn to make this more earth friendly.

The coffee: decent crema, good italian roast flavor for both nesspresso and I tried it as a pour over coffee. good strong medium roast. Whilst I enjoyed this coffee - I wouldn't buy it for the sheer amount of 'waste' that came with it - way too much packaging - it is old school.

title: fabulous and fresh.
text: Gosh, i love using this spice for risotto and simple all butter pasta dishes - just elevates.  The quality is very good and the expiration date gave me a shelf life of 30 months.  the glass container is perfect for this spice.  I love the origin of the product.

title: Qu;airy spice, love it .
text:
It’s a beautiful spice and you can never add too much in your cooking. I use this spice for many meat dishes when you are cooking it down. Made moussaka last night and complimented with the bay leaf, oregano and cinnamon stick. Looking forward to making curries, as this spice will make the flavor pop.
Comes 2 pack of 6 oz, which is a lot of spice- the expiration date was just under 2 years upon delivery- 2 years is the average expiration for most spices. Bag seal is strong, but I tend to place them in airtight container once opened.

title: Wow, delicious.
text: Wow, with just water, you get an amazing chocolate drink, and the salt is always a great compliment to chocolate.  You don’t need to make it with milk, as there is some viscosity from guar gum and I don’t feel I was drinking a watery product.  The family is happy as it is hard to find decent chocolate drinks. Cane sugar is the 3rd ingredient, and works for vegans.

title: Good GF floor
text: Great gluten free flour, used as a mix with three other GF flours for bread [add pea protein to strengthen the bread], waffles and pancakes.  Goodies have tasted great.  Happy to support small businesses especially where the products are good quality.

title: Great natural product.
text: I like this brand’s powdered fruit.  I use it with my yogurt and whilst it is tart, it has no added sugar, and I temper the tartness with some honey.  Delicious.  Tried a number of their products, and I am pretty impressed.

title: Great product, natural with no added sugar
text: I have tired a number of this brand’s products.  This one is just as good.  Very natural, with no added sugar. I add these powder to my morning yogurt.  These fruit powder is great way to support the immune system.  And mine is fried from the pandemic lock down.  So a lot of self care now. It is a little tart, but you can do some honey to the yogurt.  This would be great for smoothies too.

title: Easy to digest with yogurt
text: With my morning almond milk yogurt:  I love applying these powdered natural goodies, anything from dried berries powder to this mushroom.  The texture is gritty relative to the yogurt - negligible flavor [which is great by the way].  I am hoping the claim on these mushrooms will support anti inflammation, which risen as a result of the Covid lock down and racial unrest.  Taken This for couple of days, no negative effect, and noticing my body is sleeping/resting  longer rather waking up at 4am feeling totally tense/scared.

title: Excellent quality, cooked and tasted like any high end brand rice.
text: Great rice, and we cook in a famous Japanese brand rice cooker.  We eat a lot of rice, and we couldn’t tell the difference from The high end rice brand we ordinarily buy.  Delicious.

title: really greta blend,  Love the tea
text: Just watch the cups you use - as it does stain from the natural turmeric.  I have a brew in mid morning, after my coffee.  It has a lovely warm taste and I may add a spoonful of honey if I am looking for something a little sweet.  This is a very good mix of tea and turmeric and the latter was not over powering to the chamomile taste,  a winner in my book.  aside from all the goodness from both key ingredients - it is a good tea.  Love the packaging that came with the product.  Happy to purchase more in the future,  I like the fact the owner honored his father by naming the brand after him, in sorts.

title: medium heat, warm flavor to our gurney chili
text: I was too cautious the first time I used the peppers - just in case the heat was high.  the heat is medium [for us] and we like the warmth of the heat.  Now a new chili for our turkey chili dinners and we really like the alternative that we have used that produce a lot of heat but does not have the warmth.

title: Delicious with almond yogurt.
text: When I have my almond unsweetened yogurt- it’s when I get creative.  Honey and a tablespoon of this blackcurrnt powder..it does have a tart and sharp taste.  Kinda wakes you up!  Delicious alternative to fresh berries.

title: Monk fruit is best alternative to cane sugar
text: Monk fruit is my go to sugar equivalent ingredient for all my baking.  This brand isn’t bad at all.  You can taste the sweetness more in the baked goods.  It melts beautifully in the baking even though the granular shape is a tad larger than caster sugar.  You need to check how other brands as their end products look more natural.

title: Tasty with poke bowls.
text: Lovely sea taste when sprinkled on poke bowl meals.  Just the right amount of salt.  The only downside was the packaging ink ‘leaked’ and stained our countertop when it touched some moisture..the trick is to apply a damn cloth with white vinegar for a few hours to remove.

title: Great pure 100% date product.
text: Not naturally sweet.  I use this with my plain unsweetened almond yogurt as an alternative to dark amber honey.  It isn’t that sweet and I am happy there is no added sweetener- all natural.  Date is healthy for you, and I get to add this component to my morning intake.  Definitely recommend for pancakes in lieu of maple syrup.  Not sure I would use it for baking, but in lieu of honey in bagels - worth trying it.

title: Didn’t have the deep dark roast flavor.
text: Meh. Large grind. For a dark roast, I was hoping for a big punch and wake me up taste.  It just didn’t happen.  I used in nespresso virtuoso cup.  Disappointed, as I loved the medium roast version, which had more bunch.

title: Ooh so yum.
text: Really tasty product.  The hot one was hot..great crunch and taste.  Hub does not ordinarily eat this stuff and he chomped brought a whole packet without me!  Not greasy finish.  All the flavors were palatable.  Great for parties and snacking.

title: Decent brew but love the design of the capsule.
text: I gave this an extra star for the packaging- more earth friendly and no additional plastic.  Well done.  The new capsules are more of a linen pouch and the moment you open the new packager, which has a breathing button and sealant, the beautiful fresh coffee aroma hits you onto a high note. The coffee saint bad, definitely strong for a medium roast, and has a little kick that I find a French roasts give you.  I normally drink the coffee with extra milk.

title: Personal thing: didn’t work for me.
text: Nada, the taste just didn’t work for me and I am avid tea drinker.  I love ginger, I love white tea, and I love pear...however I this tea combo..nope.  I love their earl grey tea so much that I thought I would give this a try.  I wished they had a sample box that I could try before buying in such bulk size.  Passing these onto other tea lovers and see if this works for them.

title: Good product.
text: You need to soak them for a couple of hours before cooking.  Better if you soak them overnight.  Love adding these grains to homemade soup - gives it more substance and great healthy filler from pasta.  Love the texture and does not have a strong flavor.

title: Delicious.
text: It is delicious.  I could just eat it by the spoonful.  We use it with potato latkies, pork chops, pancakes. Just yum.

title: Brilliant flavor- love his tea.
text: Delicious!  One of the best earl grey tea.  Definitely follow instructions And seep the tea for 3 to 5 mins and then add milk.  Very fragrant and had full depth in the taste.  I was modestly surprised how refreshing the cuppa tea was.  Great afternoon cuppa.

title: Perfect for anyone who uses a lot of milk.
text:
When in lock down - this powder milk came into its own when I was baking. Once open, it does not have a long shelf life of 2 weeks once open - but with combo of cups of teas, coffee, and baking: I was surprised how quickly we used the item. I used it all up within 4 weeks and kept it in cool and dark location, and with no deterioration of product.
ratio is one part powder, 4 part water. store the combined liquid in fridge is not using it all immediately.
Perfect for baking, as some recipes ask for a lot of milk and instead of lugging a lot of wet products - this tin is light and large. I couldn't be happier. Flavor its great - like milk and has no funny smell or after taste.

title: Must for British baked goods
text: Great That this is available for purchase.  Such a stable for British baking.  Very distinctive taste.  A must for genuine flavored baked recipes.  Only issue is the packaging to minimize denting and crushing.

title: sooo easy to use. Plenty of berth to hit the mark!
text: If you gave bad eye sights, big fat thumbs...this is fab.  That early in the morning, I arent coordinated.  I love that the whole set up isn't looking for laser precision to work.  So easy to use.  And I can use some of my fav beans.  Highly recommend.  I looked at a few, and this worked as I hoped.

title: Love the flavor, strong enough.
text: Love the flavor on this one...great for mid day or not so sluggish morning cuppa. It does have a smooth flavor and yum yum.  Great addition to the vertuo line.

title: Smooth Italian roasted tasting coffee: my go to in the morning.
text: One of my favorite morning brew to kick start the day: lovely smooth coffee taste and zing, I am awake to get on with my day.  It is more of an Italian roast that doesn’t have the bitter taste of a French roast.  I prefer an Italian roasted coffee!

title: Good coffee flavor without the full caffeinated effect for mid day cuppa
text: Whilst it is decaf, the brew taste is still quite strong and as it is lungo, I often cut the cycle a little shot-et as I like my coffee with a bit more of bite.  Great for mid afternoon pick me up without the intensity of a full caffeinated drink.  I love the nesspresso virtuoline coffee, graduated up from their original line, which I still love.

title: Love this product
text: It’s our go to gluten free morning pancake mix!  Super fluffy, little chew, and it is the best flavor out there.  One cup goes a long way! Love it

title: Still a great tasting cuppa coffee.
text: Mid afternoon lull...I love that you still,can taste a strong coffee, feel a kick to get through a sluggish afternoon without the high caffeine lingering in the body.  Certainly had no problems sleeping.  The taste was strong enough that you feel you are still enjoying a great cuppa coffee.  Not a bitter taste- more of an Italian roast.

title: Ya, nice kick start to your morning. Early birds beware!
text: After falling in love with the original line, this was a treat and pressure for self to move to the vertuoline.  I love the strong smooth taste of this coffee.  The crema for his line is super thick.  If you love a real dose of coffee to kick start your day..and the quantity you need: I love the taste.  I often have to have 2 original size capsules per cup..now one is more than sufficient.  Love this new coffee.

title: Nice starter and boast your starter.
text: It really kick started my white bread flour starter during the cold weather. Now my starter is functioning well.  At the ENd of the day you still need to take care of your starter with good flour [don’t use bleached], luke warm water, temperature and oxygen.].  I use the no,waste approach. Feed what you need to use the next day, then store in fridge.  The throw away approach is wasting good flour.

title: Yummy gravy.
text: Great flavor and we used this to make gravy with beef and lamb.  Very easy to use and taste great.  Don’t need ad salt..this isn’t salt free, 35%. Hence dilute to reduce sodium as needed.

title: Great value replacement without compromising flavor and texture
text: If you love ranch flavored salad dressing then this is a great value replacement with good ingredients.  The dressing is nice and thick.  The amazon brand have come far and continue to out do even its own 365 brand!

title: Quality tea: rich and flavorful
text: Delicious.  Rich and deep jasmine flavor.  Love this brand and jasmine option.  T2 is a great brand that offers great and affordable tea.  Okay, this is now my got jasmine tea.

title: pretty yummy.
text: there is another name brand I use and whilst this does not look the same... it is just as yummy as the other brand.  In fact, I use it in the same manner as the other brand: lovely taste and consistency.  the ingredients are largely the same with some minor differences, but they are placed lower in the quantity.  Price point, Happy belly is cheaper.  It comes down to personal preference.

title: finally, a good non nesspresso brand - strong intensity
text: Finally a non nesspresso brand that actually taste like coffee.  I have tried so many and thrown so many away.  Whilst there is the plastic issue - the price point is very affordable.  This brand coffee tends to be stronger than Nespresso rating, and so try a lower number.  This one is intense and great strong coffee taste.

title: Just yummy however they present the chocolate
text: Individually wrapped toblerone chocolate- helps to manage the quantity I eat in one sitting, well almost.  The nougat needs a few chew once the chocolate deliciously melts in the mouth.  Top three flavors: the original milk cho, white and dark chocolate.

title: Delicious chocolate with nougat
text: We love this chocolate...something for everyone, whether you like milk, White or dark chocolate.  The nougat does need a few chew once the chocolate has melted in your mouth.  Love love love.  They were all gone in a week.

title: For health: cooking oil.
text: Powerful oil for health and we use it for all cooking.  you can use it at high heat for stir fries without the 'smoking' of the kitchen.  Just great for health as it is a better fat to cook with.  Definitely, improves your health as part of many practices you need to engage in.  the flavor is not intrusive.

title: what a delight and a terrific tea brand.
text: I am having so much fun and instead of chocolate advent calendar - I am testing myself to various variety of tea!  So far I love the teas sampled to-date. The first one I thought I would not enjoy and I was surprised how deliciously warm it was to the tongue.  I Love tea and being open minded to try new flavors is making December a lot of fun.  the quality of the tea is excellent and as should be expected from this greta tea brand.

title: finally a brand that does not compromise on taste and crema is great
text: I was surprised how smooth this product tasted and the strength is actually more of a 6 plus relative to a known brand.  I have tried so many non-espresso brand [with plastic tube] and end up throwing away a lot of money ... and finally, I have to say - this is a good product for the price and I am not compromising on taste.  Crema is high and the only slight snag is that the water is challenged to come through on a few pods - I just push the button to run the water again.  Not a game stopper.

title: Wow, great intensity at 4, taste is good.
text: With the known brand I am normally .6 to 9 intensity. I was surprised that this brand @4 was surprisingly strong and well rounded smoothness.  Great crema.  A lot of the plastic tub brands leave a weird taste and we have tried so many and threw so many away.  I am impressed with this brand, great tasting coffee at half the price.  I am now curious to try other intensity of this brand.

title: Delicious
text: I love this brand. The content you recognized and well produced.  I steep fruit teas for 5 minutes as they are never as strong as black tea, and I like strong flavor.  The taste was perfect and not strong.  I add some honey and it is a great soothing drink.  I drink a lot of tea in the afternoon, and nice not to add more caffeine with this tea.  The pouch seal works great and keeps a strong seal.

title: greta green tea flavor with touch of lemon.
text: The green tea flavor is light and you can detect the lemon flavor.  I like the tea, as even when I left it to brew for 10 minutes, it did not taste heavy.  It is a lovely refreshing brew when the weather gets cold.  I like the package as it sealed the tea leaves very well.

title: stronger than a medium roast: strong coffee
text: If you like very strong coffee then this is the one for you.  I would place this on the slightly bitter side and not smooth.  However, the coffee was super fresh and I would recommend transferring to a specialized coffee sealed can if you can't drink it all within 2 weeks.  I would say this is stronger than a medium roast.

title: No 2 ingredient: sugar
text: Sugar is the number 2 ingredient.  That aside, it is tasty and refreshing. Shame about the sugar ingredient.

title: Garlicky good
text: This brand is great for air dried jerky.  The garlic flavor is tasty and hits on just the right potency.  It is not that salty.  The amount goes a long way, and a few pieces is more than satisfactory.  The meat is good, without excessive fat/chewiness.  Hope they could reduce the plastic packaging in future.  Ie use paper with thin plastic lining.

title: Spicy good.
text: Love the air-dried and this brand.  Quality of the meat is good without excess fat/extra chew that are in other brands. So it is worth to pay a little bit more.  Unlike the juicy sauce covered jerky, I noticed we don’t eat the packet in one go!  So the packet lasts us a few days as the flavor is quite intense and satisfactory with a few pieces.  My only hope is plastic packaging is reduced seems excessive for the quantity of the product.

title: Air dried and not saucy
text:
if you like a saucy finish to the jerky - these are not for you. These are air dried and has no sauce: other than the various flavored jerky. Overall, salty, especially the original ones, and the spicy ones have a nice kick without burning the tongue. Because they were more salty, i wasn't eating them all in one go: hence, each pack lasted me quite a few days. the quality of the meat is good, and does not have a lot of fat/chewy finish.

I ended up liking these as I wasn't over consuming them as I do like the 'saucy' ones.

title: Quite a mild coffee.
text: Great freshness, and the grounded to sized up for brewing, not for espresso brew.  The decaf flavor is mild and not that strong with the exception of the cafe Verona brand.  I prefer a strong flavor even though it is decaf.  The freshness of the pack is good, but I recommend a vacuum seal jar once it is opened.  [preferred the nespresso pods].

title: Solid fillet of fish, and delicious
text: One of the best brands out there. There were mainly solid fillets of fish, bathed in lovely oil.  So you know you are not getting scraps of other parts of the fish.
