Delicious to eat at room temperature or slightly warmed in the microwave [without the tin].  Delicious.  Easy to open.  Well worth the money.

title: Same great taste/easier squeeze bottle
text: I have tried so many brands of mayo, and this remains our first love in taste.  The new squeeze bottle is as they claim, no mess in after squeeze.  So easy to use.  Whilst I reminisce the old glass containers, this works now and maybe one day we can get back to glass containers.

title: the future? and should be implemented now.
text: in anticipation of when no more plastic bottled water - this product is ready and in fact should be the go to product now.  You need to drink the water when you open it as the fizz will disappear within an hour of opening.  The flavor - just like fizzy water!  100% support that this is recyclable and not plastic!

title: another solid product from Amazon brand.
text:
It is crazy to have an Amazon branching into a family staple and yet again the product does not disappoint and at a great value. it was easy to cook, and even over cooking for a few minutes, the pasta did not fall apart. the family didnt notice any difference from another major brand we use.

a winner and given the value, it is likely we will buy this product in the future.

title: Serious competitor to the Brand.
text: Wow. The packaging, the capsule is just like Nespresso. I love dark coffee, and the intensity delivers. I have to compare this intensity with my nespresso favorite:  it is not as smooth, but still solid.  The price point is the same, but save and subscribe on some of the roasts might yield a 5% savings.  In terms of competing with nespresso, this brand does deliver, and I have tried many [lower proced] capsules that does not deliver.  I am not generally a Starbuck’s coffee person, but I seriously converted with these Nespresso capsules. Just wished it was a tad cheaper. at the same price point, one may stick with the original.

title: Freshly delicious.
text: This is a great brand, and the quality of the fish did not disappoint. Well packed and not squashed.  The chili ingredient was not strong at all, slight hint of heat.  It was delicious to eat with or without slight heating.  One noticeable change was the ease it was to open as there is now a strong plastic seal, no longer a metal cap.  I liked it, but concerned that the new cover is less recycling friendly.

title: refreshing drink.
text: i love these drinks, in general.  The ginger is not strong in this drink and the lemon is not sharp either.  it is a lovely refreshing drink that I take after a strenuous workout.  the sparkling aspect is strong.  great refreshing drink without any crazy addictive: interesting to see there is apple juice in the ingredients, which might explain the non-too lemony taste.  Stevia is mentioned as the sweetener of choice.

title: another pasta win.
text: it does not fall apart if cooked a little longer than recommended on the package.  this is good news.  It is pretty firm and it is hard to distinguish from some of the big brands.  It competes well in this space.  Amazon brand is 'elbowing' in a strong stable and this is value packed and for simple mac snd cheese: this a strong competitor.  it isnt a gourmet product, but a good stable.

title: best ready made capsules that isnt the Nespresso brand
text: Surprisingly good.  I like the strong italian espresso flavor coffee, and I ordinarily like to grind fresh beans. I have tried a lot of brands with ready to go capsules.  I was wrong to pre-judge this brand.  Whilst I wasn't a fan of the slightly fruitier/sweet varieties, the stronger varieties and espresso capsules were good.  I only needed one capsule per cup to get a satisfactory morning jolt!  I certainly would buy this brand as back ups when I am least inclined to grind fresh beans.

title: super great ingredients.
text: this is pure goodness and a solid brand that we discovered with their ketchup.  we are very partial to another great  brand [H] and hence, anything in terms of taste will pale a little in comparison.  the flavor is good and very creamy texture.  We use this with making burger 'secret' sauce, and potato salads.  It is pricy, but the ingredients on here are very pure, and compares well with other 'organic' brands.

title: Our favorite for chicken.
text: Often hard to find a good and organic quality chicken stock.  We have used this brand for many years, and it is one of our favorites.  It has a deep jou flavor, and you don’t need a lot to get that lovely flavor.  I love this product when I am making a roasted chicken gravy, sou vide chicken. It just adds a beautiful compliment to the protein.  I love it.  We tried so many or read so many labels!  It brings your chicken to whole new and higher level of finished product.

title: Great quality.
text: Love them. Great quality.  Pricey, but worth it compared with other brands i have tried.

title: definitely no added sweetness with these chips.
text: this is not a 'sweet' product and if you haven't reduced your sweet tooth then this product will taste 'bitter'.  We used these chips in muffins and it cooked well.  I think i will put in some honey to sweeten the deal a bit.  if you are used to the low sugar taste then these are great to bake with.

title: great go to nibble that is healthier than french fries!
text: if you are on the go and know you need to squeeze some natural food in between errands, then you will love these fruit pushes.  they are not overtly sweet and you can taste the fruit.  I love that you can close the top to fit in how much you can eat at any one time.  so easy to carry in my back pack.

title: Intense, zippy energy. Goodness.
text: Love the intense green tea taste, I have been drinking this for 2 weeks as part of overall detox program.  Drink it first think in the morning, and my energy is zipping to get my day going.  It does have caffeine and hence the effects it has on me, I don’t drink this after noon.  I prefer this to many green tea ‘in bags’.  You can also add this to smoothies, but it does have a strong flavor, and works well with blueberries/oranage juice/banana mix.

title: Yummy goodness. Love it
text: Nice. No added sweetener, which some will not like if you are a soda drinker.  I love that it is fizzy with light tough of lemon, ginger, and very light coconut taste.  It has electrolytes and I drink this after an aerobic workout.  Keep it cool in refrigerator and good to drink. Recycling is not offered, but I recycle this s part of cans.

title: nice strong rounded flavor without the usual bitterness associated with french roasted beans.
text: ordinarily i don't love french roast as the bitterness is over powering for my taste buds.  I like to grind beans for my Nespresso machine.  wow, these beans had a good strong flavor without the bitterness.  rounded. great cuppa for start of my morning.  noticed that there is no filter in the bag to allow for the beans to breathe and given the size, i wonder if the beans will stay fresh.

title: strong green tea.
text: i love this brand.  STRONG green tea flavor, and I learnt to use less for my afternoon tea.  the flavor is fresh and not that smoky.  the product is top in quality ingredients and the whole packaging is functional and seals in freshness.  i have a number of this brand flavors - love them all.

title: Fancy garnish.
text: Something fancy that we used on avocado salad: presentation and taste were fab.  Ha, I never thought I would go this fancy with my salt.  This is definitely to be used as a garnish/presentation.  Love the brand.  Interesting, as we are trying to use less salt in cooking, so this salt is great for ‘add’ it yourself.

title: Great taste. Smooth.
text: Smooth taste, is definitely not hard tap water for sure!  Love the mouth piece, so easy to use and flows really nicely.  Shape of the bottle is comfortable to hold [for adults]. Love this taste versus other brands.  Recycling of plastic bottle is a huge plus.

title: Great product.
text: Unlike the red version, these one do not have any overpowering flavor.  In fact it doesn’t much of a flavor.  Easy to cook, and they don’t ‘expand’ after cooking.  A healthy version to eat.

title: a little spa like experience.
text: i have tried a number of these flavored tea.  the quality of the material is again - superb.  i really like the flavor and even steeped for more than 10 minutes - it was not over powering, the fruitiness from the fruit was noticeable and subtle.  I love drinking this in the late afternoon to sooth my nerves.  close your eyes and enjoy the senses on multiple levels.

title: great brand and happy with yit.
text: i normally a whole food brand girl, but I love the freshness of these bay leaves that I used with many of the red meat stew dishes.  i am happy the leaves were all dry with no molds or anything that would encourage not to use it.  it has a long shelf Iife, but I try not to go beyond a year with most of my spices.  however, whole leaves or whole spices have been know to be the exceptions.

title: Big group coverage, not your end offering.
text: French roast is not my thing, or this one in particular. The grind is too course for nespresso machines; best for drip or French press.  I am more of dark roast/nespresso kinda person.  The taste was reminiscent of that bitter aftertaste of a dark French roast.  Not your higher end coffee.

title: organic, fresh and tad sweetness to the blend.
text: New brand for me and we made fresh chili con carnie.  fragrant and just the right amount of heat.  it came fresh and we liked the taste too.  There is a tad sweetness to the final taste and we liked that too.  expiration date was over 4 years from receiving the product.  positive consideration for our pantry.

title: Trusted brand for freshness.
text: Love this brand for starters.  The grinder is super easy to use and the peppercorns are super fresh.  It is the best way to cook food with fresh grinds.  Pay the little extra for quality , and your sense will thank you for it.

title: you can taste the powder.
text: didnt love the powdery after taste and even when mixed with a fruit smoothie.  the vanilla flavor is noticeable and not overpowering.  I guess I am one of those people who wants it there for post workout recovery drink, but I dont want to taste it!

title: 100% quality and great for snacks and cooking
text: Juicy!  I used these for baking and i love how fresh and juicy they were, and remained that way when we made scones.  As usual the brand offers great quality product; we have already had the almonds and cashews.  100% recommend.

title: works like wheat flour.
text: there is a distinctive cauliflower fragrant. However, we mix this with Almond flour when we make muffins and pancakes.  The flour is not heavy after cooking/baking and adds to the lightness of slightly heavier almond flour.  Also use for frying as well, and does not burn.  Works great as a thickener too for gravy and soups.

title: fresh and tasty.
text: nice curry powder.  i made a curry last night with this ingredient.  super fresh and tasty.  So important to have fresh spices and this product did not disappoint the crowd.  i like that it is in smaller packaging - unless you eat curry every day, the concern i have is that they will go stale and go to waste.  this package will last up to 4 batches of curries - feeding 4 in each batch.

title: smooth, fairly strong and delicious.
text: So challenging to find good smooth coffee that is also strong.  I love nespresso [9] and have been experimenting so many 'substitutes' and now reusable sealpods.  These are fabulous beans and so smooth and strong, obviously best to grind fresh and use them immediately.  2.5lb is a lot and hence you need to find good coffee  holders that has a valve [i just purchased the coffee gator and yet to try it].  Excited to try other coffee with this company, but it may be a while, yet,

title: Men will love them, women less so! Taste buds are so different.
text: This is for male’s taste buds!  My hub loved them, whilst I thought it was too sharp for my taste!  The raisins are great qualitynas to be expected from sun-maid.  However, the flavoring was a liquid coating over the raisins.  Refreshing little snacks.

title: Good equivalent for coffee...great booster for 60 minutes workout.
text: Delicious dark chocolate. I tried these with my runs/exercise about 30 minutes before and yes, it is as good as drinking coffee.  I need that mental boost to focus on my workout, and not feel that sluggishness.  I wouldn’t eat more than one bit unless you are working more than 60 minutes.  Quality is great, and I try to remind myself these are not candies!  Well, they are, but I am trying to reframe them as my energy boosters.

title: Solid brand for spices
text: Great brand for spices.  Your traditional basil, which I use in stews, shepherds pies, and any meat that require some time cooking time.  It sure brings the flavors out better.  The quality is excellent.

title: Solid household brand.
text: This is a solid household brand.  I used the dry onions as additional boost to dishes like shepherd/cottage pies, stews, gravy.  The additional liquid helps to resuscitate the dehydrated onion.  Adds a nice taste, subtle.  Although you can never beat fresh though.  Still, in those cases you don’t have fresh at hand, I am generous with how much dried onion I add to a dish.

title: Fabulous brand
text: This is my go to brand for ghee.  This is a great alternative and healthier than cooking to olive oil.  It is great for keto compliant ingredient.  It has a buttery texture and taste.  I love using this cooking in recipes that require a creamy texture like curries.  I also use for pasty making too. Great ingredients. The turmeric is super healthy for you in reducing inflammation and it is not strong. Would use this ghee in curries.

title: Great package to take on a long exercise run/spin/bike.
text: Tried this with a 90 minutes spin class where I ate this through regular time.  I was trying this snack for my running,,but wanted to test it where I am not far from the bathroom!  The taste is palatable, not overtly sweet.  Did not upset my stomach as I was taking electrolytes as well.  The energy boost was noticeable during the ride.  The package is small enough to carry with you during a run. I have been looking for something to ake on my run.

title: Solid ingredients, great heat/taste
text: This is hot!  Good hot.  Mixed with chicken wings, the heat is delicious.  This is definitely a hot sauce for people who can take a good heat.  Quality is good and the ingredients are a handful and they are all I can read with no strange addictive.

title: Absorbed the sauce nicely.
text: Thinner, yes, not that thin. However, the pasta was yummy with the garlic/tomatoe sauce - certainly cooked well, and absorbed the sauce nicely.  We were mildly expressed as they are are not sold in supermarkets.  Cooked well and didn’t fall apart as I like them a little soft, approximately 10 minutes.  Want too heavy on the stomach either.

title: Don’t waste your money.
text: Hmm.  Expensive for weak coco powder in plastic capsules.  My hub wanted to join in the fun of our new nespresso machine. He doesn’t drink coffee.  You need two capsules for a decent drink.  Ooh well, back to making hot coco the fashion way.

title: Definitely taste better with dark chocolate
text: What is not to like with chocolate! I have to admit the combination of dark chocolate with dried banana is Wonderful snack.  It is not Morris’s enough to consume the whole packet in one go.  Yet, I found each bite satisfactory.  Texture: soft and chewy.  Not sweet, which is great to rescue you from your ‘sugar’ habit!

title: Simply one of my top three favorite jerkies.
text: Wow.  These jerkies are simply DELICIOUS.  At the first chew, it hits the sweet spot and then the heat kicks in.  If you like heat, these are for you.  The texture of the jerky gives you a good chew without a workout.  It hits all my high points when it comes to jerky: quality meat, cooked well, taste delicious.  And yes; the final test- I don’t want to share and I will happily eat the whole packet in less than one hour.

title: Works on banana bread recipe.
text: I was very sceptical  flour could replace cup for cup the gluten flour.  So I decided to test it with banana bread. Holy cow, the bread was delicious, followed the recipe and used exactly the Sam measure of flour.  The texture of the bread was much lighter and almost cake like, which I liked.  Not dense at all, which you can experience with gluten free products.  Next is scones and pastry!  Impressed so far for someone who is gluten sentive.  Makes me want to make my own cake/bread products going forward rather than buy the untasty store goods.  Hub loved the texture of the bread too.  Thumbs up.

title: Quality is very good.  Flavorful
text: A close substitute for fresh garlic.  Actually, I use it along with fresh garlic to enhance the flavor, especially with freshly made tomato sauce.  The smell,is good and not ‘rancid’.  Impressed with the quality, although I am not sure I will get through this amount of garlic powder.

title: Hands up, best pasta.
text: So yummy!  We love it.  I love making my own tomato pasta sauce, mix it with sausage meat - the combination was so delicious.  This pasta is really worth a try, and so much better than the main brands here. Nothing like authentic Italian. Whilst little,more expensive: big believer of life is short to eat lesser quality food.  A cup and a bit more is ample for two persons.  We are sold. I wish they could make gluten free too!

title: Thinner, crisper, and still solid quality.
text: This is a matter of personal preference, and I come from the culture that is famous for its meat jerky.  Compared with other big brands, the jerky is thinner and ‘crispier’ in texture.  Somewhat saltier too.  The quality is actually good.  I prefer thicker jerky than what this one offers.  However, it was just as moorish and didn’t take long to finish the pack.

title: It is tasty and not for cooking!
text: I don’t use this for cooking, it is best with salad dressing and soaked with good bread.  It has a lovely rich nutty flavor slight bitterness at back of tongue.  Keep in dark cupboard for storage.  A treat to have in the home.  I am adding this with some chili to make chili oil.

title: One of the two great brands!
text: Okay..I love jerky. I love KRAVE. so tasty and so yummy. I can’t describe how good they are compared with other brand,  there is one other brand that is on par.  Nothing is excessive in flavoring, and yes, you can eat a whole pack and you don’t want to share.

title: Wow. Yum.
text: Yummy.  I just used this as part of a salad dressing, and cooked it as a sauce with honey and chicken.  Creamy and light flavor of garlic.  Wow.  I wasn’t expecting that flavor to be this soft, it certainly lacked the mustard sharpness - a plus for our taste bud.  Definitely would work with deli meat in sandwiches.  We are converted.

title: The fruit was too hydrated and each chew was tough
text: Love the concept, but the fruits were really ‘hard’ and I had to be really careful as I chewed on each  was the rib as I didn’t want to loose a tooth.  Otherwise, the flavor and the crunch from the granola were good.  I am hesitant with this way the fruits were hydrated.  Would love a gluten free product.

title: Best trail mix to date.  Very Impressed.
text: Perfecto!  For the nuts only variety, the nuts were sufficiently crunchy, fresh and tasty.  For the mix of nuts and fruits, I was awesomely surprised on how soft and fresh the fruits started, whilst the nuts weren’t as crunchy, they still held the taste and crunch.  Absolutely top notch quality and solid sized fruits and nuts.  So easy to open and eat from the pack.  It is definitely one of the best trail mix I have experienced to date.

title: Solid, and does not goes mushy.
text: I am pro and active in eating non-wheat/gluten based pasta.  So red lentil is a new protein based pasta.  Every brand have a different take, and with this pasta holds its shape and does not go mushy if over cooked .  There isn’t the chew or bite of a gluten pasta, but there is solid feel, but cakey in texture.  It did absorb the flavors of the sauce well.  We would buy again as it cooked well.

title: solid product and clean, a winner in my books.
text:
love everything about this brand. the quality of the fish is exceptional and well worth the expense. solid and recognizable pieces of fish! I was hesitant to try the chicken, but surprisingly the chicken was recognizable and was tasty!
Wild planet protein is my favorite band - and they set the bar high!

title: Ooh my, delicious, and cheesy flavor was not overpowering
text: I really didn’t want to like them, but I did.  The cheesy aspect is a light coating, and not that strong or empowering.  The nuts were crunchy and delicious.  Great snack size package, but it wasn’t hard to keep from eating more than one pack in one sitting. Delicious

title: Delicate but cooks with a punch!
text: We usually use the extra extra virgin oil for all our cooking and food preps.  We decided to try this oil and we love it for cooking.  It actually produces less smoke when you cook meat with fat like burgers and chops.  It has a very mild olive taste, much lighter than the extra virgin olive oil, and pending on your salad dressing this might be a better oil option.  Surprised by this oil and we cook a lot.

title: Good flavor without the caffeine shakes.
text: Here is always a bit of a compromise with decaf coffee, and when used with espresso machine, it has a richer and smoother flavor than with a French press.  Still smooth tasting and tastes great with almond milk.  The grind is medium.  Love that the package stays fresh in refrigerator for over two weeks.  This is not a bad decaf version and definitely with decent medium strength,

title: Taste natural, and not sweet, thank goodness!
text: Epic.  I don’t ordinarily like anything ddiitonalmto water other when I am working out and need electrolytes.  There artificial flavoring is minimal and you cannot taste any sweetener.  The taste was tart, but refreshing, which was great for my workouts and I need to drink a lot of water.  It tasted quiet natural and I was surprised how great it tasted.  Definitely adding this to my low impact workouts.  Claims to be gluten free and caffeine free.

title: Healthy choice
text: I love the chips, I love it that it was plantain.  I am not sure the pink salt was a hit with the plantain.  Some chip was a little more salty than another one.  I rather wished it was just plain old plantain. We certainly got used to the combo quickly, and whilst we love super healthy snacks, we could buy this again, but many rethink on this favoring.

title: Huge box, you better want to share or prepared to work out before or after eating.
text: Delicious baked snacks.  Really fresh and crunchy,  I remind myself this is none-the-less processed food.  So be careful when you order this size packaging, because once it is opened, there is no turning back.  My hands were in the box more often than I should! Great for parties or large gatherings.  Once opened, you might not like to share.

title: Wow, tasty Nd super healthy. I am changing my mango brand
text: Totally delicious and healthy, no unnecessary chemicals or extra sugar added.  Whilst I wasn’t used to this super dried mango form, I got to love it pretty quickly, and it is great snack, as I love to nibble, which isn’t a great combo with my exercising.  I was surprised how tasty these slices were, and the packet stayed fresh with strong seal.  Simply love nd I am ordering these for sure.

title: Healthier relationship with sugar, get into habit of eating this brand of chewier.
text: Reducing your sweet tooth, and opting into healthier options is never easy.  There is no getting away from options thta will have less sugar contents.  However, this new brand that combines some of my favorite ingredients succeeded in reducing my sugar craving, along with getting healthier  definitely noticed the lower sweetness, but replaced with yummy banana and coconut flavor.  I am learning to eat healthier re my relationship with sugar, and this helps.

title: Super soft and delicious
text: Melt in your mouth taffy.  The licorice is mild and not overpowering.  .there isn’t much chewing involved and literally melts in your mouth.  This may seem like a big jar, but it will empty quicker than you can guess!

title: Delicious fruit-tea fusion
text: I loooove tea, almost any tea.  This rooiboo tea is delicious.  Stewed for 10 minutes, and it taste terrific cold or hot.  Add a bit of honey and soothes a sore throat.  It is not overpowering, and yet there is a presence after each sip.  They recommend 1.5 teaspoon, and yes, it is ample to get a good flavor.  I love it, and it is one of the best fruit-tea fusion on the market.  Loose tea is much better than tea bags.  IMHO.

title: Melt in the mouth.
text: These re so delicious and moorish.  Super soft and just lieterally melts in your mouth.  The sea salt was tiny granular pieces, and adds a tasty contrast to the sweet caramel.  Not toffee like as it is soft to chew.  Really different and thoroughly delicious experience.

title: Super mix with each handful.
text: Real great mix of seeds, nuts and fruits.  And each grab out of the bag had a good balance of all three key items.  Not overtly sweet, and it does taste super healthy with no added salt/sugar/sweetener.  I was surprised how good this trail mix was and compared with Luther brands, I would buy this product again.

title: Quality stuff.  Great to be this product as part of amazon.
text: Strong, bold, and smooth tasting ground coffee.  I love this taste, and it is not overwhelmingly strong and definitely not bitter.  The bag comes resealable for freshness, which we keep in the fridge.  The ground is largely course, not fine.  Very good quality coffee, and I drink a lot of ground coffee, especially from beans provided by a great Swedish coffee house in New York.

title: Luxury chicken range. Simply beautiful and not decadent at all!
text: We have a soft spot for high end chocolate, and this brand is up there in terms of presentation, taste, rich, and so worthy price point.  Great for gift as something no one has heard of yet.  Luxury chocolate. Period.

title: Pricey, but great end results though.
text: We have tried two other major GF mixes like this one.  We love this one,  it has great bouncy texture that we love.  But it is pricey compared even with leading the brands.  The hazelnut meal is the unique ingredient that is pushing the price up.

title: Well hello morning brew.
text: To deepen the rdepth, double your usual amount.  So deliciously smooth.  I was impressed with the roasted quality and no bitterness.  Nice to have it grounded,  it it is not fine.  So if you like it fine you can process it further in coffee grinder.  For the price, this is good morning coffee..  hello weekend.

title: Beautiful quality chocolate.  Game changer.
text: High quality chocolate.  Great gifts too.  Seriously delicious and comparable to the large French chocolatier.  Each piece is crafted with such care and design.  I was very impressed as I do indulge in quality chocolate (life is short)

title: Nice heat,
text: Good spicy heat.  We used it for chilly mix, and what a nice warm bite!  Little goes a long way, and if you are using for first time, I suggest you be cautious as this spice is hot, and not mild.  I used it with vegetables, or spice up the chicken.  Quality of the ground pepper looks decent.  Smells like ground pepper with no musky smell.

title: Great combo with peppermint.
text: Seep for maximum of 10 minutes, if you like the dark tea.  Actually, the peppermint flavor goes really nicely with the dark tea,and neither the dark tea or peppermint was overpowering.  Tasted great hot or cold.  No bitterness that sometimes come with black tea.  Very fishing cup, and no milk or sugar is needed.  Pouch is triangular that is supposed to allow water to flow through the leaves.  It works.

title: Greta for cooking, and pancakes!
text: Love it.  We use it for coating food like chicken and fish.  We use it for waffles and pancakes.  Yum.  And gluten free.  Very versatile for my cooking needs.  I sometimes forget this is not wheat flour.

title: Best crisp/ chip.
text: Looooooove hula hoops, and the tartness with the vinegar.  Yum. I wouldn't eat any other chip.

title: Yummy
text: Yummy.  We started using ghee in lieu of butter/diary as part of dietary chnage..  the garlic is not hyper tatrong, but can work with garlic bread,  but we do more crushed garlic.  Easy to use, doesn't burnt with cooking red meat, for example.  We like this alternative with jacket potato.  No strange tatse, quite delicious alternative to dairy and butter.

title: Loved it, and i drink a lot of tea.
text: Tried this brand back home, loved it, best tea ever. Normally, I drink the more traditional brand,  I didn't think british tea could taste this good. Wish they sold it here, cheaper, but happy that they can ship it.  Surprisingly,  not that long a wait.  Just ordered my second box.

title: Wow, perfect for our new diet and coconut sugar-thank you!
text:
What is awesome is to find a blend that is gluten free and uses coconut sugar! I love this mix and it tastes great, I made some adaptation by using extra jumbo eggs, added grounded flax seed (4 table spoon), add tad more olive oil, and we loved it. We used the cupcake mix and they came out delicious, and made 16. The flaxseed added nice texture. I can't wait to try the bread mix.as I miss bread...great label to try once you come off whole30 and adapt to new way of eating...nice treat.
We have tried many GF mixes and this one is not dry, not overloaded with sweetener, remains moist, I wouldn't recommend adding additional sweeter until you tried it as is, and if you add then use honey or coconut sugar. We added to additional sweentner, but then again, we have weaned ourselves off sweentner overall.

title: good value
text: great value compared with store purchased items, and one less item to carry home!  we were directed to this product as an alternative to soy, as part of a whole30 program.  does it taste like soy - nope, sweeter.  i recognize it is another processed item, but supposedly does not cause inflamatory/allergenic effects on the body.  it is a relative issue.  For now, it does add a good flavor, but it is no tstae substitute to soy sauce.  it does thicken quite nicely, so worth cooking it down a bit in the pan for a deeper teriyaki flavor.

title: wow, a dried product that actually tastes good, and has no added additives.
text: i am always a little leary of dried products, and this one exceeded my expectations, as it contains only potato!  it hydrated very easily with just hot water, and we add some mayo for texture.  it is a life saver as you are not carrying heavy potatoes all the time, and they are ready to use.  i prefer presh food, but sometime you need a little helper in terms of time and money .. i am sold.  you can also use this as an alternative to bread crumbs and panko flakes if you are gluten senstive.

title: great taste, but sell by date was very short .. less than 4 months from delivery date!
text: tastewise it is as good as Hellman's and healthier relative to many store products,  However, the sell by date was less than 4 months from the day we took delivery of the product.  Not a lot of time, and depending on how much you chose to use this on a daily basis!?  As a product is a good alternative, and second to wholefoods vegan version that have no added sugar.

title: can they come without the granulated white sugar!
text: For many of these crystallized ginger products, there is so much sugar coating the pieces.  on the one had you are trying to be healthy and inadventently you are killing yourself with all the sugar.  I end up dipping these pieces into hot/warm water to wash off the sugar, either dry them out naturally or in the oven at slow heat of 350F.  then they are good to nibble on!  The sugar coating is a real turn off.

title: Excellent quality!
text: Quality of these goji berries are excellent.  An Asian ingredient used in making soups, that in combination of other ingredients, it is very healing for the body.  You can use these in making smoothies, the taste is not strong so you will not notice it in berries mix. It does not have a bitter taste, a bit like dried peach!  Would suggest you soak in water to hydrate it for smoothies or add to a green salad, and tastes Delius with fresh fig roast chicken salad!

title: Love for thai curry and alternative to brown sugar
text: We started to use this for thai curries and now it has replaced brown sugar in our cooking.  Simple love it.  Love it that this form of sugar is even better for your body than brown sugar.  Every little thing helps.

title: Super tasty and easy to use.yeah.
text: We discovered this product in a recipe, so happy with this one that provided a seriously creamy coconut milk flavor with our thai green curry!  No need to add thickener, and flav or strengthens with more powder.  Disolves easily with either hot or cold water.  Super happy with the powder, no more waste with canned milk.

title: Great Christmas pudding ...
text: Sweet...Loved it..and it is a rich fruity pudding, not dense, and is delicious with birds eye custard.  Great with Christmas dinner.  It is quiet small, but should be ample for 3 people.  Because 3 of its richness, you don't need a lot to enjoy it.

title: Natural and taste great with my cooking.
text: Do not use this for normall cooking, as it does take a wee while to melt into the cooking.  I use this a lot with soup as that has sufficient time to melt the salt into the food.  Althernativelym you can use a salt grinder to redcue the size of the salt pieces.  I love the taste and for the4 fact that this salt has not gone thru' the processing mills of mankind (!).  Strong, so be careful of amount.  Otherwise, I love this option to use in my cooking.

title: Good quality: not bitter at all.
text: Nice quality green tea..not overpowering or bitter.  A subtle sweetness.  I was impressed with the quality of the leaves as this is the first purchase of this brand.  Good value and taste good for green tea lovers.

title: good spicy-ness
text: neither the red or the green salsa sauce is super hot-spicy.  but they both produce a great kick to any taco meal!  tasty and flavorful.  you don't need to splash a lot to the dish as a small amount goes a long way.  we tried it with Chinese food- good with chicken and shrimp.  looking fro an alternative spicy sauce for Mexican food then I highly recommend this as a choice.

title: Home from home
text: Simply love this dark tea with soy milk...it is a given in our household.  It is a hold tea, but not over powering, a great pick me up for anything of the day.  I normally let it stew for 2 minutes, any longer it does get a little too strong for soy milk.

title: What is there not to like!
text: Simply love the dark chocolate covered digestives...love it with my PG tips!  There is nothing to compare, you should give it a try as it is very moorish.

title: Yummy ther goes the diet!
text: Forget cookies, love my digestive biscuits!  Yum yum, British made and take one bite and there is no going back!

title: Best British cuppa
text: I grew up on a cuppa tea and this is by far the best morning cuppa, afternoon cuppa and yes, even nighttime cuppa.  Love that it is available on Amazon! Thank you.

title: A tad too much sugar
text: We love oatmeal, but we are also conscious of the amount of sugar in our food.  AT 12g this is a little too high for what we are getting about 8g from other oatmeals (Wholefoods).  Obviously, with the extra sugar, it is very tasty, and the apply bits do hydrate well within minutes.  Overall, good product, but a little less sugar?? or a low sugar version?

title: All for salad dressing
text: Here is to better health, and we have replaced EVO with this hemp oil and it is delicious! No bizzare taste.  We love it and although the darker green color was different.  Second use we just got used to it.  Need to refrigerate once open, and it should not be cooked with as it will loose its health benefits.  Great delivery.

title: Wasabi HOT
text: Love these nori snacks, but the wasabi is HOT, and I generally love hot.  Delicious little snacks and helps to deal those mid mornings and afternoon hunger pangs: very healthy options.  Although I end up snacking on 2 packets each time!  Hell, it is all healthy for you, just wished the packaging was more 'earth friendly':  too much packaging.

title: Just the right amount of saltiness
text: Nice..we have limited salt in this diet and this is not overpowering.  Love the whole taste and product....just wished the packaging was more 'earth friendly'.

title: Yummy snack and supplement of iodine for women's health
text:
A food that is widely eaten by a nation that has the lowest rate of diseases, and with the iodine this really helps women's health: especially for those who have low energy and can't shake the fat? Sounds familiar. Besides all the health benefits, these actually are really yummy for all the brands I have tasted and relatively low In sodium too. Love.

One wish is that they make the packaging a little less as I am very concerned about the environment!
Purchased in early January; expiration date was early November of same year. Cool.

title: Made in China!
text: Hmm, authentic,I am not so sure.  Decent seaweed, but I have tasted better.  Note the sodium content is 30%+!!  Doesn't taste salty, but does have a slight fishy after taste though.m

title: helps to calm the monkey mind
text: My mind races so fast that sometime even i cant keep up with the pace and especially towards the end of the day when I am suppose to be winding down, my brain sure aren't in that same space and hence I dont get a great night sleep.  I will drink this tea at the end of the night to make me calm down naturally and it does help.  Does not have a strong flavor even after steeping it for over 10 minutes.

title: Crap, love flake
text: Flaky chocolate with each bite it crumbles in your mouth..ridiculously delicious milk chocolate!  You can get these in some large stores now, and the price on Amazon is the same for what you pay in Fairway, for example.  These chocolate bars don't last long in out household!  Love.

title: Easy and very filling for supper!
text: Those with busy schedule will love this soup base mix!  In less than 45 minutes I was able to produce a healthy and hearty meal.  I added some extra carrots and celery to the soup ...so tasty with chicken meat.  I prefer this soup mix with organic ingredients and it is not in a can!!  I purchased one packet from a health store to test it...and now I am back for the save and subscribe!

title: This is more than your instant ramen
text: Oooh yum yum yum.  The quality of the noodle is excellent and as good as what you would get in a ramen noodle shop!  I love this brand, period.  As to the soup base it is a little saltier than the other ones, but non-the-less delicious!  All love, and not bad value either.

title: Great dairy substitute with extra calcium!
text: Always tough to find substitutes for dairy products, but we may have finally found it with this chocolate almond milk!  Great chocolatey taste and a little thicker with the gum gar (organic and natural).  Loved it is as natural as it is, good taste,and the 8oz is a good portion control too!  This pack is great value!

title: Yum, almond and it is chocolatey!
text: So hard to find a replacement to a dairy chocolate milk, and along this path of over 3 years, we have found something that is made from almond milk, the sugar feature is low on list of ingredients.... Life is short, so nice to find a 'healthy' replacement from lactose and other non-dairy products.  It also as vitamins and 50% more calcium than dairy!  Yeah.  Tried the smaller box at a health food store before bulk buying!,  it actually taste chocolatey, and not watered down, although the gar gum is in there, it helps and not harmful.

title: OMG is it a sin to love this chocolate as much as I do?
text: I am a huge fan of the British Cadbury milk chocolate with hazelnut and raisin combo, hard to find places that sell it here.  Well, until I found the Green & Black brand (actually discovered the dark chocolate with ginger, another winner); browsed in amazon at the other tasty options (always dangerous for me);  only comes in minimum pack of 10: terrible really, but a temporary issue!  The fact it is dark chocolate takes away the guilt and it is all about healthy options, as are nuts and fruit, right?  The taste is devine, just the right amount of finely chopped nuts and fruit.  I hope they keep the price competive as a I am sure to come back to this seller and amazon:  how about putting this one on save and subscribe!

title: Dark chocolate and peanut!  Just great
text: I am not supporting candy, but as part of a controlled diet, this combo is great.  Much prefer the dark chocolate option and great price offered by Amazon.  Just great to grab and go.

title: One star for the very weird taste: important to know because it's expensive!
text:
I love looking for healthy alternatives, but this taste weird and if you don't like 85-90% cocoa then you will definitely not like the taste of this product. And we decided it was not a taste we were going to get used to. It is expensive and like another reviewer, it is an important for first timers to know that it does not taste good.
Now we have to throw the whole lot out as I can't think of any alternatives use for it other than melt it and add loads of sugar!!

title: Does eating the whole bar in one sitting counts as tasty-good?
text: We are chocolate-addicts and we try to stay with over 65% coco content: so the rave was genuine.  given the 68% coco content, it is not sweet, but a tad sweet enough to mellow out the bitterness that is often associated with high coco content.  However, there is a nuance of dried fruit element detected on one part of our tongues - but stared as we might at the thin bar - we couldnt see any dry fruit piercing through the chocolate.  Delicious, but 100% exceptional - the smoothness factor was somewhat lacking.

title: Hmm, this one is yummy
text: Ooh, this is my favorite.  Yu can't quite dry out the pineapple prices and you chew into each bit there is a little softness in each chew.  The taste of the pineapple comes bursting through.  Definarely is my favorite dried fruit and this one is the best out there.  The sweetness comes from the pineapple own ripeness and sweetness love this one.  One less star as there is lot of plastic with each 1.48oz!

title: Wow, it is the real McCoy
text: Looks shriveled and unlike the other dried mango slices...there is no sweetness, but after a few slices the mango flavor  comes through delicately.  a little chewy and hard texture.  It appeals to me as you can tell very little additives were added in the drying process.  Shame there is so few in the bag, and I am feeling guilty for the additional plastic I have generated by buying this product.  But as far as dried fruit goes, this is a good product.

title: Love this product
text: We already use two other pasta under the same brand and we can't stop recommending it to everyone even if it is just for health reasons.  It cooks wonderfully well and a little overlooking in terms of the recommended time does not turn the pasta to mush like other rice pasta.  Highly recommend.  Love it.

title: Great taste and so much healthier than dairy version
text: It is always tough to find an alternative and healthier version of chocolate milk.  But here it is - Almond milk is delicious and so much healthier without all the hormone issues related to dairy products.  Highly recommend as we have tried so many brands.  This is it.  Love the pricing and that the expiration date is not shorter than the dates we see in the store.  Sure: it is 12 cartons, but we have a window of 8 months and we go through two cartons a week!  Sold.  If you want to reduce your dairy intake then this is a great option, but like all bulk purchases and try one carton before buying!

title: Delicious, but wished it was a little more light on the brown sugar.
text: My first try of the Namaste brand and we added three teaspoon of ginger to make the ginger bread!  I think we could add more ground ginger as it was not that strong in the finished product.  It was delicious when it came straight out the oven,, fluffy light and sweet.  A litltle too sweet for me, I hope they could  provide a spice cake with no sugar so that I can add my own!  Was not disappointed and will try the other mixes!

title: One of many great taco sauce &gluten Free
text: I always like to make sauces fresh unless they meet my standard and it has to be GF!  Most of the Rick Bayless sauces are GF and we are so excited we have discovered this collection of taco sauces.  you can check out the ingredients on the frontera's website.). Dinner has never been any easier and absolutely delicious!  I kid you not and my hubbie has raved to his work colleagues of the experience!  Guess we will be getting some extra guests soon for dinner!  We added slices of peppers too, gotta get some greens in the mix! It works with duck and chicken.  I actually didn't think this was medium heat, more than mild but not medium like the key lime and cilantro medium heat.  I Hope Amazon will stock the key lime and cilantro soon!  Another must have in the larder.  I always recommend you try one sachet first before buying a bundle.  Wholefoods stocks this product.

title: OMG, this is simply delicious
text: We are a long time fan of Pamela's pancake and baking mix...and I normally like to try a pack before buying bulk.. Well this just took our family's breathe away! We had tried the vanilla cake mix and found it too heavy even with adjusting it with more water and more eggs, not bad, but a little to firm for our liking.  Then we tried the extra egg and extra water for this version, and holy mac, it turned out moist and delicious.  No need for frosting as on it's own it had a very chocolatey taste.  It was tough not eating them all in one go!  Filled our kitchen with such a wonderful chocolate smell!  I added 4 eggs to the basic recipe and an extra 1/4 cup of water.  here we go, we are now on subscribe and save!

title: Simple broth with a tad of chili to heat up your taste buds
text:
The noodles are more akin to rice noodles: very quick to cook and hence 2 minutes is a tad long. The pack also recommends you cook the soup base separately: I cooked the two dry ingredients packs for about one minute in boiling water then added the noodles (remove from heat just as the noodles are about to look transparent -- will continue to cook in the heat) and then add the wet sauce packet just before serving.

The broth is simple and does not soak into the noodles much: so to get the flavor, have a spoon ready to mix the broth with the noodles.

title: Yeah, great price for the lot
text: Another rare entity to find in local grocery stores and I have little time to head down the the speciality shops: and here it is on Amazon.  Definately recommend that you try a sample first: it is an acquired taste for adults!  I love it and always have done: it has a strong 'meaty' and salty (only 8%) flavor that I love to spread on toast (GF, of course) and butter.  Also great to add to a stew as it brings a deep flavor to the palate: works brilliantly on either red meat or chicken thighs (not too sure why it does not work with white breast meat, it just doesn't).

title: Just want one bottle and don't have time to head to china town
text: Perfecto, reasonable price for one bottle (and prime!) and saved me a bundle of time: it is spicy so try it in a small amount before squirting more.  Has a direct 'hot' flavor with little weird after taste.  We add it to spice up a stir fry, in noodles, in ramen, hot dogs, dipping sauce... Anything!  It is pretty good hotness.

title: Perfect, good price, easy via Amazon!
text: Finally, I have got my hands on these gluten free travel packs.  So hard to find, and even though it is 200 sachets, believe me they will last!  Now I carry some in my purse, some at work: all for those sushi moments.  I can't be happier and I no longer have to bring the little bottle of sanj GF soy!  Yeah. Taste just fine.  I use the same brand in the super large bottles at home, so I know this brand is fantastic for all their other gluten free products.. Ooh let me check if Amazon is selling the SanJ teriyaki sauce!

title: good old traditional instant noodles, all the way from Hong Kong
text: Just how I remembered them and it means one less and bulky trip to China town!  I always check place of origin and it is good to see that these are made from Hong Kong.  Very simple to cook and I would say 2 minutes top and a little over will make the noodles a little to soft for my liking.  Very filling from one little package, the flavoring is not overpowering and I normally add a dash of seasame oil (just an old habit of mine). Very good value both for the product and convenience.

title: Ooh super delicious"
text: Do not be deceived with the dehydrated noodles as once it is cooked and soaked in the water, the growth was huge and it was a satisfying meal.  There were two sachets with flavoring and oil mix.  I didn't use all of it in the soup base and amount you use will spend on your taste bud.  A notch up form the basic noodles packets and worth it.  The noodles did jot disintegrate if you cook it a little longer than the time prescribed, which the basic noodles tend to loose texture.  Yummy snack/meal.

title: Best tasting GF cookie, which sucks as I can't stop eating them
text: They are also sold at Wholefoods.  I have been trying so many brands of cookies and many of them have this dry powdery taste.. Yuck.  However, this cookie sis deliciously crunchy.  I know I should move away from expectations now that I am on a gluten free diet, but as a newbie I am still having a hard time 'cheating' as I miss the old gestures.  Finally, I can indulge on some naughty food wihtout compromising my health or taste.. Yeah!

title: fresh, not too salty and great value!
text: Great value and they are not too salty at all, compared with the salty version from Trader Joes.  Very fresh and very few unopened, no different from any other store brands.  I use a lobster cracker to open the few that needs a little assistance.  That is one less trip to the stores.  Beware they are very moorish and it is hard to eat just a few, so not recommended for weight watchers.  However, the nutrient value and health benefits are huge and with the huge fibre content, forget about eating activa, it works a whole lot better and also means less dairy fat, which is not good for you (growth hormones in milk fat promotes cancer cell growth so we have eliminated and minimized dairy intake).  Have constipation issue, these nuts will get you on a regular schedule in a couple of weeks.

title: Love this brand, period!
text: We just love ancient harvest brand and not only that quinoa tastes delicious.  You just can't overcook this, seriously, we cook this 5 minutes more than recommended and the pasta still holds it's shape and not go mushy.  We already use the other pasta shapes.  One recommendation is to make sure you use a lot of water to cook the pasta.  Yes, the water will run a ydeep yellow-maize colour, but don't panic, it is fine.  Just remember to cook in a lot of water.  Great for people who is seeking GF food as I have benefited from it.  Note that quinoa is a protein and hence it is a lot better for you too.  I think this pasta will explode in sale like almond milk!  Great price here in Amazon!

title: Cant stop eating them
text:
err, this must be our second load and it is so great for you: minimum additives, raisins and 60% dark chocolate: delicious if this is already part of your regular diet! it is hard to find good healthy snacks with minimum processes and still satify the sweet tooth.

my hubbie and I share this when we watch a movie and the portion is about right for a one a day treat.

title: yeah, pancakes again and its more delicious than plain flour!
text:
Dont we just love this gluten free pancake mix; we tired it first by buying a single packet from the store and tried this with a couple of other brands found in WHoleFoods. Hands down this flour mix was by far the best and why we loved it:
- the mixture forms beautifully on the griddle [good circular shape]
- not runny consistency even when you follow the instructions
- had a nice buttery taste (no butter added)
- we added a 1.5 tablespoon of flax mix with the 1 cup of flour and that only further enhanced the flavor and goodness
- cooked evenly and was easy to flip to cook other side

these may seems like obvious points, but some other larger GF brand really didnt meet the standard. Actually this tsate a whole heap better than using either plain white or whole wheat flour. I would recommend this brand for GF or non-GF. We will be recommending this to family and friends, GF or no GF!

title: Dark chocolate is good for you right?
text: Comes in lovely a little packets, great for portion control.  Definately tastes better with the dark chocolate (relative to the milk chocolate) ~60% cocoa.  Great value.

title: GLUTEN FREE: Lower calories, but has enough sweetness to tackle that little afternoon craving
text:
Lets not get too crazy here: looking for a snack that holds only organic products and is GLUTEN FREE and has little manufactured ingredients: yep, big thunms up for this one; looking for lower sugar content: yep, if you compare it with the other KIND bars; and has enough sweetness to sustain that sweet tooth: very big smile.
However, the sugar content is still there and moderation comes from the slightly higher pricing compared with other snack bars. The texture of this bar is chewy and can be quite filling. So great for on the road, as part of a calorie count! I sometimes forget about the latter and I think I am eating better and hence think I can eat more! So I am crazy over this new snack bar, but restrained myself when I think that it does add up if I dont exercise/move around as much as I should do: such a dampner!

I love it as it does not contain any gluten agents!

title: Not 'instant' to make and does require more additional ingredients
text:
I love trying new food and being a recent gluten sensitive, I now had to find a substitute for my love of 'instant' noodles. So upon the reviews I was sold. However, this is not 'easy to make' as it does require you to have additional ingredients in the house: shitake mushrooms, meat (optional), for example. Also, what I was not expecting was the 'strong' cinnamon component in the soup base: I know cinnamon is good for you, but fragrant wise, it was strong to both my nose and taste buds. I am not sure where the mushroom flavor was going to come from other than when I add additional ingredients like the mushrooms?

The rice noodle cooks really quickly and does become 'gooey', so do watch out for that if you do add other ingredients to the pot.

title: Firm and has texture!  Best one out there
text: For gluten sentsitives, there is finally a pasta that is gluten free and still has texture when cooked. Hooray, we have tried so many brands in Wholefoods that we were giving up and we were always slightly disappointed.  This pasta even after cooking for the full 9 minutes as prescribed, did not go soggy and did retained a nice firmish texture.  Other GF pasta tends to fall apart when cooked and often it happened within 3 minutes!  Plus quinoa is a great grain to eat, so we are super pleased to have found this GF pasta. Great price Amazon.

title: Best decaf coffee- simply the best brand for instant coffee
text: There are many claims for best instant coffee, and I have tried many of the top priced brands.  The Mount Hagen brand, both decaf and caffeinated, is excellent.  Sometimes, I do not have the time to grind fresh beans, and I have sent a lot money trying various top end brands.  A little disheartened with The result, so many lack a good solid and smooth coffee taste, I actually bought a box of the 25 sachets rather than a jar.  And boy was I shocked to discover that both the decaf and caffeinated were excellent.  In fact, the decaffeinated had just the right strong and smooth flavor of excellent ground coffee beans: one would have thought you just ground them and it did not taste watery or weak.  I kid you not.  The amazon save and subscribe is a great price!  Thank you.

title: Great on it's own or as a filler: is gluten free
text:
Contrary to it's name, this is actually a seed and is gluten free. Very easy to cook, cooks like couscous: add hot water and leave to cook, or you can simmer at low heat for no more than 10 minutes. Ends up soft, not fluffy, and I usually add a vegetable stock like mushroom, or chicken and it absorbs the flavors.

I also use this as a substitute for bulged in recipes and acts as a great combo with any meatball dishes (reduce the meat content) and is a great filler. We can't taste the grain in the meatball at all! Use instead of rice or potato.

A little goes a long way, so although each packet appears small, you actually find a cup of grain wil feed at least 6 people.

I wished amazon did a smaller amount like 6 per delivery for those who do not have a lot of storage space.

title: great price for fresh product and with delivery, it is another bonus over wholefoods
text: I love my nuts and this package offers the best cost benefits over wholefoods, whose nuts I also love.  Very fresh tasting and no over due salt.  We love the minimum added ingredients and so much better than those offered loose by some health food stores around us.  great price for a great product.

title: Definately best when lightly toasted
text:
I have also tried the seattle burger bread, which I think taste brilliant and again, when lightly toasted.
I agree with other reviewers that this bread actually feels and tastes dry; but then very few people actually eat their bread without some condiments!

Once toasted and a little spread, this is such a great gluten free alternative. it is as close to 'bread texture' as you are going to get from the current market selection. And boy have I had to try some very dense gluten-free alternative.

The size of the loaf is smaller than the tradtional wheat loaf, measuring roughly 3.5 by 3.5 inches.

I am just happy to have toast and marmite again!

title: Simply all tomato-deliciousness
text:
The sauce is not just a sauce, the tomato pieces in there are simply delicous; good size pieces, nicely cooked down (no skin) and the taste was just 'simple and all tomato goodness'. It was over flavored, and if you want a dash of salt or pepper then you can adjust it. But we loved it just as it was with some great gluten pasta and vegetables. It is as good as you can get from a great italian restaurant. So much better than any expensive brands in jars that we have tried in the supermarket. Price comparison-wise, it is very reasonable.

Better still, there is no gluten in this ready made product; so for me, finally, one less thing to have to make myself. we love it and cant wait to try this out on other recipes. Also, the jar can be reused for other things: well made and solid.

title: Fresh and delicious
text: Actually I was looking for 'jasmine mist', which I was hooked after staying in a lovely hotel.  Instead, I decided to try the organic spring jasmine:it still had that lovely fragrant and taste of the jasmine mist, but a tad less strong.  it was just peeerrrfect.  One bag held its flavor for a large teapot, if you want it stronger then just use it with a good size mug.  I normally like my tea strong, so this tea held its own in terms of flavor and strength.  Sometimes, I just allow the tea to go cold and there is no lost in fragrant and flavor.  So glad that amazon is supporting this brand.

title: Great texture. light on the stomach and gluten free!
text:
So you find one member of your family has gluten issues and the rest of the family loves pasta. Finally, we found a gluten free pasta that pleases the taste buds of those pasta lovers and yet addresses the gluten issue.

We found this pasta brand was quick to cook, very light in texture, tasty but still had the pasta-consistency (not soggy and did notfall a part) you have gotten used to.

The pasta is tasty enough that even the pasta lovers in our family are prepared to switch permanently to this gluten-free brand!

title: Delicious and alot lighter than whole wheat pasta
text: We were simply surprised by how quick it took to cook (less than the 9 minutes that was indicated on the packet) and it was delicious. What we loved about the texture was that it was still firm, but lighter compared with whole wheat pasta.  You can tell it does not taste like any of the wheat pasta, but if you were gluten intolerant then this is a great alternative.  Definately will be stocking up on this brand.  I would recommend you guy this product from a health food store before buying the bulk.  My husband who likes his whole wheat based products,really liked this brand and would consider eating this with me to avoid me having to double up on the pasta!

title: quality of the product is great, but a bit gritty in finished product
text:
I like the fact that the recipe provides alternative to some of the ingredients like sugar (replace with honey) and butter (replace with canola oil), which we did since we have moved into more consciousness in the ingredients we are consuming. The honey option definately tastes better than cane sugar (our other alternative to white and refined sugar); otherwise, it was not that sweet and a bit gritty.

I am just pleased to have a package ready that I only need to throw in a few addtional ingredients and I have cornready within 30 minutes. The mixture made two very small loaf tins, which is enough for four-six people: nice portions.

title: Trying a gluten Free diet: this works and it also offers folate and potassium, too
text:
For digestive reasons, I decided to try a gluten free diet: not so easy and Eden offers a lot of gluten free products. This grain was very easy to cook, and to make it more flavorful I added chopped shiitake mushrooms (great for the immune system) and pucini stock cube with low sodium chicken stock. Even my husband liked it (not easy getting everyone in the family to try new and healthy products).

The grain may not open up after cooking for 20 minutes, but I found it very soft. So dont over cook to get the 'open' grain look like that on the package.

The price that is offered on Amanzon is fantastic compared with our local health food store. Once I finish the pack, I will order from here.

title: The original heinz baked beans now on Amazon- how cool is that!
text: Why so great!  It has a lot less sugar than the american version and the beans hold their shape after the processing system.  A lot less mushy than the american vegetarian version.  If you are looking for baked beans with a lot less sugar then this would work for you.  Super goodness.

title: it is really that easy: 30 minutes simmering and you can taste the cardamon
text:
I was very impressed how fresh the curry smelt and tasted: you could definately taste the spice and it is almost as fresh as if I made it myself.

took less than 35 minutes from start to finish to cook: such a time saver when I need to get good dinner on the table. I love this prepared mixture as it does not contain any of these crazy preservatives. Just pure and simple. Although, my chicken mixture did not have the orange glow like the picture on the box: more like the picture for the lamb currry! It was plenty spicy - not too hot, but it did have the kick. No more frozen curry any more - yeah!

title: the next best thing to fresh tomatoes

Generally I like to make my own sauce from scratch, but this is my second choice if I am short on time. Its taste good and not artificially sweet. title: ooh yummy and it does not fall apart when cooking

taste delicious and I was surprised how much it helds its form even though I cooked it for 7 minutes and then cooked it further with the home made spicy tomato and shrimp sauce. The ingredients are simple and pure - just the way we like it. Also the packaging was simple without too much plastic.

title: Delicious, yummy moist and laced with rum CAKE
text:
We first tried this cake when we were on Grand Caymans and there was no turning back after that first taster. The cake is moist, sweet and laced with a generous portion of rum. The cake is sealed in a vacuum sealed bag that helps maintain its moisture. Dont worry once you open the bag because I doubt it that it will last for more than a couple of days!

Just so pleased that this item is on Prime delivery and that Amazon is supporting this product. It is great as a gidt idea, but only if you are ready to part with it!

title: love these hot spicy noodles

The noodles and flavoring sachet are a lot higher quality than the 'ramen' you find in the local non-asian grocery stores.  Compared to prices in asian stores - this is a bargain and no lugging it all the way home.  Fabulous value.

title: Crunchy-lious
text:
I am normally not a great fan of such bars, because despite all the healthy ingredients they contain hydrogentated corn syrup. Horray,this product contains no such awful ingredient. And they are very delicious. Crunchy oat with a lovely honey taste - not overtly sweet - just right. there are two servings per packet totalling 180 calories. This is a great little snack and quite filling. Although it is very moorish- so you have better have great self-control!

PS: we now order it on a regular basis, which does make it cheaper by at least $1 savings per box.

title: there are affordable teabags and there are affordable teabags

There are more expensive brands, but as a brand, this one cuts about the rest.  I love the chamomile version and it is a sure winner in the taste section too. Highly recommend and thanks amazon for making it so affordable.

title: OOoh the best tea leaves out there yet
text:
I was very excited to try this tea as I am a bit of a tea freak from green tea to the steeper oolong tea. I loved the fresh fragrant of the tea and it did not have a bitter taste if the leaves are steeped too long. Generous heap of tea and immediate off the boil water are a must to get the best out of the tea experience. Also, i would confirm that you do need to allow the tea to brew for 5 minutes before drinking. I normally like to steep the tea leaves several times, and in this case, I would suggest putting a few new leaves in.

the tea leaves are neither diced nor sliced; and that I believe helps to keep the integrity of the flavor whole. This is a genuinely good quality product.

I am keen to buy this for family to try as some tea smells better than it taste; not the case of this rishi jasmine tea. This is going to great after a good meal to help with the digestion.

I also can’t taste the vanilla or flower notes that this tea contains. I taste only fruity hibiscus. And that really sent my thing, so this isn’t going to be a staple tea around here.

title: The Tea Is Just Fine
text:
You get ten tea bags in the tin. The tin is sealed with a sticker over the top that wraps down the sides. The tea bags inside are not wrapped. They tasted pretty fresh. There are ten paper tea nags in the tin. No strings. No individual wrapping.
The tea itself is just okay. The cherry taste is evident, but not as strong as I expected. It mostly tastes like black tea, which would be fine if it were a little better black tea. This one just taste very generic and not very strong. The bonus is that if you leave the tea bag in your travel mug, it won’t ever get to the super strong oversteeped level.
My kids love it. They like the cherry flavor. I am really torn, because the tea itself isn’t bad, but it isn’t anything wonderful to write home about either. I keep going back and forth between 3 and 4 stars. Because it is okay, but the price is pretty high for the amount of tea you are getting and the quality of that tea. So, I’m going to go with 3 stars. It isn’t bad, but it should contain twice as many tea bags or be priced half of what it is for what you are getting.

title: They Work!
text:
I have drank my fair share of the tea, which I never enjoy because I despise licorice flavor though I love a cup of tea. One chew is the equivalent of one cup of tea. The chews look like caramel, smell like licorice, and taste like lemon licorice. They are about the size of a Starburst. Each chew is individually wrapped. I didn't think this was going to go well, but it turns out I like this method much better than the tea. I didn't like the flavor, but it was edible. And they do work just as well as the tea. You just have to make sure you're drinking a lot of water along with the supplements. I'm really liking these and will be buying more because they do work.
Now, they do have sugar added. Each chew is 20 calories. I feel like that might be important to some people.

There are two of the same kind of caramel chocolate in here, and they are pretty average- just a simple caramel cup. If you are giving this to someone who loves Nutella, you’re golden. text: I've not had sea salt caramels before, and I was missing my Mom's handmade caramels, so I started looking for caramels on Amazon. These not only looked good, I loved that I could repurpose the container.  I was not disappointed! The fusion of the sea salt with the caramel is absolutely amazing! I pinch one in half and slowly savor one half at a time, as slowly as possible. I have shared a piece or two with other friends/residents at my care center, that have dental work, and they say they don't have sticking problems like other caramels they've tried. I just love the fusion of flavors; and although they don't taste just like Mom's, I think she would understand, and not be offended, that I love these so much! I absolutely recommend these and will absolutely buy them again. If I can bear to part with them, I may make up some mini Christmas stockings, with a few pieces of Christmas candy and one of these, to hand out to residents next month. Absolutely worth every penny! And if you have family members or friends with 'sticky fingers', you may want to hide them, or make the container into a tissue box, with the caramels hidden underneath (as I am planning on doing) 😂😂😂👍💖 I would give 10 ☆'s, if they were available!!! title: So gross, I couldn't finish the 1st serving!
text: For a brand with 'True' in the name, they really fall short, and even go so far as to make it difficult to realize all the ingredients are not 'truly' good for you. Such as the fact that it contains, Stevia, which is not mentioned on the front of the box, as it should, to be less deceptive. If it had said it on the front, I would not have bought it! Although Stevia is a 'natural ingredient', that does not automatically make it good for you, or make the product taste good. It does say it in the tiny ingredient list I had to zoom in to see on my phone camera, and on the back. Nowhere is it on the front of the box, where is the place consumers see first. Not to mention that this was truly disgusting! I thought maybe it just needed a second one for the amount of water I had in my jug, but even adding a second  serving didn't help. Stevia can cause uncomfortable side effects, like possibly, diarrhea, in those with gastric sensitivities! Stevia is almost as bad as Nutrasweet, which includes phenylalanine, which can cause cancer. So I was looking for something 100% natural, with REAL sugar, and nothing else pretending to be. So if that's what you want too, don't buy this. I had set up an auto subscription, but after tasting this, I immediately cancelled it. Hopefully, my roommate can stand the taste. If not, it was an utter waste of money!
