My wife is from Baltimore where they have snowballs in the summer to cool everyone. I bought this in hopes that she would be pleased and would bring back memories for her.
She has already made the tropical punch and the lime, loves them both.
All she does is throw some ice in a blender with a small amount of syrup once the ice is crushed she puts it in the glass and adds more syrup to fit her taste.
Looks like I will be ordering more very soon :)

title: This is a nice variety of flavored oils
text: This is a nice variety of flavored oils. I make old fashion hard candy and lollies, all came out delish!

title: Bought as a Gift
text: Bought this as a gift for a co-worker! She was delighted that I remembered and was excited about the flavor and softness of chew!

title: Good Honey, Pricey, and Sugared
text: This is good honey, it has a strong but pleasing flavor. New Zealand must have some potent nectar in its plant life.  It did come a little sugared (and frozen initially) which made it so it would not squeeze or flow out, but worked well with a knife and a little softening on toast.  Cost is a little high, but pretty much all honey is now.  all in all a very good honey and we will relish the rest of the container!

title: Good Quality Black Tea
text: I'm happy with this tea, the leaves themselves look great, the packaging is good and resealable.  I don't know that it is a stand out black tea but it is a solid one.  It has a bit of bitterness to it and it is fairly strong.  Would order again.

title: Decent Floral Green Tea
text:
This is a decent jasmine tea. A steeping has a very floral and herbacious aroma. There is a slight bitterness to the tea but in general it is a decent mild green tea with some nice floral tones. I'm new to tea and trying hard to learn to appreciate tea in general and this actually has been one of the better greens I have tried. Interesting light yellow color.

I also appreciate the bag clip that will be used long after this tea is gone. It did come with a sample tea bag which was nice, however I completely misplaced mine so can't report on it.

title: Interesting Noodles
text: As a diabetic, I like the idea of low-carb noodles and these are fairly comparable to rice noodles, although I found them to be a little more rubbery.  Perhaps because these are thicker than the average rice noodle.  I was also a little surprised that they come double wrapped with seems a little overpackaged.  I like that they are ready to go and just need to be added to the dish after rinsing.  We have tried them in salads cold and added to a garbanzo bean and pea tikka masala simmer sauce and they did well in both.  There was a little inconsistency in a couple of bags which were labeled the same, but came out with one bag seeming a little shriveled.  All in all, pretty decent.

title: Interesting Chicken Bites
text: I was expecting tough, jerky like chicken bits but these are almost more like pieces of chicken breast.  They would be perfect for our camping trips as I am an omnivore living with vegetarians.  These could be added to meals just as chicken chunks.  The packaging is good with a resealable pouch.  The only real issue is that since they don't seem to be dry preserved jerky, I feel like they should be refrigerated after opening.  Nothing on the label saying that so it much be good to go unrefridgerated.  Good tasting, small portions per bag (think a single, small breast fillet.)

title: Delicious Chocolate
text:
We tried this out last night in the middle of a snow storm and it is all the liquid comfort that hot chocolate can be. Added to milk it was creamy and richly flavorful. Definitely on the top tier of hot chocolates. Even my partner who is hard to impress was super happy with it.

As a gift set, the bad side is that the external box is just a plain white box so would need wrapping and could be packaged with more show and class. The metal cup is cute and functional. Personally it is just another one off cup so not the most welcome addition to our mug cabinet but it does fit the gift set perfectly.

Recommend, but the real high point here is the hot chocolate itself.

title: We found the aroma a little off putting
text: Strangely, the first time we opened this package, we were very excited by the floral and vanilla aroma, but once steeped, it seemed a little strong.  We were a little put off, but after we got over that, I found it to have a pleasant flavor.  And in a sign of its calming abilities, my partner was snoring in 20 minutes after finishing the cup.  So looks like that part works well.

title: Good, Mild Olive
text: I was pretty happy with these olives, they have a complex but mild olive flavor that will go fantastic on salads etcetera.  I did notice that the fluid level was a little low in my bottle and some of the olives that were exposed to air were softer and less flavorful than the fully submersed olives.  All in all, pretty good though.

title: Unique Savory Flavor
text: I'm actually at a loss to describe this product.  It is like an essential oil made from a Chinese restaurant.  It have a warm, savory flavor that so far we have only added to salads, but we will be doing a stir fry in the near future.  It is a comforting flavor.  I like the squat little bottle it comes in. Not sure that we will re-order, but we are enjoying the adventure.

title: Super Fun Cultural and Culinary Adventure
text: We have really been enjoying this little assortment of Turkish snacks.  I actually keep a bucket list of small experiences and Turkish Delights were on it after reading the Narnia series with my kids.  I wish we had waited because the honey flavored delights in here are amazing.  Some items seemed surprisingly mundane like goldfish and pizza crackers, but it was fun to try them.  We have savored over the hot chocolate and all in all, it has just been a lot of fun.  Will look for others.

title: Great taste booster
text:
It took a while but I finally got the chance to make some mushroom risotto with this powder and it worked perfectly. It had a rich mushroomy taste that was fuller that just the whole mushrooms we added. The bag is nicely resealable so hopefully it will all stay nice and fresh and we can be adding mushroom to soups and casseroles for months to come.

Can't say that I got this for health benefits, just taste, but I'm glad it has some.

title: Decent Hot Sauce, Some Punch
text: This is a pretty decent hot sauce.  It is a little thin, but cannot knock it for its heat which has some kick without being anywhere close to too hot.  Nothing sadistic here. We tested it with nachos and it had a decent flavor and heat, but where it really shone was when added to soup.  Gave a very nice kick.

title: A Very Good Barbecue Sauce
text: Nice bold barbecue flavor.  I used it just to spice up some mac and cheese as a quick test and it felt like it deserved a far better base to test on.  I also used it to make some baked beans and it was wonderfully rich and tangy.  Definitely on my radar for grilling this summer!

title: Very Good Almonds
text: These are very good almonds, perfectly roasted and salted and cleaned of the papery husks you find on some almonds. Interesting that they are from Afganistan, happy to help out their agricultural industry. We have used them in salads and with cheese and apples and they have been pretty tasty and very crunchy.

title: More a Lingering Heat, Good Chocolate
text:
This is not blistering by any means. It is more like a warm after taste after you have finished the chololate. I was more fearful than I should have been. It is good tasting chocolate and I could not really taste anything to the heat, no peppery taste at all, just a contenting warmth. Probably not worth the higher price even with the nice tin, but very glad I tried it.

The mints were also very good, powerful and refreshing. Very much enjoyed both.

title: Pretty Good
text: We have been enjoying these and satisfying our sweet teeth on them.  I get a hint of cheap red rope at the start of the candies, but it quickly turns into a pretty satisfying cherry taste with a bit of tang.  Two pounds will last us a good long while and each package seems to be a good size of candy and I'm good at one.  They aren't on my top ten list or anything, but they are pretty darn good.

title: A Decent Chocolate Cookie
text: These are rather sedate little cookies.  They have a good, but not very strong chocolate taste, mild texture, soft with a little crunch inside.  The best word I can come up with is pleasant.  I don't know that I would go back and re-order, but did enjoy them.  Unlike Girl Scout thin mints, I could stop any time which made the resealable bag nice (not needed with the thin mints.)  All in all, they are not bad, but I will probably keep with flashier cookies.

title: Good Dark Roast, A Little Bitter
text: We had read a description of this coffee that promised hints of hot chocolate and many other subtle flavors.  What we got (to our pallettes) was a very decent dark roast coffee.  My partner says it needs to have milk to make it pretty good, but we are both pretty happy with it.  Our biggest issue with the coffee is that it comes in recycleable, but not compostable cups.  Since trying Beaniacs we are having a problem going back to normal cups for environmental reasons.  The coffee itself holds up well and if they had a similar compostable solution, we would probably consider it for a go to coffee.

title: A Classic and my partners morning tradition
text: My partner has gone through long periods of eating this cereal.  She likes it either as a handful of crunchy snack or as a hot cereal by adding milk and microwaving it. She likes it as a slightly sweet, but hopefully healthy snack.  Otherwise it is a classic and we are glad to have it back in our pantry, and I would guess we will be reordering for some time to come!

title: What's not to like
text: A case of Starburst, what could be better.  This has been a family favorite for years and I personally think the FlavorRED pack is brilliant.  All packs are great and we are in sugar induced heaven for a good long time to come.  Highly recommend, Will get this for Halloween next year!

title: Family Really Liked These
text: I really like these.  They are a bit like Fritos but with a very nice chipotle taste and a bit of a finer grain.  They are crispy and went well with a cheese dip.  Great size and shape.  Pretty much everything you would want in a chip and organic to boot!

title: Huge Bag of Great Rice
text: We made a huge stir fry over the weekend to try out this new rice and we have to say we are very happy with it.  A few cups of rice made a very generous and flavorful base.  It definitely has a strong nutty, taste and would make a great Bryanni.  10 pounds should last a while, but it was a big hit with everyone.  Recommend this rice!

title: Decent Sweet Snack
text: I have to admit, the idea of chicken and cinnamon sugar did not sound appealing.  But there is no sense of chicken in this snack, just chicken and pea protein "Isolates."  Think Cinnamon Toast Crunch cereal with cinnamon encrusted pretzel bits, with hidden protein supplements.  It is pretty tasty and comes in a great resealable bag for storage.  It is actually pretty good. A good source of hidden protein and a tasty snack.

title: Family Inhaled These Nuts
text: I barely had time to see the three sample bags I received before they had them finished off.  They all loved them in Habanero, Original and Coconut blend.  If anything they found them too addictive and tasty.  They were fresh, wonderfully flavored and perfect.  Literally, it did not matter that they came in zip lock bags because they completed the bags one by one in one sitting for each bag over a movie once, board games the next and I'm not sure what happened to the third.  Well Done Doug.

title: Big Hit!
text: Our daughter has a love affair with rice cakes and declares these to be very good.  We sampled the sea salt cakes and they did have a nice salty taste and the crispy emptiness that may be best appreciated by those people who love it.  Personally, I can take or leave rice cakes, but these seem to be high quality and well packaged.  These will be on our reorder list.

title: Made Great Ice Cream
text: We were looking for a good solution for natural vanilla chips in our ice cream when we were offered this as a reviewer product.  I have an induction ice cream maker that we use quite often and this vanilla paste was perfect for it.  We used this in a pretty rich recipe and it did a great job of providing a solid vanilla flavor with an appealling look of little bean chips.  Love it, will order again.

title: Packed Bars, but not Packed Box
text: With four of these per box and with the size of the bars, it does not seem like you get much per box.  The bars are smallish, but everyone like the taste and quality.  They just wish there were a little more in each container.  Our son actually said it was the best Nature Valley product he has ever eaten.  I am impressed with all the whole ingredients that you can see in the bar.  It looks healthy but tastes pretty good.

title: Very Good Rice
text: We have run a couple bowls through our rice cooker and are very happy with this rice.  We like to make Indian curries with simmer sauces and this has made near perfect and delicious rice for our suppers.  My biggest criticisum is that two pounds does not last long in our family.  I wished I had a twenty pound bag.  Recommend!

title: Very Flavorful
text: This had a tasty but perhaps a little artificial caramel flavor.  It is the right strength and roast and you can drink it without adding anything else.  I don't know if it will change my brands, but we are definitely going to enjoy drinking the case we received.  Tasty coffee, but not the best coffee we have tried. We also have gotten into coffees with compostable cups and it is hard to go back to plastic.

title: Beaniacs can’t become or go to coffee
text: We truly appreciate the effort that Beaniacs goes through to make their product environmentally friendly. What is even better is that this is a very tasty coffee. I don’t know what I can see it’s the best coffee I’ve ever had, but it is good enough to be in the top tier. Add to this the fact that their cups are completely compostable and we have a winner.It is actually hard to believe that the cup is not made out of plastic.  It is actually hard to believe that the cup is not made out of plastic. But we have been throwing them into our compost pile and they are breaking down. This particular donut shop flavor is rich and strong. Very happy with his flavor and very happy with this company

title: Great Graham Crackers
text: These were very good Graham Crackers.  They were super fresh and crispy and perhaps on par with any graham cracker I have ever had.  That being said, it is a graham cracker, so my life didn't change or anything, but if you are looking for a graham cracker, don't shy away from these, they are quite good!

title: Almost Unbelievable
text:
Organic...compostable cups...good price...good taste... It all seems too good to be true. And when I opened these and asked my partner to try them, she didn't believe any of it. She would not believe they were Kcups, which they do not look like, but do work in the machine fine. She did not believe they are compostable, but I showed her on the side of the box and pointed out that the plastic was actually coffee chaffe "plastic" that does compost as does the paper cover and the cloth bag. She said they must be expensive, but they are about 50 cents a piece which is right in line with all but the biggest bulk packs out there. And to top it all off, it is dark and fresh and tasty. We have found our new go to coffee and have several other flavors to try out!

So this begs the question, if this kickstarter product can do all these great things at the price of other coffees, why are they not all compostable. Kudos to Beaniac, we are going to put our money where our beliefs stand (which is not too hard since his is a great coffee at a very good price.)

title: Cheddar and Sour Cream Bag was Inhaled by Family
text: The kids absolutely loved these.  They had a great Cheddar and Sour Cream flavoring that comes in a yellow powder that sticks to the chip well and does not get on your fingers like Doritos and Cheetos.  They are not overly salty.  All in all, very good chips.

title: Four Classic Cookies, How Could You Go Wrong
text: Perhaps the worst thing I can say about these is that it is surprising how few mini cookies you can eat for 120 calories.  Otherwise these were a huge hit for snack time. They are perfect for putting into lunch boxes and bags and there I actually like that they are considerate of serving sizes.  48 bags goes a long ways.  I would have to say that I would not have bought animal crackers or the graham snacks if they were not bundled, but it was a nice walk down memory lane, although the animal crackers were surprisingly small.  All in all a great bundle!

title: Seems Great
text: We got a reviewer bottle of this salsa that unfortunately had burst its top in shipping, probably because it had frozen.  At any rate, we did not want to eat something that was shipped unsealed so our review is based on smell, price and appearance.  And it did smell wonderful.  I really wished we had been able to try it smelled so good and looked fresh and bright red.  The price is good and at $2, this would have been a good, big, and reasonably priced bottle of salsa.  Just wished it had arrived intact.

title: Not a Huge Hit with the Family
text: Usually we love the Orchard Valley Harvest products, but we have hit a couple duds recently.  These are interesting. They are super crisp and are decently powdered with flavor, but as one of our sons put it, "These are like tasty styrofoam."  If you are familiar with veggie straws, they have the same styrofoam texture with a light dorito like flavor dusting.  I don't know what else to say, they just never caught on with anyone in the family, and they tend to really go for crisp textures like this.  Still have faith in the brand, but surprised that the last two products we got were not the usual big hits.

title: Rare Disappointment from Orchard Valley Harvest
text: I swear that we bought the Chocolate covered blueberries before and my partner remembers fighting her kids over them as they guzzled them down.  We thought this was the same product, but we found them to be just so-so.  The chocolate seems waxy and the blueberry centers are ok, but all in all we are not impressed.  We were super happy when the bag arrived, but so far only the tester bag has been opened.  The kids say that they are alright but they passed on seconds.  Not sure what happened to this run, but it was disappointing.

title: These are OK
text: We were looking forward to trying these, hoping we had found a non-corn cornchip and they are ok, but just that.  They are thicker and stiffer than the normal corn chip. The flavor is strongly lime and ok, but not inspiring.  We will definitely eat these, but no one loved them enough to reorder.

title: Strong Dark Coffee
text: We found this to be good, strong dark coffee, but probably will not reorder.  The flavor is okay.  For us it is a little too strong with hints of bitterness.  It's a little hard to add flavors because it is strong on its own.  In general this is ok coffee, but not quite for us.  Also, I wish Keurig and other vendors would get serious about making the cups recyclable, I feel guilty about throwing away all the single use plastic.

title: A Little Greasy, A little Spicy, A little Overpackaged
text: These are pretty good, I got the jalepeno beef sticks and they have a nice little bit of heat to them.  They have kind of a greasy finish, but the beef and peppers taste is satisfying.  I am surprised how much packaging there is.  Each is individually wrapped and then all five are in a ziplock over bag which seems like a lot for a five pack.  Definitely would like to see less plastic used.  But for taste, these are pretty good.

title: Wonderful Chocolate Covered Caramels
text: We have been absolutely loving these at our house hold.  They come in a great and convenient canister for resealing, storing and serving.  They had been on the front porch when we got them and they were a little hard, but once at room temperature they were perfect and have a wonderful caramel and chocolate flavor.  The sea salt is liberally applied to the outside and balances well with for sweet and salty cravings.

title: Very Good K-cup Hot Chocolate
text: I'm impressed with this hot chocolate.  My partner has had a Keurig for years but I had not interest as a non coffee drinker, but these have changed that.  While I don't find this to be the richest, creamiest hot chocolate, I do find it very tasty.  The mint seems to be fill the flavor out wonderfully and gives it a rich taste despite being a little watery in consistency.  I do buy Swiss Miss mixes so I like the brand, but I find the ease and taste of these cups to be kind of addictive.  The price is ok per cup although in this bulk it adds up.  I wish I could say that the case will last a long time, but I really can't help but have at least a cup a day.  The are very good.

title: Kids are enjoying them
text: Everyone was unanimous that these are four star snacks.  No one is over the top about them, but they are pretty decent.  They are a little sticky and taffy like but with a savory peanut butter thing going on.  We love the plant based protein they deliver in a good snack sized packages.  All in all a good health conscious snack.

title: Good Taste in General, Nice Packaging, Pricey
text: I personally am not a big fan of almonds, but my partner is very much so.  She and the kids were delighted with these until they hit a couple nuts that were not quite right, perhaps a little rotten.  The Creme Brulee flavor was very well liked and the can only last a couple days before they were gone.  They seemed to be pretty addictive.  The packaging is very good and makes a great gift.  It is a little expensive though, I would have expected less than $15 dollars.

title: Oof, Rare Failure from Campbells
text:
This just did not go over with the family. No one cared for the taste at all. It has the consistency of baby food with a less satisfying taste. We did a couple tests containers to a vegetarian family that love broccoli and sweet potatoes and not one got finished. In fact, after an hour they even needed to be removed from the kitchen garbage because my partner could not stand the odor.

Giving presentation one star for putting them in not recycleable cans. I have to admit, I feel pretty let down by this product. Love Campbell's, but this is a swing and a miss on many levels.

title: Good Straight Coffee
text: My partner is the big coffee drinker in the house, but she likes her coffee with additives like hazelnut etcetera.  She has been drinking our reviewer samples and came back saying that this is much better base coffee than anything she has been putting through the Keurig.  She says that it has a greater depth of flavor than the other coffees and works perfectly with a dab of hazelnut syrup added to it. All in all she is very happy with it.  My only concern is that they get 10 cups into a box that everyone else seems to get 12 into.  Not sure what is up with that.

title: Good Savory Warmth
text: We used this to make a couple variants of Peruvian vegetarian soups and were pretty happy with it. It has a nice earthy and warm taste that fits perfectly with chunky potatoes and legumes to make a perfectly hardy, filling and warming winter soup. We got a huge reviewers sample product so we may be making this a lot this winter to make a dent in the canister, but right now I’m looking forward to the experiment.

title: Just What We Remembered
text:
Last winter we went to see the Monarchs wintering west of Mexico City. We stayed at a lovely rancho in Zitacuaro and discovered the greatest hot chocolate in the world. It had a hint of cinnamon, wonderful and somewhat delicate chocolate taste that was simply wonderful. We have missed it ever since.

I didn't even think of looking for it, I just assumed it was a wonderful memory until I got offered a reviewer sample of Abuelita hot chocolate. We were very hopeful when we knew it was being shipped and super happy when it lived up to our memories. It is a different taste, but we find it wonderful, and perfect for a Minnesota winter. I was worried about how well a big disk of chocolate would melt, but it quickly eroded in hot milk and whisked easily, blending into exactly what we remembered. This is totally going into a lot of stockings of friends and family this Christmas.

The only thing I would say is to watch prices. There are lots of different packages apparently and they vary greatly in price. Currently you can get six packages with six discs for half the cost of three twelve packs. Each disc only makes about two really big mugs (about two cups each.) So order big once you know you like it. It is on our "to order" list now!

title: These are OK, the kids like them
text: Oatmega sounds like a very health conscious product, but that doesn't seem to bear out when looking at the ingredients.  I like the inclusion of DHA Omega 3's but they could do with less sugars and fillers.  To me they have a kind of chemically smell, but I don't detect that in the taste.  The taste is ok, a little bland, but OK. The texture is less than thrilling and all in all they are good, but definitely not great.  But then the kids said they really like them, so at least 4 stars.  We will eat them, but probably not reorder.

title: Decent Coconut Oil
text: We used this in popcorn, eggs and a stir fry for an oil and the taste was good.  We liked that it is organic and it worked as we would expect a good coconut oil to perform.  I can't say that I was wowed, but it was good. We also used it on rough elbows and it worked.  We have had cheaper priced coconut oil that worked the same, but this is a decent product for the price.

title: Good Nuts
text: We tried a number of these and found them to be fresh and crunchy and everything we would want from a walnut.  Usually we add walnuts to recipes and oatmeals etcetera and not so much eating them straight, and these will work in any recipe.  Actually they will work as ingredients better than snacks because they are unsalted.  The ziplock bag is nice, the price is decent for a premium walnut - nearly all unbroken halves.  All in all we are very happy with them.

title: Good Flaxseed Oil
text: My partner is a vegetarian who has vegan aspirations and is well read on nutrition so she was excited to try this oil with me.  The Flaxseed Omega 3 benefits are well known and she often buys flaxseed oil already.  We tried it with a balsamic vinegar as a salad dressing and it was very good.  We also put it in a fruit smoothy with yogurt and to be honest, I could not really detect it.  The flavor is subtle and unobjectionable.  She is very happy with it and said five stars for sure.

title: These are a Favorite in our Household
text: We get the snack bags and trail mix bags quite often and we are very happy with the quality of the nuts and berries.  There is a lot of packaging, but it is also very convenient to toss some into school bags or backpacks for hikes.  We have made a few salads and put these on and they were great, but where they will really shine is when our kale starts to come in and we can make a quick salad for fresh kale, a package of these and some balsamic.  We also have mixed a couple bags into oatmeal.  We love these and cannot recommend them enough.

title: Like Adult Cheetos
text: Well, if adult means that things don't need to be over the top with flavor and you are more concerned about ingredients than power of the flavor.  They are definitely a lot more subdued in flavor, better than bland but not so far as to say flavorful.  But they are not bad.  They have a pretty Cheetoey crunch and texture, but with protein and some other nutritional value that Cheetos lack.  The price is definitely a sticking point, it will need to lower the price point to compete with flavored popcorns, but if the price were the same, I would mix it up with this willingly.

title: Decent Snack, Kids Love Them
text: So my nostalgia from Andy Capp's fries remembers them as thick potato chip sticks, not puffs like these.  That was a little unexpected for me.  We got the Ranch flavor which was strong and strangely a little sweet.  I'm not sure that my adult palette likes them as much as the adolescents in the house.  They have been eating them with abandon.  They are strongly flavored with a rich ranch powder and are a little like Cheetos but with less mess.  They're not bad, but probably more aimed at a younger crowd of snackers.

title: Interesting Salt
text: Visually interesting pink salt from McKormick, a brand I trust. I was hoping that it would be more of a salt mill salt, but this is already ground to a fairly small grain.  It is a good conversation piece and seems like a decent but subdued salt flavor.  I do wish it was more of a rock salt that would have been perfect for our glass sided salt and pepper grinders but won't quite work for that. Glad we tried it though.

title: I Appreciate What this is, Did not care for taste
text: I like these bars for what's in them and what isn't and I had a lot of hope for a sea salt flavor, but unfortunately, I didn't really care for the overall taste.  There is definitely some caramel there, but there is another undertone that I didn't find pleasing.  It's ok, and I'm sure we will eat these, probably on camping trips. Like I said, high hopes that didn't quite bear out.

title: Decent, Love that we are getting Lentils into the kids
text: We tried this over the weekend with the kids as well as a creamy vegetable meal with the same noodles.  Both came out fairly good.  These we used with a marinara we made from scratch and the noodles were a good texture and flavor and I don't think the kids realized that they were not eating their normal wheat noodles.  The price is not horrible for gluten free food and we will probably be ordering more for hosting cousins who have gluten issues. All in all, not a bad noodle.

title: Not Bad, A Little Salty
text:
Actually, for gluten free, it is not bad at all. The lentil noodles taste decent and have the proper consistency and you could even pass a healthier noodle by your unwitting kids. We have a couple extended family members that are gluten intolerant and we will be bringing a couple boxes up to the cabin for their visits this summer.

It was quick to make, just boil the noodles and vegetable mix for less than 10 minutes, drain, then stir in milk butter and their spice packet. It is pretty salty and decently flavored. It isn't a favorite, but it isn't half bad.

title: Great Product, Great Size
text:
I have a relationship that goes way back with Life Savers Mints. My mom was a firm believer that you should have a clean peanut butter jar full of these under the car seat at all times. She would even send me containers full when I went off to college and their flavor kind of meant love from her. All those memories came flooding back when I opened this bag and I could smell the peppermint.

I have always loved that these are individually wrapped, I love that they are fresh and crisp and instantly repair your breath, and I love my memories of them. I just ran a peanut butter jar through the wash and look forward to having these in my car.

title: A Good Vanilla Extract
text: I wish I could say that this is noticeably better or worse than the Vanilla extracts we have been using, but it really seems pretty close to Watkins.  We used it in an ice cream and cookies and both turned out well with no noticeable change from the old extract.  This is good news I guess since a 16 ounce bottle is pretty big so we will have it around for a while.  The smell out of the bottle is very good and taste is good.

title: An Old Standby
text: I have been working more and more turmeric into my diet due to its antiinflamatory properties and McCormick has been my go to.  I was offered a reviewer container of Turmeric and it is more of the same Turmeric that I have enjoyed from them.  I put it in my eggs this morning and it was fresh and ready to go.  Love the 5.87 ounce sized container which will last a while.  Definitely love and recommend this product.

title: Everything I could have asked for in a Almond Flour
text:
We have a seemingly growing group of friends and family that are gluten intolerant so we were very happy to test this Almond Flour and it proved to be wonderful. We have made two batches of cookies for sharing with a niece and sister in law and they came out very well. The flour worked well as a wheat flour substitute in both recipes and if anything they ended up tasting richer.

This probably won't be a regular staple in our house, but we are keeping it in mind for next thanksgiving for making treats for the gluten intolerant people who come every year. All in all a great product.

title: Great Taste for the Ice Cream Maker
text: We usually use Watkins mint extract but were happy to try this Peppermint Extract.  I was a little worried that it might be more sharply menthol tasting, but it actually proved to have a very nice taste in our mint chocolate chip.  We have a no fail, simple recipe and this totally worked with it.  Nice flavor and scent, will enjoy using the rest of this bottle.

title: Five Star Taste, but expensive
text:
I wish this was a more inexpensive treat, but unfortunately it is priced to match its richness in flavor and quality. My family absolutely loved it and my partner was diligent to make sure that no one binged it, but rather savored it. She said it was the best chocolate covered treat like this she has had.

It is packaged nicely, but I have to say that it did not look too appealing when it arrived in the mail. The shipping an the clear plastic tube container made the product looked messy and to be honest, it really did not look too appealing with the bits and crumbs showing on all sides. It took a bit of the gifting value away. However, once opened, the taste wash fresh and wonderful. I'm just not sure that I could justify the $30 list price.

title: Decent Rice, but a little expensive
text: We enjoyed this rice a lot and it went well with everything we have made it with. It is a little more expensive than our normal rices, perhaps because of the nice plastic containers that it comes in.  We have gotten a few other rices from this company and we have generally been happy with it, but usually get rice in bulk to drive down the average price.  Would not shy away from buying a specialty rice from them again in the future.

title: Very Tasty Snack
text: Our family loved these fruit strips, they are wonderfully sweet and tasty and love the Mango flavor which seems unique for a fruit strip.  They are a good size for putting into a kids lunch.  All in all a great product, will be on our buy list.

title: to quote my partner "I could get fat off of these!"
text:
These are nice and crunch on the outside and surprisingly soft in the peanut butter center. The were very fresh right out of the newly opened canister. Love that there are no artificial flavors or colors or transfat. The flavors are perfect, just the right saltiness and satisfying peanut butter.

5G of protein in ten pretzals, but at 15 calories per, you can't pop too many. The container is very big, but the taste is so good, these won't stay around long. There is currently no price for the product, but if it is at all reasonably priced, this is a winner of a snack.

title: Perfect Change of Pace for Halloween
text: We are really looking forward to giving these little juice boxes for Halloween.  They are perfectly sized for handing out, although a little small for quenching and adult sized thirst.  They are a nice fruit punch and taste as good as any other fruit punch juice box.  I know I would have been excited to get on back in the day and hope the trend remains.  Very cute.

title: Holy Moly, 5 pounds is mound of candy
text: This is an amazingly sized collection of candy classics.  Our kids were over joyed to see it come out of the box and we sampled liberally without even putting in a dent.  I had no idea what 5 pounds would look like.  The pricing is decent and is the only purchase you need to make for Halloween.  Hershey's milk chocolate, Kit Kats, and Reeses Peanut Butter Cups, what else could you need.

title: A disappointment
text: Our family definitely did not care for this.  It was mostly the texture, it was mushy, even the quinoa was mushy. The taste was an artificial blueberry. To be honest we probably will not finish the last three. It sounded great, we love quinoa and blueberries, but this just didn't do it for us.

title: Yep, These Are Good!
text: It took us a while to try these Kalamata Greek Olives for some reason, but we just spiralized up some cucumbers and a made some Greek salads and these worked perfectly.  They had a nice flavor and texture and lived up to any olives we have ever gotten for Greek Salads in the past. But they are definitely not cheap, and $40+ is a large investment for olives at one time.  We usually get a quarter pound from a mideastern deli or a small Trader Joe's bottle here and there.  We now have a lot of olives waiting in the pantry.  I have no fear that we will get through them now though.  They will be out with cheese and crackers later tonight.  These are very tasty olives.

title: Chives without my standard waste
text: I use chives occasionally and almost always end up using about half of the fresh bundles I get and throw the other half out.  I love that these are more shelf stable and I can choose to use what I need when I need it.  So far I have only made chive mashed potatoes to check test and consistency and they worked very well.  I definitely got plenty of chive taste and no problems with consistency they were soft and no distraction in the potatoes.  I rehydrated first just to make sure and let them sit in the mashed potatoes for a while before serving and eating and they seemed to work very well.  Looking forward to other possibilities!

title: A Good Cashew Butter but Pricey
text: Well I guess all Cashew Butters are pricey so this one falls in line on price.  But I find it hard to justify the price over peanut butter in general.  However, I brought the individual packages into the Amazon as a portable pick me up when hiking or heat was taking its toll.  I love the organic, simple ingredients approach that Justin's follows and it made me feel good about what I was putting into my body.  Now I have received a free 12 oz bottle for review and it is the same delicious taste and feel good nutrition from the packets, but in a Peanut Butter jar.  You can't go wrong.  But it is still pricey.

title: Great Value for a Great Product
text:
We are a hidden valley ranch potato dip family and we pay on average, about $1.75 a package for individual pouches in the grocery store. That will probably be the main or possibly only way that we will be using this product, but we will definitely go through these two bottles by mid fall at a considerable savings. Currently the two pack is not showing a price but I see that single 8oz containers are 6.27 right now. That would be half the price we currently pay which is what we would be looking for in a bulk product.

Otherwise, we are happy with the results of putting a little over an ounce of this mixing into a container of sour cream. I admit that it is decadant, but little tastes better on a hot summer evening or with a picnic. The whole family loves it. It is the perfect dip for veggies and chips.

title: Very Good Almonds
text: These a good almonds.  We can't say that they are noticeable standouts, but they are definitely good.  There is no price listed right now but I have seen other Fisher oven roasted nuts posted at some rather premium prices.  I don't know that I would consider these premium almonds, so perhaps I would check the price so you are not paying a premium price.  But if these nuts are priced at an average price, you won't go wrong with them.  They were fresh, tasty, and pleasantly salted.  They are everything you look for in a healthy nut snack (well maybe you could skip the salt, but that is pretty important to the taste.)  I can't say anything bad about these nuts, overall they are very good but probably not great.

title: Great Product that We All Know and Love, But at a High Price
text:
I giving this four stars because we love the product in our house. Cheddar Goldfish are a classic that we are very familiar with over the years. Our kids have eaten these since they were toddlers and it has rarely not been in our pantry. What holds this back from being the five star product we have known and loved is the price of this six pack. We can get these much cheaper locally and at $27 for six bags (over $4 a bag) it just doesn't make sense.

Keep an eye on the price, at half the price it would be a great five star, I just can't justify the difference in price for such a readily available product.

title: Delicious but a little runny
text:
Two things really stick out with this peanut butter, first it tastes great, interesting, but great. Second the Texture is a little offputting. We were hoping to use these for camping and I think they will definitely be in the pack, but it is a little strange just out of the pack. It is wet and runny and does not have our familiar consistency, not even the consistency of natural butters that need a good amount of stirring. We did work one up in a bowl pretty good, but it still seems a little runny.

But that can be looked over because the taste is great. I love the subtle flavor of the date. It tastes very much like peanut butter but with a little extra. Love it.

We are a little concerned that it seems a little over packaged. It is a little more that we like to do even for convenience on camping trips. The over box is recyclable, but the little packets are not. At the least, a little more product per package would be good so we would only need one for a couple people. Not sure what the solution would be, but this seems a little egregious.

But in the most important category - taste - we love it.

title: Great Tasting, A Little Small
text:
These are simply delicious and the whole family adult and child has given them an enthusiastic thumbs up. Everyone other than me in the household is vegetarian, so we love the Protein content, although it would have won on taste alone. They are the perfect after school snack expect that they are a little on the small side, maybe three inches long and taking up only about half of the sleeve package. They pack very well and will be in our backpacks for camping this upcoming weekend.

In reality though, the only thing that is important for a snack like this is taste. And it is a classic mix of peanut butter and chocolate in the right ratio. These are delicious.

title: The Best Caramel I've Ever had
text:
I'm not kidding, these caramels a rich and luxurious. They arrived and my partner tried one and quickly sent me a text saying that they were amazing. When I got home I unwrapped one and popped it in my mouth. She looked at me wide eyed telling me that it took her a half hour to fully appreciate hers in little nibbles and yelled at me to for not cherishing it enough. But, thanks to the caramel being amazingly chewy, even when softened by heat, it took a couple minutes to get through one. It was amazing. They are now hidden from the kids so we can decadently horde them.

To tell the truth, the sea salt doesn't seem that strong, or there are no larger pieces of salt because I never got a strong or punctuated taste of salt. What I did get was an overwhelming, creamy taste of caramel. Soft and warm and luxurious. A warming, rich feeling experience. I can't say enough good things about these. I hesitate about the plastic jar they come in as I'm not a big fan of plastics in packaging, but we will definitely reuse this jar. Otherwise, everything is heavenly.

title: Didn't realize this containted Sucralose, but pump bottle is great!
text: This is my bad for not reading properly, but I accidentally ordered sugar free version with Sucralose.  We are unable to use this product.  However, I love the pump packaging.  Will reorder with proper product.  Be wary of Sucralose, especially if you have precondition with irritated or inflamed intestinal lining.

title: Not overly strong, but very well flavored
text:
When I got this I was a little apprehensive that I just got 12 containers. But I am super happy with it. To be honest, it is not particularly potent so I find my self putting in more of this than I would most spice mixes. 12 containers is still a lot, but the taste is fantastic and I will make good use of it in eggs, skillet breakfasts and breakfast burritos. And actually I can see if being used beyond breakfast, although I have not done that.

Salsa is the perfect word for this, that is the sense it gives me in eggs. I love the bell pepper that comes through but could use a nice shot of jalapenos coming through. It is flavor without heat. Onion and tomato are also there for a salsa flavor. All in all a good spice mix.

title: Great Controlable Portions/Doseage, and They are Delicious
text:
I have long struggled with caffeinated sodas. I tend to slip back into my addiction on long drives so I have been looking at a variety of caffeine solutions that will allow me to stay alert on 8 hour drives but not back under the control of the sticky dragon of soda. I have used caffeinated water, gum, bars, and straight up pills. These are a near perfect solution. they are controllable portions, the chocolate and caramel combo is good and with my initial tests, they appear to be very effective.

I also like that unlike JetAwake pills and the like, these are just a half a cup of coffee's worth of caffeine. So they are enough to make me more alert, but not jittery. I brought some along on a weekend trip with a five out drive just to try. I can't say that I needed them, but I did appreciate the convenience of packaging.

As far as I can tell this is a perfect combination of control and flavor. The are a little runny, I would be careful about crushing them or melting them, but so far, they seem perfect.

title: A little Bitter, but They Do What is Promised
text:
I got the fruit flavored gum and I would have to say that the first awakening jolt that you get is the immediate bitter taste. It was a little unsettling, but if you get through it the flavor really tames down. To me I got an alkaline sense to it, perhaps that is the caffeine. I can't say that the fruit ends up being a great flavor, but it is manageable.

For me, I'm looking for a solution for long road trips to my parents while giving up my dependence on sugared colas. I really think this could be my solution, and I don't like the gum well enough to become addicted to it like I do with the soda. I have tried it two mornings and I definitely felt woken by the time my commute to work was complete. I think these will be perfect for my next 14 hour drive spread over two day road trip!

title: Fresh, Well Packaged and Decent Price
text: We were very happy with these walnuts.  They came fresh and in good shape.  I love the resealable bag and the size is perfect to get us through a holiday season.  Probably the most important thing is value and the $7 price matches favorably with what we find at our local grocery.  All in all we are very happy with these.

title: Great Pecans!
text: This is a great bag of pecans.  We love the ziplock storage bag and the ample amount of the product.  The nuts were fresh and we used them immediately for general snacking while saving half for Thanksgiving pecan pies.  We can't say anything bad about this product, but since they are not carried on the Amazon site yet we cannot tell the price point to see the value.  We can vouch for the product which was very good.

title: Good Quality Almonds in Resealable Packaging.
text: This is a very nice and generous amount of almonds. We Should be good for our baking, salad, and nibbling needs for some time.  These are very good tasting almonds with great resealable packages, which I really appreciate.  I think the value is definitely there in the product, but currently there is no price listed on Amazon so I'm not sure the ounce for ounce value.  But I can vouch that these are very good almonds.  So far we have used them in a couple salads and nibbled quite a few and everyone is happy with them.

title: So Good I Didnt Get Any, and Good Enough that We Will Order Again!
text:
Well I guess it was good. We had a girl scout event at our house and we put our bag out on the snack table. By the time I got back to it, it was empty (less than an hour with about 25 people there.) It was consumed way faster than even the frosting covered animal crackers.

Good news, my partner had quite a bit and reports that it was really good. She loved the mix of tropical fruit. She noted the nice mix of sweet and sour and particularly like the pineapple and said that banana were better than most banana chips she's had. Perhaps the biggest compliment we can give it, other than that it was inhaled when offered to a crowd, is that we are planning to reorder it, enough to take on canoeing trips next summer.

title: Not Bad, But Not Going on the Grocery List
text: We enjoyed this mixer. The kids drank it straight and thought it was pretty good and we added vodka a couple times for weekend night caps and found it to be pretty decent.  I don't know that we will buy it again, but it is a decent enough product.

title: Hot Chocolate Tasted OK, Like that Caffeine Comes from Green Tea Extract
text:
I guess I had a lot of curiosity for these and had not read much about it before I received them. I knew they were caffeinated but did not know the source, so I was glad to find that it came from a Green Tea extract which comes with a lot of other nutrient benefits. Much better than finding that it wasn't just a purified caffeine added to the batter. I was also interested to find out that there is about a half cup of coffee's worth of pick me up. I have had one in the morning on the ride into work the last few days and I can't say that it jets me awake, but I'm sure it is giving a bit of a boost.

The flavor is a little mixed for me. The bar has a very convincing hot chocolate taste, but there is a slightly unsettling taste that I believe is coming from the marshmallow coating which is sweet but with some kind of biting flavor that doesn't seem to fit. I actually think I would have liked just the dry chocolate by itself. The bar has a satisfying crunch and a graininess that sticks in the teeth for a while, so not great to eat before heading into a conversation. Also, interesting is that there is a strong hot chocolate aftertaste that is not unpleasant. But the main reason I am giving this four stars rather than five is the slightly unsettling taste I get when eating them. It is not bad, just a little off to my palette.

Packaging is OK, like that there are 12 bars. I plan to save most of them for a long road trip I have coming up to perk me up when I'm getting a little drowsy.

title: Great Product, Convenient Packaging for putting in Backpack
text:
Taste wise these are absolutely fantastic. They are fresh and delicious with a rich almondy taste in the equivalent of peanut butter. I have a love/hate relationship with the packaging. For camping, I love these, the small cups are perfect for packing and convenience of portioning. For the kitchen, they are overpackaged to the point I feel guilt having them. So I would suggest the larger bottles.

But for us we were mostly looking for a sample of the product and as camping food. And for that it is perfect. They are inherently high fat, higher caloric food stuff, but that again is what we are looking for, a healthy energy supply for paddling and hiking. We love the effort at organic and the health benefits of tree nuts. All in all a great product.

Pricewise, it is more definitely more expensive than peanut butter, but when looking at the price of nuts, it is not out of reason. Especially when looking at the larger bottles. We look forward to relishing this on our upcoming trips.

title: Very Decent Cookies, Strong Coconut Taste in Chocolate Chip Cookies
text:
We have a couple of gluten intolerant members of our extended family so we got some chocolate chip cookies to share when they were over. They seemed to like these well enough, for me, they tasted strongly of coconut which I found a little disconcerting. They weren't bad, but much like vegetarian meat substitutes, I have problems separating expectations of the real thing. The cookies were dry and crispy which was satisfying until they somewhat overwhelmed my palette with coconut. But all in all, they were ok cookies.

The box is not particularly big, a little over packaged, and like all gluten free substitutes, a little pricey. But I was happy to have these to share with our guests. I wouldn't mind having a few around for drop ins, but think it might be worth searching around to see if there are better cookies. Won't knock these though, they were fine cookies.

title: A Great Birthday Gift for the Reese's Lover in Your Life
text:
What's not to like. Reese's Peanut Butter cups with Happy Birthday messages. The only thing that would be better is to be able to get custom messages. That would be awesome! BDay is good for the Reese's lover in your life for sure, but it would be nice to have flexible messages.

Over a pound of cups is also impressive and this does make a great Birthday gift to share and savor. It was a great hit with everyone in the house.

title: Great Mix, Great Quality
text:
This is a very good trail mix. It has great diversity and the fruit is nice and crispy. It is filling and tasty and has been well received by everyone who has tried it. We took a small baggy on a hike and it worked well as a bona fide trail mix.

We were very happy and would definitely buy again.

title: Great new Twist on Starbursts
text:
I'm a long time fan of Starbursts and this is a great new collection of flavored. I especially like the sour cherry and apple which seems like more mature tastes than the base flavored. The berry flavored are also very good.

The value of this package is good as each pack is just over a dollar, but to be honest I don't know that I've ever needed two dozen packs of Starbursts tempting me.

title: Decent value for a new classic candy
text:
We all know Skittles, and a good I would think that a good number have tried the sour variety. I love the product and truly enjoy the sour sweetness of this candy. The truly unique aspect of this 8 pack of 7.2 oz packs is the price point. At a little over $2 for almost a half pound, this is very competitively priced.

So if your are in the market for 4 pounds of sour Skittles, this is a great value for a great product.

title: Perfect for Packing for Camping, Great Massage Oil
text:
When I saw these offered, I immediately thought "camping in the Boundary Waters Canoe Area." They seemed perfect for packing in a cooking oil, as well as an oil for rubbing out muscles that have paddled a little too long.

What I got was a box of wonderfully individually packaged coconut oils. The packages themselves are rather small, but enough to use to fry potatoes and vegetables for breakfast or to carmelize onions for burgers. I wince a little when i think that they are very overpackaged, but for camping I forgive that. I could see it taking a couple of these on some bigger meals, but the shelf stability and travel convenience is fantastic.

Our camping season is pretty much done for this year, so to test the quality of the oil, we tore one open and popped popcorn in it. The coconut adds a subtle sweetness to the popcorn and worked perfectly for popping. Then we squeezed the left over for back massages. For back massages, it is great how to oil melts when it hits your hands and lubricates well for kneading muscles. And afterward my girlfriend smelled delicious. It feels oily for a while but soaks into the skin well and left her skin super soft.

title: Extra light means extra light taste
text:
My honey and I like the taste of olive oil. It provides a unique taste to foods, particularly those of the Latin Caribbean kitchen. It was a staple in my household (the "G" brand which I'll never use again) and the health benefits are a bonus.

I purchased this Pompeian brand thinking that light would not lessen the taste dramatically. Oh, but it does.

There's absolutely nothing wrong with the product. Pompeian is a great brand, and with the little red seal on the back label, you're guaranteed that this is 100% pure olive oil. However, in terms of taste, there is none for us. This product would probably work for individuals who are venturing into olive oil and eschew the strong flavor. However, for us, this might as well be canola oil.

My next order includes Pompeian ROBUST Olive Oil. Much more our speed.

One word - no. I'm unsure of how long the item was in transit, but the caramels were just shy of hot. Took one out, squeezed it (see picture), tasted it and it was not good. It tasted of a warm, gooey sweet plastic. Unfortunately, I don't know if the altered taste was a result of shipping through triple-digit weather, or whether it's the actual caramel.

The other thing, which has nothing to do with summer is the packaging and quantity. The height of the product is that of a soda can (see pic) and there are 27 caramels in the container (see pic). If the quality was top-notch, I'd think this was worth it, but in my eyes, it is not. Lastly, the packaging has only one layer of seal - on the inside lid (see pic). It does not have one of those seals around the top, which didn't instill confidence in the product.

My lesson? I'll not order items that will not fare well in the extreme SW heat. I'm unsure of the quality of Tara's Caramels, but I will not order again.

title: One Star Less Due to Bottle Top
text: This is delicious. I put it in a lot of stuff because it adds a depth of flavor that I can't get with my food allergies (seafood). Typically, oyster sauce is made with oysters and fermented fish; however, this is made with oyster mushrooms, which, I am told, tastes like real oysters. It is thick, syrupy and concentrated, which is why I took a star off. The bottle has too large of an opening and it pour out instead of drips (which is what you need for this, as it can easily ruin a dish with too much- and it pours out way too fast). Only a drop or two is necessary but adds so much flavor to any dish. It doesn't taste mushroom-y (although I love the taste of mushrooms and wouldn't protest if it did). We use it in our ramen, but a good cook would know how to use it better. I have read other reviews on here that say you can use it in place of fish sauce, too. It's a bargain because of its concentrated formula- it will last a long time. It is really a pantry staple- especially if you like Asian foods like we do.

I like that it is shelf-stable; this way, I always have something on hand for quick and easy pizza. This sausage (very pepperoni-esque) would also taste delicious in any type of soup that calls for spicy sausage. It was delivered in a timely manner and was a reasonable price, too. title: Deliciously Soft Oatmeal Raisin Cookies
text:
These cookies came within a few days of ordering, sealed in a box (for these soft-baked cookies, offering a resealable bag would help them stay fresh and soft for longer, but didn't last long enough for that to be an issue for us. :)

For me, these cookies did not have a buttery flavor, which could have made them taste more homemade, and they need a teeny bit more salt to balance out their sweetness, but they were big, thick, soft cookies (they are more on the crumbly, cake-like scale of texture than a chewy cookie), with the perfect blend of oatmeal and raisin. The spices are subtle and do not have an overly cinnamon taste- they complement the cookies well.

If the makers offered this version with chocolate chips, that would be amazing, as I love chocolate chip oatmeal raisin cookies. Even offering variants like cranberry, pistachio, or adding pepita seeds, macadamia nuts or white chocolate to these would be tasty and would no doubt fly off the shelves.

These cookies are delicious as they are, though and for under $3, they are a winner. I will definitely order a second package next time to have on hand when visitors stop over!

title: Small and Expensive
text:
I am always looking for lunch ideas for myself and my son, and granola bars are one of the things I purchase often. I selected these, thinking they would be a good choice. They left me a little disappointed.

My second observation is that these are definitely expensive. As I write this, these break down to $1/bar, which is unreasonably high. If these were larger the price might be more justified.

The texture is soft and pleasant, but the flavor is just all right. I expected more peanut butter flavor, and what is there is muted.

These aren't bad bars by any means, but they're not priced well for what they are. They're small, flavor is subdued, and they're unreasonably overpriced.

title: Very Good Quality and Packaging, but Flavor is Slightly Off
text:
Everyone in my house loves cashews so I selected these as a snack idea that everyone could enjoy. There were a couple of flavor options, so I selected the s’mores flavored cashews, thinking this would be a popular choice. These aren’t bad, but they are not as good as any of us had hoped.

The flavor of the s’mores cashews is a little odd. The best way any of us could describe them is that they taste like they have been rolled in powdered Cocoa Puffs cereal. The chocolate flavor comes off as a bit artificial and strange, and it is difficult to identify these has having graham cracker and marshmallow flavors. It’s not exactly bad, but it could have been a lot better.

The quality of the cashews themselves is much better than the flavor. They taste very fresh and they have a satisfying crunch to them. We have no complaints with them in that regard.

These come in 6 pouches, 4 oz. each. They’re a good size for a snack for 2-3 people. I like that the pouches can be resealed to keep the contents fresh.

While these didn’t quite taste as good as we’d hoped, they still are good cashews. They are packaged well and come out of the pouch very fresh.

title: Excellent Pre-Made Sushi Rice
text:
I am not a sushi connoisseur but I do know good from bad. I also know that the defining ingredient is the rice and how it is prepared. I will admit that I was very skeptical of this pre-made sushi rice. My thoughts were that it would be clumpy, difficult to work with, lacking in flavor and generally sub-par. I was very wrong in my assumptions and this turned out to be much better than I imagined.

The rice comes pre-packaged in bowls, not dissimilar to ramen bowls. The pack contains 12 bowls, each just under a half pound, and they’re fully cooked and ready to go. Heating them up takes under 2 minutes in the microwave.

The cook is right – the rice is firm and chewy but not crunchy, and it is the right stickiness. It’s flavorful too. This is not the fluffy, dry, flavorless rice that many people have come to accept as “good”, nor is it gummy, but is actually rice that is cooked properly.

Once it is warmed and workable it is easy to use for making sushi rolls. Because the rice is pre-cooked and ready, it shaves time off the process and eliminates one possible failure point in the process even though making rice isn’t rocket science if you know what you’re doing.

This is very good pre-made sushi rice. When it’s gone, I am likely to buy more.

title: Good Pasta; Why Not a Full 16oz. Box, Though?
text:
We eat a lot of pasta in our house and I usually go for Barilla pasta because it is frequently in stock in the shape and size I need and I have never had problems with it in packaging and shipping. I haven’t seen the “red box edition” before this and I was interested in seeing how it compares. So far, I am pleased with it, with one caveat.

The difference between this pasta and the “blue box” Barilla pasta isn’t immediately obvious unless you’re looking closely. This is bronze die pasta and the surface is a little rougher, and that gives it some advantage in pasta sauce sticking to it. Another difference is that the cooking time is a little different and you need to experiment with it if you’re used to the cooking times with typical pasta. Flavor-wise, this pasta is basically the same as the normal blue-box version.

This particular package comes with three different shapes of pasta, 2 boxes of each, in 12 oz. and 14 oz. sizes. I have mixed feelings about the size. One of the things I have liked about the Barilla pasta I have been using is that it usually comes in a full 16 oz. size box, one of the few brands I have found that actually does so. 2 ounces might not make a lot of difference in most dishes, but in some it really does. 4 ounces makes a bigger difference – 25% less pasta – and that is a concern when it comes to certain dishes. Sure, I can buy more and weigh out the difference to get it right, but in my mind I shouldn’t have to resort to that.

I really like this pasta and I am pleased with the overall packaging. My one complaint is the smaller size which can require recipe alterations.

title: Better than Expected
text:
I like pineapple, and I like snack foods that are convenient. I selected these with the idea of having something nice to put in my lunches for a snack in between meals. I made a couple of bad assumptions about these, as these proved to be much better than I had hoped.

I have had plenty of dried pineapple over the years, and I have even made some in the past. Before this, every time I have had dried pineapple, it has still been soft and pliable, usually dry and sweetened a little, bordering on being candied. That is what I was expecting with these, even though these are advertised as crunchy bites. These are in fact very crunch, almost as crisp, dry and crunchy as croutons. And, as the packaging and the product description say, there is no sugar added so these have a slight tartness to them.

My son usually avoids pineapple, and I asked him if he wanted to try some. He was as surprised as I was – he likes them. For him, the texture is preferable to normal pineapple chunks.

These were a very pleasant surprise. I expected these to be good, but I was not expecting them to be as good as they are. I love the flavor and crunch, and they’re packaged perfectly for snacking. I will definitely be buying more of these.

title: Not Sure Can was Properly Sealed
text:
I love my morning coffee and I don't mind instant coffee when it's good. I had high hopes for this coffee, and I came away disappointed.

The can comes sealed with a foil rip top that keeps the grounds in the can and theoretically fresh. In my case, the can wasn't sealed too well - there was no "pop" when the can was opened, no sucking in of air from what should have been a vacuum seal. That was the first indicator that all might not be as it should.

The coffee has surprisingly little aroma, which to me is a disappointment as the fragrance of coffee in the can is something that just builds the anticipation towards that first cup. The flavor is also quite subdued, though it certainly isn't bad. I had hoped this would be more flavorful. I am wondering if the lack of a vacuum seal cost this coffee some measure of freshness?

What this coffee does have is a serious caffeine kick. I'm likely to use this as an additive to other coffee, as it doesn't significantly impact flavor but it does ramp up the caffeination.

I can't say this is bad coffee because it isn't. However, it's not great either, and I am not sure if I just got a can that wasn't sealed properly of it they're all like this.

title: Fresh and Reasonably Priced
text:

On the surface this box seems very expensive. However, when compared to other bulk offerings I have found, the price per ounce is actually very reasonable and is in line with competition ($0.47/oz. as I write this).

The bars are soft, fresh and are wrapped nicely. So far I haven't found any that are opened or have been damaged, though I am still in the top layer of the box.

If I could make one change to the packaging, I would have put them in a plastic bag inside the box, for easy transfer and for keeping the product fresher longer. This is a nitpick and isn't really a complaint, but more of a nice-to-have suggestion.

This box of candy is a winner. The bars are fresh and they're priced well by weight. If you need a large amount, for Halloween, a birthday party, or even just for guests who visit, this is a good choice. I do not expect this box to last long at all here.

title: Good Whole Bean Coffee; Expensive
text:
I love my morning coffee and I am always open to trying new brands. I had never heard of Grind before now but I was willing to give it a fair chance. One of the main strengths of this coffee for me is that it is not overwhelming or bitter but is a good, balanced cup.

Some of the other reviewers here have stated that this is not a strong coffee, and that is mostly true and is the reason I like it. It has a good coffee flavor; it's just not overwhelming or strong like a dark roast. It is probably closer to a light roast in flavor, and that's a good cup for the morning. For me, this works well. To be fair, I prefer a slightly stronger cup than this, though I would rather have a milder cup than a dark roast.

The beans are fresh and I haven't found any mold or discoloration. The roast seems to be reasonably uniform and the smell is absolutely wonderful. And in this size bag, this will last me a month or slightly more.

The one reservation I have is the cost. Coffee prices have skyrocketed in the last couple of years and finding affordable coffee is not easy. However, if the coffee is good it's a necessary expense. There are many coffees available that are less expensive and brew up nicely; the question is if the cost of this particular bag is justified when there are comparable coffees available. I have mixed feelings. I am likely to buy more, but it will be more of an occasional treat than a recurring expense.

I like this coffee. The beans are fresh and this coffee has a nice, smooth flavor and it isn't bitter. There's enough in the bag to keep me occupied for a while. The one issue I see is the cost which is a little high when compared to other coffees available.

title: Outstanding Granola
text:
Everyone in my family likes granola so I selected this three-pack with the idea that we would all enjoy it. This is some of the best granola we have tried and I will definitely be buying more.

Opening each bag, we're greeted with a very fresh aroma, like the granola was made earlier in the day and was bagged as soon as it was cool enough (having made my own granola, I am familiar with this). Most other granolas, whether snacking granola or breakfast cereal, do not smell or taste this fresh, and that's enough right there to convince me to buy more.

There are three flavors in this pack - Super Hemp, Dark Chocolate, and Original. We've all agreed that the Original bag is our favorite, though all three are delicious.

Reading the ingredients, these are all natural and use organic ingredients which should make just about everyone happy. It does drive up the cost, but these are not priced so high as to be unreasonable when considering the quality.

This is excellent granola, and as soon as my bags are all gone I will buy more. This is some of the best granola my family and I have tasted.

title: Fine for Cooking
text:
I selected this non-alcoholic Vermouth for cooking in particular so my perspective is probably a little different than that of most reviewers here. So far I have had no issues with this product and it has worked out well for me as a "regular" Vermouth substitute.

It took forever to reach me and was tied up in shipping before it arrived. I have had a few products get lost in shipping and I was concerned for a bit that this would be another casualty. However, it arrived shortly after the status was marked as "lost". I was concerned that the exposure to heat during it's extended trip would negatively impact it but it survived, no worse for the wear. I cracked the seal and opened the bottle to get a good whiff. It has a slightly fruity fragrance and appears to be fresh, in spite of the delay in arrival. It doesn't have a bitter bite, either, which was my biggest concern.

In cooking it has proven to be a fine substitute for regular Vermouth. Recipes I have tried have not been negatively impacted by the lack of alcohol. Then again, the quantity needed is small too.

So far I am pleased with this bottle of non-alcoholic Vermouth, and it has worked out well for me. I use it for cooking instead of sipping, and in that capacity it is a fine replacement for its alcoholic counterpart.

title: Excellent Flavor
text:
Note: There are multiple products attached to this listing. I am specifically writing this review for the peanut butter variety of granola bars.

I like Nature Valley granola bars and I buy them periodically to toss in my lunch or to take on trips. These peanut butter granola bars are delicious, if a little messy, and I absolutely will be buying more.

These are crucnhy granola bars as opposed to chewy. The concern there is that they can get a little crumbly which makes them messy to eat when not sitting still somewhere. If you are looking for soft and chewy granola bars, these are not it. However, for crunchy granola bars these are very good.

These have a very definite peanut butter flavor to them. In fact, they have a slightly pasty feel to them because of the peanut butter on the surface. They can get a little messy when they get warm so be careful in very warm environments. These are not like eating soft serve ice cream on a hot day messy, but the peanut butter can stick a little to your fingers and you'll need to be aware of that or you'll end up leaving smudges on things you touch.

These are fresh, right out of the wrapper. They are bundled two per sleeve.

I am very happy with these. They taste great and they have a nice crunch to them. They can be slightly messy to east, though, so keep this in mind when traveling or in hot areas.

title: Outstanding Granola
text:
Oh my goodness... This is some of the best granola I have ever had.

I selected this granola thinking it was a snack granola but it is better suited as a cereal. That's not a bad thing but wasn't quite what I expected. It is not in clusters but rather is more granular than that. It can be made into clusters, of course, but it doesn't come out of the bag that way.

When we opened the bag it looked very typical of granola of another major brand that we buy, though closer inspection shows that it has a good mixture of nuts as opposed to just one type. I have been able to identify almonds, cashews and walnuts individually, before reading the label.

I took a handful and popped it in my mouth, not expecting a whole lot of difference from other granolas. I could not have been more wrong. It is fresh - very fresh. It is reminiscent of granola that is homemade and eaten the same day it has been prepared after cooling down. I have never had granola out of a bag that is so fresh-tasting. I do make my own granola cereal on occasion and this bagged granola is equally good.

The one downer is the cost, though it should not be a total surprise being all organic. You get what you pay for in this case - a very high quality product with excellent flavor. It also comes in 2 2-lb. bags, so when looking at the overall cost it is still cheaper by weight than coffee.

This is great granola and my family is very, very pleased with it. In spite of the cost, I will definitely be buying more when what we have is gone.

title: Disappointing
text:
I chose these pouches of overnight oats as a possible quick breakfast option in the mornings (assuming preparations were made the night before). These are all right, but to be honest I prefer overnight oats that I can make from a recipe instead.

The main issue with these is a distinct lack of flavor. That is, these are quite bland and lack any real punch. They do have flavor, and the flavor isn’t bad, but these just seem very subdued when compared to overnight oats I can make myself. And, for the price, I can’t see buying these when it’s much more affordable to follow a recipe with quality ingredients.

These certainly aren’t bad, but these overnight oats bring only convenience without the flavor I was hoping for. They’re awfully pricey too, when I can make overnight oats by following a recipe and the results are something I prefer for much less. Others may feel differently about these, but I was disappointed with this product.

title: Gentle Flavor, Gentle Caffeine Kick
text:
I usually prefer coffee to tea but I do like hot tea on occasion. I have never had Guayusa before now so I wasn’t sure what to expect. It has a mild flavor and gentle caffeine pick-me-up. I plan to make some for my wife who doesn’t care for coffee, to see if she likes it as well.

This is a mixture of Guayusa as well as cacao. It doesn’t look like tea; instead it looks like a complex mix of spices, very similar to an Italian seasoning mix though the pieces are larger. It’s not unattractive or unappetizing at all, just not what I was expecting. It brews just like tea, though, so you’ll need either fill-your-own tea bags or an infuser. My preference is using bags with a tea bottle.

The flavor is very similar to a mix of green tea (not matcha) and jasmine tea. Green tea is usually not my preference, but this is better than green tea and not as pungent. The jasmine-like flavor is an undertone but it’s there. I do not taste the cacao.

There’s enough in this bag that I’m set for a long while.

The caffeine pick-me-up is not a hard kick and crash like I get with coffee, it’s more gradual.

One thing that puzzles me about this bag is that is says on the bag that it’s 100% Guayusa, while the listing says it’s a mix of Guayusa and cacao. One of them is wrong.

This is a nice mix with a mild flavor and gentle caffeine kick. It’s not like black tea; I find it to be very much like a mild green tea and jasmine tea blend instead. It will take me a while to get through the whole bag, but it’s a good substitute for when I don’t want coffee.

title: Very Good No-Bean Chili
text:
I have seen Stagg Chili on the shelves when I have shopped at the local bulk store but have never tried it before now. I wasn't sure what to expect but I assumed it would be good because I have seen it available for a long time. It did not disappoint and I am very pleased with it.

This is a basic chili with no beans. This makes a good ingredient for larger dishes that call for a can of chili, and it also is well suited for chili dogs (my primary use for it). It's a bit finer texture-wise than homemade chili which makes it less appealing to eat straight out of a bowl but better when used as a component.

The flavor is good - mildly sweet, not really salty and not overkilled with liquid smoke flavor.
