title: Great Coffee in a Big Bag
text:
I am a relatively recent convert to coffee, having been a heavy soda drinker for many years. I have learned fairly quickly what makes a good cup of coffee and I have discovered why some people make a face when they get a bad cup. I was given an opportunity to try this particular coffee by Dancing Moon and I am so glad to have done so. This is some great coffee and it comes in a big bag.

This was my first exposure to Sumatran coffee so I had no preconceived ideas about what I should expect.

The coffee comes in a 2-lb., zippered bag and the aroma hits you when you open the bag for the very first time. The smell is rich, earthy and very inviting. I like the fact that the bag can be sealed up again without needing take or rubber bands to keep it closed, and the bag does a good job of keeping this coffee fresh.

Unfortunately I do not have a small electric grinder so I used a hand grinder to grind the beans to espresso fine and brewed myself a cup (I like my morning coffee to be strong). The hand grinder made the process longer and more work but it also gave me more time to smell the coffee. The cup came out rich, bold and earthy without the bitterness I have come to expect from most other coffees I have tried. This was not a bad cup of coffee at all (it was a great cup) and I made another immediately to continue my enjoyment.

This coffee is part of the morning routine for me now. I love the flavor, but I love the smell as I grind the beans just as much. When my bag is empty, I will definitely be getting myself another bag.

title: Very Smooth and Soothing
text:
There are four different teas attached to this listing. This review is specifically for the Lapsang Souchong tea.

I have a brother who works in a teas shop and his passion for tea has helped me gain an appreciation for tea as well. I usually prefer a hot cup of tea over coffee in the morning. I was interested in trying this loose-leaf tea and I have not been disappointed. I shared some of this tea with him and my review includes his thoughts.

Although this tea was packaged with a sticker that read "as (Lapsang Souchong Tea)" this oolong did not have the smoky scent nor the flavor of a Lapsang Souchong. The first infusion, about a minute, was bright reddish-brown in the cup, aromatic, and malty. It was smooth and well-balanced with the pleasing, lingering finish of a premium oolong. The second infusion of the same leaves, also about a minute, was almost indistinguishable from the first. The third infusion was slightly lighter in color and noticeably less potent, although still a pretty good cup of tea.

Overall, this is very good tea and I am very pleased with it.

If I open the microwave before they are done, I have to add another minute to the cooking time. The ones that do puff up that you can eat are still pretty hard on the teeth. I had better luck cooking them in a frying pan with saved bacon grease for about 15-20 minutes, covered on medium/hi heat - this method results in a puffed rind with a softer crunch that is not so hard on the teeth. I will say this package has a lot of servings in it.

Those cooked in the microwave have zero flavor on their own and added salt does not cling to them (bounces right off). Interesting product.

title: ~~Okay~~ Messes up my stomach
text:
Not the most appetizing appearance. The box is pretty shabby, too. Have to be careful how I grab it, or it literally falls apart.

Has the smell of lemon tea. The lemon taste is present, not overpowering, and does a good job of masking the flavor of the nuts in there (I'm not a fan of nuts, in most cases.) I don't plan to buy again, but I will likely end up eating all of them, eventually, but that's likely just because of my personal preference. Was just browsing amazon for snacks, and saw lemon bars. Didn't read ingredients, so I didn't realize there was also nuts and such in it. My mistake, ofc.

Edit: A couple days after I bought them, and doing some testing to isolate what I had that was causing me issues (I'd bought a few new types of snacks), I discovered that these give me something akin to indigestion. Reflux, lots of gas, discomfort in my stomach, etc.

This may, of course, just be me, or I may have gotten a bad batch. However, I won't be risking it again. Threw out 13 of the 16 bars.

title: Definitely buying again.
text:
First off, let me just say this is far better than other hard coffee candy I've had. None of them are overpowering, and they're quite sweet. You still get the coffee flavour, though. They're hard enough that they discourage me attempting to just chew them, and low in calories, and seem to be killing my appetite, which is nice. Instead of me eating 400+ calories for lunch, I just suck on these throughout the day, and don't get anywhere near that. Plus the tiny bit of caffeine helps me stay awake when I'm low on sleep.

Out of the three flavours, I'd have to say my favourite one is the latte. The flavour between latte and coffee is roughly the same, but the latte one has a cream in its center that's reminiscent of the center of those cream filled caramel sticks which I can't remember the name of. Least favourite of the three is the expresso. It's flavour is quite strong, reminds me of the one time I ate some coffee grounds.

title: Not great for popcorn, best for other foods
text:
We have an air popper for making popcorn, so I had an issue with this type of seasoning. Specifically, it won't stick to the popcorn and all falls to the bottom of the bowl instead. Perhaps it would work better if I lightly spritzed the popcorn with butter or oil first.

Instead, we've been using the seasonings on other items. Namely potatoes (mashed & cubed), tater tots, french fries, and even as a dry rub for chicken breasts. The Bacon Cheddar & Cheesy Jalapeno were tasty on tater tots & french fries. It was sort of a mixed bag of results in mashed potatoes, tasty but we prefer their other flavor (Ranch) for those. The dry rub for chicken breasts was pretty tasty.

Now if Kernel Seasonings came up with some sort of low-calorie butter or oil spray I think it would make these seasonings work a lot better for popcorn. Otherwise, we'll probably skip buying this pack again and just stick with their Ranch seasonings for our potatoes.

title: Makes Amazing Ranch Mashed Potatoes!
text:
I've had mixed results using this seasoning on popcorn. Specifically because we use an air popper. There is really nothing for the seasoning to stick to, so it all falls to the bottom of the bowl. Use an old style oil popper and believe you will get better results.

We've been much happier using this seasoning on other food items. I've added it to my mashed potatoes, and the family screams for more. It's tastier than adding one of those packs of Ranch dressing. The dry buttermilk Kernel Season's uses seems creamier and doesn't have a weird aftertaste like the others I've tried.

Another favorite, as strange as it sounds, is to sprinkle this on pizza. The kids introduced me to the idea of ranch dip for pizza. It's a little different, but quite tasty. So we thought we'd try sprinkling the ranch seasoning on our pizza, and wow it was good!

So while I was kind of unimpressed using it on popcorn, we found many other things to use the Kernel Season's Ranch Seasoning on and really liked it.

title: None of them were moldy but the taste wasn't great
text:
I have never tasted venison, elk or wild boar and I have always wanted to try venison & elk but never had an opportunity so I bought these.

The first one I tried was venison. Then wild boar. Last I tried elk.

I was very disappointed. It's almost impossible to tell the difference between the meat types aside from the spices used. The venison and elk tasted exactly like the wild boar. They all taste like $1 Slim Jim's and I found that disappointing. I was expecting some sort of difference. Even if I didn't care for the flavor of elk/venison I would have been satisfied if I could at least tell the difference between them since at least I would know what they all tasted like.

It wouldn't have been so bad if they were priced at like $15 or something like that but with the cost of these as high as they are I expected more. Surely when you are charging this much for these jerky sticks you can at least make them taste somewhat like quality game meat.

The only positive I can say is that none of mine were moldy like other reviewers have experienced. I inspected every jerky stick closely when I got them and they were all sealed properly and looked safe to eat.

Would I order these again? No. Definitely not. If you're like me and want to just experience these different kinds of meats I recommend looking elsewhere.

If you like Slim Jims I think you will enjoy these although I don't know why you'd pay triple the price when you can get Slim Jims themselves for much cheaper and get the same taste.

title: I was extremely hesitant..now I’m addicted!
text:
I was initially hesitant to purchase these caramels after reading reviews about people receiving the product melted or the container half full and other complaints.

Normally I order Kraft caramels but for $9.99 I decided to take the plunge and buy 2 containers.

I’m glad I did!

Both of them arrived full to the top with caramels and none of them were melted or had any problems of any kind.

I just popped one into my mouth and I’m writing this review while eating it.

I love that they use real wax paper and a simple twist to seal method so all you have to do is untwist both ends and enjoy!

If you’ve ever had a butterscotch hard candy it tastes kind of like that but it’s soft and chewy with just a pinch of salt.

I can tell that these are homemade for sure. The reason is because I can taste individual ingredients like butter & brown sugar & even a tiny bit of molasses from the brown sugar used to make these caramels whereas with processed foods distinguishing individual ingredients while eating it can be tough due to being processed and refined to conformity. The sea salt is wonderful! It’s a perfect treat for when you’re craving something sweet & salty. I wouldn’t say there’s too much sea salt but because it is salt when you get that large grain of sea salt and crush it between your teeth you definitely get that blast of salt. taste. I try to just swallow the salt as a grain of salt rather than trying to crush with my teeth to prevent getting too much salt taste.

I would definitely order these again IF the price remains at $9.99.

I highly recommend that anyone who likes caramel/butterscotch give these a try. Don’t be afraid of all the bad reviews. No one is perfect and sometimes the fault is on Amazon’s side. For example the people who got melted ones probably ordered in Summer and then Amazon left them in a hot warehouse and then a hot delivery truck.

Anyway I’ve typed too much so just buy these and your sweet tooth will thank you for it. ;)

title: None of mine were broken.
text:

Secondly: I see a lot of reviews complaining about them being broken to pieces. I’m not saying that it didn’t happen.

But mine came packaged in a plastic carton WITH air pocket things to protect it. This company is doing all they can.

I think what happens is some packages are handled very roughly and if the sticks are banging around the carton (or worse dropped) then they will shatter like egg shells.

I do notice these sticks crumble much easier than I’m used too. In some aspects I like it because it’s easier to bite pieces off but it also makes a mess when I do bite pieces off.

To all the parents out there:

If you have 2 or 3 little tykes and plan on giving one of these to each of them be sure to get the vacuum or you’ll have little sugar crystals all over your carpet. They hurt to step on too!

I had 2 bags of genuine Kraft caramels when these ones arrived and here are the differences I see.

1). Smaller squares. Kraft ones are thicker.

2). Different taste. There is something about these that just isn’t the same as the Kraft ones. It’s almost like a tapioca flavor aftertaste, or maybe vanilla. But I know the Kraft caramels never taste like that.

3). Not as smooth and thick and creamy as the Kraft ones. Kraft caramels melt in your mouth into warm, thick, smooth sweet caramel but these ones get slightly gritty before dissolving.

Now, having said that, are these awful? No they aren’t. They’re okay. They’re just not Kraft caramels like the description says.

title: Inconsistent grind and very dark
text: I don’t personally enjoy this coffee for a couple reasons. First, I find the flavor too dark and harsh. Second, the grind was odd. I normally grind my own coffee from whole beans, so I’m used to a pretty consistent grind. But at first glance, the grind seemed way too big, similar to the coarsest setting on my grinder that would be used for a French press or cold brew. However the coffee took WAY longer to brew than my normal grind, indicating a lot of smaller particles slowing down the drip. So it’s both big and small and very dark. Not my favorite.

However, this granola with blueberries flavor is something I would be happy eating everyday as it was just like the granola with milk I usually eat for breakfast. title: Strike one come back for my updates. READ THE REVIEWS.
text:
I want to address many aspects of this product:

1. The listing shows a cake that looks baked with golden brown edges and crust. It is a very very light tan to white and the base is a watery grey-brown. (Tried for a long time but the Amazonites won’t let my photos upload.)

2. I personally have no issues with GMO’s, however, many people do, and if you read the label it contains an unidentified engineered ingredient. The marketing is misleading because people who do not support GMO’s would disagree with “pure and simple”.

3. It did not arrive frozen.

4. There is no “Best Buy” date and the seal is inadequate. Very easily tampered with and it leaked. Very watery even after six hours under refrigeration.

5. The one I received had physical gray mold on it and mold between the layers.

6. The price point is absolutely acceptable. The portions were cut evenly and all through the bottom of the crust.

Amazon refunded the cost. I’m willing to try this again, and then again based on the three strike rule in baseball. Go Red Sox! Will wait a few weeks so I’m not getting the same batch. Come back for updates. I enjoy ALL types of cheesecake!

Suggestions to manufacturer:

1. Update your photos.

2. Update your ingredient description.

text:
As a low-sugar, low-carb snack option, these cookies definitely fit the bill, but for consumers who aren’t acclimated to the taste of a traditionally keto-flavored diet, these might not seem overwhelmingly scrumptious. That being said, each cookie is adorably sized, and all of them arrived to me intact! They are slightly crunchy, and the individual bags inside the box feature an attractive packaging design.

I love that this product is made in the USA, and each bag comes labeled with a clearly marked expiration date. This gluten-free recipe has no added sugar, and there is an almond taste that is readily detectable in each bite. The cookies do seem a little bit greasy overall, but they are a great chocolate-chip keto option for consumers who are in search of such a snack!

title: Great Flavor But Most of the Cookies Arrived As Crumbles 🍪
text:
These cookies smell good, taste great, and make a perfect ice cream topping, but of the 2 product boxes containing a total of 24 cookies, only 6 cookies actually arrived to me intact. The other 18 were broken to varying degrees, some were very small crumbles. It disappoints me to even say that because the actual flavor of these cookies is incredibly tasty! They’re definitely quite sweet, and I love the bourbon vanilla component, but I didn’t detect much of a sea salt crystal presence. Despite that, I still loved them!

My boxes had a printed (best by) date of 01/12/2022, and the outer shipping box they arrived in wasn’t damaged in any way, so the ingredients either combine to make a physically fragile combo, or the recipe has an issue with temperature instability (a factor that will unfortunately always fluctuate greatly with the transportation heat of nationwide shipping routes). I appreciate that the little trays are made from 100% post-consumer recycled plastic, and I love that the boxes are visually pretty AND recyclable. They also come with helpful stickers, forewarning potential consumers if they happen to have a milk/egg/wheat allergy.

Grace Farms Foods clearly makes a commendable effort to adhere to responsible cultivation and sustainable farming practices, so I greatly appreciate their mission statement and their intentional efforts to give back!

title: Chewy, Beefy, Oven-Baked Goodness!
text: [[VIDEOID:b782d59d6a1dd4268f2e5b459c8c71f6]] My chiweenie has greatly enjoyed sampling these oven-baked beef chews! The bag says that these beef backstrap tendons are sourced from Colombia and/or Bolivia, but there are no added chemicals, fillers, or preservatives present. There is a 2022 expiration date given, and I like the see-through window that is present on the front of the bag. The resealable feature along the top edge offers a secure and reliable closure, and each chew takes my senior dog about 30-45 minutes to eat. She can easily hold each treat between her paws, and she happily tears off jerky-like strips to chew and swallow. I haven’t noticed any issues with digestion, but they do have a strong scent, so I make her eat them outside. 😁 Overall, we’ve been really pleased with these treats!

title: Healthy Green Snack 🍃
text: The blend of dates, cashews, wheatgrass, moringa, spirulina, baobab, and barley grass certainly gives these Super Green Bars undeniable substance. A lemony taste is present in every bite, and I love that they’re 100% plant-based! They’re vegan, organic, and gluten free with no added sugars or artificial preservatives, and each bar is densely packed with noticeable and filling ingredients. I would say the flavor is an acquired taste that takes some getting used to, and it may not please all palates. These bars make a great addition to days spent hiking because they won’t melt or crumble in a backpack. They are sort of bendy and flexible, and they come nicely labeled and packaged.

title: Grind and 🐻 Bear It!
text: When I first received my aromatic bag of Wandering Bear organic coffee grounds, the aroma was absolutely amazing! The majority of the scent did dissipate fairly quickly over the next couple of days, but the resealable feature of the bag does seem reliably dependable and secure (and I love that feature). I do drink my coffee black, and while this variety is labeled as being Extra Strong, I wouldn’t necessarily agree with that bold of an assessment. The flavor IS smooth and palatable, but I’d prefer for the mix to be a little less coarsely ground. I use refillable Keurig cups, and even when I leave some empty space at the top of the container, the drip feature can’t seem to fully penetrate these grounds for maximum filtration and absorption, so the resultant coffee cup quantity ends up being 25% less than expected. I did find this product to be tasty and palatable overall, but a finer blend might work wonders!

title: This Honey Is Worth The Money! 🍯
text: This raw, unpasteurized honey product is absolutely delicious! It is undeniably flavorful and has a smooth, velvety texture. I enjoy drizzling it over whole-wheat toast, but it would pair perfectly with a wide variety of grains, fruits, and other prepared dishes. It even has a delicate aromatic quality that is delightfully floral. I greatly appreciate that it comes packaged in a recycled plastic jar as well! Couldn’t be(e) more pleased. ☺️🐝

title: So greasy yet so tasty at the same time.
text: I know these are bad for you. I know this, man. I'm trying to move to a more vegan lifestyle, but man do I need my meat. No one else in my family likes these; they can feel the grease spill onto their lips as soon as they try them (only once, too), but I can help but have at least one in my lunch bag. A mild flavor with slight spices that whets the palate just right.

title: Slightly stale out of the package, but great flavor anyway.
text:
I brought these to work and they were gone within a week and a half. Most of my coworkers liked the flavor enough to eat them straight for a week and a half, but personally I found them a bit stale out of the packaging. I know other Sour Patch candies are a bit too hard for my liking, but i was hoping these fruit-shaped ones would be a bit more chewable.

Great flavor that doesn't get old, though.

title: Moderately edible taste, strong stomach effects.
text:
I eat cashews normally without any adverse effects. To my knowledge, I havce no allergies to any foods, let alone any nuts. I love cashews, in fact, so I thought this would be a good alteranative to my jelly instead of peanut butter. But when I tried a taste before putting it on my morning toast, I found the taste to be far from delightful. It was very coarse and not easy to spread, and the texture while eating was very dense, and the flavor overpowering. But I ate anyway.
To my dismay, I found my stomach extremely upset later on. This was the only variable that day that was the anomaly; everything else in my diet was stadnard fare, so I knew it was the cashew butter. Unfortunately, the other members in my family did not like the taste either, so I had to retire the butter from my shelf.

title: Fun colors and even better flavors.
text: These are pretty easy to distinguish in lunches and in the fridge amidst all the puches we have. I eat them as well. We carry them in our diaper bag which is large already, so it's nice to be able to see them easily. Teh flavor isn't like other raspberry-flavored pouches; sometimes our daughters are into them, other times they're not. Probably just used to more sugary pouches.

title: Love them, but, man, are they filling...
text:
I absolutely loved these chips. My family hated them, and, when I brought some to work, only two other people out of fifteen liked them. But I was a staunch proponent of them until the very last bag. The combination of flavor was a revelation, and the texture was just right.

They were, however, EXTREMELY filling. I couldn't finish half a bag in one sitting. The bags are a bit bigger than the regular chip bag, but you get more bang for your buck. Eating more than half a bag made my stomach not very happy, but my taste buds soared with the angels.

title: Pleasant taste--and effective!
text:
For some odd reason, I love the taste of prune juice. I know its effects, and maybe that helps, but I'm always keen to buy some when I see it.
This is some great stuff as well; a bit too concentrated for my taste, but after some dilution the consistency is perfect for me.

And it's effective! ;)

title: Good stuff, but maybe a bit too fine.
text: This stuff tastes great. I'm a fan of the sea salt flavor, but I found that there were too many smaller pieces in the bags I received. I was hoping to use this with homemade cereal, but the bits were too broken. I wound up consuming them all as snacks for about a month; the taste may be a bit too sweet for some, but I envisioned these as my dessert and all was well.

title: They're nuts!
text:
The sea salt is a bit overkill, but then again I'm very sensitive to oversalted nuts. I love cashews, though, so I quickly became accustomed to the salty flavor, though I couldn't grab a handful as I normally do. The sea salt at least is a much better option than normal table salt.
Much better alternative for those who can't part with the saltine lure.

title: Great taste, but very small portions.
text:
The packets come in smaller sizes than expected; I would profer these are the "fun size" variety. The actual blend is great; there's a very nutty and oaty flavor you get, with a bit of dryness, but, I guess because of how small the portions are, your mouth isn't left feeling out of moisture.

If you're an adult, I would suggest going with a bigger mix. For small kids it's fine, but mine didn't like the flavor as much so maybe you'll have better success.

title: Love BirchBender, just not this flavor
text: Our family absolutely loves the BirchBender pancake mixes. I had the opportunity to try the Buttermilk mix and it was AMAZING! I love how easy these are to make - just add water! I wanted to try these peanut butter ones because of the added protein. When I tried the mix, however, I wasn't impressed. To be honest, I'm not a big peanut butter fan. I'm sure if you really enjoyed peanut butter, this would be the mix for you! The plain protein mix was good - It's nice to be able to make a quick, easy breakfast but still get the protein you need to feel full for a few hours. Even though I wasn't impressed with the peanut butter flavor, I'd still recommend these. BirchBenders is amazing!

title: Super easy to make!
text: This was the first time I've used BirchBenders mixes and I'm officially sold! Being a busy working mom of two young kids, it's extremely difficult to find relatively healthy meals that are easy to make and that my kids will eat! These are beyond easy to make - just add water!! My kids love them and they taste great! After loving this type of mix, I went to the store to buy more. I was excited to discover that BirchBenders has a variety of types of pancake mixes! We do not currently own a waffle maker, so I did not use the waffle recipe. I'm tempted to buy a waffle maker just so I can try it!

title: Strong, but can be diluted.
text: Stronger than the usual brands, but can be diluted in the maker by adding more water and/or creamer. Great taste; though it's naturally strong, it's not as bitter in taste.

title: Good, simple mix.
text: I like cashews a lot, so for me this "mix" is perfect--just cashews and one other nut! Enough to make the taste and shapes distinct, while still satisfying that cashew craving. The salt could use some toning down, but otherwise the taste is great. The nuts are fresh and crunchy.

title: They're nuts!
text:
A great mix of nuts, though the salt can be a bit overwhelming, even if it's sea salt. I don't like salted nuts much as I feel they steal the show from unsalted, but taken in small amounts they're not too bad.
A good variety too; don't see pistachios as much as I'd like in other nut mixes.

title: Great!
text:
The texture is fantastic; it's not too hard to be difficult to chew. It gives way in chewing but retains its shape and consistency in the tub.
The taste is great, with minimal grit to give you that salt assurance. They're not overly sweet to make you think you're chewing on pure sugar (though you are).

Great stuff!

title: Flavor too heavy to be distinct.
text:
The flavor is much too heavy to be distinct; you can't even tell it's cookies and cream. It's masked by the heavy amount of dairy and the thickness coats the throat too much to enjoy. Most of the "flavor" rests at the bottom, and so each bottle needs to be shaken thoroughly and continuously throughout the drink to be enjoyed.
Nice to have on warmer days, but the thickness of teh dairy may be counterproductive for some

title: A bit too runny, but nice flavor.
text:
Good honey, but does run a bit thin. I use this primarily in my coffee as I like to have a sweet taste without using sugar. The taste isn't that sweet, which is welcome because I've had honey that is loaded with a sugary aftertaste.
The bottle so far hasn't gotten drippy or anything, either, which is a common issue I've had with other bottles.

title: Works!
text: I've been taking these after a run, which is when I'm most tired, and once I reach the bottom of the can--I take about five minutes to consume the entire beverage--my energy feels completely restored. I don't like that i have to drink it ice-cold (people shouldn't really drink ice cold beverages anyway), but it does taste better that way.

title: Great coffee, weird packaging.
text:
This stuff really does give a good kick in the morning. It is definitely one of the stronger cups we've tried, and no matter how many times we've been drinking it our body still gets that jolt, never seeming to adjust to the amount of caffeine in each pod.

When we first opened it I had forgotten what it was. Inside the Amazon box was another cardboard box. Upon opening that, there were two black boxes contained side by side. On each box was a picture, encircled in a pink border, of a male's arm flexing its strength. What a weird picture to put on coffee. Considering it's a sleek black box with pink accents and a male's arm, bare and flexing, you may think the box is for something completely different. I sure did.
My five-year-old daughter, who was right next to me when opening the box, exclaimed, "What the heck?" And my wife, also next to me, asked, "What did you order?" with one eyebrow raised.
"I have no idea," I responded, completely forgetting that this was coffee. It wasn't until I checked my Amazon orders that I realized what it was.

Still, good coffee.

title: Nice packaging, sub-par chocolates
text:
The packaging is extremely well done. It definitely evokes a sense of superior chocolates.
However, the chocolates do not match the presentation of the outside. Every one that I've tasted left an empty taste in my mouth; that's the best word I can use to describe it: empty.

The presentation is nice and each chocolate is done really well in terms of aesthetics. However, once you bite into them you don't really absorb any substantive, quality chocolate. My wife agreed and she's a better chocolate connoisseur than me.

title: The whole family loves it.
text:
Thankfully none of us has peanut allergies so I confidently can say that the whole family loves this mix.
I'm always down for a good trail mix, but far too many trail mixes out there have unnecessary foods in it to really make it a mix that you can snack on on the go; unfortunately, this one seems to be one of those, but it's still not bad. I like to mix it with some ice cream or other dessert options for after dinner.
Both of my girls love it, too. My one-year-old was caught sneaking the bag away from the pantry. She wasn't able to open it, but it was hilarious seeing her waddle with the bag half her size and into an unlit area of the hallway, where she hoped no one would notice.

My wife, the last to try the mix, couldn't stop once she had her first taste.

Overall, an excellent mix that's probably better suited as toppings on dessert options.

title: Manna from heaven.
text:
I like nuts. I like honey-roasted nuts. I like a big ol' tub of honey-roasted nuts. When Moses led the Hebrews from the grip of Pharaoh, the Hebrews groaned and complained. Understandably so: Would you want to walk in a desert for decades without a real home?
At one point God gave them manna, a honey-like sustenance. If these honey-roasted nuts are what food tastes like from God, then I look forward to death.

This is as good as a snack of honey-roasted nuts can get.

title: Taste just like smoked bacon.
text: I love almonds. I think bacon is *okay*. But these were worth a shot to try and I must say it totes tastes like smoked bacon. I feel there's too much salt on them (they're coated with salt; you can see white chunks all over them), but in small doses they're great!

title: Great tasting noodles.
text:
We wanted a gluten-free alternative to our pasta that our toddler could eat, and the elbow ones seemed the best to try.

They were easy to make, not much different than regular pasta, and tasted great. I felt they had a thicker texture than regular elbow pasta.
My daughter loved them; she tried them with and without pasta and ate them up just the same.

title: Skip for the plain regular mixes.
text:
I'm not sure what I was expecting--maybe dried veggies? But here they are, clumped in smaller packets which you'd all mix up. They look more like seasonings you'd find in ramen packets.
You're better off, as another reviewer put, mixing in your own broccoli and chicken.

As such, price-wise it's not a bargain. Just buy the regular Velveeta cheese mix to add to your meals. I personally always use less than recommended because it's really heavy. The cheesiest is right.

title: Bitter.
text:
As a word of caution: these are single servings. Not sure why I thought they'd be full-brew packets.

Still, I tried it out and found it much too bitter for my taste. While it was bitter, it was also watery, so I had to add some milk and creamer to get at least a semblance of how I like my coffee.

title: Tastes great.
text:
Hesitant at first, I ordered the new Kool-Aid peach mango flavor. I'm not a big fan of peach, but the mango looked appealing. When you open it there are little yellow flecks mixed in the mix, and that looks like it's the mango flavoring.

Works great with some "medicine."

title: Pretty good cereal.
text:
At first I didn't like this cereal much, but because it reminded me a lot of Waffle Crisp cereal, I started to enjoy it more. Then, when I went through my first box, I realized how much I liked Crunchy Nut!
It's a great breakfast item with a hint of honey and lots of nutty taste, and has a delicious aftertaste that, like I mentioned already, reminded me of Waffle Crisp.

Great new cereal!

title: Great!
text:
A great alternative to the other "life waters," this Jones Soda 24c has all the benefits (or downsides, depending on your view of these so-called "health" beverages) of the other drinks, but with the great slap-on sticker of Jones Soda--quality you can depend on.

Jones Soda--makers of some of my favorite sodas, and I don't even drink that much soda--makes a challenge for the other "health" beverages in that, while I've found the taste in others to be somewhat lacking, your palate will feel a rush of exuberant taste when sucking down one of these bad boys.
Highly recommended if you want a most tasteful "life water."

After re-reading my review, I just want to point out that I'm not an employee of Jones Soda whatsoever. Some of my text can sound overly-enthusiastic, but I just want to express how much I liked this product.
Thanks!

title: Excellent
text:
Normally, I'm not a fan of apple-flavored drinks, but I was willing to give this a try as Jones has a tendency of making some mighty fine products.
I was met with a nice, fruity taste that wasn't too tarty, and the mixture of fruit and tea in this beverage made for some pleasant swigs.

Recommended for anyone, especially if you're a fan of tea and fruit mixtures, or just plain ol' Jones products.

title: Brings back childhood memories!
text: As a child of the 1950's, I grew up with Tang. Haven't had it for years. The doctors all want me to drink more water. The rest of the family drinks water by the gallon it seems, but despite various filtration systems we have on hand, I don't seem able to get much of H2O down. I will think, "Oh, I just drank a lot," then realize I've only consumed maybe a half cup. Somehow, with the addition of a little Tang, I've turned into a chug a lug. I don't know how great this orange stuff is for one's health, although, it did help to get men up to the moon and back if I recall correctly, but I'm thinking it can't be all bad. I actually like it quite diluted and over ice, all of which means I'm mostly drinking water, right? It's funny, I always thought of this as orange flavored, but it tastes rather like tangerines to me now, hence, I guess, the reason why it's called "Tang." Something I never thought of as a kid. The only negative caution I have is regarding acid reflux which I have. If I drink to much of this, I do start getting some reaction that way. Yet, I find I'm craving it so maybe I need the vit C just the same. Afraid I haven't read the ingredients and don't intend to. I'm sure it's not as good for me as fruit juice, but I've never been much of a juice person. Or a water person. But this suits my taste well. It's pretty easy to mix, although I couldn't initially find the scoop. It was hiding half way down in powder. But experiments with using a tablespoon worked well for me at about 5 or 6 spoonsful per 2 quarts. As I said, though, I like it over ice and diluted a bit more.

title: Nice: Like a tart sparkling lemonade with a twist of raspberry
text: I'm somewhat in the middle on this one. Might not have bothered with writing a review, but I read such horrible reviews about it, following my purchase here, that I actually tried to cancel this order. I'm kind of glad I wasn't able to. It was decently priced, I think around $13 for 24 cans (split into 4 6-packs which I like). I wouldn't say it's the best thing ever, but a pleasant change overall. I've been switching over to sparkling waters that all have a little essence of flavor, trying to get away from the sweetened sodas. I read complaints that these have sugar in them, but I have to say for 35 calories it can't be a lot. And it remains tart, so I think the sugar is rather needed. Glad they didn't go with artificial sweeteners. This has the taste to me of Italian lemons and a nice twang of raspberry. Not too sweet for sure, but not terribly sour either. Having the real fruit juice in it is a nice change for me.

I'm really picky about the taste of powdered milk products.  I will barely use others on cereal or in cooking because I'm so tuned in to that taste.  But Sanalac doesn't produce the same results.  I used it many years ago (when it was easier to find) and found it to be quite acceptable -- glad it hasn't changed.  The other nice feature is that it doesn't go bad as quickly as most when made up.  Most dry milk products will only last 4 days or so in the refrigerator -- I always sniff it with caution. text: I decided we eat far too much junk food in our house. So, I replaced potato chips with Pepperidge Farm goldfish crackers. I love this pack of 9 individually wrapped snack pack bags. title: Odd 'Burnt' Flavor-
text: I was so happy to see Creme Savers back after vanishing for a decade. Strawberry and creme was always my favorite so I ordered this pack of 6. The pieces are a bit smaller than they used to be. Completely understandable, MANY food products are smaller than they used to be.  Each piece is individually wrapped.  At first, the candy tastes just as it used to. But then it gets weird. Odd as this sounds, there is a burnt taste to it.  'burnt' as in burnt food.  The strawberry and creme flavor is the prominent flavor but the weird 'burnt' flavor is still there.  I had my husband try a piece and he tasted it as well. We tried pieces from 2 rolls, each had the weird taste. Maybe the flavor changed from 10 years ago? Maybe we got a bad pack of candy? Maybe it started to go bad due to the excessive heat/humidity here? (Though we did bring it inside as soon as it was delivered.) Whatever the issue, this candy doesn't taste the way it used to.  I don't think I'll purchase  Creme Savers again.  Very bummed. I was looking forward to enjoying them again.

title: 3 Tasty Snacks
text:
Surprise, surprise! I was so certain I knew which of the 3 root Foods snack I would like best. Turns out, I got it backwards. I ordered the 3 bag variety pack which includes: potato wedges+cheddar dust, mushroom crisps w/bbq smoke and corn kernels/chipotle. I expected the potato wedges to be my favorite and the corn the least favorite. Nope...the opposite occurred. I'm not a fan of hot/spicy foods; while the chipotle corn has some 'kick' to it, its not overpowering or terribly spicy. I tend to get paranoid about eating certain foods since I have some dental work (fillings, crowns, 2 dental implants) but the corn kernels are light, airy and easy to chew. The mushrooms are crispy and also easy to chew. I like that both the mushroom and BBQ flavors are present, I kind of worried the smoke flavor would drown out the mushroom flavor. It does not. The potato wedges are crunchy and good but i find the cheese flavor a bit much. (For what its worth, my husband likes the potatoes best followed by corn and mushrooms)

Overall, 3 tasty snacks that are yummy to munch on. I'd buy this again.

When I ordered Premium Penguin's bulk mixed nuts, I didn't realize just how many nuts are in a 6lb bag. Trust me, its A LOT! lol. All 3 nuts: hazelnuts, walnuts and almonds are shelled. You're definitely going to need a nutcracker, no doubt about it. We've been munching on them for a few days now and they're nice and fresh. Each nut is tasty. I recommend putting the nuts in an air-tight container or a freezer type plastic bag with a seal or zipper. The bag the nuts are in is not strong at all. Ours tore when we first opened it. I put the nuts in a large plastic container that originally held a pub mix of various snack items. Even if the bag hadn't torn, I still would have transferred the nuts to the container-pretty sure a chip clip would tear the bag.

I find the price reasonable for 6lbs of good quality, tasty nuts.

title: 3 Delicious Flavors (Chinese BBQ is our fave!)
text:
Ty Ling's variety pack consists of 3 tasty glazes. Quite honestly, I'm not really into glazes and sauces but he is. To my surprise, I found I actually enjoy them. 3 flavors come in the variety pack: Hot Chili, Orange Ginger and Chinese BBQ.

Orange Ginger: Our least favorite of the three but we still VERY much like it. I made Asian orange chicken for dinner one night and used this glaze. Added nice flavor to the chicken that wasn't super sweet or overpowering. The kids liked this one.

Hot Chili: Not super hot/spicy. My husband likes it on burgers. We had steak for dinner one night and had no more steak sauce so he used Hot Chili on his steak and very much liked it. Good on grilled veggies as well

Chinese BBQ: This is the unanimous favorite in our home. Love using this glaze on our wings. Makes them more interesting than using regular barbeque sauce.

All glazes dispense from their bottle easily. The consistency is nice; its not watery nor is it super thick. A little sauce packs a good deal of flavor and goes a long way. We're having some people over for New Year's Eve and I'll be setting all 3 Ty Ling glazes out for guests to use on sliders, wings and shrimp. The price for 3 bottles is more than reasonable. I have a hunch I'll be ordering another variety pack soon.

title: Tasty Treat, Makes a Nice Gift (not all items included, however)
text:
We've all been picking at the Cherry Picked Christmas Dried Fruits and Nuts arrangement since it arrived. lol. Its rather addicting and better than picking at greasy potato chips or chocolate Christmas candy. The arrangement comes in a nice, decorative box that is very sturdy for storing/shipping purposes. The various fruits and nuts are nicely displayed inside the box and not scattered all around. A good variety of fruits are included with some fruits having far more pieces than others. We have a lot of pineapple, papaya and cherries but only 3 slices of kiwi and 3 peach slices.

The box doesn't contain all of the fruits/nuts listed in the description above. There are no bananas and pears included. Instead of cashews, our box contains almonds.

Overall, this is a nicely displayed dried fruit/nut box containing some tasty treats. Its funny, I'm not normally a huge fan of kiwi but it turns out, kiwi is my favorite fruit in the box. Well, kiwi and apricots. All of the fruits and nuts are fresh. And there is something for everyone in this box, at least when it comes to our family. Its definitely worthy of gift-giving and not just for Christmas holidays. Easter, Thanksgiving, new home, parties or 'just because'.

title: Tasty Alternative to Chips
text:
Our family very much enjoyed sampling each of the three Whisps Cheese Crisps and Nut Mix snacks flavors. This also marked the first time any of us had ever tried Whisps products.

Tangy Ranch: I'm a huge ranch fan and fully expected this to be my favorite flavor. It wasn't. The tangy ranch flavor isn't terribly tangy...not overpowering or gagging. Definitely detectable but mild. Not much ranch flavor on the nuts, just a hint. Out of the four of us, one liked tangy ranch a lot, the other three of us found it to be 'OK'.

Garlic Herb: This turned out to be mine and my husband's favorite flavor. We both like the garlic herb seasoning. Again it was strongest on the cheese crisps with the nuts only having a hint of the seasoning. The kids weren't huge fans of this flavor

Smoky Barbeque: This was the complete opposite of the garlic herb flavor. My husband and I didn't care much for this flavor but the kids liked it. It was their favorite out of all 3. Again , the majority of the barbeque flavor was found on the crisps with the nuts having a very light barbeque taste.

I have some dental work including a few fillings, crowns and 2 dental implants as well as some tooth sensitivity issues. I was very pleased that the nuts are not terribly hard and did not hurt my teeth at all.

Whisps (cheese crisps + nuts) are Keto-friendly for those on the Keto diet. Cheese is the first ingredient which is pretty impressive. All 3 flavors contain 8-9g of protein, 3g of net carbs and less than 1g of sugar. Whisps aren't limited to just snack food, they can be used to add some flavor to salads and soup as well. Overall, a decent, flavorful alternative to greasy, unhealthy potato chips. Each bag has a zipper seal to keep the product nice and fresh.

title: Delicious!
text: This item includes 40, regular size strawberries and cream Chupa Chups lollipops. Each is individually wrapped.  We took some to a school function and ate a few at home as well. So far, all are nice and fresh and in one piece; none are broken /cracked/chipped.  They're incredibly delicious and were a huge hit with everyone-to the point I just ordered another box! lol. I have some fillings, crowns and 2 dental implants and have no issues chewing these.  The price is VERY reasonable and I will continue to purchase these for the kid's various school functions and us to enjoy as a nice, sweet treat.

title: Delicious...Bye-Bye Potato Chips!
text: Not only do Harvest Snaps Snapea Crisps taste delicious, they satisfy my potato chip cravings. No, they do not taste like potato chips. But they have a delicious taste of their own, are lightly salted and are nice and crunchy.  They're free of preservatives, non-GMO, certified organic and soy free.  Best of all, they're baked and not fried.  They come in a variety of flavors. I prefer 'lightly salted'.  Perfect for your holiday parties, snacking, kid's lunches, etc. The price is reasonable.

title: My 2 Fave Chupa Chups Flavors
text:
I initially felt the price for a bag of Cremosa Chupa Chups was on the high side. Despite this, I still placed my order. I changed my opinion about the price when the bag arrived. These are full size Chupa Chups lollipops-25 per bag and come in 2 flavors: strawberries & cream and chocolate & vanilla. Both of these happen to be my favorite flavor Chupa lollipops. They're absolutely delicious, fresh and satisfy my 'sweet tooth'. I might as well go ahead and confess that I selfishly hide this bag and keep it for myself and do not share. lol. I know, I know. That's terrible. But I also purchase bags of 240-mini Chupa Chups for the rest of the family as well as customers who buy nail polish from me. (I always include some Chupa Chups with their polish purchases. )

Chupa Chups are my favorite lollipops and I will continue to purchase them.

title: Delicious...We All LOVE Slim Jims!
text: Everyone in our house is a fan of Slim Jim, especially the snack size.  They're the perfect size for a quick snack between meals or between the kid's extra-curricular activities.  Each piece is individually wrapped.  I have some dental work including fillings, crowns and 2 dental implants and have no problem chewing the sticks.  We usually get original flavor but at times we get mild instead.  The price can't be beat and I usually order 3 boxes at time.  Definitely recommended!

title: Satisfies Your Sweet Tooth
text: I'm normally not a fan of sour candy but ZOTZ Fizzy Candy is definitely the exception. I only recently discovered ZOTZ and I'm already hooked.  This bag contains 7 different flavors :  cherry, strawberry, watermelon (my fave!) blue raspberry, apple , grape and orange. 100 pieces of individually wrapped candy is included. The outside of each piece has a good, sweet flavor. Inside, each piece has a powdery fizz that is sour, but not too sour.  The sweet/sour flavors work great together making this candy terribly addicting!  I have dental work including fillings, crowns and 2 dental implants and I have no issue eating/chewing this candy.  The price is incredibly reasonable and the candy is nice and fresh.

title: Perfect for Snacking, Work/School Lunches. Our Fave Flavors Included
text:
This variety pack is perfect for our family as it contains our favorite crunchy snacks: Cheetos (regular flavor), Cheetos Puffed, Doritos regular, Doritos cool ranch. The portion sized bags are the perfect size for a snack at home, work or school. The snacks are all fresh. They arrived packaged well and protected...didn't have any issues with open bags or crushed chips. The price is exceptional reasonable.

I'll be ordering this again!

title: Delicious! Great Variety of Yummy Flavors
text:
I sell nail polish online. When I ship polishes to customers, I like to include a little treat. When I ran out of the other lollipops I'd been sending, I decided to try Chupa Chups mini lollipops. The bag contains 240 mini lollipops in 5 flavors: strawberry, cherry, creamy strawberry, orange and chocolate/vanilla. All 5 flavors are great. Our family especially loves strawberry cream and chocolate/vanilla. It is easy to tell the flavors apart-the flavor name is on the wrapper and each flavor has a different colored wrapper. The lollipops are very fresh. I've yet to find any that are broken. (I have to sample them, don't I? ;) ) My only complaint and its not really a complaint, more like an 'FYI'...some of the wrappers are on the candy pretty tight and aren't the easiest to get off.

I have dental work including fillings, crowns and dental implants. I don't have any issues with the lollipops though I am extremely careful and don't bite the candy until its TINY.

These lollipops are perfect when you're craving something sweet, nice to put out in a candy dish at home or at work, perfect for trick-or -treating, etc. The price is more than reasonable-the flavors are good, candy is fresh and delicious and 240 mini pops are the bag.

Definitely recommended!

title: Warning: ADDICTING and DELICIOUS!
text:
I live across the street from a Godiva factory and am an hour away from Hershey, PA. I'm surrounded by chocolate! I do love both brands but I'll take Toblerone over both any day! The chocolate is so creamy and the honey + almond nougat give it a unique taste unlike any other brand out there. I love the tiny bars in the Christmas gift stocking stuffer box. They're the perfect snack size and quite a few come in the box. (30+) Each piece is individually wrapped as well. The price is more than reasonable.

Its probably a good thing I don't live near a Toblerone factory, I'd be in BIG trouble! lol. This chocolate is delicious and my favorite out of all the brands out there!

title: Great Variety...Something for Everyone
text: There is something for everyone in UTZ's pub mix! Honey mustard twistix (my fave!), cheddar cheese twistix, honey mustard sesame chips, Oriental rice crackers, nacho bagel chips, pretzel stix and Worcestershire rye chips make up the pub mix.  Lots of delicious flavors.  Comes in a 44oz container with a resealable lid that does a great job of keeping the mix nice and fresh.  Perfect for parties and snacking.  I got one for my niece to take back to college last year and she loved it. The price is incredibly reasonable; its actually quite low for the variety of snacks included  and the 44oz size container.  Enjoy!

title: Absolutely Delicious and Addicting
text:
I almost wish First Choice Candy's watermelon gummi rings weren't so darn good. They're addicting and I can't stop eating them! lol. Each ring is bursting with a sweet watermelon flavor and a hint of sourness. I'm very impressed by their freshness. They're unbelievably soft. I have a few fillings, crowns and 2 dental implants and have no issues with the rings affecting my dental work in any way. The rings come in an convenient resealable heavy bag.

Due to the fabulous taste and wonderful freshness the price is reasonable.

title: Tasty Snack
text:
Our BranchOut Banana Bites arrived an hour ago and we're already down 2 of the 4 bags! lol. As you can tell, they're a hit in our home. Each slice looks just like a regular banana slice but is lighter and a bit puffy. They're nice and soft and easy to chew. I have some fillings, crowns and 2 dental implants and have no issue chewing them or getting stuck to my dental work. Of course, they taste like banana but not quite as strong. There is a sweetness to them.

Banana Bites are perfect to snack on, great to take along when on the go, make a good snack during extra curricular activities. They dont' make a mess; heck, they don't even make fingers sticky. I do think the price is a tad on the high side but I'd still purchase again thanks to the good taste and convenience. I plan on trying the banana/strawberry flavor next.

title: Delicious and Easy to Prepare
text:
I normally buy canned chickpeas. Curiosity got the best of me...I wondered if there would be much of a difference between canned and dried chickpeas so I ordered a bag of Pereg's 16oz dried chickpeas. They are easy to prepare. Following the cooking instructions on the back of the bag, I soaked 1 cup of beans in 3 cups water for 8 hours. I then boiled them in water before turning the stove down and allowed them to simmer for an hour. Drained/rinsed them and added some olive oil, salt and pepper and served them up at dinnertime. They were a hit. Surprisingly, everyone in the house enjoyed them! That doesn't happen often! lol. There is most definitely a difference using dried chickpeas over canned. Dry is FAR better and tastier.

Chickpeas are packed with vitamins and minerals, are easy to prepare and taste fantastic. The price of Pereg's chickpeas is reasonable. I will continue to order/prepare Pereg's for our family.

title: Perfect Balance of Sweet and Sour
text: I'm not a huge fan of  sour candy but the sour in Zotz candy isn't overwhelming.  Its the perfect blend of sweet and sour.  3 flavors come in a bag: watermelon (my fave!), cherry and grape.  Watermelon and cherry each have a great amount of flavor. I don't notice the grape flavor quite as much as the other two but it is still good.  Since each piece is individually wrapped, I keep a few in my purse. They're quite satisfying; especially the fizzy center and  incredibly addicting!  I have dental work including fillings, crowns and 2 dental implants. These candies are soft enough for me to chew and not have to worry about my dental work. Candy is nice and fresh and the price is incredibly reasonable for 3 bags! Will definitely buy again!

title: No Mystery Flavor, Limited Flavors, Unwrapped Pops
text:
Very disappointing. 2 bags of lollipops, neither contains a mystery flavor. Limited to only bubble gum, pineapple, strawberry, peach-mango. Not one cream soda (my fave) 3 lollipops in one bag have no wrapper. Lollipops are fresh

Will not buy again

title: Sweet, Salty, Crunchy...and Delicious
text:
Many years ago, I worked with a girl who was obsessed with Boston Baked Beans. I don't recall the brand she snacked on but they had little bumps all over. When I saw Oregon Farms Boston Baked Beans in my VINE queue, I decided to try them for the first time ever. I made the mistake of immediately trying to bite into the first one I popped in my mouth. It was pretty hard and I became paranoid about my sensitive teeth/dental work (fillings, a few crowns, 2 dental implants) . Thankfully, nothing happened. When I ate another, I sucked on it for a few seconds before biting and that worked very well. I'm no longer worried about these affecting my teeth. They're quite addicting. A nice, sweet candy coated shell taste to start soon joined by the salty, crunchy peanut. Delicious! My husband and I have been scarfing them down since they arrived. lol. Perfect to snack on between meals, when you're craving sweet/salty, while 'on the go', etc. I think I'm going to make a trail mix using some.

The price is definitely reasonable. You're getting 2lbs of fresh, delicious candy. And its well packaged in a very durable, resealable pouch.

title: Healthy Snacks CAN Taste Good!  (these pretzels are proof!)
text:
Wasn't quite sure what to expect when I ordered FitJoy's gluten free tangy dijon mustard pretzels. What a nice surprise to find that not only do I like them, our entire family does as well. Just goes to show, healthy food CAN taste good. And this is a healthy snack! FitJoy has eliminated gluten, wheat, rice flour, corn starch and maltos, replacing the with ingredients such as sunflower oil and date nectar. If that's not awesome enough, the pretzels are non-GMO, vegan, dairy free and allergen friendly.

I have stomach sensitivity issues but these pretzels don't cause me any trouble.

I will say, I could use a tad more dijon seasoning. That said, these are a hit in our house. After we munch our way through all 6 bags of tangy dijon, we'll try either FitJoy's honey mustard or garlic basil gluten free pretzels.

title: I'm Hooked!
text:
I had the privilege of testing Amazin' Graze's Apple Crumb granola for the VINE program and loved it. Loved it so much, I purchased a bag of the Banana Bread flavor. As much as I enjoyed the apple, I'm pretty much obsessed with the banana bread flavor! Its fabulous. Its packed with granola clusters, pecans, rolled oats, coconut sugar , flax and banana puree. The puree is a tad sticky so if you're eating this on the go, take a long some handi-wipes. None of the many flavors is overwhelming and the coconut sugar adds a hint of sugar; this is not sickeningly sweet by any means.

Amazin' is perfect for ice cream, yogurts or as I eat it...straight out of the bag! I'll definitely buy this again, I'm hooked! I just placed my order to try Amazin' Graze's brownie chips as well!

title: Delicious and Addicting!
text:
You know what? When I saw this in my VINE offers I only read Amazin' Graze Apple Crumble Granola and stopped reading to place my order. That's all I needed to hear. When the bag arrived, I opened it and my husband and I immediately dove in to taste it. We both found it delicious with the very first bite. It was only after we ate some and I went to put the bag away that I noticed the rest of the info...that it also contains rice puffs and flax seeds. I had no clue. I thought this was just an apple granola. I hadn't realized how healthy it is! Healthy AND delicious!

It has a light, natural sweetness to it with a hint of nutmeg and cinnamon. The granola is tasty , as are the nuts which are coated in apple puree. Raisins are also an ingredient but I'm not a fan and picked them out of my portions. (husband and kids love the raisins!) The big apple pieces are my favorite and contribute a bit of sweetness along with the delicious taste of apple. The apple really stands out for me. It helps make this unique from other granolas I've tried in the past.

There's a lot of good, nutritional ingredients in this granola and it tastes great. We eat it straight out of the bag though my husband has sprinkled some on both his ice cream and vanilla Greek yogurt. I'm planning on adding some the next time I make my apple caramel walnut pie, assuming there is some left! This is a keeper for us. We all love it. When this bag is finished, I'm ordering Coconut Kaya next!

Delicious! Recommended as a great snack or to liven up your parfaits, ice cream, yogurt, salads, etc!

title: Wasn't Sure What to Expect...Turns Out, Its Good!
text:
I decided to try Wholefort's Puffed Quinoa Cereal out of both curiosity (never had quinoa before!) and a desire to eat heathier. Wasn't sure what to expect. Turns out, I like it! There is a light, pleasant tasting sweetness to it. I wouldn't say its bursting with flavor...it definitely has it but overall, the flavor is fairly mild. Also has a nice crunch.

I'm not a huge cereal person. I have to be in the mood for cereal in order to eat it. I didn't eat this with milk poured over it. I ate the pieces straight out of the bag as a snack.

I like that only 3 ingredients are in this cereal, its nutritious and has a good taste to it. I'll order this again.

title: Where's the Fruit Flavor?
text:
When I saw the description for Herb Guru Fruit Drink, I got excited and placed my order. I was looking forward to a refreshing juice filled with pineapple, orange, cranberry and apple flavors. Equally exciting? The fact that each bottle has only 5 calories and 0 grams of sugar. Upon arrival, I put a bottle in the fridge overnight so I could drink it nice and cold. (It can be consumed hot as well) Finally, it was time to give it a try. I tasted NO apple, NO pineapple, NO cranberry, NO orange flavor. The big (and only) sip I took tasted like dirty pond water. I made my husband try it. Same reaction.

Based on the lack of fruit taste and the high price, I cannot recommend this product.

title: Water is No Longer Boring!
text:
If you find plain water as boring as I do, I highly advise giving MiO fruit punch drops a try! Just a few drops of MiO in 8oz of water delivers a ton of fruit punch flavor...BUT....without sugar, calories or caffeine! And its a nice and sweet taste; not overwhelming or artificial tasting. It tastes so much like regular fruit punch, its almost hard to believe it contains no sugar.

You will receive 8-3.24oz plastic bottles of MiO fruit punch drops. This was my first time trying MiO, but I did read that the 3.24oz bottle size is twice the size of MiO's old bottles. If you're familiar with MiO, you're getting twice the amount you used to get. Each bottle measures app 4" x 3". (You may find it odd I'm giving you the bottle size but I'm including it in case you want to carry a container in a purse, gym bag, briefcase, lunchbag, etc. ) Each has a lid that closes securely though when I took one in my purse the other day, I did put it in a plastic sandwich bag to be safe. The expiration date is noted on the item. Once opened, the drops are good for 30 days and should NOT be refrigerated.

The recommended amount of MiO is '1 quick squirt' into 8oz of water or 3/4tsp. I actually use a tad more than 3/4 tsp just because I like sweet drinks. The rest of my family is satisfied with the 3/4 tsp amount. Using the recommended amount means one container of MiO will flavor 48-8oz bottles of water! That is A LOT of water seeing as you get 8 containers of MiO in this item!

I'm not going to lecture you about how bad soda and most fruit juices are. You know they're filled with sugar and sugar can lead to obesity, diabetes, damage to teeth, etc. You don't have to worry about sugar, caffeine or calories with MiO fruit punch drops. (The sweetness in MiO is due to ingredients Sucralose and Acesulfame potassium. BOTH are recognized as 'safe' ingredients by the Food and Drug Administration (FDA). ) If you're looking to add flavor to plain water while avoiding sugar, calories and caffeine, I absolutely recommend MiO fruit punch!

***FYI...My review is based ONLY on MiO FRUIT PUNCH FLAVOR! There is a chart listed above with all of MiO's brands/flavors and what each contains/does not contain. All are sugar/calorie free but some DO contain caffeine, vitamin B and electrolytes. This review is for FRUIT PUNCH ONLY!**

title: Oh, SO Addicting and Delicious!
text:
I almost wish I'd never ever tried this gummy candy. It is SO good and so darn addicting! It is bursting with a delicious strawberry flavor. (reminds me of strawberry Bubblicious gum from the 80's/90's!) I love that each is individually wrapped; doesn't make a mess in the candy dish or in my purse. Definitely satisfies my sweet tooth yet isn't sickeningly sweet. I have a lot of dental work; fillings, crowns and 2 dental implants. I have NO issues eating/chewing this candy with my dental work. Its easy to chew/swallow. Every single bag I've ever ordered is always super fresh.

Delicious candy, especially if you like strawberry!

title: Delicious!  Easy to Cook With
text:
I love to cook and do so often. The state of PA, where I live, produces the largest amount of edible mushrooms in the country. We love mushrooms and I cook with them often but I've never cooked shiitake mushrooms before. I was very much looking forward to cooking DALAMHARI's Open Air Forest Dried Shiitake mushrooms. Though not the normal mushroom used in chicken marsala, that's what I decided to use them in. I followed the recommended instructions and allowed the mushrooms to sit in a bowl of warm water w/sugar for an hour before use. This did a nice job of softening them but only the caps; the stems stayed fairly hard/dry so I wound up cutting them off. The mushrooms sauteed beautifully and tasted delicious! They're packed with flavor that isn't at all overpowering. They were tender and soft and easy to chew.

There is an odor with these mushrooms. It filled the kitchen and we didn't care much for it but it wasn't an issue.

The mushrooms come in a handy, resealable bag. We very much enjoyed them and I love that they're easy to cook with. I'll definitely use these again and soon as its now summertime and we grill vegetables all summer long! I'm also thinking of trying to make for the first time ever, hot and sour soup. If I do make it, I'll definitely use these again.

title: Had to Try It!
text:
A retro TV channel I follow on social media posted an article about Cactus Cooler. I had never heard of Cactus Cooler and learned it came about from The Flintstones cartoon. My husband never heard of it either. People were leaving all kinds of comments on the social media post about the drink and how much they loved it (and still do) as a child. I looked it up, found some on Amazon and placed my order. Couldn't resist! It arrived the very next day. I was so excited to try it but had to pop it in the fridge first. Finally, it was cold enough to try. I'm not the biggest fan of orange flavor so I didn't except to be blown away by CC. To my surprise, I enjoy it! I expected it to be super, sugary sweet. And it IS sweet, but not sickeningly sweet...at least not for me. I can taste both the orange and the pineapple flavors. Everyone in the family tried some and really enjoyed it.

I'm thinking of crushing some ice and blending a can of CC into a slushie. Perfect for a hot, summer day.

I normally would NEVER spend so much money for 6 cans of soda but I was curious and wanted to try Cactus Cooler, so no complaints there. As for buying it again, I have no plans to. But that's due to the fact I'm weaning myself entirely off of ALL soda. Never say never.

title: YUM!
text:
I'm impressed! D'vash's Date Energy Bars are really good! There are 6 bars per box. Each bar is individually wrapped and easy to open. They're the perfect snack size. The bottom layer is crunchy, yet fairly soft. The taste reminds me of granola. I can taste the coconut and a hint of maple syrup. Surprisingly, I find the peanut butter to be on the mild side. The top layer is covered in tasty chocolate that is neither bland nor sickeningly sweet. Puffed rice, cashew and hazelnut are mixed in and make a delightful topper for the bar. I really do not taste the dates much.

The first bar I tried immediately crumbled all over when I broke a small piece off. I made a mental note to mention this in my review and warn others against eating a bar while in a car driving as it might make a huge mess. lol. But when I ate another bar a few days later, it was a bit softer and had FAR less crumbling than the first bar.

The bars are made with 'clean and pure' ingredients. They are non-GMO, Vegan, Kosher, gluten and dairy free. This particular flavor has 9g of sugar but no added sugar. (This particular bar has the least amount of sugar out of all 6 flavors D'vash offers) Suitable for those doing the Paleo diet. Obviously, those with a peanut allergy should stay away.

They have a shelf life of 12 months.

I seriously wasn't expecting to like this bar as much as I do. I'm impressed. They make for a nice snack and taste delicious, especially the chocolate. Believe me, I'm fussy when it comes to chocolate. I live across the street from a Godiva factory and an hour from Hershey, PA so you know I like my chocolate! lol. I had originally planned on giving this a 4 star review due to the excessive crumbling but when the second bar didn't crumble much, I upped my rating to 5 stars. I really enjoy these bars, I WILL purchase more in this flavor and I absolutely recommend them!

title: A Delicious, Excellent Snack!
text:
Oh boy, are these ever addicting! This was the first time I've ever tried Kasugai Roasted Green Peas and I wasn't sure what to expect. After a few bites, I was hooked! They're nice and light and taste great. They're not spicy or terribly salty. Crunchy but not super hard. I have sensitive teeth as well as some crowns/dental implants and have no issues chewing the peas.

Not only are these peas delicious, they're definitely healthier than potato chips which I normally snack on. While I eat them straight out of the bag as a snack, I did sprinkle a few on a salad i had for lunch and they added a nice flavor it to it. I bought a 4 pack; they arrived super fast and packaged well. Getting ready to place another order! lol. They're that good!

title: EXACTLY What My Prime Rib Needed!
text: I knew my prime rib was missing something flavor-wise.  When I looked up a good prime rib recipe and found that Herbes De Provence  spice is ideal for prime rib, I immediately ordered a container of The Spice Lab's seasoning. It arrived quickly and was packaged well.  And it was PERFECT when I made prime rib again! It was exactly what was missing the first time around. I've since used it on a few other meals and its awesome, our family loves it.  The price can't be beat-it was less than I  assumed I'd have to pay.  This was my first time using a spice from The Spice Lab brand and I'm impressed and happy with it.  My spice cabinet is currently well stocked but as soon as I'm in need of a spice, I'll purchase it from The Spice Lab! VERY happy with the flavor this particular spice delivers!

title: SO Delicious and SO Addicting!
text:
I am so happy to have found Sahale Snacks in individual packs. Prior to finding these, I'd been buying Sahale Snacks at the grocery store in the 'regular' size bag (4oz) and eating it far too quickly because its unbelievably addicting. Thanks to the snack size packs, when I finish a pack, I"m done. I don't keep reaching for more as I did with the 4oz size.

I've only tried one flavor, the maple pecan. Perhaps at some point, I'll try another flavor but for now, maple pecan is absolute perfection. A little slice of heaven. Every bite is delicious...doesn't matter if its a pecan, walnut, apple or cherry. They're all fantastic. Each is glazed with maple and a bit of cinnamon, making every bite sweet but not sickeningly sweet by any means. The individual packs are the perfect size for a light snack, to pack in work/school lunches, a snack during an extra curricular activity, for traveling, while vacationing...you name it, these are perfect. But they're not limited to snacking out of the packet only. My husband sprinkles some on top of his vanilla ice cream for added flavor. I mixed a bit in my Greek vanilla yogurt. Sometimes, I warm a bit in the microwave for a few seconds so they're nice and warm when I snack on them. I love to bake and make a caramel apple walnut pie often but sometimes, rather than using plain walnuts, I'll add some Sahale maple pecans instead of the plain walnuts ( I also eliminate brown sugar when I do this) to give the pie a new twist. I made pancakes for breakfast yesterday and sprinkled a tablespoon of Sahale maple pecan on top of the sugar free maple syrup I'd poured on my pancakes. WOW, did that ever add some delicious flavor!

No, these are not sugar free. BUT...they are kosher, gluten-free, contain no artificial flavors or preservatives and are non-GMO. The individual packs help prevent overeating-at least they do for me. One packet worth is sufficient. They're delicious and perfect when you're craving something sweet.

This is likely silly of me to mention but I figured I would just in case there is someone out there with my same situation. I have some dental work...3 crowns and 4 dental implants. I also have sensitive teeth. The pecans and walnuts in Sahale snacks are soft enough that they do not hurt my teeth in any way. They're still crunchy but they're not hard enough to cause any type of pain or make me worry about losing a crown or harming one of my dental implants. I'm VERY paranoid when it comes to my dental work...I won't eat /chew anything that could hurt or cause damage to my crowns or implants and that includes these snacks. If these were a concern, as much as I love them, I wouldn't eat them. Just thought I'd mention this for anyone who might be in the same situation!

I was THRILLED to learn Sahale is on Amazon's 'subscribe and save' plan and I've already signed up for automatic delivery of my beloved Sahale maple pecans! If you enjoy the flavors found in these snacks, I HIGHY recommend them. But be warned...they're incredibly addicting!!!!!!! lol
