title: 4 Flavors, Soft, Fresh and Delicious! There's a flavor for everyone in this bag!
text:
One of my all time favorite chewing gums, Bazooka, has just released a new line of gummy candies under the brand name Totally Awesome. This particular Amazon item is for twelve 3.8oz bags of Totally Awesome Unicorn gummies. Each bag contains approximately 20 gummies. 5 gummies=1 serving size. Each bag contains approximately 3.5 servings. I've included a photo of the nutritional facts on the back of the bag showing the ingredients, sugar/carb amounts, etc. We've now opened 2 of the 12 bags. Every single gummy in both bags incredibly soft and FRESH! The gummies are a nice size: bigger than a typical gummy bear, yet on the flat side. My husband is hooked on another brand of gummy bears because they come in 12 flavors. He loves the variety. Totally Awesome's unicorn gummies have just 4 flavors. I love this...they just so happen to be 3 of my 4 favorite flavors! Now, I don't have to waste my time with flavors I don't care for. (Sorry, lemon, lime and orange!) Each flavor is, of course, a different color and its quite easy to tell the flavors apart. Should you forget which is which, a convenient chart is on the back of the bag to help.

4 flavors:

strawberry (red): Has a nice but mild strawberry taste. Its obviously sweet but not in a gagging way. Everyone (our family+kid's friends sampled the candy for this review) likes strawberry. Not one of us didn't like it.

blue raspberry (blue): This was the overwhelming favorite flavor of everyone. Except me. I actually cannot detect much flavor in the blue raspberry gummy. (FYI: I have a nasal cyst that at times, affects my sense of taste. Not sure if that's the case here as I can taste all of the other flavors without issue. But everyone LOVED this flavor and can clearly taste blue raspberry)

watermelon (green): This too has a mild flavor. Its clearly watermelon but not overpowering. 2 of the 4 kids didn't care much for this flavor (though one whined that it was green so I'm not sure if it was the color or the flavor that wasn't appealing! lol) but I like it.

grape (purple): This was by far, the gummy with the most flavor. Everyone likes it. I love it. Its my favorite of the 4. Its just bursting with grape flavor-kind of reminds me of drinking grape Kool-Aid when I was a kid. Its also very sweet. Two pieces hit the spot for me when I'm craving sugar or something sweet. (I'm now enjoying my 4th grape gummy since starting to write this review! lol)

Bazooka/Totally Awesome has created a great new line of gummy candies. They're flavorful (some more than others), soft and fresh. I have fillings, crowns and 2 dental implants and have no issue eating these gummies. (I do advise to eat and enjoy with caution if you have dental work) These gummies are perfect if you have a sweet tooth, make a nice stocking stuffer or grab bag item for a child's birthday party. (especially if it has a unicorn theme!) Keep in mind, these are all sweet. These are not 'sweet and sour' gummies. Sweet only. Recommended for kids 4+. One thing to keep in mind: there is a warning on the back of the bag advising the candy MAY contain milk. Great candy, well worth the price. Definitely recommended!

title: Incredibly Flavorful (even w/o sugar, gluten, fat, low sodium!)!
text:
I love to cook and do so all the time. Whether its 'tried and true' recipes that our family loves, recipes I find online/cookbooks, or recipes I create on my own, cooking is one of my favorite things to do. I'm excited to incorporate Saucy Lips sauces into family meals to bring a whole new level of taste to dinnertime! I must admit, the only reason I tried Saucy Lips sauces is because my husband has high blood pressure and his doctor wants him to lose 25lbs to reach his ideal weight for his height and cut down on sodium. When I saw Saucy Lips is sugar, gluten and fat free, I thought to myself, "BORING!" and kind of pitied him, assuming he'd be using sauces that are tasteless, bland and boring. You'll notice I said I pitied HIM. When I ordered Saucy Lips, I did so for him to use, not the rest of us. When Saucy Lips arrived, he was excited to try the sauces. I first made a shrimp , rice and vegetable recipe we often eat. He used the pineapple thai sauce in his. I initially had a very snobby attitude towards it .To my surprise, the kids tried and LOVED the pineapple thai sauce. I thought they were being polite but no, they genuinely liked it. I wanted no part of it and didn't use any. Later, as I put the leftovers in a container, I snuck a few drops on a forkful and tried it. OMG...lolol...I LOVED it! I couldn't believe it. It has such a fresh taste, with a hint of sweetness and a nice pineapple taste. Over the course of the past couple of weeks, we managed to use all 5 sauces. Here's how it went:

pineapple thai: Nice pineapple taste-has a bit of sweetness to it, not spicy. Perfect for shrimp, ham, chicken, pork, salads. Kids + I love this one. Excellent amount of flavor

tangy mango: Sweet/sour flavor--mainly sour with a hint of sweet. Works well on shrimp, fish, salads, ham, chicken, (and chicken nuggets) vegetables. Not spicy. Flavorful

cilanto lime: Mix of cilantro+ lime flavors, mainly cilantro. Not spicy. Slightly thinner (consistency) than the other sauces. Works on fish, chicken, salads, vegetables

ghost pepper: I can't stress how small of a sample of this I tried. Not even a drop. The teeny tiny amount I sampled was HOT and spicy. Perfect for hot wings, tacos, tortilla chips (as a dip). Husband is a huge fan of spices and LOVES this one!

jalapeno+green apple: Has some kick to it-not like ghost pepper but still hot and spicy. Perfect for wings, chicken, burgers, sausage, tacos. Lots of flavor

So, once again, I was wrong! Turns out, sauces not containing sugar, gluten and fat can most definitely be packed with flavor, taste wonderful and still be healthy at the same time! Saucy Lips is going to add some great flavor to whatever you're cooking WITHOUT containing fat, sugar, gluten . Our entire family recommends Saucy Lips sauces!

title: Heavy/Sticky At First-Then Incredible Hydration+Firm/Soft Skin!
text: I absolutely cannot stand any type of cream or lotion that feels heavy on my skin. Not only does Serendibeauty Labloom Nourishing Repair Cream have a thick, heavy consistency, its also very sticky and tacky as well. It is not scented.  (It reminds me of the icing  on top of a Cinnabon roll lol) The first time I used it on my face I had to rinse it off 15 minutes after I applied it. Fifteen minutes wasn't a sufficient amount of time to give it a fair chance so the following day, I applied it to my face right before bed.  MUCH better! Yes, of course it was still  heavy as well as sticky and tacky. I now use Serendibeauty some nights before bed. My skin is not only soft, but very well hydrated and has a new firmness to it as well.  Because I have extremely sensitive, dry skin and am susceptible to extreme flareups of eczema in the winter months, I'm trying to hold off using Seredibeauty daily until the harsh weather hits and my skin needs extra protection and care. Once I see how well it works during the harsh winter months, I'll decide then whether or not to continue using Serendibeauty.  I marked a calendar to come back to my review in a few months and note how well its working during the cold winter months. For those interested in packaging, this cream comes in a very pretty square , mirrored jar.  (I wasn't able to get a decent photo using my cell phone, unfortunately, but I would say the jar is definitely worth of gift-giving the way it is with a small bow/ribbon. title: Delicious Cookies Filled With Flavor!
text:
I have good news and bad news. The good news? Happy Belly old fashioned oatmeal cookies are delicious and addicting! Now for the bad news. Happy Belly old fashioned oatmeal cookies are delicious and addicting! lol

These cookies are delicious and I'm so glad I ordered them. If you like oatmeal/oatmeal cookies, give Happy Belly old fashioned oatmeal cookies a try! Amazon offers a 1 year refund if you're not satisfied!

title: So Good, You're Going To Think You're Eating Fresh Pineapple!!!!
text:
I'm usually not a fan of sour candy. ( Actually, I'm not really a fan of anything sour! ) I was hesitant at first to try Classic Series sour/sweet pineapple candy. But after I read reviews left by others I decided to place my order. To everyone who left a review, THANK YOU. I LOVE LOVE LOVE it! You're the reason I bought the candy. (And the reason why I might have cavities at my next dental check up! lol. I'm kidding!)

This candy is fabulous. Each piece is individually wrapped. I immediately put some in my purse so I always have some with me. The candy pieces are on the smaller side, but don't worry. They may be small but they are absolutely PACKED with flavor! (Not to sound overly dramatic but IMO, dont' allow young children to eat this without adult supervision due to the size) When I tried a piece for the first time, my first thought was that I could have been eating an actual piece of pineapple. This candy tastes exactly like pineapple! It starts out very sweet, but not too sweet/gaggy and soon after, the sour pineapple taste comes into play. As soon as I realized the sour was coming, I grabbed a tissue in case I wanted to spit it out. No need. While i could taste the sourness, it was NOT overwhelming at all. Its a mild sour pineapple taste in addition to the sweet pineapple taste that was there from the moment I first put the candy in my mouth. The combo of sweet/sour truly makes this taste like real pineapple!

For those interested: 1 serving size=6 pieces of candy. (I'm not going to tell you how many servings I've had since opening the bag a short time ago... A LOT! lol) Per the bag, there is app. 23 servings in each bag. You're getting app 138 pieces of candy PER BAG and this listing is for 3 bags! That's A LOT of candy! A lot of DELICIOUS candy that will last for a long time. 3 bags for $14.72 is absolutely ridiculous! I would have expected one, maybe 2 bags to cost $14.72 but three is just insane. title: Adds Some 'Zing' To Your Recipe!
text:
I like to cook and do so usually 6 nights a week. Though I'm a fan of cooking, I'd never before used ground mustard. I did a bit of research online and found that ground mustard works well on meat ( spice rub), salad dressing, mac and cheese and some soups. I decided to try it in homemade mac and cheese. I made my usual homemade mac and cheese recipe. The info I had found online suggested adding 1 teaspoon of ground mustard to mac and cheese. Since I'd never before tasted ground mustard and wasn't quite sure what to expect, and due to 2 kids who can at times be fussy about what they eat, I decided to not use the full teaspoon and instead used about 1/2 teaspoon . The ground mustard didn't make the mac and cheese hot and/or super spicy. But it did give it a bit of a 'kick'. It made the cheese have a bit of a tangy taste to it. It wasn't overpowering or gagging by any means. It was a subtle tang and in fact, my kids didn't even notice it. My husband and I did but the kids did not. (They love mac and cheese and wolf it down so quickly it probably didn't sit on their taste buds long enough to detect the slight 'tang'! lol) I have always liked my homemade mac and cheese and thought it was delicious the way it was. After trying it with ground mustard, however, I do like the new flavor it brings to my recipe. I've not yet decided if I will go with the full teaspoon of ground mustard the next time I make my homemade mac and cheese, but I absolutely WILL continue to use it! I like what it does to mac and cheese . My next experiment with ground mustard is going to be a hamburger recipe I found online.

I'm happy I'm now becoming familiar with this particular spice and am looking forward to working it into some favorite family recipes to give them a nice change! I've always had positive experiences with Happy Belly brand items (formerly Solimo) and Happy Belly ground mustard is yet another product from this company that I enjoy and will continue to use!

title: Toblerone Far Exceeds ALL Other Chocolate Bars Out There!
text:
As a member of Amazon Vine, I promise to try all products in exchange for an honest review. If that means I must take numerous bites of chocolate bars in order to deliver an honest review, then so be it! lol. In all seriousness...I love chocolate. And that can be dangerous because I happen to live right across the street from a Godiva chocolate factory. I also live an hour away from Hershey, PA and have visited Hershey Park and the chocolate factory dozens of times. There is also a smaller chocolate company about 30 minutes from me, Wilbur chocolate. Wilbur may be a small company but their chocolate is out of this world. Its safe to say that I'm picky about my chocolate. I'm surrounded by some of the best chocolate brands in the world. I'd never tried Toblerone chocolate before and was anxious and curious to see how it compared to the 3 chocolate companies I've been a huge fan of for decades.

The Toblerone Swiss Chocolate variety gift pack comes in a very nice gift-giving box. The box is nice enough that you don't need to gift wrap it. The gift box contains 6 Toblerone bars: 3 milk chocolate, 1 white chocolate, 1 dark chocolate and 1 salted almond bar. Each bar is 3.52oz , however, each bar has 10 sections and can easily be broken off to eat piece by piece. Each bar is wrapped in a foil -like wrapper and inside its own thin box.

My review:

White chocolate: I despise white chocolate and that's the attitude I had when I took my first bite of the Toblerone white chocolate bar. I'm telling you, I was fully prepared to chew it a bit and immediately spit it out. That's how much I hate white chocolate. To my surprise, no, make that astonishment...to my astonishment, I LIKED it! I liked the white chocolate Toblerone! It didn't have that 'waxy' taste that I associate with white chocolate! The chocolate was smooth and creamy It was my least favorite of the 4 flavors I taste tested, but I actually liked it~!

dark chocolate: Absolutely delicious! I always love the slight bitterness that comes with dark chocolate and Toblerone was no exception! The honey and almond nougat in the bar really paired nicely with the slightly bitter dark chocolate! I liked it so much, I had to take a 2nd piece to make sure I liked it as much as the first bite! lol :)

salted almond: You know when you crave both sweet and salty at the same time? Make this your 'go-to' food for those moments because its perfect! The combo of fabulous Toblerone chocolate and salty almonds is what I refer to as being the best of both worlds! Be careful though...its easy to eat piece after piece of this bar!

milk chocolate: My favorite of the 4 bars. The milk chocolate is creamy and fabulous and the addition of the honey and almond nougat make it incredibly addicting. This is a scary flavor as I had no problem popping piece after piece into my mouth and enjoying every second of it!

I literally felt guilty after I finished sampling each of the 4 Toblerone bars in the variety box! I'd been so curious to not only taste Toblerone for the first time but to find out if it compared to the 3 chocolate brands I've been eating all my life. And what i discovered was that Toberlone chocolate is BETTER than my 3 life long favorite chocolate brands! I honestly cannot believe I'm saying that. I did NOT expect that to happen. But there is something SO very special about Toblerone that makes it better than the rest. The chocolate, whether its dark, milk or white exceeds all other chocolate bars out there. It truly does. The honey and almond nougat makes Toblerone absolutely unique and it just works SO well with the chocolates. I have a new favorite chocolate bar in Toblerone. Its better than the rest.

title: My Newest Addiction!
text:

title: You've Been Warned...They're Addicting!!!! Full of Flavor/Great in Soup/Salads!

title: Delicious and Packed With Protein and Energy!
text:
This was my first EVER Clif bar and boy, was I ever surprised! Sure, I've seen and heard about Clif bars before. My local grocery store has them on the shelves in the Health and Fitness aisle. For that reason, I just always assumed they probably didn't taste so great. How wrong I was! And that brings me to another surprise I experienced when I tried a Clif bar for the first time. I'm not a huge coffee drinker at all. When I received the box of 12 Clif Dark Chocolate Mocha bars from the (Clif) Coffee Collection and saw that each bar contains one shot of espresso, I automatically assumed I wasn't going to like the bar. When I opened the wrapper, all I could smell was the scent of espresso. I REALLY thought I wasn't going to like the Clif bar. I took a tentative first nibble, fully prepared to spit it out into a paper towel once it hit my taste buds. I think I was caught a bit off guard when that didn't happen! lol. While the scent of espresso was all I could smell, it definitely was NOT all that I could taste in the bar. Yes, I absolutely could taste the espresso. But it didn't drown out the rest of the bar's flavors! The dark chocolate is absolutely delicious as is the light drizzle of white icing on top of the bar. The bar also contains small pieces of dark chocolate covered organic coffee beans and its NOT overpowering. I went from thinking I'd be spitting out the bite I'd taken, to having to tell myself I could only eat ONE bar! For a second there, I was actually tempted to open another bar and scarf it down. These bars are THAT delicious! Had I not known it was a Clif bar, I believe I would have assumed it was a homemade brownie from a bakery. And I truly mean that!

Since this was my first Clif bar, I did some reading about the product. If you're already a fan, you likely already know this information, but it was new for me. Clif bars contain a lot of organic ingredients. I love that. The bars also contain sugar. This is not a sugar free food, HOWEVER, Clif bars are full of protein to help maintain and boost energy and keep you going. I actually went Christmas gift shopping after eating my first Clif bar and I was good to go all morning/afternoon. While I did drink some bottled water during my shopping, at no point in my almost 5.5 hour shopping trip did I feel the need to stop anywhere and get something to eat. The Clif bar was enough. I also learned that Clif has a line of products for kids (Clif Kids) as well as a line of products geared towards women, Luna . ( I HIGHLY recommend visiting the Clif website and reading up on the company, employees, products, etc. Its very enlightening and you will quickly learn this is a company extremely passionate about not only making delicious products but taking care of and protecting the environment! The website also contains nutritional info for all Clif products

Clif bars are now officially a part of my breakfast routine. I will not eat a bar daily for breakfast but when I need sustained energy or have a higher than usual activity/s planned, I know a Clif bar will provide the energy and protein boost I will need. (I will also know how darn good it tastes as well! lol) I plan on having my kids try Clif Kids bars as well.

Clif bars are delicious , nutritious and wonderful energy boosters!

***FYI... I have IBS. I've had NO negative health issues/flareups after eating a Clif bar.

title: LOVE ZEVIA KIDZ! NO Sugar, NO Calories, DELICIOUS Flavors!
text:
We allow our kids to have soda 'once in a blue moon'. Not often at all but on special occasions such as a birthday party , holiday or occasionally when we go out to eat, we let them have a small glass of soda. And they're OK with this. They understand soda is a rare treat because its terrible for their health and teeth. They're happy with bottled water, bottled water with sugar free flavor packets mixed in the water ,milk and diet Ocean Spray cran-grape or cran-cherry drinks which are sugar free. I have seen Zevia products at the grocery store but never really paid attention to them. When I saw an offer in my Vine account for Zevia Kidz drinks and did a bit of research and learned the drinks are sugar free, calorie free and made with Stevia, an organic sweetener/sugar substitute derived from the plant Stevia rebaudiana, I decided to give it a try. We received 4-6 packs of Zevia Kidz, each a different flavor. Each can is 7.5 ounces. The packaging is great...each flavor is in a brightly colored box with the cans the same color and each box/can has Disney characters as well. Very eye-catching and both the bright colors/Disney characters immediately stood out to my kids. The Zevia Kidz flavors are: orange cream, fizzy apple, strawberry lemonade and fruit punch. I put a can of each flavor in the fridge for about 6 hours, then we did a taste test of all 4 flavors. Below are the results/opinions of each flavor.

strawberry lemonade :

"This is good but it doesn't taste like lemonade very much". (8 year old son)
"I like it!" (3 year old daughter)
I love anything strawberry lemonade but this was a bit too sweet for my liking. (me)

orange cream:
"This is my favorite out of all of the flavors!!!" (8 year old son)
"Yummy!" (3 year old daughter)
I'm not a fan of most things orange flavored or scented but this, I REALLY liked! It wasn't just orange tasting, it really was orange CREAM. It wasn't super sweet at all. (me)

fruit punch:
"I love it!" (8 year old son)
"I like it better!" (3 year old daughter...and I think she meant she likes it the best! lol)
I liked fruit punch very, very much! It wasn't overly sweet at all but still tasted like fruit punch. I used to guzzle Hawaiian Punch as a kid, now as an adult, its far too sweet and gags me. Zevia Kidz fruit punch is perfect for my liking. You can definitely taste the fruit punch but its not too sweet.

fizzy apple:
"I love this way more than apples!" (8 year old son)
"This is SOOOOO good!" (3 year old daughter...and, yes, she dragged the word 'so' out as I wrote it! lol. She really found it to be SOOOO good!)
One of my favorite drinks as a teen was apple Slice soda. It didn't last very long but i absolutely loved it. As soon as I tried Fizzy apple Zevia Kidz, it immediately reminded me of apple Slice. Hands down, this is my favorite out of all 4 flavors! I LOVE it! LOVE IT!

Without a doubt, we WILL purchase Zevia Kidz! Its carbonated so its very much like soda without whopping amounts of sugar! No sugar, no calories, made with Stevia and EXCELLENT tasting! I'm very much looking forward to trying other Zevia products when i go grocery shopping now that i know they're sugar/calorie free, made with Stevia and taste great! Yes, my kids and I ABSOLUTELY recommend Zevia Kidz! (In fact, I'm about to sit down to dinner and I'm drinking Fizzy Apple Zevia Kidz with my meal tonight! lol)

title: YUM~!!!!!  Give In To Your Chocolate Cravings With Cocoa K'Choo Chocolates!

title: Doesn't Have Much of a Ranch Taste
text:

title: This Oil Has SO Many Wonderful Benefits!
text:
Its summertime and my vegetable plants are delivering loads of veggies each day. We eat a lot of the vegetables raw (or with some dip), I use a lot in salads and I also saute or grill the vegetables multiple times each week.

For dinner last night, I grilled some salmon and sauteed vegetables for a side dish. I rubbed a bit of avocado oil on the salmon prior to grilling. I also used some on the vegetables I sauteed. I was absolutely happy with the delicious results! I LOVE the skin on salmon. The avocado oil helped crisp the skin while it grilled and it was delicious. I did not taste the avocado oil flavor on the salmon at all (I also added a bit of cilantro, pepper and Adobo to the salmon prior to grilling) but I DID taste it on the vegetables. Its had a mild and light taste which was very enjoyable. Because I had never cooked with avocado oil before, I did a Google search ahead of time and learned the smoke point (temp the oil reaches when it produces smoke) is very high, at 500-520 degrees. That's a plus.

(During my Google search, I saw a suggestion to drizzle a bit of the avocado oil on cantaloupe with a bit of sea salt. I did not think I was going to like this but I actually did! It put a nice, new but not overly-dramatic spin on regular cantaloupe! )

After cooking with the avocado oil for the first time, I figured I'd go all out and try some of the oil on my hair. My hair was soft when it dried, however, I do not know if that was from the oil or the conditioner I used. I"m actually going to continue to use it on my hair as well (and stop using conditioner during this time) to see if I notice any results. From what I read, the avocado oil will not only moisturize hair but it strengthens the hair shaft and helps to prevent breakage. I plan on updating my review with the results after using the avocado oil for a bit.

FYI: I read during my research that avocado oil lasts 6 months once the bottle has been opened so I did write yesterday's date on the label of the bottle. Its very likely I will probably use the entire bottle of oil before 6 months are up, but better to be safe than sorry.

I'm actually excited over my newfound love/use of avocado oil! I'm thrilled with the oil so far and can't wait to find other uses for it. I don't mean to sound whiny but I will say that I hope they rethink the bottle/label this oil comes in. When I received it, before I took a good look at the label, I actually thought it was a cleaning product. Its very generic and I have to say if it were on a shelf with other oils at the grocery store, I'd likely walk right past it and assume it was a cleaning product someone stuck on the wrong shelf or a very cheap, 'no frills' bottle of avocado oil. This oil works well and has so many great benefits, the bottle/label should stand out more and be more eye-catching.

title: Good Taste But Not Very Spicy
text:
I made BLTs for dinner one night last week and realized I'd forgotten to buy a jar of mayo at the grocery store. title: Lots of Flavor! A Nice Break From Regular Potato Chips!

title: WAY Better Than I Expected!
text:
WOW. I did NOT see that coming!

I can be fussy when it comes to coffee. (And by 'fussy', I mean incredibly anal! lol) If I don't like the flavor, I'm done. No second chance. (Unless I'm desperate) And instant coffee? I have to be VERY desperate to drink instant. Or so I thought...

And the price is right!

ENJOY!

title: Perfect as a Topping, Perfect Right Out of the Pouch Too!
text: Orchard Valley Harvest salad toppers (glazed walnuts and berries) are absolutely fantastic! I have finally found my perfect cup of coffee! I like a medium roast and I like it smooth without any sharp edges, bitterness or burnt taste. I drink my coffee black with no additives, so I can taste the pure taste. I've tried more brands than I can count, but for consistency in taste and quality, McCafe Medium Roast wins hands down.
With so many different price ranges, this 84 count box is the best price I have found.

title: Movie Theater Style!
text:
I received an electric popcorn maker and so I researched for what would be the best products to use in it. I read about Wabash Valley Farms Popping Oil, like used in the movie theaters and decided that was the one I wanted. It has the machine recommended Coconut Oil and it has the color and flavor I am looking for.
Following the machine's directions, I added the popping oil and corn. Before I knew it, the popcorn was popping all over inside the machine and every single kernel popped! It came out perfect and delicious and Wabash Valley Farms is the only brand I'll use from now on. I love it!

title: It's Good.

I'll try a different type of Amish popcorn. Like I said, it's good but I wouldn't call it great. Had a lot of hulls which I didn't expect. Perhpas I didn't read the labels right.

title: Little Can, Lots of Taste

I put it on toast or rye bread with a little mayo and lettuce or you can put it on crackers. Doesn't taste like Spam in the familiar can... Tastes better, I think.

title: Best Vanilla Flavor
text:
My daughter was responsible over 10 years ago for my drinking flavored coffee and vanilla or hazelnut were always my favorites.
I drink my coffee black and so the flavor does not get covered up in any way. The first time I tasted Folger's Vanilla Biscotti, I knew no other flavored coffee would ever do. The flavor is so pure and rich and it doesn't have that French vanilla flavor that I really don't care for. I buy the Folgers Vanilla Biscotti in bags of ground coffee and also in the K-cups.
For guests, I make regular coffee in the coffee maker and pop a K-cup of Vanilla Biscotti in my Keurig for myself. It's not always the easiest to find, but its worth looking around for.

title: An exceptional treat
text: This is delicious smoked salmon.  Have a nice, big platter ready when you open the package.  The salmon is packed in some liquid keeping the fish moist.  The outer flesh is darker because of the smoking, but still tender and tasty.  The flavor is rather strong, but I liked it.  However, this type of fish is really best when added to other foods.  There are excellent suggestions on the package.  The first meal I made was a Waldorf salad: chopped toasted walnuts and chopped apple added to lettuce and tossed with pieces of salmon.  The typical dressing is a mayonnaise based one: I used Ken's Asian sesame dressing.  This was a really good salad!  I've sauteed some vegetables in garlic butter, added some salmon and tossed it all with cooked pasta.  Another favorite is to lightly toast a split English Muffin, lightly spread with mayonnaise and top with flaked salmon, thinly sliced onion and a slice of tomato.  A slice of Swiss cheese may be added to the top-put the muffins under the broiler for a few minutes and you have a nice lunch.  In all of these dishes, the salmon blends well and the other ingredients are enhanced by the salmon's smokey flavor and saltiness.

There are 18 different kinds in a box, so there's a good variety (there is a very nice sheet with a picture and explanation for each kind). You begin to get know the different kinds by their appearance. I try not to overdo it, so I limit myself to 2 a day, but it's really nice to be able to have them frequently. They probably aren't as "giftable" as Godiva, but they're a pleasure to be able to have them in the house for me to eat. I will be reordering them.

title: Amazing!
text:
This stuff is amazing! I make a gravy out of it when the roast is done and also make sour cream mashed potatoes to go with it. See below for exactly what I do. Best dinner ever. My husband loves it!

Ingredients
2-3 lb chuck roast
1 pouch Campbell's Tavern Style Pot Roast Slow Cooker Sauce
2-4 carrots (depending on size), sliced into finger-length wedges (alt: baby carrots sliced in half lengthwise)
2-4 thyme sprigs
4-5 cloves of garlic, sliced in half or in thirds lengthwise
butter
flour
sour cream mashed potatoes*
baked rolls or french bread
side salad

Steps
1. Smear butter on the bottom of the slow cooker pot. Lay carrots along the bottom. Place the thyme sprigs on top of the carrots, then sprinkle with the garlic cloves. Place roast on top and pour sauce over the roast. Cook for 7-8 hours on LOW or 4-5 hours on HIGH.

2. When roast is finished, set to warm and spoon out most of the liquid in the bottom of the pot (move some things around and tip it to the side). Pick any remaining garlic cloves out of the pot and smash on cutting board. Heat butter in a small pot until melted, whisk in flour to make a roux, then whisk in liquid from slow cooker to make a gravy. Whisk in mashed garlic cloves.

3. Serve roast and carrots with mashed potatoes, gravy, bread, and side salad.

Notes
*However many Russet potatoes are needed: boil, mash with salt, garlic powder, and sour cream. Butter optional. Milk not needed (will make leftover mashed potatoes runny).
Also optional: sliced mushrooms and/or onions.

I might have gotten a random fluke, super tight jar, but I’m a 32 year old male and this thing was a challenge.  Maybe the struggle made the flavor that much more sweet..

title: Tasty, but not s’mores

It is definitely chocolate, but I was expecting more marshmallow and graham cracker taste.  Overall, it’s a very rich, dense, tasty treat.  For the price, I expected more precision with the recipe.

title: Full of flavor, not as dense
text: Breyers ice cream is full of flavor and inexpensive as well.  This ice cream is not as dense as some of its competitors, but it makes up for that with very strong flavors.  Mine arrived via Amazon Fresh, and it was still frozen and well-packed.  Overall, Breyers will always be in my ice cream lineup, but if you prefer a more dense ice cream, look elsewhere.

title: Crisp, fresh, instant favorite
text: I can’t believe I’m writing a review for sparking water, but Voss deserves all 5 stars!  I just returned from military assignment to Germany where sparking water is offered everywhere.  There is a big difference in brands and quality, so I’ve been looking for a high quality brand that doesn’t taste artificial.  Voss sparking water is somehow crisp and fresh without tasting like it needs to be mixed with flavoring.  It is simply good the way it is.  I enjoyed my bottle straight out of the refrigerator, and it was so refreshing I immediately put it back as to savor the experience over the whole day.  It sounds silly,  but when you finally find your go-to drink, you’ll understand! Also, the glass bottle serves two purposes.  One, it is trendy and a great way to re-use the container for other drinks.  But it also helps to keep the drink colder longer than a plastic bottle would.  I highly recommend this sparking water!

title: Too different from original Peeps to appeal to me
text: I am a lifelong lover of original Peeps. I will also buy them at times other than Easter.  Wild Berry Sparkle does not have the sugar coverage of the original and had a slight tart taste neither of which I felt was beneficial to this variety of Peeps.  Maybe if you dislike original Peeps or find they are "too sugary" Wild Berry flavor variety might appeal, but these are a hard no from me.

title: Delicious Ginger Snaps Cookies
text: I very much enjoyed this ginger snaps cookie brand.  If you like ginger snaps cookies, I think you'll like these.  No overly strong taste and a great crunch.  Gluten free too. The price was very reasonable.  I definitely plan to keep ordering this brand of cookies.

text: I hadn't had these thin mints in a long time.  They were as great tasting as I remembered and actually even better than I remembered.  Needed small chocolate candies to fill out stocking stuffer type gifts and these Andes mints did the trick.  As mentioned, loved them so much, I kept some for myself.  Will definitely purchase again in the future.

title: Wonder family stocking stuffer gift
text: This was given as a stocking stuffer gift to a family I knew would enjoy and appreciate receiving it.  I am happy to have found it on Amazon as I am unable to run around looking for a store having it in stock.  The family told me they loved the great taste.

title: Loved this applesauce flavor
text: I really enjoyed the flavor.  I would not have guessed this is a no added sugar item.  The cherry added a lot to the applesauce taste.  Definitely will repurchase this applesauce flavor again.

title: Great Lemon Taste
text: I included this gourmet candy as part of a stocking stuffer gift.  If you love lemon taste you will enjoy this candy.  I gave it a 4 rating because it's a bit pricey and the candy is not long-lasting, but still delicious.  Everyone had compliments after trying this candy.

title: Walkers Shortbread Cookies Delicious Christmas Gift
text: My mother has always enjoyed shortbread cookies and Walkers is an excellent brand, so I like to give these as gifts for her especially at Christmas.  It's a pleasure to gift her something I know she'll savor and not just shove in a cabinet somewhere.

title: Good mild tasting convenient rice pouch
text: I add vegetables to this rice flavor and make a quick convenient meal.  I don't like a strong garlic flavor, but find this very mild.  One can always add extra spices, but you can't easily delete them.  Some of the rice pouches I've tried tend to clump, but this one has not which I like.  I appreciate its availability in the Amazon Subscribe and Save program.

title: Apricot adds extra taste to this Apple Sauce
text: I enjoy the taste of this apple sauce.  I need the convenience of individual cups because I add in some unpalatable medication to the apple sauce so I can take it more regularly and not dread taking it.  My dog can testify that it tastes great as she stole 2 unopened cups and gnawed them open and I now store the cups in a place she had no access to.  Bonus that it is organic.

title: Del Monte Carrots 12 cans
text: Not a lot one can say about canned carrots, they meet my nutritional needs and are of good value.  Del Monte is a quality brand and the carrots taste as well as any canned carrot I am able to purchase. I appreciate their availability in the Amazon Subscribe and Save program.

title: Del Monte Spinach 12 cans
text: There isn't much glamour in describing canned spinach, but I actually do like it and can't always have access to fresh for eating, so I am pleased its being offered here in the Amazon Subscribe and Save program at a fair price and Del Monte is a good brand.  A little splash of lemon enhances the flavor.

title: Tasty corn treat
text: Great flavor and crunch.  I have gluten allergy and I am always looking for food I can eat that does not trigger allergy and I have had no issues eating these.  I love the portion control with the individual bags and that is a big plus too.  I became burnt out with eating potato chips and this was a good alternative for an occasional treat and no worries about bag becoming stale because the individual packets eliminate that.

title: Great tasting gluten free pretzels
text: These pretzels are a gluten free product and have an excellent taste.  They are currently my go-to easy snack to grab.  Additionally they are a good value.  Since saltine style crackers are no longer easily available to me, I find eating these when I feel a bit queasy works just as well.

title: Okay somewhat bland cookies
text: I would rate these in the middle.  The cookies weren't awful by any means, but I found them fairly bland.  The lemon was the best although I am partial to lemon flavor. The cookies were somewhat crumbly in the package, but not completely broken apart as so many gluten-free baked goods are.  I have no plans to reorder these cookies.

title: Great Oreo taste
text: I have not had Oreos in many years after I had to stop eating products containing gluten, but these gluten-free Oreos taste the way  I remember and also do not leave an unpleasant aftertaste that gluten-free products often have.  Additionally, they do not fall apart like so many baked goods without gluten do!  So win win all the way except they are a bit pricey as are so many gluten-free products 🤔.

title: Good tasting juice drink
text: It's been so hot and I found myself craving something else to drink in addition to water or soda.  I was a little hesitant to order because sometimes grapefruit juice can have an unpleasant after taste or taste a little "tinny".  This juice was good tasting though so that was a nice surprise.  As long as one is okay with an occasional sugary drink that contains at least some vitamins and potassium this was a good purchase for me.  I would buy this juice drink again.

title: Disappointing
text: Unfortunately this purchase is a big regret.  Taste was very disappointing, plus the cakebites left an odd after taste which I didn't care for.  They are very pretty though.  I will of course, never purchase these again because I had to toss them into the trash since for me they are inedible.

title: Lay's great tasting chips
text: I love Lay's Chips and really appreciate the portion size.  No food waste or chips becoming stale and I find I can better control how much I eat if I am not using larger sizes.  I think the price and convenience are good benefits too.  I need gluten free snacks and Lays chips are a great option when good portion size is available.  I've tried other brands of chips, but Lay's never goes out of style.  So far the expiration dates have been at least 5-6 plus weeks away and I have never had stale chips.

title: Love the mini can size
text: I enjoy a good Pepsi on occasion, but have to acknowledge that soda is really empty calories that I want to cut down on (sorry I despise diet soda.)  This size is a great compromise.  I can drink one and feel very satisfied without opening another.  This is a good size to keep on hand (especially during summer) when you want to drink a cola, but do not want to consume 12-16 ounces or more of soda pop.  I appreciate that this size is on offer because I had completely stopped buying any soda at all because of large size.  Even better no waste like with the larger sizes, I got so very tired of food waste including pop.

I think it was a fun idea and the variety was appreciated.  There are a lot of gourmet steak seasonings one can include to make a nice house-warming type gift especially for someone just setting up a household and won't have a variety of spices and seasonings.

The packet size is more like a sample size which I guess if you're dieting and can limit yourself to only 1 packet that's great, but not practical for most folks. text: I will preface this review by saying that I had heard about this "skinny pop" popcorn and how healthy it was and how great it tasted so I decided to give it a try.  I didn't look at the nutrition label beforehand surprisingly and I was under the impression it was really healthy. The front of the bag boasts it's only 39 calories per cup, no trans fat, etc.  It does taste great.  Maybe not as good as some of the super butter movie style popcorns out there but much better than the low-fat, 94% fat free, type of popcorns out there.  So I'm thinking this is a great popcorn!  I read the ingredients and it's just popcorn, oil and salt and I thought that was nice it didn't have a bunch of chemicals and preservatives or dairy.  But then I finally read the nutrition label.  The "serving size" is 4 c (pretty generous but i think standard popcorn serving size) and it has 10 grams of fat!  That's quite a lot for something that bills itself as being so good for you and skinny.  I still eat it, because it is really good but I think they are a bit misleading with the packaging and would encourage those to read the nutritional information and keep that in mind when trying it.  That said, this is a great way to order it on amazon as it's a good price and I can just add a bad onto a regular order.

The unfrosted strawberry ones I eat occasionally never do that.

Also, I've never paid attention to expiration dates on Pop-Tarts. But I found out the hard way that the taste of the unfrosted strawberry & unfrosted cinnamon Pop-Tarts goes bad after several months. title: About 1/3 of product seems to have evaporated

title: These dyes will work on mineral oil as well
text: I needed something that would allow me to dye mineral oil without having the color separate out, and this works very well. title: Delicious on oatmeal
text: If you haven't tried Lyle's Golden Syrup yet - what are you waiting for?  It's really good on oatmeal (especially McCann's or Bob's Red Mill) [[ASIN:B001EO5U3I McCANN'S Steel Cut Irish Oatmeal, 28-Ounce Tins (Pack of 4)]][[ASIN:B004VLVBVG Bob's Red Mill Steel Cut Oats, 24-ounce (Pack of 4)]]or Cream of Wheat or any hot cereal instead of brown sugar.  Probably good on other things, too, but I use it for hot cereal.  I think it's made from cane sugar, so it has a lighter flavor than maple syrup.  It used to only come in a tin, where you pried the lid off, and after the first use, it was a sticky business getting that lid off again!  These plastic squeeze bottles are a much better idea.

title: 5 big tummies & a couple tips for you
text:
Sourdough is my favorite bread. Studies show sourdough is also the most healthy bread you can put in your body. This is a great starter, and I'm very happy w/it. Now I like my sourdough w/ that tang; you can really taste sourdough. I researched what I could do to increase the sourdough flavor. I spoke to the lovely bakers at King Arthur Flours & they wracked their brains to try to help me. Finally their suggestion was to add a more sour note w/ the use of citric acid. I really didn't want a chemical taste & wanted my little sourdough organisms to do their thing. After months of experimentation I found a way to kick up that sourdough flavor, naturally. What I recommend is that you prep your dough & do your first rise in the refrigerator. Let it go 2 days if you have the time, but keep it slow. Then remove your dough, punch it down, shape & let it do the final rise till it's perfectly risen. I never use a warm area for rising any of my breads cool,& slow produces a far more complex, tastier, better crusted & crumbed loaf of bread. So bake it off & enjoy. If you are one who doesn't like a stronger sourdough bread, keep both your rises short. Still I'd advise against the warm place to rise method. Hope this top helps you use this starter to bake the best sourdough bread of your life! Happy baking.
O, as you explore look at sourdough in the dessert arena. Truly yummy.

text:

3). The tiny thermometer is not digital & is impossible o read;
4). It doesn't include a curd knife;
5). This kit includes cheese making wax;
6). There is a brush (boar bristles) for applying wax;
7). it doesn't include a press with the lame e cues that all cheese presses "cost hundreds of dollars (I am sure I haven't remembered everything but I think is a lot).

I think those reasons alone demonstrate this isn't a "complete cheese making kit. I became so disgusted at I ordered the ultimate she else making kit from Leeners. What a difference! Leeners kit was clearly superior. It includes a book of cheese making that is very complete. This kit is clearly far superior. It includes a professional curd knife, a digital cheese thermometer, a number of different baskets for shaping different cheeses, and fancy this it has a cheese press that is very nice! It has the cheese cloth & ingredients as does this one. It doesn't offer the pot but as I indicated I found a beautiful pot on Amazon for under $30 & if u don't have an induction stove I would venture to guess you can find a perfect pot for less money.

You need to make your own decision of course; but I wanted to make sure you had all the facts on both kits as Leeners kit doesn't describe what the kit contains and I think that's a shame. I found the Leeners kit to be amazing. The box is much bigger that this one because it offers so much more. Also Leeners is available 7 days a week and very helpful. I already ran into a problem and called them. They were very helpful & encouraged me to call whenever I needed help. And you ca make hard cheese with their kit as well as soft cheese!

title: Made licorice caramels for my Mom
text:
A recipe I have NEVER in the history of ever even heard of before, let alone eaten. I'm not a licorice aficionado, I don't buy licorice, but I will have a few if offered 🙃

My mom loves licorice. Love love love love LOVES. She particularly loves the Brach's (black) Jelly Bird eggs licorice jelly beans. And she has been craving them for months, but they're only fresh at Easter (I mean, you can find them here but they're only made for the Easter sales, so they're likely to be older). She does have chewing difficulty with hard candies, foods but says the jelly beans eventually become soft enough she can chew them. I have an amazing mother who has always been beyond good to me, so I wanted to try to make her some licorice. I knew that sometimes licorice is made with anise, but couldn't have told the difference in anise oil and licorice oil if I was drowning in them. Finding them locally wasn't gonna happen, so I ordered both here. Expensive is an understatement BUT a little lasts a long time and will last through MANY batches of licorice caramels. (Oh yeah, there will DEFINITELY be more to come!! Buh-bye, Brach's!).

I could tell the difference in the anise oil and the licorice oil when I got them, smell-wise. I am now supposing 90% of licorice sold in the USA is made with anise oil or anise flavoring. Which left me even more baffled as to which to use for my Mom's licorice caramels. I used 1 part anise to 2 parts licorice oil because the smell of the anise is unmistakable and I wanted her to be able to smell that distinct 'licorice' smell. (The pungency is also unmistakable to the palate, but I didn't want to overdo the punch, so to speak. These are licorice CARAMELS and I wanted there to be a licorice smoothness to them, as well.)

The quality of these is top notch, so don't hesitate to purchase them. The flavoring is phenomenal!!

title: Not for dysphagia or those with oral tactile issues...
text:
Kid has been in need of powerful food thickening since 1998. ThickIt Concentrate (fka ThickIt 2... still blue lid container). With all the haywire shortages going on - toilet paper, anyone 🙄 - I figured it wouldn't hurt to have a 'back up plan' in case our preferred food thickener became unattainable. I also thought it might be smart to compare the two, as I couldn't find where anyone else had...

Whereas our preferred ThickIt 2 is modified corn starch (whether they modify by processing technique [something about an electrical 'zap'] or enzymes or chemicals, I don't know) Xanthan Gum is some "sugar building blocks fermented blah blah blah". For us, this doesn't matter.

For my purposes, I made 16oz of what I call "Gatorade Jelly" - it makes his beverage the consistency of thick pudding or slightly 'wet' mashed potatoes or sieved jam. Because the TI doesn't keep the liquid bind as a solid in the stomach, it's a good way for us to add fluids. (He NEEDS a GI tube but they won't because he's developmentally delayed and apparently the DD love to yank their GI tubes out daily. I usually put the 2 cups of Gatorade in a quart container with a screw on lid, add the 1/2c TI and shake violently for ≈20 seconds. Thickness is achieved within a minute to 90 seconds max. With the XG, mixing with cold beverage left white chunks. Had to remove to a blender and blend on high 30 seconds to get rid of the white chunks. Thickening was possibly more immediate than with the TI, but thickening didn't seem to stop. I used maybe 2 tbsp of the XG. Because of the costs and volume, the measures can't be compared by my math-challenged brain. The Gatorade with XG got so thick that I had to use a fork to get it to wash down my sink drain using 135°F water.
For us, that's gonna make the XG a Plan B only in the direst of circumstances.

As far as texture, the XG thickened Gatorade was, in all forms of thickness, slimy. Oral tactile sensitivity isn't an issue for us, but it's a nightmare for many.

Hope this helps another caregiver 💛

title: Better than most but...
text:
I've come to the conclusion, after trying dozens of 'caramel flavored' products (flavorings, flavored sugar free syrups, flavored syrups, drinks from the big name franchises, etc.) that NOTHING NOTHING NUHHHHH-THINNGGGG tastes like caramel except actual caramel.

Some people talk about bitter undertones and bitter aftertastes... for me, I've rarely noted bitterness in a caramel flavor product (unless it was with a sugar free product, in which case those artificial sweeteners - alone or in combination with the caramel flavoring chemicals - do have a bit of a bitterness sometimes); what I find is that the have a black pepper aftertaste. I don't know why my taste buds process the aftertaste that way, and I know it's weird - lol - but this product wasn't any different. It says it is super strength so I used a clean dropper I had and added a couple of drops... no caramel taste... a few more drops... maybe.... then literally two more drops and BOOM!! caramel-pepper.

I really wanted this product to be "IT" but it just wasn't for me. 3 stars instead of 1 because I know my tongue processes that weird taste whereas most folks are normal ;)

title: Best flavor of any I have used... and I've used A LOT
text: ...but, that headline aside, the strength is half to 66.6% that of other brands. So whether that's worth it to you is for you to decide. I would absolutely recommend this for anyone first transitioning from sugar to artificial sweeteners - this product makes the transition smoother than products with a strong aftertaste (anything with stevia tends to have a weird minty aftertaste... not good with some flavors, IMO).

title: UGH!!! I am hooked...
text: ...this stuff ain't cheap. If you figure it out it is about the same price, if not more expensive, than some of the really good loose teas you find in tea shops and boutiques. I figured out I was most in love with blueberry - I make 36 Oz a day and squeeze in a whole lemon. I am now poor - lol.

title: Lasts me 10 months...
text: I’m a coffee-drink fiend. I’ve been doing this for so long that mine are a latte better ;P than Stankbux: mocha latte with fresh mocha whip, mocha-peppermint latte with fresh mocha whip, French vanilla latte with fresh vanilla whip... all sugar free, all 40 Oz, all for less than half of a Stankbux. This type of liquid sucralose is key. I originally started out buying the EZ Sweetz back when it was about all one could get on Amazon (that had a decent average review). I switched to an equally good tasting brand when it become near to impossible to justify the price difference. That brand disappeared and I found another equally good tasting brand last year. This time, when it was reorder time, I was happy to find the EZ Sweetz to now be price equivalent. So I came back to the original. Tastes as good as it did in the beginning (I CANNOT STRESS THIS ENOUGH: This is super concentrated!! If you’re using too much it’s gonna be awful, they all will. I use more than most regular users and I use maybe 18 drops for a 40 ounce drink. Use less, you can always add more.).

title: I will NEVER but any other brand ever again
text:
If I could use emoji on this review I’d post the ‘praise’ hands and/or the applause hands.

My most common use is making mocha whipped cream for my iced coffee/lattes. 4 Oz heavy cream + sweetener to preference + 1 teaspoon Hoosier Hill Farms Espresso Powder + 1 teaspoon Hoosier Hill Farms Unsweetened Cocoa Powder and whip til stiff. YUMazing!

This was priced better so I ordered one (I put a tablespoon in my 40oz Ozark Trail tumbler before adding my hot coffee; I put a teaspoon in with a teaspoon of the Hoosier Hill Farm Espresso Powder with about 4 Oz heavy cream and sweetener of my choice to make mocha whipped cream for my iced coffee drinks). The flavor beats the famous, universal brand.

title: If you don’t love it immediately, give it time...
text:
I was addicted to Teavana Weight to Go. Thanks, Starbutts for buying out and ruining another good thing. So, after a Google search of the ‘ingredients’ of the W2G blend, I found the Tealyra SlenderBerry Blend and, after an adjustment period, I became addicted to the Tealyra SlenderBerry. On a whim, I bought this Wellness Weight Loss Blend. Initially, I wasn’t over the top in love but it was “meh” 3 Star okay. But, I had spent I think $10 for 2 ounces or whatever l, so a I kept drinking it. And as I kept sporadically drinking it, something weird happened... I am SO OVER the SlenderBerry and totally addicted to this Wellness Weight Loss Blend. (I think that the Tealyra SB has more of a spearmint-y undertone and less of a berry, compared to the Teavana, and I just never could make my palette believe it was the exact same thing.)

A 2 ounce bag last A LOOOOOONG time. Like almost daily (for me) for at least 2 months.I use a rounded tablespoon in one of those generic reusable kcups in my Cuisinart KCup Brewer. I run it through Brew cycle (12 oz each) twice. Then I remove the kcup, drop it in my tea mug, and let it steep until the tea is cool enough for me to drink. Monk fruit sweetener to taste and squeeze half a lemon and YUMazing!!

title: I can eat waffles...and still KETO/LCHF!!

title: NOT EVEN SWEET except in ridiculous quantities
text:
My review is based on my opinion, my experience. I can’t be the only purchaser on the planet that thinks ‘Okay, I’ll try this supposedly healthier alternative to liquid sucralose’ and migrate from using sucralose to erythritol. Then, believing that drop for drop the two will compare in sweetness.

NOT EVEN REMOTELY CLOSE.

I’m estimating it takes 3 to 4 times the NOW FOODS BETTERSTEVIA LIQUID drops to 1 drop of liquid sucralose. Besides the whole ‘at this rate I’ll go so poor buying the NOW FOODS that I’ll die of starvation long before any supposed system failure due to use of liquid sucralose. If Amazon would allow the use of emoji in their reviews I would totally insert the eye roll here.

title: Authentic British (meatless) Mincemeat...unlike the grocery store junk

We lost her 10 years ago and being able to make these pies really makes the holidays feel a little more like she is with us in spirit.

title: Perfect replacement for the discontinued Teavana Weight 2 Go
text: Because Starblechs bought out Teavana and shut them down, discontinuing nearly every product, and commercializing the crap out of what was once a quality product - I was forced to find a replacement tea. I WAS ADDICTED TO MY DAILY 24 OZ OF TEAVANA WEIGHT 2 GO. When I found the  Tealyra Berry Rose Slenderize after doing a Google search of the ingredients in the Teavana, I initially only ordered a small bag. At first it seemed like a slightly mintier substitute, taste-wise, but now I can’t taste the mint and am so completely happy and thankful with my find. Delicious tea!! I’d give it 10/5 stars :)

title: Well, obviously it is super strong - you have to use 3x the usual

Tastes good, not bitter at all, quite smooth. Which is 3 stars. Because to get the astronomical caffeine per cup the brand notes in their sales pitch, you have to use 3 or 4x the amount of grounds, per cup, as you would with your grocery store brands. I COULD SPOON UP 3x AS MUCH DUMPKIN or STARBLECHS or MCDOUGALS and get 3x the caffeine.

Subtracted 1 star for the misrepresentation & 1 Star for the therefore ridiculous price.

title: THE BEST espresso powder - bar none!! Invest, it lasts
text: I don’t love hot lattés in summer - I like mine iced. So I make up a gallon of strong coffee at a time, pour a 30 oz steel tumbler 2/3 full, add 4 oz frothed half/half, 2 tsp Mexican Vanilla Blend, 10 drops liquid sucralose, 1.5 - 2 tsp MEDAGLIA D’ORO INSTANT ESPRESSO, 4 oz whipped heavy cream and YUMazing. Energy for the entire day, too. Best instant espresso I’ve ever had. Worth the investment. —- OH! I also add a teaspoon to my sugar free jello chocolate pudding mix (made with heavy cream and half/half for lower carbs) and it is DIVINE!!

title: Prefer this blend to most pure extracts
text: Use a teaspoon in my 24 oz coffee/latte every morning. It is also really good in baking. Tastes less alcohol-y than most (or maybe just a better quality alcohol? Some other brands taste like the manufacturer used rubbing alcohol in the production process). Really nice flavor, like you would expect pure vanilla to taste.

title: Made nice little gifts for all my baker friends

He likes the enhanced flavor an extra tablespoon gives each half gallon of creamer that I make up for him. Lovely in homemade vanilla ice cream, as well.

title: Great price! Convenient size!
text: Add in Subscribe & Save and this is one of my best subscription orders. The special kid (intractable epilepsy, EoE, PDD-NOS, oral motor issues, low weight, blah blah blah) loves Gatorade in this flavor and the lemon-lime. He especially loves them mixed (it is quite tasty!).

title: Alcohol aftertaste; not a strong vanilla flavor
text: If you've used vanilla long enough, in any type 'application' (baking, beverages, etc.) you will - I think, at some point - use too much. I do this more than I should admit. Still. I make my own coffeehouse beverage every morning. Couldn't tell ya if what I make is a macchi-frappe-cappa-java...I just call it "jet fuel". It consists of 12 oz coffee made from espresso + one shot espresso + 2 oz frothed milk + dollops of unsweetened cream. And a tsp of vanilla. (This is where my review comes in)...I go through A LOT of vanilla. I've been using Mexican vanilla. This time I decided to try this McCormick's. Apparently a teaspoon of vanilla is too much - well, in the McCormick's it is - because there is an overwhelming ALCOHOL flavor. Never had that before with any other brand (and I haven't exactly been the most faithful brand buyer when it comes to vanilla). Perhaps this is a problem because I'm using the McCormick's in a beverage and it is a brand better suited to baking (?), I don't know. I do shake the bottle each time before measuring the vanilla - that's a habit that may not be necessary. There is, however, an UNDERwhelming vanilla flavor. I will go back to the Mexican vanilla after I go through this bottle of McCormick's.

title: Divine (yes, I really mean that) cinnamon
text: As soon as I opened the bottle, I could smell the difference in the Saigon Cinnamon and the 'other' cinnamon.  Now I can literally smell the bitterness in the 'other'. The taste is like comparing filet mignon to soy steak (this being the filet), in that I now can taste that the 'other' isn't real.

title: Thickens on par with corn starch, NOT xanthan gum - A review for medically-required usage
text: Have been using Xanthan Gum for a couple of years (after discovering how much cheaper it was, because I had to use so much less, than the Thick-It 2 food thickener.  Unfortunately, my kid developed something that is shortened into EoE, and the three triggers are dairy, nuts, xanthan gum.  I had really hoped that Arrowroot Powder would have the thickening capabilities of Xanthan Gum, but it sadly does not...not by a mile.  I would guess this is more consistent with using plain corn starch.  By the time I used enough to barely come close to the thickness we needed (stiff pudding), you could taste the Arrowroot Powder and were also aware of the chalky texture from needing so much Arrowroot Powder.  Also, as my kid is a heavy drooler, after a few bites, if any of his (slobber) was on the spoon and re-entered the bowl, the Arrowroot thickness would disappear.  I can't recommend this for medically necessary thickening (for poor swallowers), but it might be fine for baking or what have you.

title: Glad I took a chance and tried NuSugar
text: Formerly used EZ Sweetz, which is quite a bit more expensive.  This tastes identical.  The seller NuSweet ships with the flip lid sealed in some kind of heat-sealed clear film, so there was no spillage or leakage in shipping. Glad I took a chance and tried NuSugar.

title: If you're ready, willing, and able to ditch sugar then you'll probably like this
text: Apparently I use way WAY more sweetener than most, because this lasts me about 9 months.  It tastes really good IN MODERATION; if you try to make a gallon of sweet tea (I'm from the South, y'all) and sweeten it like you do with sugar (I'm talking diabetes-inducing 2 cups sugar per gallon SWEET tea), then it's really bitter and not good. I take a little tea with my lemon :) so I sweeten each glass in moderation.  My husband is a die-hard sweet tea man, and he'll drink water rather than unsweet tea sweetened with this.  I think it's great, but wouldn't suggest buying a lot if you're still pretty addicted to sugar because I think you have to be willing to give up the sugar in order to appreciate this stuff.  I do like the way this drops; as in two drops equals a serving equivalent to 1 teaspoon of sugar.  I tried the grocery store stuff with the skinny chic on the front and I don't like that a serving is a squeeze. My squeeze isn't the same as a big man squeeze, so that's kind of hard to gauge.

title: It's pretty dang good for sugar-free

title: YUM-azing!
text: This stuff makes muffins (following the recipe on the bag [plus the extra egg suggested for fluffier muffins]) that NO ONE will know are gluten-free.  Seriously...I made muffins with fresh blueberries and they were yum-azing.  Same can be said for corn muffins I made to go with BBQ.

title: Is it really BETTER? I think not.
text: I think I judged a book by its cover, so to speak.  Given the name is "BETTER Bowls", and some of the reviewers were singing the praises of not getting brain cancer from the aspartame found in the national brand of sugar free pudding, I assumed this product was BETTER because it contained some natural sweetener.  It does not.  It has the stuff that's in Splenda - a product not without its own controversies.  Had this contained stevia or monk or agave, then I could see where they could call it BETTER - even though it doesn't set up better than the other stuff and it doesn't taste better than the other stuff (sucralose is yuckier tasting that the aspartame, in my opinion).  So my review is they either need to change the mis-leading name or look into truly making a BETTER sugar free pudding mix.

title: IF you are a consumer of canned roast beef, you'll like the Libby's brand for the taste and convenience

My husband, about once every month or so, gets a 'wild hair' and decides he wants a hot roast beef sandwich.  Usually about 9pm on a weekend night.  This is a product he likes for that.  I only eat roast beef cooked in the crock pot, so my opinion doesn't matter. title: Don't buy the thickener they sell at the pharmacy in the yellow or blue can unless you wanna be poor -
text: For thickening purees for someone with oral motor issues.  Thickens VERY VERY well (don't use more than 1/2 tsp. or you'll end up with a bowl of concrete) and lasts a REALLY long time.  (Comparatively, I was using $60/month in ThickIt 2 food thickener and this 1.5 pound jar lasts a bit over a year for us.) I would give this 100 stars, to be honest, after the expense of the food thickener they sell at pharmacies.  (BTW, this does not alter the flavor of food or beverages, even though it does a have 'lumber' type smell when you open the canister.  I think I read that Xanthan gum is made from birch trees or something, so I guess that's why it smells that way.)

title: Maybe 5 stars with Keurig brand - NOT for Cuisinart
text: I opened the package and, before doing anything, I put the B&S K Cups (individually) into the Cuisinart SS700, and ran a Rinse.  Cover closed as it should, Rinse ran just as smoothly as it should.  I then opened the cover, left the same B&S in, closed the cover, and ran a Hot Water cycle.  Still perfect.  Finally, I ran a Brew cycle (no grounds).  Finished perfect.  Repeated all steps on the 2nd B&S in the package.  Duplicate perfection.  I then considered that each B&S was clean and sanitized.  I took a B&S out, filled with my Illy Espresso, and ran a 4 oz espresso.  YUM! A few hours later, I got out the 2nd B&S, filled to the appropriate level with some Dunkin Donuts Ground and ran an 8 oz cup of coffee.  AAHHH!  *Here's where it gets weird and disappointing.  Unless I missed something (and I very well may have), I ran the B&S cups in my dishwasher, in the silverware compartment.  Next morning, I open the dishwasher, retrieve the B&S, put it in the Cuisinart...and the cover won't close on the Cuisinart - as if the location of the top hole in the B&S moved, or the inverted plastic filter part had gotten less deep.  (Yes, I put it in correctly.)  Put that first B&S to the side, retrieved the 2nd B&S from the dishwasher, put it in the Cuisinart...and the cover won't close.  What the heck?!?  If anyone can clear up this conundrum for me, OMG I would love you forever (strictly platonically, of course).  I REALLY REALLY wanted the Brew & Save Refillable to work.  I just cannot, for the life of me, figure out what happened.  Bizarre.

This is what exceeds our needs, but is affordable (as far as good coconut oils) its clean, not greasy on us, Its organic, natural, refined, and smells like coconut.

I will add I live in a hot environment, its been 118° average this summer, and winters are in the 80's, so I had zero doubt that it would be liquid when delivered. title: Quick Serve Indian Food
text:
I like meals that are quick to prepare. I also like Indian food from time to time and I was quick to grab the opportunity for a fast Indian meal when I discovered Palak Paneer, from Ashoka.

To prepare this food, you can either drop the pouch in boiling water or empty the contents in a bowl and microwave it. Given my preference for simplicity, I chose the latter option. In two minutes, the food is ready to eat.

I admit, this product doesn’t look so good when squeezed from the pouch. However, looks can be deceiving. It is made mostly from spinach and has a distinctly earthy, plant enhanced flavor. There isn’t as much spiciness as expected. The paneer cheese adds some contrast and good flavor addition. I recommend serving with naan, for added enjoyment.

If you like spinach, you will enjoy this Palak Paneer. I would prefer if there were smaller, single serve pouches in the box, but this is still a good product overall and a good choice when you want the taste of Indian food and have only minutes of time and/or limited patience.

title: Smooth and Sweet Way to Start Your Morning
text:
I drink more coffee than I should, and I insist that the coffee I drink meet several minimum standards. Boyer's Coffee Aspen Gold Coffee, Medium Roast, Whole Bean coffee easily meets or exceeds what I demand in a cup of coffee.

I have a coffee grinder and thus go for the whole bean variety when I shop for coffee. These beans earn high marks the moment you open the bag and soak up the wonderful, sweet scent they emit. You can tell from that moment that good things lie ahead.

This is a medium roast coffee and that makes it suitable for most tastes. I like dark coffee on occasion, but I prefer the medium roast overall. The flavor of this coffee is certainly roasty, but not overwhelmingly so, and it does contain chocolate notes, making it almost dessert- like in its flavor. It is sweeter than the average brew, so no need to worry about excessive bitterness. And there is no burnt flavor, which is another plus. It’s smooth and sweet, which is a combination most anyone will like.

Some may be wary of the cost of this coffee, but don’t forget that this price is for a 2.25 pound bag. That makes it a full 36 ounces which is about triple the size of bags of gourmet coffee you commonly find in stores. When you compare the price ounce for ounce, the cost here is very economical, especially for the quality you get.

I will drink coffee until I drop and since it has become a regular part of my lifestyle, I insist on drinking only quality brew. Boyer’s Aspen Gold is easily a quality coffee and when you consider the price per ounce, it is a real bargain and one I certainly recommend.

title: Good for a Quick Indian Meal
text:
I love Indian food. I have several places in my area that I frequently turn to for take- out orders when Indian food is my family’s desire. But preparing our own Indian food is also enjoyable, especially when I can find a way to make the food without much effort. A good way to achieve Indian food without much work is Alcoeats Indian Simmer Sauce Spice Mix.

I have tried three of these powdered spices: Butter Chicken, Sauteed Veggies, and Royal Paneer. Each one is good for adding the necessary spice to make a meal taste like authentic Indian food. The mixes are good from a nutritional standpoint, with my only concern being the sodium content.

Of the three I have tried, I like Royal Paneer the best because it seems to pack the most flavor. The other two, not so much. In fact, I found both of the other two a little too mild. We immediately started to turn to other spices and add- ons, to improve the overall flavor.

Still, Alcoeats Indian Simmer Sauce Spice Mix is a good choice when you want a quick Indian meal. It doesn’t take long at all to prepare the sauce and it does make an ordinary meat or veggie dish taste better. The flavor isn’t as intense as I would like, but Alcoeats is still a good starting point when you want homemade Indian food in minimal time.

title: Natural Flavor and Good Nutrition
text:
If you’re going to snack, it makes sense to keep the snack tasty and the nutrition at an acceptable level. Many quick snacks rank highly in the taste category, but low in the nutritional category, or vice versa. A snack that has both sides covered is Kind Peanut Butter and Dark Chocolate.

Rectangular in shape, these bars are small enough to make for a satisfying, quick snack. The texture of these bars is just slightly crunchy. They have a very natural taste, and it is easy to tell they are made using whole grains, as you can taste them in every bite. The dark chocolate flavor is certainly present, and the taste of peanut butter, while there, is subtler than expected.

Nutritionally, these bars are good. They have a few grams of protein and fiber per bar and there is very little added sugar or sodium. There are no red flags that I can see, from a nutritional standpoint. And the calories are reasonable for a snack of this type. On top of that, I like the individual packaging because I can easily grab one or two and take them with me on a walk, in my lunch, etc.

I like when I can find a snack that delivers in both taste and nutrition. Kind Peanut Butter and Dark Chocolate is one such snack. The natural flavor, the whole grains, and other positive qualities make this a good choice for a between meal fix.

title: Good for Your Health
text:
With beverages, I try to avoid the low- nutrition, high sugar options and go for something healthier, and this is even truer when I select something to drink for lunch. It’s an added plus if said beverage is low in calories, and that is why I feel like someone special whenever I drink V8 Low Sodium.

A definite notch above than tomato juice, V8 Low Sodium is a drink made with a blend of eight different vegetables, plus a few additives like citric acid, salt, etc for added flavor. You get a solid dose of vitamin A and vitamin c with every serving. And even though there is a full 11.5 ounces in each can, the calories are still low- quite a bit lower than, say, the same size serving of fruit juice.

I like V8 Low Sodium better than original V8 and the reason is, of course, the reduced sodium. The original is a little too salty for my taste and I certainly don’t need that added sodium in my daily diet. The level of sodium you get with this low sodium version is still enough to add flavor while still low enough that you don’t need to worry.

V8 Low Sodium is healthy and earthy tasting. It goes well with most any lunch time meal, from a cold cut sandwich to a BLT to a frozen pasta meal. Best of all it’s good for you and you feel good when you consume this in place of a sugary drink. I will keep drinking V8 Low Sodium indefinitely and I can’t imagine lunch without it!

title: Adequate for a Quick Lunch
text:
I like trying a variety of different things for my daily lunch. I prefer to go for convenience and more often than not, I bring food with me and eat at my desk. My love of Indian food was enough to convince me to give Saffron Road Chicken Biryani a try.

I prep my frozen meals in the microwave and consume them in full immediately. With this meal, I found it was adequate for a quick lunch, but it lacks in many ways. The spice is only slight. I was expecting to taste more from the caramelized onions. The Basmati rice forms the bulk of what you get and it’s not bad, but you need more than rice to make a good Indian meal.

Possibly the most disappointing aspect of this food is the dryness. It begs to have more sauce added and if I had a bottle of something handy, I would immediately add it. There is some sauce mixed into the meal, but not nearly enough.

Nutritionally, I like that the calories are reasonable, and you do get a nice amount of protein. The sodium isn’t too bad, especially when compared to other frozen meals. These are certainly good points, but the overall flavor and the lack of sufficient sauce convinces me to rate this frozen meal average overall.

title: Agreeable Taste and Organic, too
text:
I try to keep snacking to a minimum and when I do snack, I try my best to go for foods that are healthier than most. And a snack that does measure up well in terms of natural qualities is this Peeled Snacks Organic Apple Clusters with Cinnamon.

This snack food doesn’t contain the lengthy list of chemical additives like some snacks, and this is easily its strongest selling point. The snack is made with just three ingredients: apples, apple juice concentrate, and cinnamon. Plus, it’s organic certified so it easily earns points for purity.

The texture of this snack is crunchy and puffy, so it is lighter than expected. The taste is about what you would expect, with light cinnamon and apple at the forefront of each bite. The taste isn’t very intense, however, and that fact could make this snack a letdown for some. It’s milder in taste than other snacks, but it still goes well with a packed lunch and it’s good for those times when you’re on the run and need a quick bite.

Nutritional figures for this snack are not too bad. There is a little more sugar than I would prefer but you do get a couple grams of fiber per serving. Just remember to multiply the calories and other nutritional data by four if you consume the full package, since there are four servings per package. If you’re a habitual snacker, you won’t have much trouble downing the full contents.

Snacks are best when they at least try to be heathy. Peeled Snacks Organic Apple Clusters Cinnamon is a good snack overall. It may not be the greatest tasting snack you have ever tried, but the organic factor, small list of ingredients, and fiber make this snack deserving of an occasional place in your lunch box.

title: Switch to Whole Grain for Better Health
text:
Eating healthier is an important goal for many and often, you can move yourself and your family in a healthier direction with a few simple changes. An easy switch is to eliminate regular pasta and switch to whole grain, like Barilla Whole Grain Pasta- Thin Spaghetti.

With this pasta, you get a product with a grainier flavor compared to regular pasta. Yes, it does have a wheat flavor, like it should, so it is certainly more earthy- tasting than ordinary pasta. If you haven’t tasted whole grain pasta before, it could take some getting used to. But once you have tried it a few times, you are not likely to switch back.

Since this is whole grain, it contains a good deal of plant protein and fiber. These are, after all, two of the key reasons to switch over to whole grain pasta and these health benefits make it worthwhile. Fiber is lacking in most peoples’ diets so it’s good to have these extra grams. The sugar and sodium content are low, too, which is another plus.

Barilla is a well- known, quality name in pasta and this spaghetti is certainly a quality food. It’s an easy way to eat healthier and it’s a change that everyone needs to make right now.
