And with this convenient 4- pack, you will have all the pasta you need for many meals at a more than fair price.

title: Tangy Snack with Good Nutrition
text:
It’s really interesting some of the snacks that manufacturers are making lately. They keep looking for new ways to interest the consumer and a snack that is certainly different, and in a good way, is this Freeze Dried Superfood Snack made by Upland.

Sold in a package of six, easy to reseal pouches, these snacks feature 2 bags each of three flavors. There is Strawberry-Beet, Mango-Pineapple, and Blackberry-Cherry. Each snack is plant based with a good amount of fiber and protein and minimal sugar.

What stands out with these snacks is the intense amount of flavor packed into every cube. You can taste the tangy fruit immediately, almost like it’s liquid puree. The snacks are dry, of course, but there is a good deal of taste and as you can see from the pictures, the ingredients include more than fruit. They are loaded with seeds of varying types, quinoa, and more.

Among the three flavors, I like the Blackberry- Cherry best and it’s because of the added dark chocolate. It’s like eating a dessert but without the calories and associated guilt. All three flavors are good in their own way. They are light and exactly the way you would expect a freeze- dried snack to be. I wish there was a little less powder in the bottom of each bag, but I suppose that it inevitable with a snack like this.

Healthy snacks are more readily available than in the past. These freeze dried snacks from Upland are a healthy alternative to most snacks and they make a good addition to any lunch or as a between meal treat.

title: Healthy and Organic Snack Food
text:
I don’t often snack, but when I do, I prefer something that has at least some nutritional value. I always include some type of snack food with my lunch at work and my desire for a good, healthy snack led me to try these Tosi Organic SuperPops Puffed Crunchy Snacks, from the Peaceful Squirrel Store.

You get four flavors with this snack pack. The individual pieces are square shaped, crunchy, and very earthy in flavor. I liked the sweet salty flavor most, but they were all good. And while there are technically two servings per package, I consumed the full contents each time. I liked them enough that I kept on snacking.

These snacks are healthier than most. I like that the nutrition is consistent from one flavor to the next. Eight grams of plant protein per serving is standard and there is almost no difference in calories. They are vegan; nut free and gluten free. The ingredients include wholesome items like grains, quinoa, seeds, sea salt, etc. You get lots of benefits with this type of snack- benefits that go well beyond just the vitamins and minerals.

I love a healthy and tasty snack. This Tosi Organic Puffed Crunchy Snack is an excellent one overall. The price is a bit steep, but you get a good amount of nutrition for the money and that, combined with the pleasant, earthy flavor makes this a good option for snack lovers of all ages.

title: Organic and Pure
text:
I drink a little more coffee than I should and I am always seeking out new brands to try. I mostly drink medium roast and for that reason, I decided to give Solspring Biodynamic Organic Brazillian Medium Roast Coffee a try.

The coffee is organic certified, which is a plus. The beans look good and the aroma when opening the bag is fresh and enticing. The medium roast results in the color and body I expect for this type of coffee.

With the flavor, it’s a little lighter than expected, but not too light. The roast level is about right and there is a certain nuttiness in the flavor, too, which is good. There are no other obvious flavor that I can detect. It tastes like coffee and nothing more, so it’s good when that is the taste you seek. I like to drink mine black without food, but this would match well with a morning breakfast or nutty snack.

I like to seek out new coffee experiences and Solspring Biodynamic Organic Brazillian Medium Roast is a tasty coffee overall. It’s natural and organic, with authentic roasted taste, perfect for the coffee purists among us.

title: Great Taste and Nutrition
text:
I love a sweet treat as much as the next person. I also love a sweet treat that I can keep in control; that is, control my portions so that the calories and sugar are kept in check. All these requirements are satisfied with Piccola Cucina Regali Assorted Italian Almond Macaroon Cookies.

With these four packs, you get a resealable container with a separate pouch for Almond, Lemon Lavender, Pistachio, and Maple Walnut flavor. The macaroons are small, and I like that each one, regardless of which flavor you choose, has similar nutritional levels, identical calories, and almost the same level of sugar.

I like all four of these flavors, but the almond is my favorite. Best of all, I can keep my calories and sugar in control by eating only two or three at a time. What is unusual is that just a few of these cookies, just two or three, is enough to satisfy. With other cookies, I often can’t control myself and just keep on eating. But I find that a few of these is all it takes to satisfy my sweet tooth.

Sweet foods are great. They are even better when they contain a decent level of nutrition and keep calories in check. These macaroons from Piccola Cucina Regali accomplish exactly that, with a respectable level of protein and vitamins per cookie, along with great taste.

title: Life is Like a Box of Chocolates
text:
I love chocolate as much or more than the next person. I love it in most any form, but small, bite size chocolates are my favorite because they encourage smaller portions and make it a little easier to know when to stop. Therefore I was more than happy to get my hands on a box of chocolate truffles from Sweet Choice Gift Baskets.

This square box contains 29 pieces of assorted chocolates, some of them individually wrapped. The chocolates include dark and milk chocolate and they all have a sweet, satisfying taste.

One thing I noticed is that the chocolates in this box tend to stick with chocolate. Most of them are chocolate filled, which makes them great for the chocolate fiends among us. One of my kids was hoping to find one with cherry or similar filling, but there were none. The closest she could find is the wrapped, raspberry chocolates.

This box of chocolates from Sweet Choice Gift Baskets is a good one overall. You don’t get a huge variety of chocolates here, but for someone who is in love with the taste of sweet chocolate, you really can’t go wrong presenting them with this box, as a gift or otherwise.

title: Acceptable if You Prefer Milder Taste
text:
Most people drink their coffee from Kcups. I, too, usually reach for the Kcups when I’m in the office because they are convenient and everyone can drink what they like. But at home, I use a coffee grinder so I was anxious to try whole bean Twin Peaks Coffee Columbian Decaf.

Free from caffeine, this whole- bean coffee is non- GMO verified and all natural. I don’t mind the elimination of caffeine because, well, it’s a good idea to cut caffeine consumption whenever possible and I already consume a good deal of caffeine in my daytime coffee and tea drinking routine.

These are good qualities, but what matters most is the flavor. And in that regard, well, Twin Peaks isn’t among the richer decaf coffees I have tried. It holds promise at first. The beans look good and the aroma is pleasant. But when you taste it, you notice right away that it is lacking in overall flavor and complexity. There is no bitter edge, which is good, but the flavor is so- so at best.

It's good to go decaf every so often. Twin peaks Coffee Columbian Decaf is an acceptable coffee, but not among the best I have tried. Buy it only if you prefer a milder flavor.

title: High Nutrition Won Me Over
text:
I try to avoid snacking. But everyone needs the occasional means to control hunger and I often take a small snack along with me to work, as part of my lunch. I strive to eat snacks with at least some redeeming qualities and Outstanding Puffs has several.

First, let’s talk about the snack itself. The individual pieces are light and airy, like a cheese puff. They have a small amount of spice to add flavor, but the taste isn’t as rich as the flavor of other, similar snacks. The lightness though is good because it means that Outstanding Puffs don’t fill you up as quickly as other snacks. Some might even be able to finish a full bag for that reason, which has 400 calories.

The best reason to consume Outstanding Puffs is the nutrition! They are gluten- free and vegan, which is nice, but the most impressive statistic is the vitamins, minerals, and protein. Most snacks contain little to no added nutrition, but this snack overflows with nutrients, even things you would never expect in a snack food, like calcium and Vitamin C.

One thing that could stand to be improved with Outstanding Puffs is the opening and resealing of the bag. You cannot pull the sides apart, but there is a notch in the top for tearing. You have to be careful or else you will tear the entire side, like I did in my included picture, which will make it difficult to reseal. One improvement would be to design the bag to tear horizontally so that you can more easily fold the top. Or, better yet, change to a ziploc- style seal.

Among the different flavors, I like the Chill Ranch and White Chedda best. The others aren’t bad either, but these two are my faves. Like I said, the flavor isn’t as intense as with other snack foods, but when I weigh in the impressive nutrition facts, there are enough positive qualities overall to earn Outstanding Puffs four stars out of five.

title: Let it Shine!
text:
Keeping hydrated matters. Plain water is boring, but there are lots of flavorful alternatives to keep our bodies full of liquid and a newer option that I have tried and like is ShineWater, Mixed Berry Acai flavor.

ShineWater is so named because of the dose of Vitamin D it provides. But there is much more than Vitamn D- you also get more than a day’s RDA of Vitamin B12, plus a good dose of magnesium, zinc, and potassium. There is no added food coloring, no processed sugar, and almost no calories. From a nutrition standpoint, this drink earns top marks.

With the flavor, the berry taste is more pronounced than expected. With other fruit- flavored waters, the fruitiness is generally subtle. But with ShineWater, you get a fuller dose of berry, and that makes it more flavorful than the typical fruit- flavored water.

Each bottle of ShineWater is 500ml, so there is a good deal of water to be consumed- more than you would need for a typical beverage with a meal. Extra is good, in this instance, because it’s water, which is something we tend to not get enough of anyway. And since the taste is better than most other flavored waters, you won’t mind drinking a little more.

Water is important and so is nutrition. Whether you feel you lack adequate sunshine to produce the Vitamin D your body requires or not, ShineWater Mixed berry Acai is an excellent way to get the water you need. It’s extremely thirst quenching, tastes great, and is loaded with important vitamins and minerals. It’s an easy winner in my book!

title: Healthy Addition to my Beverage Routine
text:
Deciding what to drink can be daunting. There are so many beverage options, and it can take time to decide what flavor you want, what taste matches the food/occasion, etc. But if you’re going for something healthy, the choices are far more limited and one good option is V8 Low Sodium.

V8 achieves its signature flavor by blending assorted vegetables. Tomato is the most obvious flavor, but you can tell that what you are drinking isn’t just tomatoes. The other veggies are what make V8 better tasting than straight tomato juice. There is a slight spiciness and light amount of salt. This is one of the chief reasons people choose this V8 alternative- it is far lower in sodium.

Healthy drinking is the main reason to love V8 Low Sodium. Each full, 11.5 ounce can provides 2 servings of vegetables and a healthy dose of Vitamin A, Vitamin C, and potassium. All of this, and only 60 total calories plus a few grams of fiber and no added sugar. From a health perspective, V8 Low Sodium is tough to beat.

I try to drink an assortment of beverages. With my daily lunches, I prefer something healthy and that is exactly what I get with V8 Low Sodium. Good nutrition, low calories, and minimal sodium make this a beverage for those who want to improve their health and well being.

title: Natural with Only a Few Ingredients
text:
I eat cereal regularly and I have since I was a kid. I like almost any cereal and I’m generally not picky about brands, flavor, etc. I like to consume healthier options and that desire led me to try this Puffed Quinoa Cereal from Wholefort.

First, let’s talk packaging. It is different from other cereal. It comes in a pouch that you can reseal. This is better than traditional boxed cereals that require you to fold the inner packaging, to make it airtight. I feel better with this type of packaging because the built- in seal is more secure.

There are only three ingredients in this cereal, which is a definite plus. But it also means there is less overall nutrition with this cereal compared to other, fortified cereals. There is a good deal of protein, however, so it does have its advantages. And with added milk, you still get a good deal of nutrition overall.

So, most importantly, what about the taste? Well, this cereal is natural in flavor but I must admit it lacks the tasty appeal of most other cereals. And I don’t mean just the sugary- sweet cereals or chocolatey cereals or other enhanced flavors. Even the other, natural cereals I consume have a better overall taste that this one.

It’s great to eat healthier foods. I love cereal and Puffed Quinoa cereal is a decent option overall. I like the packaging and small ingredient list, but taste- wise, I like other natural cereals better.

title: Keeps Snacking Healthy
text:
I love to snack as much as anyone and so do my kids. We are fully aware of the limited nutritional value and high sugar and sodium of most snack foods, so we try to keep these measurements to a minimum while seeking out healthier options. And a good variety pack for the more health conscious crowd is the Healthy Student Survival Snack Box from the Peaceful Squirrel Store.

Packaged in a bright orange box, this snack pack comes complete with 15 different snacks and a reusable orange bag. The snacks include such options as apple chips, coconut chips, veggie and fruit strips, fruity gummie bears, and others. The snacks try their best to keep the calories, sugar, and sodium in check and they succeed almost every time.

These snacks are not only healthier, they are also unique and part of the fun is trying snacks that you have likely never had before. Some are even a little intimidating because they are so different. Barbecue Plant Crisps is one example. With a name like that, you really don’t know what to expect. But once you try this and other snacks, you are likely going to be pleasantly surprised at the flavor, much like I was.

The orange bag that comes with this pack is cool because it can be used to haul the snacks around, but also for other things once you are done snacking. This box might be a little pricey, but the contents are good and it makes a great care package idea or gift idea for anyone who likes to consume healthier snacks.

title: Good Nutrition and Organic, too!
text:
Prepared meals are not to everyone’s liking. I purchase them mostly for convenience’s sake, especially for my lunches at work, because they are so quick to make. I’m always looking for alternative to my usual frozen meals and that is what led me to try Food Earth Organic Indian Meals.

I received a package of 6 different meals. These meals are shelf stable, so that means you don’t need to clear a place in your refrigerator or freezer. You can store them in the pantry. When you’re ready to eat, you just peel off the plastic covering and pop in the microwave for about a minute and a half.

I was skeptical about how these meals would taste but I have found them quite good! They are certified organic, which is always a plus. And the curry isn’t overly spicy, which is another plus. My favorite is the Chickpeas Curry with Steamed Rice, but others are good, too. With some of the meals, the rice is kept separate from the sauce, in its own compartment. You them need to mix them together before you eat. This is a good idea, because the separate containers keep the rice in its most edible condition.

Another reason to like these meals is that the sodium is kept in check. As many people know, the sodium content in a frozen meal can easily exceed an entire day’s recommended allowance, in a single meal. The sodium content here is more reasonable. The overall nutrition is good and there is no added sugar.

It’s great to try new foods and even though prepared meals cannot match freshly prepared meals, there are certainly some prepared meals that are better than others. Food Earth Organic Indian Meals are better than most, organic certified, and easy to store and serve. They have proven a good addition to my daily lunch routine- an addition I plan to continue.

title: Healthy Snacking and Lots of Variety
text:
Snacking should be kept to a minimum. It shouldn’t become too frequent and it certainly helps with the snacks one chooses are healthier than average. Nowadays, there are many healthy snack choices and a quick means to get a large sampling of healthy snacks is with the Peaceful Squirrel Variety Snack box.

Opening this package reveals 15 different snacks and a tote bag to carry them in, which can be used later for other purposes. The snacks range from such diverse options as seaweed, cookies, chickpea snacks, and much more.

What makes these snacks better than most is that they are made with healthfulness in mind. Several of them offer multiple grams of plant- based protein per serving and most all of them are low in sodium. Some of them are certified organic, too.

I like the snacks I have tried so far in this pack. I think my personal favorites are the Hippeas snack and the Beanfields Nacho bean chips. These are quite satisfying when served as part of a healthy lunch and the added benefits, like the extra fiber and protein in the bean chips, mean I can enjoy my snack and feel good about what I am eating.

If you’re going to snack, you should always try to eat healthy and should try to limit what you consume. With the Peaceful Squirrel Variety Snack Pack, you get a nice assortment of 15 healthy snacks bound to put a smile on your face and make you feel good about what you’re eating, all while satisfying your urge for a quick between- meal fix. If you like variety in what you eat, like I do, then this is an excellent snacking option. It's a little pricey, but the healthfulness makes you overlook the cost.

title: Everything You Want in a Drink, and Everything You Don't
text:
Refreshment comes in many forms. A bubbly soft drink is often great for quenching thirst and making you feel satisfied, but ordinary soft drinks are loaded with calories and sugar while diet soft drinks often contain questionable ingredients. An excellent alternative is Polar Seltzer Cranberry Lime.

A quick glance at the ingredients shows that this drink is designed for those who want to keep calories, sodium, sugar, and other undesirable ingredients in check. There are, in fact, zero of all these, and zero carbs, too. Thus, you can drink this beverage as much as you like and feel one hundred percent confident that nothing bad will enter your body.

With the flavor, Polar Seltzer Cranberry Lime scores high marks. I’m not a huge advocate for the taste of cranberry, but it tastes quite nice when it’s paired with lime. The citrus compliments the berry and the fruity combo makes it a more flavorful drink than others. And the bubbly character is just right for adding a little pizazz, which is often missing from flat, flavored waters.

Cool refreshment makes everything better and Polar Seltzer Cranberry Lime is a refreshing and tasty beverage. Not only does it taste great, but there are no calories, no carbs, no sodium, no sugar, and most importantly….no guilt! It’s a beverage that has it all and a drink I am certain to enjoy over and over again.

title: Light Roast in a Convenient Coffee Bag
text:
Convenience makes life better and when it comes to coffee consumption, brewing coffee is more convenient today than ever before thanks to the creation of coffee pods. But these pods have a drawback: They are not environmentally friendly. Does a good alternative exist? The answer is yes, and that product is Steeped Coffee, a new way of brewing coffee one cup at a time.

I just got to know this new way of making coffee and I selected a box of Steeped Coffee Sunrise Blend to get acquainted. The packaging is like that of tea bags, except larger in size. I like the small notch at the top of each because it makes it easy to open the package. Once you have the coffee bag ready, you place it in a cup and pour hot water over the bag. After a few minutes of steeping the coffee is ready to drink.

Steeped Coffee isn’t as quick as using coffee pods, but it only takes a little more time. The manufacturer recommends dunking the bag for 15 second and then steeping for about 5 minutes, for best results. You need to be careful with the dunking step because, with the large size of the bag, you could easily slosh the liquid out of the cup, onto your counter. I try to use a large cup to alleviate the problem.

With the taste, the Sunrise Blend is a light roast and it easy matches or surpasses the flavor of coffee brewed using pods. At first, I was concerned that the coffee might taste like instant coffee, but it doesn’t. It has a nice, roasted flavor that doesn’t overwhelm but is certainly one of quality. And you don’t need to feel any guilt with the packaging because it is made from renewable and compostable materials. You don’t need any special machine to make it, either. All you need is a cup and a hot water source.

I love a good cup of coffee and I love the way coffee has exploded in popularity in recent years, getting more convenient to make while improving in quality and taste. Steeped Coffee is a great alternative to pods and with its environmentally friendly packaging, it could easily catch on with the coffee drinking crowd. It’s a little pricey per bag, but this is still a very good product and one I recommend.

title: Flavorful Means to Healthy Snacking
text:
Healthy snacking wasn’t something many people considered in the recent past. Snacks were associated with unhealthy eating, but now, there is a cornucopia of healthy options just waiting to be discovered. One healthy- focused company whose products I have tried and love is Flax4Life and one of their many tasty snacks is Flax4Life Wild Blueberry Muffins.

Like the other Flax4Life snacks, this one is high in fiber, high in protein, and high in Omega 3. One muffin provides a large dose of each. Among the healthy snacks I have tried and enjoy, these rank among the very best in terms of these three important nutrients.

Also like other Flax4Life products, these Blueberry muffins are rich and tasty. This company doesn’t skimp on flavor, like other health food companies are prone to do. The taste reminds me of bran muffins with added fruit. A single muffin provides a good deal of food energy and while these muffins are not low in carbs and calories, they provide outstanding nutritional benefits, making the calories well spent.

I love my healthy snack foods and I enjoy Flax4Life Wild Blueberry Muffins as much or more than other snacks. I would prefer a little more blueberry flavor, but these are still a tasty and most memorable snack food with much to offer.

title: Delicious, Healthy Snack
text:
I try my best to eat healthy snacks. However, a large percentage of healthy foods are rather bland and unexciting to eat and I don’t look forward to what should be a small but satisfying indulgence. There is a company that caters to healthy and promises delicious flavor and that is Flax4Life. One of its many memorable snacks is Flax4Life Muffins Carrot Raisin.

With the added flax and other ingredients, these muffins are already better than the typical snack and a quick check of the nutritional facts confirms this. You get 10 grams of fiber per serving, which is more than what you would get in a typical serving of bran cereal. They are also packed with omega3 and other good things, not to mention a large dose of protein. Nutritionally, these muffins have already won me over before I even took my first bite.

I stated before that healthy snacks are often bland and forgettable, but nothing could be further from the truth with Flax4Life Carrot Raisin Muffins! These muffins are rich in flavor, with lots of grainy goodness and just a touch of carrot. They are not overpowering with the carrot flavor, like a piece of carrot cake is known to be. They instead keep the carrot flavor in check, while the overall taste is rich and indulgent.

Flax4Life Carrot Raisin are not low in calories, so if you’re counting calories or carbs for that matter, you will need to make sure to limit your intake. But if you crave a rich tasting snack with above average nutrition, Flax4Life Muffins Carrot Raisin are the answer to your prayers. They have everything I want in a snack, and so much more!

title: Ditch the Grains and Gluten
text:
I love granola, but I am aware that traditional granola is high in carbs and while I am not on a low- carb diet, I already get more than enough carbs from other sources and thus try to limit any additional carb consumption. Fortunately, there are plenty of low carb snacks and one or my favorites is Paleonola Grain Free Granola Original.

I have tried several Paleonola snacks and have enjoyed them all. This one, the Original, is made using pecans, walnuts, flax, sunflower seeds, coconut, pepitas, and cranberries. It is mildly sweet and crunchy with flavors like vanilla and honey helping add to the overall taste and enjoyment.

This is the type of snack that is great when consumed straight from the package. The plastic pouch has an easy seal at the top and it stands upright. It’s very easy to grab the pouch, open, and pour some into your hands for a mouthful of nutty goodness. I was eating it that way at first, but I have found that the way I like this product best is served with yogurt. It really adds to the flavor and with the nutrition present in yogurt, you have a better-balanced snack with lots of vitamins and minerals.

I like to snack on occasion and Paleonola Grain Free Granola Original is one of the better snacks I have tried. It’s great for consumption by itself, in a bowl with milk, mixed with yogurt, and consumed many other ways. The combination of ingredients makes it just as good or better than traditional granola and with the absence of grains, the carbs are kept to minimum. It’s another tasty snack from Paleonola.

title: Excellent Taste and Keto Friendly
text:
If you’re a salad eater like me, then you know that salad has to have at least some amount of added dressing to make it more flavorful and more easily edible. Dressings, however, can be quite high in calories, sugar, and fat but there are exceptions and one of them is Lemonette Sugar free, Low Cal, Low Fat Salad Dressing.

From the start, this brand of salad dressings has immediate appeal. The low calories and the fact that it is keto- friendly already have me convinced to open the bottle and give it a pour. I know that most salad dressings pack on the calories so it is nice to know that Lemonette is different in this regard.

As for the taste, I love what I have experienced. I like the Mediterranean Herb the most of all. With its herbal and minty flavor, it is like no other salad dressing I have tried before. The minty component took me by surprise, but in a good way. I wasn’t expecting it at all, but I love the flavor and love how it helped turn an otherwise ordinary, boring salad into something special.

The trio pack is an excellent way to discover this salad dressing for yourself and choose the flavor you enjoy best. These dressings are all keto- friendly and have far fewer calories than I expected. There are lots of low-calorie salad dressings, but most of them have little flavor. Lemonette blows the competition away with its great taste.

I will continue to enjoy the occasional salad and now that I have discovered Lemonette, I can enjoy them even more than before and not feel guilty. They really pack the flavor and thus contain all the things you want in a salad dressing minus the things you don’t want. Give this salad dressing a try and see for yourself.

title: Tasty Granola Alternative
text:
Snacking should be kept to a minimum, but I think we all agree that the occasional snack is fine, and often necessary. And since we know we are going to snack, it makes sense to at least keep the snacks healthy and a good option is Paleonola Pina Colada.

Referred to as granola, this snack, like the others in the Palenola lineup, isn’t really granola in the usual sense because it isn’t made without grains. It’s really an assortment of nuts, fruits, and seeds and a quick scan of the ingredients shows that it is made with almonds, pepitas, pecans, coconut, flax, sunflower seeds, and dried fruit. It’s a granola alternative, and some would argue that it tastes better than the typical granola snack.

Because there are no grains in this snack, it is naturally gluten free and relatively low in carbs. This makes it a possible snack option for those on keto and other carb- restrictive diets. It also has a decent dose of protein, iron, and a few other nutrients.

With the taste, this snack food is quite addictive, much like the other Paleonola snacks. However, even though it is named Pina Colada, the only flavor you will notice that reminds you of the popular cocktail is the flavor of coconut. You aren’t going to taste pineapple and, other than the name, the flavor doesn’t make me think of a pina colada. It’s nutty, slightly sweet, and great to eat by the handful, but to say it tastes like a pina colada is pushing it.

Still, for a snack food, Paleonola Pina Colada is more than acceptable to my palate. I love mixed nuts and the added coconut, seeds, dried fruit, etc make for a delightful snack. I like some of the other flavors better, but this is still a worthwhile snack food from Paleonola and one worth trying.

title: Good Medium Roast Coffee and Love the Seal
text:
I go through quite a bit of coffee in my house. I used to use the single- serve pods, but now that I have a coffee bean grinder, I don’t think I will ever go back. I need whole bean coffee for my needs and that was enough to convince me to get Ethical Bean Fair Trade Organic Coffee Medium Dark Roast Whole Bean.

First, let’s talk about the facts. This coffee is organic certified and is fair trade certified, hence the word ethical, as part of the name. You can even scan the code on the package and follow your bag of coffee beans, from the moment it was grown to its place in your kitchen.

As for the taste, this is a good, quality coffee with a roasted flavor and hint of smoke. I don’t add anything to my coffee. I drink it black and thus I can judge it directly and taste all the subtle and sometimes not so subtle nuances in flavor. The coffee is medium in intensity and it measures up to most others I have consumed. I like the creamy head this coffee produces when I grind it and brew it by the cup. It helps smooth out any rough edges and it looks cool.

There is another thing I like about this coffee that deserves mention, and that is the bag. With most coffee bean bags, you pull the top open, empty out the beans you need, they fold it back shut. What they have here is much better- there is a pull tab you use to open it, and it has a ziploc- style seal. This is much better because this type of seal is much more secure and helps keep the coffee fresh. Also, it makes it less likely to spill beans because there is less chance they will pop out and spill everywhere when you pull the sides, which is a common occurrence with other coffee bags. It also means, however, that the opening is smaller so it takes more time to empty out a large amount of beans. Still, overall, I like this method better.

I like organic certification on my food and beverage and I like things that are fair trade. I also like beverages that taste good and Ethical Bean Fair Trade Organic Coffee Medium Dark Roast Whole Bean meets all these conditions. It’s not a robust flavor, no. But it is good for those times when I want a cup of coffee that is less harsh and more easy drinking than others.

title: Light on the Maple, but Still Tasty
text:
Snack foods are a necessity from time to time. You need something to calm the growling stomach and it makes sense to try to find a snack that has at least some nutritional value. A good option for those who want a better snack food is Paleonola Maple Pancake flavor.

This snack, like the other Paleonola snacks, is grain free and is comprised mostly of nuts and seeds. The ingredient list shows walnuts, almonds, pecans, sunflower seeds, flax seed, pepitas, and raisins. Plus, there is added coconut, honey, vanilla, and yes, maple syrup. The absence of grains makes it gluten free, which is a definite plus for some consumers.

As for the taste, it is just about as good as most of the other Paleonola snack foods. I love the assorted nuts and other ingredients and this is why I have taken such a strong liking to this company’s products. I love traditional granola, too, but it is nice to have a snack that is free from grains. The one small issue I have with this snack is that the maple flavor is lacking. Yes, it is on the list of ingredients but if I didn’t already know there was maple flavor added, I doubt I would have guessed it. Still, rated for what it is, the taste is excellent, especially if you’re someone who likes mixed nuts.

I need snack foods on occasion to tame my between meal hunger. Paleonola Maple Pancake flavor does the trick. It has more nutrition than other snacks and is grain free. A little more maple flavor would make it better, but this is still a tasty snack in its own right.

title: Get Your Chocolate Fix here
text:
I’m an admitted chocolate fiend. I will go out of my way to find something chocolate flavored when the need arises, and I will reach for anything from cereal to candy bars to provide my fix. An excellent way to satisfy my chocolate cravings is Paleonola Grain Free Granola Chocolate Fix.

Packaged in a re- sealable plastic pouch, this snack food is grain free, gluten- free, and non- GMO. It is made with an assortment of nuts such as walnuts, almonds, and pecans plus other ingredients like sunflower seeds, coconut, flax, and dried fruit. It’s like a modified version of traditional granola but it can be used as a substitute for the things you love that normally call for granola as an ingredient. The low carbs and other factors make this food ideal for those on Keto and other restrictive diets.

Oh, there is one other ingredient worth mentioning, and it is what gives the snack its name. I’m referring of course to the chocolate which is achieved by adding cacao. The chocolate isn’t overwhelming, but it is definitely present. It adds tremendously to the delicious flavor of mixed nuts and coconut. It makes this a tasty snack served alone, with milk, or as a topper for yogurt and other foods.

I love chocolate and I love Paleonola Grain free Granola Chocolate Fix. I have tried several different Paleonola snacks and have been more than satisfied with all of them and as a chocolate freak, this one ranks highly on my list. Give it a try and get your chocolate fix by the handful!

title: Cinnamon, Blueberry, and Nuts- What's not to Like!
text:
I admit, I like the occasional snack food. Between meals, I often feel the hunger pangs and need something to get me through. I also try to eat healthier snacks and this desire for a better snack food convinced me to try Paleonola Cinnamon Blueberry.

Like the other Paleonola snacks, this one is labeled as granola, but it is a completely different take on granola. It is grain free, gluten free, and has low sugar with a respectable dose of protein and fiber. The main ingredients are almonds, coconut, and pecans along with dried blueberries, vanilla, and cinnamon. It’s a natural food product, too.

Nutrition- wise, this product is better than most but equally important, it also tastes better than most! I like to eat it plain, straight from the package, by pouring a small amount into a bowl. I also like to add it to my yogurt for added flavor and enjoyment. It could also be consumed like cereal by adding it to a bowl and covering with regular milk or- even better- almond or cashew milk. I love the mixture of nuts, coconut, and spices. I like regular granola, too, but I have to say that I like this product even more. It’s only slightly crunchy and the combination of flavors has me eating it by the handful.

There is nothing wrong with the occasional snack, but it makes sense to make sure your choice of snack is as flavorful and healthy as possible. Paleonola Cinnamon Blueberry is one of the very best snack foods I have tried and I can’t wait to sample even more flavors from this brand.

title: Tasty, Nutty Snack Food
text:
Snacks are often loaded with carbs and that is because a primary ingredient in many of them is oats, wheat, and other grains. This is especially true with granola, but one snack that is granola- like and free from grains is Paleonola Granola Pumpkin Pie.

Formulated as a granola substitute, this snack is nut- based. A quick check of the ingredients reveals almonds, pecans, walnuts, with coconut, honey, cranberries, and other ingredients. There are no grains at all and the product is gluten free. The lack of grains keeps the carb content down and the added nuts means you get several grams of protein in each serving.

As for the taste, this product is nutty, slightly sweet, and addictive! I don’t see pumpkin on the ingredient list, so I assume the flavor was achieved through a combination of added spices. The nutty flavor dominates, but there is also a distinct taste of vanilla and coconut. The addition of coconut and honey adds a small amount of sweetness, which is just right. The pumpkin flavor is rather subtle and lighter than expected.

I love granola and don’t plan to eliminate it from my diet, but I also love nuts and Paleonola Granola Pumpkin Pie is a tasty granola substitute. I have been enjoying mine as a snack, served directly from the re- sealable pouch, but I could also see sprinkling this in yogurt or even on top of certain cereals. I might like it more if it had a stronger flavor of pumpkin, but this is still a tasty snack overall and great for those on gluten- free diets.

title: Dark Chocolate, Low Carbs, High Protein and Fiber = Win!
text:
If you love the occasional snack but want to watch carbs and calories, your choices are limited. Most sweet snacks are high in sugar and have high calorie counts, but with a little research, you can find good alternatives and one of them is Shrewd Keto Dark Chocolate Protein Crisp Dippers.

This light snack takes on the appearance of malted milk balls and there are about a dozen or so small pieces in each package. A quick check of the nutritional stats shows that this snack does have much to offer: Only 2 grams of carbs, 8 grams of protein, 140 calories per package. The snack even has 7 grams of fiber, which is above and beyond what I would expect in this type of food.

With the taste, the best part of the flavor is, like you might have guessed, the dark chocolate. The rest of the snack- the crunchy interior- is rather bland in taste. It is light and reminds me of a cheese puff with the cheese flavor removed. Not much to get excited over, but the dark chocolate makes up for it and this is the taste you remember best.

Snacks keep improving and Shrewd Keto Dark Chocolate Protein Crisp Dippers are a good snack overall. I’ve tasted better, but when you consider the nutritional factors and the keto- friendliness, this is definitely a snack worth eating.

title: Nature Valley Crunchy Peanut Butter Always Satisfies
text:
Among all the snacks available, the one I consume most is granola bars. They taste great and are enough to satisfy hunger while generally keeping calories in check. I have tried most every brand but I the one I return to with the greatest frequency is Nature Valley and one of my most often consumed flavors is Nature Valley Crunchy Granola Bars Peanut Butter.

These granola bars ae packaged with two thin bars per foil wrapper. I like that there are two bars as opposed to a single thicker bar for two reasons. First, you can share one with someone else if all you need is a quick food fix and second, it makes them easier to eat. Some granola bars are thick and the crunchiness can reach the point where it’s a chore to chew them.

I love the pleasant flavor of these peanut butter granola bars. They are mostly oat/grainy in taste with added peanut butter and the peanut flavor isn’t overdone. Look at one side of the bars and you will see a thin peanut butter glaze. This is enough to make the peanut butter flavor obvious, but not so much that it overwhelms the flavor of the grains.

With each pair of bars, you get 16 grams of whole grain, 190 calories, and 2 grams fiber. The only factor that could be an issue for some consumers is the sugar, which is 11g total. I have noticed that, due to the thinness, these bars will sometimes be slightly crumbled or broken up a little when you open the package, but I really don’t mind. If necessary, I just tilt the foil package and pour the contents into my mouth.

I’m not a huge snack person but I will reach for a snack when hunger strikes me, and I always add snacks to my packed lunch for work. Nature Valley Crunchy Granola Bars Peanut Butter are one of my go- to snacks and have been for many years. The taste, the convenience, the low price, and everything else adds up to a highly recommended food product.

title: Superior in Most Every Way
text:
I like when I can find a good, healthy beverage. There are some that sound healthy at first but have several undesirable additives. But one beverage that has everything I want in a healthy drink is Beetology Beet and Veggie.

Looking at the fact sheet, Beetology Beet and Veggie has everything I could ever ask for. It is made using only beet juice, green apple juice, carrot, kale, and celery. There are no preservatives. There is no sodium and it’s USDA Organic certified, along with having several other noteworthy certifications. Based on the label alone and the facts, this drink is tough to beat.

With the taste, let’s just say I love this drink! They have managed to achieve just the right balance between the five ingredients to result in a flavor that is certainly one of veggies and very earthy and plant- like, but with added carrot and apple to provide a sweet, palatable flavor. The calories are relatively low, too, and it tastes great. Other veggie juices are overdone with salty flavors, but there is no such issue here. It tastes natural, like a quality veggie juice should.

Beetology Beet and Veggie is packaged in a heavy glass bottle, so be sure to recycle. I agree that the price is a little high, but based on nutrition, quality, and taste, you really can’t ‘beet’ this beverage!

title: Excellent All- Around Beverage
text:
I like to vary what I drink. I don’t want the same drink every day and I have become a true non- creature of habit when it comes to my lunchtime beverage. I switch things out regularly and one of the best tasting drinks I have tried as of late is Wonder Melon.

First, let’s talk certifications and facts. A quick check shows that Wonder Melon has just about every type of certification you could ever want in a beverage. It is certified organic, vegan, fair trade certified, non- GMO, all natural, and gluten free. It also contains no preservatives, artificial colors, etc. The ingredient list contains only five items: Watermelon juice, cucumber juice, lemon juice, apple juice, and basil. The calories are low, too, with only 80 per bottle.

Okay, so Wonder Melon goes above and beyond from a just-the-facts perspective, but what about the taste? Well, again, Wonder Melon exceeds expectations. The mixture of watermelon, cucumber, lemon, and apple is super- refreshing and great with my lunches or on a hot day. And while it is a mixture of fruit and vegetable juice, it is mostly fruit juice, is pulp free, and is thin in consistency. I also like the dash of basil. You can certainly taste it, but it doesn’t overwhelm with spice. The fruit and cucumber remain at the forefront.

I try to keep my food and drink intake on a natural level and Wonder Melon certainly helps in this regard. It is natural, pure, and great tasting overall and a drink I plan to add to my regular rotation.

title: Hi Protein, Low Carbs
text:
Snacks are something I generally try to limit. But sometimes, especially during the workday, I need a snack to eliminate the hunger pangs. If I’m going to snack, it makes sense to keep things healthy and a good choice for a reasonably healthy snack is EPIC Beef Jalapeno Protein Bars.

These small, rectangular snacks are made mostly from beef with just a few additives. They contain 10 grams of protein per bar and only 3 grams of carbs, making them a good choice for those on the keto diet or other carb- restricted diet.

With the taste, the flavor is beef and spice, as expected. You can taste garlic and jalapeno mostly, but I know from the ingredients list that the snack also contains cilantro and celery powder. I like the taste, but I could do with a little less jalapeno. I’m all for spice, but I think it would have been better if the spice was toned down a little bit, in this instance.

There is one other strike against this snack, and that is the sodium. You get more than 600mg per bar and this can add up quickly if you have more than one. Those on low sodium diets need to consider this before they consume.

Snacks help get me through my day and EPIC Beef Jalapeno Protein Bars are a good, high protein option. They are individually packed for convenience and they have a good flavor, even if a little over spiced.

title: Great With so Many Different Foods
text:
When you live in the land of tex mex food like I do, salsa is a regular part of life and an everyday grocery shopping item. I strive to have at least two or three containers of salsa in the fridge to fit my mood and one I have recently added and like is Herdez Guacamole Salsa Medium.

Creamy and tart, this salsa features the flavor of avocado and only a moderate amount of heat. I am used to salsa tasting hotter/spicier when graded as medium. This salsa is less spicy hot than I expected, but I find it just right for most uses. It’s also a tad on the salty side and it takes only a little to liven up food.

This salsa is tasty on many different food items. I like pouring it on tacos, serving as dip with tortilla chips, etc. It’s even good as a dip for pizza. I have heard others say that it’s a good addition to scrambled eggs. I haven’t tried that yet, but considering that plain scrambled eggs are rather bland, adding this salsa sounds like a good idea.

Salsa comes in many flavors and styles. Herdez Guacamole Salsa Medium is a very good option for those who love guacamole. It’s a great alternative to traditional salsa and it makes a noticeable difference on tex mex and other foods. I plan to keep a jar in the fridge at all times and recommend that you do the same.

title: Low Calories, Low Sugar, Low Carbs, Low Taste
text:
Those who are watching their weight often turn to the keto diet to help reach their goals. These diets have been shown to be quite effective and manufacturers have responded by offering a nice variety of keto- friendly foods and snacks. One that I have tried and found decent is Fat Snax Blondie Bites.

This snack is small and low in calories, with no sugar and minimal carbs. They easily pass the keto test for carb standards and you can eat several of these without feeling guilty. Because they are so small, you likely will want more than one. I try to pack at least two with my lunch, because one is just not enough.

Where these snacks lose some points with me is with the taste. Rich, sugary brownies and cookies are easily tastier than Blondie Bites. If you did a side by side comparison, with one of the better sweet snacks pitted against this one, it would be no contest as to which one tastes better. Then again, these snacks are meant to be different and need to be judged as such.

Avoiding sugar and calories is a good idea for everyone, even if you’re not on a keto diet. Fat Snax Blondie Bites are a good way to avoid the sugar, carbs, and calories and while not as rich and flavorful as other, similar snacks, they are still good enough to recommend and it’s difficult to argue against them when you look at the nutrition label.

title: Dark is Good!
text:
Reeses peanut butter cups are a candy classic. They are one of the few candies that most everyone loves and if you’re like me, you need to limit yourself to only a few at a time, lest you could easily overdo it. Reeses classic cups are sill one of my favorite go- to candies, but I love the variations also and one that I have tried and enjoy to extremes is Dark Reeses Miniature Cups.

Mini in size, these peanut butter cups swap out the usual milk chocolate for dark chocolate. The peanut butter in these cups, as far as I can tell, is the same peanut butter in regular Reeses. They combine with the bittersweet taste of dark chocolate for an incredibly tasty and highly addictive combination.

With this type of packaging, the cups are individually wrapped. I like it this way because it prevents the cups from melting together and it makes it easier to practice portion control. You just grab the number of cups you like, then reseal the bag and store in a safe place, preferably out of sight and reach, once again, so that you don’t overdo it.

I love dark chocolate. I love peanut butter. I love traditional Reeses peanut butter cups and I love Dark Reeses Miniature Cups. The taste combination is out of this world and one that most anyone will enjoy.

title: High Protein and Subdued Banana Flavor
text:
I share a house with two teenage girls that are into athletics and a wife who likes to watch what she eats and keep her carb count low. They are all constantly wanting to eat more protein and the best way to get the protein is through a high protein beverage like Premier Protein 30 gram Protein Shake Bananas and Cream.

With its 30 grams of protein per bottle, these shakes have more protein than most others. This is a good dose of protein and enough that it can easily take the place of a meal. The fat and carbs are low, so they have the nutritional levels that we want.

The flavor of these shakes is banana but the banana taste is rather subdued. This is a good thing, at least to me and my family, because none of us is very fond of the taste of bananas. They taste more like cream than anything else. And calling them a shake is pushing it- they are more like flavored milk.

One fact I like about this drink compared to other protein shakes is the packaging. It has an extra seal, which makes me feel safer. So, when all things are considered, Premier Protein 3-g Protein Shake Bananas and Cream is an easy winner in my book and my family likes it very much.

title: Wonderful Flavor and They Encourage Portion Control
text:
I love chocolate in most any shape, form, or flavor. I know chocolate candies are often high in calories, so I like when I have smaller, individual packages for better portion control. And a chocolate candy that is precisely the way I described is DOVE Milk Chocolate Truffles Gift Tin Tube.

Sold in a pair of tubes, DOVE Milk Chocolate Truffles are made using the silky goodness of Dove milk chocolate. What I like best about the taste is that it’s smooth and flavorful and not excessively chewy. You don’t need to worry about getting lock jaw from excessive chewing. These candies are easy to handle so that you can focus on the flavor above all else.

With the packaging, I like the individual wrapping because I can grab a pair and get my chocolate fix without going to extremes on calories and sugar. I don’t have the strongest willpower when it comes to chocolate candies. Place an open box in front of me and I am likely to eat ten or more pieces. With the individually wrapped Dove pieces, I can stay in control. And the metal tins and bow on the top are nice because they make it look like a gift, perfect for handing to a friend or someone in the office.

I love chocolate and DOVE Milk Chocolate Truffles are one chocolate product I am thrilled to have introduced to my home. My kids love them, too, and again, the portion control that they encourage makes all the difference.

title: Light, Crisp Alternative
text:
Snack foods are something we try to limit in my household, usually for nutritional reasons. But there are some decent options available and one of them is Good Thins Gluten Free Crackers Variety Pack, Simply Salt Rice Crackers and Sea Salt Corn Crackers.

This variety pack serves up two flavors of crackers for different tastes/moods. Each of them is light and crisp, thin, and easily crunchable. The thinness, in fact, reminds me in many ways of a baked potato chip.

With the flavors, I find that I like the corn crackers a little bit more. Upon opening the package, you get the pleasant aroma of corn. The corn aroma is obvious and the taste is pleasant, with a light saltiness. The rice variety is also good in its own way, just a little less flavorful but quite good when paired with dips.

Good Thins Gluten Free Crackers Variety Pack, Simply Salt Rice Crackers and Sea Salt Corn Crackers are free from high fructose corn syrup, artificial colors, etc and since they are baked, the fat content is low and there is no greasy texture. They are a very good snack option overall and one I am glad to have introduced to my household.

title: Good Salsa with Just the Right Amount of Heat
text:
When you serve Mexican and TexMex food dishes as much as we do, one essential food item is salsa. I really like the explosion of salsa brands over the past decade or so because there are so many good choices and so much variety. And one brand that I can add to the list of good- tasting salsa is Amazon’s Happy Belly Traditional Medium Salsa.

Poured from the jar, this salsa is a little runnier than expected, but it still has enough thickness to hold its own when served in different food dishes and maintain a grip on foods when you dip. The first thing I tried with this salsa was a simple serving of tortilla chips for dipping. I noticed that there is just a small amount of spice/heat, so it was about as expected in this area.

The flavor of this salsa is tomato with a small amount of peppers/onion taste, and salt. I found it tasted good matched with my chips and it added a good deal of flavor to a cheese quesadilla. There is nothing really over the top about this salsa, but I think it easily matches or beats most of the store brands. And the large, 24 ounce size means it should last a fair amount of time, just be sure to keep refrigerated after opening.

We buy salsa on a regular basis in my house and Happy belly Traditional Medium Salsa is a good choice for your everyday salsa needs. It’s not among the absolute best salsas I have ever tried, but for its price level, the quality is quite good and it is definitely worth a try.

title: Healthy Mix and Tastes Great
text:
I like to take different snacks with me to work and lately, I have tried to emphasize snacks that are more nutritious, natural, etc and that make it easy for me to practice better portion control. A snack that works well for me is Orchard Valley Harvest Cranberry Almond Cashew Trail Mix.

With my two favorite types of nuts and cranberries, this trail mix is certainly tasty and I like that it doesn’t include m&m or other, sugary additions. These candy pieces taste good, yes, but they also rack up the sugar content and make trail mix less healthy. I also like that this mix is non GMO and contains nothing artificial. This are certainly good qualities and they add to the food’s appeal. Oh, and I like that the sodium content is low. Too often, trail mix contains excessive amounts of salt, which may taste good to some, but really increases the sodium content, often to unhealthy levels.

As I said above, I am striving to practice better portion control when I eat and this snack makes this desire easy thanks to the packaging. Each individual serving contains just 140 calories, which is just right for adding to my lunch each day. I like that I don’t need to pour the trail mix from one large bag into a plastic bag and try to estimate the calories. It’s much more convenient when you can just grab a small bag and add it to your lunch container.

Better eating is my goal now and I like anything that helps me in this pursuit. Orchard Valley Harvest Cranberry Almond Cashew Trail Mix is perfect for my needs and it’s a snack food that needs to be found in every health- conscious person’s pantry.

title: Tasty Coffee and Every Purchase Helps Those in Need
text:
Coffee has really changed over the years and changed for the better. The quality is vastly improved compared to the past and the ethical and social considerations are far greater. A company that is mindful of these important factors and others like them is Happy Day Brands and one of its products I have tried and like is
Happy Day Brands Fair Trade Whole Bean Organic Guatemalan Coffee Beans.

Like most any household, I own a single- cup coffee maker, but I get tired of constantly using and throwing away the pods. This convinced me to add a deluxe coffee maker and grinder and start using whole coffee beans instead. The freshness and flavor you get from whole beans is often better and Happy Day Brands Fair Trade Whole Bean Organic Guatemalan Coffee Beans is a good choice for your coffee bean needs.

This coffee has a roasty taste, medium bodied, with some vanilla notes and a creamy texture. You can see the creaminess if you look at my picture. I don’t know if every coffee bean grinder will produce the same results, but my coffee maker certainly does and the creaminess certainly adds to the experience.

So, the coffee quality is above average but lots of coffee brands make above average quality coffee, so why buy Happy Day Brands? Well, there are many reasons. The coffee is organic and fair trade certified which places it a notch above the competition. But the most satisfying quality of all is Happy Day Brands commitment to the local community. You see, every purchase you make from Happy Day Brands results in the company giving food to those in need. The social responsibility of Happy Day Brands places it in a league of its own and easily moves this coffee brand to the top of the heap.

Coffee is much better than it was in the past. With Happy Day Brands Fair Trade Whole Bean Organic Coffee Beans, you get an above average cup of coffee and you get the added peace of mind of knowing that Happy Day Brands is pursuing something much greater than financial profits. They are also giving food to the needy and when you factor everything, it adds up to a coffee brand that easily earns the highest rating from me.

title: High in Protein and Supports Community
text:
Breakfast isn’t my favorite meal of the day. I’m not a huge fan of breakfast foods overall, but I still try to start off my mornings with food of some sort and while I usually reach for cold cereal, on the weekends, I am more inclined to spend a little more effort prepping food. One item that I have tried and like is Happy Day Protein Pancake and Waffle Mix.

This mix is, like most others, simple to prepare because it only requires water. A quick stir in a bowl is all it takes to get the batter prepped and ready to make the pancakes. And the pancakes are light, fluffy, and high in protein. This latter quality sets this brand apart, as most pancake mixes lack much protein. The other quality that sets Happy Day Brands apart is its commitment to community. They provide food for others every time you make a purchase and this fact alone makes their foods worth trying.

I like that the package this mix comes in is easy to reseal. It is a pouch and all you have to do is pinch the ziploc style seal to close. This is much better than the mixes that come in boxes, many of which you cannot seal completely.

We have experimented a little bit with these pancakes, adding a pinch of cinnamon and other spices to add even more flavor. They are good all by themselves, however, and make a good choice for your morning nourishment.

title: I Love Chocolate and I Love This Candy!
text:
I love sweet treats as much as anyone, but I am picky about my candy. I don’t like fruity candies very much at all and I don’t like candies that are so chewy they get tiring to eat, taking the joy out of the experience. My candies need to be chocolate and easy to eat, so I was more than happy to welcome Cocoa K-Choo Milk Chocolate and Dark Chocolate the Vanilla Vault 2 Flavor Mishmash into my life.

These resealable bags of candies contain two slightly different versions. The ones wrapped in a yellow wrapper have a sugary sweet vanilla filling covered in milk chocolate. The ones in the blue wrapper have a creamy vanilla center coated in dark chocolate. I like the dark chocolate version just a little bit more but in truth, I love both varieties. I usually eat these in pairs and I like to enjoy one of each. The combination of chocolate and vanilla is just right and they offer a much- needed decadent reward at the end of the day.

The candies are soft, not chewy or crunchy, and square in shape. Each pair has 150 calories, which isn’t too bad. But I challenge anyone to eat only two! I usually started off with a pair but almost always went back for a second pair and sometimes a third.

I like that these candies are individually wrapped. This way, they don’t melt together, and you can take only the number you need. They are wonderful to eat and all I can say is, get this bag away from me before I consume the entire contents! Cocoa K-Choo Milk Chocolate and Dark Chocolate the Vanilla Vault 2 Flavor Mishmash are a huge hit with my family, and they come highly recommended by everyone in my home.

title: Krusteaz Comes Through Again
text:
Some food items are almost universally loved and blueberry muffins certainly fit into that category. This is why I gladly accepted the opportunity to get my hands on multiple boxes of Krusteaz Protein Wild Blueberry Muffin Mix.

This blueberry muffin mix is from one of the foremost names in muffins and this was reason enough to give this mix a try. And I wasn’t disappointed with my decision, as Krusteaz delivered the quality as expected. The muffins are easy to mix and make and they include a container of blueberries. All you need to do is mix the batter, fill your muffin pan, bake and cool.

One of the many appeals of this blueberry muffin mix is the nutrition. Yes, there are still a good number of carbs, but everything else exceeds expectations. Each serving contains 12 grams of protein and 3 grams of fiber. There are no artificial flavors, colors, or ingredients. A serving is defined as 2 muffins, so keep that in mind.

With the flavor, these muffins are very tasty and I like that they are not overly sweet. It’s like a semi- sweet yellow cake with added blueberries. About the only way I can think of that the taste could be improved is with even more blueberries. I might consider adding some additional blueberries of my own when I make the next box.

I love blueberry muffins and Krusteaz Protein Wild Blueberry Muffin Mix is certainly a blueberry muffin mix deserving of my affections. It’s another quality product from this maker of muffin mixes and a product that earns an easy recommendation from me.

title: No Sugar or Calories, Acceptable Flavor
text:
A refreshing beverage can go a long way in making a meal better or making a hot day more bearable. Carbonated beverages are usually a little better in terms of refreshment I tend to like drinks more when they are low in calories and sugar. So, I decided a good beverage option for me would be Alta Palla Grapefruit Sparkling Water.

Examining this beverage from a nutritional perspective reveals a long line of zeroes: Zero carbs, zero calories, zero protein, zero sugar, etc. This is all well and good, just keep in mind that, like most any other zero calorie and carb beverage, there is also zero nutrition. However, on the positive side, there is also a very short ingredients list so in this regard, it is better than other zero calorie beverages, many of which are loaded with artificial ingredients.

With the taste, Alta Palla Grapefruit Sparkling Water isn’t too bad. It has citrus flavor and the bubbly carbonation keeps you refreshed as you sip. The flavor isn’t sweet, but it isn’t as unsweet/dry as expected either. It’s a little on the bland side, but still not bad when you consider everything.

I like a good, refreshing beverage that doesn’t add inches to the waistline. Alta Palla Grapefruit Sparkling Water is good for this reason. It isn’t the most incredible tasting drink I have ever tried, but it has enough positive points to make it worth a try.

title: Healthy Alternative to Ordinary Snack Foods
text:
Finding a healthy snack alternative isn’t always easy. Most snack chips are simply not good for health and worse yet, many of them are highly addictive. But alternatives do exist and one excellent choice is Mozaics Organic Popped Veggie & Potato Chips, Sour Cream and Onion.

These chips are made with quality ingredients. I was surprised to discover that the number one ingredient is peas! When was the last time you saw a snack chip that could make a claim like that? With vegetables ranking highly and with a popped and not fried process, you feel good about these chips before you even open the bag.

A quick glance at the nutrition confirms the superiority of Mozaics chips. The calories are lower than that of other snack chips. The fiber and protein are higher that of most snacks and the snack is certified organic. The sugar is low, too. Again, this is a snack and it shouldn’t be a substitute for a square meal, but it’s definitely a better snack than others on the market.

With the flavor, I found it pleasant, with an earthy, vegetal taste. The sour cream and onion are more subdued than expected. I could taste olive oil and some potato. There is a light spice as well and I like the crisp yet light crunch. The chips are light enough that you could eat a good portion of the bag and still keep the calories under control. And while they are tasty, they aren’t as addictive as most potato chips, corn chips, or tortilla chips. Many of these other snacks are far worse from a calorie and nutrition perspective, but are so addictive you could easily eat multiple servings before you know it. This Mozaic snack is very good, but I am more able to keep my snacking in check.

Snacks are nice every now and then but it is important to be choosier than usual when you select a snack food. Most are terrible from a nutrition and calorie standpoint, but Mozaics Organic Popped Veggie & Potato Chips, Sour Cream and Onion are an exception to the rule. I really can’t find anything negative to say about this snack, and so they earn an easy 5 stars from me.

title: Pleasant Herb and Spice Flavor
text:
Tea is my most often consumed beverage. I like to have an assortment of teas available because I prefer variety to repetition when it comes to my drinks. I like the exotic flavors of tea available on the market and this was enough to convince me to get my hands on a package of Elevate Tea Almond Cinnamon Herbal Tea.

This tea is loose- leaf so it won’t work if you’re looking for ready to use tea bags. You have to have a filtering system of some sort to make this tea. Yes, this makes it a little less convenient, but it also helps keep costs and waste under control, since you can use a permanent filter if you have one. It takes very little to make a cup of tea and each package is good for about 27 servings.

One of the first things I noticed is that the pieces are larger than those of most other teas I have tried. The package is see- through on one side, so you can get a good look at the tea before you order it or open the package. Can’t really say if the size of the ingredients matters, but I can say that this tea features a pleasant herbal flavor with spices. There is an almond component to the taste also, but it is more subdued than expected.

I love tea and Elevate Almond Cinnamon Tea is a good change of taste from my usual varieties. The taste is good and there is no caffeine, which makes it perfect for a nightcap. It’s a good product overall.

title: Healthy and Not Overly Addictive
text:
Snacking isn’t something I do much, but I have been known to reach for snack foods to tame my appetite between meals. I try my best to go for the snacks that are at least a little bit healthier than average and one snack that certainly fits this description is Handfulls Crrrunchy Bites Sea Salt Almonds.

Checking the nutritional fact label on this snack reveals that it is easily better than the average snack food. A 3.75 ounce bag has four servings and each serving has only a couple grams of sugar, no cholesterol or trans fat, and 3 grams of protein. The sodium is lower than expected, too, and this was a pleasant surprise considering the salty taste.

Speaking of the flavor, this snack is certainly in a league of its own. I love almonds, but I have never tried an almond snack quite like this one. It’s basically an almond wrapped in a shell that tastes like a mixture of potatoes and rice. This might sound like an odd combination to have with an almond, but somehow they make it work.

Probably the coolest fact about this snack is that, while I certainly enjoy the taste, I don’t experience that must-finish-the-entire-bag feeling that I often experience with other snacks. Many snack foods are so tasty and so addictive, you feel compelled to indulge. But Handfulls Crrrunchy Bites Sea Salt Almonds stimulates your senses at just the right level that you know when to say when.

Snack foods are often loaded with sugar, fat, calories, and sodium but Handfulls Crrrunchy Bites Sea Salt Almonds keep the bad aspects in check, resulting in a snack that is tasty yet not over the top. It’s the type of snack I can enjoy without the guilt feelings and it’s a snack I recommend.

title: Almond Snack Alternative
text:
I try to avoid snacking. It’s often a bad habit to get into, but there are still those times when a snack is necessary and one I have tried and find to my general liking is Handfulls Crrrunch Bites, Ranch Almonds.

Consisting of small almonds wrapped in a shell, this snack food is a little different from others of its type. Yes, you get the nutty taste of almonds but you also get the rice cracker shell along with a slightly spicy seasoning. The seasoning is like that of ranch dressing with added onion and garlic and I admit that I wasn’t so sure I liked this flavor combo at first. However, it did grow on me with each passing handful.

Nutritionally, this snack isn’t too bad. The sugar content is low and the sodium is kept under control. They seem a little saltier than the facts indicate, but that is because of the seasoning. There isn’t as much salt as you think. They are gluten free, too.

Handfulls Crrrunch Bites, Ranch Almonds are crunchy, but not tiring to eat. They are more fun than the typical bag of nuts and offer a good flavor and snack experience overall. I’m still not completely sold on the taste, but another bag should do the trick!

title: Cheese and Caramel Combine for a Tasty Snack
text:
I’m not normally a snack person. Many of them are far too appealing- if I get started, I know it will be tough to stop. But I do take snacks with me to work as part of my midday lunch and one that I have tried and liked is Handfulls Fusions Lakeshore Trail Mix.

This snack is a little different from other trail mixes. It doesn’t have as many ingredients and, in fact, there are only two: Cheesy, puff- like almonds and cashews. The Cheese almonds are a little crunchier than the typical cheese puff, as expected, and the cashews are coated with a salty caramel that adds greatly to their flavor profile.

Cheese might seem like an unusual flavor to pair with almonds and cashews, but in this instance, it works. Part of the reason is that the cheese taste is milder than you might expect. With other cheese snacks, the cheesy flavor is far more intense. They keep it subdued in this mix, and it ends up complementing the salty caramel taste quite well.

I try to avoid snack foods like chips, pretzels, etc because they are often difficult to put down, but Handfulls Fusions Lakeshore Trail Mix is one snack I am glad I took the time to try. The re- sealable pouch is great for those times when you want to practice portion control and even if you do give in and consume the contents of an entire bag, the total calories is still not bad. It adds up to a pleasant, enjoyable experience perfect for those who want a snacking splurge, however small, from time to time.

title: Wholesome and Tasty Start to My Day
text:
Breakfast cereal is, for me, a regular part of life. I consume a bowl of cold cereal about 25 times each month, and I like to have an assortment of brands and flavors from which to choose. Since I have been looking for ways to add fiber to my diet and increase my good cholesterol, I have been on the lookout for cereals that can aid in both areas and this need has convinced me to add Nature’s Path Flax Plus Muiltibran Flakes to my morning routine.

I have always been a fan of Nature’s Path cereals for many reasons. Nutritionally, they are sound, with a good level of vitamins/minerals, whole grains, etc. Plus, Nature’s Path cereals are USDA Certified Organic and Non- GMO. With this specific product, Flax Plus Multibran Flakes, you also get a good dose of fiber and the added benefits of flax, which is known to be good for overall health.

Okay, so the nutrition is positive but what about the taste? Well, I am happy to report that this breakfast cereal has a wholesome, natural taste and isn’t too extreme with the bran. Some bran cereals are like eating twigs off a tree. But Nature’s Path Flax Plus multibrane Flakes are better in overall flavor. You know you’re eating a healthy cereal, but you still get a good- tasting, grainy way to start your day.

About the only thing I wish was different with this cereal is the packaging- the plastic bag containing the cereal takes too much effort to open. You can pull it apart with enough muscle power, but the bag often tears open suddenly, leading to spilled cereal on the counter. Scissors work best in this instance, but I wish the manufacturer would just make the bag a little more user- friendly when it comes to opening.

I will always be a cold cereal fiend and Nature’s Path will continue to be part of my cereal rotation. With its added fiber and other wholesome goodness, Nature’s Path Flax Plus Multibran Flakes will be a regular part of my morning meals. It’s better tasting than other bran cereals and with so many positive qualities, it easily earns a five- star rating from me.

title: Good Nutritional Qualities but Bland Flavor
text:
Parents want their kids to maintain a healthy diet but with sugary foods ranking so highly among the foods that kids love best, this can be a challenge. There are, fortunately, snacks that meet the challenge and one of them is Oatmega Kids Protein Bars Chocolate Peanut Butter.

These bars are small and are made with plants. They include a good deal of protein for such a small amount of food, plus Omega- 3 and other desirable qualities. There are only a few grams of sugar per bar and not many calories, so the bars easily pass most parents’ requirements. The calories, however, for a snack of such small size are actually more than I expected so you need to keep servings under control.

With a flavor like chocolate peanut butter, it would seem like a parent can’t go wrong with these bars, but after tasting them myself, I can say that they lean toward the bland side overall. They aren’t very sweet, which is great from a nutrition standpoint because the sugar is low. But from a taste perspective, they seem a little too unsweet for this type of product. Also, the chocolate and peanut butter flavors are quite subdued. They are not bursting with taste, like I had hoped.

I want my kids to eat better and Oatmega Kids Protein Bars Chocolate Peanut Butter are a good choice for parents who demand nutritional quality for their children. Many kids won’t be thrilled with the flavor since it is rather tame and the small size won’t satisfy the appetite of bigger kids. So, taking all factors into account, Oatmega Kids Protein Chocolate Peanut Butter bars are an average product overall.

title: Good Combination of Flavor and Nutrition
text:
I love my coffee. It is part of my regular drinking routine and while I prefer to drink it plain with no additives, in order to save calories, I’m not going to pass up any coffee beverage, even if there are a few of those pesky calories in the mix. And one slightly caloric coffee drink I have tried and liked is La Colombe Vanilla Draft Latte.

Lattes are excellent when brewed up fresh so the first time I tried La Colombe, I approached with skepticism. I wasn’t so sure that a drink out of a can would be good enough, since I was already so hooked on lattes created and served in coffee shops. But given the convenience, I figured this was worth a try.

Before we get to the flavor, let’s talk about a few facts. I mentioned being wary of calories, but the good news is that these drinks keep the calories in check. There are only 100 per 9 ounce serving, so nothing to worry about. There is a good deal of protein and calcium in this drink, too, so the calories are well spent. It’s also lactose free, which is an added plus.

Now, let’s talk about the taste. There is a pleasant vanilla and milky flavor and character and it tastes natural. It’s not excessively sweet and the coffee component is more subdued, but still okay. The frothiness makes it taste better than expected- not quite as good as a freshly made latte, but still good for something out of a can. Oh, and speaking of the can, it has a plastic, sip- through seal on the top, which I find annoying because it makes the dispensing too slow. However, this is not really an issue, as the plastic sip- through top pops off with ease, leaving a larger opening behind, for faster drinking.

I still like a freshly made latte best, but La Colombe Vanilla Draft Latte is a good alternative, conveniently packaged in a metal can for portability and drinkability wherever you happen to be. The price is a little high, but this is still a good drink and one I will continue to purchase.

title: Good Alternative to Cow's Milk
text:
