Milk is generally considered a good beverage but due to health, environmental, and other concerns, many people shy away from drinking cow’s milk and seek out alternatives. Soy and almond are the most common options, but sesame milk is another available choice and one that I have tried and liked is Hope and Sesame Organic Sesame Milk.

This manufacturer makes several different flavored versions, but the one featured here is the original. It pours out thick and seems like a milkshake at first. The product is dairy free and gluten free, soy and nut free, plus it’s organic certified. These are all positive qualities for many people, particularly those who are on restricted diets.

With the taste, this milk is interesting. It has a somewhat nutty flavor, even though it contains no nuts. There is a certain earthy, plant like quality to the taste as well. I found that it went very well with a peanut butter and jelly sandwich, like you see in my picture, and it tastes good poured over whole- grain cereals, like wheat flakes. The taste is different, but it is still compatible with many foods and the creaminess is pleasant. It's lightly sweet as well.

Milk is part of a healthy diet and it is a good idea to rotate and try different types of milk from time to time, for better nutrition and healthfulness. Hope and Sesame Organic Sesame Milk is a good product overall and one I will certainly use again. It offers a good alternative to traditional milk products with a distinct taste.

title: Indulgence Without the Guilt
text:
I love sweets. I don’t usually overindulge, but I do find time to slip in a few sweet treats into my daily diet. Organic or all- natural foods are always welcome and one I have sampled and enjoyed is Newman’s Own Oatmeal Chocolate Chip Cookies.

Newman’s Own Oatmeal Chocolate Chip Cookies are small, tasty cookies made by a company that strives to make healthier food alternatives and then gives its excess money to charity. The Newman’s Own brand can be found on a variety of foods and it has become synonymous with charity and good quality.

These cookies are bite- size and feature the taste of oats and chocolate. The oat component is a little toasty, due to the baking, and the chocolate component is less pronounced than in other chocolate chip cookies. The chips are small and there is a limited number per chip. Thus, you get a cookie that is a little less chocolatey, but still tasty and enjoyable.

One of the many positives with Newman’s Own Oatmeal Chocolate Chip Cookies is that they are small enough that you can grab a handful, satisfy your cravings, and not feel guilty. Reading the label, there are only 140 calories per 5- cookie serving. Even if you double to 10 cookies, the total calories are only 280, which is still not bad. With other, larger chocolate chip cookies, it’s easy to eat five, six, or even more and consume well over 500 calories. With these cookies, it’s not too difficult to keep your eating habits in check.

I like that these cookies contain natural ingredients and I like the taste. About the only issues I have are the tendency of the cookies to crumble and the price. The cookies fall apart easily and you can expect to find a layer of crumbs in the bottom of every bag. And the price, on a per- ounce basis, is quite a bit higher than budget priced brands. Still, weighing all factors, Newman’s Own Oatmeal Chocolate Chip Cookies are a very good selection when you need a sugar fix. Natural ingredients, lower calories, and great taste make this a cookie worth adding to your list of acceptable treats.

title: Good Qualities but a Tad on the Sweet Side
text:
A boost of energy is easy enough to obtain when there are so many energy drinks on the market. I try to stick with drinks that are more natural in composition and this desire led me to try Sambazon Acai Berry Energy Superfood Juice Blend.

Made with Acai berry, Yerba Mate, Guarana, apple juice, and lime juice with pure cane sugar, this drink contains a good dose of Omega 3 and other antioxidants. It contains caffeine also, to provide the boost you need. There is added sugar and it works out to about 37 grams per 10.5 ounce serving. This is a little on the high side and won’t necessarily sit well with some consumers.

With the taste, I feel that it is pretty good overall, with flavors that include fruits and a touch of earthiness/plants. My one issue with the taste goes back to the 37 grams of sugar per serving: The drink is a little too sweet. I would probably like it better if the sugar was reduced.

There are many energy drinks on the market and they each have their share of pros and cons. Sambazon Acai Berry Energy Superfood Juice Blend does contain anti- oxidants and is organic certified, so it certainly has its merits. If you can get past the sweetness, you will find that this is as good an energy drink as any.

title: Natural Energy Drink Alternative
text:
We could all use a little more energy and there are more than enough energy drinks available to provide a liquid boost whenever we need one. Many of these energy drinks contain synthetic chemicals, but there are good, natural alternatives and one of them is Runa Energy drinks.

These drinks come in assorted flavors. I have tried the assortment pack and I like the berry flavor best, followed by the blood orange. Regardless of which flavor you choose, you will notice that there is a distinct, plant- like taste in each of them. This comes from the addition of the Guayusa plant, which is something I had never heard of until I tried these drinks. It’s not a bad flavor, but it is different than expected and it does add a touch of earthiness to each sip.

Runa drinks are USDA Organic certified and are naturally caffeinated. They don’t rely on tons of sugar and calories to get you going, like other energy drinks are prone to do, and they are free from artificial sweeteners. The lime, watermelon, and blood orange have no calories, which is nice, but even the other three have a scant 70 calories each, which is still low. The boost they provide is similar to that of coffee, so they serve their purpose but if you’re like me, it will likely take two or three servings to notice a difference in your energy level.

Energy needs vary from person to person and while I usually reach for a cup of coffee or tea when I need a boost, cold energy drinks are a good alternative and it is good to know that natural energy options like Runa exist. The plant taste is different, but these drinks still taste better than most other energy drinks and when all things are considered, they easily beat most of the popular competition.

title: Healthy Alternative to My Usual Granola
text:
I eat granola bars or something similar practically every working day as part of my midday meal. Not only do I like the taste, I also like the convenience of this type of food, since they are individually wrapped and can be grabbed and thrown into a lunch box with no prep necessary. I am always open to new bars especially if they have something unique to offer and this was enough to convince me to try Clif Whole Lotta Spiced Almond Ginger Organic Protein Bars.

Organic certified, vegan, and loaded with protein, these bars are certainly a notch above the typical granola. Taken from the individual package, they seem like a small piece of health bread based on appearance. You can visibly see the various seeds and other ingredients and they immediately make you think of something healthy, which they are.

As for the taste, I like the flavor overall. I like ginger, almonds, etc and I like the fact that these bars are not excessively sweet. In fact, the first thing that ran through my mind when I took a bite was how less sweet these bars are than my usual granola bars. There is no added sugar, only naturally occurring sugar. And you get a healthy dose of protein along with some important vitamins and minerals. The carb content isn’t low, but that is about the only possible negative I can think of, at least from a nutritional standpoint.

I need to get healthier foods into my daily diet and Clif Whole Lotta Spiced Almond Ginger Organic Protein Bars are definitely healthier than most foods of this type. They have a healthful, earthy flavor that is natural and tasty, and a little less sweet than expected. They do a body good, and I recommend them for you lunch or as a healthy snack alternative.

title: High Protein and Fiber, Low Sugar, Odd Flavor
text:
I like to eat healthy, at least some of the time, and I am fully aware that many of the foods I eat from day to day are lacking in many essential, nutritional ways, or they are loaded with undesirable ingredients. The desire to get away from animal products and get a good dose of nutrition led me to try Aloha Organic Plant Based Protein Bars.

First, let’s talk about these bars’ top selling points. They are vegan, non- GMO, organic certified, and dairy free plus they contain 14 grams of protein and 14 grams of fiber- very high levels for each, especially for this type of food. If you look at other breakfast bars, you will find that most of them- even the ones that claim to be high in fiber- contain only about one- third the fiber found in Aloha Organic Plant Based Protein Bars. The high protein and fiber and the low sugar of just 3 grams per bar are definitely among the top reasons to consider trying this food.

Second, let’s talk about the texture and taste. These are chewy bars and the taste is mainly that of caramel and grain, with a certain degree of earthy character. I must say, the taste is not as good as that of other cereal bars/breakfast bars I have tried. The mix of ingredients leads to a flavor that is a little less sweet and a little more plant- like than usual. I found it a tad funky, but the other, positive qualities listed above help me overlook this fact, at least a little.

We could all use a little more nutrition in our diets and Aloha Organic Plant Based Protein Bars definitely score high in the areas of protein, fiber, low sugar, and natural ingredients. There are better tasting breakfast bars and granola bars, but the many nutritional positives are enough to convince me to give these bars a recommendation.

title: Great Tasting Snack for My Family
text:
The snack we consume in my home more than any other is granola bars. Not only do they taste great, they are individually wrapped and it’s easy to grab on when you’re on the run or in need of a quick hunger fix and don’t want the mess. My family’s love for all things granola bars convinced me to try Solimo Sweet and Salty Peanut Granola Bars.

These granola bars feature the tastes of roasted peanut, oats and rice. There is a sweet glaze on one side of the bars and the taste alternates back and forth between sweet and salty. The calories are about what one would expect from a granola bar, just enough to satisfy the hunger pangs but low enough that you won’t feel guilty.

With the word salty in the name, one concern I had with these granola bars is that they might contain excessive sodium. A quick check of the nutrition facts shows that this is not true. In fact, they actually taste saltier than one would expect based on the actual sodium content. The carbs and added sugar could be a concern to some, but as long as you’re careful not to consume too many, you should be perfectly fine.

Granola is my preferred snack and you can always find granola bars of varying types in my pantry. Solimo Sweet and Salty Peanut Granola Bars offer a good overall taste for a fair price with nutritional data that, while not impressive, shouldn’t make anyone gasp in disbelief. These are a good granola bar overall and definitely one worth trying if you love the taste of roasted peanuts.

title: No Calories or Carbs and Natural, Too
text:
Sugar gets a bad rap and often for good reason. The calories contain nothing of any nutritional value and the calories can add up quickly. This is why a good sugar substitute is so essential and a good product for this purpose is Whole Earth Sweetener with Erythritol.

I have to admit, I had not heard of Erythritol until I decided to give this product a try. I was fully aware of other artificial sweeteners, many of which have been deemed potential health hazards. I couldn’t find anything negative about Erythritol so I decided this product was worth a shot.

Texture- wise, this product is very much like regular sugar, with the same granulated qualities. With the taste, it does produce the same sensation as anything that is sweet, but I have noticed it isn’t as sweet as regular cane sugar and thus it takes more of it to get the same level of sweetness if you add it to a beverage or food. I tasted some straight from the bag and noticed that it didn’t produce the level of sweetness that I would get from regular table sugar. But it is certainly close enough and this is a small sacrifice to pay for something that is completely free from calories and carbs.

Erythritol is a natural sweetener found in certain plants and the processing to make Whole Earth Sweetener is free from GMO. It may not be a perfect taste substitute for ordinary cane sugar, but it is far better for your health and great for dieters. It’s better than the artificial sweeteners, too, so when all factors are considered, Whole Earth Sweetener earns an easy recommendation.

title: Flavorful Citrus and Spice
text:
I drink a good deal of tea. Whether iced or hot, I consume tea almost every day and I’m game to trying most any flavor. So, when the opportunity arose, I had no problem accepting a chance to try Elevate Orange Cinnamon Black Tea.

This tea is packaged in a stand up pouch with a clear backside, letting you see the tea within. Right away, you can tell this is no ordinary tea based on sight alone and that is due to the large pieces of ingredients. This contrasts sharply with other teas, most of which contain finely ground tea leaves and perhaps tiny specs of other ingredients. The stand- up bag has a Ziploc- style seal on top, so the tea is easy to seal and store, and is always fresh.

Since this tea is loose leaf, you will need a tea ball or french press in order to brew/steep the tea. Once ready to drink, most will find the flavor better than that of the average tea and, again, the larger pieces of ingredients are likely the reason. The aroma of this tea is stronger than others, too. The flavor is intense, with citrus and spice dominating. I don’t add any sweetener when I drink tea and I found this tea perfectly good tasting without it.

I love tea and drink it more than I do any other beverage. Elevate Orange Cinnamon Black Tea is yet another example of why I love tea the way I do. It’s more pronounced flavor and aroma easily place it above the average tea in taste and quality.

title: Refreshing Tea with the Great Taste of Peppermint
text:
I drink more tea than any other beverage and it’s one of the very few drinks that I like anytime, anyplace, and while I’m in any mood. Since I love all styles and have a fondness for mint, I quickly accepted the opportunity to try Gus and Joan Green Tea, Peppermint and Matcha.

These tea bags are packaged 20 to a box and they are all contained inside a plastic sleeve. Once the sleeve is broken open, you will notice that the tea bags are without a string and paper handle, plus they are attached together in sets of two. You have to tear them apart to use them and since there is no string or paper handle, you will have to fish the tea bag out of your cup after it finishes steeping. It’s really not too bad, but it does help if you have a spoon, to avoid burning your hands.

With the taste, peppermint dominates. You can smell the mint as soon as you open the plastic sleeve. The peppermint is not that peppery, which is good. It’s actually close to tasting like spearmint. The green tea is pretty tasty, too. I like green tea more than most people do and I like how the added peppermint produces a nice, refreshing zing that truly adds to the flavor of green tea in a positive way.

I love tea and will always love tea. Gus and Joan Green Tea, Peppermint and Matcha is easily one of the better gourmet teas out there and I’m glad I took time to give it a try.

title: Good Tasting, Healthier Snack Alternative
text:
Snacking is a regular part of life for most people. We all agree that between- meal snacks need to be kept under control, but most of us are not about to cut snacks completely from our diets, and I’m one of them. Thankfully, there are some better, healthier, more earth- friendly snack options on the market and one of them is Hippeas.

These snacks are made with chickpeas and are vegan, gluten free, and USDA Organic Certified. There is a good dose of protein and fiber, too, so this is certainly a healthier than average snack. No, it’s not going to replace eating fruits and vegetables, but the nutrition and ingredient listings do place it a notch or two ahead of the average snack.

The Hippeas variety pack includes three flavors: White Cheddar, Barbecue, and Sriracha Sunshine. Of the three, I like the White cheddar best. The cheese taste isn’t as full as it is with other, similar snacks, but it is still pretty good, and the crunch level is about where I like it. The Sriracha Sunshine is good, while the barbecue is my least favorite among the three, but it’s still not bad. And, again, the nutrition level is better than that of my favorite barbecue potato chip.

If you’re going to snack and can’t do without a walk down the salty chip aisle at the store, then at least go for something a little healthier than average. Hippeas is a good substitute for the typical health snack and while they are a little on the pricey side, it is good to know that the manufacturer donates a portion of each sale to charity. Give them a try and see what you think!

title: Orange and Floral Flavors for Your Enjoyment
text:
I drink more tea than any other beverage and I like to vary my tea among different flavors and styles. My quest for variety led me to try Teavana White Tea Youthberry, and I was satisfied with the results.

Teavana Youthberry is a fragrant tea and you will know this the moment you pull the seal off the top of the container. The scent of floral and fruit is obvious and part of the reason it is so strong is because there is no paper covering on each individual tea bag. They are loaded into the container on top of each other, waiting for you to grab a bag, add hot water, steep, and enjoy.

Speaking of the tea bags, they are not shaped like traditional tea bags. They are triangular, and I find this design better for dunking the bag into the tea, in order to steep out the most flavor. The contents of each tea bag are heavier than most, and combined with the design, it makes it a little easier to sink the bag into the tea, for maximum flavor.

As for the taste, Teavana White Tea Youthberry is fruity and floral, just like the scent would lead you to believe. There is an orange blossom taste with other light citrus, berries, herbs, and flowers. The caffeine level is moderate and while you could add ingredients to this tea to make it sweeter and/or creamy, I prefer it exactly the way it is. Without any additives, you get the full taste of the tea without calories or anything else.

I love a good cup of tea and Teavana White Tea Youthberry is a good tea for everyday drinking and enjoyment. Just a few minutes in a cup of hot water is all it takes to release the flavors and get your day off to a great start.

title: Good Lemon and Butter Flavors
text:
I love my carbs. I know that many health practitioners preach against carbohydrate consumption, but I love my sugars, grains, and other like foods and have no intention of giving them up. I also love my coffee and the many flavors/varieties sold and a sweet snack food designed to pair with coffee is Starbucks Meyer Lemon and Blueberry Cookies.

These cookies are bite size, roughly the diameter of a quarter. They have a flavor that is buttery and sweet, like a shortbread cookie in many ways, with a good deal of lemon and a small amount of tart blueberry. The lemon and butter flavors dominate while the blueberry flavor remains in the background. I noticed that some of the cookies didn’t even have any blueberry specs in them at all so don’t purchase these if you’re expecting a burst of berry flavor. The lemon is what you taste most.

Starbucks recommends pairing these cookies with coffee. I had some with a cup of light roast coffee, served black, and I found that the tastes do, indeed, match up nicely. However, I like these cookies best when paired with a glass of milk. They are also quite tasty all by themselves as a quick snack.

Carbohydrates are a large part of my diet and I love sweet treats the most of any type of carb. These Starbucks Meyer Lemon and Blueberry Cookies are a good tasting snack that will satisfy any sugar craving. I could do with a little more blueberry, but the cookies are still tasty regardless.

title: Like a French Roast and Priced Right
text:
I consume a good amount of coffee at home and on the job and, thanks to my keurig coffee maker, I can brew exactly what I want, when I want it, one cup at a time. Coffee pods are therefore an essential part of life and that is why I was happy to try My Coffee Espresso Roast coffee pods.

My Coffee pods are constructed a little differently than others, with ribbed sides that supposedly enhance the flavor and a recyclable, biodegradable interior. These are certainly good features, particularly the biodegradable aspects. Most coffee pods are not earth- friendly and we need to do what we can to control their usage.

As for the taste of the coffee itself, I found it okay. It’s medium in body and similar to a French roast in many ways. It’s also a little bit burnt in taste and certainly not as good as other coffees I have tried. On the other hand, the price per pod if you go for the large, 100 count package is tough to beat. When I think of some of my favorite coffee pods and their price, they are often double the price of this brand, so this needs to be taken into account when considering a purchase.

I like coffee and drink multiple cups every week, both at home and at work. My Coffee Espresso Roast is a good coffee overall and while it may not rank on my top 10 list, it has enough positive qualities to give it a small recommendation.

title: So Good, You Won't Be Able to Put the Package Down
text:
I like the occasional snack. I try to keep my snacking healthy, but I don’t always succeed and more often than I should, I go for the sugary foods with little or no nutritional value. One healthier option is nuts and since cashews are my favorite type of nut, I was anxious to try Mavuno Harvest Organic Direct Trade Premium Whole Cashews.

Crunchy, slightly salty and even a little sweet, these cashews satisfy in every way. The roasted flavor is excellent and I like that the cashews are whole and not broken into pieces. Sure, some pieces do get broken during shipping, handling, etc, but almost all of the cashews are whole.

Some cashews are oversalted and/or they include too many additives. With these cashews there are only two ingredients: Cashews and sea salt. That means they are much purer than most other cashews on the market. And while there is certainly a salty taste, it isn’t overdone and the sodium level is actually not bad at all for this type of snack.

Mavuno Harvest Cashews are Direct Trade Certified, Non GMO, and USDA Organic. I love everything about these cashews but I must warn anyone who tries them: Once you start, you may be unable to stop eating them! I went through one full package while sitting at my desk at work and still wanted more! They are addictive, delicious in every way, ethically produced, and as natural as a cashew can possible be. Could you ask for more? I don’t think anyone could, so if you love cashews like I do, be sure to add these to your snacks- to- try list. And indulge in some of the finest cashews available.

title: Not Your Typical Ginger Ale
text:
A good ginger ale is a welcome diversion from the usual soda and makes a good complement to various foods. Some ginger ales are artificial in taste, but one I have tried that has a flavor that is natural and mostly to my liking is Organics Ginger Ale by Red Bull.

Chilled and sipped from the can, you can tell that this is not your typical ginger ale. There is some lemon flavor added and bergamot, too, with a touch of caramel. The combination produces a taste that is not quite as gingery as other ginger ales, a fact that could pique the interest of some but also disappoint those who want their ginger ale to taste predominantly like ginger. The drink is organic certified, which is another plus and it’s caffeine free.

This soft drink is packaged in a smaller can, which to me is better than the standard soft drink can size. I find I often have to force myself to finish a larger can of soft drink because it is more than I need to wash down a meal. These cans are smaller and just right. The slightly smaller serving size also means fewer grams of sugar and calories- facts that should make this beverage option more appealing.

I like ginger ale and often select it instead of other soft drinks when I get tired of the usual cola, lemon- lime, orange, etc. flavors. I still like the stronger ginger ales and this Red Bull version cannot take the place of the purer ginger ales I have tried and loved. But it still has good taste overall and it makes a good choice when you want an alternative soft drink.

title: No Health Food but They Taste Great
text:
I love sweet snacks as much as anyone else. My favorite flavor of sweet food is chocolate and I’ve been a fan of Oreo cookies since I was a kid. I love the taste of mint, too, so I was naturally drawn to try Oreo Thin Bites Dipped Mints.

These cookies are small, bite size cookies that are like Oreo cookies but with a mint center. The mint cream filling is soft and makes for a cookie that is only slightly crunchy- less so than an ordinary Oreo but not as soft as, say, a cookie straight from the oven.

There is a good deal of mint flavor here and the taste reminds me of a dish of mint chocolate chip ice cream, which is one of my favorite flavors. I like the taste of these better than that of a regular Oreos and the small size means it easier to control portion sizes and keep your calorie count under control. But I admit, these are addicting. Once you start to eat, it’s very easy to continue all the way to the end of the package.

Another nice thing about Oreo Thin Bites Fudge Dipped Mints is the package itself. You don’t need to worry about re- sealing with your own plastic wrap or trying to fold over the plastic once torn, like you have to do with many other cookie packages. That is because this cookie bag has a re- sealable top. You just zip and the job is done.

Oreos are an all- time favorite snack food and Oreo Thin Bites Dipped Mints are a great tasting treat. No, they are not going to score any points from a nutrition standpoint and the concentrated calories are a concern. But there is no denying that these cookies taste great and they make a delicious, indulgent snack for those who love the flavors of mint and chocolate.

title: Not Bad, but I've Had Better
text:
I eat snack bars like granola bars and others practically on a daily basis and I like trying different bars and mixing/matching flavors. I’m open to just about any type of bar, and that was enough to get me to try Luna Rica, a chocolate, coconut, and almond bar.

Luna Rica bars have several good things going for them. They are non- GMO, gluten free, and organic certified, which are three traits that will make them immediately appealing to a specific segment of the population. They have a fair amount of protein and fiber, too, but there is a somewhat high level of sugar per bar.

So, the nutrition seems to check out fine but what about the taste? Here, I am less positive about Luna Rica. I like the texture and I appreciate that they are not very chewy. But the taste is a little too tilted toward the flavor of nuts, with almonds and dates dominating. There isn’t as much coconut flavor as I expected and I would prefer that the chocolate be emphasized more. I notice that some other people have noted the same things in their reviews. I’m someone who prefers chocolate, so any breakfast bar that emphasizes that flavor will win out over others.

These bars are on the small side and can be eaten quickly. I suppose they are acceptable overall, but I don’t rank them among my favorites. I can think of several other breakfast bar and granola bar brands that I like more than these and that contain less sugar. Still, these have enough going for them to earn a middle rating and small recommendation, at least as something worthy of a try.

title: Quality Pancakes with Dark Chocolate- What's Not to Love?
text:
Among hot breakfast foods, pancakes are my go- to item. I’m not a huge fan of eggs and many breakfast meats don’t sit well with me, but I do love me some pancakes and I love chocolate, too. So, I was naturally drawn to trying Birch Benders All Natural Chocolate Chip Pancakes.

Packaged in a plastic sleeve, this pancake mix is easy to prepare. With box- style mixes, you usually pour the powder from a narrow opening and it ends up making a mess, as some of it misses your measuring cup. With the wide opening on these pouches, you can reach your measuring cup directly inside and scoop, without a mess. Each pouch has a ziplock- style seal at the top, for simple closure, which is again an improvement compared to other mixes. The mix is complete, and that means you only need to add water. The chocolate chips are already there, so there is nothing more to add.

As for the quality and taste, they rank highly in my book. They use dark chocolate, which I prefer over milk chocolate in my pancakes. I like it better because it isn’t as sweet as other types of chocolate and it adds contrast to the already very sweet syrup you are likely to pour over the cakes. The chocolate is tasty and the pancakes cook up fluffy and cakey, without any runniness or excessive thickness. The preparation instructions seem just right to produce pancakes with the right consistency.

These Birch Bender Pancakes are all natural and non- GMO verified, so they past most tests for purity. They are very close to fitting a vegan’s strict diet limitations and they taste great. I love the easy to re- seal package convenience, too. Sum up all of the pros and the few, if any cons, and you have a chocolate pancake lovers delight and product worthy of your breakfast table.

title: Skins Make the Difference
text:
I love cashews. They are probably my favorite type of nut and I easily like them more than peanuts, walnuts, and others. Most cashews I eat are bare, but eating wrapped cashews is healthier, and that convinced me to give Karma a try.

These cashews are different from what most of us are used to and the difference, as you might guess, is mainly with the wrap. With the natural skin in place, these cashews are crunchier than others and, dare I say, tastier, too! They also have additional fiber, above and beyond what you get from cashews that have the skin removed. And they contain important trace minerals, making them a healthy snack.

Karma Premium Wrapped Natural and Dry Roasted Whole Cashews do have a small amount of salt added. But the manufacturer uses only a small amount of salt and it does add to the flavor, even if the extra sodium may be less than ideal for some. About the only other issue I have with these relates to the skins. Like peanuts with the skins, they do tend to get stuck in your teeth and you may feel the need to reach for a toothpick after eating. It is somewhat of an annoyance, but once again, I feel the added benefits you get from added skins is worth it.

Cashews still rank as my favorite type of nut and Karma Premium Wrapped Cashews are a very tasty cashew, loaded with good nutrition. The added crunch and touch of salt make this a better cashew than the rest and if you can get past the price tag, I think you will agree that these are a notch above what you’ve been buying from your local store.

title: Nutritionally Lacking but They are Organic and GMO Free
text:
Sweet snack foods are usually rated low on the nutritional quality scale and most of them are made with questionable ingredients. Pure Growth Organic Mickey Shaped Chocolate Animal Crackers are an alternative to the norm, in some ways, with natural ingredients to make them a better alternative to the usual snack.

Looking at these animal crackers/cookies, they depict Disney’s most favored character, Mickey Mouse, as the package promises, and they are on the small side. Animal crackers usually are small, and these crackers are just that, measuring about an inch across at the widest point. They are flat, thin, and crunchy and it’s easy to eat large handfuls at a time. There is no icing- just a plain, baked cookie.

As for the taste, it’s pretty good, actually. The flavor is mainly that of cocoa, but there is some vanilla too. They actually remind me of some of the chocolate graham crackers I have tasted. Nutrition wise, however, there is little to be found here and that is why I stated above that these crackers are different from the typical snack in some ways, but not in all ways. Other than a small amount of iron, the calories you get from this snack are mostly empty.

I like the occasional snack as much as anyone else and I love anything made with chocolate. Pure Growth Organic Mickey Shaped Chocolate Animal Crackers are a better snack than most, with no artificial flavors or colors, no GMO, and all organic ingredients. A little more nutrition would be nice, but this is a sweet snack food so it’s pretty much par for the course.

title: Sodium Free Snack and Lots of Protein
text:
Peanuts are a good source of protein and they serve as a much healthier alternative than other snacks. They can, however, lose some of their healthy appeal when excessive salt, sugar, and other things are added. Fisher has solved that concern with this, Unsalted Dry Roasted Peanuts.

Fisher offers several good- tasting snack products. I like peanuts best, at least as an affordable snack. Other types of nuts like cashews are better tasting, really, but they cost several times more. Fisher peanuts are less expensive and fit into any budget.

Nutritionally, these Fisher peanuts have much to offer. A small, one ounce serving provides 7 grams of protein and the ingredients list is very short, containing exactly one item: Peanuts. You cannot get more natural than that. Oh, and lets not forget the lack of sodium. Salted peanuts really rack up the sodium levels and you can easily exceed the recommended daily allowance limit with a few handfuls. There is no such worry here- these peanuts are completely sodium free.

As for the taste, it is fresh, roasted, and natural. There is no spice from salt or other additive so, yes, some might say the taste is blander than that of honey roasted or salted peanuts. I would agree with that, but the complete lack of sodium and single gram of natural sugar per serving makes this a better alternative, even if it is a little less exciting.

Peanuts are good for health, provided they are consumed in limited quantities and have no additives. Fisher Unsalted Dry Roasted Peanuts have much to offer and without all that sodium, you can feel much better consuming these as part of your snacking routine. Here's to Fisher Unsalted Peanuts, and here's to your health!

title: Tasty, Addictive Snack Food
text:
Eating choices are limited when you have to go gluten free. Luckily for those who cannot eat gluten, manufacturers continue to create more gluten- free versions of ordinary foods and one I have tried and liked is Lance Gluten Free Peanut Butter Sandwich Crackers.

I don’t personally have any need to eat gluten free foods, but I do like to eat health foods when possible and since I love peanut butter, this seemed like a good product to try. The crackers are small, bite size, and are sandwiched the way you expect- two small crackers with peanut butter in the middle. The crackers are crunchy and make a good snacking option for anyone.

Besides being a healthy option for celiac sufferers, these crackers are good tasting, with a buttery, grainy taste that can stand up to the better crackers on the market. The peanut butter is good, too- not gourmet top of the line good, but good nonetheless, with a natural peanut flavor.

If there is anything negative to be said about this snack, it would be that it’s highly addictive. I could easily consume this entire package in a single sitting and that is why I try to limit myself whenever I eat a snack like this. The taste is very good, the crackers are bite size, and several fit into the hand at once. This spells addiction, and that means you need to be disciplined and limit yourself to just a small serving, if you can.

Gluten free foods are growing in popularity and it’s nice that so many manufacturers have heeded the gluten free call and now produce so many different gluten free options. Lance Gluten Free Peanut Butter Sandwich Crackers are one of the best gluten free snacks I have ever tried and they make a great snacking choice for anyone. Just be sure to limit yourself- the entire package will be gone in minutes if you’re not careful.

title: Quality Chocolate, Nuts, and Berries
text:
Few things in life are better than gourmet chocolate and Cailler L’Art Du Brut Milk Chocolate Bar with Whole Almonds, Hazelnuts, and Cranberries is a chocolate bar made with quality in mind. The nuts, berries, and creamy chocolate make for a tasty after dinner or midday treat.

I usually go for solid chocolate bars without any other ingredients, but I don’t have any problem with the occasional deviation from my preference. This chocolate bar, with almonds, hazelnuts, and cranberries, offers a good tasting combination of ingredients that tastes better than expected. I wasn’t so sure about cranberries in my chocolate, but the manufacturer makes it work. The hazelnuts and almonds are more pronounced and add more to the flavor than the cranberries, but the berry taste is still there, in a small but pleasant dose that contrasts nicely with the sweet chocolate.

The nuts and berries are nice and add their own dimension of taste, but the basis of this candy is milk chocolate. It’s creamy and smooth and it melts in your mouth the way quality chocolate should. The berries and nuts are actually softer than expected and, with the milk chocolate, make for a more delicate bite. And you can break the large bar into 12 small, bite size pieces, making it good for sharing.

I love solid chocolate most of all, but I must say that Cailler L’Art Du Brut Milk Chocolate Bar with Whole Almonds, Hazelnuts, and Cranberries is a very good alternative to 100 percent chocolate. The milk chocolate is still front and center, but the nuts and berries are tasty in their own right and make this a good- tasting, quality snack.

title: Sweet Treat to Indulge the Taste Senses
text:
I love any snack that includes chocolate and Popcorn brittle with Hershey’s milk chocolate drizzle contains exactly that- milk chocolate drizzled over a mixture of snack foods for an indulgent treat great for the holidays or any time. The popcorn, toffee, pretzels, and chocolate combine for a taste most anyone will like and many will get addicted to quickly.

This snack food relies on gooey but hardened/set toffee to hold together what are actually large pieces of candy. I had no problem grabbing one of these big pieces of snack food and eating the full piece, but some may want to break the pieces down into smaller sizes. The manufacturer claims that this candy is sweet and salty and it is, but the sweetness is most noticeable. The popcorn taste is there, too, and it tries to balance things out, but it’s the least pronounced among the flavors and sweetness dominates.

I like this food item from a taste perspective and I’m sure that others will agree that the taste is pleasant and indulgent. My concerns with this snack food are more along the lines of the nutrition. The sodium level is significant, although not as bad as other snack foods, and there are a fair number of calories that add up quickly because the candy is so easy to eat. But worst of all is the saturated fat. Each small serving contains about 5 grams of saturated fat and, considering how easy it is to eat multiple servings in a single sitting, the saturated fat catches up to you quickly.

Popcorn brittle with Hershey’s milk chocolate drizzle is a tasty snack overall and it would make a great gift. I think it’s a little pricey and I am concerned about the level of saturated fat. But this is still a tasty snack and besides, the holiday season is meant as a time to indulge so go ahead and enjoy this pretzel, popcorn, chocolate, and toffee treat if you get the chance.

title: Better than Most Other Snacks but Could Still be Improved
text:
Want a quick, easy to unpackage and eat treat that offers some decent nutritional value? Most snacks don’t fit the bill, but one that does is Fiber One Streusel Bar Strawberry flavor.

I like a quick snack and I like that these bars have more nutrition than others. They are made with real fruit, healthy whole grains, and a good dose of fiber. The added fiber is completely lacking in other snacks and does help set this snack food above others.

As for the taste, well, these bars are decent although not quite the burst of natural flavor I was hoping for. The ingredients list concentrated strawberry puree and it’s nice that they use this real ingredient. But I wish there was more of this natural flavor and I’m a little disappointed that the product contains artificial colors and other additives that contribute to the less-than-stellar flavor. The taste is, therefore, not much different than that of other strawberry flavored cereal bars and, while certainly not bad, it isn’t as good as I had hoped.

Still, when I compare the overall product to other, similar snack foods, I have to say that these are a notch better than most and the reason is the fiber and whole grains. Could these be made even better? Of course they could, but they easily measure up to or exceed other snack foods and they have enough good qualities to earn my recommendation.

title: Very Good Tasting and Healthy, too!
text:
If you need a healthy meal and have little time to wait, consider Tandoor Chef Channa Masala. A frozen meal that tastes far better than most, it can be pulled from the freezer, popped into the microwave, and prepped for serving in minutes.

I usually go for meaty meals when I eat my lunches but I will be the first to admit that the occasional deviation from fatty meats is a good idea. I have no problem at all going vegetarian or vegan from time to time, especially if the food is tasty, as so many of these items tend to be bland. Channa Masala is a nicely seasoned dish, made with chickpeas, tomatoes, onions, and other ingredients for a completely plant- based food that smells good and tastes even better. The amount of seasoning is just about right for this type of dish and the taste is quite good. Like other Tandoor Chef meals, the quality and flavor are vastly superior to most other frozen foods and healthier, too, with no cholesterol and low calories.

Tandoor Chef Channa Masala is all natural and certified vegan, making it perfect for the plant- eating citizens among us. The gluten- free quality is perfect for those with specific health concerns and nutritionally, it’s very difficult to find anything wrong. It doesn’t have as much protein as a meat- based meal, but that is expected and the protein level you do get- 5 grams- is still good for this type of food.

Frozen foods are often very unnatural in taste and usually bland and forgettable, but Tandoor Chef has set a new standard for quality. Its Channa Masala is a very good vegan meal and it’s one I plan to buy again for workplace lunches or a quick and healthy snack at home.

title: Healthy, Good Tasting Frozen Meal from Tandoor Chef
text:
Tandoor Chef Chicken Tikka Masala with Basmati Rice is a nice way to enjoy ethic eating from the comfort of home. Just four minutes in the microwave is all it takes to prepare this small meal for one, perfect for lunch, a snack, or as part of a larger dinner.

This Tandoor Chef meal includes separate masala chicken and rice, both of which are quite good for a frozen meal. The rice was fluffy and much better tasting than the rice found in other frozen meals. It even looks better when you open the package for the first time and this improved appearance does, indeed, translate into better tasting rice.

With the chicken, I found it very good, even if a little less spicy than I would prefer. It isn’t exactly the same as chicken masala ordered in a restaurant, but it’s still good in its own way. The chicken breast is tender and good- tasting. Again, the flavor is much better than the taste of a typical frozen meal and with only 360 calories and 24 grams of protein per serving, it should meet the standards of most consumers, including those on calorie- counting diets.

A good, authentic chicken tikka masala is a gourmet treat when served at a fancy restaurant. Tandoor Chef Chicken Tikka Masala with Basmati Rice may not be quite as good as the food ordered when dining out, but as far as frozen foods go, this one is far better than most and it earns a thumbs- up recommendation from me.

title: Miss Jones Vanilla Cake Mix: Natural and Delicious
text:
Going all- natural is a popular trend nowadays with food and beverages and manufacturers have delivered their share of hits and misses. One brand that appears to have hit the ball out of the park is Miss Jones with its Vanilla cake mix.

Cake mixes might seem like a generic food item with little differences among them, but Miss Jones Vanilla Cake mix is a standout in the crowd. The cake itself comes out fluffy and delicious, with a vanilla flavor that is more pronounced than that of other cakes. The taste difference is obvious and my family and I noticed the difference right away. With other cake mixes, the vanilla flavor is faint, but there is no mistaking the flavor with this cake mix.

Another reason to like Miss Jones Vanilla Cake Mix is the obvious reason- the all natural ingredients. There is no a trans fat, hydrogenated oil, or high fructose corn syrup. The mix uses wheat flour and contains a reasonably short list of ingredients without the slew of unpronounceable words so common on the labels of other cake mixes. There are no artificial colors or flavors added and there is actually some nutrition in the form of the essential minerals iron and calcium. So, not only does the cake taste good, it is better nutritionally than other cake mixes, most of which offer no nutritional value at all.

Cake mixes might seem like a product with little variation from one brand to the next and for the most part, this assessment is an accurate one. But Miss Jones Vanilla Cake Mix is a standout in the baking products crowd, with a taste that is more flavorful and an ingredient list that is more natural. The quality shines with this product and it earns a high recommendation from me.

title: Lipton Iced Tea Lemonade Doesn't Live up to my Standards
text:
Owning a Keurig makes it easy to serve up a piping hot cup of coffee or tea. Just turn on the appliance, pop in a K-cup, press the button and walla- a cup of steaming hot beverage is ready to drink. There is no waste and you make only what you need so nothing goes to waste.

Lipton K-Cup Iced Tea Lemonade is as easy to use as any other K-cup. It carries the Lipton name, so it has a solid reputation behind it. These are all good things, but I have to say that the beverage itself is only so- so in taste. It’s a little on the sweet side, at least for me. I usually drink my tea unsweetened, but I can handle a small amount of sweetness. This one goes a tad far in the sugary direction so it doesn’t necessarily suit my preference.

Aside from the sweetness, Lipton K-Cup Iced Tea Lemonade is also somewhat artificial in taste. I tried a few different cups, hoping that perhaps I got a bad K-Cup. But each cup of tea tasted about the same as the last. The flavor seemed a little off- not bad, but not anything amazing and not as good as some of my favorite all- natural, tea- bag style teas or other K-cup teas.

I drink quite a bit of tea and I love the convenience I get with my Keurig. But not all K-cups are worth drinking and Lipton K-Cup Iced Tea Lemonade is one of them. It isn’t terrible, but the artificial flavor and sweetness level convince me to rate tis product below average.

title: Useful in So Many Ways
text:
Multi- purpose and useful in each of its recommended ways, Viva Labs Coconut Oil is a pure, natural, organic certified non- GMO product ready to use. It is non- refined and can be used as food or as an aid to healthy skin and hair, making it one of the most useful products in your kitchen or night stand drawer.

I have used a few other coconut oils, usually for cooking, but this is one of the few I have ever tried that is so versatile. The first time I used this coconut oil was on my hands- they were feeling a little dry from handling paper all day on the job and I decided to reach for this product instead of the lotion I would normally use. I found this to be superior to the lotion and it quickly brought an end to the dryness. It doesn't dry in as quickly as a lotion, but it works better. I haven't tried it on my hair, as I have thinner hair than most and I would likely not benefit much, but it does seem like a good moisturizing product for this purpose.

This extra virgin coconut oil is also useful for eating and cooking and it makes a good substitute for butter and other dairy products. About the only possible strike, from a consumption perspective, is the high level of saturated fat. This is true with other coconut products as well and it is expected. But it could be a concern to those who are trying to cut back on saturated fat as, according to the label, a single tablespoon contains 13 grams of saturated fat. Yes, the product does taste delicious and the type of saturated fat contained here is not as bad as that in other foods, but try to keep the use to a minimum if you're on a low fat diet.

Softer skin and great tasting- you don't find many products that take care of both the inside and outside of your body. Viva Labs Organic Extra Virgin Coconut Oil is one product that does it all and my experience has been very positive on all levels. It is an excellent product that wins my highest recommendation.

title: Acceptable Pasta Side Dish with Good Nutrition
text:
Everybody likes a little convenience in the kitchen. A main dish that requires preparation is certainly desirable, but a side dish can make the meal more complete and it's always nice when the side dish takes little time or work to prepare. Lipton Pasta Sides Chipotle Rosa works well when you want a simple addition to a main meal and don't want to devote time to preparation. Just add water, milk, and butter, boil for a short time, and serve- it really is that simple.

The convenience of this product is easily its best quality, but what about the taste? Well, it is spicy, Mexican- like, basic pasta flavored, and seems like a decent choice to add to a meal consisting of Mexican or similar foods. The spice level isn't too extreme, but I find the taste a little boring and a little too salty. A few more added ingredients to the mixture would make it better, but the manufacturer instead decided to keep it simple and included nothing but spiral- shaped pasta and spicy seasoning.

Based on flavor alone, this product would rank slightly below average, but it does offer some other qualities that help convince me to increase my rating. Besides the quick preparation already discussed, this product offers a good deal of nutrition- a level more on par with what you would expect in a healthy vegetable or other side dish. And, the price is right. It is common to find envelopes selling for less than a buck fifty each, so it easily fits within any budget.

A side dish can add greatly to a main dish and if quickness of preparation is your desire, then Lipton Pasta Sides Chipotle Rosa is a possible food option to consider. It isn't a great- tasting food product, but for the nutrition, price, and ease of preparing, it makes a good side dish option for your next Mexican dish or other meal.

title: Okay Product, but Needs More Flavor
text:
Lipton's Orange Blossom Hibiscus is another one of Lipton's pyramid herbal teas- products with a pyramid- shaped tea bag and added herbs for a unique taste. This tea product contains herbs and real pieces of orange for a supposedly authentic flavor.

I like the pyramid teas from Lipton in general, but I have yet to find one that really grabs my attention and this product is yet another that seems okay overall, but that doesn't live up to its potential. The taste is rather mild overall and while you can certainly tell it is an herbal and orange flavored tea, there isn't much to the overall taste to make it memorable.

Besides the mildness of the orange flavor, the other taste that is lacking is, well, the other one in the title: hibiscus. There isn't much in the way of hibiscus taste and the flavor seems most dominated by the taste of herbs, however mild they may be.

I will continue to enjoy tea and sample as many new products as I can, but I don't know if I will try this Lipton product again. It needs a boost in the taste department to make it a viable product, but I admit that it does have just barely enough good qualities to make it worthy of trying. Don't get your hopes up too high and you just might like this orange and herbal flavored product.

title: Artificial Taste, no Nutritional Value, and Questionable Ingredients..Are You Ready to Try?
text:
Drinking water is important, but many among us do not drink as much as we should. One reason is the lack of taste and this is where Mio Liquid Water Enhancer Peach Tea flavor can make a difference. It offers a convenient, quick means to add a little flavor to otherwise bland water, increasing the chances that we will drink as much water as we should.

I have seen and heard about these Mio products for some time, but this one, the peach flavor, is the first one I have ever tried. And now that the experience is behind me, I must admit that my feelings are mixed. Yes, it is better tasting than a plain glass of water and it does encourage me to drink more water on a regular basis. But the flavor is a tad too sweet and there is actually very little peach or tea taste. The overall flavor profile is artificial and not nearly as good as the flavor of a fresh, real, fruity drink.

Along with the taste, another issue I have with this product is the odd smell. It is chemical- like in nature and very unappetizing. I would never guess, by smell alone, that this was a peach flavored liquid. It has an artificial smell that makes you hesitate to try it. I can assure you that it tastes better than it smells once it is diluted in water, but the smell is still unappealing.

There is no nutritional value with this drink, but also no calories so it won't expand the waistline. I recommend not looking at the ingredient list because it will raise many concerns due to the artificial colors and preservatives. These are certainly not good qualities, but on the other hand, most of the beverages on the store shelves are no better and some would say they are even worse. At least with a product like this, you are actually consuming a very small amount of the liquid with each serving, so the negative effects are minimal.

Taking everything into account, Mio Liquid Water Enhancer Peach Tea flavor is a tough product to rate. The taste is okay, but nothing amazing. The ingredient list raises some eyebrows, but is no worse than many other common beverages. There is no nutritional value, but also no calories. On the positive side, the product is packaged in a small container, is very convenient, and encourages consumption of water. So, with all of these good and bad qualities, I am going to take the take the middle ground and give this beverage flavoring a middle rating overall. It isn't anything special, but it has enough going for it to consider a sample.

title: Snackwell Brownie Bites: Dry, but Acceptable
text:
I love chocolate and I like indulging in the occasional chocolate- flavored snack or dessert. My love of all things chocolate- enhanced led me to sample Snackwell Brownie Bites. I like other Snackwell products and there was no reason to think that this one would be any different from the others.

Snackwell Brownie Bites are sold in small packages with about seven small brownie bits per bag. Each package contains only about 150 calories, which isn't too bad. The individual packages are nice because they are just right for an individual treat and they lessen the chances for overindulgence. Open a very large package of a sweet snack and you may continue snacking until your stomach cries out in pain, but open a small pack and there is a better chance you will end your snacking experience when the package is empty.

Smaller packages and servings are certainly nice, but what about the taste and quality of the product? Well, I'm afraid that Snackwell loses a few points in this area. The brownies are a tad on the dry side- nothing like the moist, gooey fudge brownies I had in mind when I first tried them. They are a little chewier than I prefer, too, and in many ways they remind me of a Little Debbie brownie snack. Little Debbie snacks, as most will agree, are acceptable but far from great. And this is exactly how I feel about Snackwell Brownie Bites.

Everyone needs a chocolate fix every now and then and Snackwell Brownie Bites are fine for this purpose. But they are not as tasty as other Snackwell products and they are not even close to the delicious chocolate burst so common with the better brownies. Still, they aren't bad for a quick snack and with only 150 calories, you can indulge yourself without any guilt.

title: Hot, Minty Refreshment with a Boost
text:
Yogi Refreshing Mint Revitalize Tea is a minty and slightly spicy tea that includes green tea, black tea, organic peppermint, kola nut, guarana seed, ginger, and cinnamon. This tea is formulated, according to the manufacturer, to get your chi moving; that is, to improve your overall energy and well- being.

First, let's talk about the taste. This mint tea is minty more than anything and a few minutes of steeping is more than enough to bring out the full, mint flavor. The mixture of green and black teas is evident, too, although not as obvious as the flavor of mint. And, if you search, you can detect the added spices. The cinnamon flavor is certainly there, but I admit that I had a hard time finding the other flavors, like the ginger.

As for energy, well, I agree that I feel more energized after drinking two cups of this tea, but I can't say the credit goes to the basic ingredients. A more likely culprit is the caffeine, which is higher in this tea than in other teas.

I love a good cup of tea and Yogi Refreshing Mint Revitalize is certainly a tasty tea with plenty of fresh mint taste. It might be a bit much for those who prefer to taste tea rather than mint, but I enjoyed it very much and recommend it to those who love the refreshing and uplifting combination of green and black tea with peppermint and other spices.

title: Quaker Dipps taste great, but other factors reduce the rating
text:
Quaker Chewy Dipps peanut butter bars are a tasty snack that is sure to satisfy anyone who loves the flavors of granola and chocolate. This snack food product takes an ordinary granola bar and coats it with a layer of milk chocolate to create a snack that is more chocolaty and sweeter than the average granola bar.

I eat granola bars almost every day and Quaker Dipps are certainly high- ranking in the taste department. Granola with added milk chocolate- who wouldn't love such a combination? However, as much as I love the taste of Quaker Chew Dipps, I cannot overlook some of the negative qualities of these granola bars. First, there are some questionable ingredients such as high fructose corn syrup, cottonseed oil, artificial colors, etc. Other granola bar brands and flavors contain similar less- than- healthy ingredients, but their lists are not as long as the list for Quaker Chew Dipps. The ingredient list for this product includes multiple lines, which cannot be a good thing. Second, these granola bars are quite small. Other granola bars are larger and/or chewier and take more time to eat. These bars are only slightly chewy and their small size makes them disappear in seconds.

The added milk chocolate on a Quaker Dipps bar makes them seem like candy bars. And compared to a candy bar, Quaker Chewy Dipps are certainly better. They do contain some wholesome ingredients and actually make a good choice when you have a sweet craving and need a fix. There are many questionable ingredients and the nutritional content is nothing to brag about, but at least you get a little bit of nutritional value and it is still better than that of most candy bars.

Granola is a favorite snack food and Quaker Chewy Dipps are a good tasting snack that rate highly based on taste but much lower based on ingredients, nutrition, size, and other factors. I consider them an average snack overall and while I certainly won't turn one away, they include enough negative qualities that I don't seek these out when I shop. They taste great, but the negative qualities mentioned above are enough to make them average overall.

title: Mint, Green Tea, Honey, and more Mint spells Delicious!
text:
Sweet Leaf Mint and Honey Green Tea is a delicious iced tea from one of the fastest- growing names in bottled iced tea. This company produces many delicious tea products, many of which are certified organic for healthy refreshment.

I consume more tea than any other beverage and I am naturally game to trying anything new. Sweet Leaf is a brand that only recently caught my attention when I noticed the interesting packages, with the cartoon image of a grandmother, along with the interesting flavors. Sweet Leaf Mint and Honey Green Tea was the first one I purchased from this company. I was very impressed by this tea and it ranks as my favorite flavor in the Sweet Leaf lineup.

What I love about Sweet Leaf Mint and Honey Green Tea is the fresh mint flavor from the addition of spearmint. I realize that some green tea purists will object somewhat to the flavor of this tea because the mint dominates the taste. It is true that you have to search for the flavors of green tea and honey, but they are there, hidden beneath the flavor of mint. And the fresh mint makes for a nice change of pace and a delicious flavor combination. The mint has a very natural and pure taste- a vast improvement over other mint- infused teas that often have a chemical flavor and aftertaste.

Besides the great taste, another important reason to enjoy this product is the refreshment factor. You take a few quick sips and.......wow! The flavor is not only refreshing from a thirst-quenching perspective, it is also refreshing from a flavor perspective. Mint, as we all know, is the most common flavor used in mouthwash and other like products. It is a natural refresher, and it enhances the refreshment factor of this beverage product.

Sweet Leaf mankes many delicious products and Sweet Leaf Mint and Honey Green Tea ranks as my personal favorite. It offers great refreshment and flavor, a full day's supply of vitamin C, and is certified organic. If you haven't sampled it yet, I recommend seeking it out and enjoying the great refreshment that comes from green tea, mint, honey, and all- natural ingredients.

title: Starbucks Doubleshot Mocha: Energy, Nutrition, and Great Taste
text:
Starbucks Doubleshot Energy and Coffee Mocha Drink is an energizing drink with an interesting flavor and a large amount of nutrition. This beverage contains added ingredients for energy, with a taste that is creamy in texture and combines coffee, mocha, and caramel with a little bit of herb in the background.

This Starbucks beverage has many positive qualities. The drink includes guarana and ginseng, both for energizing qualities and for anti- oxidant benefits. If I didn't already know that ginseng was added, I wouldn't have been sure it was there. I say this because, while you can certainly detect something in the background, you cannot tell that the taste is due to ginseng or guarana. This is nice, because it doesn't distract from the overall flavor, yet it is there, adding this slightly herbal quality to the taste.

Probably the most important quality of this beverage is its added nutritional value. Starbucks Doubleshot Energy and Coffee Mocha Drink is loaded with several vitamins, offering large doses of several important vitamins that exceed one- hundred percent of the recommended daily allowance. Dieters will not like the high carbohydrate level, but the significant level of vitamin nutrition easily makes up for this fact.

I like flavored coffee drinks and I enjoy Starbucks. With Starbucks Doubleshot Energy and Coffee Mocha Drink, you get the great taste of Starbucks in a cold beverage that can be enjoyed at home any time of day. It is a tasty, creamy mocha drink, offering a good deal of energy and nutrition to get you going.

title: Good Nutritional Value, but Essentially Flawed
text:
Everyone should drink more water, or so we are told. The problem is that water is plain and boring. It needs some flavor, and many companies have responded to this demand. O.N.E. Coconut water with splash of pink guava is one such product. It contains coconut water along with guava juice for a unique taste.

I like the taste of coconut but I am only so- so on the flavor of guava. Still, I decided this drink was worth a try because as long as it emphasized the coconut, it would be fine. Unfortunately, this isn't the case. O.N.E Coconut Water with a splash of guava is misleading in its naming, because you taste more guava than anything. Even then, the taste is rather unexciting. Even lovers of the flavor of guava will likely find this product a letdown.

Nutritionally, O.N.E. Coconut water is very good, with low calories and a large dose of vitamin C and electrolytes in each serving, and more potassium than a banana. The sugar content is a little higher than some would prefer, but it isn't too bad and, unlike other sweet drinks, you get a good deal of nutritional trade- off for the sugar. Each time I take a sip and feel dissatisfied, I keep reminding myself of the nutritional benefits.

Along with the bland flavor profile, there is one other problem I have with this drink, and that is the packaging. It is sold in a small foil box, which is ordinarily not a problem, but there is no included straw. There is an opening at the top that must be pushed- in to open, but the manufacturer doesn't include a straw. Thus, you have to use a fork or some other device to forge an opening. Then, you must carve out just the right shape for drinking from the box OR have another glass handy in which to pour the liquid.

I wanted to like this beverage but when all factors are considered, I must rate O.N.E. Coconut Water with a splash of guava as a below average product. The coconut flavor is masked by the guava, the taste is unexciting, and the packaging is flawed. Yes, you get a good deal of nutrition so the product isn't a complete bomb, but there are other, better tasting products on the market with equally good nutrition, better taste, and more sensible packaging.

title: Blueberries and Coffee Combine for a Tasty Beverage
text:
Flavored coffees are a vast improvement over the bitter, standardized coffee from the past. Manufacturers have created some tasty concoctions with their coffee, and Green Mountain is one of the recent pioneers in this crowded field. This company makes many different coffees; some more traditional in flavor and others a combination of fruit and other taste sensations. Wild Mountain Blueberry is one of the fruity blends and it ranks as one of my favorites in the fruit/coffee section of the market.

Green Mountain Wild Mountain Blueberry Coffee sounded unusual when I first heard about it. I wasn't so sure the flavor of blueberries would match the taste of coffee. But this product easily exceeded my expectations and I can now see why so many people rave about this coffee. The scent alone is very enticing, with its blueberry muffin- like nose and caramel undertones. The taste is also very nice, with flavors of blueberry, coffee, caramel, and a touch of butter. I appreciate that Green Mountain decided to go easy on the blueberry flavor when they formulated this coffee. Too much fruit flavor would take away from the contributions from the coffee. The balance here is very nice.

This coffee product is sweeter than the average brew and it would make a great beverage for a hot breakfast. My experience with this flavored coffee has been confined to the workplace, but I have sampled a cup or two in the mornings when breakfast has been served at my place of employment. The taste is perfectly compatible with most any breakfast food and it made my breakfast even better than usual.

I like coffee much more today than I did in the past, and the main reason for my newfound interest is the plethora of flavors offered by so many different manufacturers. Green Mountain Wild Mountain Blueberry Coffee is one of hundreds of flavored blends and it offers a tasty alternative to the average brew. I love blueberries, and this flavored coffee offers a nicely balanced hot beverage that tastes good with food or all by itself.

title: Big Nut Taste from Planters
text:
Planters Big Double Peanut Nut Bar is a newer granola bar from a company that knows a few things about peanuts. I have been enjoying Planter's peanuts for as long as I can remember and when I heard about these granola bars, I was anxious to give them a try. With Planter's peanuts and granola, it sounded like a winning combination.

Planters Big Double Peanut Nut Bar, like the name suggests, contain plenty of peanuts. Looking at these granola bars, one can clearly see the peanuts, along with added oats, brown sugar, and other ingredients. Other granola bars contain peanuts, so this is nothing new. But few come close to matching the amount of peanuts used in Planters Big Double Peanut Nut Bar. The peanut- enhanced flavor will bring joy to the taste buds of peanut lovers everywhere. This, balanced with the great taste of granola and other ingredients, make these nut bars better tasting than most competitors in the granola/breakfast bar market.

These granola bars offer a nice balance of flavors. They do tend to make one thirsty, but one surprise is that each individual bar contains only a small amount of sodium. Based on the taste and the tendency to heighten thirst, I would have guessed the sodium content was much higher, but Planter's managed to keep this ingredient under control, and this is certainly good news for the health- conscious. However, some other facts about these granola bars could make them a questionable food option for certain diets and nutritional concerns. First, there are thirteen grams of fat in each bar. If you are the type who usually eats two or more bars at a time, these numbers can add up quickly. Second, there are a few less-than-desirable ingredients. The majority of the ingredients are natural, but there are some that could raise a few eyebrows. Nutritionally, however, these bars are better than most. Each serving provides seven grams of protein and one- hundred percent of your daily allowance for Vitamin E.

I enjoy granola bars and I enjoy the taste of peanuts, so Planters Big Double Peanut Nut Bar is a product to which I have taken an instant liking. These bars are a little more costly than some and there are only five bars in a standard box, so they aren't likely to last very long. But they are still a product worth trying. The great taste of peanuts, peanut butter, and granola combine to make a very good- tasting snack for morning, noon, or night.

title: Start Your Day Right, With Quaker Chewy Chocolate Chip
text:
I like to grab a pair of granola bars in the morning as I head to work and Quaker Chewy Granola Bars Chocolate Chip make a good choice for this type of breakfast. They offer a decent amount of nutrition for such a small amount of food and the ingredients are mostly wholesome. Combined with a small amount of milk or other beverage to wash them down, they make a great way to start the day. I also like the sweet, grainy taste and the chewy texture, which is better than some of the crunchy granola bars that can often be a chore to consumer.

Even though I like Quaker Chewy Granola Bars Chocolate Chip very much, there are a few possible drawbacks with these granola bars. The first one is the fact that they are not very filling. If you don't plan on eating lunch for a long time afterward, then you might want to reconsider Quaker Chewy Granola Bars Chocolate Chip because they are likely to result in a growling stomach in a relatively short time. The reason is because they lack sufficient fat and calories to keep you going for very long. The other potential drawback is the addition of high fructose corn syrup in the manufacturing of this product.

If you are worried about budgetary restrictions, you will be pleased with Quaker Chewy Granola Bars Chocolate Chip. These bars are not very expensive and the surprising fact is that, compared to other granola bars, they often rank in the bottom half in terms of overall cost. This is surprising when you consider that they carry the Quaker label. A premium, quality name like Quaker should, one would assume, carry a premium price. But Quaker has managed to keep costs under control and it offers these granola bars for a price that is lower than most other name brands.

Granola bars will likely remain part of my daily eating routine and Quaker Chewy Granola Bars Chocolate Chip rank among my favorite breakfast bars. The ingredients are a little worrisome, and the carbohydrate level is too great for those on low- carb diets. But these are still very tasty bars and they are priced right.

title: Tastes different...but in a good way!
text:
I have been buying this product for a while now. Time for a review.

First I wanted to address the nasty comments some people wrote about their jars arriving open...well, after ordering for a while my last box arrived with one jar (out of four) broken. I contacted Alovitox to let them know and they replied in less than an hour apologizing for the trouble and they are sending me a replacement right away. See? No need to be mean if you don't try to solve the problem. No company can read minds that I know of.

I chose this product because I have several health issues that prevent me from eating regular honey or straight up maple syrup (more on that below)...for a little while I could not have yacon syrup because I was suffering from SIBO (Small Intestinal Bacterial Overgrowth)...don't judge :) lots of people are walking around with this condition and don't know it! the reason I had to stop for a bit was that the syrup is high in what is called FOS (Google it please) so if you have gut issues like I did you might want to heal your gut first and then continue with this syrup.

It is worth clarifying that the syrup is healthy! I could not eat many other foods high on FOS during my gut healing time, including onions, garlic, apples, kale and a bunch of other healthy and delicioius foods.

Now to the good stuff. The taste.

I am a very very picky person when it comes to food. Going with me to a restaurant is anybody's idea of a nightmare LOL. And I definitely went without anything sweet for a long long time because I am hypersensitive to all sweeteners natural or otherwise. That distinctive metallic taste of stevia and others just stays with me...even when I prepare coffee for my hubby (who, luckily will eat anything and any sweetener) if some particles of stevia or monk fruit fly in the air I can feel it in the back of my throat.

So, it's been established: I am frustratingly picky when it comes to food and particularly sweeteners.

I use yacon syrup when I make my own chocolate bars and also for any home made desert.

For those of you who are as sensitive to the taste of yacon as I am to any other sweetener: try adding a bit of organic grade B (which is darker and richer) maple syrup. I like the taste of yacon very much but on Sunday paleo pancakes day I do splurge and mix it with MS...it is SOOOO good!

text:
Gave this product five stars based, not on flavor (which is very personal), but on the fact that this is the purest stevia powder I was able to find...although the fact that the label reads "94% stevia" in barely legible letters makes me wonder "what is the other 6%?" "and why not write it clearly and visibly in the package?" So that's for the main technicalities...

I give this product ** FOUR STARS** (instead of five) as far as flavor is concerned merely because my taste buds have a hard time adjusting to anything that is not organic maple syrup or honey...sadly for health reasons I decided to switch to stevia. This is a very personal taste issue...everybody is different.

Still, if you find yourself suffering from allergies or candida infections or any other ailments that would require you to give up sugar and fructose then I'd choose this product over any other. I have tried them ALL...and loved the laste of none but Truvia...but I had the unwanted side effect of actually gaining a bit of weight while consuming the latter. I should have known better, the product is made by CocaCola...a company that clearly does not have humans' best interest's at heart. The weight gain was not due to increased cravings (which I normally don't have anyhow) but to the fact that there is so much artificial garbage in it that your body literally does not know what to do with it...Google "trivia side effects or adverse reactions" and you'll see. Several studies are out there that were conducted by reputable sources.

Bottom line, to me NONE of the sweeteners taste great. But if I am going to be a grown up and do what's best for my health then you bet my money is in this product.

Side note: don't be discouraged when you receive the product, which is just a few sizes larger than the standard coffee shop individual sugar package. I baked two loaf cakes yesterday and put half a teaspoon in each one...turned out too sweet! A third of a teaspoon would have been best.

If you are reading this you are probably a health freak or someone who is starting to walk the road to your best possible health. Best of luck to you both!
