It might do if there's no real coffee in the house and you're not too discerning about the flavor. I've made several cups of this to try for this review. I'll be putting the rest in the emergency hurricane supplies.
Making a cup couldn't be simpler. Heat six ounces of water (I use the microwave) empty a packet into the cup and stir. The initial flavor was almost, sortmof, kinda like coffee. It smelled better than it tasted. As it cooled the taste drastically became worse. It's been years since I've made instant coffee, it doesn't seem they've made any real improvement in the product.
This will do in a pinch but I wouldn't want to drink this regularly.

title: Lots of Twizzlers!
text: Great for snacking. The big tub lets you have one, two or more Twizzlers and still have plenty for next time. Taste is Twizzlers, good with a bit of waxyness.

title: Interesting But Not Amazing
text:
First and foremost I don't think this product is really designed to compete with the 'other' peanut butter cup candy. You just can't. They've been around forever. This is its own product so I'll make no comparison to the 'other' peanut butter cup candy.

That being said this is a Butterfinger flavored peanut butter cup and the idea is a good one. The actual product is a bit less exciting than the concept. I love Butterfinger candy bars but due to some dental problems I've been unable to enjoy them for quite a few years. These taste... something like Butterfinger candy bars.

Something like... The outer chocolate is a little plasticy. The quality is a step above poor but not rich and creamy like a quality chocolate. The inner filling is very sweet and does taste of the original candy bar. There are little crunch bits scattered throughout the peanut better filling.

The candy is somewhat thin. The cups are packaged without paper liners. They're just sitting on a cardboard sheet waiting to melt and make a mess.

They were interesting. I enjoyed a couple of them. I don't think I'd buy them often but every once in a while? Sure. If you do order them online make sure you pay attention to the daily temperatures. Chocolate and candy items are notoriously hard to ship safely.

title: Good Affordable Coffee
text: We like the pods more than the wasteful kcup brewers. The Senseo medium roast makes a good cup of coffee. It's not harsh, weak or bitter. It's hard to find coffee pods these days but I like our Bunn brewer and will keep buying these Senseo pods.

title: Very Nice Product
text: The quantity in the bags (2.5 OZ) is generous, really too much for one person to eat at in one sitting (unless you're hungry!). There were no bad bags in the case we bought. All the product was dry and fluffy. The flavors (cherry and 'blue') are bright and distinct. These make great party favors or treats on movie night.

title: Consider your shipping location carefully!
text:
These cookies are pretty good. A little too sweet and I'd have liked a bit more actual peanut butter taste. The cookie part was nicely crisp and crunchy and the chocolate was flavored well.

My main concern is melting during shipment. I received these cookies in Central Florida via US Postal mail at the end of March. The package was brought to the door so it spent no time heating in the mailbox. Just the few days in transit caused every single cookie to melt to some degree and stick quite badly in the plastic dividers they rest in. It took several hours in the 'fridge to cool them down and even then a not insignificant portion of the chocolate coating was left behind on the packaging.

I would hate to see what these would have looked like or the mess that they would have made in July or August. I like these cookies and will probably buy them again but I'll do so at the local grocery store. Think before you order. Chocolate melts!

title: Not really my cup of tea...
text:
Yogi Refreshing Mint Revitalize Tea makes a reasonable strong cup of tea with just a couple minutes steeping. The taste of the tea however is overwhelmed by the spice note, most notably the black pepper and the mint. While the pepper gives a nice warmth to the beverage the rest of the spice family sticks around far too long. I was tasting this tea hours after drinking it. The aftertaste was mildly unpleasant.
I don't know that the few cups I've had so far revitalized me. The brew has far less caffeine than a decent cup of coffee so it didn't perk me up any more than any other tea or coffee. I just wasn't impressed. There are far better mint teas out there. I think the only time I might enjoy this tea is if I had a cold or the flu.

title: no real black tea flavor
text: This black tea has no taste. It’s weak or bland.  or old.

title: Bread is constipating
text: The bread will constipate you as though it was HIGH carb and zero fiber.

title: Highly overpriced good taste but too oily
text: This small chocolate spread is tasty but highly overpriced a bit too oily.

title: So so ok😒
text: These Yupik macadamia nuts are not as good as the macadamia nuts from Costco. I am a bit disappointed.

title: Enjoyable keto bread but overpriced
text: I am enjoying this keto bread but it’s way too expensive so I won’t buy it much.

title: Going bad
text: Has a crunchy nice spicy taste but they are going bad. Arrived in a clear garbage like plastic bag with a sign that read “sell as is”

title: Some of the filbert hazelnuts are going bad
text: Some of the filbert hazel nuts are going bad

title: Excessively Overpriced-rip off for tiny cartons
text: I did not realized it was 8oz. This is such a rip off. This is so overly priced. They are tiny cartons not worth $20 at all. This is ridiculous. Amazon allows sellers to do this to customers all the time.

title: This ratio keto friendly product has sucralose.
text:
Results indicate that SUCRALOSE may elevate blood sugar levels in new users but have little effect on regular consumers.

SUCRALOSE can modify intestinal microbiota and may eliminate some of this good bacteria, leading to inflammation of internal organs, like the liver.

SUCRALOSE may alter hormone levels in your digestive tract, leading to abnormalities that may contribute to metabolic disorders like obesity or even type 2 diabetes

Metabolic alterations caused by SUCRALOSE can lead to glucose intolerance, which increases your risk for diabetes

Cooking with SUCRALOSE is dangerous.

In high temperatures — such as during cooking or baking — SUCRALOSE can disintegrate, forming potentially toxic chlorinated compounds.

Artificial sweeteners like SUCRALOSE are marketed as sugar substitutes that don’t raise blood sugar levels, making them a safer choice for diabetics.
While these claims seem promising, they have yet to be confirmed by multiple large studies.

Studies have found sucralose to have little to no effects on blood sugar levels in individuals of average weight who regularly used SUCRALOSE.
But more recent research suggests that it can cause blood sugar levels to spike in other populations.

A small study found that SUCRALOSE elevated blood sugar levels by 14% and insulin levels by 20% in 17 people with severe obesity who didn’t regularly consume artificial sweeteners.

These results indicate that SUCRALOSE may elevate blood sugar levels in new users but have little effect on regular consumers.

For individuals with diabetes who do not produce insulin or do not respond to the hormone properly, a spike in blood sugar levels could cause serious health problems.

If you have diabetes, you may want to limit or ELIMANATE your SUCRALOSE intake.

what is picnic bacon? from google = "Picnic bacon is from the picnic cut, which includes the shoulder beneath the blade. It is fairly lean, but tougher than most pork cuts."

old - no mention of smoke flavoring

often, to me, smoke flavoring tastes sweetish. i don't care for sweet bacon.

howdy y'all,

this is a good product. taste's good, easy to use, [mostly] predictable and priced pretty well, too.

_however_ ... the last two 12-packs eventually developed moths and moth grubs. ick! [*grin*] i had eaten three of the packets already and when i when to get the next one i found grubs [worms] and moths in the bags. NOT all of them - one packet in the 2nd box seemed ok.

so, lets see ... out of 21 packets there was ONE that had no [visible] bugs. i had already eaten 3 packets.

how many bug eggs did i eat? [*grin*]

now, i KNOW that one of the gotchas with organic and/or all-natural foods is the higher loss rates to pests. so it's not a _total_ surprise to find bugs hatching out.

it is however, unacceptable.

i admit that i had left the boxes setting in the pantry for more than three months. i was in for another round of chemo and just didn't eat anything that wasn't on my approved foods list. still, the fact that ONE packet had no bugs - and that NO bugs were loose in the box that held the packets - seems to mean that the bug eggs were on the product before i got it.

i suppose i'll try this product one more time. but it NEEDS to be store-able for a few months for me to be able to buy it in the rather large quantities it is sold in.

take care,
lee

text: Delicious and pretty easy to make… I googled some recipes and it’s basically a hot skillet with a little oil and butter and garlic and three minutes on each side but you have to get a good sear here so the skillet has to be real hot. But delicious and pretty big scallops! fairly easy to make. I will have this in my freezer as go to.

title: Tasty at first
text: Tasty at first… But after a short time I believe it went bad giving off a very petroleum gasoline type taste. I think mangoes have a tendency to do that.

title: Delicious and so much cheaper then most brands
text: Delicious and much cheaper than most brands. The only drawback being that it’s almost the whole pepper you are getting so you have to do a little bit more slicing or chopping. But also it is only slightly roasted so it is a very firm pepper that you can use in a variety of ways. I make them with garlic and oil and salt and pepper, but because these are less cooked I also chop them up in a mango salsa. I will remain a buyer of this for sure and always have them in my pantry!

title: Wow!
text: Wow! Absolutely delicious! Needs nothing added… Creamy buttery deliciousness, and so quick and easy to make. No need to ever peel a potato again…

title: Ick. Sucralose. Read the description my bad
text: Sucralose is extremely sweet and strange and unnatural and goes through me like a freight train as it does other people. This stuff was nasty but it’s partly my fault for not reading the description more carefully. Nuclear waste

title: Only 12% fruit juice?
text: Only 12% fruit juice? I didn’t realize it until after I bought it but that seems like a low percentage to me. Also I found it to have a slightly medicinal aftertaste.

title: Ducking felicious
text: So delicious! I looked up a recipe on the Internet a little water a little oil some tarragon salt pepper and parsley microwave for 6 to 10 minutes depending on how many fillets. Moist flaky wonderful! However this last delivery I only got three fillets in the box and I was a bit disappointed.

title: Not bad. Not good.
text: Not bad. Not good. Sort of tasteless. First off the sauce was pink not white. I hope I didn’t get a bad batch and I’ll be up all night driving the porcelain bus. It smelled OK it just really didn’t taste like clams. Very disappointed.

title: It is what it is… Namebrand, reasonable price!
text: It is what it is… Namebrand, reasonable price! It’s not like I’m gonna do use it for anything to eat or drink, I’ve bought it because I’ve seen a lot of antique collectors suggest mixing it with three parts water and a bit of lemon juice as a non-toxic non-abrasive cleanser. Definitely less expensive than some of the name brand things like Windex or fantastic and less mystery ingredients…

title: Yummy and convenient
text: Yummy and convenient… I mean, Motts applesauce is there any other? I like the little individual tubs and the fact that it doesn’t need refrigeration. FYI, if you have digestive problems on occasion remember BART… Bananas applesauce rice toast. I very rarely have bananas around and I’m not making a pot of rice if I’m having digestive problems so the toast and the applesauce is a good home cure.

title: Not as good as the regular lemonade
text: Not as good as the regular lemonade, But at the time I ordered the regular lemonade was unavailable. I love the regular lemonade, I think the peach flavoring added some thing not quite right to it.

title: Original is the best
text: Original is the best… Can’t say I particularly cared for the other two flavors, but that’s because I was looking for something to go with cheese. The original flavor is buttery and delicious. If you’re looking for more of a pita chip than the other two flavors are OK I suppose but not for me.

title: This stuff is incredibly delicious…
text: This stuff is incredibly delicious… And the price wasn’t too bad but the delivery was three times the cost. I have found similar on the Internet for less money but I don’t think they were the Merlot. Either way this cheese is a out of this world variation on a cross between Swiss and Parmesan Reggiano. Absolutely delicious!

title: Convenient
text: Convenient. Every once in a while I’ll make some thing that calls for a clove of chopped garlic and I don’t keep garlic around the house like that all my vampires have left. So this product is good for just a bit of garlic to a recipe and it’s better than the powdered stuff.

title: Absolutely delicious!
text: Absolutely delicious! I think the burgundy wine really adds a unique and delicious flavor. A certain richness. And I detect a hint of Parmesan cheese in the sauce but I could be wrong. But this sauce is absolutely delicious, I miss is coming from a nice Italian boy.

title: Delicious and versatile!
text: Delicious and versatile! I love this stuff. And I don’t particularly care for orange juice, this is so much better. Also makes for killer adult beverages. And it’s got vitamin C so that’s good… I have already subscribed here on Amazon I want to have it in my home at all times…

title: Tasty and substantial in size…
text: Tasty and substantial in size… A bit pricey though. For those that say they are chewy that is just the nature of some clams. I threw them into a can of White clam sauce towards the end of the cooking process and it made for a substantial improvement. However I have found some others on Amazon that I am going to try because they are less expensive. But that doesn’t take away from the fact that these were good.

title: Wow! Beautiful!
text: Wow! Beautiful! Big suckers. In a pot of boiling water, cover and remove from heat for ten minutes… peel and eat heaven! With cocktail sauce of course.. 3/5 update… I think this last delivery was bad. Normally the shrimp are perfect this last delivery they were kind of mushy and tasted off. I can’t complain the other 10 times I’ve ordered it they were delicious.

title: Yummy little bunches of guar gum!
text: Really tasty little bastards but filled with tasty little test. “Mmmmm mom! More sodium casenate soy protein isolate polysorbate #60!?!? Please!?!” When my hungry family says more I say yes to protein isolate polysorbate! Who cares if my grand children are born with three eyes and a tail! Yummy yummy for now is all that matters and the little bastards shut up for 5 minutes as they’re shoving them in their pie hole. I like the convenience and they love the taste!

title: Delicious right from the jar!
text: Delicious right from the jar! I’ll usually make sliced beets from the can with oil salt and pepper and Bermuda onion. These were slightly different having a vinegar base but needed absolutely nothing. I had them straight from the jar and they were delicious. I’m guessing the canned sliced are a better bargain but these will be nice to have handy when I just want something even quicker. And beets are pretty much on every diet so they’re good for you.

title: Hard to say…
text: Hard to say… Truffles have a very earthy taste sort of like mushrooms. Also a very distinct taste. I think they should be used sparingly. These chips were very truffle flavored a bit too much I think.

title: Excellent value!
text:
Excellent value! If you love Anchovies like I do this is a good deal. They are very fresh and firm and of course buying in bulk makes them more reasonably priced.

1/13 update: just had some on crackers, I think these anchovies taste better than other brands. Strong anchovy taste, very fresh.

title: Nice healthy portion!
text: Nice healthy portion! Foil pouch kept it very fresh. I microwaved it for a minute with a bit of olive oil and lemon pepper and it came out delicious. I suppose you could eat it straight from the package but I made a hot meal out of it with a side of rice and it was very satisfying and filling! It is on my subscription list now, can’t go wrong with salmon it’s so good for you

title: Delicious and perfect size portion
text: Delicious and perfect size portion. I’ll pop it in the microwave for a minute with a side of basmati rice, a quick and healthy meal! Uncle Ben’s makes a microwave basmati rice that’s ready in under two minutes so I am really saving a lot of time in the kitchen!

title: I always keep a few of these handy…
text: I always keep a few of these handy… Whenever a recipe asks for fresh lemon juice ain’t gonna happen around this house I’m not squeezing lemons when I’ve already got enough to do in the kitchen. A squirt or two of this stuff is just as good to me.

title: So delicious!
text: So delicious! I just discovered this cheese and it is so delicious. Sort of salty sort of dry yet creamy? And they say you shouldn’t eat the wax skin, but I have no time to peel that paper thin stuff off and i’ve  had worse in my mouth. Trust me you can eat it wax skin and all. They also warn that freezing change the texture, I froze it and if it did change the texture I didn’t notice because the taste was so incredibly delicious. Everyone I have suggested this cheese to that have tried it have also loved it.

title: Meh
text: Meh. Tasted OK but the regular StarKist white chicken with your own ingredients taste better. And I believe this is a bit pricier.

title: Absolutely delicious!
text: Absolutely delicious! I have bought this from several different vendors and this is reasonably priced and just as good as some foreign vendors. It’s a firm slightly salty creamy cheese that you’ve just got to try. I double checked and it freezes sort of OK too

title: Just don’t read the ingredients…
text: Just don’t read the ingredients… Delicious little cake, sort of a ring ding on chocolate steroids, just don’t read the extremely lengthy ingredients because I’m sure they are  a molecule or two away from floor polish. But yummy!

title: Buttery.
text:
Buttery. Very tasty, but I’m guessing loaded with tropical oils that are not the best for your cholesterol. I could hear my arteries clogging as I ate them but I didn’t care. I had them as a treat with cheese Christmas Eve. Delicious!

Update: I just read the ingredients no tropical oils! My bad. A lot of corn syrup but corn syrup is one of my favorite food groups.

title: Perfection!
text: Perfection! Delicious, great price, quick delivery! I suppose I’m partial I just love cocktail sauce. I could eat a shoe with cocktail sauce on it. And McCormick is a trusted namebrand you can’t go wrong.

title: Not bad.
text: Not bad but not great. I am an unfair judge however. When I was a kid back in the 70s my family had a small boat and we would pick them fresh from the Long Island sound. To this day I’ve never had them that good even at expensive restaurants. These were good on top of pasta just OK

title: A great start to my Christmas Eve Italian Fishkill!
text: A great start to my Christmas Eve Italian Fishkill! So easy to make right from the freezer, just boil water throw them in frozen take the pot off the flame and wait 10 minutes or so till they turn whitish pink. Give an ice bath and serve with cocktail sauce, absolutely delicious! I think I’m going to be treating myself to this more often!

title: Pretty damn good!
text: Pretty damn good! Can’t go wrong for the money… I looked up how to cook them frozen and followed the Internet directions and they came out great! With cocktail sauce of course. A real treat for my Christmas Eve Fishkill. I will be ordering again. The shrimp were a decent size, very satisfied. And I could eat a shoe with cocktail sauce on it so that doesn’t hurt.

title: Delicious!
text: Delicious! A great addition to so many meals! I add some to Smoked salmon fillet and basmati rice, really makes a special meal! Come summer I’ll be putting it on burgers and franks from the grill. Can’t wait!

title: Big ass bag of dark chocolate!
text: Big ass bag of dark chocolate! If you like dark chocolate this is for you! A lot for your money! Firm dark chocolate.

title: Just OK.
text: Just OK. Nothing spectacular just white rice. Convenient little microwave portions. Can’t complain. It is what it is.

title: Everyone makes rainbow cookies differently!
text: Everyone makes rainbow cookies differently! I found these to have a slightly unique flavor I’ll bet more chocolate than some other brands or bakery items, also a bit smaller than average rainbow cookies, but very enjoyable.

title: Very nice!
text: Very nice! Maybe not what you’d get from your local Italian bakery but all things considered very tasty and fresh and fairly priced and delivered to your door very satisfying treat! I will order again!

title: Pretty good all things considered…
text: Pretty good all things considered… I mean it’s not like you’re going to get in Rome, but decent for a decent price. I enjoyed it. Prosciutto is hard to find in certain stores so this was convenient as well…

title: Quick and delicious!
text: Quick and delicious! 90 minutes in the microwave and you’re good to go! Plus the basmati and jasmine rice have such a unique flavor. Perfect rice every time no muss no fuss. This is going to be in my pantry at all times from now on.

title: Delicious way to add garlic to a recipe or meal
text: Delicious way to add garlic to a recipe or meal. Sometimes I just want to add a little garlic to some thing like pasta or rice and this is perfect. I think it’s just the right amount of garlic and it went very well with some pasta tossed lightly with tomato sauce. I will be ordering again in the future. March 6, 2013 update… Stuff tasted good at first but now I am starting to feel like it is glop. Maybe if used sparingly OK but too much tastes very processed.

title: Very tasty, surprised at the color

title: As good as the name brands!
text: As good as the name brands! Obviously less expensive. A slightly unique flavor to it. A bit hotter at first. But after a few bites it mellows out and is very tasty, the honey comes through. I will be buying again in the future!

title: A little bit of Italy!
text: A little bit of Italy! Reminds me of the prosciutto, salami, sausage I had in Italy. Just remember to pull the thin skin/membrane off first. I’m sure the skin is digestible it’s just a bit chewy. Just delicious! I’m going to subscribe to get it monthly!

title: Not bad not great

title: Delicious and reasonably priced!

I chopped some with mango and red onion and a dash of hot sauce for a salsa. The remainder I will add garlic and oil to and use that way.

title: Delicious and reasonably priced!

title: I found the flavors to be slightly medicinal…
text: I found the flavors to be slightly medicinal… The cherry lime especially. I suppose it’s because I am only used to Stevia sweetened drinks… I’m not sure this has any sweetener at all added…

title: Don’t have much to compare it with…
text: Don’t have much to compare it with… but for what it’s worth I found it quite tasty! I’m no chorizo expert, I just had it sliced with crackers. I will experiment with my own version of paella which will just be rice and chorizo and some type of seafood. I did notice people saying it was a bit chewy they may not have noticed the thin layer of plastic that needs to be peeled away maybe that’s the problem.

title: I paid for one jar and I got one jar…
text: I paid for one jar and I got one jar… Not sure what other reviewer’s are complaining about $23 or whatever. I paid $11, I got one jar and it is delicious! A bit pricey but you get what you pay for sweet red pepper is pricey to begin with. I am going to try it on salmon!

title: Not bad as a mixer.

title: Damn these are good!

text:
I've been eating sunflower seeds for over 50 years! tried many many many brands, and just1 brand were of great size and taste, the Original JUMBO seeds from Klein brothers in CA. that was about 15 yrs ago, and now JUMBO seeds are anything but jumbo. seems like they are Davids seeds in different packaing. bleh! too small, hard to open, bland.

FINALLY, I found these seeds from South Forty. just got them today and opened right up. so like other reviews, I found the shells to be oddly shaped...long, thin/flat, but easy to crack open. the actual seed inside is indeed larger than Davids (bleh!) these are best eaten one at a time, not a mouthful..IMO. the long thin shells are like splinters, and I can imagine them stabbing my gums if I ate them that way...which has happened with Davids (bleh).

I had ordered from South Forty's web site for their FIRSTTIME discount of 10%, but it took over a week to get here. free shipping yes, but same price as amazon at $31 for the 6 pack of the 8 oz packages. they are tasty, bigger seed, NOT over salted IMO.

I'll definitely be ordering them again, even at about $5 per bag, I've spent more on Davids (bleh) and never really enjoyed spending about $4 per bag...for what? bleh! :) btw, if you can't order, look elsewhere until they are back in stock here.

title: Change is Not Always Good
text: I have eaten dozens of these, and have always been very happy with them, until this recent shipment.  The delicious brand of hummus that previously came in the box is now gone, replaced with a GoPicnic brand, and it's just not very good.  The hummus separates, so there's a pool of water next to the dried up mass of hummus.  The recipe for hummus doesn't call for water, so not sure what that is exactly, but it was kind of nasty.  The GoPicnic meals are a GREAT idea, and there's a real need for them, but for the price, there shouldn't be any issues with quality.  I'm afraid I may have to break up with GoPicnic.

title: If You're Thinking About This as a Gift, be Sure to Check the Pictures.
text: I love the tea, and have no problems with the assortment, but I'd hoped to give this to someone as a gift, and the packaging just isn't nice enough for that.  The box is fine to keep around the house, but it's a shipping box sealed with a VarieTea label stuck on the outside.  You need to slice through the label to open the box, and the teabags were just stuffed inside.  It was a little bit of a disappointment since I now need to find something else to give the person these were intended for, but I don't blame VarieTea because they don't claim these are in a gift box.  Instead, I blame myself for not checking the customers' photos before ordering.

title: Don't Touch Anything!
text: I love KIND brand foods, and thought I would try these bars since I like so many of the others.  The taste of this bar is terrific.  My problem is that unlike any of the other KIND bars I've tried, these are unbelievably sticky.  You won't be able to eat one of these at your desk at work, and certainly not while driving the car, unless you have a wet-wipe handy or can immediately wash your hands afterwards.  Even touching the inside of the wrapper by accident leaves a sticky mess everywhere.  Still, the taste is great, just like all the other KIND bars, and there are no issues whatsoever regarding the quality of this product, but it's a little inconvenient being unable to eat one without washing my hands.

title: One of the Best Teas.
text: I've been on a journey to find the teas that would become my favorites.  I need some variety, and I wanted to find teas that would satisfy the whole range of reasons why I might have a cup.  Now that I've arrived at my quartet of favorites, it's no surprise to see Harney & Sons in 3 of 4 top spots, and this delicious green tea is one of them.  I generally didn't like most flavored greens, preferring the delicate [[ASIN:B001714V1U Harney & Sons Japanese Sencha Green Tea]], but this tea has such a bright flavor & delicate sweetness that I know I'll always want to drink this. If you're looking for wonderfully decadent (but still kind of Zen) experience, drink your wonderful Harney & Sons tea out of a proper vessel like [[ASIN:B00FYHCQA6 Lenox Federal Platinum Tea Cup and Saucer, White]].

title: The Tea for Me.
text: Thanks, tea-drinking Amazon Reviewers, for convincing me to try the tea that ruined me forever.  I drink a variety of teas, or I should say I did drink a variety to teas.  No more. Still, I would like to personally man-hug Mr. Harney and each of his fine sons, and absolutely in the overly-long and ultimately awkward way.  I don't care.  I'm blinded by love.

title: The "Creamy Foam" is Scary.
text: Remember when International Coffees were just instant coffee, sugar & flavoring?  Not anymore.  Now, the hot water you pour into your cup magically creates thick cappuccino foam from...something.  Maybe it's from something as ubiquitous as cellulose gum, I don't know, but every time I drink a cup I feel like I'm swallowing a science experiment.

title: Best Instant Period.
text: I love this coffee.  I'm not generally a fan of instant, and I'm not a fan of chicory, but this smooth, delicious coffee is by far the best instant I've ever had, and I would put it up against many brewed coffees.  I've taken the leap and cleared my counter space of a coffee maker.  I use a French press for fresh ground coffee, mostly on the weekends, and drink this during the work week.  I also take a jar to work and make my own coffee there, because office coffee is swill.  This coffee is so smooth and non-acidic that you can make a really strong cup of it and still enjoy the taste.  I get it auto-delivered from Amazon, which knocks 15% off the cost, so I'm a happily awake customer.

title: Tastes Great!  (Take Your Blood Pressure Medicine)
text: Come on, Uncle Ben.  You get it so right with the plain brown rice version of these easy microwave packs, with only 15mg of sodium (1% of RDA), but these Whole Grain Medley versions are salt bombs, with 690mg of sodium, which is a whopping 29% of recommended daily salt intake.  Why make it so salty?  The rice cooks perfectly and would taste great without all the salt.  It's hard enough to find healthy food that are easy to prepare, without taking something that sounds healthy, making it otherwise, and selling it in a case of 12.

title: A Little Piece of Heaven with a Bow on Top
text:
Warning: The aroma and flavor of this product are extremely intoxicating. Handle with caution. One whiff of this panettone may cause excitability, with sudden episodes of granny-slapping, table-dancing, woo-hooing, mmm-mmm yummy sounds and an uncontrollable urge to send the kids to boarding school, move to Italy and get a job in a bakery.

This is, without a doubt, one of the most delicious things I have ever tasted in my life. But it's even better than that. When you open this beautiful, lovingly-wrapped package, you will not believe the rich, wonderful aroma of this Italian masterpiece. It's simply indescribable. Don't be surprised if you bury your face in the package over and over again just to experience the delicious aroma. I certainly did.

For those unfamiliar with panettone, don't be fooled by comparisons to fruitcake. The panettone is more the consistency of fresh-baked bread than a dense fruitcake, and the flavor is much lighter and fresher. The candied lemon pieces add a delicate sweetness, not tart or over-powering, that perfectly compliments the fresh ingredients used by the Sorrento bakery. It's perfect for tea, or with a dessert wine, and I would imagine that french toast using this panettone would qualify as the 8th deadly sin.

When the product becomes available again, order it and order it and order some more. Give this exquisite panettone to everyone on your shopping list, and order many more to savor yourself. You'll hide them from your family members. They'll find you in the linen closet covered with panettone crumbs. I'm serious. It really is that amazing.

I warmed it up to see if that would change after but no, it still stunk and the two tiny bites I took tasted worse! After storing it in the fridge I went back and threw it all completely OUT! I actually put some dish soap in the garbage disposal when I ran it to make sure its and it's smell was gone. Was this "just" a bad batch? Everything was sealed as it should have been. Is this what you get with the "convenience" of a pouch??? Makes no difference to me now. Never, ever. Ever again!

title: Simple to make and super easy spruce up!
text: Follow packet directions to make regular hot sour soup, then add a little cubed firm tofu, a few matchstick carrots, a few sliced mushrooms, 1 scant tsp. sesame oil, 1 T. soy sauce, 1 T. ponzu sauce, 1/4 tsp. white pepper, 1/2 c. cooked basmati or jasmine rice, a dab of garlic paste (Aldi) and a dab of ginger paste (Aldi).  Add-ins are "to taste."  White pepper can make it a little hot, so go easy at first.  Sesame oil is very easy to overdo, so add a little at a time to start.  Lots of other combinations are possible.  Instead of greasy fried wontons, I substitute cooked rice to make a whole meal.  Other options are a few bean sprouts, bamboo shoots, water chestnuts and/or a little cooked pork or cooked chicken.  Yields 4-5 large servings with additional ingredients.  Nice flavor!

title: Family is addicted to the taste!  PET warning, however!
text:
We will never go back to sugar. Delicious and prescribed by our dentist. I learned that it's been used in other countries for 30+ years, because of the health benefits. So I checked with my regular physician and discovered he's been using it for many years as well! When asked why on earth the U.S. doesn't use it instead of sugar in kids' treats, he explained that it is cost prohibitive. Plain sugar is approximately $1.00 per pound, Xylitol costs 5-6 times that amount.

Beneficial to dental health and is used in some countries as a nasal rinse to guard against or treat sinus problems, according to some studies. One study I read about found that school children showed significant improvement in dental health when given Xylitol-sweetened treats vs. sugar-sweetened treats. Another pediatic dentistry study showed a 40% reduction in tooth decay! So why don't we use it here in the States? Fillings, crowns and extractions are more expensive and painful than using Xylitol.

Dr. John's Xylitol fruit flavored suckers are offered (under the brand name Smilemakers) at my dentist's office for children and adults. They taste like the old-fashioned Lifesavers candies - though a little stickier - and leave your mouth and teeth feeling clean and fresh.

Walmart and other department stores have begun selling brand-name chewing gums with Xylitol.

My mother, brother and his family are now addicted to the taste as well. It actually TASTES better than sugar to us all and dissolves more quickly. Sprinkling the granulated Xylitol over foods exactly as regular sugar would be, we can tell the difference only by the way our teeth and mouth feels. Xylitol leaves your mouth feeling tingly and fresh. I have used it in beverages, baking and cooking with no problems whatsoever. Sweetness ratio is 1:1. I have not attempted to make fudge with the granules, as I hear this can be tricky because of the melting and cooling properties.

Bulk granulated Xylitol recently became available at my local 14 Carrot Whole Food store for $6.05/lb. This Amazon item is priced at $6.60 per pound before shipping. I have switched to my local store, simply because when we run out, I hate to use other sweeteners (even honey) while waiting for my delivery. Wonderful for diabetics. Xylitol can actually lower your glucose levels according to this info from the University of Sydney.

The glycemic index (GI) is a ranking of carbs on a scale from 0-100 according
to the extent to which they raise blood sugar levels after eating. Foods with high GI rankings
are those which are rapidly digested, absorbed and result in marked fluctuations in blood sugar levels.
Low-GI foods, by virtue of their slow digestion and absorption, produce gradual rises in blood sugar and insulin levels,
and have proven benefits for health. Low GI diets have been shown to improve both glucose and lipid levels in people
with Diabetes (Types I and II). They have benefits for weight control because they help control appetite and delay hunger.
Low GI diets also reduce insulin levels and insulin resistance.
The GI ranking for Xylitol = 7.
The GI ranking for Honey = 58 !

!!!!!!!! WARNING TO DOG OWNERS !!!!!!!!
Xylitol carries warnings that it is considered LETHAL if ingested by dogs (even in tiny quantities like a piece of gum or candy). The effect on cats is not conclusive yet, but I have 3 cats and won't let them near anything with Xylitol in it, just in case. If you use granulated Xylitol or use Xylitol gum or candy, please make certain the Xylitol is not left where your pets may have access. If you cook with it, please do not let your pet eat the food containing Xylitol. Be careful of granule spills if you have dogs.

text: For decades, I would always make pancake mix from scratch (and to be honest, it's really not that difficult to do so.)  But now that I have less time and perhaps out of laziness, I've switched to this product.  It's REALLY EASY.  Literally all you do is add water to the fill line (on side of jar), put lid back on and shake vigorously to mix.  It's not always that easy to get the mix at the bottom to mix with the water and their suggestion of tapping the bottom doesn't work.  But the mix turns out just fine.  It doesn't make the nice fluff, airy pancakes that you can get from homemade mixes but it makes perfectly fine, tasty regular pancakes.  And you can't beat the convenience.  They're great to have on hand even as back ups.  This particular size (10.6oz) I found too large for just my son and I but the smaller size is perfect. title: I've only used it once or twice but it is pure, from a good source, and has many uses.
text: Not sure what to say about this yet. seems to have a neutral flavor, which is what I wanted because I didn't want to buy the crap that's on the shelves at the grocery store. You don't know their source of gelatin. However, I found early on that you do not, and I repeat not, need a lot of this product when making jello, or jello- pops, and things of that nature. I used way too much, and had more than I needed! I was making so much jello and so many jello pops that I won't want anymore for the rest of the summer! I also bought it because gelatin is a good source for helping the condition of skin and nails, and also for gut health. I have a lot of gut problems, and I'm hoping this will help alleviate some of them. It's too soon to tell at this time.

title: Very good gluten-free cereal at a very good price.
text: The cereal is very tasty and crunchy and has a flavor similar to a name brand, popular, corn puffs cereal. It is very sweet, and I wish it had a little less sugar in it. It is not expensive, especially for being gluten free, and I buy it on a regular basis.

title: Good blend of good tasting sweetener as good as sugar.
text: This blend is very very sweet. It's ideal for cooking and baking. If used in beverages or on cereals, I would suggest using half as much as you would sugar. It has a good taste, no aftertaste either. It's well packaged in a plastic bag and for the price, you get a lot of product, especially considering you don't use as much as you would other sweeteners.

title: Impressed with this tea more than others I've tried. makes good hot tea and iced tea.
text: I have to say it's probably better than most other teas I've tried. I will say that it's steeps well and quickly. you don't have to wait all day for a good cup of tea. It makes good iced tea also, faster than others I've used. I got more than one cup and more than one pitcher out of 1 or more tea bags. That's not usually the case with other teas. It can get very strong and thick pretty fast, so I watched it carefully until it was the consistency that I liked. It does have a full rich flavor and has that little bit of green tea bite, but it's not extremely tart.

title: A big bag of tasty chips! You don't feel any air in this bag!
text: This is a big fat bag of chips! they are very salty however, which I didn't like because I don't eat a lot of salt.  the more I ate, the more I craved. They weren't too greasy or oily tasting. They have a very good flavor to them and were very crunchy, but not overly cooked. I would definitely buy them again, other than them having more sodium than I prefer. They also weren't very expensive, especially for the quantity that you get!

title: Good meat, good value.
text: Keystone meats are very good and tasty. They taste fresh out of the can and you can do a lot with them. I use them to make chicken salad, creamed chicken, or just eat plain with crackers. I think it's a pretty good value for the price, for this big of a can. I like to keep some on hand  for times when I don't feel like cooking.

title: Big box, good value, taste and gluten free.
text: I like Cheerios and this is a big box for the money. It is gluten free and still tastes good. The packaging was very good and box sealed well. No damages.

title: A good find. alternative to peanut butter and tree nut and other butters .
text: This is pretty good stuff. It's creamy, tastes good and spreads easily. It doesn't taste like peanuts but has a mild pumpkin flavor. I can't have peanut butter, almond butter, or sunflower butter, so I was so glad to find this! I put it on GF bread or rice cakes, sometimes with a little low sugar jam. It doesn't have a lot of sugar and is gluten free. If you want it sweeter, you can add some honey, agave, or stevia, etc.

title: Good flavor, quality brand, not too expensive.
text: This is pretty good. It has a mild Apple taste doesn't taste sugar free and doesn't have a lot of nasty ingredients. I make a full pitcher. I use about 6 six squirts and a  2 quart pitcher with filtered water. You can add more or less depending depending on your taste.

title: One of the best canned coconut creams with the potential of using various ways.
text: This is one of the best coconut creams I've used. I like to refrigerate it and skim the cream off the top and whip it with an artificial sweetener or cream cheese. I'll make it into a topping or a cupcake frosting. It has to be used fairly fast or it will lose its texture. It has a rich coconut taste, which I like. You can also add a little bit of vanilla or very fine shredded coconut to give it an even richer variated texture.

title: Trusted brand, good tasting for sugar-free, reasonable price.

Because I'm gluten free, sometimes I will crush up some gluten free cookies at the bottom of muffin tins, and pour the mix over those, and either refrigerate or freeze them. You can also top with a couple blueberries or other fruit, or some sugar-free jam.

title: This Diamond Is Not In The Rough!
text:
As a Knife Maker who only uses high end woods for handles I'm always seeking Quality and Variety.
Cut Off and Sample Packs are a way to Try to obtain those - a method that is normally very disappointing.

I saw this box though and calculated that for the weight it wasn't actually a bad deal, pretty good, even when shipping was considered - roughly the Weight of 3 of the boxes from the 'other guys' at basically the price of two.

So I ordered.
Contacted Diamond with some questions and got Fast, Excellent customer service from Kevin.
Then I waited - but not long - the package got here quickly.
When I went to open it I found it was basically double boxed and, on top of that, the wood inside was bound.
Packing way beyond anything else I've seen.

Then I got to the wood itself.
I wasn't merely 'happy' or 'satisfied' - I was Blown Away. Each type of woos was labeled on one side...with measurements on the other side. There were no thin or small pieces. The quality of each wood would be 'Good' to 'Outstanding'. Several pieces would stand out as ones I would have been happy to purchase as individual pieces.
And the variety...well...
A large piece of highly figured Mango.
Several decent pieces of Monkey Pod - one Good, One Very Good.
Three Very Nice pieces of a variety of Coyote Wood with excellent figuring.
Several pieces of Teak. One good and one that was absolutely Top Of The Line.
Nice piece of Indian Rosewood.
Good piece of Tigerwood.
Several nice pieces of Spanish Cedar.
A splendid piece of one of the Mahogany's.
A wood called Ceiba that has some nice spalting.
I'm probably missing some...
Thing is, these aren't scraps or small cut offs - every single piece is usable for Multiple Knife handles and, while they say 25 lbs - package was 27.
No complaints there!

So they've impressed the heck out of me and now have my future business.
Don't let the shipping worry you - do the math!
Also, this Is a US Based company, so you don't have to worry about International Shipping.

I have not a single complaint and view this as one of the best purchases and deals for my business ever, in regards to woods. Will probably pay for itself 10 times over.

Highly Recommended.

title: By far the best Nespresso compatible capsule coffee I have ever had
text:
I am admittedly a bit of a coffee snob (certainly not James Hoffman-level, but a guy has to have standards) . The fact I sometimes use a Nespresso Essenza MIni machine at all is merely a testament to my laziness - sometimes, you just want to push a button and *presto* you have coffee.

My favorite coffees are usually from Latin America, and Guatemalan beans are among the best coffees I have ever found. I admit I had medium hopes for decent Guatemalan espresso from a capsule, but I was very surprised to find this was actually very good.

Better than any other Nespresso original compatible capsules I have found. This is deliciously rich, and the chocolate/sugarcane flavor I so love about Guatemalan coffees is indeed present, although I will admit it feels like something ay have been added to enhance it.

Still, on a scale of 0-10, where 0 is the cup of stale decaf I had this afternoon (different review - came from a third party seller - oops), and 10 is a cup of Urth Caffe Guatemalan Four Estates Organic Fair Trade coffee (sadly, extremely hard to get lately), this is a solid 7.

I should note that number is the highest I have ever rated any Nespresso-compatible capsule coffee. For reference, Starbucks standard dark espresso capsules are a 6, and are about as good as you can normally get from a capsule. I am very glad I tried these--I would be even happier if they added these to subscribe and save so I could save a few bucks.

Highly recommended.
