title: Plentiful Potatoes & Ham are lost under added fake smoke flavor
text: Very heavy artificial smoke flavor that over rides almost everything else. It's a shame, because the basic ingredients and texture of this soup are pretty good. It's creamy and full of actual chunks of potatoes, pieces of real ham and corn. It's not very salty either and could be awesome with the smoky flavor used as an enhancement instead of as the main event.

title: Great for shipping to the troops in a care package
text: My husband loves these. They taste great and are each individually wrapped so he can toss a handful in his pocket at work and they don't get icky through out his day. Easy to travel with as well and the bags ship well to the troops overseas, always a bonus when you're filling a care package!

title: Handy individually wrapped & easy to ship to troops overseas
text: Love these Lifesavers in the big bag. They are individually wrapped so a handful can be tossed in a pocket on the way out the door easily. Plus the big bag is nice to ship to the troops in Afghanistan - easy to share and they don't melt etc in transit.

title: Wow - a great glass of tea in seconds!!
text: I tend to be wary of sweetened drinks because they usually use some funky fake sweetener or whatever is trendy that week. The result is usually a nasty aftertaste. Not in this case! This Celestial Perfect Southern Sweet iced tea is excellent. I have found my normal big Texas iced tea glass full of ice and one Kcup is dead on right. It's just sweet enough, no after taste, no chemical flavor and it's just strong enough to taste like real tea. Plus it takes less than a minute to make.

title: Good flavof, easy to ship to the troops!
text: I love this Del Sol salsa in the single serve packets. The flavor is good, it is NOT very hot though, so if you are looking for a fiery addition to your morning eggs or a burrito, be prepared to use multiple packets or buy something other brand. However, the Texans on our "care package" list over in Afghanistan really like this salsa and it ships well overseas! Glad to see it available on Amazon.

title: Tastes like water & nothing else
text: I love the Avitae caffienated water - both this and the 90mg version. It tastes like plain water - no chemical aftertaste and no bitterness. I have been swapping one or two sodas a day with this water. No sugar and no calories yet I still get that caffiene lift. I will keep these on my auto subscribe order from now on.

title: Light roast, no aftertaste, hint of praline
text: This is a light type of coffee. The pecan praline flavor is good, but not as strong as say the Butterscotch or vanilla flavor versions. It's more a hint of praline taste - though it smells wonderful while brewing! The best way to describe it is if you broke up an actual praline into a cup of hot coffee - gives the faint taste of the candy, but doesn't knock you over. I add a bit of real milk and a spoon of sugar & it's pretty darn good on a cool morning. NO chemical taste and no funky aftertaste like some of the other flavors out there - no bite of fake sweetener either now that I think about it.

title: SOOOO good - like a warm butterscotch candy
text: LOVE this Butterscotch flavored coffee! Smells like the best memories of fall while it's brewing and tastes even better. No chemical aftertaste, no bitterness at all. This is a light, smooth coffee with just enough Butterscotch flavor to make you think about the old fashioned hard candy, but not so much that you feel like you drank a dessert. Add a bit of real milk and it's sort of a decadant treat that can't be replicated at the over priced coffee houses.

title: Excellent flavor, no after taste, smooth
text: I cannot abide plain coffee so I've been sampling all the flavored coffees for our new Keurig machine. Some have just been too strong for me, too bitter, or too chemically tasting. (Husband calls me Coffee goldilocks) So I was delighted to realize the Folgers Caramel Drizzle was just right. Sort of a smooth, silky feel in the mouth, mild to medium roast and not too strong at all. The caramel flavor is light and not overwhelming, but it smells GREAT while brewing. It's not quite sweet enough for me (that being said, it IS lightly sweet on it's own). I added a teaspoon of sugar to a 7 ounce cup and literally a splash of milk and it was perfect. Fortunately this is also available regularly at our local grocery store as well as Amazon. And for less than the third party sellers are offering it.

title: Fresh and SUPER fast shipping from seller!
text: Having returned from New Orleans and realizing I had not brought home nearly enough pralines, I turned to online sources for my addiction. These arrived in good condition, not broken up during shipping and they were fresh. Creamy and melty when you take the first bite and loads of pecans. The shipping was amazingly fast for a non Prime order and I will definately come back to order more in the future.

title: Cute cup shaped basket, overpriced
text:
Ok, let me say this first off... if I had spent $30 to $50 on this gift basket and sent it to a friend, I would be seriously angry. The items inside the basket are few and far between. The cup shaped basket is really cute, but not worth the overall price of the package.

Two individual tea bags, that tasted good, but that's all, just two single tea bags. A single serving of powdered instant coffee mix in a "latte" flavor - it was weak. A tiny Ghiradelli chocolate & carmel candy bar that was good, but again, just the one. A tiny sampler size of chocolate truffles, rich flavor and tiny. A box of chocolate wafer cookes that were very good and the single box did have 8 bite size cookies in it, so you could share with a friend. A single chocolate biscotti - not very sweet, just right as a complement to your cup of coffee. And a packet of hot chocolate mix - haven't tried it yet, but again just enough for one serving.

If this is the actual size of the entire gift basket (rather than a sample size for the Vine program), then just give it a pass. You can buy the individual items in larger quantities and a cheap, equally cute basket at a hobby store - put it all together and save some cash AND give a better present!

title: Very strong cinnamon flavor, lightly sweet
text: I tried this new Chai Tea Latte with no preconcieved expectations. I have never been a big tea drinker and have only had chai tea a couple of times in the past. It has a very strong cinnamon scent and flavor. The marjoram and other spices are easily detected as it brews into your cup. As with the other Dolce Gusto latte flavors, this tea is lightly sweetened with sugar and none of the fake sweeteners. Personally I prefer sugar - the fake stuff can cause intestinal upset and who needs that? I normally add two teaspoons of sugar to the vanilla or carmel lattes, but that was way too much sugar for this Chai Tea. One teaspoon and the drink is just right, you can clearly taste the tea and the milk doesn't overpower the overall spice flavoring. I'll buy this again to put in my daily rotation.

title: Cool stuff! Pretty presentation
text:
This was a cool basket of goodies. I wasn't sure what to expect honestly. There were two little packets of specialty flavor coffee, two different kinds of cheese sticks & cheese biscuits, a packet of cheese & spice dip, a box of spaghetti, chocolates, box of garlic crackers, and a can of cheese stuffed olives from Spain. Most everything seemed to be from Italy or Spain. The basket is a standard little woven job with cute leather handles. (It'll make a fine container for the trick or treat candies)

The chocolate covered cherries were very rich and indulgent. The hazelnut mousse chocolates were extremely rich, everyone agreed though that the cherries were the best of the two items. The cheese straws were cheesy and not overly crunchy - tasted fresh. My father is an olive nut - he can tell the difference in types of olives under all circumstances and there is always some type of olive on his table. The can of cheese stuffed olives was good - he liked them, I find olives a tad salty normally, but these were quite nice. We haven't had a chance to make the coffee yet or cook the pasta, but if the other items are any indication, there won't be anything yucky in this basket. I would feel good sending one of these as a gift to family or friends.

title: Smooth, sweet, smells wonderful
text: I tried this new Caramel Latte Macchiato for the first time today and WOW! The Vanilla Latte has been my favorite of the Dolce Gusto coffees since I bought my Piccolo, but this Caramel Latte is tied with the Vanilla now. It smells so good brewing - sort of like the best caramel apples at the state fair combined with a hint of pecan pie baking. Inhaling it made me think of the first fall frosts. The taste is smooth and silky and there is no doubt this is a caramel flavored coffee - the Vanilla is a hint of flavor and this one is not shy or subtle in the least. I normally add a teaspoon of sugar to the other flavors, but this one is sweet enough on it's own to not need any additional sugar. Make sa very nice after dinner coffee or late afternoon soda replacement.

title: Excellent coffee for a home machine!
text:
I have never been a regular coffee drinker and rarely indulged in a latte or cappucino. The local coffee house and Starbucks are just so overpriced, it seemed like an insane daily expense. However, after vowing to reduce my Dr Pepper consumption, yet still needing the caffeine, I bought the Nestle Dolce Gusto machine and a variety of the various coffees for it. After three months I find I am drinking two or three of these per day and have cut my cola habit in half and significantly reduced my sugar intake as well. (Nice bonus there!)

The Latte Macchiato is a good one. It's got a simple flavor without being too strong or bitter. The milk doesn't have alot of sugar (no artificial sweeteners). I do add a teaspoon of sugar to the entire drink. I tend to make my latte larger than the portion size suggested on the box - I don't care for really strong coffee. The Vanilla version of this drink is lightly sweetened & flavored - this one is not. You could add a shot of caramel syrup to this to "fancy" it up for guests very easily. I like this one so much I've done Amazon's Subscribe & Save plan with it. Compared the local big box store prices per box, Amazon's prices are about $1.50 cheaper per box!

title: Light hint of vanilla, smooth easy flavor
text: We've been trying all the different flavors for our new Dolce Gusto machine and this one is pretty darn good. I've never been a vanilla fan per se, but I really like the Vanilla Latte flavor. It has a very light, a mere hint really of vanilla in the milk. When the machine is steaming & applying the pressure to the milk pod, you get a faint aroma of vanilla as the mug fills. The flavor is delicate and doesn't overwhelm the rest of the coffee. I like a sweet drink so I have to add a hit of sugar to all of coffees, so while it says it's a lightly sweetened latte, they really mean LIGHTLY. The main thing I do like is that Nescafe is not using fake sweeteners (like splenda etc)so you don't get a funky aftertaste with any of the flavors. This Vanilla Latte is one we'll be ordering from Amazon in the three packs. (we've been buying each flavor in single boxes at the local W-Mart)

title: Nice flavor, single serving, super easy to cook
text: While this isn't the best ever curry mix available, it IS pretty good. What makes it worth buying is the simplicity. You literally just boil the bag in a pot of water, cut it open and pour it over cooked rice (or noodles) and you're done. Instant curry dinner for one. (or two if you are just snacking) The box is marked "Hot" and it's got a decent level of spice or heat, but it's not hot by my standards, if you're looking for fire breathing hot curry, you'll want to add some spices of your own and do some doctoring here. But again, for a quick curry fix or snack, it'll work fine. There are some small carrots & potatoes in the packet already & they are ok, totally edible. I usually cook a small lamb chop or pork chop to add to the rice for a full meal after a busy day - makes a nice enough cold weather meal with a favorite movie type of thing.

title: Excellent Halloween Handouts

Six bags of single serve peanut butter cups  ready to pass out to the trick or treaters - plus a couple of extras for snacking on between hordes of kids at the doorstep. These are regular size candies rather than those chintzy tiny "snack" size which explains the pricing. I for one, found that a pleasant bonus actually. I will totally buy these again - beats standing in line at the grocery store!

title: The only salt my husband will use
text: I have always felt that salt is salt is salt.... my husband however is another story all together. He brought a number of his own customs to our marriage and Real Salt Sea Salt was one of them. He won't use anything else and scowls ferociously at all other inferior salts I've tried to introduce to our kitchen over the years. I will give him this... the Real Salt does taste better than any of the other stuff out there, but it is a bit more expensive than the plebian grocery store stuff. I finally decided it's worth the price difference if he's happy and cooking (means I don't have to!) The fact that I can find this stuff on Amazon AND use our Prime shipping totally made my day!

title: No heat, but super easy to cook and good flavor
text:
I really like this product for it's simplicity. Essentially a single serving of pre-made curry in less than 5 minutes - what's not to like? You toss the packet in a pot of boiling water for five minutes, cut it open, pour over rice and you have a meal. It's also possible to microwave this curry, but it's easier if you just boil the packet instead. The flavor is good and carrots & potatoes are already included (also they are not mushy or overcooked) so all you need is some cooked rice and if you choose a little cooked beef, lamb or chicken and you have an entire meal with almost no trouble at all.

My ONLY complaint and the reason for 4 stars instead of 5 is that the medium hot should really be called mild. There is no heat at all to this curry - if you want heat, bring your own and add it. This company (brand) makes the same product in a black box that is called "hot" and while I don't consider it truly hot by an stretch, it does have some heat and thus a little more depth of flavor. I much prefer that version to this one in the green box. However, in a pinch, craving a single serving of curry and being too lazy to do all the work of cutting/cooking fresh veggies etc either of these versions will totally work. ESPECIALLY if you live in a place with zero Indian restaurants and no Indian food options in the local grocery stores.

title: Just right for a light lunch or snack on the run

title: Great snack for the troops & movie watching
text:
These taste great, salty and meaty - they hit the spot late at night watching a horror flick or action movie with especially bad acting, but great special effects. Being single sticks in single serve wrapping they also make excellent items to put in your care package to our troops in Iraq, Afghanistan, etc. Slim Jims don't melt, go stale or wilt in the heat or at the bottom of a pack out on a march.

Granted these things are so not health food - I mean come on... the whole point of junk food or comfort food is that it tastes great and makes you happy. Period. If you're worried about calories or sodium intake, then you need to be shopping for something all together different like lettuce or carrots. Don't slam the Slim Jim for being what it is - we all KNOW what it is... it's a greasy, fatty, salty stick of meat in a little plastic baggie made to be eaten in 3 bites with a cold mug of beer in the other hand and a bag of Fritos as a side dish.

I was buying packs of ice breakers at the grocery store, but realized that it ended up being pretty costly and created a lot of plastic waste. This is a far better option. text: I love to take these to work so i am not tempted to order delivery which kills my wallet AND my waistline. I was happy with how quickly this shipped, and I really liked the cardboard packaging this came in that keeps all of the packs of rice neatly lined up. It makes storage in my pantry easy and tidy. I'll throw this in the microwave for an easy meal with soup or beans.

title: They were nice and crispy and turned golden in the oven
text: I'm not gluten free but I got these because they are vegan. They were nice and crispy and turned golden in the oven. I would definitely get these again!

title: Macaroni
text: while shopping at my local nutritionsmart for another brand of vegan macaroni, I found this instead and decided to give it a shot. The instructions were simple and I added a couple of fistfuls of fresh spinach before I baked it.  I was impressed by the simple list of ingredients but was completely unimpressed by the texture and flavor. I make much better vegan macaroni and cheese from scratch. My advice to people who are interested in vegan gluten free macaroni and cheese is to check out Daiya or make it at home yourself. I will not be repurchasing this.

title: Red lentil pasta
text: I really like the texture and taste of this pasta, and the fact that it is only one ingredient is awesome. Be sure to mix it with your sauce immediately after you drain it or it will get pasty and stick together! Also, prepare to be pretty gassy after eating it...it's a lot of beans after all!

title: Hits the spot!
text: I love this product! I usually just use nutritional yeast on salads, pasta, and pizzas, but when I'm really looking for that Parmesan flavor I'll use this. I will be repurchasing and telling my friends about it.

title: Loved it!
text: I brought this to a party last night with some fancy vegan cheeses and crackers and it was a total hit. My vegan and vegetarian friends really liked trying caviart. The texture and flavor were both really nice. With the little bit I have leftover, I'm looking forward to trying it on vegan sushi.

title: Very salty, but still good.
text: I picked up a pack of this at my local health food store tonight to accompany some mashed potatoes. I was happy with how affordable it was and how easy it is to prepare! It is suuuuper salty, though, so I'm glad I under-seasoned my potatoes. I mixed in some green peas and poured it over the mashed potatoes and it made a delicious, simple vegan meal. I also really like the simple ingredients! I just wish it was a little lower in sodium. I would recommend to a friend and I will definitely be repurchasing!

title: Perfect.
text: The texture is AMAZING! Like chickens eggs, the flavor is pretty bland without some salt, pepper, or hot sauce, but it is easy to make (just mix with cold water and put in a hot oiled pan) and just like that, a perfect duplicate of scrambled eggs, minus the cholesterol and cruelty. I've made breakfast tacos and sandwiches with them. My only concern is where will I get more eggs when I'm all out?!

title: Texas barbecue
text: This review is for the Texas barbecue flavor jerky. I impulsively picked some up at my local health food store at the check out a while back, and finally got the urge to try it this morning. I don't think the flavor fits the name very well. When I think of Texas barbecue, I think of a tomato based sauce. This was more like smokey teriyaki, definitely not the Texas barbecue I know. That being said, I otherwise really enjoyed the product. The texture is really nice, not too chewy or dry like I remember traditional meat jerky to be. I will definitely be repurchasing these to keep in my handbag for when I'm feeling peckish. Very satisfying!

title: Delicious!!
text: The tomato cayenne makes an AMAZING vegan quesadilla. I adore this product. It is now a repeat purchase, as well as the original creamy flavor! They do melt a little too, which is nice it doesn't have the same meltiness as dairy cheese, but the flavor is absolutely to die for. I highly recommend!

title: Love the company, not the sausage.
text: I've purchased these sausages twice because I've had so many people tell me how much they love them so I decided to give them a second chance. I'm not sure if it is because of how I've cooked them, but I really don't love the texture of these sausages. I've chopped them and sautéed them and mixed them with spaghetti, I've put them on a vegan pizza, and I've crumbled them and put them in lasagna and I still am not convinced that I like them. I like the flavor, but as far as texture goes, it's not my favorite grain based meat. I do, however, LOVE the field roast Chao cheese.

title: A staple!
text: I prefer the original variety of veganaise to any other type. This is a staple for so many vegans, it is tried and true! This makes a delicious chick pea salad.

title: These are definitely a favorite junk food of mine
text: YUM! I actually used to pick these up all the time before I went vegan, not realizing they were vegan LOL. Now I grab a bag whenever I make the half hour drive to Whole Foods. Totally worth it, these puffs are addicting! I have to hide them from my cheese loving roommate and my boyfriend. These are definitely a favorite junk food of mine!

title: Convenient & tasty.
text: I really liked the white sticky rice, it made a great lunch at work. My only gripe is that it's a little expensive compared to when I usually make rice in my rice cooker. I understand that convenience is worth paying for!

title: Coconut milk posing as soup.
text: I bought the coconut soup when my local health food store was having a sale. I like all of the Amy's soups I've tried so far, but this one wasn't a hit with me. It tasted good, but it was far too liquidy for me. I prefer my soup a little chunkier or thicker. If I hadn't poured this soup over rice, I would have just felt like I was drinking a can of coconut milk. If I repurchase this again, I'll add more sweet potato and some jasmine rice.

title: Convenient, tasty.
text: I mixed the jasmine rice with the tasty bite Bombay potatoes and it made a great lunch! I may start ordering this product on Amazon, since it's cheaper than purchasing individual bags at my local health food store. Good to take to work.

title: yum!
text: I picked these up at my nutritionsmart so I could take them to work for lunch. I like that the back says VEGAN right at the top so I don't have to scour the ingredients list for animal products. I mixed the Bombay potatoes with their jasmine rice (would have gotten basmati if they had it in store) and it was very tasty! Not too much spiciness, a good amount of sauce to mix with rice or dip naan into. It says two servings per container on the back, but a whole bag + a whole bag of their jasmine rice was the perfect amount of food for me. (I eat a lot.) Overall, I would definitely repurchase!

title: I really liked the taste and texture of the meal and the ...
text: I picked this up from Walmart the other afternoon to eat at work. As a vegan, there are few microwaveable convenience foods I can bring to work when I have no leftovers to eat. I really liked the taste and texture of the meal and the meatballs were delicious! I would buy this again, but probably not too often because they are a bit on the pricey side, and the meal itself is very small.

title: work lunch approved.
text: I got these because they were on sale at my local supermarket and I thought they'd be good to take to work. I like that they don't require any refrigeration.  Overall, eating this wasn't nightmare inducing, but it certainly wasn't gourmet. The texture, as expected, was a little strange. In a pinch, I may purchase these again. It's a better option for me than ordering out at work and spending $10+.

title: Buyer beware! Overseas packages
text:
Update 02/15/23
All packages we buy are good now. As long as they’re not tight. The family size packs form Thailand are tight and can’t be broken up. This is a sign they’re no good. I have found that if you can easily squeeze the package arrives and break it up then it’s probably going to taste good.

***08/08/22**
So packages from the UK also taste terrible. The ONLY normal tasting packages of the jasmine rice (that’s the only kind we buy) come from CANADA. shipping issues causing the rice packages to go bad? Any of these packages been sitting on shipping containers for ungodly amounts of time? There is something disgusting about the packages coming from overseas and I truly believe it’s the shipping issues! Do not consume****

***now local stores seem to be only carrying packages from Thailand and they’re all the same. Tight packaging that’s tough to squeeze, and awful taste. WHAT IS GOING ON!? I emailed Bens Original and they were ZERO help. **

I’ve ordered Bens jasmine rice before with no issue. The last time though, the package said “made in Thailand” and it tasted disgusting!! Bland, and nothing like others that say “made in Canada”. Just AWFUL! And odd since jasmine is Thai, yet the ones made in Thailand were terrible. I’ll never buy on Amazon again, I’ll buy in store and check where it’s made.

title: Great to add a few more nutrients
text: We use this product sprinkled over popcorn or added to potato dishes. It adds nutrition, and tastes a lot like parmesan cheese.

title: Thinner, but taste is fine
text: This product is a little thinner than the brand I normally buy.  I like the container. It is easy to handle and store. I would buy this one again.

title: It's okay, nothing special
text:
This comes in a nice, re-sealable bag. But I always store salt in glass jars for freshness.

I can't say there was anything special about this salt. It was supposedly melted to purify it, then re-crystallized for use in cooking. I don't make kimchee or anything like that, so maybe that is why it seems like nothing special. It is a nice salt, but I prefer the himalayan salt I normally use.

Overall, there is nothing wrong with this, but nothing special enough to purchase it again either.

title: Makes creamy gravy
text:
For those who have never tried garbanzo bean (chickpea) flour before, I hope you will try it at least once.

I've never been a big fan of gravy before, until my husband started making gravy with garbanzo bean flour. Oh. My. Gosh. What a difference!

There is no discernable flavor profile. You still need to do all your preferred seasonings, just like you would with plain flour. What this flour brings to the table is CREAMINESS. It makes the creamiest gravy I've ever had.

I hope everyone will give chickpea/garbanzo bean flour a try at least once. Yummmm

title: Great portion size bags
text:
We really like Moderna pasta. We have tried it in many shapes. The shells are our most recent purchase.

The bags are smaller, but you get plenty. The smaller bags are actually my favorite thing about this pasta. These are perfect for adding to soups, making a side dish, or even a midnight snack.

We love these and will be a repeat customer.

title: A fun addition to your baking supplies
text:
I had bought the shimmering gold from this company the previous month. It added such a great boost to our holiday cookies. So, I was happy to see that they also offered the "shimmering" in silver as well.
I'm a fan, and plan on collecting all the colors we can.

title: Not a big fan
text:
Well, this is a good item to keep in your pantry in case you run out of brown sugar.
But I have to be honest - I am NOT a big fan of monkfruit. It has a texture I don't much care for, and weird aftertaste.

Your experience will probably vary.

title: Great tasting, quick to prepare
text:
These pouches are SO tasty! I love wild rice, but it takes so long to cook it. Sometimes, you need something quicker.

These are safely sealed and microwave ready. They are a bit pricey, in my opinion, and I wish they could lower the price. But I am still happy with my purchase. They have a pretty long shelf life, and we always have these on our shelf.

title: Ridiculously small containers. Awkward.
text:
Using glitter with baked goods is still new to me. These claim to be edible glitter, but I'm not sure if they are really edible, or just cut microscopic enough to be considered edible.

The colors are nice and bright.
But these are in such tiny containers! It looks like they had extra lip gloss containers to use up. They were awkward to open.

When we got this and opened the box, the purple glitter had already leaked all over the package. The container lid was not on right, so the contents went all over during the trip.

All in all, I did not care for the containers at all, and I'm very leery about ingesting the stuff that came in the tiny containers. I cannot recommend this one. They are overpriced for what you get. I certainly will not buy it again.

title: Yummm!
text:
This sauce is the perfect dipping sauce for chicken nuggets or french fries. To me, it tastes very similar to "Mickey D's" sauce.
I haven't tried it on a hot dog yet, but will.
It leans more to the sweet side than the tart of mustard, but that's why I like it.
We'll definitely buy this one again.

title: Wayyyyy too hot
text:
Oh my goodness!! NO!!
This flavor brings way too much heat for our family's taste. This stuff sets your mouth on fire right away. It literally made the roof of my mouth and my throat hurt like I had burned them. Then the heat stuck around.

It was overwhelming and very unpleasant. This rice just punished your mouth.

I know some people enjoy really spicy, peppery hot foods, but we do not. We added some soy sauce and it toned it down about 1/40th. 3 tried it and 3 rejected it. My adult son ended up throwing up later on, as it did not set in his stomach either.

Hard pass unless you like to put lit matches in your mouth and call it dinner.

title: My new favorite rice
text:
I had never tried parboiled rice before. So, after learning what it was, I got a bag. I love it. Less rinsing and trouble than other rices.
It's now my first go-to on rice. We make it in the crockpot, so we have plenty for other meals all week long.

title: Fun addition to decorating baked goods
text:
We haven't made any baked goods since receiving these. But, the glitter is super fine.

The color assortment is very nice. You don't get a lot of any one color, but you'd likely use this sparingly anyway. I'm planning on using this on Valentine's Day cupcakes.

title: It's Franks!  Grab that turkey and bring it over here
text:
How fun is this? It is about time Frank's came out with this. Other brands have had injectors for quite a long time.

We love Frank's Hot Sauce at our house, because we are not into searing heat that melts taste buds away. Frank's adds a depth of flavor, not literal heat.

Very happy with this product. It's hard to go wrong with this one.

title: Cereal is good
text: We love Wheat Chex. I bought this one to make chex mix. I buy this cereal often, but will not buy it on Amazon again. Disappointing experience.

title: Our guys' favorite snack
text: Everyone at our house loves Jack Link jerky. They have really found the sweet spot on balanced seasoning. We are happy long-term customers.

title: Very tasty...has a sweet aftertaste
text:
We tried this on hamburgers. I thought it was pretty good. My daughter did not care for it.

It left a sweet aftertaste in my mouth, which is something I very much liked.
She found it gross! Ha ha! Taste is so subjective.

Anyway, definitely leans to the sweet, but was pretty good.

title: YUM!  Great flavor
text:
[[VIDEOID:ea0de69631eddd5169063c9194dfa82d]] Ty Ling makes three flavor varieties of fried rice. We got the Garlic and Ginger rice today. We love fried rice, so tried one right away. I thought these were going to be in microwavable bags, but they are actually in small trays slid into a cardboard sleeve.

They suggest pan frying as the best method. But, since we had just finished doing dishes, we were not going to dirty a pan. We opted for the microwave directions. (Be sure to peel the seal off, as it has metal in it.) I suggest covering the tray with wax paper or a paper towel, as the rice pops a bit.

Now, if you want 100% authentic Chinese food, this isn't it. But if you are like most people and enjoy Chinese takeout, try this.

This item not only looks good, but it tastes very good too. We split one package. The seasoning had a perfect blend of flavors, with the ginger coming through just a bit more than other flavors. No complaints, just mentioning it.

You could easily add a protein like shrimp or chicken to this one and have a great meal.

We'll definitely be repeat customers on this one if the price point comes down. Right now, I think it is too high for what it is
Very tasty though.

title: Amazing stuff
text:
I never liked gravy before, until my culinary student husband started making gravies with this chickpea flour.
So smooth!
So creamy!
So tasty!!

It turned me into a gravy lover! We also use this to coat chicken. Great product with a great flavor and consistency. We are regular customers, with Bob's Red Mill being the favorite brand.

title: We all know ramen
text: There is not a lot to say about these. We all know and love ramen noodles. We rarely use the seasoning packets that come with them. We buy these for the little quick-fry noodles. They are easy to add to recipes of all kinds. They help stretch soups or stews, and make great snacks.

title: Great for using with air fryers
text:
We love these non-aerosol oil sprayers. The flavor is good, and the spray is just right for coating foods that are going in the air fryer.
(We have tried two other kinds of manual sprayers where you just add your own oil, but they never work right.)

We'll continue to be happy customers as long as they keep the price within reach.

title: Not my favorite sweetener, but it is a quality product
text:
I have to say upfront that I am not a huge fan of xylitol. I did use it quite often when we were doing a low carb diet for nearly a year. I am not a fan of the cooling sensation it gives me on my tongue.

That being said, I still like to keep things on hand to be ready for any recipe I want to try. With this, you get a quality product and a generous amount of it. Just know to keep this away from pets - it is toxic for them.

title: Not my cuppa tea!
text:
I love green tea. I drink more green tea than any other, and love it mixed with black as well.

BUT, I didn't really care a lot for THIS green tea. Instead of a really clean, crisp flavor, this was more reminiscent of a grassy aftertaste to me. Of course, taste is totally subjective. You might experience this in a different way.

I tried it hot first, just plain. Didn't care for the taste. So I added some honey. Still a nope for me. I made a new cup of hot and tried it with a little creamer...that seemed to make it worse. I also let a cup of plain cool off and added ice...now I had iced lawn clippings.

So, I am not sure who their target audience might be, but it isn't me. This is just not something I enjoyed, and would certainly not repurchase.

title: Horrid drink
text:
Well, I was not sure what to expect, really. The description does not adequately prepare you for the flavor.

Granted, taste is extremely subjective, so your results may vary. If you gave tastebuds that work, be aware. I have tried other hemp products and been both happy and disappointed. This drink falls into the latter category.

If I had tried this blindfolded, I would have thought I was being punked, or I'd check the date to see if it was April 1st.

Y'all, this is NASTY. I tried it right out of the can, as well as poured over ice. Nope and nope all day long. This is horrible.

Not sure I can describe the taste, but I'll try. So, you have a few potatoes you just dug up from your garden that you put in a bowl. Toss a handful of dirty mushrooms into the bowl too. Now, rinse them, swishing them around in the bowl. Remove the potatoes and mushrooms, but save the water.
Pour that dirty water into a glass. Add some coconut flavoring, or perhaps a little coconut water. Stir and drink it.
And that is being kind.

The coconut aftertaste was there, but it was overridden by the taste of dirt. I never picked up any vanilla whatsoever. Maybe a lone vanilla bean was added to the vat before canning.

The ingredients are a mess as well. Erythritol, "natural flavors", monk fruit AND stevia. The coconut perhaps is the "natural flavors". They claim on the can that there are no allergens. Really?? IF coconut is in this drink, it is a tree nut and known allergen. Not sure about hemp allergen status. Then one sugar alcohol and two "natural" sweeteners. Vanilla is not mentioned, but is in the product flavor name. I tasted none. Just a mess!

Truly, I cannot recommend this in any way for any use at all. The labeling felt deceptive, the ingredients vague, and the results speak for themselves - it is disgusting.

title: Unexpectedly tasty!
text:
I have to say I was hesitant to try this. I really like coffee, but blueberry coffee? Hmmm. The company, San Francisco Bay Coffee, has a good reputation, and we've had their plain coffee before.

This is a medium roast coffee, with both natural and artificial flavors added. The company says both blueberry and honey flavors added.

You get a generous amount of 80 pods per order. This company uses fibrous pouches rather than plastic cups for their coffee pods. Just an fyi, in case that matters to you. A group of pods is sealed tightly into bags, so all the rest of the coffee stays at its best freshness...you only open and use one pouch at a time. I appreciate that, since they aren't in the traditional-style sealed cups. There were eight sealed pouches with ten pods per pouch.

I wanted to try this first thing of the day, so there were no other flavors in my mouth. I use creamer, so just mentioning it.

The pods have a slight blueberry-ish smell to them. But overall, not a pleasant smell. So, I wasn't sure what to expect on the flavor. (And I've never had ANY brand of blueberry coffee, so I had zero taste expectations or comparisons.)

I have to say, I was pleasantly surprised! The best way I can describe the taste (which, of course, is completely subjective) is that it tastes like you've dunked a blueberry cake donut into your cup of coffee. (That is in no way a negative from me, as blueberry donuts are one of my favorite donuts.) I have my preferred vanilla creamer added to it. It made a delicious cup of coffee, which I am enjoying right now as I write this review.

I would definitely buy this one again. It was an unexpected flavor treat.

title: Yummmm!
text:
We love the combo of garlic and parmesan on almost everything. My daughter makes a great chicken garlic parm.

We were definitely up for trying this product. We used it a couple of ways. The first use was on chicken thighs cooked in the air fryer. Oh my gosh, they were SO good! Definitely something to do again.
The second use was to sprinkle some on french fries right out of the air fryer. Another winner!

So this is a very tasty, versatile mix. We'll be trying it on pork chops next.

title: Hard to chew, but great mushroom flavor
text:
These packets are very convenient for making a quick side dish. The mushroom flavor of this packet is great.

This is a blend of rice and pasta, which I did not notice when I bought it. I thought it was just rice. This is actually mostly pasta (small, thin little pieces) with a little bit of rice. The ingredients list puts rice ahead of the pasta, but our packet was not like that.

Now, the taste is great, BUT - I have dental problems, and pastas are very hard for me to eat. They tend to slide around and make me feel like I am choking on them. So this was pretty disappointing to me. I realize this won't be the case for everyone.

So, if you don't mind more pasta than rice and love mushroom flavoring, this might be just right for you. Note that like so many prepackaged foods, this one "contains bioengineered ingredients". Not happy with that part either.

title: Good to have on hand
text:
I don't often cook with whole spices, but they are nice to have on hand. Everything arrived fresh and in good condition. I'll use the cloves and cinnamon for sure, but the star anise gives me a giant headache - and it isn't this brand, it is ALL anise.

So, you get decent quantities at a decent price.

title: Yummmm
text:
I love Milanos anyway, but had never tried the milk chocolate ones. These are so good!

The Milano tender shortbread cookie is so tasty. This one is milk chocolate only, no additional flavors.
I've bought them twice now, and it probably won't be the last.

title: Tastes great, but needs other help
text:
We like this flavor a lot.
I ordered two boxes. Both arrived crushed enough that they will not sit on the shelf. Hoping the inside contents survived (I did not finish opening the boxes).

title: Perfect for recipes
text:
My kids LOVE black olives. But, I don't like messing with the whole ones. These were perfect. Whether you are making a quick dip, tacos or a casserole, these small cans are great.

We will definitely buy them again.

title: Not bad
text:
I like to add a little bit of vanilla to all kinds of things. I often use muffin mixes, and a little vanilla really boosts the flavors.

This one does an ok job. It isn't as strong as I had hoped for. It is good enough to add that little boost to premade mixes, but for anything truly homemade, I'll stick to real vanilla extract. I would not buy this one again.

title: Great to keep on hand
text:
We aren't fans of really spicy foods, so this works well for us. We do the standard cheesy dip or nacho covering with a can of Rotel stirred in.

Great to keep a few cans in your pantry.

title: Great way to fix food for a crowd.
text:
If you have family cookouts or other functions where you need to cook for a lot of people, this is the way to go! It comes in a plastic jug, which helps make this liftable!
It's a good value for a good sauce.

title: Nasty stuff, poor lid design
text:
This item sounds like a good product. Carob is used in a lot of foods, so how bad would carob syrup be, right?

Well, it can be bad. In fact, it was gross. There were three of us, and we all wanted to try it. So, we finally got the bottle open, and tried a little on a finger, and a bite with a muffin.

Not one of us liked this product. In facr, it went into the trash, as no one wanted it again.

I thought about keeping it and trying on other food, but new design problem - my bottle does not seal. Yay. The cap just endlessly turns around with no grip anywhere. Since I didn't feel like holding it or sitting it on the counter with two nosy cats in the house and no one liked the flavor, we tossed it into the trash.

I am sure someone will like it and buy this one, but it won't be me.

title: Beautiful bottle
text:
Beautiful bottle.
Heavy, dark to reduce light exposure, all text easy to read, beautifully designed graphics, fonts, layout.

The first thing I notice about a product is the graphic design of the container. I love doing graphic art myself. This item comes in a large, heavy bottle. It is dark glass to reduce light exposure of the oil.

The contents are a good quality olive oil. It is fine, but I think you're paying for the bottle on this one.

title: Salt lick!!
text:
Well, I've only tried this one on one thing so far. All I can say, is this is SALTY!! Yikes. Like, overpowering saltiness.

It smells great, and the rest of the flavor (once my tongue recovered from the salt scalding) was pretty good.

Due to the salt levels alone, I will not be a repeat customer. Yuck. I love sea salt, but at least in the jar we got, this was way out of balance.

title: Pretty tasty. Definitely different. After-heat.
text:
We like to try new flavors and new foods, so we wanted to give this new-to-us spice a try.

The Sunshine seasoning mix is a little different from anything else we have had before. The ingredients include such flavorings as pineapple, mango, ginger, allspice, red pepper and maple syrup. It sounds like a very odd combo, but in reality, it works together well.

We tried this on fresh chicken thighs cooked in our air fryer. We cut the spice with panko, about a 60/40 mix, spritzed the coated pieces with olive oil spray and popped them in the air fryer.

The results were beautiful, juicy thighs. The flavor was very good. It had a noticeable after-eat heat in my throat, but nothing crazy. (I am not a fan of super spicy foods. So if you are looking for swallowing lit matches, this is not your spice!)

One thing they need to work on is the lid! The spoonable side would not snap shut and stay shut so we had to put a piece of tape on it. The other side barely snaps shut. Since the lid is what keeps it fresh, they need to maybe redesign the lid, or use a higher quality plastic.

It was a thumbs-ups from everyone here. A nice blend with no dominating notes, fairly reasonable heat and overall good flavor. Would I buy it again? Honestly, no.

title: Not bad. Good protein grams, grain free is nice
text:
We were able to try a package of Incredi-bowl Keto Cereal in the Chocolate Crunch flavor.

First off, it was nice to see a full package inside the box. So many companies these days seem to leave the box the same size and shrink the contents - this was a pretty full package.

Once opened, the first thing you notice is the smell. It smells a little bit like slightly burnt caramel to me, which I loved. Then I tried a handful. It is actually pretty good. I expected cocoa puffs, but that is not really what it tastes like. (To be fair, I eat most cereal dry. I can't drink milk, and don't care for the fake junk like almond milk. So, not sure what it would taste like in a normal bowl of milk. I eat cereal in place of popcorn. Lol) My daughter tried them in milk; she said the first few bites were ok, but the cereal quickly turned into cellulose in milk.

These have a light, sweet coating of some kind that tastes pretty good. As they dissolve, there is a flash of cocoa flavor, then pretty much nothing.

The sweeteners used are erythritol (a sugar alcohol, so do NOT let your pets eat this cereal!) and stevia leaf extract.
Honestly, I didn't like the ingredients list overall. I am sure those of us who have done low carb are familiar with most of them. The ingredients are:
- milk protein concentrate
- canola oil
- tapioca starch
- chicory root fiber
- allulose
- cocoa (processed with alkalai)
- erythritol
- sugar
- calcium carbonate (tums!?)
- citric acid
- sunflower lecithin
- tetrasodium pyrophosphate
- salt
- natural flavor
- stevia leaf extract
- tocopherols (vit E form)
- rosemary extract
___________

This is NOT a low-carb cereal, with 14 grams, minus fiber of 4 gms, leaving a net 10 grams per serving. On the box, the mfgs also deduct the allulose and the sugar alcohol and generously claim a net carb of 7 grams per serving. Whether or not you deduct those last two is probably dependent on which dietary plan you are following. Personally, I do not deduct those.

I do like that there are 16 grams of protein in each serving though.

Overall, certainly not bad.
I like that it is grain-free, and I like that protein count. But they could have found a better oil than canola, one of the worst oils out there. That slight weird sensation on my tongue is likely the cooling aspect of the erythritol. But the jury is still out as to whether or not I would be a repeat customer. It tastes decent, is grain-free and gives you a little chocolate snack.

title: Quality snacks from a quality company
text:
I was so happy to try this. I was not aware that Bob's Red Mill (BRM) had granola mixes. We love BRM's quality, and already use many of their flours, grains and steel-cut oats.

You get five flavor assortments.
There are just two of us, so we didn't want to open all of them at the same time. We chose to open the Peanut Butter mix.
As soon as you open the bag, the snell of freshly roasted peanuts. It smells wonderful. My daughter tried a big handful. She is a peanut butter addict. She thought it was great.

This is a product you can eat dry for a snack, put on top of yogurt, or grab a bowl and pour on some of your favorite milk.

These granolas are an all-around great product, and we liked them.

title: YUMMMMMMM!  Not heat, just flavor
text:
We love to try new spices and spice combos, but are NOT fans of the ones that just bring heat - you know the kind - you wouldn't know if it tastes good or not, because your taste buds have been burned off and your throat scorched. Hard pass on those!

This Peruvian spice was a new one to us. It looked good, so we tried it. All I can say is WOW. It is so tasty!!

We had chicken thighs cooked in the air fryer with only this spice and panko, about 50/50 blend. The chicken was sprayed with olive oil, then rolled in the Peruvian/panko mix and air fried. It was so good, we had it again the next night, and will be having it again this week.

It is very flavorful, but not "hot" spicy. No one got the consolation prize of heartburn from this one.

It is so good, we shared a container with my son too. We will happily repurchase this one when ours runs out. Well done!

title: Very sweet, but tastes great
text:
I tried this one just for fun.
I love blue raspberry flavor, and I caught a sale, so why not.

I get tired of plain water. So, I tried this the first day it arrived. Yummm! It is a bit sweet, but I like that. You can adjust it to taste, so it was very easy to add a few drops at a time.

This was very tasty, and I would buy it again.

title: Great taste!
text:
We got a different box than in the photo, but at least it was the right flavor. Wish we had had these during the Sharknado movie years! Ha!

Very yummo when prepared with 1/2 cup LESS cold water, cubed and folded into cool whip.

title: Fantastic bbq sauce!
text:
This is a pack of four glass bottles of barbeque sauce.
Everything arrived in perfect condition, and was packaged well.

This sauce is great! We used to buy it in Texas often, but had not seen it here in the Midwest.

It is a middle-of-the-road sauce. It is not spicy hot (yay!), but has a great tang to it. We had it with chicken nuggets. It was delicious!

title: Smells great, tastes great
text:
This is a very fresh cinnamon. It is ground and ready to go in your favorite recipes.

I like to add a teaspoon (or more!) to my favorite oatmeal cookie recipe for some extra kick.

I had no problems with this cinnamon, and would purchase again.

title: Salt that is better for you
text:
I am a big fan of Himalayan pink salt. The extra mineral load makes this a better alternative to plain table salt.

I keep this salt in a separate shaker/grinder, but leave it out all the time. I would definitely buy this one again.

title: Very happy with this one
text:
I LOVE this!
You get a very generous amount of wild rice in this bag. It is my favorite kind of rice.

I have zero complaints, amd would repurchase this item.

title: I'll stick with the dollar store tins
text:
These are good clams. Everything tasted fine, and we had no problems with them. My clam love has only included clam chowder and fried clams.

I guess I am not a seafood gourmet, because I didn't notice a huge difference between these and the canned clams we buy at the dollar store. Sorry.

title: Plenty for a lot of good cooking
text:
You get two containers of granulated garlic. They are sealed well, so freshness seems pretty guaranteed.

This is granulated garlic, not powdered. It is a bit stronger, but still perfect for tossing into stews, soups, pasta and more.

title: Tastes great, but still not a champion. Not even on the board.
text:
First off, I appreciate the humor in the name of this cereal!

Secondly, this actually tastes pretty good!
The cereal is in small, round pieces. You don't get a lot in the box, but I think this item is meant more for a small amount helpful fiber boost, not the kind of cereal you fill up a big bowl and curl up on the couch for a movie marathon.

I did not become a "champion", and in fact noticed no change at all in this area. But depending on the price point (which is pretty danged high right now), I would buy it again.

title: Too much heat for us
text:
I don't care for super spicy foods. However, these said mild, so I tried one of the sauces with chicken tenders, the al Pasor.

Whoa!! Too spicy for me. They said it was mild, but my tongue is on fire.
I actually ended up rinsing the sauce off my chicken tenders so I didn't waste them.

If you like spicy foods, you might like these. I donated the remaining two jars...these just are hotter (spice) than our family cares for.

title: Love it
text:
I love adding flaxseed to foods. It adds a little more fiber and extra nutrition to whatever you add them to. Since they are ground already, it is so easy to toss a spoonful into nearly anything. I prefer adding it to foods that will be cooked or baked, like muffins, casseroles or breakfast skillets.

I also prefer the golden flaxseed just for appearance sake. I was very happy with these, and will definitely buy this item again.

title: Not a favorite
text:
Well, we do not HAVE to go gluten free in our family. We thought my daughter might benefit from trying to get away from gluten, but this is not anything we've done on any dr recommendation.

I was not really sure what to expect, but I can say the taste was disappointing. There is so little moisture in these brownies! Not a lot of flavor at all, in my opinion. If I was to try them again (and I do not plan to at this time), I would add a few spoonsful of applesauce to it to see if the overall drywall texture could be improved upon. It was amazingly dry for how much oil it took.

Right now, I would not buy these again.

title: Not a favorite, but if you love garlic, give this a try.
text:
I don't eat popcorn any more (can't), so my daughter gave this a try.
She said it was really good, and would buy it again when this runs out.
I think you could also spray it on mashed or baked potatos as well.

title: Not sure about their packaging sanitation
text:
Well, this one was interesting.
The jar arrived only half full. Things can settle during shipment, so I'll guess they go by pkg weight alone.

Now for the main problem. The paper strip across the lid arrived broken. Odd, but I checked for an inner seal before discarding it. Nope, no inner seal of any kind existed.

The product smelled very good, but given the lack of hygenic seals of any kind, the product was not used, and was discarded.

title: Nice to have on hand
text:
These were all tossed into a box. I guess that should be expected. But as such, I saw no expiration date either on the box or the packets.

Given the chilly January weather, I wasn't worried too much about heat spoilage.

These are great for lunchboxes, for folks who can't access condiments easily (nursing homes, etc) or just to have a few handy.

title: Good for a quick craving
text:
The mac n cheese is certainly not the best. In fact, the cheese sauce has a pasty taste to it, like they are not cooking it long enough to get rid of the raw flour taste.
But it is good enough to hush the midnight snack monsters.
Note to check your cans carefully. I have a hard time getting any that are not dented.

title: Yummmmmmm!!
text:
These are orange-flavored jellies covered in semi-sweet chocolate. Think of the inside of a gumdrop as far as texture.

You get a generous amount of candy in the bag. They look a little beat up, but the food is just fine.
The only thing I would change would be to offer these in bites half the size of these slices. They are a little large, and biting them in half leaves chocolate crumbles on your shirt. Shoving the entire thing in your mouth (which I did for the rest of the bag - don't judge me!) is awkward tastiness.

The flavor was great! I would purchase these again.
(These were gone way too soon!)

title: It's okay, but not nearly enough frosting included
text:
We have never been gingerbread house folks. I've never made one myself, but thought they looked cute.

This is a kit to create a small gingerbread house. It also comes with extra gingerbread cookies to decorate and eat. The cookies tasted ok, but are very hard.

First off, I am not a fan of eating cookies that are premade so far in advance of being used. I would consider these solely as decorative.

You get several very small tubes of frosting for detail work, a packet of red frosting and a slightly larger packet of white royal icing, which provides the "glue" to put the pieces of the house together. There is a nice variety of small bags of candy trims, including my favorite, candy holiday "light bulbs".

There is definitely not enough frosting to do everything that could be done. There isn't even enough royal icing to decorate the roof completely, and definitely not like the photo examples, which was likely done by professional decorators.

I HIGHLY recommend decorating the house front, back and sides BEFORE trying to put it together. It is nearly impossible if you put the house together first, then try to decorate. It will be hard to do any details like the windows or doors. We did that first.

Once the walls had dried a while, we attempted to put it together. It comes with a white plastic tray to help hold up the sides. I put a line of regular tube frosting I had on hand to help set the walls, and used the royal icing to glue the walls together.

Once we let that sit for a half an hour, we tried to put the roof on. The roof pieces are pretty heavy. They include a cardboard support piece in this kit to help hold the roof pieces on...you'll need them! The roof weight pushed in the walls, despite them having dried for a good 30 minutes first.

Overall, the kit is cute enough. Just don't expect it to look like their photos.

Many people have wondered about the completed size. Ours turned out approximately 5" wide and deep, and around 7.5" in height (not counting the cardboard roof holder).

Overall cute enough, but not enough frosting to complete cookie works, and not worth it. I would not buy it again.

title: Smells good
text:
I had not used whole vanilla beans before, so I was looking forward to trying them out.

My plan for these is to try to make my own vanilla extract. I've read that you can use glass bottles with a tight seal to fill with plain vodka and stick a few vanilla beans in it. It takes about 5-6 months to become usable as vanilla, but that's my goal with these beans. They look good, seem fresh, and I look forward to my experimenting.

title: Nope. Hard pass
text:
We love to try new flavors, so we had to at least try this new Canada Dry flavor.

It was our first AND last purchase!
I am not sure how some of these things ever make it past the product testers.

This has a very odd flavor. You can taste the ginger, of course. You would think ginger and lemon would complement each other. They do in some foods, but NOT in this soda.

It was more like drinking cough syrup than a refreshing soda. I can in no way recommend this one, and will certainly not be a repeat buyer. It is just nasty.

title: Tasty
text:
Everything Bagel Cashew Crunch is very good. Considering we don't like poppy seeds, it was tasty. Lots of poppy seeds were at the bottom of the bag, and we left them there.

We would buy this flavor again.

title: Not low carb
text:
This is a sugar-free and gluten-free muffin mix in pumpkin spice flavor.
The packaging is very nice looking and well-designed. The colors are great and all the text is legible. It claims to make one dozen (12) muffins or one (1) loaf.

The sweetener used here is monkfruit. This is an item you'll probably have to develop a taste for - however, it is much better than aspartame.

The ingredients list is as follows:
Monkfruit, almond flour, oat fiber, tapioca fiber, fava bean protein, cellulose, psyllium husk, spices*, pumpkin, sea salt, annatto extract, baking powder and baking soda.

*personal comment - I would like to see the spices identified instead of lumped under one word. What if there was something you had an allergic reaction to? Lakanto needs to separate and identify the spices.
Also note that they use almond flour in these, in case you have tree nut allergies.

The carb count is pretty high, so these are NOT a low carb item.

title: Spicy, but good value
text:
I was very happy with this ground mustard. I like to use ground mustard when I make potato salad. I had no problems at all, and everyone liked the salad.
I love the containers too. I would definitely buy again.

title: Great, fresh tasting
text:
These were very good. You get a generous amount in a resealable tin.
When you open them, they are very aromatic. The peanuts are fresh and crunchy.
Additionally, their packaging makes them giftable.

title: Smells good, but weak packaging
text:
I have never bought coriander before, so I really can't compare quality fairly. It smells very good though.

The only thing I will say about these is that I really do NOT like the bottles they came in. They are not very sturdy at all. They crinkle when you touch them. Think super thin water bottles. I wish they were sturdier. I feel like I am going to crack it open every time I pick it up.

title: Very good
text:
I never used to like pepper. Our family only bought the stuff in tins, and while it is decent, I just never liked it.

Then my husband went to culinary school, and I started learning about all kinds of things we never used in my family. Peppercorns are one of those things.

Freshly cracked peppercorns tastes so much better and fresher than the pre-ground stuff. I actually choose to add pepper to foods now, where I used to avoid it.

These are good peppercorns (even though my personal favorite is a mix of different colored peppercorns). I keep one hand grinder just for black peppercorns. These are fresh and taste just fine in recipes.

title: Not horrible
text:
Well, I think the idea behind quinoa as a cereal product is great.
This is packaged in a plastic bag rather than a box. It has a zip top closure.

The cereal itself is in small, circular pieces, much like so many cereals. It makes for quick and easy breakfasts or snacks.

I cannot say a lot about the taste, because the bag I received had a hole in the lower back side (NOT caused by shipping), which had allowed all the cereal to become stale. So I braved a bite anyway. Aside from horribly stale, the overall taste was very neutral. I could see this being a healthier alternative, but you'll need to add some fruit or a sweetener. It is completely bland.

Meanwhile, our squirrels loved it.

title: Great for New Year's Eve
text:
These are cute sprinkles. I originally chose them because I thought they were Halloween designs in orange and black. They are not

The candies are actually more geared towards a New Year's Eve celebration. Think black, silver and gold.

The round balls have a metallic look in gunmetal gray and an orangy-gold. There are solid black jimmies, and white stars. Everything but the stars are very shiny.

Overall, perfect for NYE cupcakes.

title: Fresh, but very faint peanut flavor
text:
This is a big container!

The flavor is much lighter than previous peanut oils I have used. In fact, I am not sure that I could identify it if blindfolded for a taste test.
That part was a bit disappointing.
However, it is still miles ahead of the other oils that are created by chemically processing various vegetables.

The worst part for me is lifting the big bottle. I might look into getting smaller glass jars and filling one to get something more manageable at mealtime. I think this was probably aimed at filling up turkey friers, which usually use peanut oil because of the higher smoke point. My favorite way to use peanut oil is to toss cut up potatoes in it, which are then air fried. This oil imparted no strong flavor, which is good OR bad, depending on what you were wanting.

So, overall, decent quality oil, but very faint peanut flavor.

title: Mine had no inner seal or outer seal on the lid!
text:
Well, I am a huge peppercorn fan now. I've tried several brands and flavors.
I would love to write a glowing review for this product. However, it had no inner seal, no outer seal, and a big crack in the container. There was no way I was going to use it in that condition. It was discarded. The fact that the lid had no inner seal over the product, nor any seal around the lid is concerning.

title: Smells wonderful.
text:
This is difficult for me to compare, as I have never had anything with this spice before, and never had Indian food. I am not a big fan of super spicy foods, so I move cautiously.

This stuff smells great! It is a bit disappointing that it is in a paper zip-close bag instead of a jar. I prefer jars of some kind for my spices, for easier storage and keeping them fresher. Not sure why they chose paper packaging, but not a fan of it for spices.

title: Tastes ok, but rather misleading labeling
text:
Well, this product is a little misleading, based on the packaging. I expected white sea salt. What you actually get is a light pink salt with brown specks in it.

I do like the packaging, in that it isn't a little shaker or grinder that clogs up a lot. It is awkward to leave out all the time though, so it's a mixed blessing type of thing.

I do like that it is sourced supposedly from the Rocky Mountains. But that's a very large mountain range, and it does not specify where. So apparently, this is North American salt.

Of allergen concern to note: this says it is processed in a facility that also processes tree nuts. Really? So you package your "pure, unrefined" product in a place that also processes huge allergen products? So much for the unrefined part.

Overall, this looks and tastes like himalayan pink salt. The taste is like - salt.

Given the desperate attempt to market itself as pure and white sea salt but failing, I would not buy this again. It all felt very deceptive. And while I am thankfully not allergic to nuts, if I was buying salt, I would not have expected to be possibly exposed to nut allergens. I hope no one has suffered problems from that. Overall, the product is ok, but the label needs a complete re-do.

title: Cute idea, but not easy execution
text:
Well, this was an adventure!

I've never made cookie houses before. Quite frankly, I had no interest in trying them. But this kit was so cute, we couldn't resist.

A very important lesson on this:
Decorate the walls FIRST and let them dry. THEN assemble.
It was beastly hard to try to get frosting to stick to the vertically placed walls!!

It turned out ok. But some notes...
The green frosting is NOT a "slime" green, which would have looked great - it is more of a Christmas or St. Patrick's Day green. That was disappointing.

Having no experience with cookie houses, we mostly tried to follow the examples from the photos. There is not really enough frosting in this kit to do all those decorations.

The extra cookies are super hard. We didn't even try to eat them. We tried to decorate a couple, but as already said, there is not nearly enough frosting in this kit to do the house and all the cookies included.

Overall, it was definitely an experience...but I would have rather put the time in on something permanent, like a wooden version of this cute house.

title: I prefer the ground version
text:
I love Himalayan salt. It has a high mineral content and does not have as much effect on blood pressure.

I really liked this salt as well. I thought I would enjoy the flake style, but truthfully, due to dental problems, I prefer fine ground or run through a salt mill more.

title: My favorite key lime juice
text:
I absolutely LOVE this key lime juice!
I like to make key lime cheesecakes. Since real key limes are nearly impossible to find in my area, I rely on Nellie & Joe's Key Lime juice to make GREAT tasting cheesecakes!

I'm a lifelong customer.

title: TINY BOX
text:
If you are like me, you sometimes have a hard time picturing ounces of a product. I loved the old photos Amazon used to use with a lap or hands, showing the product size.

Got this today. I did not know Bisquick even made boxes this small. How disappointing. If I had realized how small (or read the reviews like I normally do, but thought Bisquick, use it, don't need reviews 😑), I would not have bought it.

Just do yourself a favor and shop locally for this item, so you can see what you are getting. Bisquick is great stuff. This box? Waste of money.

title: Very good, easy to prepare
text:
I am not a big fan of regular pasta, so I put the biggest fan I know - my daughter - on the job.

You get a generous amount of dry pasta. It comes in a brown sack-like bag. Be careful...I got stabbed by a random noodle.

I did a generous handful of pasta in the skillet to cook it. I was thinking along the lines of pre-boxed "helper" meals. But I ended up transferring it to a pot of boiling water.

I like the nice big noodles. I used a premade alfredo sauce, stirred into the mix. It was very good. In fact, I made some more for lunch today.

title: Interesting form of chia
text:
I have a confession to make. I have no idea how to use this product! But I am going to learn.

As it turns out, chia isn't just for coating terra cotta shapes. It actually has a lot if nutritional benefits to it. My plan is to start adding this powder to muffins, meat loaf and salads. I will have a learning curve, especially on the moisture/powder balance.

I was actually happy to see chia available as a powder to make it even more versatile.

title: Nice product. Good way to get more chia into your diet
text:
I have become a recent chia seed convert. My former thoughts of these were only as ceramic fillers!

However, these are actually very nutritious. I am still learning ways to use them in my diet. Right now, I've only soaked them overnight in a way to create a pudding.

Fresh chia like this will help us continue to figure out more ways to use them.

title: Smells great, tastes great too
text:
First off, I think the packaging is pretty cute. I ALWAYS notice the graphic designs of packaging. This one is a little busy, and the monkey is ugly, but the important info is easy to read.

The ones we received have a good expiration date of July 2022, almost a year out from now.

This is grain-free, gluten free, non-GMO, kosher and vegan. There is bo cholesterol, 6 grms of carb and five grms of protein per serving.

The ingredients are listed as follows:
Almonds, walnuts, pecans, sunflower seeds, pepitas, organic apple cider vinegar, organic coconut aminos, olive oil, sea salt, gum arabic, turmeric, paprika, garlic, onions and cashews.

They taste very good. The scent is very savory, with the notes of paprika and garlic hitting the nose first.

They are made here in the USA, in Loveland, Colorado. 💚

Overall, very good.

title: Aspartame is the sweetener in these
text:
What I could not see in the listing I ordered these from was the ingredients list.
Sadly, every single flavor is sweetened with aspartame. I am allergic to aspartame, so won't be able to eat any of these. So sad!

title: Great to have on hand
text:
It is always nice to have a tube of frosting on hand for quick projects. This brand is a larger tube than what I have seen in local stores.

It does need to be refrigerated after opening if you don't use it all. I cannot comment on the taste, as we have not yet opened the tube, and I do not want to waste it

Also of note to some, this brand does use some GMO ingredients. I would prefer that they did not.

title: Pastel mix - great for baby showers or Easter
text:
Sep 29

These are very cute. It is an assortment of shapes in pastel colors with a beautiful pearlized finish.
My only concern is how hard those little ball shapes are going to be. I have not opened the package yet so I can keep them as fresh as possible until I need them.

These would be perfect for Easter cupcakes, a baby shower or a little girl's party. The color combo is very pretty.

title: Hard to store, but great assortment
text:
Large color assortment.
You get a great assortment of colors in this set. If mixing basic colors to get what shade you want is not your strong suit, these might be for you!

I found it a bit odd that the manufacturer claims these can be used in so many things, from frosting to epoxy resin! RESIN?? I am not sure about that. It made me wonder what I would be putting in my food.

These are tiny bottles. That is not a big deal, but storage is. If you put them in a gallon zip bag, you lose the ability to easily find what colors you actually have or want to use. The box is just a plain, flat box, so the bottles shift all the time. It won't stay closed either, so it is not a good way to store these. What they SHOULD have done is do a slightly bigger box and put in a cardboard insert where you pop each bottle in and out of its spot. It would allow you to easily see what colors you have, find it easily and store it better.

We have not made anything that takes food coloring yet, so I cannot comment on how well they color. Just know that storage is a beast.

title: So good!  We love it
text:
I love dates and enjoy other foods with dates in them.

This syrup is smooth, tasty and not overly sweet. Enjoy this one on pancakes or waffles, or put a generous squirt into your next cookie or muffin batter. I love the subtle sweetness it adds to muffins.

The bottles do tend to leak just a little bit once opened, so keep an eye on the bottle to make sure you won't have a mess in your pantry.

title: You must like "flaming" foods to like these
text:
These are packaged very well. The packets make it easy to toss into a backpack or gym bag, or your desk at work.

Almonds are so good for us. I am always looking for ways to get more into our diets.

BUT...these Sweet Heats are a different ballgame. Yikes!
Disclaimer - I do not like super spicy foods or a lot of spice "heat" in my food.

The first thing that hits your tongue is a quick note of sweet. Very quick.
The comes the heat! Oh my! I spit them out. My daughter said they reminded her of another "flaming hot" snack.

These were just too hot for us, so we passed them along to someone who loves hot and spicy snacks.

title: Love coconut oil
text:
We like using coconut oil to fry foods in. We also use it for skin moisurizing and keeping pet paw pads in good shape. It is fabulous for your pets.

Our jar of coconut oil arrived looking like a glass of water. It was likely due to warm temperatures. It does state on the jar that it is supposed to be solid at room temp, so hopefully, it will solidify. If not, we'll still use it. There is nothing at all wrong with it.

title: Fresh, packaged well
text:
These come packaged nicely in a resealable bag.

They are much more brown in color than red lentils I have previously purchased (a different brand). However, I anticipate no problems at all with these. Just season to taste or toss a handful into your next batch of soup.

title: I do not like the smell of these
text:
I have ordered whole vanilla beans several times before.
But these are different.

First off, there is a piece of paper towel or some such thing vacuumed in the package with the beans. It has brown liquids on it, despite the package being sealed. Quite frankly, the entire package smells like urine!!
If I didn't know better, I might have thought a cat urinated on it.

I don't think I am interested in trying a food that smells like urine. I'm going to discard these. There is something "off" about this item, and I definitely do not want to eat it.

title: Very short shelf life
text:
This is a nice powdered form of blueberry to add to smoothies, muffins, or sprinkle over cereal.

My problem with this one is that it has such a short useage life once you open it.
I would not buy this product again. It just wasn't worth it for me.

title: Nice, but overpriced for the spices you get
text:
All of the spices in this set are great to have on hand. If you are just starting out and don't have many cooking things, this will give you all the basics quickly.

The jars are a handy size as well. BUT, I think the set is very overpriced. I would not personally recommend these - not because of the spices, but because of the prices.

title: Heavy, hard to grind, but smells great
text:
[[VIDEOID:5e3a5e7407e48acb0c3ba88ff1fd9a51]] This was certainly different from what I expected. The salt looks green in the bottle. There is dried basil and garlic in the bottle.

When you grind it, you get an assortment of all the seasoning at the same time. (In one of my photos, I did a grind over a paper towel, so you can see what you get.)

We tried it on chicken, and it was very good. But, I would have liked less salt and more basil.

So, this item might be a hit or miss for you. The grinder is nicely designed, and the contents are very good quality and look beautiful. I would probably not buy it again, but that has nothing to do with the product. I just prefer that my salt just be salt.

title: Tasted great, generous amount
text:
We gave this mix a try on chicken thighs cooked in our air fryer. We left the skin on, gave a quick spritz of olive oil, shook this generously all over the chicken, then spritzed again.

This was very good on chicken, and you get a generous amount of seasoning.

title: Expensive, but super for backpacks
text:
What a great way to package manuka honey!
I've seen other honey strips, but they were mainly glucose.

These are PERFECT for keeping in your backpack. Whether you want to use this for quick energy, or you want to use it medicinally, these little packets are less messy than an open jar and very convenient.

title: Very fresh, very supple
text:
These are very nice quality peppers. The color is great. There is a fresh smell to the bag, but I really don't smell a lot of pepper - perhaps that is normal for dried peppers.

I look forward to trying these out in some recipes. I have never tried cooking with dried peppers before, so I am on a learning curve here. There is a generous amount of peppers as well, so I vacuum-sealed 3/4 of them so they stay fresh until I can use them.

title: Cute, but not really useful
text:
We were going to wait until closer to Christmas to try these, but my daughter couldn't wait any longer.

These are definitely green! Close to Grinchy green, but more like kelly green.

The taste is just your basic pancake taste. Not bad, but nothing special either. I suggest adding some vanilla.

This would have been much better if you could make 3 or 4 pancakes at the same time. The kit made four pancakes, but one at a time. It was a real pain to try to flip the cakes to the other side. (I would suggest letting the face cook in, then flipping it out into a different pan to cook the other side.)

Overall, very gimmicky. I would probably not recommend it. But, I AM going to try pressing cookie dough into the pan and see if I can get a Grinch imprint in the cookie.

title: Very fresh. Just know the shelf life is shorter than with white flour
text: This comes packaged well and was very fresh. Note that whole wheat flour does not last as long as white flour, so be sure to either use it fairly soon after opening, or keep it in the freezer for maximum use life.

title: Tastes great, but pretty pricey for regular rice
text:
This product has a cute name, great graphics and bag design, and good food inside.

These are bags of rice cooked in chicken bone broth.
