No reason to pay the obscene prices some of the sellers on Amazon are charging.

title: Smells great, tastes good, bad aftertaste, too high in sugars
text:
I had to try a can of this, as I love mango flavored anything.
This is okay. Just okay.

I like the design on the can and the colored tab. Good job, design team!
It smells good when you open the can. Definitely a tropical smell.

I didn't drink this out of the can, so I can't vouch for any can taste.
I had this over ice in a Bubba brand sealed cup.
The initial taste is pretty good. You can pick up notes of pineapple and mango.
The carbonation level is decent as well. I like things that have a little "rip" to them.
However, the AFTERTASTE is not great. Have you ever gone to fill your drink at a serve-yourself soda machine where you push the lever and fill your cup, and had the syrup run out so only carbonated water was left? The AFTERTASTE on this drink is a cross between the plain carbonated water and cough syrup! Not great. If you take another sip, it'll kill the aftertaste for a few minutes. But of course, that is a never-ending loop.

I won't buy this again.
The IDEA is great.
The ingredients are just not that good for you, and I'm going to have to pass.

title: Tastes great, nice packaging, like the brand
text:
This was recommended by a friend because it is low carb.
All they had i stock was the white chocolate, which I like, so decided to try it.

It seems like it won't be a lot of chocolate, but it is a decent amount.
The taste is very good. You melt these cups in the microwave and either pour them over the food of your choice
or dip stuff in it. The taste reminds me of melted Ghirardelli white chocolate chips.

My ONLY complaint with these was that one cup arrived busted open inside the can.
I couldn't return it for a replacement, because now THIS flavor was out of stock as well.
It's a little expensive, so that was disappointing that 10% of the chocolate was not usable,
and I couldn't do anything about it.

title: This made me a coffee drinker
text:
Well, I was never a coffee drinker. I tried. I really did.
I tried all kinds of creamers, tried a little coffee with my cream, etc, but never liked it.

Then we tried this one because it was on sale.
We use a Keurig, of course (where else would you use pods).
I originally got one because I thought it would help me like coffee better if it was fresh by the cup, instead of stale pot coffee.
It didn't at first... but this coffee tasted really good to me.

Now I am addicted to two pods a day (still with creamer, but that's okay).
Yummmmmm!

title: You don't get much, but great color of gold
text:
Well, this seems to be a really great product.
BUT - I was truly surprised by the amount that you get for the price.

Remember those plastic cups that hold the paint in paint-by-number kits?
That's how this comes - a little plastic cup, with even less product in it!
It'll do the job I wanted it for though.

title: Portion control of tasty snackage
text:
We got a great deal on these from Amazon. Who doesn't love these products?
That's the problem for us - they taste TOO good!

We are starting low carb here, so these will be a part of our past.
Too much flour and sugar in them.
But if you are not affected by those ingredients, these are handy snack sized,
and built-in portion control (if you don't scarf several bags at once!).

title: Excellent quality, great flavor
text:
We all love liquid smoke in our family.
We had used a couple different brands, but always seemed to return to
the same one. I saw this one on Amazon, and saw the great reviews.
I wondered how great a liquid smoke could really be...

Well, there is only one way to find out - order some!
I thought it was pretty high priced, but I'd at least try it once.
I have become a repeat customer!

This is a great liquid smoke! It only tastes like smoke (the grilled kind, not tobacco kind).
Most of the others we have tried (and liked) have a flavor base of a certain type of wood,
or even a certain food. There is one we buy from a restaurant supply that is bacon flavored.
They all have their place, but sometimes, you just want to bring out the smokey notes in a dish.
This is the liquid smoke for you then. No additional flavors!

So far, I've tried it with hamburger, roast, chicken, pasta salad and deviled eggs.
It just works. Very tasty.

My only advice is to use a light hand when adding this. It is stronger than you might think.
You can always add more, but you can't take it back out! It is very concentrated, and a teaspoon
of this is like two of other brands.

Well done.

title: BACON!  Yes, you want it
text:
We like Jack Link products, but most have MSG, so we stopped buying them.
I got this one on special, so decided to try it.
This one claims that it has to "added MSG", which is a good thing.
Many other jerkys DO add extra MSG, because it is a flavor enhancer. It also can cause a lot of side effects
for people, including swelling, headaches, etc. All meats have natural glutamates in them, so it is just fine
to see some - it is when companies ADD the MSG that it gets to be problematic.

Both my husband and my son loved it. I tried a bite as well, even though I am not a big fan of jerky.
This was nice and soft, not the shoe leather I think of with jerky!
It tasted like a slice of bacon.
If you have ever had the Hormel pre-cooked bacon in the black package,
that is what it tasted like to me. We ate it right out of the package.
There is a serving suggestion to heat it up, but we didn't try it that way.

Over all, it had a good taste, not enough msg to bother any of us, and we'd buy it again.

title: Weak, grassy, not something I would buy again
text:
Meh.
I'm glad we didn't order a big box! Taste is subjective of course, so this is simply my opinion of this. (As a yardstick of sorts, I like both Lipton and Luzianne teas, as well as many of the Celestial Seasonings teas.)

As hot tea, it tastes pretty much like steeped lawn clippings. I added some sweetener, but it didn't help.

Left the cup sit for a half an hour. Added a little bit more sweetener. It was now semi-tolerable. So this was much better as a room-temp, possibly ok as iced, but I have no ice at the moment.

So, perhaps this brand just isn't going to be my cup of tea, literally. It is middle-of-the-road at best. If you like super weak flavor that you can't quite identify, you'll like this tea. But for me, I'll stick with Luzianne.

title: Popular with the kids, not much food
text:
We had never seen these locally, so decided to try them from Amazon.

You get four individual cups. Each cup does not make much at all... it leaves you wanting more. But could be a decent size for a child.

The flavor is good, the convenience is great, the ingredients so-so. The price point is too high though... a dollar a cup for what you get isn't worth it. Hint... use a little less water than it calls for if you want anywhere near a mac-n-cheese consistency. If you use all the water, you'll have a weak, nearly-flavorless, watery pasta.

Do, didn't mind the first purchase, but not amazing enough or even "enough" to reorder.

title: EXCELLENT!!
text:
This stuff is SO good!
Very happy with the purchase.

I made a key lime cheesecake with this. It is pretty potent, so we only used 1/2 cup instead of 3/4 cup, and it was perfection.. not too sweet or too tart.

I am on a key lime kick right now as well, so looking for more things to try this in as well.
Yummmmmm!

title: DECAF LISTING! Just know that. I missed it!
text:
It will be fine, but I hope other folks read better than I did... this is DECAF coffee!

I didn't even see the green stripe on the box. My bad!
So, this is sitting on top of the fridge, gathering dust, until Hubby decides to try a decaf cup. 😉

title: Very small bottles... make sure you see the size.
text:
It is too soon to tell if these will have a positive health impact. However, I want everyone to carefully note tje SIZE of these bottles.

The photo gives the appearance of a tall bottle, like the 1ltr sizes. Nope. These are only 12 ounces, same as a can of soda. Not even as much as a grocery store bottled water. Wow.

So, very little water for the price. There are other alkaline bottled waters for a better per-bottle value.
This was my first and last purchase of this brand.

title: Please Read 2018 Updated Review. //GREAT!  My favorite Hansen's soda
text:
Update again, September 2018:
I have since learned there are apparently two different Hansen's Diet Root Beer.
It MIGHT explain the drastic taste difference.

No one in our area sells Hansen's at all, so I have to rely on Amazon. Each and every time, I order the DIET CREAMY ROOT BEER. The cans I have been receiving only say "Diet Root Beer". The word "creamy" is missing. So I am not sure if there are indeed two different diet root beers or not. However, the vanilla aftertaste we used to have in the Creamy root beer is gone. I no longer enjoy the taste of the plain diet root beer...it has a heavy black licorice taste that is very unpleasant. I've written to Coca Cola several times, but no one takes my complaint seriously.
I can no longer recommend this root beer. Darned shame.

------------------------------------
UPDATED REVIEW Jan 2018:
Well, another soda company bought Hansen's a couple years ago. The formula seemed to stay the same. That now has seemed to change.

Update to our last purchase in Dec 2017.
This no longer tastes like my favorite Diet Hansen's Root Beer. The cans have a textured design now that is neither here nor there. But, the original diet root beer tasted very close to A&W root beer, with a very pleasant vanilla aftertaste. No more! Argh. It has a black licorice aftertaste now. Not pleasant, not desired at all.

Our last batch in Dec tasted little like our favorite root beer. The vanilla taste? GONE.
Now it tastes very similar to Barq's root beer, much moreso than A&W. Apparently, Coca Cola bought Hansen's in a deal with a larger soda company. Coca Cola also owns Barq's. Quite frankly, our last purchase tasted like they just put Barq's root beer in the Hansen cans. NOT GOOD!!

We will give ONE more case a try.
If it too tastes like Barq's garbage, then we are done. Coca Cola will have ruined the best diet root beer on the market. SO disappointing.

------------------------
ORIGINAL REVIEW:
What can I say about this one?
I LOVE IT!

I needed to get off of Pepsi. This is one of three beverages that has allowed me to do that.
(The other two are cold brew green tea and Fiji water, which sets well in my stomach.)

Hansen's root beer is my favorite soda. It does not taste sugar free.
It has a very nice vanilla aftertaste to it - nothing chemical at all.
Very nice carbonation to it as well - it will foam up quite a bit in the glass, but
I never have any problems when drinking directly from the can.

To compare root beers, because they can be so very different, this is closer to A&W,
NOT like Barq's. That being said, it of course is not A&W, but is very tasty in its own way.
I love it.

I wish it would go on sale more often! We have ZERO stores around here that carry any Hansen's sodas,
so I have to rely on Amazon to fulfill my cravings that keep me away from regular HFCS sodas.

I highly recommend this one. If you don't like it, you can always donate your remaining cans to me! ;-)

title: Yum!  Turkey Spam is very good!
text:
We recently went back on a low carb diet.
So you might think 'what the freak are you eating Spam for?"

Well, Spam is low carb in most cases!
I was tired of the ham, and wanted to try the turkey.
It does NOT disappoint! This is very tasty stuff.
I sliced mine to have plain on a plate, but I could
easily see this being added to stir fry dishes or
a pan of scrambled eggs and veggies.

Very tasty and the price is fair as of this review.

title: I LOVE this water! It truly is different.
text:
I know - review water? Come on already. However -

I have acid reflux, and weirdly enough, water is one of the things that backs up on me
the most. When I drink water, I soon get a horrible mouthful of molten cooled "lava"
burning back up my throat.

I had about given up on drinking water at all, until my son brought me a bottle of
Fiji one day. I tried it, skeptical.
It tasted good! Yes, the water tasted good!
If you've ever had water with overtones of chlorine, or just plain meh, you'll understand.
It has a wonderful "mouth feel", as well as taste.

I woke up desperately thirsty one evening after I'd gone to bed, so I decided to try
some Fiji. Much to my surprise, I didn't have a throat full of fire when I laid back down!
As it turns out, this is the ONE water I have found that actually stays in my stomach
where it belongs! It does have natural silica in it, which perhaps helps with that.

I honestly love the taste of Fiji. It is an indulgence, for sure.
But for someone like myself who has problems with regular tap or bottled water,
it is a really nice thing to have around.
(And the square bottles fit really well into my small upstairs refrigerator.
I keep some empties, wash them out, and use them for creamer and other liquids that won't fit
in there in their original containers.)

title: Gross ingredients... stick to the real thing
text:
Well, this was available at a bargain price.
I usually only use real extract for baking or cooking, but thought imitation vanilla might be nice for things that weren't going to be heated, like smoothies or shakes.

It smells pretty decent. Haven't had the chance to use it yet so can't comment on the flavor. The ingredients, however, are disappointing. Took a photo of the label. Note it is also made with GMO ingredients.
Disappointing.

title: Horrible flavor... hard pass
text:
Well, I like many different water flavorings, but this one is horrible!

I've tried it in both tea and water. It was equally bad! Instead of a refreshing lemon-lime flavor, it tasted like moldy limes!! 😝

Save yourself some money and pass on this one. I could never find an amount of drops that worked, or a liquid it tasted good in. Yuck!!

title: Deceptive photograph
text:
We but Torani sugar free syrup all the time.
WATCH YOUR SIZES!!

This listing shows a photo of the full size bottle, but what we got was the small bottle! We could have had the regular size for less than this one. Grrrer
Deceptive photos.

title: Meh.  Not that special, esp for the amount you get.
text:
Well, this was my first order of this brand of almonds.
So far, not all that impressed, and wasn't impressed with the expiration date either.

I think I'll stick to the ones I can buy at other locations.

title: Very tasty, will definitely be permanent at our house
text:
I couldn't find this locally (of course!), so ordered on Amazon.
We are doing LCHF diet, and coconut aminos were in a few recipes.

Simple version - this is a no-soy soy sauce.

It tastes great! A bit milder than most soy sauces, but still very tasty.
I will definitely buy it again.
Happy to rid my life of as much soy as possible!

title: Was sent OLD drinks... not worth it.
text:
We've often purchased Vitamin Water and like most of the flavors.

I was thrilled to see a great price listed on Amazon for a case. Well, it arrived yesterday and now I know why it was on sale... It expires in ONE WEEK. That's how OLD the product was, it expires in 7 days.

Wow. Never again. Shame on the seller for sending out such old product.

title: Meh - wouldn't buy it again
text:
I bought this for my husband for his birthday, to try something new in the coffee pot.

It looks really interesting. But... this neither smells nor tastes anything like either pecans or whiskey.
Not sure where they got the name from, unless they put a few drops of pecan flavoring into a roaster with the beans.

Overall, not an unpleasant coffee, especially with creamer.
But as long as you don't expect it to taste like the name, you'll be fine.
It's just a nice medium roast with an undefinable flavor.

title: Excellent balance and taste
text:
I bought this for my husband, who loves chicory coffee.
So, I will pass along his feedback. He loved it.
He said it made a great, smooth, tasty cup with a great chicory balance.

This is not available locally, so we ordered from Amazon.
We'll definitely reorder again.

title: YUMMMMMMM
text:
These are so good!
The product we received as very fresh and tasty. Every rope was a big mangled, like they'd been shoved in the package by ogres, but they were not popped open and were safe to eat.

Laffy Taffy, for those who have not had it before, is a very soft, chewable taffy, not at all sticky.
We love all the Laffy Taffy flavors except grape, but strawberry is a big favorite.

title: Very tasty, zero calories, no aspartame
text:
We have a recently-diagnosed diabetic at our house, and have spent the last few months researching
and trying out sugar free foods that were aspartame-free.

This is sweetened with sucralose (Splenda). While I am not a huge fan of it, it doesn't have the aftertaste of some other
fake sweeteners. I would prefer stevia, but sucralose is a close second.

I LOVE raspberry tea. Love it. Could drink it all day long. Did I mention I love it? But if you read the cans (Brisk brand), you'll be shocked.
It's basically raspberry kool-aid with a little tea flavoring, but if you need to cut back on sugar, it has to go.
Enter this syrup.

This has made tea worth drinking again! YUMMMM
The flavor is a really nice raspberry without any artificial aftertastes from either the berry or the sucralose.
Two pumps is perfect for a large glass of tea. It is also great over fresh cut fruit, adding an extra fruity dimension
without any calories. Did I mention this has zero calories? Also only one gram of carbs for two tablespoons. Very decent.

Last night, we discovered a new tasty option - over ice cream! (Hey not everyone is diabetic!)
We tried a couple of pumps of this over vanilla ice cream - wow. Just wow. Made a super tasty dish.

This is definitely on the repeat-purchase list for as long as the forseeable future lasts.
Two thumbs up from everyone here.

title: This one tastes like pancake syrup
text:
We have a recently-diagnosed diabetic in our house, so have been purging the house of all things sugary
and trying out replacements that do not have aspartame in them.

We have several flavors of the sugar-free syrups.
This one tastes like pancake syrup.
Not unpleasant, but I wouldn't call it caramel either!
Very thin and watery, and definitely leaves the pancake syrup flavor behind in your mouth.
Ok maybe for super sweet coffee drinks.

I don't think I'd buy it again.

title: Tiny amount... not worth it.
text:
Well save your money and buy a different kind than this one.
While I am sure the seeds are just fine, the listing is deceptive.
As of when I bought it, nowhere in the listing does it state the amount you'll receive.
Unless you can enlarge the photo 500%, you'd never know that while the other chia seed listings
are either 1 or 2 POUNDS, this little gem is only EIGHT OUNCES. If you pick up the bag,
it is less than half full.

I feel ripped off, but shame on me for buying a product that didn't clearly state how much you were getting,
and for shopping from a tablet where I couldn't see the amount on the label.

Just beware and know you are only getting a fraction of the amount here that you get with most chia seed listings.

title: VERY tasty, no aspartame, great taste.
text:
Well, I have to say right up front that I am NOT a fan of Splenda, because of the chemical mix. (Spare the pro-Splenda arguments please - everyone is entitled to their own opinions of it.) It beats aspartame by a mile, but if there has to be a chemical sweetener, I miss good ol' saccharine, which didn't hurt anyone but lab rats (and the study was done with an abnormal amount of saccharine - you'd have to drink 600 sodas a day to get the amount they gave each rat! It also just happened to coincide with the release of Nutrasweet, aka aspartame).

But I digress. Giving Splenda a pass on this item, I have to say that I really liked this soda.
Hansen's is nearly impossible to find in our area, and if you can find it, there are one or two flavors. While I really didn't want to buy an entire case of a flavor without tasting it first, I took the leap anyway, calling it a calculated risk. My husband needed sugar free drinks, and aspartame gives him migraines (and makes my tongue and lips swell up, so it is a no-go at our house). We already bought the Hansen's black cherry cola and he loved it.

I'm an avid Pepsi drinker, but need to cut back on the sugary drinks myself. So, this was something I wanted to try as well (I'm not a huge fan of the black cherry). I am SO GLAD we risked it and bought the case! This is really good root beer!

For those who might be wondering like I was whether it is more like A&W or Barq's, it is closer to the diet A&W root beer. (I do not like Barq's very much at all, so I was also rolling the dice that this would taste like that one. Nope!) There's a nice vanilla aftertaste that I find really pleasant.
There is no caffeine in this either, so it makes a great late night drink too. This isn't clear like many of Hansen's sodas, but it doesn't really matter.
Diet A&W has aspartame as their sweetener, so that makes Hansen's the clear winner in the diet root beer category.

So far, I have had close to half of this case - Hubby needs to be faster if he wants some too!
I'll be purchasing this one on a regular basis, as long as they keep the flavor consistent to what we received (March 2016).
Very tasty, no heartburn, no headaches, no weird bizarre aftertastes.
Well done Hansen's! You have a winner with the diet root beer!

title: Very pleased - will definitely purchase again!
text:
I was really not sure what to expect from this product. I'd read the reviews, and they ranged from "gross" to "crisp and light".
I couldn't find it locally, so finally ordered one on Amazon.

Now, I LOVE carbonated drinks. I've never bought a Soda Stream though, because there's no place around here to get canister refills, and most of the syrups were disgusting, so no point. I've been drinking sodas, but want to wean myself off the cola type drinks. I thought this might be a good compromise, as I don't really like plain water.

I bought two brands to try - the other one (not naming it here, since this is a review about LaCroix, but it was strawberry dragonfruit. It was gross, and I love dragonfruit) was NOT good at all, so I almost didn't want to try this one! That would have been a mistake.
This comes very close to Sierra Mist, IMHO. Of course, it isn't the same, since there is no sweetener in it. That's right - no sugar, so salt, no fake coloring. Clear and bubbly. It was very good. The colder, the better. I tried it right from the case and it was meh. But, stuck a few cans in the fridge and let them get nice and cold (I don't always have access to ice), and it improved it a great deal.

I can see this being a regular part of my drink lineup. It will help me not drink so many sugary sodas, but still give me the carbonation I love.
The light lime taste is nice, and I am a big fan. You could float lime slices in it if you wanted it more pronounced.
LaCroix, you did a GREAT job with this one, and you've won me over. Wish I could find you in our area, but I'll spoil myself and get it here until it arrives. Will be happy to try the other flavors as well. Yum!

title: Very fresh, tasty coffee that makes mornings go a little smoother
text:
We are repeat buyers for this coffee. My husband is the main coffee drinker in our house.
Making a pot during the week just ends up going to waste.
This has fit the bill perfectly for us.

The coffee is very fresh, dissolves well and my husband really enjoys the flavor. You can make as strong a cup
as you'd like. If you buy the three-pack, they come shrink-wrapped, and we've always received very fresh product.
The decaf in this is not nearly as good as the regular in the red jar.
Definitely can recommend this coffee.

title: Very fresh, tasty, good cashews
text:
Well, it is hard to find people who don't like cashews. My husband is crazy about them, so I like to get
the pieces and halves for him. I use them in recipes as well. The cans are always fresh, tasty and
smell great too!

You can chop them up a little more for other recipes. I have replaced the almonds in lap salad with these cashew pieces
and it is fabulous. I usually end up hiding a can to keep for recipes, or they mysteriously "disappear" whenever my husband
knows we have them.

Great brand, great cashews, yummm!

title: Nice flavor, nice scent, not so great ingredients
text:
My daughter bought this to try, and we've since bought it a couple more times.
This is a really tasty coffee concoction that warms your tummy on a chilly morning.

They recommend running plain water through the machine after these, because of the powdered creamer in them.
We usually do this first, and let the plain coffee people do theirs afterwards.

One note - if you are very careful about what you eat or drink, you won't like these. I have to admit, I was shocked when I read the ingredients list. It isn't pretty. In fact, I have to wonder why it is even necessary for most of the junk in there. But they have created a tasty cup of pseudo coffee that is a nice break from the regular stuff. As someone trying to learn to like coffee or hot drinks, this is at least training me up in the right direction.
I just wish they offered better ingredients!

Overall, a tasty cup of vanilla-flavored warmth.

title: Very tasty, cute bags
text:
Well, Cheetos might not be the greatest snack for you, but lots of people love them anyway.
We looked locally for a few of our last year's favorites - the glow-in-the-dark bags or the Cheetos "bones"
that were covered in white cheddar, but found neither. Sadness!

So I tried to find them on Amazon. I didn't, but did find these. A little Halloween fun is better than none.
I only buy stuff that we'll eat too to give out as treats, because we don't get very many trick-or-treaters.
These were fresh, tasty and cute bags. Glad we got them.
(Now, Cheetos company - where were the bones this year?!?)

title: Very good, but not very much in the bag.
text:
Well, I ordered these because they looked really interesting. When the bag arrived, the entire family let out a collective "ewwwwww".
Undaunted, I forged ahead and tried them first. Now, I can't chew really well anymore, thanks to a horrible dentist, so I proceeded with caution.

These are not hard at all. They are crispy, but easily break down. The flavor is really good! I would not have guessed it was coconut at all if I had been blindfolded! The bacon taste is good, not too fake, and not slimy at all.

I could see these being crumbled over almost anything, especially salads. I'd try them on top of a sandwich too.
They don't have a funky aftertaste either, and I'd love to try other flavors.
I did ding one star, however, simply because of the overall stinginess of the amount you get in each bag.
You could probably eat the entire bag in one handful without too much trouble, especially if you are a guy.
The quantity is TINY. So, if they can figure out a way to put a little more in the bag, especially at the prices I paid on here,
I'd be happy to repurchase as well as try other flavors. For now, it is going to be back-burnered simply because of the cost vs quantity.

title: Little round bits of caramel, just waiting for you to attack them or maybe even use them in a recipe.
text:
Caramel lovers will enjoy these!

I was happy to see these on Amazon and give them a try. I've never seen them in our area stores before.
Now, i can't speak about their baking prowess or how they function within cookie dough, per se, because the bag hasn't made it off my desk yet.

When you open the package, it looks a lot like Cap'n Crunch peanut butter cereal. However, they are nice and soft, yet not sticky.
We've had a few "glumps" in the bag, but overall they are loose and non-sticky.
The flavor is pretty good, although after a handful or two, your tongue will just lose the ability to taste them anymore... overkill!
(You can guess how I figured that one out...)

Overall, very happy with our purchase, and will likely purchase them again. Yum!

title: Just say no!!  Truly horrible flavor - save your money!!
text:
Oh my gosh!
Do they have any taste testers at Zevia? Ones with taste buds that still work?

I've been looking for a sugar-free and chemical-free alternative to regular soda. I love my carbonated drinks, but realize
it is time to get rid of HFCS (high fructose corn syrup) from my life.

My husband likes Hansen's sodas, and I had asked him to try to find one for me in a flavor I'd like. He has not been able to find any stores in our area that carry Hansen's, but came home with a six-pack of this Zevia cola for me to try. I am SO GLAD that he only bought one six-pack and that I did not buy a case online!!!

First off - the positive:
The can is a really pretty color.
The soda is clear, which I actually like.
That's it!

Now for reality - this stuff tastes HORRIBLE!! Four people in our house - not one liked it. Not. One.
Wish I'd had taken a movie of the expression on their faces when they tried this one! It was that surprised,
what-the-freak-is-in-this-can look! Even my husband, who drinks sugar-free sodas, pulled back and looked at me in surprise.
He bravely tried another few drinks.

None of us were able to identify what the heck that taste is in this can. It certainly isn't cola. It isn't artificial sweetener.
Sort of plastic-like, with maybe rubbing alcohol stirred in? Seriously bad.
It is UFO cola!
My husband did say that it very vaguely reminded him of the aftertaste of homemade sassafras root tea that his parents used to make
in the summertime from scratch - yes, chopping a root from a sassafras tree and boiling it to make tea.
That wasn't a compliment, just an observation.

All I can say is- JUST SAY NO.
No matter what you like to drink, this one won't be on that list.
Just plain disgusting.

title: Great taste, great brand, but EW to the sucralose.
text:
My son loves Arizona tea, and these packets make it easy to have tea instead of water.
He tosses a few sticks into his backpack or pocket and can easily have tea whereever he can get a bottle of water.
They are a little overpriced for what you get, so watch for a sale price, but he's happy with them.

It's odd that they can advertise "no artificial flavors" when they use SUCRALOSE as their sweetener though.
They aren't truly sugar free, and the fructose in sucralose can really mess with your blood sugar, so be aware if you have
problems that way. It'll also add to your waistline if you drink too many of them.
Be aware that you are drinking that mess every time you have them. That lost them a star for my review.

title: YUM!  These are really good!
text:
We already used the True Lime and True Lemon products here, and buy the packets by the box.
When we saw these, we had to try them.
My husband loves all things black cherry, so this was a no-brainer.

And as expected, they are great!
I am not a big fan of plain water (sorry nature!), and these sticks really help me get more liquid.
My husband loves them too.
No artificial junk in them, no extra sugars or chemicals...
These are a definite "buy-again" item!

title: Very good - better than regular KitKats
text:
I know many people don't care for these, but we all liked them.

I've never been really big on white chocolate, but Hershey's is somehow making me a fan!
These were very good. You can't really eat too many, because (quite frankly), if you try, you'll end up with a really
pasty feeling on your tongue! Ha!

For some reason, the orange covered KitKats taste a little better than the plain white KitKats.
It is almost like they added some extra vanilla on this type, but I don't see it in the ingredients list - it is just a taste.
Overall, love these, and hope they bring them out every year!

title: Great taste, great balance, just right bite sized treats!
text:
Well, I love Hershey's chocolate anyway, but was never a big fan of either white chocolate, or
the Cookies N Creme bars.
I ordered a bag of these to put out at the holidays, because the blue wrappers looked so cute.
Little did I know that I would become hooked on them!

The chocolate melts in your mouth, and the little cookie crumbs are pretty good too. The cookie part is very fine, so no lunky bites or strange lumps. I've reordered them twice now, and probably will continue, at least until summer temps stop me.
YUM!!

title: Very good taffy, could use a few better flavors in the mix
text:
I adore salt water taffy and felt this was a really good price at the time of my purchase.

The Taffy Town taffy is very good, not at all sticky, and I'm happy with the purchase.
I wish there was a little more detail in the flavors besides "Tropical Assortment".
What I received was Coconut (tan and white, mild and good), Mango (good), Pineapple (good), Banana (great), Tropical Punch (okay) and Passion Fruit (blue outside, yellow inside - flavor is blech!)..
If you want to see photos of the flavors so you know what you are eating, you can find pictures here:
http://www.candystore.com/brands/taffy-town/?gclid=Cj0KEQiA5dK0BRCr49qDzILe74UBEiQA_6gA-tG4wPkWMbb7eU5rcvdy0lCT45tjhN2u73H4FrZKUAkaAkzJ8P8HAQ

I was a bit disappointed that Taffy Town did not include the Pina Colada flavor, but I'll live.

My only complaint, and why I dinged one star, was that there are a very large percentage (way too much) of the bag I received that was the Passion Fruit, which is the worst flavor by far to me. It is very tart and not in a pleasant way - it sort of coats your tongue and leaves a bad aftertaste. It is the only flavor we have left, because no one will eat them!

I hope Taffy Town will offer more assortments on Amazon. (I know they have their own site as well.)
What we received was fresh and shipping was prompt.

title: Really great combination of white chocolate and candy corn bits - and they even smell good!
text:
Well, I was never a big fan of white chocolate or candy corn either, UNTIL these!

Somehow, Hershey has managed to make a bar out of two different flavors that I really didn't care one way or the other about,
and turn them into something that is completely craveable!

These bars not only taste good, but they SMELL good. Seriously. Hershey should consider making a candle
with this scent, because it is wonderful. I left one opened bar on my desk just for the smell... it is that good.
I included a photo of a larger bar (which is how we got hooked on them), with a little piece of candy on the top of the bag.
They are white (of course), with little tiny chips of orange and yellow candy corn bits.

We'll be buying these again for sure. Excellent job Hershey!
All thumbs up!

title: Great mix, love the orange and white bars the best.
text:
This is a really tasty assortment!

The chocolate KitKats are, of course, the standard issue chocolate covered wafers.
There are more of the plain chocolate in the bag than anything else.

The white ones are divine, and are my new favorite. I could live forever without another milk chocolate KitKat if I can keep on having the white chocolate ones! Great balance of taste!

The orange ones would seem to be just the white chocolate tinted orange. However, for whatever reason, they have a slightly different taste to them, almost like a little more vanilla than in the plain white bars. Whatever it is, they are great as well.

The hardest part is making them last. The white ones are addictive to me! The kids like the orange and we leave the chocolate ones for desperate snacking times.

title: Great quality, but VERY small jar!
text:
Well, my husband is the big coffee drinker of the house, and he prefers regular. I bought this one just to have in case of late night coffee cravings. We regularly buy the red jars of Folger's. The flavor is fine, but READ THE FINE PRINT! This is NOT the same size jar as the red!
I did not notice it - the red jars are 8 ounces, and honestly, I thought these would be the same. Nope. These are TINY. They are three-ounce jars.

So, not a bad purchase, not a bad flavor, but be aware of the amount of coffee you are getting for the price.

title: YUM!!!  If you love Swedish Fish, you really need to try these individually wrapped fishies
text:
Well, I have a huge problem here.
Three people managed to devour this entire box in under a month!!

I wasn't sure I would like the individually wrapped fishies, but I have to say, I like them BETTER now than the boxes or bags.
Everyone in our house loves Swedish Fish, and we usually buy the smaller bags. I saw this and thought I'd give it a try.
YUMMMMMM!! Our fish were very fresh and tasty. The fish are a little larger than the ones in the bags or boxes, but NOT complaining at all.

There is something about mass quantities of something that just fills a need - perhaps I am related to the Coneheads.
But a large box of individually wrapped fishies were great! We all ate too many of them this time around, but the second box should be a little better controlled consumption. The novelty will have worn off, and we'll be able to snack normally. I hope. If not, eh - bring it on!

This is also such a great way to put fishies in treat bags, lunches, a note mailed to someone, etc etc.
They stay clean and fresh.

We will DEFINITELY be back for another round of fishing with the individual fish in the happy yellow and blue box.

title: Great packaging, great for camping and hiking, only so-so on taste.
text:
I was going to write a review after it arrived, because I loved how it was packaged. But I decided to hold off and try it first.
Glad I did!

First of all, this is a great item to take camping or hiking. If you have a cat, these are about the same size as a can of Fancy Feast.
They are small, compact and pop-top. They are great for putting into your prepping supplies as well - good source of protein.
I like tuna and thought this would be a great thing for me to also keep upstairs for lunches (mobility problems restrict my access to the kitchen).

Well, I have to be honest. It isn't very good.
The tuna is really mushy. The texture is close to unpleasant, in fact. Think if you opened a regular can of tuna and ran it through the food processor, water and all. That's what you'd have. Sort of like tuna paste! The taste wasn't all that either. I tried adding a little mayo, but that didn't help either. So, I have 23 more cans of tuna paste! Better than starving, great for camping, and that's about all I can say for it.

Oh yeah - great packaging.
I expected a box with 24 cans in it, like cat food. Instead, it came wonderfully packaged in sleeves of three cans each.
I give that five stars, the taste one star, so I'll meet in the middle with three.

title: Great for when you know you don't want a full size can of Pepsi
text:
I decided to try these out more for the size than anything extra special about the formula. I do not drink diet sodas, as I am allergic to aspartame, and sucralose seems to give me a headache as well. That leaves the very few sweetened with stevia, and this is NOT one of those.

This simply uses sugar instead of high fructose corn syrup for the main sweetener. As far as taste, I don't taste a lot of difference, except that this one is a little bland and less carbonated for some reason. Perhaps our package got beat up too much on the trip. Probably a total of 10 cans out of the 24 cans had dents or smooshed edges on them. One could not be opened at all by hand. The edges were the worst, but some of the ones in the middle were also a little mashed, which surprised me. It wasn't worth tryig to return it, so we kept it.

There are a couple pros though -
first off, aesthetically, I like the can color! Ha! Yes, I like the shiny green can. I like shiny things. I also like caffeine, but once the evening wears down, I often don't want to drink a full can. This is where this product shines. They are just the right size for a late evening Pepsi without having the rest of the can sit and go flat overnight. (I've poured out more than my share of the blue cans the next morning.)

I wish they were more carbonated, and they need to perhaps put them in sixpack rings AND the case to keep them from slamming around so much.
But, they have a place in the Pepsi world. Would I buy them again? Undecided at this point.

title: Nope.  No amount of creamer will help kill the bitterness of this one
text:
I bought these for my husband, who likes his coffee strong enough to curl the hair on your chest (assuming you have chest hair).
He loves bold, strong, coffee.

BUT - he doesn't love this one! In fact, after trying it plain, watered down, with creamer, with even more creamer, etc etc, he has
given up on this one, and gave me the rest of the box back, telling me to pass them along to someone else.
His review is that the overall flavor is okay, but that it is still bitter, no matter what you do to it, how much water or creamer you add, the bitterness overrides everything else.

So sorry Emeril - this one gets all thumbs DOWN from our house. Back to the drawing board!

title: Very tasty, but also pretty darned small
text:
I finally tried these today. This was my first time buying the Fiber One bars, although I've wanted to before, because I like the commericals! Ha!

I chose the lemon bars just for something different. I was not looking for super chewy/sticky, as I have some dental issues. These bars are nice and soft, with a very good flavor. There is a ribbon of lemon flavored frosting on the top of them as well.

There is a slight dryness in your mouth after eating these, but not enough to make them hard to eat or something I would not repurchase. The only negative thing I have to say about them actually, is the size. The wrappers are a little deceptive. You think you are getting a much larger bar than you
actually get. They are still tasty, but would not be an everyday treat, given the price vs the size.

UPDATE:
I also wanted to add a review about the Cinnamon Coffee Cake bars.
(That's what picture Amazon chose to put by my review anyway!)

I have to say, I love this one too! I thought it would takes more like those Little Debbie Pecan Swirlies with the cinnamon in them.
No, these are fluffy and actually DO taste like a nice cinnamon spiked coffee cake! The frosting is hard, but I can live with that.
This makes the second bar I can recommend.

(So far, the only truly nasty ones have been the Chocolate Chip ones. They taste like sadness and disappointment.)

title: Bitter, burnt-tasting FAIL
text:
Ok. So I have found the first Gloria Jeans coffee that I truly do not like.
I had been wanting to try the butter toffee flavor for quite a while.
Major disappointment!

I do not like super strong coffee, and prefer slightly sweet flavors.
But this was just not good. I tried it three different ways - plain, with regular cream and with flavored cream.
Then I tried it plain again. Sorry, there is just no win on this flavor!

It smells great while brewing, but that is where the good scent ends. When you smell the coffee in the cup,
it just smells burnt. And sadly, that is pretty much how it tastes as well... like the last cup in a burnt pot of coffee!
I'd return it if I could. Bleah! And I bought a whole box of it because I thought it would become a favorite. Boy, was I wrong!
This one was a bitter failure, literally.

title: Very tiny jar - nothing special enough to order again
text:
This is okay, but it was my first and last purchase.
I wanted to try a jarred brand of anchovies, and thought I'd toss this into my order.
The photo is deceiving, and the jar looks like it came from Barbie and Ken's pantry!
TINY!!

The anchovies are fine - we chopped them up and added to pasta salad. But I would not buy these again.

title: Very tasty - well worth buying!
text:
This sauce is great!
I first ordered it from Amazon Pantry to give it a try. We all love Tso chicken from the Chinese food restaurant,
and have never managed to reproduce the sauce at home.

I expected a powder to mix up, but this is actually a packaged sauce. You just open, dump and heat.
It was really tasty, and everyone liked it a lot. We did two packets for our family of four, tossed in chicken
chunks and veggies, and served over rice. Very good!

We've since found one store that carries this brand, but they are usually out of this flavor.
I would happily buy this one again. Great addition to your pantry for a quick weeknight dinner.

title: Very tasty - favorite of the kids.
text:
While the Kernel Seasonings might not be the best thing for you, they sure know how to make
popcorn taste great! We've tried almost all the flavors, and this is the one that the kids keep coming back to.

This also tastes great on mached potatoes, over rice, etc etc. We even tried it in soup, and it added a little flavor boost.
It would be nice if KS offered a variety pack, but we were pretty sure we'll use all of the white cheddar shakers here.

Over all, very happy with the product, like the flavor, and we'll very likely continue to purchase.

title: Great product that used to be available locally, but no longer
text:
We love the French Vanilla creamer, and our area Sam's Club no longer carries this packaging.
I ordered one from Amazon, hoping it would be the same stuff that we used to get from Sam's, and it was.
No refrigeration needed, which is a real plus.

We'll happily buy this one again - it tastes great, and the individual cups are perfect.

title: Great to keep in your pantry or for camping, hiking, etc.
text:
This is a great item to keep on your pantry shelf. While I like Spam, I don't HAVE to have it. The reason I bought this was
winter was coming, and we sometimes lose electricity. With no electricity, where we live, that means we can't cook anything.
(Our place is all electric, and we do not have a generator at this time.) These are perfect for a backup in the pantry. Everyone
can make a sandwich from these, and they are even good to take for a lunch. My husband likes to crumble it into a salad.

The price was reasonable, and the fresh date over a year in advance, so very happy with the purchase.

title: I love this stuff!  Anxious to try other flavors now.
text:
Okay, let it be known right up front that I am not a long-time coffee lover. Sure, I love mocha stuff, and loved the occasional sip of coffee, but I am seriously trying to learn to like coffee. I've only found one other that I really truly liked (Dennys).

We just bought our very first Keurig for Christmas, so hav been having fun playing with the various kinds of coffees for it.
I couldn't drink an entire pot no matter what, so the one-cup model is perfect for me. But, the husband has hijacked it, after saying he thought it looked stupid. *koff*koff*

I bought this flavor on a whim, and because the other Gloria Jeans flavor that I really wanted was out of stock. I figured, how bad could it be.
First off - the aroma. I have to say that it smelled a LOT like someone was making pancakes when this was brewing. The syrupy scent is strong at first, but it does fade. The coffee didn't TASTE syrupy though - it was just a nice cup of medium strong coffee. I added some vanilla creamer (all I had) to it, and it was still good, but I think this one probably needs plain creamer, no added flavors.

I've had a cup of this one every day since I got it, which none of the other flavors can boast, so I have to give this thumbs-up!
I will gladly be trying other Gloria Jean flavors and reviewing those as well, as I get the moolah to buy more coffee.
Meanwhile, I was very happy with this one, zero complaints, and as long as the aroma of syrup doesn't bother you, you'll probably enjoy this mild coffee as well. It didn't upset my stomach, even first thing in the morning. Great job!

title: Definitely worth getting this assortment
text:
Well, I originally bought a Keurig for my husband, who then said he didn't really want one, so thought I'd snag it
and keep it for myself. LOL But, I knew he'd still want it once he tried some decent coffee in one.

I ordered this assortment to help beef up our selection for our very first Keurig.
There are all kinds of coffess in here, from the extra bold to the weaker, to the flavored. If you can't find something you like here,
you probably don't really like coffee.

Hubby has found two he thinks is worthy of getting a box of just that flavor.
I tried the Oh Fudge, and thought it was horribly bitter. But, added a container of French Vanilla creamer to it,
and it becamse a very tasty cup of coffee with chocolate aftertones.

We'll very likely buy this assortment again. I bought it in December 2014, and the fresh dates are Nov 2015.
Happy with the coffee and the service. Thumbs up to Brooklyn Beans

title: Great honey in a convenient bottle size
text:
We love Tropic Bee Orange Blossom honey.
My husband likes to use it in the crock pot on pork roasts, and uses half of the bigger jars.
I thought this size would be just right for his cooking ventures.
It also seems a little easier to handle, since honey can be a little heavy.

VERY happy with my purchase. The company packs their honey VERY well, and everything
arrived in great condition with no leaks or messes.
We'll be long-time customers of this brand.

title: Tastier than the full size cookie somehow....
text:
Can there be anything wrong with this?
I am not an Oreo fan (bad experience with unseen ants on a cookie - totally turned me off Oreos!),
but these are different.

For some reason, having your own private cup and small, bite-sized cookies make things taste better!
I actually liked these and could see ordering them again.
Of course, there was no question that they were popular with the kiddos.

title: Fabulous addition to anyone's pantry!  Smoky, rich and wonderful!
text:
We absolutely love this paprika!

This is not the cheap, weak stuff you get in the regular grocery store.
We've also tried other brands but they just are not as good!

This is a paprika with a rich, smoky flavor that adds depth to any dish you use it in.
Makes for wonderful meats, especially in the crock pot, and adds a great slight tang and smoke to
cold salads as well.

Definitely buy this one - you can't lose! :-)

title: Stick with regular green tea. This one is NOT tasty!
text:
I love Lipton tea, love green tea (I actually prefer it over black now), and like berries, so how bad could this be, right?
Well, it is NOT good!
This has a strange taste that I could not necessarily identify, and didn't care for.
I used to drink herbal tea blends, and to me, this tastes more like a berry herbal concoction than green tea.
I could only get through half a glass. I tried adding some sweetener, but that made it worse.

I'll stick with plain green tea.
Not sure what to do with all the leftover packets...like most Liptons, they only have a paper pouch,
so no way to truly keep them fresh. They'll get tossed into a zip baggie and probably sit until discarded.
Very disappointing flavor.

I cannot recommend anything but avoiding this one.

title: Nice way to buy tuna
text:
I love these packets! No can openers needed, no draining needed.
I have not tried the tuna packet yet, but I've had BB in a can, so I am sure these are just as good.

The product arrived quickly. What I most wanted to know was the fresh until date.
We ordered in June 2014, and received product with a fresh "use by" date of July 2017.
Since I am buying this partially for "prepping", I was happy with the date.

Would buy again.

UPDATE:
I've now eaten this tuna three times. It is great! I was concerned that it might be dry and yuck,
much like Walmart's tuna packets. Nope... these are very moist and have great flavor.
The packets are very easy to open as well. I often just squeeze some mayo right into the packet
and stir it up and scarf it.

Interesting note to me... we have two cats, neither of which likes seafood or tuna flavored cat food.
But when I opened the Bumble Bee packet, our boy cat about climbed up on my shoulder to check it out!
Very unusual for him, but I take it as a sign that this is a much better tuna than the WM brand I've been buying. I let him lick the inner packet (which I cut completely open), and he was eating chunks of tuna right out of my hand. So, this is a better tuna, according to both my fork and my cat! ;-)

title: Melted mess!
text:
Well, apparently you can only order these in the winter!
I ordered three bags, and nothing was done at all to try to protect them,
or even include a little packet of the stay-cool shipping packets.

We picked up the bags out of the box, and had Wilton Soup.
They are in the fridge now, firming up, but they will not be easy to get out of the bag.
It is one blob of candy.

Disappointing that zero effort was made to either deflect heat or add a cooling packet.
I sell online, and use small flat packets that stay cold for two or three days.
So, only order during a very cold winter.

title: I still have to learn how to use it
text:
I am still in a learning curve on this one.
I had no idea what to expect when I ordered it - I only had read about this sugar having a
lower glycemic impact than other sugars.

The sugar itself is brown, and looks like a dark brown sugar.
The taste is going to be one that you either love or hate... to me, it tastes a little like
burnt brown sugar - like you have added a little butter but the sugar itself tried to burn.
Now, I have to say that I like that flavor... I actually am one of the weirdos who likes the burned
parts of foods - the crispy burnt edges of a meatloaf, the charred parts of a hot dog, etc etc.

I have only tried to make one recipe with this so far - peanut butter cookies.
I substituted coconut sugar for the brown sugar. The cookies came out much darker, and hard!
Because this sugar is so dark, it changes the appearance of your food as it cooks. If you normally
use your eye to know when your cookies are done, you won't be able to with this sugar. You have to use
your timer and trust it. Then the cookies themselves were very hard and much drier, despite my
using the same recipe I've used for years - the only change was the coconut sugar. So, I would advise
that if you are going to use this for cookies, add a little fat and moisture from something else - either
a couple extra tablespoons of butter or maybe 1/8 to 1/4 cup of applesauce to help keep your cookies
from becoming dry bricks.

Ironically, this sugar created an opposite reaction as the cookies got older. Normally, we don't have a problem
with cookies getting old at our house! But no one really liked these. I did not throw them away, because I didn't
mind them if I broke off a piece and let it sit in my mouth! Ha! (Like I said, I liked the burnt flavor aspect.)
But here is what is weird - the longer the cookies sat, the SOFTER they got, the complete opposite of normal cookies!

So, you could definitely try this. I wanted to for the lower glycemic index on this sugar. But, it is going to take some
tweaking and adjusting to be able to use it for cooking.

title: One of our favorites to cook with
text:
We love the smokey flavors in foods, and this LIquid Smoke makes a great addition to your foods.
I have used it when making hamburgers and meatloaf, add a little to a crockpot meal,
and even a few drops in pasta salad makes a really nice undertone.

This is always in our pantry, and we love the product.

title: A big hit at our house
text:
I didn't taste a lot of ranch in this, which is fine with me.
My kids absolutely love this, and use it for all kinds of things, from
sandwich spread to dipping french fries in it.

We would definitely buy it again.

title: Very surprising
text:
I ordered this simply because it was on clearance, and thought we'd try it.
I love Dove's milk chocolate, but never tried a flavor blend.

The first thing you notice is that they are visually pretty. I could see even using these to
decorate cakes or cupcakes. They have a chocolate and pink swirl appearance that is really nice.

The taste is pretty good as well. Not overwhelming in either flavor profile.
If you have ever had neapolitan ice cream and had all the flavors melt into the others,
then that is pretty much what these taste like - much like your chocolate and strawberry ice cream
have melted together, and you are eating the mix.

Overall, I would definitely buy these again.

title: One of the best flaxseeds out there
text:
We have never had a bad product from Bob's Red Mill, and this is no change to that.

The product is fresh and tasty, and easy to add to any dish you'd like.
Flaxseed offers so much of a health benefit for such a little item.
We add it to salads, eggs, meatloaf, hamburgers, etc etc.
There is no noticeable taste that I could tell, but perhaps if I added more than I do,
there would be some sort of taste. The way I see it, I am just adding healthy supplements to our food.

title: Nice but would not buy it again
text:
This is a pricey little bottle. It isn't paste thickness, which I actually thought it might be.
Instead, it is only a tiny bit thicker than regular extract.
You can see little flecks in it, so I guess that's the draw.
I used it in cookies, so the effects of bean flecks was not visible.
No one noticed any difference in taste, so will probably not purchase it again.

title: Not too bad, but strong!
text:
I was wanting to try this flavor, but none of our local stores was carrying it.
So, I broke down and bought the six-box pack from Amazon!

First off, know that there is a LOT of sugars in these teas. I don't see why it needs anything except
the honey they advertise, but there are other sugars in it as well, including sucralose and maltodextrin.
You'd think tea and honey would be a fairly basic thing, but Lipton managed to turn it into an additive cocktail.
Just be aware, in case you have blood sugar issues, either high or low.

The taste? I was the only one in the family who remotely liked it.
I could not taste ANY coconut flavor, either in the first taste or the aftertaste. Nothing, Nada.
The passionfruit overrides every other flavor. That isn't a horrible thing, but if you are hoping for a coconut
tea, you'll be disappointed. Not sure why they put that flavor first on the label, but I guess that's because it would
attract the crowd who is currently drinking coconut water. But nothing on the flavor, and it is low on the ingredients list as well.

Note that the nutrition label considers each little packet to be TWO SERVINGS, so when you look at
the sugar and calorie counts, double it for a 16.9 oz bottle of water and one packet.

The passionfruit flavor is overwhelmingly strong in a 16.9 bottle of water. There's no way to do just half
a tube without making a mess. So, just be aware that it'll grow a little hair on your chest. If you are at home
and can do a bigger glass of water, stir it well and add lots of ice, you'll have a good drink.
Oh yeah - we've tried almost all the flavors now, and this one is a beast to get mixed up! It took longer to get the chunks
to dissolve in this one than in ANY of the other flavors we've tried.

So, it is a very sweet and strong tea. If you like strong flavorings, then you'll like this one.
Note that the TEA is not strong - like, missing entirely - and the passionfruit flavor is strong.
If I hadn't mixed it up myself, I would think I was having a glass of juice, not tea at all.
It makes a peachy-orange colored fruity-flavored drink.

Would I buy it again? VERY unlikely. But, I am saying that in the middle of winter.
It might make a super great fruity drink in the middle of a hot summer, with lots of water and ice.

INGREDIENTS (off the box):
Honey granules (sugar,honey)
citric acid (provides tartness)
Green tea powder
Sucralose (sweetener)
Modified corn starch
Maltodextrin
Natural flavor (coconut)
Caramel color (contains SULFITES)
Beta carotine (for color).

So, not exactly a great group of ingredients.
Lipton could do so much better for us.
Still giving it three stars for the convenience and the end product does taste good.
But they lost stars for the misleading flavor labels and lack of tea flavor, as well as so much sugar.

title: First off, no propylene glycol!
text:
It was nice to find a liquid drink additive that wasn't made of glycols.

I have not tried this yet, but I bought it for my husband, who loves peach tea.
We've tried all the various brands of the powders that you add to the water bottles.
While he likes them, he thinks most of them have aftertastes that are not that great.

He made sure to tell me tonight that he really liked this one, and we had to buy it again!
We have not found it locally yet, so I just ordered three more bottles.

There is more sugar than I'd like to see in here, so I suggest that people have this with meals,
not alone, to avoid a blood sugar slam. Seems like honey should be the only sweetener they
need, but Lipton thinks everyone needs more. I'll post the ingredients if/when I get the bottle back
from my husband! I might have to wait until the second order is delivered.

UPDATE: Okay, I tried it tonight. Since I am not a huge fan of peach flavors, I just wanted
to taste the balance of stuff. I did two squeezes into a 16.9oz bottle, and it was pretty good.
My son did 3 squeezes. When asked, Husband said he usually does 3 or 4.
So, being able to make it to taste is great. It's convenient, even if the bottle is a little bit hard to open.

Definitely worth trying. I've ordered another flavor to check it out as well.
A trip to the area WalMart found that they had the bottles there for the same price as Amazon,
but only in one flavor.

title: Excellent product... will purchase again.
text:
We are not hummus or tahini experts, but had wanted to try some different foods.
I'd had a jar of this tahini sitting in the pantry for almost a year without using it! (Shhhhhh!)
I finally decided to just dive in and try it.

The jar had separated into oil and "paste", so it took quite a bit of stirring to get it creamy again. But even after sitting so long, ignored, it tasyed really good.

We made baba ghanoush with this. We didn't entirely like the flavor, so we added a can of garbanzo beans to the recipe (which was mostly tahini, eggplant and lemon juice), blended until smooth, and it was very tasty!
The kiddos inhaled it with tortilla chips.

I would definitely buy this again, and not let it sit so long next time!

title: We got the bag today, and it is already one third gone!
text:
We've been wanting to try these, and when I had enough other items to place an order with Vitacost,
I added these to the cart. (There are shipping discounts on the actual VItacost website. These do not
ship via Amazon.)

The crumbles were fresh and tasty. Everyone had their hand out to sample them, and it went from
a few pieces to a handful a time or two. I bought them to add to cookies and oatmeal - I hope they last
that long!

We'll definitely buy these again. The coating you see is a light coating to keep the dates from sticking into
a glump of fruit. It does not affect the taste at all.
I highly recommend these - the bag is fresher and a better value than the boxes in the grocery stores,
and the taste is truly good.

title: Just as good as I remember from childhood, but problems with dented cans being shipped out
text:
We have loved this spaghetti since it was Chef Boy-Ar-Dee's brand. We went a long time not being able to find it anywhere, then I came across it here on Amazon, under the Campbells label.

The spaghetti is just as good as I remember it. The cheesy sauce makes this so good, you could eat it out of the can!
It is our goulash base as well, and why I order it.

Shipment has been quick and reliable.
My biggest problem is the condition in which the cans arrive...

I am not sure if the mashed cans are sold to Amazon at a discount, or they are getting mashed once they are there.
Two times now, we have received order with at least half of the cans mashed or dented so much, they are hard to open.
There is no way at all to put them on an electric can opener, but we have managed to pry them open with a manual
opener. There seems to be enough packaging in the box, so truly I don't know what the scoop is on why they arrive
in such lousy condition. They are not so far in that we fear contamination, but they shouldn't be mashed at all.
I dinged one star for the apparent inability to store and ship these in such a way that they don't get damaged.

Disappointing shipping issues, but the spaghetti is the great spaghetti of our childhood.

title: If you like the taste of pancake syrup, this is a must-try!!
text:
Well, I am not so sure I would call this pecan pie, but it makes for good marketing during the fall!

No matter what they call it, this is worthy of trying.
Not everyone will enjoy this, but if you like a mix of sweet and salty, give it a try!

Of course, everyone's taste buds are a little different. If I had to describe this flavor, I would say it
was most like regular pancake syrup (NOT maple, just regular), with a salty touch side by side.
I like sweet tastes, so I thought this was a fabulous chip!
If you are not a fan of sweet things or syrup tastes, then don't bother... you won't like this one.
(That leaves more for me! Ha!)
YUMMY - Pringles, this one should be a keeper.

title: Great snack but a little pricey
text:
Well, I've bought these a couple of times before.
The little bags make it nice and easy for my husband to have a snack
and help control his blood sugar while at work.

The price needs to be watched though.
They opened a Sam's Club near us recently, and this same box is $7.99 there.
Of course, no one has to pay shipping that way, but they are basically
doubling the cost here to cover the "free" shipping.

Other than that, they are tasty little peanuts in a very convenient package.

title: SHAME ON YOU, Anna's Choice!!
text:
We had been on a waiting list for notification when this item came back in stock.
Notice received, product ordered.
Product arrived yesterday.

Now, we had 99+ temps here this week, so I am sure heat played a little factor here.
But, the jar was a little oily on the outside, as was the inner seal (greasy/oily on the TOP
of the sealed jar). I am going to be nice and blame the hot temps. We wiped everything off,
peeled the seal off and took a whiff of some of the most wonderful smelling butter ever!
The item came packaged well, so I really don't think it was the shipping. Once the lid was
opened up and the actual product got some exposure to inside room temps, it seemed to get a
little bit firmer.

We quickly got out a roll of crackers to sample this nectar which had arrived at our door.
We didn't bother with silly things like knives or spoons, and dipped our crackers right into
the butter! Ha! It was SO GOOD!

My husband is a cashew freak already, and the kids follow closely behind. I have a hard time chewing
them, so I never get to enjoy cashews like they did - UNTIL NOW!

Now, I admit I thought the jar could have been a little larger. When compared to peanut butter,
it seems so small. But, totally different nuts, so totally different jar. I am sure they had their
reasons for using this size vs the "normal" peanut butter sized jar.

The taste is creamy and smooth, with truly nice aftertaste of roasted cashews.
The ingredients label lists only three things: cashews, macadamia nuts and organic coconut sugar.
No weird preservatives, binders, etc etc. Just fresh nuts with a little natural sweetener.

I said "Shame on you", because now we are hooked on a new product that is not particularly budget-friendly.
But, we will definitely be reordering this item. I've never seen it anywhere in our area, and stumbled
across it during one of my random shopping sessions on Amazon. I even had a request from my husband to
be sure and try making my famous peanut butter cookies using THIS butter instead, or at least a few
scoops of it in the dough! We look forward to trying this on toast, in sandwiches, etc.

Thank you for a product that is so unfussy yet incredibly tasty!

title: This is very tasty rice!
text:
I bought this just on a whim, and because the price was right.
It is packaged well in a reclosable bag you can zip-seal to keep it fresh for the next time.

If you are a rice fan (like everyone at our house is), then you want to add this one
to your rice collection. It cooked up very easily, made the house smell great while cooking,
and tasted great too.

The rice cooks up beautifully - not sticky or lumpy. The grains are all separate and easy
to eat. It reminded me of wild rice a little bit. We eat a lot of brown rice, and that tends to
be a little stickier, so the texture of this rice was very nice.

The smokiness is apparent more in the aftertaste.
If I had to come close, I would say that I would think this might have been cooked on an outdoor grill while
someone was smoking meat on the other side. It is not overwhelming, but we really liked
the smoky taste.

Other than the smokiness, there is no other flavor in this rice, so I would suggest cooking it
in the stock of your choice, like chicken stock or beef stock. We ended up adding just a little
bit of soy sauce to ours to boost the flavor a bit, but we were having shrimp with it and it seemed to fit.

All in all, it was worth getting, and I would buy it again.
The manufacturer does a great job with this one.

title: Still too much bad stuff in them.
text:
Well, such a great idea, but with such poor execution!

Yet again, Mio has chosen to use propylene glycol to liquify their product.
Surely there is a better ingredient than this chemical to make it work.
I love the idea of being able to do a quick squirt and get a nice flavored drink,
but there's no way I will drink this. People are up in arms over GMO foods,
but drink this chemical cocktail.

You can, and should, do a whole lot better for your body. Pass on these.

title: Another really great product!  This tastes so good, and no long waits.
text:
We've been drinking a variety of other brands for several years since moving back to the midwest.
I have both brew and instant teas, and never had a lot of them that I liked.
My husband prefers black teas, and buys this cheapie stuff with 100 bags in a box that looks like they
swept it from the floor of the packaging room. I never liked the taste either, and had given up on tea.

I bought one of these Cold Brew Black Teas just to give it a try.
There is a great attraction about not having to boil water (even in the microwave!) to make tea, then
wait around, then ice it down, etc. (We drink mostly iced tea.) I gave it to my husband to try, and he
was pleasantly surprised!

We used to live in Texas, and made sun tea all the time. We enjoyed the taste, and always had
a big glass container on the back porch "cooking". This gives you almost the same flavors without
the long wait (or the need for sun!).

He really liked it, and loved how it only took a little while to get a great pitcher of tea.
While I am a fan of green tea now, I did end up helping him polish off a half gallon of this tea
over the weekend while we were cooking mass quantities of food for the week.
It was actually very good! It was not bitter in any way, and tasted good even with nothing else in it.

This tea gets all-thumbs up from our house, and we will DEFINITELY be buying this again.

UPDATE, July 2017:
I still love this tea! It remains really hard to find locally, so I still rely on online retailers like Amazon.
(You can buy directly from the company as well.)
My husband has learned to like this as well, but still makes his gallons with three black teas and three green teas,
half and half, all cold brew.

And PS - I have now been Pepsi-free since April 2016!

doesn't upset my stomach. Woo-hoo!
(Trying to rid myself of ALL HFCS products)

title: Fabulous tea!  Made it easier to give up soda.
text:
First off, you must know that I am a recovering Pepsi addict.
I am trying to get away from all the sodas with high fructose corn syrups.

I still love carbonated drinks, and am allergic to aspartame, so my substitutions have been very limited.
There are so many great flavored drinks out there, but the manufacturers seem to want to load them with aspartame or even splenda. I prefer stevia, but good luck getting that for less than $1 a drink! (Crystal Light is really missing the boat with a whole lot of women by using aspartame in the majority of their
great-sounding flavors - I'd buy it all the time if they were stevia.)

Anyway, I really have not been a huge fan of regular iced tea. I've tried several brands, and the only other
one I really like is the Bigelow Red Raspberry herbal tea. The rest of my family drinks a lot of iced tea, but I
just never really liked the black tea they drink. I've tried many brands, but most are just not appealing to me.
I do like Luzianne, having lived in Texas for many years and it is very popular there, but Hubby never buys it!
Since he is the main tea drinker, it is not something I demand my way on! ; )

So, thought I would give this one a try. I'd heard plenty of good things about green tea, but never had it before.
I'd had sips of gas station bottles of green tea with all kinds of other flavorings in them, but regular, plain green tea was still a mystery to me. The cold brew was a big attraction to me, because I am partially disabled, and have limited access to the kitchen/stove area. However, I can fill a pitcher with water from the upstairs sink, and have a small fridge upstairs.

This tea was VERY good! I was not sure what to expect, so I am not judging it against other green teas. It's my first plain green tea. I loved the way I could use two tea bags to make a full quart of tea. I guess you could use just one if you like it weaker, or could let it sit overnight. I sip liquid all day long, so waiting a long time isn't on my agenda either! Ha!

The taste is light and refreshing. There's no funky aftertaste or fuzzy-tongue from this one.
I've tried it with and without sweetener, and actually prefer it right from the pitcher with nothing added.
Now, it is all a matter of taste, so i cannot give you a blanket 'you'll love it', because everyone's taster/palate is different. However, I can honestly say that I can see this replacing my pepsi entirely! I don't drink much pepsi during the summer anyway, since it gets syrupy, but still didn't like the tea my husband made either. Plain water gives me ferocious heartburn for some reason, so I need a flavor of some sort in my drinks. (Most of the little tubes of flavored drink mixes for water bottles use aspartame. What a shame!)

We have already gone through the first box pretty fast, with only two tea bags left!
My son loves it better than the black tea too, and we knock out between a half gallon to a gallon a day
between us, and it isn't even summer yet!

If I had one criticism, it would be how the tea is packaged.
What you see is what you get - the tea bags are sitting directly inside the box, which is then wrapped in cellophane. Once that cellophane wrapper is broken, there is no way to keep the tea fresh, except putting it in your own baggie or jar. There is no wax liner or any other liner in the box to fold back over the tea. I bought a snap-seal wide-mouth container [[ASIN:B0047GSC4Y Snapware 1022 32-Ounce Square-Grip Canister]]] to keep them nice and fresh, and just empty out the boxes as soon as we get them, and tuck them into the container. Very easy.

The tea bags are large, and on a long string with a tag at the end. We just put them in our pitcher with
the tags hanging over the edge, and put it in the fridge to brew. So easy!

Meanwhile, I have already ordered more, and will try to find it locally as well.
Luzianne, you have done a wonderful job with this tea!
As long as the quality stays the same, I'll be a very happy repeat customer!

Update April 20, 2013:
We can't find this tea locally, so we are glad Amazon carries it. This continues to be the drink of choice for me. I also bought an infuser and want to try it with some fruit flavors as well, although I have not yet tried it - been pretty happy with the original flavor of this tea. I will definitely try out lemons, limes and other fruits this summer.

title: These are good, but nothing to faint over
text:
Well, we were immediately drawn to these, since they have a caramel apple flavor.
We ordered them from Amazon, and quite frankly, a lot of the small bars arrived a bit
mushed. we put them in the refrigerator to firm them back up, but that wasn't the problem.
I'm not sure if it was from the cat toy (something for them to rub their faces on) in the same
shipment box could have done the smushing, or if they were improperly stored at the warehouse level.
We haven't found any that didn't have the actual bar cracked, making the caramel stick to the paper.

That being said -
I love regular Milky Ways, so didn't think this could be too horrible.
It isn't. But, it also wasn't worth the price we paid for them!
I have included a photo of the inside.

The taste is pleasant, for sure. I think it was the relative cost-to-candy ratio and the condition in which
they arrived which was annoying for me. The caramel is just like a regular Milky Way and tasty.
The apple part is the bottom nougat - it is a white shade, and tastes like a candy apple more than a
caramel apple. So, you have a candy apple bottom with the caramel on the top.
Again, good, but nothing to do a city-wide search to find.

title: We love most of the BTB's but...
text:
Okay, I am a fairly new recruit to the "bases" for cooking.
They have some MSG, but no added/additional MSG, so the amounts have been
low enough to not cause problems. (My husband gets migraines from MSG.)

We love most of the flavors, and I was anxious to try this one as well.
They don't carry anything but beef and chicken in our local stores, so all
the other flavors have to be purchased online. That makes them very expensive to use,
since the shipping is never cheap for these heavy little glass jars.

I made a batch of New England style clam chowder last week and used the clam base.
I was looking forward to a real clam-intense flavor from the base that would be more
than the milk/cream combo. It was VERy disappointing. I used enough of the product, but
I would have had to double it to get any taste, in my opinion. I didn't want to do that,
since I don't know what other flavor tweak it might have caused to have double the recommended
amount.

Over all, I love all the bases (the chili is amazing!), but the clam leaves a lot to be desired.
I also have a lobster, so the next time I make the chowder, I'll try it with lobster base instead.
This one is just too "blah" to be useful for very much.
I don't think I'll buy it again.

title: Bugles hit the mark on this one...tasty!
text:
I have dental problems, so my enjoyment of normal crunchy things isn't what it used to be.
I can't eat popcorn anymore, for example.

That being said, I had to say that I LOVE these Bugles!
They dissolve fairly easily, so I would guess they are easy to chew too.

The taste? Great! The closest I can come is like caramel corn without the hulls!
A little sweet, a little salt (our bag was not overly salty like another reviewer had mentioned),
and a lot of very tasty!

I didn't even look at the ingredients or calorie count on this one, because quite frankly,
there are times that I just don't care. This is one of them.
Of course, don't eat anything like this every day, but when you can't decide between sweet or salty,
this will fill the void!

Great job Bugles - this one is a keeper!
