It makes amazing chili dogs, too. And chili mac. And chili cornbread casserole (thicken the chili a little, put it in a square baking dish, top with dollops of cornbread batter, bake at 350 until cornbread is puffed and starting to brown).

Carroll Shelby's mix has just the right combination of spices to make the best tasting chili I've ever had. I'll so glad that it's available right here on Amazon.

title: Easy and tasty!
text:
Surprisingly good -- I use this with linguine or angel hair pasta to create a tasty side dish to go with grilled scallops or salmon. I use just a little less oil than called for, and it works just fine. Just follow the directions on the package, and you can't go wrong. Each packet makes 2 servings, so it's perfect for singles or empty nesters.

It's not too salty -- a big problem with a lot of things like this -- and the sun dried tomato flavor comes through loud and clear. Amazon's price is very reasonable, too.

Here's another use: it makes amazingly good stuffed portobello mushrooms! Very easy -- here's what you need for 4 servings:

1 lb of Italian sausage, casings removed (I use good very lean sausage that I order online from a place near Hermann, MO)
1/4 C dried bread crumbs (I use plain bread crumbs, NOT the seasoned ones)
1 envelope Mayacamas Dried Tomato pasta mix
4 medium-large (4" or so) portobello mushrooms, cleaned, with stems removed and finely chopped (remove gills and discard)
2/3 C shredded mozzarella cheese, divided.

In a bowl, mix sausage, bread crumbs, Mayacamas mix, chopped mushroom stems, and 1/3 C of the cheese until well blended.
Spray mushrooms with non-stick spray and place "hollow side up" in a shallow lighly greased (I use non-stick spray) baking pan.
Divide sausage mixture among the 4 mushroom caps, packing it into the hollow left by the removal of the gills and stems.
Top with the remaining 1/3 C shredded cheese, distributing it evenly over caps.
Bake at 325 for 30-40 minutes. Test for doneness with a meat thermometer - filling is done when it registers 165 degrees. Cool slightly; serve with garden salad and breadsticks. Enjoy!!

I've been using this stuff for over a year, a couple of times a month or so. Really, really tasty!

title: Not fantastic, but reasonably tasty ...
text:
These "soft" packaged pasta sauces are a relatively new form -- shelf stable, unbreakable packaging, etc.

And Bertolli is known as a more "upscale" premium brand. I've used their pasta and sauces for years.

This product, however, didn't quite live up to my expectations. It's plenty tasty, but I found no slices of mushrooms as shown on the package front in the three packages of this I've tried so far. The mushroom flavor is there, and it looks like there are very finely diced mushrooms in the sauce. But I was expecting a chunkier sauce, with mushroom slices and tomato chunks.

That said, the sauce tastes very good -- plenty of ripe tomato flavor, decent garlic, earthy mushroom. I used it as a base for a spaghetti and meatballs dinner, as well as a quick lunch just heated and served over linguine.

Is it worth the money? I'm not sure it is. I like the jarred sauce better in terms of texture, and it's definitely cheaper. But these are easier to store, so there's something to be said for convenience. I'm just not sure it's worth the extra $$.

I give this 4 stars for the taste and convenience; 3 for value.

title: Total yum!
text:
This stuff is great! Terrific flavor, great texture, and oh so many uses.

It's wonderful on crackers, bruschetta, pita chips, etc. I've also used it as a base for goat-cheese pizzas.

The jars are on the small side -- 3 1/2 oz -- about 1/2 Cup -- but that's OK for me. I don't usually use that much at one time (unless I'm doing pizza), so a jar can last awhile.

I can't find this locally. None of my local markets carry it -- they carry another type of sundried tomato "pesto"-type sauce, but this stuff is SO much better. So I'll continue to order it online as long as it's available.

title: Low fat, high fiber -- and great taste!
text:
This cereal has just about everything: great crunch, lots of interesting "bits" (cranberries, nuts, etc.), and it's wonderfully filling. Two-thirds of a cup doesn't sound like a lot, but with this stuff and 1/2 C of skim milk, it's a decent serving.

If you're on Weight Watchers, this will fit right in: a serving with skim milk is only 4 points -- not bad for a nice filling breakfast. Add some fresh fruit, and you're set to go.

Amazon's price is quite good, too. This stuff is sky high in the supermarket if you can find it. Yes, you have to buy 5 packages, but a little goes a long way -- I have it 2-3 times a week, and I'm not getting tired of it at all.

All in all, a good value: healthy, filling, and great taste.

title: The BEST dried cranberries ....
text:
These are the BEST dried cranberries out there. They're plump, tender, super high flavor -- and NOT TOO SWEET! My biggest complaint with many of the supermarket popular brands is the high amount of added sugar. I want cranberries to taste TART -- Hello!?!? That's what makes a cranberry a cranberry. Adding tons of sugar just dilutes the wonderful flavor.

These are just about perfect. I'm single, so I "repackage" the four pounds into 8 oz packages, and toss most of them into the freezer. I use them several times a week: on my breakfast cereal (I love them on Frosted Mini-Wheats), in rice pilaf (with slivered almonds), chopped and mixed into cream cheese with some chopped walnuts, in homemade apple pie -- and of course right out of the package as a snack.

As long as I can find these, I'll keep buying them. And I'm definitely trying more of Traverse Bay's products. If they're as good as these, it will be money well spent.

title: Not bad for the price ...
text:
I'm a sucker for dark chocolate, so when these became available, I had to try them.

They're not bad at all. If you're familiar with Hershey's Nuggets, these will look and "feel" somewhat familiar. Hershey's isn't the highest quality chocolate out there, but for the price, it's a decent buy.

My only quibble with these is the "truffle" filling. I'm used to chocolate truffle that is silky smooth. This seems a tad "grainy" for my taste. The flavor is just fine: a nice dark semi-sweet chocolate taste. But the texture of the filling wasn't quite as smooth as I would have liked and expected.

Still, for the money, they're just fine. They have a nice intense dark chocolate flavor with no bitterness, and that puts them well ahead of some of the competition. Amazon's price makes these a decent buy, too.

title: Really tasty!
text:
I LOVE Indian food, and I've struggled to re-create my favorite restaurant dishes at home. I love to cook, and it's not terribly difficult, but it always seems that the best dishes require dozens of ingredients, mostly spices, that have to be pre-blended in a specific order. So I had pretty much relegated myself to getting my Indian food fix with occasional visits to my favorite Indian restaurants.

Then I discovered the Kitchens of India products. Oh. My. Goodness. This stuff is incredible! Butter Chicken is one of my all-time favorite dishes, and my favorite Indian restaurant (Saffron in Seattle) does an amazing version of it. The Kitchens of India Curry Paste for Butter Chicken comes *very* close to the quality of that restaurant dish.

The ingredients in the paste are all-natural -- no preservatives, nothing with unpronounceable names. Just tomato paste and spices (mostly). You just add butter (natch), chicken, and water, and let it simmer for 20 minutes.

I've used chicken breasts cut into large pieces, and chicken thighs, too. I prefer the flavor of thighs (skinless/boneless), but they're both good. I usually serve it with Pulao -- Basmati rice spiced with cinnamon stick, cardamom pods, cumin seed, bay, cloves, sultanas, and slivered almonds. Yum!

Amazon's price is good, too, considering that you get 3 servings or so from each 3.5-oz package.

I can't wait to try more of the Kitchens of India products -- so far, I've had this one and the lamb curry, and both have been exceptional.

title: Wonderful flavor ....
text:
I first tried this a couple of months ago after purchasing it at my supermarket for more than double the price here. I was blown away at how easy it was to fix, and how tasty it is! It's not too salty, and makes quite a lot.

I was thrilled to find it here on Amazon, and quickly calculated that the price of 10 packages of rice PLUS the shipping was less than the cost of 10 packages from my local store. I can go through 10 packages in a couple of months, so ordering from Amazon definitely makes sense.

As someone else mentioned, reducing the amount of water just a bit makes for a fluffier end product. I use this a lot when I make Indian dishes (using sauce mixes I also purchase from Amazon), and also with baked herbed chicken. Yum!!

title: Wow!  This stuff is GOOD!
text:
I usually make my own curries from scratch, but sometimes I'm in a hurry and prefer not to spend the time required. At that point, I'd head to one of the several good Indian restaurants to satisfy my curry cravings.

I read the reviews here, and decided to give the Kitchens of India Curry Paste for Lamb a try. All I can say is WOW! This stuff really IS good. At just over $2.00 per package, it's a great deal, too. Each package makes 2-3 servings -- very reasonable indeed.

I used lamb shoulder, cut into bite-sized pieces, and browned it a bit (the instructions don't tell you to do that, but I like the flavor), then added the paste and 2 cups of water. Bring it to a boil, and let it simmer for 45 minutes or so. I paired it with [[ASIN:B0001XIZMQ Saffron Yellow Rice]], and it was very tasty.

I'll definitely be buying more of this. I also purchased the Kitchens of India Butter Chicken mix at the same time, and can't wait to try it!

title: One of the better Millstone varieties ...
text:
I find Millstone coffees to be a mixed bag: some are very nice (Kona, Foglifter, Columbian) and some are, frankly, awful (Chocolate Velvet).

This is one of the good ones.

The hazelnut flavor isn't too overpowering, and there's just a hint of vanilla, enough that you can taste it.

Amazon's price is very good, too. This brand is sold in most of our local supermarkets for quite a lot more.

I'll likely be drinking this quite often.

title: A little bit of chocolate heaven ...
text:
Wow! As an unrepentant chocoholic, I'm always looking for great yummy chocolate treats. Unfortunately, there IS a downside: too much of a good thing can lead to less than desirable results, especially on the scale.

Soooo ... I try to moderate my chocolate consumption, exercising portion control, etc.

I've been a big fan of Warm Delights since they were introduced - they're VERY good and easy to prepare -- but they're rather high in calories (and Weight Watchers points).

These new Minis are the perfect solution: 150 calories (or 3 Weight Watchers points). I fix one of these, and top it with a small scoop of low-fat frozen yogurt -- heaven! They're just the right size to give me my chocolate "fix."

The price here is excellent, too.

title: Really good pasta!
text:
Most "multi-colored" pastas lose both flavor and color with cooking, and you end up with a bunch of noodles that are sort of gray-ish and relatively bland.

NOT SO with this product! The flavors and colors hold up well in cooking. The mixture of shapes adds interest and vibrancy to any pasta dish.

I've used this pasta for baked chicken alfredo, for pasta with sausage and peppers, and for a quick pasta with marinara sauce. The flavor is excellent in all three dishes.

Although this is a 10-oz package, it cooks up to an amount equivalent to a 12-oz package of lower-quality pasta.

Finally -- this high-quality pasta is lower in calories and fat (and higher in fiber due to the veggies) than others -- which translates to lower points if you're on Weight Watchers: about 200 calories or 4 pts per generous serving.

All things considered, this is an excellent value.

title: Wonderful for singles/couples ...
text:
This comes packaged in a packet that contains two envelopes of the peanut-spice coating mix, each one covering 2 large chicken breast halves. You can use one, and save the other for a later meal. This is a VERY nice touch for those of us who cook for only one or two people.

The mix itself is very good -- mildly spicy with finely chopped peanuts. It bakes into a yummy "sweet"-spicy sauce, a little like barbecue sauce. It's much better than the usual "shake and bake" coating mixes. I've had it on chicken breast halves, chicken tenders, and pork chops so far, and really like the flavor. It isn't too salty, either.

I'll definitely be purchasing more of this in the future.

title: Not bad at all ...
text:
This stuff cooks up quickly in the biodegradable bowl. It's not quite as good as freshly made "from scratch," but then I don't really expect it to be. I've had this "plain," but also topped with some grilled chicken, cooked shrimp, and some sliced beef, and it's all equally good.

The package says it serves 2, but the portion size is a little on the small side.

Personally, I think it needs a bit more lime flavor and a little less salt. I usually add about 1/2 tsp of lime juice and about a tablespoon of sliced fresh scallions.

If you're looking for a quick simple-to-prepare dish for one, this is a reasonable choice.

title: Wow!  These are REALLY good! ...
text:
I'm always looking for healthier alternatives to the standard grocery store chips, and these certainly fill that bill.

They are definitely spicy -- I like things with a lot of flavor, so they're perfect for me, but if you're not into foods that supply a little after-kick, these may be a tad too spicy.

Amazon's price isn't bad, either. I've seen premium chips in the store for about 50% more than these.

I'm very pleased with these, and plan to purchase more.

title: Excellent quality, great price!
text:
This is some seriously good pasta. I've seen this at my local supermarket, but the cost per package is about 50% more than the price here. I've ordered a few different varieties from Amazon, and they're all wonderful.

The Fiesta (tri color) fettuccine is one of my favorites for cream sauces and for lighter "non-chunky" mixtures (like a nice bright pesto or sun-dried tomato toss).

One of the biggest advantages is the time it takes to prepare -- this is NOT like the hard dried pasta you find among the cheaper store brands. This stuff really takes only 3-5 minutes (tops!) to cook to al dente. It's that fast. And the flavor! Wow! It tastes like the best fresh pasta you can find. The packages are 12 oz, but you end up with about the same amount of cooked pasta as you would from a 16-oz package of the cheap stuff.

I'm sold -- and will continue to buy this stuff from Amazon as long as they carry it.

title: Tasty product at a great price ...
text:
I've watched the price of cereal rise in the stores, and I've been looking for good alternatives that are reasonably healthy (lower in fat, etc.)

I decided to give this a try, and I'm so glad I did! The price is amazing for the quality. It has a soft vanilla flavor with just the right amount of nuts for me. You get 16 oz in each package; the stuff in the stores is easily double the cost of this, and you get only a 12- or 13-oz package.

I'll be buying more of this for sure, as well as some of the other varieties made by Golden Temple. If you're a little nervous about whether or not you'll like this enough to risk getting six pounds of the stuff, find a couple of friends and split the cost. You'll each get two packages, and the cost will be less than $2 per package. That'll give you a chance to try it without risking too much. My guess is you'll be favorably impressed.

title: This is a GREAT deal!
text:
This pasta is quite expensive at my local market, so I was thrilled to find it at such a reasonable price here on Amazon.

It is SUPERB pasta with exceptionally good flavor. The linguine does cook up very quickly -- 3-4 minutes, tops, and you really don't want to overcook this. This is not your mother's dried pasta -- it cooks up more like fresh, so keep an eye on it until you get a feeling for how long it takes.

I'm hoping Amazon keeps this in stock for a long time -- I'll be a repeat customer for sure!

title: Yumm!!
text: Excellent quality, not *too* sweet (we're talking milk chocolate here, so it has some sweetness to it).  The filling has a really intense strawberry flavor, with just the right amount of "tang" to make it really interesting.  I just received my second order of these -- the price is better than I can get locally (and with Prime, there's no shipping added).  This is one of my favorite sweet treats!

title: Sweet with a "kick"!
text:
As a previous reviewer stated, this mustard packs a punch. But if you like things on the hot 'n' spicy side, you'll love this. Use it in moderation the first time, just to get a feel for the spiciness level. Then adjust later as needed.

I love it on brats, kielbasa, knockwurst, hot dogs, burgers, and I use it in marinades for chicken (mix with some lemon juice, oil, and a little minced garlic) or for grilling salmon (thin with a little oil, then brush on the salmon and grill).

I'm a big fan of the Beaver line of sandwich spreads/mustards/etc. This one is near the top of my list.

title: Outrageously good!
text:
I grew up in Kansas City, MO, so Wolferman's English muffins were for a long time a staple in my home. I've tried a lot of different muffin brands, from cheap store brands (not worth the money) to higher-end commercial brands. NOTHING beats these Bays muffins!

They're not fork split -- they're actually sliced, but that's not necessarily a bad thing. They still have plenty of "nooks and crannies" for the melted butter due to the high-quality yeast they use. Pop 'em in the toaster, and you'll get a nice crispy exterior and a chewy and flavorful interior. The flavor is wonderful -- just the right amount of yeastiness, but no "sour" taste. Great for breakfast with butter and a little marmalade or jam, but they also hold up well under heartier accompaniments or in sandwiches. The flavor still comes through.

I made room in my refrigerator's freezer for these, even giving up some ice cream room! The sacrifice was worth it.

title: Really tasty!
text: I was a little surprised.  I'm not a huge fan of packaged rice or noodle dishes, but sometimes I need to throw together something quickly.  I was intrigued by the list of ingredients, and decided to give Fox River Rice Creole a try.  I'm glad I did!  This is seriously good stuff -- lots of flavor, easy to prepare, etc.  Best of all, it's not overly salty, one of my pet peeves with packaged food.  It's great as a side dish, but I think it would also be wonderful with a little dded sausage (maybe some andouille).  I'll definitely be purchasing this again.

title: A chocoholic's dream come true!
text:
I know the description talks more about nuts, etc., but this stuff is actually seriously CHOCOLATE! It's a creamy fudgy chocolate spread with a hazelnut flavor (think fudge spiked with hazelnut liqueur). It's incredibly rich -- a little really goes a long way. I usually just spread it on graham crackers for a wonderful indulgent treat.

I'm hooked -- this will be in my pantry from now on. (No refrigeration necessary -- how convenient is that?)

title: It doesn't get much better than this ...
text:
This is yet another new favorite! I've tried several varieties of Immaculate Baking Company's cookies, and every time I try a new one, it becomes my "favorite"! This one is no different. It tastes like a "pumpkin pie" in cookie form, with a bit more "kick" than your typical pumpkin pie filling. I love the 2-oz snack bags -- otherwise, I'd be really pigging out on these. I just toss one in my book bag on my way out the door in the morning for a quick snack between classes (I'm a full-time student).

Really, these are unusually good, high quality cookies. At about $.80 per pack, they're a good deal. As long as Amazon keeps stocking them, I'll keep buying them.

title: Another winner from Immaculate Baking Company ....
text:
Wow! These really are very yummy. They're soft chewy cookies, more like little brownies, small nuggets of dense chocolate goodness with chocolate chips. For an unrepentent chocoholic like me, they're a little slice of choco-heaven.

Well worth the price, the small bags are the perfect size for the brown bag lunch or an afternoon snack. My second favorite flavor from Immaculate (my favorite, so far, is the Key Largo Lime cookie), these are likewise made with no preservatives, all natural ingredients, organic. I'm re-ordering (and planning to store some extras in the freezer).

Enjoy!

title: Outstanding quality -- VERY yummy!
text:
These are some really tasty little cookies. Intense key lime flavor, buttery, a few well-placed white chocolate chips -- just the right size for a quick snack. I love the fact that they're pre-packaged in 2-ounce packs -- as someone who is constantly dieting (and who has a well-honed affinity for sweets), I can practice portion control without really trying.

I'll be reordering for sure when these are gone. Seriously, these are well worth the price. They don't taste at all like "packaged cookies" -- more like home-made.

title: Tasty and quick breakfast ...
text:
I realize that breakfast is really important, but as a busy full-time "non-traditional" undergrad, it's not always easy to fit it into my schedule. I'm always looking for something quick and nutritious, and I had tried various brands of instant oatmeal. They were OK -- pleasant tasting, somewhat filling, good in a pinch.

Then I found McCann's Instant Irish Oatmeal -- oh my!!!!! I've died and gone to breakfast heaven! Seriously, this is amazingly good stuff. The Apple Cinnamon is my favorite variety: full of chunks of apple, excellent cinnamon flavor, filling, really wonderful stuff. The Maple Brown Sugar is tasty, too -- I usually throw in a couple of tablespoons of sultanas or currants for some added texture.

Well, I'm hooked. I can have a nice hot tasty breakfast in less time than it takes to feed the cat. Yeah, this is a little pricier than what you'll find at your local supermarket, but I think it's worth it.

title: This Is a Fabulous Idea in Need of Improvement
text:
I love the idea of this where you can have hot pasta in just 60 seconds via the microwave. Sadly, it is in big need of improvement.

I have two different microwaves (a Whirlpool and a Panasonic). So, I can conduct multiple tests.

I tried the Penne and the Gemelli. Both results identical. A lot of the pasta cooked in the bag comes out darker colored/overcooked.

OK, so I shortened the 60-second cooking time which helped, but then the pasta was not hot enough.

As soon as the microwave starts you hear popping sounds coming from the bag. And again, in either microwave, the results were disappointing. It's as if there is no way to keep some of the pasta from overcooking.

The alternative: Do not heat the pasta in the bag. Pour out the pasta first into a microwaveable bowl. Then put the bowl in the microwave for 45 to 60 seconds.

OK, so now that I solved the heating problem, how is the taste? Well, when I tasted it when heated in the bag, I did not like the taste. After cooking it in a microwaveable bowl, the taste is better but not even close to the quality taste when cooking pasta the old fashioned way in a pot of boiling water.

The taste is certainly acceptable, especially if you're covering it with great sauce or butter or cheese or flavoring. And if you really want pasta cooked in 60 seconds or less, this will certainly work well. I just wish they had found a way to make this "Ready Pasta" equal to traditionally-cooked pasta.

(Please note that you can heat this pasta in a pan or pot over the stove with some olive oil. I did not try it this way.)

The cap is also difficult to dispense the syrup without getting it on the cap and/or bottle. The price is good, though. I don't believe this to be a "healthier" alternative. Just more convenient than trying to melt sugar in a cold beverage.

title: Not impressed.

Unfortunately, by the time they got here, the shrimp had already thawed, despite being in a styrofoam cooler. When re-frozen, froze together in a solid lump which basically forced me to boil them to separate them. By the time they were separated, they had zero flavor. Might be worthwhile if purchased at a supermarket and kept frozen, but not good for delivery, especially in warmer weather.

title: These were a big part of how I quit smoking!
text:
I know, weird title, but it's true. Almost a decade ago now, my ex and I decided to quit smoking. I had support of family and friends and kept a pocketful of Atomic Fireballs. Every time I had a craving for a cigarette, I just put a Fireball in my mouth and went about my business. I celebrate a decade as a former smoker in less than a week.

(Side note: I put the "giftable" as a 1 because I'm not sharing my Fireballs. Get your own!)

And if you're thinking I work for them or am sponsored by them, all I can say is: I wish. Maybe then I'd get a discount on it.

title: Best Sports Drink Ever
text:
I’m no expert on sports drinks so I can’t really speak to the ingredients or compare them to other similar products but like so many others, I struggle to drink as much water as recommended and know that I feel much better in every way when I can stay hydrated. My son turned me on to Body Armor and I thought it was delicious. I love sugary drinks and Coca Cola is my guilty pleasure. I drink quite a bit of it despite knowing that it is terrible for me in several ways. I started out with the regular flavors but decided to try the Lyte variety because they have almost no calories for the entire bottle. I can down on of these puppies in a few minutes where it takes me an hour to nurse a bottle of plain water. I’m no athlete but I do work out and these drinks are great at quenching thirst and I’m hoping that the ingredients are replenishing to my body. The Peach Mango is my favorite flavor but honestly I have not found one that I don’t like! Even better, they are reasonably priced on Amazon and cheaper than they are at my local grocery store even when they are on sale. I hesitate to post this glowing review because I don’t want to run out if everyone runs to snap them up. I have the PM flavor on auto-delivery and last night, after reading a bunch of reviews, ordered a few more flavors to have on hand for variety. With Body Armor Lyte I have a beverage that keeps me able to drink the recommended amount of fluid daily while not feeling guilty for the empty calories or spending a fortune. I am a huge fan of this product. I hope they never stop making it and that Amazon continues to make it available at an affordable price.

UPDATE: I just got my shipment of the Coconut flavor and if it’s possible I like it even BETTER than the Peach Mango and I haven’t even tried the Strawberry Lemonade yet. Someone had said these were 40 calories a bottle but it looks to me like there is only one serving per bottle making them only 20 calories for the whole bottle Either way a winner in my book. These things are the easiest way I have ever found to hydrate. Amazon don’t stop carrying these and don’t quadruple the price. Enough said.

title: Best K-cup there is!!!
text: I have tried many varieties of k-cups and this one is by far my favorite.  Having said that, this cup of coffee is not for the faint of heart.  This is the strongest, boldest cup of coffee I have found.  It has almost a burnt flavor that I adore!  When this coffee is brewing the aroma is just about Heaven!!  If you prefer a more mellow blend I don't think you will like Big Easy too much, but personally I don't like the flavored cups which taste diluted to me.  You know you are drinking a strong, flavorful cup of coffee when you pop this in your machine.  It will stand up to cream, and is the perfect wake up beverage.  I love Coffee People French Roast, and Timothy's Rainforest Espresso, but I have to say they now taste almost ordinary to me after having discovered Big Easy Bold.  If you are looking for the boldest, most THERE cup of coffee you have ever prepared, you will not be disappointed,  Emeril Rules!!!!!

title: Some better than others
text:
I did not know what varieties were in this package. It has Wake-Up Call, Black Tiger, French Roast, French Roast Decaf, and Organic Bold. In my opinion the French Roast is the best one. It is strong but not bitter and smells just the way I want coffee to smell. None of them are bad, but I wouldn't by the others by themselves. I was hoping that some of the other highly rated Coffee People Bold varieties would be included like Donut Shop Coffee and Jet Fuel. I will try them next. The other CP Bold variety pack has "flavored" bold coffees and I am not a big fan of flavored coffee. I prefer to brew a great cup of strong coffee and flavor it myself if the mood strikes me. I was told at Starbucks that coffee sold flavored has usually had some type of error in it's roasting process. In my experience flavored coffee tends to be weak, especially in K-cups. Even on the smallest cup setting I can not get the coffee to taste strong enough. I also get sick of 50 cups of them same flavor!
I hope this was helpful.

As an update: I was informed that the "bold" K-cup varieties actually contain more coffee by weight per cup, and in fact after checking the packages I found it to be true. Who knew? :)

text:
In regards to the masala tea, a review: upon opening the canister, I took a sniff. This is really Pungent (with a capital p). Not in a bad way, but sure packs a spicy punch.

After reading some reviews I was aware to shake the canister before using to mix the contents and counteract the settling of the various spices. Half the cup with hot water, one level scoop of the tea, (VERY glad I did not let my inner gremlin win, tempted to put in two) two tsp, sugar, stir vigorously, and filled the rest with milk and stir again.

I find this tea spicy in the way curry strikes me as spicy: smooth to start with a bit of an after bite. It has a somewhat peppery flavor but not overwhelmingly so. I will warm the milk first in the future as it predictably cooled the tea a little too much. There was a bit of sediment at the bottom of the cup, but I probably didn't stir it well enough before adding the milk.

It is not a tea to drink in the evening to relax. More of a morning or afternoon tea to pick up your flagging energy. My gums were still tingling a half hour after finishing my cuppa. LOL I would buy again. Not an everyday tea, but will definitely keep me warm this winter!

title: So many ways to serve this wonderful staple food.
text:
I soak this dried corn overnight in a closed glass container, in the fridge, in the coldest, freshest cleanest water I can get (tap water)..
The next day rinse with lots of cold tap water in a colander.
Add to large pot with lots more clean cold water and bring to boil for a solid 5 minutes. I add no seasoning letting the dried corn absorb water freely. Salt will alter the water absorption process.
Set the temperature to low and cover. Let your corn simmer for 2 hours then check. It will have absorbed lots of water and puffed up a little at this point.
How long you simmer after this depends on how firm or soft and puffy you want your corn to be.
When the corn has puffed up to your preference and almost finished, add salt and other spices.
This corn can then be stored in a covered air tight container in the fridge for a very long time.
I ground some cheese flavored corn snacks and added this for a wonderful cheese flavored hominy corn.
So many ways to serve this wonderful staple food.

title: Welp, I need rehab now
text:
I watch news reports of drug addicts, alcoholics, etc. I have never been addicted to anything but ok, thanks to Amazon, I now have a SERIOUS addiction to cookie butter. I mean, people……it’s bad! I eat it with a spoon. I slather it on crackers, toast, bagels, burgers, lettuce, tortillas, crackers…..I’m pretty sure if I had boiled cod, grilled steak or white chili, cookie butter would be slathered on or in. Now, I know what you are saying…..hey, it’s not illegal. Yep, it’s not. No one cares if I now need cookie butter rehab. Sure, crack. Rehab. Booze. Rehab. Painkillers. Rehab. Even overeaters anonymous. I have checked and there simply is no “I have eaten so much cookie butter, my gelatinous butt must be lifted out of my home with a crane”. No rehab. None. Quite frankly, it’s a bit disappointing. I have no idea how to break this cycle of ‘eat, slather, sleep, eat, slather, repeat”. Sigh. Oh well, I’m off to bathe in cookie butter.
I wonder if I can put this stuff in meatloaf? (Rubs hands with glee). I shall find away.
Cookie Butter is the elixir of life!

Ok…..perhaps this was a bit overly dramatic but this stuff is seriously good.

title: Out of Date!
text: All three jars I reviewed were out of date! Do not order because you may likely get the same thing. I was so looking forward to these too. Such a shame. Under the circumstances, I would give 0 stars if I could.

title: Soooo good.
text: I used to live in Ireland and loved these. I was glad they could be ordered on Amazon at a fairly reasonable price. A bit of mint sauce and malt vinegar, served with fish, these are wonderful. Thanks Amazon for stocking them!

title: Very expensive!
text: We have to use dairy free sweetened condensed milk and this stuff is harder to find than hens teeth. That said, I knew how much it was as the price was clearly listed but still, it felt like highway robbery. I am glad it was available here and yes, will buy more at that price, if I must. The product is great and you cannot tell the difference in this and the standard sweetened condensed milk. I just wish it was still available in stores.

title: Awful
text: I have had clotted cream both in the UK and Ireland. This was awful. I stored it in the fridge after opening and it became hard as stick butter. Also, nothing like the flavor I remembered. Would advise people to stay away from it.

title: Excellent seasoning
text: We have used this on lamb, ham and in mushy peas. It’s a wonderful flavor and a little goes a long way but oh so worth it!

title: Excellent flavor!
text: We made these with a little Norfolk mint sauce and pub malt vinegar. Very different from green peas or split peas. Excellent flavor. Next time will order more!

title: Excellent
text: These are excellent. Very moist, great flavor and fast shipping. They are very expensive but I knew the cost when I ordered them. I would recommend these if you have a few dollars to spare. They were just like I had in England.

title: Food of the gods
text:
This stuff is amazing! I like the bars so thought I would check this out. It is even so much better than the bars (which is saying a lot). I will definitely be ordering more and more and more…….
Sooooooooooo good!!!!

title: Love this!
text: This is the most awesome snack. Bit tangy, bit spicy. Kind of addictive. I’ve tried lots of brands of these and these are the best.

title: Wow sorely sour!
text:
This bag lasted one night in my house. We all love sour candy (ok, most candy in general) but getting good sour candy is tough. This was so sour that the next morning all our tongues were that “it was so sour but so good” pain. Worth it.
If you love sour candy, you must try the chair belts.

title: Put them in the freezer!
text: These are awesome as is or put them in the freezer and they are even better. Honestly, I could eat them all in one sitting. I’m so happy I found them on Amazon.

title: Awesome!
text: These are the perfect combination of spicy and sweet. Love them and will order more. I’m not sure if they are healthier than other “junk food” but they sure do taste better. Soooooo addicting.

title: Threw away!
text: These were horrible! They did come in a nice resealable bag but the flavor was just awful. To me, they taste like vomit. I spit out a bite and then threw them away. What a waste of money! Odd, I love bacon and maple. I love the combination but in this product it was just inedible. Yuck!

title: Couldn’t eat it
text: Had to throw it out

title: Makes wonderful winter Sbiten
text: We make a warm winter drink using blackberry jam, water and spices called Sbiten (a Russian hoy drink). This brand was delicious. Right now, I noticed, it’s unavailable. I hope it comes back in stock because it is the difference in average Sbiten or out of this world Sbiten. Will order several more jars if it is available again.

title: Awesome
text: This stuff is so much better than grocery store vanilla. It makes everything that takes vanilla sooooo much better. Very happy customer!

title: Excellent Flavor
text: This cinnamon has a complex taste, unlike regular cinnamon. It’s rich and a tad spicy, though not hot. I use it in hot chocolate, horchata, Atole, applesauce, etc. It gives a flavor depth ordinary cinnamon doesn’t give. Will certainly buy again.

title: LOVE THIS!!!!
text:
This is fantastic! I added a bit of Mexican vanilla and it was very good. It could have been a bit more spicy but it was very very good! Highly recommended. I love the smoky flavor and if made with milk, it’s just a cup of spicy milky Mexican memories.
Love it! Will order again and again.

title: Addicting!
text: These are uber expensive but my goodness are they good. For a real treat, these are amazing. The heat is mild but pairs with the sweetness of the pineapple and mango perfectly. I expected them to be hotter but turns out they are perfect. I can’t recommend these highly enough. Just delicious. Too expensive for me on a regular basis but still, I will no doubt order again.

title: Wow! Yum!
text: I love these. I got the blueberry-lemon and they are soooooo good! These will last a while but when I’m out, I will be ordering more. Sooooo good!!!

title: Hard to see the water line
text: These were ok. It was hard to see the water line and the taste was ok but nothing special. I’m not disappointed I ordered them but probably won’t order again.

title: Love the flavor!
text:
The flavor of these are great. I usually add more milk/water than it calls for and I also add my own cheeses and sometimes sausage or black pudding chunks. This often serves as the base for soups or just a mashed potato base I use to great various types of mashed potato dishes. A family favorite is to start with this, add extra milk, cheese etc. Then throw in garlic, onion and pieces of spicy cooked brats. Add spices like Chicago Seasoning, garlic powder, onion powder, truffle powder and whatever other spices I think of. Easy to have these packages on hand so the side does not take very long.
Will be ordering more.

title: Great in soups!
text: I love this powder. I add it to soups, rice, mashed potatoes etc. It gives a bit of a more complex note to everyday dishes. I was unsure about it when I ordered but thought I would take a chance and I’m so glad I did. It will last a very long time as a little goes a long way but that makes it even more economical. Wonderful product. Never knew what I was missing before.

title: Geez these are addicting
text:
If I were going to have to pick only one junk food snack to have for the rest of my life, this would be it. They are small and rich, so a few go a long way but are so delicious. I’ve ordered numerous packages of these over the last year and I love each package just like the first one.
I can’t find them locally so buying them online is convenient and the price is very reasonable. A win/win.

title: Convenient!
text: Love this rice. It’s convenient to have ready in 90 seconds. It’s got great taste and is such great value. Mostly, it’s the convenience of it.

title: Great taste
text: I love this brand. It’s not exorbitantly expensive and has a great mustard taste. Fantastic!

title: Peach......yum!
text: It’s soooooo hard to find peach water flavoring. This stuff is awesome. It’s not peach tea (at least I didn’t order the peach tea) because I hate tea but love peach. I will be reordering this soon!

title: The real stuff
text:
This is the “real cinnamon”. It is excellent. I use it mostly for making horchata and you can tell the difference between this and other types. This provides a more complex and rich cinnamon tone to the drink.
Highly recommend it!

title: So addictive!
text: OMG! These are fast to heat up, full of flavor and very addictive. I will certainly be ordering more!

title: Not tangy or very flavorful but still nice for a quick dinner
text: Not quite the same as my local restaurant but for ease of use, not bad. Still, it’s not very tangy for lemon rice and rather bland. I finally mixed it with some sauce and ate it. It was tasty like that and I enjoyed it. I would have preferred more tang and flavor though.

title: Fresh and crisp!
text: These are fresh, awesome tasting and crunchy. What more could you ask for? Love these!

title: Wow! So good!
text: These are unbelievably good. I will definitely be ordering again.

title: Very good rice but they don’t send a 4 pack! Just one single package?
text:
I got just one package. One for $10.00. Don’t order this.

EDIT
Apparently this was just a mistake. I called Amazon Customer Service and they said they will send a 4 pack, telling me they could not just send a 3 pack. It was a better outcome than I expected. Very happy. The rice is good and the problem was solved. I will order again.

EDIT
Well, received the replacement, one single package in an envelope, again, not the 4 pack as described. I mean, how many times can they get this wrong? I called customer service and got a refund. I’m not going to call each time a single one comes. The customer service rep was very nice and when I told him it seemed like many people had this same issue, he read the comments and stated he was going to write a report on the problem. I hope he does. I suspect it’s a problem in the warehouse or contractor.
Now, I just hope I get the refund. I have to say, this was a really odd problem and I’ve never experienced anything like it before.

Best to not order this item.

title: Awesome!
text: Got these for the staff at the physical therapy facility I was in and they loved them. Everyone loves these. Good value and good will by staff for the money.

title: Yuck!
text:
This cinnamon tastes like fake cinnamon or cinnamon that’s gone bad. I threw the whole thing away. I used cinnamon sticks at least twice a week in horchata and one of these made the horchata taste nasty. Had to throw it away too.
Absolutely do not recommend!!!!

title: I love these
text: These things are sooooooo addictive

title: Not for me
text: These had a funky taste. They tasted a bit burned or something. I assume it’s just my taste preference. The packaging was very good and they were not expired (they didn’t taste bad in that way, just not my preference). I love hot things and jalapeño flavors but these just didn’t appeal to me.

title: Perfect salsa!
text: This is the best salsa. Just the right spice and heat. A bit smokey. Highly recommend it. It’s great on tamales!

title: Like McDonalds (perhaps better)
text: Ok, this stuff may not be McDonalds honey mustard (may be even better actually) but it’s as close as I have found and man oh man, is it ever good! I mean....SERIOUSLY GOOD! I saw this online on some message board when someone asked about a mustard close to McDonalds. They gave this brand and I thought I might as well try. I’m not sure if it’s sold in my area as I tend to buy wasabi and hot pepper mustards/sandwich spreads instead but have homemade nuggets that needed this kind of mustard. I hit the jackpot with this. Highly recommend it. HIGHLY!

title: Awesome!
text: I add this stuff to milk, coconut milk, sparking water etc. It’s soooooo good. I can’t recommend this highly enough. I love it and the price on Amazon is far better than I have found in other places. Can’t recommend it highly enough.

title: Bad batch!
text:
I have ordered this before and love it but this last order came and was awful. It looked like it had been left outside in a downpour (though no rain has occurred in my area) and the wrappers were soggy and disgusting. I won’t order from here again. I ordered 4 of these and they were all disgusting. As I’ve said, I ordered before and was fine so I don’t know where it went wrong but the Amazon box was fine. It was the contents. Was there a hole in the warehouse roof? This product stored in a well?
I l

title: Not for me
text: This taste was off for me. I think it’s just preference. It was well packaged and seemed like a quality product but I did not like it. So, I’m not sure I would put much stock in this review because there is really not any accounting for taste. You might like it very much. I just didn’t.

title: Add cinnamon and a bit of sugar
text:
I add a bit of sugar and a cinnamon stick to each box as soon as I open it. Shake it up and have a glass. This stuff is just as good as the horchata I get at my local Mexican restaurant. Wonderful!

UPDATE
This is apparently now next to impossible to find. I hope it’s just a supply chain issue and not that it is no longer being made. That would be awful (though I suspect without too much effort their regular rice milk could be turned into horchata rather easily). At any rate, I have placed 7 orders for these in then 15 months and each came packaged well, undamaged and though I punched it up a bit, delicious.
If they carry it again, I highly recommend it.

title: Perfect!
text: I love to make cold peanut sesame noodles. I bought this oil and it’s the best I ever had. The flavor is rich and bold. It pours nicely and looks great sitting on my shelves. I doubt I will ever buy another brand of sesame oil again. This one is perfect.

title: Love these so much!
text: These things are so good. I can eat so many I can make myself sick. I love these! I can’t find these in my area. So happy I can find them in my area.

title: Wrap everything!
text:
These are awesome! I wrap everything from sausage and eggs to salad. The jalapeño in these is not too spicy but the flavor is there. I will be buying again.

Tip: they roll better if you slightly warm the wrap before using,

title: Beyond awful!
text: This was horrible. I took a bite and threw it away. It truly was nasty and I love marzipan but this is the WORST I have ever had.

title: Great on rice!!!
text: I love sumac on rice and it’s hard to find. This was good quality. Makes my rice excellent!!!

title: Addictive!!!
text: I love these! They were so good and now, I can’t find them. It’s like crack (ok, how I assume crack would be as I have never had it). You take it and then want more and more. These are just that good but I’ve only had the jalapeño flavor.

title: Developed taste
text:
I love rice and never had this before. It was VERY unusual tasting. I was not sure if I liked it or not. I have made it several times since then and like it better each time. I think it’s a developed taste and tastes best if served with a dish with a lot of sauce (a Thai peanut or Indian curry). It was very good with some dishes but so-so in others, hence the 4 stars.
Just beware if it is new to you, it may take some getting used to.

title: Excellent but not spicy
text:
I was hoping for a bit of spice. I eat VERY spicy things so my curve may be a bit higher for what’s considered “kick” but this didn’t have any. That said, it is still wonderful tasting, just not spicy enough for me.
Mind arrive packaged well and unbroken (as I see some others didn’t but mine was well packaged and was used immediately. Seal was unbroken.
I recommend this jam but know if you like things spicy, this isn’t.

title: Revolting
text: Awful. I love cherry and that includes natural cherry flavoring, imitation cherry flavoring and real cherries. This tasted like none of those. I also love merengues. I though “perfect pairing”. I thought wrong. I put one cookie in my mouth, chewed a bit, spit it back into the tub of cookies, popped the lid back on and chucked them in the bin. It was a bit flavored how a bug spray we use at my house, smells. Just vile.

title: Pure gold!
text: This stuff is gold! I visit a German restaurant once in a while and they have this. So glad I found it online. If you like mustards, you will LOVE this. I highly recommend this to everyone. Goes great on burgers, brats, sandwiches etc. Delicious!

title: A bit of magic!
text: I can no longer find this in stores and it’s so good my family is addicted. It’s pepper with a unique taste (the blend itself), a bit of a kick (not too much) and magic in a jar (it has the ability to perk up bland vegetables, meats, soups, casseroles etc). I highly recommend this. It is, quite simply, fantastic!!!!

title: Cookie bits and dust
text: I have ordered these more than once. They are delicious. My problem is that twice, the cookies have come smashed to bits. Once, there was almost packing around them. The other times there was but only one box made it through with whole cookies. One was literally about 1/4 merengue dust from the smashed cookies and the rest were tiny bits. One box had a few half cookies and another had several whole cookies. The taste is wonderful but I need to make them here at my home because serving merengue dust after this pandemic is over, will not be top of my list (or even on my list....unless it’s a list of things to NOT do). I took off 2 stars for cookie bits and dust but if delivered whole....they would be a very easy 5.

title: Fantastic stuff!
text:
I love this and I love the little cans. I don’t have to throw so much away (a little goes a long way)
I found this in France, accidentally, and came to love it. It’s good on toast, crepes, blinis, crackers etc. It is thick and sweet.
Odd as this sounds, I love this on a cinnamon sugar bagel with cream cheese and then this. It’s delicious. I’m soooo glad it was packaged in little cans. This is the first little cans I have seen and I will be ordering more, without question.
I highly recommend this!!!!

title: Yum. No other word but YUM!
text: Excellent on biscuits (scones) or simple toast. Also great as part of a lemon cake glaze. Awesome on fruit pizza. This stuff is sooooo good.

title: Superbly delicious
text: This is great on crackers, pizza (odd, I know), hamburgers etc. It’s even delicious on just plain bread.

title: Great one pot meal.
text: Love this. I add spices. Decrease water. Add an egg, spices, sausage, dried onions, cheese and jalapeños. It makes a big “meal in a bowl”. It’s so good.

title: Amazingly good
text:
I love these. Cook them with less water than called for, for thicker grits. Add cheese. Soy sausage (or sausage) and some spices. It becomes a filling easy one bowl meal. I add a bit of jalapeño powder to make it hotter as well as a few dried jalapeños.
Soooooo delicious and filling.

title: So delicious!!
text: I make pickle soup but sometimes I’m not up for it. No problem, add water and there you go. It’s so good and so fast. It’s a go to “quick snack” now. Love it.

title: Not too spicy but very good
text: I really enjoy this stuff. It’s good on a lot of things. It’s a bit sweet and a bit warm (not too spicy). It can snazz up bland food in a heartbeat. It’s different but oh so good!

title: Great on rice!
text: I love sumac on rice. I was happy to find this. It’s an unusual and perhaps acquired taste but it’s wonderful. I advis3 trying it and this brand is very good.

title: Fantastic product!
text: I eat this plain, add it to soups and stews, toast it etc. I always have some on hand and this is the best. Highly recommend it.

title: Not a bad coffee
text: I liked this. I wanted to taste this as I usually drink Death Wish. I think I prefer Death Wish. I cold brew and make iced coffees and I think this is better hot. Still, it’s tasty. It does have a lot of caffeine but it didn’t give me the jolt I wanted. Not a bad coffee though.

title: My buddy highly recommends it
text: This is a good coffee. A friend of mine liked it and I gave it to him as I prefer another brand but he loved it so much he asked for it for his birthday so purchased again. I drink iced coffee and he drinks it hot and black. Says it’s got a fantastic taste.

title: Great in iced coffee
text: I add a few drops of this to my iced coffee in the morning. I prefer it a little sweet and try to save calories as I can. This tastes great. I also use it in smoothies and overnight oatmeal.

title: Garlic panini
text: Use this for panini press. I spray the press and the bread and it adds a garlic punch. Love it.

title: Great for a panini
text: Use this oil for panini’s. It adds an unusual taste and adds to the food. Highly recommend

title: Certainly gets you moving
text:
I cold brew this and then drink it with milk, baileys creamers etc. This coffee will give you a kick like a mule. I mean, you are ready to go for the day. For G-d’s sake don’t drink it in the afternoon or you will never sleep. If you are a graveyard worker, drink this stuff and you will be running a mile a minute, smiling all the time.
I need to decorate for the holidays and I’m oretty sure after two iced coffee of this, I’ll have the boxes unpacked, the house decorated and everything put away in about 5 1/2 minutes. That would include chopping down the tree, dragging it home and stringing it with blue lights.

title: LOVE THESE!
text: Love these and they are not found in my area. They are very very crunchy. Can’t get enough of them.

title: Best rice in the world
text: This rice is my favorite food and is very hard to find. It’s a wonderful flavor of rich and easy to fix. I could eat this for every meal.

title: Great for iced coffee
text: Excellent coffee. It gives you a real punch and tastes very good. I cold press it and use baileys creamers and milk to make iced coffees. This pairs great with those.

title: Good as cold brew or hot cup of joe
text:
I cold brew this coffee but using my mason jar kit the coffee was expensive as the kit called for using so much. I cut back on the instructions of the kit and used less. I brewed it longer and it still tasted great.
If you like cold brew. Give it a try.

On a side note my mother mentioned she had to stop drinking coffee for digestive issues and was missing it. I cold brewed this and she added a bit of water and heated it up. She fell I love. If it's good enough for an 86 year old coffeeholic (numerous cups a day for 70 years) to drink hot, it's no wonder I love it as cold brew. I'm new to cold brew to be honest but it appears I started with the best.
Love this as cold brew and my mother loves it hot.

Highly recommend this!

title: I love this stuff!!!
text: This gingerbread is great. I like it at xmas but it's good all year round. If you have never had this, you are in for a treat. Old recipe. Tradition. Great taste. You can't beat it!

title: These are to die for
text: I can only find these in the south and being from outside Chicago, they are a big hard to come by. I love them. Only problem is....I can't stop eating thm. Love it that Amazon sells these. Only problem. They make me thirsty. Solution: Eat them anyway, they are worth it.

title: Bold nutty flavor
text: Excellent kasha! I'm not sure what else to say, this is great kasha. I am a kasha connoisseur and this is one of the better brands I have tried. The directions are in English, Russian and Hebrew. If you are new to kasha or a frequent user, I think you will like this.

title: This stuff rocks.
text: I add flavorings to a kefir/coconut milk I drink throughout the day. These make it taste a lot like an Orange Julius. I really love the flavor and it's hard to find locally. I really like it. I have no idea what it would taste like in water though. In dairy.....it's amazing

title: I love these impossibly hard to find cookies!
text:
I am addicted to these. I love them but they are so hard to find. I had knee replacement surgery in October and again in December. I ordered 2 boxes of these (they are small and don't contain many cookies) and my caretaker parceled them out to me over the course of many weeks. They didn't go stale and were a treat each time she brought them to me. I am sad they are almost gone.
My favorite cookie in the world.

title: It was just ok
text: This was good. Not as strong as I wanted and leaves the drink rather oily (more so than other flavoring oils). I have used it but will probably not buy it again.

title: No spice whatsoever
text: I was hoping this would have some kick to it. It doesn't. I'm so irritated. However, I'm giving it an extra star for the desert pear lip balm they sent for free. That stuff is amazing. It would get 5 stars but since I'm reviewing the jelly, only 2.

title: Pickle anf hot pickle are great!!
text:
I liked the pickle and spicy pickle but only use them on cottage cheese. I really hated the lime and cannot think of one earthly place I would use it.
So, I'm happy with 2 and the price was ok, so I am happy.

title: Nice quality
text: Excellent taste and great price. I make turmeric milk in the evenings and add cardamom and not all cardamom is created equal. This is nice quality cardamom.

title: Great quality and price
text: I love to put these in smoothies and these are high quality and a great price. I highly recommend.

title: Marzipan Heaven!
text: OMG. This stuff is the best I have ever had. Seriously. If you like marzipan, you really must order this. It's so good it can't even be described.

title: Easy and delicious
text: I like this soup. I actually add kasha to it and some dill pickle juice. Easy and tasty.

title: Makes a great milkshake
text:
This has a very strong bubble gum flavor and is good with milk and vanilla ice cream, with a gum like chiclets (or whatever little bits of gum you can get) added to it. Let it sit for a moment and chow down.

If using plain milk, don't use as much as the directions call for. It makes it less strong and makes it last longer.

title: Wonderful Treat!
text:
This stuff is very good. Works best in whole milk. Has a subtle but unmistaken cotton candy flavor. I plan on trying it with ice cream soon. I am thinking vanilla or cotton candy ice cream, milk and ice.

I sometimes add a drop of vanilla when I make this. It makes it even better!

title: Love this stuff
text: I love coffee milk and so far have only tried the Autocrat and love it. I can't wait to try the others. The price was not bad for the three of them either. I live in Illinois and coffee syrup is not available here. I guess compared to buying it in Rhode Island, it's very expensive but as it's cheaper than gas and time to get to Rhode Island, I will stick with this and I will certainly be ordering again.

title: Excellent quality
text: Love these. They tasted like creamy coffee and similar to See's expensive suckers. I will be ordering again.

title: One of my favorite foods
text: I eat a lot of rice and I love this rice the best. It is much better than plain white rice and is just as easy to make, if not easier. I can't recommend this highly enough! One of my favorite foods.

title: Horrible taste
text:
These taste horrible....kind of taste like the smell of oil or something. They taste nothing like coffee at all. I cannot recommend them but I have had many coffee candy's so I can compare.
I took these to a dodgeball tournament (for adults) and no one liked them. We had to throw them away.

They are packaged well but just taste horrible.

title: Horrid
text:
These tasted nothing like cappuccino or coffee. They tasted kind of like butterscotch or something. I took them to a dodgeball tournament (for adults) and everyone hated them.

I don't recommend them at all

title: Just like you added a shot of Amaretto yourself
text: Hot chocolate does not get better than this. Best hot chocolate I have ever tasted.

title: Seems like fun to me
text:
I got this for my 21 year old nieces and nephew (2 sets of twins, different parents) and 2 were seemingly happy with it...2 were not so enthused. I think it's just a drop shoot.

I liked them and I am not sure if any of them will play them but they did seem very fun.

title: Excited to find this!!!
text: I love this and it's super hard to find. I was so excited to find it on Amazon. It's the best hot chocolate you can drink! It's not exactly like you added a shot of Baileys Irish Cream to it.....but it's pretty close!

title: Awesome Stuff!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
text:
I was in Paris once (I don't speak French) and got a crepe. I pointed to what I thought was chocolate. I walked away, took a bite and thought "what the hell is this?!?". My taste buds were expecting chocolate lol. After the initial shock, I decided it was quite good. When I returned to the US, I sought out chestnut paste. This was the brand I found and wow....it is very good.

This is good on toast, crepes, pancakes....even ice cream. I love it.

Glad I found it on Amazon. My local supplier went out of business.

title: Liquid candy
text: I love this. They are better than other types of powdered drink mix. This have a cherry flavor I would say is stronger than other kinds of mixes, I love the candy....these are like liquid candy. Awesome!

title: No Fuss....No Mess
text:
I have made guacamole for years. I trained in Europe to be a chef. I thought the recipe I came up with was great. One day I made guacamole....a lot of it, for my mother. We made this and ate them side by side. Yes, mine had more things in but it took me a while to prepare. i chopped things, juiced things, measured things etc. It takes a while to make. This is fast, easy and while I still think the recipe I use is better....this is a close....and I mean seriously close second.

Hint: prepare it about 20 minutes before you need it.....it blends together a little better.

Pair this with Tostitos or some other quality corn chip, serve a Midori margarita to wash it down with and truly, your taste buds will be dancing.

title: Great for Kasha Varnishkes!
text: I love kasha and I love this brand but even though it says toasted, I toast it again. I eat it with pasta and meat, not as a cereal. I have used other products from Bob's Red Mill and have never been disappointed yet. This product is also great in soups.

title: Better than the recipe I had been using for 30 years!
text:
My mother and I have a tradition of Midori margaritas and chips and guacamole one weekend evening, each week. One weekend I slaved over a recipe, chopping, cutting, measuring and it was good. The next weekend she used this mix and mashed an Avacado. I liked hers better, despite the fondness for my recipe I had used for 30 years.
Highly recommend this product. Simple to use, tasty and better than store bought. Ready in a couple of minutes!

title: High quality kasha!
text: I love kasha and eat it with bow tie pasta. This is high quality kasha, it toasts up very nicely. Will be ordering again.

title: Excellent  Excellent  Excellent
text:

title: Fantastic as a base for drinks
text:
I LOVE Lifeway Kefir and buy several bottles every week. While I do sometimes buy plain, I prefer the coconut chia flavor. At any rate, I took a tip from a friend and do not drink the kefir straight from the bottle. I pour it into a class, add about the same amount of water (or a quarter of the amount of kefir, it just depends upon my mood) and then add a few squirts of water flavoring (the kind in the little tiny bottles). I have used Koolaid grape and cherry, Crush cherry, Margaritaville pina colada and strawberry daiquiri and a few others. Sometimes in the morning I will add orange juice instead of water.

It is good on its own but with those few additions it becomes the base for many different flavored drinks that are very good for you. I don't know what I would do if I didn't have kefir everyday and Lifeway is the best.

If you don't like yogurt, you won't like this full strength but even if you do not like yogurt, if you add water or juice and some drops of flavoring, you will still like it (I know because have had friends do who did not like yogurt try it).

Cannot recommend highly enough!

title: Exceptional flavor and ingredients
text:
One of my family’s favorite of this brand, of the many different varieties that they have available to offer. Of the many brands of this type of product, they stand out as offering the most affordable and different options compared with others at half the price.
I would suggest that you look for this in a brick and mortar store due to the fact that there’s a serious problem within the packaging department with Amazon. My shipment of 4 jars of this arrived in a 9 x 9 x 18 inch box containing these 4 jars each wrapped individually with some tiny bubble wrap and left to bounce off of each other in this oversized box during shipping to my home.
Unknown to me I picked it up from my porch and sat in down on my carpet, when I let go of it, I cut the palm of my hand and two fingers from glass protruding from the bottom of the box. After tending to my hand, I discovered the lovely mess of sauce that leaked out onto my carpet!
This is not one single incident but one of several concerning packaging of this item I’ve had problems with being able to receive without damage.
The product is wonderful and worth purchasing but sadly it’s a gamble if you’ll be able to receive it if ordered through here.

title: Brand is excellent, packing leaves much to be desired!
text:
I’ve been on a defeated quest to order this brand that’s a quality item, with it’s many different flavorful ingredients and optional choices that is offered to suit any family members taste buds. It can be very versatile to use in many different dishes as a starter and your own creativity is the limits to what you can use this for. I highly recommend this wonderful, economical brand.
The downside is not connected with this product but rather the ability to order it and receive the item. There seems to be serious negligence with the employees who are packing these items. You simply cannot wrap a glass jar in tiny bubble wrap and then put several of these wrapped glass jars inside a big box unsecured and not expect the glass jars to bounce around, hitting each other throughout the shipping process all across the country until it reaches the customers door step and still expect the glass jars to remain intact!
So far I’ve had approximately 10 jars that have either made it here but I had a huge mess inside the box or my order was canceled during shipping due to damage and leaking from the box!
Amazon, you need to have a very serious discussion with your employees about the proper way to pack these items containing glass! This is getting very ridiculous!

title: Be cautious of very old items
text:
This the first time I’ve ordered this item, from the reviews I thought it would be a healthy alternative to eating chips, something my family is trying to avoid in our diet.
I’m sure they’re probably good if they’re not as old as what I received in my order but customers have no control about being sent an item that is a month before the expiration date. Most items purchased at a brick and mortar store will usually have six months before they hit the expiration date.
The package I opened up tasted stale with no flavor at all. Lesson learned once again from buying a product that was marked lower than the regular price. I guess if you see anything marked lower that must mean it’s either expired or very close to expiring.
I would suggest if you’re wanting to try this, buy it from a brick and mortar store so you can verify if it’s a fresh item or if it’s been sitting around on a shelf aging.

title: Glad I only bought one pack
text:
I was looking for a flavored version of my pumpkin caramel coffee at a decent price since there’s so much price fluctuation going on here with items that I normally purchase but I just refuse to pay an extra $5-$7 per item, just because they want to charge it.
I decided I would order this item instead of my regular choice but it has no expiration date on the packaging and no smell from the product and lastly no taste or aroma when brewed. It doesn’t taste bad but it also doesn’t have the taste I wanted from a flavored coffee.
I don’t understand why it doesn’t have any expiration date printed on the packaging. I thought that was required for all human consumption items. I guess it’s possible that the date has been rubbed off or maybe it’s embedded and I just can’t see it.
Regardless, I suppose I should have known better since it was on sale for half price that something was wrong with it.
Even for just a regular tasting coffee it’s still higher priced than just plain coffee, I’m disappointed because I expected it to have more flavor after reading the reviews. My guess is that I received very old coffee that had been sitting in a warehouse somewhere.

title: Planning ahead in case sickness comes visiting
text:
Everyone knows that when you get sick the best thing for you is either sipping chicken broth or a hot bowl of chicken noodle soup to get you through it. Campbell’s Chunky Chicken Noodle Soup has just the right amount of ingredients to give you something to put in your stomach without being overly heavy when you’re not feeling your best.
I happened to see this 3 can pack of soup and thought I should put some away in the pantry because nobody wants to go to the store when they don’t feel well.
The 3 can pack is a good price, I believe it’s comparable to what I would have to pay for 3 cans at my local grocery store. My order arrived in good condition and I’ve found other varieties of Campbell’s soup available in the 3 can pack as well as single cans, so I intend to purchase more. Nothing beats a brand that’s been around since I was a kid, but a hot bowl of soup and a sandwich hits the spot on a cold winter day for lunch too.

I’m back to purchase more although a bit harder to find right now and the price has changed a little bit for this economy sized box of 32 bars but not as much price fluctuations as I’ve noticed in other products lately. I was curious about the availability of this brand in other stores, so imagine my disbelief when I found this same size box at Sam’s for half the price I paid on here. If you’re like me and need to get the most from your grocery budget, I’m sure you’d rather spend $12 versus $25. This place has been convenient for many years to login and order but if you’re like me you have to put your needs first and start looking for a better solution to your food budget.

I haven’t had any Pecans in awhile to compare them to but they seem to be a little bit soft biting in to them although that certainly doesn’t seem to affect the flavor at all. I’m also used to eating almonds more often so maybe it’s just me and nothing to do with the Pecans.

title: Pleasantly surprised
text:
I've been purchasing Starbucks Doubleshot Espresso & Cream for years. Recently though, the 12 packs have shot up in price - doubling from approx. $15 to $30, in some cases and availability has been scarce - no idea why. Lately, the average price has been about $26. I began tracking them via CamelCamelCamel and, after a couple of months, was glad when I received a notification that the Amazon price had gone down to $15.99. I snapped up 4 of the 12 packs, but was dismayed to learn that it would take 3-4 weeks for them to arrive. I wasn't in a hurry, so I placed the order. Turns out, deliver only took 11 days.

I was also surprised to see that there was virtually no damage to the cans. I've received 12 packs in the past that contained many dented cans. I've seen many reviews complaining of the same thing - as well as mold and rodent droppings. In this case though, there were only 4 or 5 cans out of 48 with dents - and those were very minor. Since these were shipped directly from Pepsico in Grand Prairie, TX, I assume that's why. Typically, these ship from Amazon, which may mean there's additional handling which could account for the poor condition of the cans.

The cases/cans have the revised name and packaging - the green top being the most distinctive aspect of the new design, not to mention the new RTD (Ready To Drink) moniker and the removal of the "Doubleshot" brand name. The taste appears to be similar. I can't say for sure, but the flavor seems slightly less rich/creamy and a little more watery. I don't know if Starbucks/Pepsico have tinkered with the mixture, but it's certainly possible. Then again, it may just be that it's been some time since I've enjoyed a Doubleshot. I will update the flavor portion of my review once I've had a few more cans.

Regarding value for the money and freshness, as mentioned before, they've been going for as much as $30 per 12 pack, so a $16 price is a relief - although at that price, I believe they're still overpriced. $13-$15 would be ideal. Being canned products, freshness is difficult to judge. My guess is these could sit on a warehouse shelf for months and the taste would be fine. It would be nice if they came with a canning date though.

All in all, I'm happy with the product and hope the price/availability have stabilized.

title: Like A Shot In The Dark, It Missed The Mark
text:
TL;DR - more product, but more watery, less espresso taste than similar Starbucks product.

Full Review - I really wanted to like these but in the end, they don't live up to Starbucks Double Shot. On the plus side, the DD Shot In The Dark caramel flavor 12 pack is cheaper - approx $12 vs the Double Shot at approx. $15 - for a one time purchase. However, the other SITD flavors (mocha and vanilla) are more expensive - approx $15, putting it on par with Double Shot. It doesn't make sense that the flavors aren't priced the same - unless Amazon is trying to push a slow seller.

SITD offers more product per can - 8.1 oz. vs 's 6.5 for the Double Shot. But, the most important aspect is taste. Dunkin's SITD comes in caramel, mocha and vanilla. I'd prefer a straight espresso flavor, but my guess is they add the flavors to make up for the weak espresso flavor.

Anyway, regarding the flavor, the caramel taste isn't over powering, but the smell is a little off-putting. The can says the flavors are natural, but the smell struck me as super sweet and artificial. The can says it's a coffee/espresso blend - with no indication of what the split is. I'd say it's significantly more coffee than espresso. SITD's first listed ingredient is "coffee." The first ingredient in Starbucks DS is "espresso coffee".

The SITD has more preservatives, but Starbucks DS says it is "partially produced with genetic engineering." The SITD has less calories - 80 vs. 140. This seems odd given you get 25% more product, but this is probably because there seems to be less cream in the DD product. My first reaction was that it was more watery and less creamy than the Double Shot. The fat quantity (2.5g for SITD vs. 3.5 for the DS) seems to confirm this assumption. Also odd for the SITD is that, according to the can, it's a product of Japan, produced for Coca Cola. Weird.

Apart from smell/taste, the only other attribute of note is the caffeine. The SITD delivers 134mg of caffeine. By comparison, the Starbucks DS delivers about 150mg. Another indication of less espresso in the SITD.

The smell/taste of the SITD aren't bad. I think I'm just spoiled by the flavor of Starbucks Double Shot, which to me, seems to be of higher quality. If you're unfamiliar with the Double Shot, you'll probably find the flavor of the Dunkin' Donuts Shot In The Dark to be acceptable - albeit without a good espresso taste.

Tostitos with a hint of jalapeno are awesome, but $40 for 38 ounces???????  That's almost $1 an ounce!!!!!!!!!  Whoever is selling these things is out of their mind and should be arrested for price gouging.
