title: Heart is a muscle.
text:
Good jerky, although I don't taste any cranberry. It's very mildly sweet and tasty in it's own way, just don't expect it to be sweet or taste like cranberry. Still, it tastes good. I don't think kids will go nuts over this, but they'll probably eat it happily for a snack. The texture is on the dry/mealy side, but not off-puttingly so -- it's better than being greasy. It doesn't taste like "organ meat", but be aware the heart is a MUSCLE, so although many people might find the idea of eating heart to be "weird" it's not that much different taste-wise to any other lean muscle. The taste or texture of this jerky won't blow anyone, but for a healthy snack it's good.

Considering the price for even "cheap" gas station beef jerky, this product is very well priced at around $3.33 a stick. People should be aware heart muscle isn't going to pack the "organ meat" health punch they want, and how much of these sticks are kidney vs heart isn't clear, and to keep saying "a WHOPPING 25%" doesn't really mean anything, even if the stick is 25% kidney that's still only about 2 teaspoons max, and you have to figure a good amount of that is heart muscle. Which is totally fine, but people should be aware they're not getting a ton of organ meat here, especially if they want/need it for health reasons. Still it's a good healthy jerky option, which is where its value really lies.

title: It's important to understand how cod livers are packaged. Great value for the money!
text:
This is an excellent product. There's other brands with SLIGHTLY better flavor, more "whole" livers, and better consistency -- but this brand is excellent for the money and the difference is so slight that I'm very happy to save a few bucks and purchase this brand. It has a very light, clean flavor (sort of like very very mild tuna fish) and nice firm texture. I've never had any issues with dented cans whatsoever, although I order it through Prime.

The reviewers complaining about the amount of oil in a product (this tinned cod liver or other) clearly don't know how this product is packaged. It's important this be understood: The cod livers are harvested and sealed into tins by weight. The tins are then heated, which steralizes the livers and also causes the livers to release their own oil. Oil is NOT added to the tin! Cod is a lean fish, meaning most of its fat is in the liver -- this is what causes the oil found in the tin. How much oil is in the livers is a function of the individual fish and time of year. It's incorrect to ding any seller for "adding too much oil", as the sellers don't add oil -- the oil is released by the livers themselves after the tin is sealed and heated. For this reason you can expect natural variations in the amount of oil in any given tin. I've never thought this brand has "too much" oil in it compared to other brands, and have found the balance between liver and oil to be quite good. Of course I'm sure there's some tins with very oily livers where the balance might be wanting, but this is to be expected in any brand as it's out of the control of the producer.

I personally most enjoy cod livers eaten by themselves with a fork. I've tried other preparations, such as on crackers with cream cheese, and found the combination of fatty foods was far too rich for my palate. They're lovely straight, and in my opinion need no "dressing up". They don't taste like "cod liver oil" sold as a supplement, nor do they taste like beef, venison, or chicken liver which has a more bitter/metallic taste (I personally LOVE liver!) -- in fact I'd say cod liver doesn't really taste like "liver" at all, but it's very lovely in its own way. The oil itself is clear and very light and has little flavor itself.

Please note that because of the high levels of vitamin A in cod liver a person should only eat two tins a week, max. Vitamin A is good in certain doses, but too much can be toxic and therefore intake of cod liver should be monitored and people taking a multivitamin with vitamin A, or other vitamin A supplements or who eats a lot of vitamin A rich foods (carrots, spinach, sweet potatoes, etc) should be very careful eating cod liver. That said cod liver is extremely healthy (and delicious!) in reasonable portions and an excellent source of Omega 3's. Most of the nutrition is in the livers themselves (not the oil), and be aware that certain nutrients start to oxidize and degrade after the tin is open. One could choose to save the oil for use in cooking etc, but be aware the oil oxidizes faster than the livers themselves and may have lost many nutrients by the time its used, especially if not used immediately

Personally I open the tin and eat the livers in one sitting as a meal -- the high fat content means just one can is very filling, and in my opinion a perfect single portion size. The tins are easy to carry for a healthy on-the-go meal. As a bonus I usually add a little of the oil to my dog's food -- he loves it and it's really made his coat shiney and smooth. Excellent value for the price!

title: Check out the serving size.
text:
I have been eating Uncle Ben's Ready rice for a long time now. I have found it convenient when I am trying to get a quick meal going. All the flavors are great. As for convenience and taste I would rate this a 5 star. I recently decided to start a portion control diet. The nutrition information says that the pack as about 2 cups serving size in the package. I thought I could split it for two meals about 1 cup each. When I measure out the package actually only has 1 cup. I opened several more and they all had the same. I measure before and after heating. Still 1 cup. Not 1.5. Not 1.25. Not 1.75. 1 cup. I contacted the company

Their response " 1 cup of our Ready to Heat Whole Grain Brown Rice yields 1.79 cups/servings per pouch. Under FDA regulations, we must label the product as having "about 2" servings. Again, this is because FDA regulations state that for a serving size that is between 1.5 and 2 cups, the product be labeled as having "about 2" servings. We do not have the authority to change FDA regulations. We also put on the Nutrition Facts Panel that 1 cup weighs 140 grams, which should enable consumers to see that a 250 gram pouch does not contain 2 full 1 cup servings of product."

But I only got 1 cup. No response on second attempt. Not buying this again.

text: When I was sprouting I soaked them for 8 hours and the germination rate was 50%. I increased the soak time to 12 hours and the germination rate increased to 66%. Not very good. Take this into consideration when comparing the cost per ounce to other brands.

title: Good Ketchup
text: This is the brand that I grew up with. The one my dad always used. I especially like the squeeze bottle. When placed in the refrigerator it's always standing on the dispenser top so that the ketchup is ready when you squeeze on the bottle.

title: Better than powdered milk.
text: I tried buying powdered milk now that I can know longer get to the grocery store to buy fresh milk. Powdered milk never seemed to mix well and never tasted like fresh milk. Evaporated milk has proved to be a real good substitute. One can of evaporated milk with one can of water and I can't taste the difference when I use it on breakfast cereal.

title: Simply Delicious
text: I first tried their sample pack of ribs, pulled pork, beef brisket and BBQ beans and really enjoyed them all. Then I ordered the Burnt Ends. The product description says it all. It's like eating ribs with a fork without the bone. I think it would make a wonderful sub sandwich with a French bread roll. I highly recommend their products and the packing and shipping.

title: Very Good!
text: I was very pleased with the delivery and the packaging. It was shipped in a insulated container with frozen cold packs and arrived frozen and ready to put in my freezer. Each item in the sampler was easy to heat and serve. I enjoyed it and I followed up with an order of their Burnt Ends.

title: Didn't really like these beans.
text: I didn't really like these beans. Not much BBQ flavor but very spicy (hot). I like other Bush's beans but I will not purchase these again.

title: Taste Good
text: I found these olives to be slightly tuff because of the large size compared to other olives I have eaten but the price is great compared to the smaller size containers.

title: Fantastic Pears
text: I had never tired Comice pears before. They were wonderful. They were well packed and included instructions on how to tell if they were ripe and ready to eat.

title: Excellent Pasta
text: I was afraid that this pasta would have a different texture and taste due to the fact that it was multigrain. It found it was excellent and was just like the pasta I grew up with. It is the thin pasta and cooks up perfectly in just 11 minutes. I will purchase it again.

title: Wow! Love these pecans.
text: I tried another brand of pecans and they were good, but these great. I placed the order on day one. They shipped on day two. I received them on day three. They are packaged in a container with a screw top lid, the other brand was in a bag that had to be cut open and the pecans transferred into a Ziplock bag. This will be the brand that I order from now on.

title: Very Handy!
text: I live alone and when I purchase a bottle of honey it turns to sugar before I use it all up. These packets are just the right size for a biscuit.

title: Very good!
text: I was apprehensive when I placed the order because the last fruit cake that I purchased was dreadful. This Claxton Fruitcake is wonderful. I will purchase another next holiday season.

title: Addicting!
text: I tried my first bag of pistachios and found I like them more than cashews or salted in the shell peanuts. Each of the three 1lb bags has a zip lock closure. Very handy.

title: Love it!
text: This is the first time I have ordered dried Mango and I find that I love it. I will reorder.

title: Superb!
text: I've loved Swiss Miss for years but I always made it with whole milk. I can no longer get fresh whole milk so I made it with water and added 1/2 tablespoon of whole powered milk and it was delicious. Rich and creamy.

title: Very Happy!
text: All my life I've purchased French's yellow mustard. I decided to try Plochman's and I was not disappointed. I will purchase again.

title: The smell is fantastic!
text: The smell is fantastic and the taste is excellent but I'm not sure it is worth the increased price over the Kraft Brand.

title: Excellent Taste!
text: It's easy to prepare and the flavor is excellent. I've used it with French bread sandwiches filled with Philly sliced beef and have been very pleased.

title: Very Good!
text: I have only purchased Oberto Brand pepperoni in the past and decided to try the Old Wisconsin Brand. Excellent quality and taste. This brand is much cheaper and I will order again.

title: Don't care for it!
text: I really didn't care for this stir fry sauce. Not what I was used to at restaurants. I tried it with stir fried mixed vegetables. I use Kraft Sweet and Sour Sauce instead but would like to find a good stir fry sauce.

title: Classic Mustard - I love it!
text: This is the classic mustard that I grew up with. I've tried other mustards over the years but I always come back to French's. There is nothing better on a corn dog.

title: Excellent!
text: I love corn bread but have been buying the Jiffy brand. I much prefer Krusteaz. I was hesitant to buy the larger sized box until I read another review suggesting you could freeze what you didn't eat. I tried freezing and microwaving when I wanted more to eat and the results were excellent. It's nice to have corn bread without having to bake more.

title: Excellent!
text: Excellent quality and great taste. I usually find some soft mushy ones in other brands but not the MARIO brand. I like the small size can since I live alone. I really like the convenience of the pull tab top.

title: They were burned and I can't return them.
text:
The beans tasted burned and were black on one side. I checked the beans left in the can that I had not heated and they were burned also. Its not likely the other 11 cans in the case are better.

Update:
I attempted to return or replace this item, which was shipped from and sold by Amazon, and got the following message: "This item is not eligible for return."

title: Very Good. No Problems!
text: When I received this popcorn I followed the cooking directions to prepare. It says not to use the popcorn setting on your microwave oven. I followed their instructions and it turned out great. I like the single servinging size because the larger bags don't save we'll. I'm very satisfied with this purchase and recommend to everyone.

title: Nice to keep on hand!
text: I just made a homemade pizza using a Chef Boyardee Pizza Kit. I used this cheese in addition to the cheese included in the kit. One of the two envelopes was just enough for a 12" pizza. This is shelf stable so you can keep some on hand.

title: Disappointed
text: When it arrived I tried it on cornbread and it was OK. The next day I used it on a baked potato and it was terrible. I purchased it to use on a 50 lb. box of russet potatoes. It's not a good substitute for butter or margarine. I would not buy again.

title: Excellent Product
text:
These are excellent onions. They are nice and crunchy. I like to pour off the brine and add the onions to the juice in a jar of Baby Kosher Dill Pickles. I plan to try adding to the juice from a jar of Stuffed Green Olives. If I liked the brine that they were shipped in I would have given them a five star rating.

Update: I added to the juice from a jar of Stuffed Green Olives and they were great.

title: Excellent
text: This is a great product. It's half the cost of La Choy brand and it's in a very convenient squeeze bottle. It's great as a dip or used for stir fry vegetables or chicken.

title: I love it!
text: This is as you can get next to fresh pineapple. I love the can size and the lift tab tops. These were much cheaper than my local store.

title: Good but overly expensive
text: I tried it and liked it very much, however it is lemon juice and sugar and you can make it with a strong mix of Country Time Lemonade at a fraction of the price.

title: Excellent!
text: I purchased lipton's Onion Soup mix to make my favorite Onion Roasted Potatoes. It was so good I decided to try adding canned whole baby carrots and canned roast beef. A superb way to make pot roast for one or two people. This is a great product for single people who want quality, great tasting beef. I will be adding more to my pantry.

title: Very convenient
text: These are very convenient. The individual packets contain just enough for a slice of toast or a small pancake. Half are grape and one quarter each of strawberry and mixed fruit.

title: Only OK
text:
These carrots are very good. They are very small and tasty. I purchased them to add to homemade fried rice but found that I like them heated right out of the can.

Update: 80% are small baby carrots, 20% are damaged or culls that are ground down to look like baby carrots. If I order baby carrots again I will switch to another brand.

title: It's okay
text: If you don't have access to fresh asparagus this is good until you do. My local "Mom & Pop" grocery doesn't carry much fresh produce so I keep some canned on hand. This is probably as good as canned can get.

title: Wonderful Beets
text: I usually buy the Baby Whole Beets but they were not available so I ordered these. I thought thay would be larger and not of the same quality. These are small and terrific! I usually cut the whole beets before heating and now I don't have to. I live alone and i like this smaller size can.

title: I love it
text: The description doesn't make it clear if it is presweetened. It is, with sugar. All you add is water. It mixes easily and tastes great. The weight is 4 lb 3.3 oz. I also use this to make whiskey or vodka sours. Very refreshing.

title: One of my favorite soups
text: This is one of my favorite soups. My only complaint is is very difficult to get it out of the can. Great taste! I love the easy open pull tab top. Much cheaper than my local store.

title: Disappointed
text: I purchased these tamales to use in taco/tamale salads. I was disappointed that they were rather bland. I normally don't care for highly spiced food but would have preferred more spice. I like Nalley products and my favorite chili is Nalley so I was surprised that I didn't enjoy these tamales more than I did.

title: I don't like it
text: The product does not resemble the picture on the package. No chunks of ham or green vegetables. Looked like it had been puréed in a blender. It didn't taste like ham. I didn't like the taste and I'm not looking forward to eating the other five in the case. I won't be buying again.

title: I don't like it
text: I'm addicted to Pringles BBQ chips. I love Cheetos Cheese Puffs. I just don't care for the Pringles Cheddar Cheese chips.

title: I love it!
text: I have been purchasing this at my local grocery store but they don't always have it in stock. I haven't tried other brands but this seems to as good as, or better, than the seasoning used at the local  restaurants. I use it to make taco salads.

title: I like it!
text:

3 cups cold cooked rice
1 packet of Kikkoman Fried Rice Seasoning Mix
1 egg
1/4 cup chopped onion
1 fresh sliced button mushroom
1/3 cup frozen peas
1/2 can of Kirkland chicken breast

Before eating, store in the refrigerator overnight so the flavor penetrates all of the ingredients. Microwave to reheat.

title: I don't like them!
text: I was hoping to use these as a substitute for Cheetos Cheese Puffs. I am addicted to Pringles BBQ chips but the cheddar cheese flavor falls far short for me.

title: Easy to prepare
text: These boil-in-bag packets are so easy to prepare. No muss, no fuss. They yield 2 cups per bag and there are 4 bags per box. I wouldn't be without it.

title: I love it!
text: After preparing it I dished up a bowl to eat it for the first time. I thought it was just OK. I put the rest in the refrigerator where it sat for half a day. When I reheated it for the second meal it was terrific. It needed time for the seasoning to to absorb into the rice. This is as good, or better,  as any fried rice I have eaten. It has great versatility because you can add anything you like from meat, seafood and vegetables. I added fresh mushrooms, frozen green peas and onions. I ordered additional rice because fried rice will be on my menu more often. I made the decision to buy based on other quality Kikkoman products and was not disappointed.

title: Terrible!

When I received and opened this box of Lindt Lindor Truffles I found the chocolate had turned white on the surface. Some of the truffles had hard interiors that could not be eaten. Possible cause, the chocolate was old or exposed to heat. They came in a plain white box that was not the factory pack pictured. I have purchased these truffles from my local grocery store for 4 years and they are my favorite chocolates but I will never buy this 60 pack box again. They are terrible!

Update: The more I eat the worse they are. Most are hollow inside with a hard layer at the bottom. They are really not worth eating.

I will not purchase this product again.

title: It's okay

title: The Best!
text:

All my future orders will be for Chicken of the Sea in the 12 pack. Whether added to other ingredients or eaten with my favorite, Heinz Seafood Cocktail Sauce, it is delicious.

Update: The price increased by $5 since I purchased. The quality is great, the price is not.

title: Handy
text: You can't beat this product for convenience and ease of use. I had a box of Bisquick but the pancake recipe called for an egg which I don't have. You add water, shake and pour into the pan. If you don't use all of it, it keeps in the refrigerator up to 3 days.

title: Excellent Bread
text: This is an excellent bread. It makes a nice large loaf. I checked the contents of three different brands and found the following: Krusteaz 14 oz., Hodgson Mill 16 oz. and Bob's Red Mill 17 oz. if you buy by price, keep this in mind.

title: Excellent
text:
I have been buying this cocktail sauce in the bottle which has a lot of waste because it is so thick. Using the individual packets you can squeeze out every last delicious drop with no waste. I like the tangy taste of the horseradish.

Update: I use 6 packets for each 4oz can of shrimp.

title: I like it!
text: I have used the dry mix for years but it is not always convenient. I sometimes run out of fresh milk. I decided to try the liquid version. I can keep it on hand and use it without having milk. The taste is not the same as the dry mix but it is good. I will keep this on hand. It's nice to be able to just grab it out of the refrigerator and drink as much, or little, as you want.

title: Very Good
text: These blueberry flavored muffins are very good and very easy to prepare. A good size package for one or two people.

title: Excellent
text:
I wanted to order a bean salad and I wanted the 4 bean rather than 3 bean. I had never heard of the Read brand but decided to try it. I was nervous because it was a 12 can case. Long story short, I couldn't be happier. This salad is far superior the the 4 bean salad I had purchased from the local grocery store at the deli counter. I don't often give a 5 star rating but this product deserves it.

The case that I received had no dusty, dented or rusty cans.

title: It's okay
text: Not too bad for an "instant" soup but not what I was looking for. I guess I will have to try a canned Corn Chowder.

title: Better taste than non-fat dry milk
text: I found this product while searching for the old Milkman brand. I keep this on hand for emergency use. I like it much better than non-fat dry milk but I still prefer fresh whole milk if it is available.

title: Prefer Cheetos
text: I prefer the Cheetos brand. These do not have as much tangy cheese flavor as Cheetos and don't have as much of the good corn meal taste and texture. I have 11 1/2 bags left and went to the local store to buy more Cheetos.

title: One of my favorites
text: This cereal has just the right amount of sugar out of the box and you don't need to add additional sugar.

title: Good
text: I have always preferred the Italian green beans to the standard Blue Lake variety of beans. I will definitely buy again.

title: Better than frozen
text: I had tried frozen Lima beans before getting these canned lima's and was disappointed. These are much easier to prepare and they taste great.

title: Good
text: I have tried three of the Simply Asia noodle bowls and I liked all of them. I preferred the Spicy Mongolium Noodles the best. I will definitely try other products of this brand. The Sweet and Sour noodles don't reheat as well if you don't finish them in one sitting.

title: I Love It
text: I tried the Spicy Mongolian Noodles first and loved them. I ordered the Sesame Teriyaki and was hesitant to try them for fear I would not like them as much. They are great. More spicy than I expected but they are very good. So far I am extremely pleased with all of the Simply Asia noodle bowls. They are fast and easy to prepare and I can make two meals from each bowl making them very affordable. Next on my list is the Sweet & Sour Chow Mein Noodles. At this rate I may have to try all of the Simply Asia noodles varieties.

title: Not Sweet
text: I don't care for these Apricots. The package says they are "tangy-sweet". I would describe them as tangy-sour. I won't order again.

title: Fantastic
text: This is the best bread machine mix I have used. The flavor and texture are far superior to Krusteaz Country White. It even looks bettter after coming out of the bread machine. I will order again!

title: Makes great hamburger buns
text:
I had to adjust the recipe before it was good in my bread machine. I blame the Hamilton Beach bread machine. I have ordered two other mixes to try before I order again.

Update: I did order again. This mix makes great hamburger buns.

title: Disappointed
text: I love Spam. I love Hormel Bacon. Combine the two and I don't like it as much. I eat Spam with jelled cranberry sauce but it's not appropriate with Spam with Bacon. It has a lot more fat content and I had to fry it longer. Next order I place will be for Spam, no bacon. Regret I have 5 cans left to eat.

title: Really excellent product
text: I paid slightly more for the small beets over the sliced beets but I was not disappointed. They are extremely good.

title: Great Chili
text: I've loved this chili for over 50 years. At one time I purchased a can of every brand on market at the time. Since then I buy any new brands coming on the market. This brand is still my favotite.

title: Good!

title: Good Soup

title: Bad, Bad, Bad!

title: Disappointing
text: I had been purchasing another generic brand but decided to try the name brand that was offered on Amazon. I was disappointed that it was not better. I don't think I will purchase again.

title: Delicious
text: For years I made my own. I'm older now and don't want to spend hours making it from scratch. I thought I would be disappointed with a boxed mix. Happy to say I loved it. Quick and easy to prepare and it tastes great. I will certainly buy more.

title: Very good
text: I  love tapioca pudding and I liked this product more than Swiss Miss ready made. I did find it was a little thin so the second time I made it I put in a little less milk and it was just right. I will buy again.

title: I like it
text:
These hashbrowns are very convenient to use. Taste great and very easy to fix in a short amount of time. First time I prepared them I salted on both sides. Second time I salted only one side. Third time I added no salt and they were still on the salty side. If you are looking for low salt you might want to avoid these. I will still purchase more.

Update: checked the label and it has 12% of your daily value of sodium

title: Good Shrimp
text: I have tried Bumble Bee Tiny Shrimp and Roland Picnic Shrimp and I see no difference in quality. Both are good and I would order either brand.

title: Excellent

title: Disappointing - Would not buy again!

After heating, the potatoes were hard and I had trouble even getting a fork into them to stir them up with the gravy. They tasted like they had a lot of onion seasoning, which was too strong.

Update: After eating three of the six in the case I have thrown the remain three into the garbage can. I went to the neighborhood mom & pop grocery store and bought a Stoffer's Meat Loaf and Mashed Potatoes and it was so far superior, I just can't get myself to eat the remaining Hormel product.

title: Give it a try...you'll love it
text: I thought I would try the Naturals without the salt added, based on another review, I found it delicious. I use it to make a great corn chowder as well as heating and eating right from the can.

title: Very Tasty

title: Excellent Turkey

After having this soup three times I think it is better suited for wallpaper paste.

That part of the label on the picture was covered up. I don't mind spicy but the "Hot" label made me nervous. After preparing it for the first time I found they were indeed hot but I enjoyed them immensely. I will defiantly buy them again.

title: Easy, Easy, Easy!
text: I have loved this product for years, but it is almost impossible to find in my local stores. I cut the top and bottom off and throw one away. Use the remaining lid to push out the bread far enough to cut off a slice using the can as a guide. Place the slice on a microwave safe plate, butter, and cover with a paper towel and microwave for about 20-25 seconds until the butter melts. Great snack any time of day and quick to heat. Can't be beat!

title: Add bacon to anything!
text:
Lean and smoky flavor. By far the best bacon bits I have tried. These things make it soo easy to add bacon to just about anything. (I haven't found anything they don't go with.) And to microwave mac and cheese for an awesome snack. Very good mixed in with instant egg crystals. Sprinkle some into a grilled cheese sandwich. Mix in with stovetop stuffing to elevate it to a new level. The uses seem endless. I just love "pig candy"! Pre-cooked bacon and these crumbles make adding bacon so easy with out any mess cooking bacon, The price by weight seems pretty good to me compared to those little packages of famous brand bacon bits you find in the grocery store. I have found shelf life to be very good stored in a pantry. But refrigerate after opening.

That said, a few reviews suggest that quality control might rarely be an issue. These are non-returnable, however, they are eligible for refund or replacement. I have on rare occasion had an issue with a food item and if I had the problems noted by a few reviewers, I wouldn't hesitate to complain. I have found Amazon to be very understanding and they will make things right.

title: Good Jalapeno flavor but not too hot.
text:
This is good green salsa. The flavor of Jalapenos comes through and not just the heat. It's hotter than mild, but not super hot. That's one of the great things about Jalapenos, they have a distinct flavor and not just heat. It is a good mix with some onions and garlic. This is a really good brand and their other stuff is quite good too. I've used this for some time and like it. Seems like the original version said it had Tomatillos in it too, but they are not listed now. I use it in both cooking and as a salsa. It makes for some pretty good tacos with beef, pork or chicken. I usually make mine medium hotness and you can put a little more on after, if you want extra heat. Makes for a good tuna salad with a little kick too.

A bit thin for chips like you might use a chunky salsa, but it goes great added to a lot of dishes. If you want some good flavor along with some heat, this is the stuff!

title: So much better than minute rice
text:
The whole grain brown rice is a very good basic rice, much better than a bland white minute rice. The good flavor of whole grain brown rice comes through and is not masked by any other seasonings.

Like all these Ready Rices, these are good to go in 90 seconds and are fine as a side just as they come out of the microwave. But the real benefits come out when you use these as a base for other creative dishes. The while grain brown is pretty vesatile and goes with a lot of things from beef roast to grilled slamon steaks. It also makes a great rice for some quick pork or chicken fried rice.

The whole grain brown is mild enough that it compliments a lot of dishes without being overpowering. Far more flavorful than a processed white rice but still subtle. Works well in many applications calling for plain white rice to add just a bit more flavor and richness.

title: Excellent mix of rices
text:
Most all of the Uncle Ben's ready rices are really a quick way to add rice to virtually any meal. The Long Grain and Wild Rice mix is one of their best. Great flavor with the earthy, nutty, subtle hints the wild rice adds. Well balanced seasoning that doesn't have a packaged taste.

Great with pork and beef too. You can serve it up as is or use it with other ingredients to make a gourmet style side. One favorite way to use it is by adding it to some chopped onions and portabella mushrooms simmered in some beef broth. You can cook the mixture on a low to medium simmer well gradually adding additional beef broth slowly much like a rissoto. The result is a rich flavorful dish that will get rave reviews.

title: A very smart way to keep milk
text:
First off, I am not a big milk drinker, but a lot of times milk is an ingredient in a lot of recipes. The 8 ounce size is pretty convenient for that purpose. The one year shelf life with no refrigeration, simply can't be beat. I have had some milk lovers try it as a drink and they think it is just as good as fresh milk. I don't use milk in coffee, but for those who do, they love it.

It is funny, because all around the world, we are about the only ones who buy fresh milk from the dairy counter. UHT milk has been used in most major countries for years now. The Europeans are far more careful about food safety than we are and this is what they prefer. UHT is ultra high heat treated. That means it is sterilized by heat, not radiated as some have thought. The process doesn't damage flavor but makes it safe to sit on a shelf unrefrigerated.

It comes in quarts too, but as I don't use a lot of milk, the 8 ounce size is great for me. Good product, but not available everywhere. Buying a case from Amazon just makes far too much sense, at least for me.

title: Very handy to have around.
text:
If it were cheaper, I would give it 5 stars. Tastes better than minute rice and has some body to it. It is really nice to keep around. Sometimes just adding a bit of rice to some leftovers makes it a new meal. 90 seconds in the microwave and it's ready to eat. It is convenient to add to other dishes you are cooking or as a quick side. It works nice for making a quick fried rice with a little pork or chicken, some diced onions and seasoning, stir fried in a wok.

Most of these Uncle Ben's Ready rices are pretty good, although I favor this original white and the long grain and wild flavors. Garden Vegetable is a pretty nice basic one too, that adapts to a lot of dishes quite easily. I use these more as an addition to a dish rather than as a side. This is good quality, nutritious rice that isn't over processed.

I always keep some on hand for quick meals. It isn't the most economical way to add rice to your diet, but it has to be the quickest and easiest. At the same time you don't sacrifice anything in the way of quality. Actually better in my opinion.

Looks like hell but man is it tasty. :)  Serve with tortilla chips or corn chips, or even various veggies. Enjoy!

title: Helps with fleas but not 100%
text: Brewers yeast with garlic is great for your dog or cat. It helps keep fleas from being as bad as they could be. You would still need to treat the pet for fleas using some other method.  Also, garlic is a homeopathic cure for internal parasites, namely worms.  My dog was having recurring problems catching worms until I started giving her the Brewers yeast with garlic.  She loves them too. Most dogs and cats love brewers yeast. If the pet doesn't want to take the first one you can put it in their mouth. That's usually all it takes to get them to like them.  I've had that experience with about 4 of the cats I've had in the past. After the initial force feeding of the pill, my cats would almost fight each other over them and saw them as treats.  :)

title: fast and delicious side dish
text: This couscous is easy to prepare and quite tasty all on its own. When I make it I use a really good extra virgin olive oil and some chopped fresh tomato right before I cover it.  You basically boil water, add salt, oil, tomato, cover it and it's ready in 7-10 minutes. YUM.

text: I like all the Uncle Ben's Ready Rice that I've had so far.  They heat in 90 seconds.  Many times I have eaten them with a salad as a whole meal.  Filling and delicious.  Great for kids in dorms or people who don't cook.  Great product.

Perfect for a quick lunch on the go, or with a nice toasty grilled cheese sandwich. It's got a lovely Parmesan flavor to it and the soup itself is creamy and not too acidic.  I plan to order more!!

title: typical syrup size, good price, nice assortment coffee--not amazing but I have been enjoying it all
text:
Pleasant set, might be nice as part of a coffee themed gift. Comes in its own box with 2 bottles side by side and a clear bag of loose k-cups tucked in.

The caramel flavor is low key. It doesn't overwhelm. I find it easy to drink; not harsh. I found it pleasant in my coffee, but needed a healthy splash to taste it (though often find that true of syrups). I usually drink my coffee black, so I don't often use flavor syrups--yet my giant collection says otherwise, haha. But once in a while I like to make a more interesting drink. Ice with flavor is nice, or a big mug of hot coffee with cream and flavor syrup, or espresso latte. Italian soda, etc. I also use flavor syrups for flavoring frostings, and for use in smoothie. Though for that I normally use sugar free. The caramel syrup from Cafe Le Rou uses cane sugar.

Two 25.4 ounce bottles (typical size, and probably any pump works with it if that is your preference) as well as a bag of k-cups of various roasts. 25 cups, 5 of each variety. A little something for everyone.

The k-cups work well in my machine. Good brew, no issues. I typically brew 10 ounces, and any of these taste fine. Nothing that rocks my world, but I have been drinking them daily. I can tell the difference between them, but no huge difference. Closer in line with cheapies like Victor Allen, but I happen to like that brand and keep some on hand at all times. I have my preferred brands for use as my 1st cup to really enjoy, then I usually stretch it out with mediocre brands for the simple caffeine need. And sometimes the more low key flavor sits better with me.

I don't see the coffee offered separate of the syrups anywhere, so I wonder if they will be releasing it soon or not or if it will forever only be available with 2 big bottles of syrup. If so then this wont be a repurchase any time soon since 2 bottles of syrup will last me years!

Really comes down to preference, some may totally love this, some may not like it at all, but I imagine some be perfectly happy with it but may or may not buy again.

-->>I dont rate on price, but I comment. Bottles of syrup I get of this size (for basic flavors like this) is usually $8-10, and so I was trying to figure out how much this costs- is the syrup pricy or is the coffee? It's a nice pack and $33 isnt unreasonable, but I'm curious about the coffee pricing. They have a 5 bottle listing (just syrup) for $34, making it $6.80 per bottle (less if do subscribe & save). Maybe that is bulk pricing. So lets bring up the bottles to $8 each. With a price of $33.75 minus $16 for the syrup, that leaves $17.75 for the price of the coffee. That breaks down into $0.71 per k-cup for an ok cup of coffee. More or less depending on cost of bottle of syrup. The coffee is more like $0.81 per cup if assuming the $6.80 per bottle pricing. Even my most favorite coffees I will hesitate to get if pushing 70 cents or more. I expect this to be more in line with the cheapy brands, or at least sub $0.40 per cup.

title: rich, salty, tastey. Good mouthfeel, nice flavor and texture. Goes with anything
text:
Rich and tasty. Has a good mouth feel. Light and crispy, easy on teeth, yet has substance. I could nosh on these as is. Has more flavor than expected. Nothing predominates it is just more than the typical blah cracker. Salty and rich is what comes to mind. There is a denseness that gives it a more fulfilling mouth feel. I suppose that is why they call it flatbread and not just cracker.

Really impressed with it as something to pair with dip. Pita chips are too hard on my teeth, chips are too boring (dont always want tortilla), and other crackers are hit or miss. I would buy these just for times I definitely plan on making an artichoke dip, eggplant (babaganoush) dip, hummus, or soft cheese. The cobo of texture and taste makes them versatile. I often do up plain "cheese and cracker" boards or a charcuterie for more variety for use as a meal or big snack. Sometimes that just hits the spot. These are a nice addition to the assortment I set out for myself.
Think I would like this soup too.

4 packs of crackers, sorry flatbread in a brand box. The majority of my crackers are in good shape. Some breakage more noticeable in a couple of packs, and nearly nothing in the other 2.

Crackers are loose in a tray with plastic wrap. Thinking that to minimize breakage that perhaps the internal packaging could be redesigned. For sure you will want to slip these into a ziplock bag once opened.

title: great addition to oatmeal and yogurt bowls
text: Love this brand. Lasts forever, never seems to get old or funky. I always toss some into my oatmeal or yogurt bowl. That's pretty much the extent of my use. Sometimes nosh on a handful. Have yet to bake with goji berries, but I imagine there are some recipes worth trying out there.

title: creamy and really good (I dont even really like hazelnut!)
text:
I'm not much one for hazelnut, and actually am not a fan of Ferrero Rocher classic candies, but I had the opportunity to try this awhile back and liked it. A lot. I had the white chocolate (LOVE!) and the milk chocolate and really enjoyed both varieties of candy bar. I think was an influenster thing as I dont think I would have ever tried it otherwise.

I am putting together a few treat gift bags to give out to friends for the fun of it, and saw this bulk box. I dont often see the milk chocolate hazelnut in the store, so I just went ahead and bought this. I have enough to give away as well as plenty for me. Yum!

I like the container, wrapping, and that the bars can be broken off from the scoring. Lots of squares!

title: soft, heavy, smells good, could use more lychee flavor, overall quite filling, very sweet
text:
It's fair and within expectation. 3.5/4 stars

Smells lovely. I love lychee and basically bought this on impulse. I don't often get out somewhere that carries this treat, so I am glad I found it here. Smooth, chewy, soft outer with small glob of lychee flavored gel. I could use more lychee flavor, or more of the center substance. No visual texture like some of the customer pics. Smooth like the product pics.

Sweet, high calories. It does provide a sense of fullness. It sits kind of heavy. I am a big eater, and I would not eat more than one. Pretty typical of mochi, and so if I were looking to buy more I would likely get this again. Who knows.

title: versatile pack of rice & veg, eat hot or cold, eat as is or add other food to it
text:
I like the "hint of salt" option. It isnt overly loaded with sodium. Has some vegetables. Easy to cook, or can just eat cold. Great addition to emergency pantry as no cooking (or minimal cooking) is required. DIY MRE. Convenient for on the go lunches, or added to hiking pack or camping supplies.

Versatile: add to broth for a quick soup, or balance it out by adding some protein, or add more vegetables. Spoon it over salad. Or simply eat as is.

title: crunchy but not hard on teeth, holds up well in milk, great for pairing w/ non sweet cereal
text:
Small dime sized maple flavored crunchy bites. Tasty as a dry cereal to snack on, or absolutely stellar with milk (I like unsweetened vanilla almond or oat milk). I like a little sweetness to my cereal and this provides just that. It has crunch and texture but is easy on teeth. It doesn't dissolve in milk but doesnt stay as crunchy, yet still maintains a very good texture. It is really quite perfect to me.

Are you a cereal mixer? Yeh me too! I LOVE MIXING MY CEREALS. I love mixing a sweet cereal with a less sweet/no sweet cereal. I love adding this to Cheerios or [[ASIN:B001ELL3DM high fiber Natures Path Organic Bran Cereal]]. Mmm what a combo. SO GOOD.

OR I will make a Greek yogurt bowl with berries and sprinkle on the bran cereal then top with a little of this for added flavor, visual interest, and texture.

I am not a regular cereal eater. I go through phases where it just sounds good to me. Then I gobble it like crazy- eat for any meal or as a snack. Usually way too much at once, but oh how I enjoy it. So glad I tried this cereal. Yum!

I just really like it and will consider it again, especially if I can get it on sale. I bought this from the warehouse for cheaper price. The best by dates are usually short with warehouse stuff (often on cusp of so called expiration, but that is why it is discounted--just like a clearance section in store), but this actually has a date 4-5 months out. Not that I would care if it was 2 weeks out. This cereal wont magically go bad because of a date on a package.

title: fresh, flavorful, good every day coffee, solid medium roast, not tangy or acidic, pretty good
text: Good flavor, fresh, smells good. Was one of the first k-cups my husband was buying for himself many years ago, then he branched out. Kinda forgot about this brand until recently so I bought him some when I saw it. I tend to prefer bold dark roasts, so this is all for him as it is a medium. But I like it too. It is a style that is easy to offer anyone no matter their preference. Good every day coffee.

title: crunchy, sweet, easy on teeth, nice portion for grabbing a sweet treat, little dust (tasty tho)
text:
So far so good. Little bags have good sized pieces (mostly squares), little dust. I dont normally care for crunchy cookies, but this has a good flavor to me. The small bags are perfect for enjoying a little treat when I want something sweet with my coffee. I see the giant bags at the store, but never the snack size.

I bought this primarily for use in creating a few treat goodie bags to give out, but I knew that I would have plenty left over for myself. Glad I like it!

I like the "variety pack" as the combo will provided added interest & options to the treat gifts I am making.

title: fresh, aromatic, tasty, really good quality from a quality Amazon brand.
text:
Pleasantly surprised how fresh and aromatic these fluffy marshmallows are. More of a name brand taste and not at all generic tasting. They did well with flavor and texture.

Usually, I buy a pack from the store for use in riced cereal treats, but I saw these Amazon brand marshmallows for a reasonable price and decided to order them on a whim. Kinda forgot about the order until they arrived. Now I need to buy some cereal! Or maybe more marshmallows too because these have a really good flavor.

I've been buying Happy Belly products for a few years now and have been satisfied with the quality. OI can add this to the list!

Really comes down to your perception and preference. Worth giving them a try. Price tag wont break the bank.

title: tasty every day spice for anything and everything
text: I'm not too picky when it comes to seasonings, though I do tend to buy Lawry's and McCormicks for blends.  I just love having a wide variety on hand. Some become my daily seasoning, others are for less frequent uses. This blend is good for anything, anytime. I like it best as a finishing spice- sprinkle over potatoes, vegetables, chicken. Though would be fine for adding to soups and stews too. Just keep in mind that it already contains some salt.

title: good flavor and consistency, pantry staple, use it in and on anything
text:
CONDENSED soup, so plan to add water or milk. Nutrition info is typical of a canned, shelf stable item. Of course it has a lot of sodium, but also keep in mind that this is a condensed food item. A review mentioned it being a lot of sodium for a little can, but it isnt just a little can when it is condensed. Take a look at regular cans of soup, any brand, any style, they all push 1000 mg and beyond easily. Also, the nutrition information is clearly listed directly in the product description. 790 per can

Good flavor and consistency. I dont use this style of soup often, but it is a great pantry item for casseroles, sauces, "gravies" and use for general flavoring. Probably good as a soup too- paired nice with chunk of bread? mmm

I like when I can buy a case of something. I can find these on sale in store often, but I don't get to the store frequently enough to take advantage, and when I do I really dont want to load my cart up with cans. Also don't want to clear the shelf. So if I can just buy a case and tuck it away then I am set for a while and dont have to bother with remembering to buy any when out shopping.

title: heat and sweet, unique flavor combos, worth the try. Nice as food themed gift
text: Definitely has some spice. Has an intriguing flavor profile once you get past the heat. The fruit gives a sweetness and a level of nuance that is often missing in hot sauce. So yeh, its spicy but it has flavor too. neat assortment, pricey (but I dont rate on price). I like best that this is just different. Would make a nice addition to food themed gift, or for yourself if you just want to branch out from the usual assortment of hot sauces. I didnt expect to like the bluebeerry as a hot sauce, but it's probably my fave. I like them all, but the heat at first is a bit much. Didnt stop me though, haha. Probably one of those things that will vary from individual to individual.

title: sturdy tall bunny shaped container stands up on its own, festive easter vibe, excellent quality
text: Typical high quality Ferrero Rocher candy. The main thing here are the containers. Grab this when you want to give a festive looking treat. Thick, robust bunny shaped containers that will make a stand out feature in an Easter basket, or just handed over as is. I love that the containers stand 9" tall, and the containers stand up perfectly well on their own, no need to have something to prop it up. The candies inside are visible and very much appear how they do on the product pictures. One bunny with classic Ferrero Rocher and one bunny filled with a variety.
