title: excellent flavor, nice fizz, no caffeine, drink as is or add to cock/mocktails, a tad sweet/cloying
text:
I love grapefruit, but the guava pairs nicely with it. The combo of the two reminds me more of an orange flavor. It is quite good, even better than anticipated. Clean flavor, lightly sweet. A little sweeter than I prefer, but it is still quite good. Pleasant level of carbonation (I love carbonation!), and I love that it is not a caffeinated energy drink. Acquired 03/2023 with best by date of 11/2023. Probably wont make it a week as this is very easy to drink, nice addition to my day.

4/4.5 stars. The sweetness level is just a little cloying. I wouldnt drink this to quench y thirst, and I may drink some of these by adding additional plain club soda to help decrease the sweetness. Not as sweet as pop, but the 7 grams of added sugar (agave) is noticeable. Even so, I would consider this again.

title: convenient, tasty, fresh, lasts long time in cupboard, good as is or add other goodies to it
text:
Love keeping Annie Chun products in my pantry. Convenient, shelf stable food that makes for a quick lunch or dinner. Easy to prepare, good flavor. Not always my go-to for food of this type, but sometimes I dont want to make a lot or I dont want to be bothered with all the prep. I just want the taste and texture when I want it.

I love that everything is separately packaged. This really helps to keep it fresh and very long lasting in the cupboard. Well beyond any "best by" date. Noodles are vac packed, seasoning and sauce in their own packets, then all tucked into a sturdy bowl.

Sometimes I eat it as is, sometimes I add in other goodies (veg or protein, usually some sort of left over in fridge), sometimes a little extra seasoning (or even a little added peanut butter or peanut butter powder). Totally good prepared as is, but it also works when used as a base if you have things you want to bulk it up or change the flavor a little. Nice crunchy chili oil works very nicely for turning it into spicy peanut noodles!

title: Waxy, hard, plastic like. Doesn't melt in mouth, barely softens in microwave. Use in trail mix
text:
(yuck!!))
WHY THE DIFFERENCE? Here are the ingredients for the regular milk chocolate bar versus this organic chocolate bar: I see they omit milk fat and soy lecithin (fat emulsifier), which is basically taking those out is what makes this taste like plastic. They cheaped out taking out these items. If they wanted to make a "soy free" item there are alternatives available. I will not be repurchasing this, I will not recommend it. If the formula ever changes to give it a better mouth feel, then I would consider again. I normally love Hersheys, but this is a huge HECK NO from me.

(regular recipe): MILK CHOCOLATE [SUGAR; MILK; CHOCOLATE; COCOA BUTTER; MILK FAT; LECITHIN (SOY); PGPR; NATURAL FLAVOR]

(organic): ORGANIC MILK CHOCOLATE (ORGANIC SUGAR, ORGANIC COCOA* BUTTER, ORGANIC MILK, ORGANIC CHOCOLATE).

---->>>1 star. My rating is based primarily how this tastes in comparison to regular Hershey's chocolate bars. I think it is fair to do this because I am sure there are others that may give this a try thinking that it will at least resemble a Hershey's product. NOPE! It is an entirely different product. The taste, texture, and smell is just different. It isn't "bad" for chocolate flavor, but it is incredibly disappointing if expecting it to resemble the original base formula. There are other healthy recipe chocolates out there that far exceed this.

It does NOT have a good mouth feel; it does not have a melt in mouth creaminess to it. It doesn't even melt when placed in microwave. Perhaps with more time it would, but I just put it in there to give it a try---I was just curious to see if it would soften up with any sort of heat. I gave it 10 seconds and expected it to soften. Nope. I gave it another 10, and then another 10. Only at the 30 second mark did it become less "hard", but it didn't soften. There was no glorious chocolate experience. Had that been the regular chocolate bar, it would have been soft at 10 seconds. Or in my mouth, or in my pocket.

Waxy, hard, plastic like. Once I get chewing the chocolate flavor is ok, but it doesn't taste like Hershey's, at all. And as mentioned, sure doesnt feel like it.

I'll stick to the regular Hershey's for the occasional chocolate treat. I dont eat this stuff enough to try to switch to a "healthy" version. I got this because I was curious. Other reviews said it was bad. I thought how bad can it be? I am an avid reviewer and like trying different stuff and giving it my thoughts in a review. I should have saved my money and heeded the bad reviews because this is not a pleasing product at all. I had also bought it to be used as part of a treat bag for some of my older friends. Just a "thinking of you" gift. I will NOT be adding this in. I would be embarrassed to add this in. I tucked it into my cupboard for possible use in baking, or for use as barter if TEOTWAWKI occurs. :P

So yeh, not one to waste.. I'll use up these bars in baking or break them up for use in a trail mix. But for noshing? nope, no way. SO DISAPPOINTING!

title: Espresso is my favorite, nice pack for various preferences
text:
I've been buying San Fransisco Bay coffee for several years. I buy it ground, whole, and in K-cup form. I like dark roast best, so I usually buy their espresso, french roast, or my favorite, Dark Italian Roast. I bought this variety pack because it was on sale and because my husband usually drinks medium and light roasts. Hazelnut is never my thing, but a family member loves hazelnut so I figured I would gift this portion to them. So basically this set includes a little bit of everything.

I like how the cups are packaged in sets of 10. 20 of each variety, but packaged in sets of 10 (so two bags of each). This helps with freshness as the base of the cups are exposed. I've never had any issue keeping an open pack fresh; just be sure to close up tightly.

Works perfectly fine in my Keurig brand brewer as well as our [[ASIN:B096BJJ1FG Instant Pod 3 in 1 brewer]] (makes k-cups, nespresso capsules, and can take an adaptor for using own coffee--neat machine).

Love the Espresso roast. Very happy with the robust, bold, smooth flavor. Havent heard any feedback on the rest of the pack, so I assume all is just fine.

title: for quick snack, meal on the go, good as is or w/ crackers.
text:
I'm not fussy. I really like sardines. They really aren't a fishy fish for those curious. Less so than a lot of tuna out there. They provide good nutrition and are so easy to eat. I often just eat them direct from the can. Or will occasionally prepare like I would a tuna sandwich. Also adore them on Club crackers.

I normally just get them in water, but will buy them in any base if its on sale. I like these "lightly smoked in olive oil" option. That was new to me.

Love this brand. There are a lot of good brands out there and some that I avoid(bumblebee). Wild Planet has always served me well.

title: prepper delight, nice assortment of beans and vegetables, quality product from trusted brand
text:
Trusted brand! Pricey per pound, but I love the assortment of goodies in this blend. I keep a variety of soup blends on hand and it is nice to see something a little different. I put this on an subscribe and save as I know I will be wanting more of this to tuck away for future use.

Love this assortment of beans and vegetables. You can see the full ingredient list on one of their pictures. What an assortment! I keep a variety of dried beans and vegetables on hand for anytime use, but also for long term storage.

Directions are on bag as well as recipe idea.

title: fresh, flavorful, excellent hot or iced
text:
Love Stash brand of teas. I am not much of a tea drinker, but my cupboard full would have you thinking otherwise. I make a point to drink a variety of tea for the health benefits, and sometimes just because I want something hot (or iced!) to drink once I am done with coffee for the day.

This tea is just a blend of black teas and peach essence. It doesnt list caffeine content but it can be assumed that it is caffeinated otherwise it would be sure to say decaff if it wasnt.

Lovely flavor, easy flavor. Nice balance to the peach flavor. Make it as strong or as mild as you so desire.

title: loaded with fiber, easy on teeth, nice by the handful or as a cereal, or added to yogurt
text:
Yum! Lightly sweet pellets that are easy on the teeth. Not too sweet; just right. I dont need it sweet, but this little bit of added cane sugar does make it taste extra nice.

Tastes good directly from box as a snack, or consumed as a cereal, or my fave: added to a bowl of plain (or any flavor) yogurt with a handful of berries. Goodly amount of fiber per 3/4 cup serving. I usually eat 1 serving, sometimes closer to 2 depending on how I am eating it. Good stuff. Love being able to buy a multi pack

Ingredients:
Organic wheat bran, organic oat fiber, organic cane sugar, organic psyllium seed husk, organic barley malt extract, organic oat bran, organic whole oat flour, sea salt.

title: as good as other brands, exactly as described and shown in pictures, no surprises, good stuff
text:
The tiny bit of added sugar comes as no surprise as it is shown in the product pictures. Just take a look at the nutritional information before ordering. 3 grams added sugar (less than 2%)

Tastes like coconut water, similar to other coconut water options. If you have had coconut water before then there is nothing wildly different about this. If you haven't..well it is an acquired taste.

The hint of added sweetness is subtle. Kinda makes it taste better, and lends to overall flavor as well as for use in replacing electrolytes if you are legit dehydrated. I really only drink coconut water when I am going to be sweating profusely (usually outdoor work, or arduous hikes). Then I like to use it straight, or added to water, or as base to smoothie, or will do half and half water to coconut water. Basically because I dont actually care for coconut water despite loving all things coconut otherwise. I drink it because it is very helpful and makes excellent addition to true hydrating needs.

Sometimes I top it off with an electrolyte powder. This big container is fine for most applications, but wouldnt be my go to size for just drinking straight up coconut water. Might also be good for use in cocktails and mocktails.

Perfectly good, as described, and all bottles look to be in good shape. 5 stars for overall quality, though nearly same as others out there.

title: easy green tea for hot, cold drink application, add to foods, smoothies, other teas
text:
Lovely product. No big concerns. Wish I could find out more about the company. I snooped around and found that this brand is under Real Good Beverage Company, with a web presence of Real Good Coffee (offers coffee, mushroom coffee, and now some tea). I made an inquiry about the country of origin, since it says USA, but not many areas of the US grow green tea. Usually tea comes from China, India, or Japan. The answer I got is that they dont know what I am talking about even though the product is listed on their website. Does not inspire confidence!

However, I'm still drinking it. Maybe I will still get clarification, and if I do I will update.

Still interested? This is a big bag of instant green tea. I love how I feel drinking green tea. Despite not being a huge fan of tea, I tend to drink it often because of the health benefits. I often drink green tea (cultivated in sun, leans brown/amber color) and matcha (shade grown, bright green) as it really gives me an interesting energy boost that my beloved coffee alone cannot provide. It provides a sense of well being, a low key but steady energy, truly reduces craving for sweets (discovered this decades ago before it became a thing), and is loaded with antioxidants. If you dont like the taste, it is easy enough to hide under other flavorings- add some flavored syrup, or juice, add to smoothies, add to baked goods, oatmeal, etc. I happen to love green tea based boba tea which I like adding lychee syrup to. Its a cold snowy day, but I think I will make myself a boba later today.

What I love about this is that it is instant. No fuss. I can shake it aggressively in cold water, or stir in with hot water. Though a little added to hot water then topped with cold & ice is best way to help dissolve.

Use whatever amount/ratio that suits your taste. Just be mindful of caffeine content. Serving size is just 1/2 teaspoon.

3.5/4 stars

title: pure cane sugar, good flavor, lovely in Italian sodas, pumps are extra nice addition
text:
I have the berry collection, and it is just what I use for my Italian sodas and occasional frozen drink. I have been using Torani for a few decades.

These come with pumps. This is not a Torani thing, but a Little Squirt Syrup product add-on. I think it is a nice addition. They work with Torani as well as a wide hose of other brands. I rarely use the pumps as I don't have the room to accommodate them all (I do usually keep one on my counter, and the rest of my syrup collection in a lazy susan cupboard which doesn't have headspace), but it is a great feature for those with the space. Instead, I just pour from the bottle.

The pumps are fine. Never in my years of having a pump on a bottle has it ever malfunctioned or gotten clogged. I dont expect it from this. I put one pump on the raspberry for testing and review purpose. It's fine.

Why the complaints that this is a plastic bottle? It says directly in headline that it is a plastic bottle. I can't remember the last time I had a glass bottle. Never ever have I had one break.

Flavor and quality of Torani is good. I tend to find it similar to Monin. Quality good tasting versatile product that is made with pure cane sugar.

I dont rate on price, but this is a reasonable price especially with the pumps. Would make for a nice "coffee station" themed gift.

title: orange drink for vitamin C and energy (calories, sugar) in a pinch. Make bad water taste better
text:
5 pounds of flavored powder. I bought this in lieu of Tang as I figured the long shelf life and long term storage container suits me better for prepping than a basic store shelf purchase. I dont normally drink stuff like this. I bought it for a few reasons.

1. I love water, and drink a lot of it. It is my drink of choice. But if an emergency/shtf/etc scenario happened and the taste of water was impacted, then having something to add to the water to make it palatable would be of great benefit to keep on hand. I have other powders and such tucked away, but I figured to add in an emergency storage item.

2. Vitamin C. If food items were scarce, especially fresh foods, then it would be easy to deplete vitamin C stores. We dont need much but we do need it. I have fruit and vegetable powders, I have vitamins, but this is just another option. Good to have redundancy. Stress will further deplete vitamin C, so it is something to think about.

3. Calories and sugar. So quick energy. 9,240 calories in this container. For the price, I thought it made a good addition to long term storage supplies

Yeh so the ingredients aren't amazing. Personally, I dont care. I dont drink this on a daily basis, and if used in a more dire situation the last thing I care about is the ingredient list. Can it provide energy? That's all I want. In this case it also adds much needed vitamin C per serving.

The container looks good, no issues. Even if dented it would be fine. There is nothing to go bad here and a dent doesnt mean a breach. If it were a can of tomato sauce I would be more concerned. But nearly anything freeze dried or in powder form? No biggie. Definitely not orange powder drink. All good.

Maybe I will buy more over time. Maybe I will add it to a subscribe and save order for even better value.

title: light carbonation, hint of flavor, barely there sweetness- pleasant means to hydrate
text:
I love carbonated water with a hint of natural flavor. I dont want it sweetened, I dont want it to have an artificial flavor. Often the products look similar, so it is important to take a peek at the ingredient list. Stuff I buy is usually just carbonated spring water with natural fruit essence. Nothing else. Liquid Death is different, but I was curious.

I have passed over "Liquid Death" several times because I assumed it was an energy drink. Then when I learned that it doesnt have caffeine, I figured it would be an artificial tasting overly sweetened drink. But I made an impulse purchase when it was on sale. I saw that it is sweetened with agave, and appears to not have much in it. I saw lime and orange extract. I was a little concerned about citric acid (when a company uses too much it creates a biting flavor), but went for it anyway.

It's good! Just a hint of sweet. Not a sweet drink. Softens the taste. Citrus flavor is gentle, and citric acid isnt noticeable. The carbonation is low key. I prefer a more intense carbonation, but this is doable. Not as fizzy as club soda or pop, but it has a good mouth feel anyway. They also offer "flat" (no carbonation) as well as unsweetened plain carbonated water.

I'd consider it again. The sale price wasnt too far off from the subscribe and save price. I love a fizzy drink, but dont necessarily want pop. This is nice because it is pretty much just water with just a hint of flavor and a barely there bit of sweet. Not a fan of the name, but I like their "death to plastic" motto.

title: lovely tea, little goes long way, delicate flavor, easy to drink
text:
Butterfly Pea tea is a rare treat for me. I should really drink it more often as it is touted to have a plethora of health benefits. I love the mild flavor. Such a gentle, easy to drink tea, And pretty too! Makes a lovely blue-ish purple color. Just the dried tea is appealing to look at too.

I brew mine in a French press or use a tea strainer.

Whether drinking or making for use as a food dye or crafting color, a little goes a long way. Robust 8 ounce bag will last a long time.

title: pleasant kitchen filling aroma, mild flavor, easy to drink, an occasional coffee
text:
1 full pound, resulting taste depends on brewing method and grind level. I go through a lot of coffee when I use my French Press, so while this isn't a daily drinker for me, I will still go through it quickly. I like it for something a little different. It has a fall flavor vibe.

Quality is good, smell is good. Taste is pretty good. Not my fave but it is a perfectly pleasant coffee.

I'd consider it as part of a foody themed gift, but the label looks washed out. It isnt, it was the choice of the company. I like minimalist looking products, but the light color with light color font really makes this look like the label was faded out and therefor cheapens the appearance. It is very similar to the product picture, but in my hand I am not a fan of how it looks for the price.

I dont rate on price (we can see price, we all have different preferences and budgets), but I comment. It's spendy for coffee. Not the most expensive out there per ounce, but it's ahead of many. Probably not a repurchase for me.

title: plenty of carbonation, hint of lemon, similar to other brands, larger container
text:
Larger bottle than what is typically offered in the stores. Similar fizz and flavor. I either buy store brand or name brand, depending on price. I like a carbonated water with an essence of flavor. I drink it like a bottle of pop.

Not flavored, not sweetened with anything. Just simple carbonation, hint of flavor. I normally go with lemon or lime, so this pack of 12 works for me. Just spring water, carbon dioxide and natural lemon essence.

42.3 ounces (compared to typical 32 ounce bottles). Pack of 12. I dont rate on price.

Perfectly bubbly. I love carbonation. This has plenty of it. It sizzles while I carefully opened it, and I drank direct from bottle. I definitely had some burps. Lemon essence is just that-- just a hint, and very typical level of flavor compared to others.

All good. I would consider again (dependig on price). Nice to have a case delivered.

title: Tried them all, pretty good, fresh tasting, eat hot or cold, easy prep, veg options are salty
text:
I like them all. The wheat bulger with tomato and onion is lovely any time of day, hot or cold. It has a good flavor, not too heavy, and it is pretty filling if that is all I eat. The lentils have a similar quality but totally different taste. It tastes good hot or cold and doesn't need anything added to it.

The other two options are tasty, but they would benefit from being paired with rice or something more filling. Texturally bland, but taste is quite good. I did not have any issues with the beans- nothing stringy. The eggplant dish is fresh tasting. I can clearly make out the flavor and texture of eggplant.

I like that they are shelf stable and taste perfectly good heated or cold. Good options for on the go, for quick meals, meal prepping, and for emergencies. I also like that they provide the nutritional information for a serving as well as for the entire bowl.

One thing to keep in mind is that these are pretty salty. Probably similar to consuming a can of soup. Shelf stable foods tend to lean high in sodium. Taste wise, I didnt think the bulgar or the lentils tasted salty. But the eggplant as well as the green beans have a noticeably salty taste.

title: very smooth, good coffee taste brewed at 10 ounces, budget friendly per cup
text:
My main and original review is for the "French Roast" which I think is smooth tasting. I am a fan of super dark, extra bold dark roasts consumed black, unsweetened. I have my preferences, but often price dictates my purchase when it comes to coffee. I was shopping for a budget coffee to add to my coffee stash, and this Solimo (and Amazon brand) came up that fit what I was looking for.

The reviews are mixed. I dont find this to be watery. I think it has a good stout taste that is quite smooth and easy to drink. I brew it at 10 ounces so perhaps that makes a difference. It is very smooth. Ive had darker, bolder more intense tasting dark roasts, but this is quite suitable as a daily drinker for me.

Side by side, it reminds me of [[ASIN:B07JR9CN53 Panera Dark Roast]] but at half the cost.

I'd buy it again, hence 5 stars

EDIT TO ADD:
I also bought the Donut Shop Blend, which is under this listing. I bought this for my husband who typically drinks other brands of same style. He said a few times that he doesnt feel like it has caffeine. He made no mention of taste or mouth feel, but he said he didnt feel like he drank coffee and actually looked to make sure it wasnt decaf. Not sure how to interpret that as far as rating goes. Maybe he just drinks too much coffee or is tired and just didnt feel it. Hope he finishes it up, and I will likely not buy that particular one again. But the French Roast? oh yeh! yum!

title: quality, trusted brand. Good taste and aroma
text:
Good brand. Great taste and aroma. Coconut oil is firm when cold and liquid when hot. The melting point is around 72 degrees. So right now my house is 64 degrees and this is totally solid. Come summer, it will be liquid. I usually buy larger containers at better price point, but I wanted a fresh jar and wanted a trusted high quality brand. Nutiva is one of the early brands that were available in store way back when it was just coming on the scene some 15 years ago or so. Good stuff.

I really just use it for consumption. I know there are plenty of bodily uses. Keep in mind that it may feel moisturizing at first, but it can be drying over time. Someone included a giant list in their review and I would be careful with that. Aids?Mono? how?

I'll stick to culinary uses and for base to some nutritional supplements (ie turmeric paste)

title: bold, smooth, full bodied dark roast. I brew at 10 ounces and drink black, unsweetened, Yum
text:
Ooh this is good. I have the dark roast, which is my preference across the board. I like my coffee strong, bold, and consumed black, unsweetened. This has that lovely deep flavor of what I call "coffee tasting coffee". It just tastes good, smells good, and the coffee flavor lingers on my tongue, makes me want more. I brew at 10 ounce. Will hold up fine to 12 ounce brew.

I haven't been to Panera in a few years, and I really dont recall what their coffee tastes like. I know I always chose the dark roast but I cant say how this compares. I really just got it because I wanted to buy more dark roast coffee and this was on sale. Now I wish I bought more. It is really quite good! Just a bold smooth coffee. I'd say [[ASIN:B07CFD96ZY McCafe French Roast]] has a similar vibe, which is budget friendly and has a smooth dark taste. For reference, I am also a fan of [[ASIN:B00YVDP6LU Peet's Major Dickenson Dark Roast]] (premium priced, rare treat) and [[ASIN:B088PRCDRN San Fran Bay Dark Italian Roast]]. Overall I will drink anything, and sometimes just buy based on price. But when I want a particularly good cup of coffee that I know I will be paying attention enough to enjoy then I will make the splurge. I have to say.. this is a contender.

I was able to buy mine on sale, steep discount ($21). I came back to maybe buy more and saw the new price ($73) but that it a tad spendy for my current budget. But since I dont rate on price, I will just say this makes a good cup of coffee. And for some the price will be worth it!

title: pieces (similar to halves but with smaller bits) not chopped (as shown). Good quality, fresh
text:
"Pieces" is accurate. The picture depicts chopped, but the term pieces and what I got are more accurate. I have no problem with these, or how large or small the pieces are. The picture makes it look like they are "chopped" which tend to be smaller pieces. These are more of what I expected with the term "pieces". Somewhere between halves and chopped. Reminds me of products that are actually labeled as "halves and pieces". Need smaller? The fix? Get out your chopper. Pecans are super easy to chop. If you truly need a small cut pecan then choose something called chopped.

I didn't have a specific need for these. I like to keep pecans on hand for toss in hot oats or in occasional baking. I never care what form they are in. I suspect there is some variability in what you may get. If you really dont care (like me), then you will find these to be just fine. Good quality, fresh, reasonable price. I'd buy these again.

title: good flavors, fresh smelling & tasting kernals. Have purchased this a couple of times
text: I first bought a box toward the end of summer 2022 for $15, now 6 months later it is up $6. Ah well. I bought it as part of a Valentines day gift. Popcorn themed! It's good popcorn with good flavoring and it makes a lot.  I pop it in a microwavable bowl. I dont care for the smell of popcorn but this always smells like corn on the cob. Very fresh smell. Lovely kernels. I would buy this again when I want added variety to my snack options. Be forewarned, the fiery hot pepper is spicy! Could probably make an extra batch of plain popcorn and distribute the powder for less intense flavor. It's good though! Nice flavor all around!

title: gently smoked flavor, salty but works. Good meaty texture, not mushy!
text:
Delicious. Excellent taste and texture. I was getting the Smoked/ Peppered version but the price recently nearly quadrupled. I saw this simply smoked version for the price I had been paying for the other, and decided to try it. Just as good. Just a simple salt and lightly smoked flavor. Packed in canola/rapeseed oil.

Very tasty. I love eating it on crackers. The texture is hearty, not at all mushy. The flavor has a delicate smoked taste, and while it is quite salty, it is so good. I even like the oil. I imagine some sodium is left behind if you dont partake in consuming the extra oil.

As with any can of this style, peel back the lid slowly and carefully.

I just bought 4 more. I really like this product!

title: open jar is an empty jar. Like a creamy chunky Ajvar, love w/ crackers, seems versatile
text:
I love it. First bite was like, eh.. this is weird. Then I kept going and next thing I knew I had emptied the jar before I even left my kitchen counter. Now tis a memory, and feeling slightly remorseful that I gave a jar to my mom to try, haha. I have one jar left, and next time I will sit down with my crackers before diving in.

That's how i like it, with crackers. Loads of other ways to have this stuff, but I eat like I do with a jar of Ajvar which is also a red pepper spread, sometimes with other vegetable bits and spices-- so very similar, and therefore very familiar. Unlike ajvar this Three Pepper Spread has some texture to it. Little chunks and bits like salsa, but in a creamy base. Thick enough to use as a dip, spread, or eat off the spoon.

I dont rate on price. We all can see the price before ordering, we all have different budgets, preferences, etc. Prices fluctuate. And really, now adays I dont know what is a good price. Nearly $10 a jar (for the size) is steep for me, but yet I really like it. I would consider it again. Has an added dimension of flavor that ajvar tends to lack. I would consider buying a jar of ajvar and mixing this into it so I can have a giant bowl of crackers and this spread. I really want to try it on a pizza crust or with a hearty bread. Mmm

I like it. If you like red pepper spreads, I imagine you will like this too. Taste is of quality, ingredients are simple. Love the pack of 3.

Red Pepper, Yellow Pepper, Green Pepper, Paprika, Tomato Paste, Tomato Powder, Water, Sunflower Oil, Potato Starch, Lemon Juice, Sunflower Seeds, Carbob Bean Gum, Agave Syrup, Garlic Powder, Onion Powder, White Pepper and Sea Salt

title: cant stop eating, so flippin good, my fave ever
text:
ridiculously good

Popcornopolis Zebra is the best popcorn I have ever had. I am not a fan of popcorn, but will occasionally enjoy a caramel popcorn. This is way better than anything.

I had first tried this brand when I was at a movie theater. They sold those cone bags of this stuff, and figured I would try it. I fell in love. Never saw this stuff in stores. SO I pretty much went to the theater once a year just to have a cone of this stuff. Then more recently I found it online, and was gifted a bag of this. Never saw it in a HUGE bag! WOAH. Well, after I gobbled that up, I eventually ordered a couple more bags. One for myself and one for my husband as I am not sharing!

Not sure if is a good thing to be able to buy a big bag of this stuff whenever I want. It is really hard to stop eating it. The texture and flavor is just so good. So perfect. Doesn't get all stuck in my teeth either. Perfect balance of caramel, chocolate and white drizzle.

title: lightly ginger, overall good taste. Not my fave, but will drink it up
text: A little light on the ginger, but if you dont need it strong then this is pleasant enough. When I want more of a ginger kick, I will add in a ginger tea bag or ginger powder. I love ginger so I bought this mostly based on that and not on the probiotic part. It is nice hot or over ice.

title: pleasant easy flavor, helps me wind down, nice on chilly nights.
text: Pleasant, easy flavor. I use two tea bags, and I feel relaxed shortly after I begin sipping. Been adding it to my night time routine as a way to wind down and to help support my immune system. I have been savagely stressed lately and so I am doing all that I can to take care of myself while going through a dark spot in my life. Celestials Seasonings Sleepytime Echinacea Immune Boost has become part of a much needed self-care routine. I add nothing to it, tasty as is. Mild easy flavor.

title: odd tasting "chai". Not what I am used to
text:
I live Bigelow tea, and I thought I have had their Vanilla Chai before, but this is not what I remember. Maybe I just had black chai? Anyway, it has an odd taste. Like a weird cookie taste. Not bad, just not what I am looking for in a chai flavor profile. I cant quite pin point it. I will be adding this to different chai just to use it up as I dont really like the flavor of this.

Freshness is intact, packaging is good. No problems there. Just the flavor is not what I expected.

title: Sweet & Spicy green tea is quite sweet, reminds me of apple spice. Pretty good
text:
Sweet & Spicy green tea is pleasant. Not exactly what I expected, but I like it. It is sweet, and the spice is primarily from the cinnamon. While it doesn't have apple in it, it reminds me of a spiced apple drink. Green tea doesn't really come through which is good or bad depending on your preferences. Might be a nice option for those that want to drink green tea, but don't otherwise care for the flavor. Strong flavor, so I use more water or less tea bags, or I use it in combination with a plain bag of green tea or matcha powder

Ingredients: STEAMED GREEN TEA, CINNAMON, LEMONGRASS, NATURAL FLAVORS, ROSEHIP, NATURAL GRAPEFRUIT FLAVOR WITH OTHER NATURAL FLAVORS, ANISE SEED, GINGER ROOT, NATURAL MANGO FLAVOR WITH OTHER NATURAL FLAVORS

title: MYSTERY! dont bank on getting what is pictured. Less gourmet, and more gour-meh.
text:
If you enjoy a mystery, this product may piqu your interest. The intrigue over not knowing what you will get until you open the box is so enticing. Will it reseble what is shown in the product pictures? Will it be as described in the listing? Or will be it be entirely different with products you will love.. to hate! Who knows! For $60 you too can join in on the "what will I get?" game!

edit to add that I am a glutton for punishment, or really just a glutton. I bought another. Yes I did, haha. Another sale one. I think I had a little too much fun with the other, and was curious what I would get this time around. As of 3/4/2023 it is same as in the picture (gray soft sided basket, Napoleon cookies stand out). Overall similar quality, but more stuff I am excited about. Still sticking with 3.5 stars (but am tempted to go w/4). OK.. so read on for continued original review:

So yeh.. Reviews may not be reflective of what you are actually buying. They seem to change product, so just be mindful of what the reviews are saying. Maybe sort by "most recent", and even then I wouldn't bank on getting what you are looking at.

I bought mine on sale ($25, less than half the current $60), and assumed it was a closeout item with short shelf life. I dont mind, I live dangerously.. and the price is what encouraged me to go for it.. Bought it as an impulse purchase for myself (don't shop hungry), and figured I would take a chance on it for the price. I dont recall if what is pictured now is what I saw then, or if the product details have changed since my order. I am just going to assume that whatever it is, likely wont be exactly worth it.

Another review of this exact product called it "underwhelming". I have to agree. The products are ok, some are better than others, but I would not be proud to give this as a gift. I'd rather find something I can see in front of me at a store, or simply put together my own assortment. Or go with a reputable company if the need to have it delivered is mandatory.

What I bought in early Feb 2023, is 100% different than what is pictured at time of review mid Feb 2023. So I am not sure what you will get. I dont mind what I have, but its a lot of fluff.

"Basket" is fine. Soft sided neutral toned with handles. Will be repurposed. Some crackers, cheese spread (gouda), olives, a few mini boxes of candies (couple pieces each of vanilla "fudge", chocolate covered caramel, truffles--all in their own packaging, which takes up more space than the actual item), pack of crunchy salted caramel cookies, spicy peanuts, oh and a box of tea. I think I remembered everything. All wrapped in cellophane with fabric ribbons. Not a bad look overall, just.. underwhelming.

For the sweets, I haven't really "liked" anything yet. Flavors of the candies are blah. There are some brand names too (Lindt, Godiva), but I guess they are just not for me. Now I know.

I really like the crackers- large rounds that hold up to dip. The cookies are kinda yuck to me Love the olives, and the cheese spread is pretty good.

Quality is Ok overall, but nothing to be excited over. Most of the stuff has a generic vibe. Less gourmet, and more gour-meh.

If we could do half stars, I would do 3.5. I dont like it enough to give it 4 stars. So I am going with a middle of the road rating of "3". Not great, not terrible, just "OK". It's fine. I am sure I would buy another if on sale and I was in an impulse buying sort of mood.

Maybe other variations are better. But who knows what we are getting?!?! (thought it was kind of fun to be wondering what would arrive.. )

title: pleasant flavors, quality shaker cup, well packaged, should double the samples
text:
I really like MTN Ops products. The flavors here taste good to me. This kit includes 5 sticks of powder, 5 flavors and a nice shaker cup. This is a powder that you add to water. It dissolves easily and does not need the shaker cup to dissolve, but use it if you prefer. It is not at all like a smoothie. It is 100% just as expected-- powder added to water that dissolves into a pleasant drink.

200 mg of caffeine per packet. Says to use 10-16 ounces of water. I use 20 ounces, sometimes more because.. why not? Use as much or as little as per your preference. It has a lot of flavor, so to me 10 ounces would be way too strong. Just be sure to stir or shake well as you drink it to ensure all the flavor is distributed evenly.

Because I use so much water, the flavor is mild to me. Not overly sweet. Pretty easy to drink. Just keep in mind that this is loaded with caffeine. I always drink regular coffee, so I use this when I am going to be active and want to give myself a boost as well as clear the fog. Dont drink it then just sit there.

I dont rate on price, but this is crazy pricy for 5 sticks. Yes, it comes with a shaker bottle (and strainer), a nice one at that and is also very nicely packaged (ready to go as a gift), but it needs double the samples to make it worthwhile to me. I can buy 30 servings of a single flavor for less (minus cup). I dont rate on price, but I sure comment on it (and utilize the rate features portion--2 stars!).

I happen to already be quite familiar with this brand, and like it a lot.. and it is half the reason I didnt look real close to the product description. I use their [[ASIN:B08WWQBWKH Hot Ignite MTN Ops]] which is a tasty hot caffeinated drink, and after that I purchased one of their fruit flavored powders (one of which is in this sample).

I often dread the taste of energy drinks. They work, and can make a difference in endurance and motivation, but often there is a weird taste that I have to overcome each time. With all the MTN Ops products I have had, I never taste anything truly off putting. I like all thre flavors, but the pink lemonade is one of my faves as it just tastes like lemonade. Quite refreshing tasting.

title: sweet & salty combo made for each other, good portion of each, perfect product
text:
If you already love Nutella, you will love this. If you are like me and normally don't care for Nutella, this is a game changer. Give it a try! I never once thought to pair nutella with pretzels. I rarely buy pretzels as there are other snacks I prefer. But the combo of nutella and pretzel (or the bread stick) are really made for each other. I like it a lot!

It's that sweet and salty combo. Really appealing. Perfect portion- neither item skimps. Easy enough to grab a little at a time, and it stores well for later use.

Nutella & GO is a product that I hope stays around. I don't think I would buy a container of nutella and a bag of pretzels as much as I would just order more of these conveniently packed portions. There is something greatly appealing about this. It is sweet, but not overly so. I don't have a desire to binge on it. There is a satisfying "mini meal" vibe to it. I could eat this if feeling hungry and not feel run down. I would pack this for on-the-go any time. Keep some in a hiking pack, in a car bag, work desk, in emergency supplies.

Nutella firms up in cool temps, but still workable with the sticks.

title: quality puree, highly versatile
text:
My favorite brand for vegetable purees. I usually get pumpkin or butternut squash as I find them super versatile for adding texture, flavor, and nutrition to a variety of soups, stews, and sauces. I recently decided to buy this sweet potato puree because I have been making a lightly cooked non brothy vegetable soup for my young dog with cancer. I just wanted to add further nutritional support, and the added puree gives the finely cut vegetables something to stick to. I dont use a lot, but it makes me feel good to add this high quality component.

I also like it for myself, for same uses as the butternut squash or pumpkin. I will sometimes just eat it cold by the spoonful, or heat it up. Add it to smoothies, soups, sipping broths, etc. Just works seamless with so many options.

This isnt a thick puree. There is no water added but it is a tad thin. Nothing I consider negative, just figured I would try to describe it.

Love this brand. Premium priced, but i dont rate on price. I try to watch for the occasional sale.

title: I love Dals Foods-- jam packed with fiber, any option is good. Love it all
text:
I love all these Dals Foods products. I dont even get them for their low carb aspect. I just like the great amount of fiber in each serving (24g in this!). I started off with their [[ASIN:B09B64FJ3X Slimovina]] and fell in love with it. Have ordered it 6 times now in the past 16 months. Great for thickening anything super quick and easy (way easier than flour, cornstarch, etc) and it adds nutrtion-- so loaded with fiber!. I'll take a brothy soup and add it in which turns it into a thick creamy like base. Really neat for making a chicken soup base feel like a chicken pot pie.

Then I wanted to try their other options, and so I have been buying a bag of something regularly. I now love "fu fu". A dough ball of the sort. Took me awhile to knack of creating it, but it really adds bulk to a meal, which is great because I have a big appetite.

I havent ventured yet too far out from what I have mentioned. I would like to find more ways to work with it. I really like the fiber content, the mouth feel, taste, and even though I wasn't aiming for low carb, I certainly can benefit from being more mindful. Instead of a hunk of bread along side a soup or stew, I will make a large fu fu ball, or several smaller ones.

title: nice product, good flavor, freshness and price. Love the ladle, funnle, & bottle added in
text:
Fresh tasting garlic powder. Good option for those who go through a lot of garlic. Price and quality are reasonable, and works for my nearly daily use of garlic, and a lot of it. Love garlic!

The addition of the ladle, funnel, and spice bottle is a real nice touch. Figured if I didnt use it for me, I could fill a bottle and share with my mom.

Fine granulation- not a powder, but the typical "garlic powder" one finds in the store.
I would definitely buy again

title: tang, fruitiness, and bite. Flavor profile more akin to a light roast. Fresh, zippy!
text:
Amazon Fresh capsules do a good job with describing the flavor. This Lungo medium roast is indeed "lush and fruity". It has a full mouth feel (not watery), with a spark of fruit and tart.Has a bite, slightly acidic. It actually is more reminiscent of a light roast in that regard. I actually thought it was a light roast until I double checked the packaging. Kind of reminds me of the equivalent of a hoppy IPA beer. It has that tang, fruitiness, and bite.

Brews well, works fine in my Instant Pod 3 in 1 brewer. Fresh tasting coffee-- I have tried 6 kinds I think now. My preference is for dark bold roasts, but I am always game for other roast levels. I think it does well brewed at 2 pr 4 ounces, and I dont bother with 6 ounces, usually. I think this would hold up though.

Just gotta like a tangy, fruity, slightly acidic, light leaning coffee

I like it, just not my fave BUT I do like this brand a lot, and really enjoy their dark roasts and decaff. So all those get 5 stars, and this is a solid 4 star from me (if it said light roast, then that would be different)

title: fresh clean taste, capsules work very well in my Instant Pod brewer, nice variety, good pricing
text:
Love this combo pack, a little something for everyone. I have tried a variety of Amazon Fresh nespresso capsules, some of which are in this pack, some of which are not. I have been overall pleased with everything I have tried. I am partial to dark roasts or a dark leaning medium. My husband prefers light or medium roasts, so I left the light roast to him. No complaints.

I use these in my Instant Pod 3 in 1 brewer, and these capsules work very well with it. The material sees to just work with ease; no issues.

Fresh clean taste, nearly half the price of Nespresso brand. The latter being my favorite but with the most recent price bump ($40-42 for same amount), I just cant justify the price. Amazon Fresh is currently $26 (some options with coupons and promotions), and the taste and quality is good enough to me to make it a repurchase (I love their decaff and their extra dark/intense options).

title: dark and smooth, not bold enough for me, but it is an easy daily drinker
text:
I'm not a coffee snob. I have my preferences but I will drink just about anything, brewed in any fashion.

I love a good dark, extra bold, chewy coffee that I can just drink black. As with any roast levels, there is variation between brands and even options within the brand. This "dark roast Signature Blend" is OK. That means nothing to you since we all have our preferences. What I like, you may not. What you like, I may not.

I find that this has a smooth taste, nothing jarring. I can tell it is a dark roast. Just sort of falls short on the bold aspect. I just want a little more oomph in flavor. I want to really taste the bean.

It's good, its doable, it isnt great. If the price is right I will buy it again. Anyone who has tried it in my household thinks it is fine; haven't heard any negatives. Some guests have been wowed. So yeh, it's all about preference.

Tastes fresh, brews fine, no coffee grounds or other annoyances. Perfectly good coffee, just not amazing. Yet, here I am considering ordering another box because the price per cup is reasonable ($0.39 w/ subscribe and save). We'll see.

title: mild chai that might not be strong enough for Chai lovers, but still makes good cuppa
text:
Medium sized box full of loose wrapped tea bags. I counted them out, all there plus an extra 3 bags.

I am reviewing Chai Green tea. This is not a strong chai, in fact it is quite mellow. I suppose stronger flavor with longer brew time or more bags. But I dont downrate for that because I find that it makes a good cup of tea.

Normally I buy flavored green tea or chai to help mask the sometimes off-putting flavor of green tea. And while this isn't super strong chai, it is really quite pleasant. I would recommend this for anyone who normally doesn't like green tea but wants to drink it for its health benefits.

I tend to really like Stash brand of teas. I am not brand loyal per say, but I have been drinking Stash on and off for a couple of decades.

You can see the list of ingredients in the product pictures.

title: pleasant deep dark flavor
text:
Clean, smooth, bold flavor. Nice layer of crema. I brew mine in my [[ASIN:B096BJJ1FG Instant Pod 3 in 1 brewer]], with zero hassle. Probably the easiest brew I have ever had with this brewer including using their own Instant brand capsules (same brand as Instant Pot). So something about the material used in these capsules makes for an easy brew and super clean taste.

Delicious brewed at 2 ounces, and holds up perfectly well at 4 ounces. Tastes more like regular coffee at 6 ounces, but still has that deep flavor. I rarely brew at 6 ounces. Mind as well grab a k-cup at that point.

Love just drinking this black, and for occasional use in a latte or other fancy drink.

I have tried a wide variety of Amazon Fresh capsules I prefer dark roasts, so this Ristretto Intenso and Espresso Intenso, as well as their decaff version are my favorites. But their light and medium roasts (espresso suave) are very nice too. All are pretty smooth, none are bitter, light roast has that tinge of acidity that is expected from a lighter roast. But not tangy or bitey.

Coffee is a personal thing, so it will come down to preference. I like this, you may not. Main thing to know is that the capsule material works extremely well in my brewer and the taste is fresh and clean.

For reference: I love dark bold coffee consumed black. My favorite capsules happen to be the Nespresso brand, any of the dark roasts including decaff (tastes the same as regular). But at $40 (or more) a pack these days, I only grab for those on occasion. I dont rate on price, but I will comment that the current $26 for this Amazon Fresh brand (even less with some promotions/coupons), that it is much more budget friendly as a daily drinker.

title: pleasing deep flavor as good as or better than their dark roast. Budget friendly over Nespresso
text:
Very good! I think they are close to flavor and mouth feel of the much pricier [[ASIN:B00US0M7GC Nespresso Arpeggio Decaffeinato capsules]], which I love but the price is now beyond my budget These work very well in my [[ASIN:B096BJJ1FG Instant Pod 3 in 1 machine]]. I'm already considering buying more. 5 stars!

Why decaff? I drink some regular dark black coffee in the morning, and once in awhile I still want a little coffee in the afternoon or a specialty drink, but I dont want/cant have the caffeine (super sensitive to it).

Or I use it to add volume to a regular cup of coffee without compromising taste. Kind of like a "halfsie"- use a regular cup of coffee and add in some decaff.

Finding a good decaff is such joy. Unlike some decaf options, this does not taste watered down. In fact, I think it has a bolder flavor over their regular [[ASIN:B09P1B3FPC caffeinated Ristretto Intenso Dark Roast capsules]].

Comes packaged in the typical 5 long tubes of 10 capsules, then all together are places into a branded box.

Much of this comes down to preference, so what I may like you may not, and visa versa. I like it and plan to buy more. I think the actual Nespresso brand is exquisite, but the rising prices ($40 for same amount compared to $26, and even less so with coupons and other savings!), makes me look at other brands such as this. I usually have nothing but good experiences with Amazon brands, and this is another I can add to list.

title: similar to other packet lentils, tasty, can eat hot or cold, for quick meal, emergency, camping, etc
text:
I have the Moroccan Lentil Stew. Good flavor from the spices, but a tad salty tasting. Still quite pleasantly flavorful, but noticeably salty. Says 2 servings, but I eat the whole container. So 1010 mg sodium, which is about same as a can of soup, and other packaged items of this ilk. The spices are good, but they repeat through the day (keep on tasting them). Not a brothy meal, but just enough base to allow it to pair nicely with rice or a big hunk of bread. Can be eaten hot or cold. Nice option for quick meals, emergency meals, camping meals, etc.

I absolutely adore lentils, and eat them regularly. I usually cook up my own batch, but I often reach for a prefab packet of flavored lentils. Price is on par with similar products (typically $3-5), albeit on the higher end of the range at $4.66 a packet. I don't rate on price anyway, especially given these food shortage/supplychain times. I tend to look for sales.Not sure if I would buy again at current price, but I definitely would on sale or w/ a coupon. I'm curious to try their other flavor options.

I like the flavor. I like them a little more than [[ASIN:B0007R9L4M TastyBite Indian Madras Lentils]] or [[ASIN:B07DWDCY6Y Fillo Peruvian Lentils]], but overall all about the same to me. Even the ingredients and nutritional profile tend to be similar, so for me this is when I do buy based on price (but I dont rate based on it).

I appreciate the clean ingredient list. 5 stars because I gave the other brands 5 stars, and this is on par or maybe a tish better than those.

Ingredients
Water, lentils, tomato, onion, extra virgin olive oil, sea salt, garlic, paprika, parsley, cumin, cilantro, ginger, turmeric, black pepper, coriander seed.

title: best buy date is printed on side of cup. Mine was dated for a full year out. Good flavor!
text:
I have the Basil Pesto option. I think it has plenty of flavor, and I am impressed with the generous amount of basil pesto sauce. Mild but tasty flavor. Can eat hot or cold. I have had it both ways, but I like it warmed up best.

This absolutely has an expiration/best buy date. So many reviews saying that it doesnt. It is directly on the cup. On mine, it is on the side of the cup. I purchased these in Jan of 2023, and it has a date of Jan 2024.

A lot of the scathing negative reviews are about the variety box, but there is no specific details provided. Tasteless? which ones? all of them, specific ones? Anyway, so as stated y review is for just the Quinoa & Pesto. In some of my meals I chopped up some proteins (either chicken or a vegetable burger) to add bulk and additional textural interest as the quinoa is a tad bland feeling in the mouth. This would be nice tossed onto a salad. Haven't been in the mood for salad, but I will set one aside for that. The pesto has enough oil to coat whatever it is mixed with.

title: pleasant flavor, easy to drink, check their website for much more detailed info
text:
I recommend checking out their website for much more thorough information on this product and the brand itself. There is a lot to read which help make sense of this product. I was otherwise confused.

Powdered formula that just gets added to your water. Drink day and night anytime and especially when dealing with extra stress, environmental or food toxins, etc. Supposed to reduce/eliminate toxins, and that we should see our pee turn more yellow as the toxins are eliminated.

Taste is pleasant. I normally prefer plain water, but will occasionally use an electrolyte as needed or when feeling run down. I like this for when I am feeling run down. I happen to be dealing with some big stress as well as not sleeping because of it, and so I have been trying to up my supplements (and so my pee will be a tad ore yellow anyway). I've just added this in, which has been perfect because I noticed that I wasnt drinking as much water as I normally do. So at the very least I am feeling more hydrated.

I'm starting off with 4 stars. I want to get through it all before making final determination. But so far so good and has pleasant taste. I am also using their variety pack of flavors, and I think any of them are pretty good.
