I usually buy five or six 6-packs at a time and then have them shipped using the pantry box. It works great, and the flavor is good.

title: Great for a Weight Loss
text:
I love the flavor of these waters. Just the splash of flavor makes it a whole lot easier to down the whole bottle than if they had no flavor. This is great for weight loss because drinking calories is the easiest way to gain weight (you ingest a lot of calories that you don't even notice). If you switch to only drinking water, watch the pounds peel off.

Also, I received this through Amazon Pantry shipping, so this is a cost effective way to live healthy. I believe the shipping charge on 5 units was 5.99. When buying water, the hardest part, for me anyway, is carrying the stuff from the grocery store to my house. Great solution...live healthy.

title: Taste Like a Leprechaun
text:
I should have known from the rainbow distress signal pulsating from the oddly ambiguous meat on the cover that this wasn't the real deal. After all, Unicorns are notoriously hard to catch, and when you skin 'em and fry 'em you end up with a kind of fluffy pink cloud like a marshmallow expanding over a flame.

Now Leprechaun meat, on the other hand, tastes just like regular meat (except for you hear bells jingling like Christmas as you chew it).

My little conspiracy theory is that they meant to sell Unicorn meat and ended up throwing the wrong label on the tin.

I don't know why they didn't pull the product from the shelves though. Leprechaun meat is way tougher to find than a common 'ol Unicorn. This would be like ordering a Radiant farms tin full of silver, and opening it up on arrival to discover a tin of gold.

That's why they're still getting 5 stars out of me. You don't look a gift unicorn in the hoof.

title: Absolutely amazing!!! I will be buying more! Not some keto nasty tasting stuff either!
text:
I'm not exaggerating at all, these are AMAZING and I will be buying more later! I don't know why anyone would NEED sugar in their smoked sausage sticks but this is proof that you really don't because they taste amazing without it! This doesn't taste like any of that weird keto diet junk either, it's sugar-free but tastes soooo good!

It has a great flavor and I'd say a pretty mild spice. If you're someone who doesn't like any spice at all you might not like it though.

title: Nice variety Mexican candy mix!
text:
This is a great candy kit with a variety of different flavors. It comes with so many different types of candies that you will want to try. The ingredients include a variety of flavors and the quality is amazing. This is a great way to explore Mexican sweets!

These candies are so unique and they taste so good. I love that the ingredients are all natural and safe for my family.

title: Amazing marinara sauce!
text: I love this sauce. I have never seen a sauce with this much depth of flavor. I like to make a big batch of this tomato marinara sauce and put it on pasta dishes, in sandwiches, and on pizza. This sauce is definitely going to be a staple in my kitchen and I highly recommend it to everyone.

title: Fresh skittles, taste amazing!
text: Skittles candy is a classic candy for many people. I love that you can buy this in bulk, in individual packs, and each pack comes with multiple flavors. These are perfect for parties, pinatas and more! I also love the fact that they are still a trusted brand and that the product is still being manufactured in the United States.

title: Pleasantly surprised, exactly like the ones in lucky charms!
text: I'm a little marshmallow snob and have tasted some of the off brand gross marshmallows- they're just not the same. These though? They taste exactly like the ones you get in Lucky Charms- same texture and flavor! I don't know if it's just me but I have a weird enjoyment of these little marshmallows in my cereal because of the slightly dry crunch to them. It's like a weird texture thing for me and these do the trick just like name brand ones from cereals! Very pleased with these and happy to have them, the cereal companies are stingy with them and I prefer a sprinkling more than what's included in a cereal box.

title: Everything in this is amazing!
text:
Everything in this is really good quality and tastes amazing! It came wrapped in plastic and had a red bow and that was put inside a nice box- very impressed with the presentation! A lot of these gift baskets use the cheapest quality chocolate and I'm a bit of a snob on chocolate so I can tell you without a doubt that all of the chocolate in this from the pretzels to the chocolate covered almonds- are high quality and taste amazing! The white chocolate pretzels are my favorite in this whole basket!

The basket is smaller, like the size of a larger piece of paper or diploma you see on a wall. I think it's a very tactful gift size as an overly large basket can be overkill sometimes. So if you need a conservative sized gift basket with high quality snacks- this is it!

title: Cute little truck, chocolate is so so
text: The chocolates in gold coins are dollar store quality- always. That being said, the metal armored truck was a nice touch and it's super adorable with it packed full of gold coins! I did eat a couple of the coins and maybe they're a small step up from brands like Palmer but it's not AMAZING and isn't even real chocolate FYI. That being said, they are edible and kids wouldn't notice the difference.

title: Arrived in good shape, all fresh and non melted!
text: These arrived in good shape, a few boxes were a little dented but it didn't hurt anything. They all taste fresh and amazing!

title: Pleasantly surprised- taste just like the sugared version to me!

title: These actually taste pretty decent!

text: These have a good flavor and seem to be a decent quality chocolate. They're very middle of the road average as far as quality and flavor. Nothing life changing for me personally, wouldn't buy again.

title: Very pretty but I think the price is outrageous!

title: They're edible and taste good, just not as good as other candies I love
text:
These aren't as good as actual saltwater taffy, they're not as good as laffy taffy, and they're not as good as Mamba candies. These are like a dollar store version of Mamba candy. They're good and they're edible but I much prefer the flavor of Mamba better. And the Mamba candy is much softer, these taffys in this bag are a bit chewier and harder to chew.

For the price, they're not terrible. They'd be good filler for something like a Pinata and kids certainly wouldn't mind the off brand candy either.

title: 5 stars for flavor, the price is a bit much though.
text:
Considering how little you get in each of these bags, the price is a little excessive. That being said- these are all really good! I didn't care for the wasabi peas so just pulled those out but other than that I loved these! The mix bag had several different things in it and they were all good. The original flavor is my favorite though, hoping they sell that in bigger bags. The wasabi one is okay, just not my personal favorite.

Overall these are good quality super cute little bottle-shaped bags and would look adorable in a gift basket for someone.

My only complaint is that my favorite is the red ones and they have very little of that color in there. It could just be that I got a bag that had very little though, other bags might have more.

title: Really good tasting!!
text:
These taste really good! You never know what you'll get in things like this but these are tasty and I highly recommend them!

Sensitive stomach people:
I have IBS and who knows what else- things like strawberries cause warfare in my intestines and make me sick for like a whole day. That being said, I love fruit leathers and wanted to try these so I got it and halfway thru eating it, I decided I should take it easy so saved the other half of one for later. Next day and my stomach is still doing fine. I have the other half and it's still great. So apparently these work with sensitive stomachs if you don't overdo it. I don't dare eat a whole one, it's a lot of compressed fruit in there.

title: If a Twix and a Nestle Crunch had a baby- it'd be these. Pretty tasty!

Love the crunchy texture of these and the flavors are amazing, no complaints at all here! Size wise they look about the size of a Snickers bar and considering there are 12 in the box- $10 isn't a bad price at all! The flip-top box protects them well for shipping too, they arrived in perfect shape! Will definitely be getting more of these!

title: Good chips#

title: Very sturdy and well made bag!  For brining, not putting in the oven.
text: These are a game changer for brining a turkey- traditionally I put them in a crazy large dish to do that and it never worked out great. This works out perfectly and it didn't leak in my fridge at all while I was brining some chicken before I put them in the rotisserie grill.

title: Very convenient and tastes great
text:
This stuff tastes amazing and my guests have all loved it! Definitely a game changer to be able to offer a good quality cocoa with no real wait time or effort to make it.

The flavor is rich and creamy and tastes amazing with marshmallows and a touch of milk.

title: Just like I remember them!
text: Old people used to hand these out to us when we were kids and I loved the taste of them! It's been over 30 years since I'd had one and they're just like I remember them. No complaints at all!

title: Taste just like jelly belly and these come in an adorable jar!
text:
The jar is adorable and these taste amazing! My only complaint is the random coffee and licorice- not my faves at all and I can't really tell them from some of the others sadly so I end up eating those when trying out the flavors in this jar.

Overall I am very happy with these, they're very soft and have an amazing flavor. 100% taste like jelly belly.

title: This was great for making marinara/ pasta sauce
text: I hate store bought sauces because I can't have a lot of any oil and even if they do use olive oils in them, it still makes them too oily for me and it gives me terrible heartburn and makes me sick. So I got this and figured we'd try our hand at making our own sauce with very little oil. We did this and it tastes fantastic and doesn't make me sick like the store bought junk. These tomatoes are a very good quality and have a great flavor to them- will be buying more!

title: Flavorful rub that's not packed full of salt
text: This rub isn't packed full of salt like some but it's still plenty flavorful and was a big hit at the party we just had. Several people had me send them the link to this because they loved the seasoning so much. Great quality tasty stuff!

title: Really good flavor seasoning, I love it!
text: My favorite part is it being light on salt- I can't tolerate the taste of a lot of salt when foods are just drenched in it so the lighter salt is welcomed. The flavor of this is very good and it was a big hit at the family get together where everyone tried it. There were no leftovers at all, it all got eaten up!

title: Good tasting candy
text: Good tasting candy. Not like anything I know of here in America. Getting six of these, they lasted a pretty long time. Didn't really come off as sour to me at all. These were enjoyable and I wouldn't mind getting more. The plastic case they come in is fairly sturdy, and I'm reusing them to hold stuff because they are cute.

title: Loved them all of course!
text: I love all pringles and loved this variety pack! All of the chips were fresh and tasty. They didn't get broke up into pieces in shipping either which is very nice. No complaints at all, I love these pringles!

title: Nice assortment of candies
text: This is a nice assortment of various name-brand candies. All were fresh and the assortment was what you see in the pictures so what you see is what you'll be getting. Some of these mixed bags that's not the case but this one pictured it pretty well and is honest about that which is nice.

title: Tasted terrible, nothing like sonic's cherry limeades!
text: Sadly this didn't taste good at all and tasted nothing like sonic cherry limeades. Wouldn't buy these again at all.

title: Great tasting gum, I love it!
text: Has a nice strong cinnamon twist but no bitter sugar free bite to it. Tastes great and the flavor lasts a while! Absolutely love this gum!

title: Tasty and not greasy at all!
text: These aren't gross and greasy like some of those others out there in gas stations. These are thicker and so so tasty! These are very good quality beef sticks and I will be buying a lot more in the future!! I love these because they don't give me heartburn like the cheap greasy ones.

title: Good taste, great for tea!
text:
Great for adding a little kick to your tea. Not super hot but it has a little spice to it. If you want to make it even hotter you can add some cayenne to it. Honey, cayenne, and lemon is my grandma's homemade throat remedy and this honey flavor make a great syrup for that too!

Pretty good honey and it arrived in good shape.

title: Good for adventurous foodies
text:
These candies aren't like American candies and will taste a bit different fyi. That being said, none of them were nasty and they're all edible at least. I get bored of constantly eating the same foods so this is a nice break in that, a chance to try some foreign and exotic candies.

It's fun but like I said, don't expect it to taste like American candy, it just doesn't somehow.

title: Cheaper quality but tastes ok
text: So if you're used to brachs saltwater taffy, this is a downgrade in quality. It's sticker and not as firm. It has a decent flavor to them but texture wise, I'm not super impressed. Price wise it's terrible, I can get Brachs bulk saltwater taffy much cheaper pretty much anywhere else. Not too impressed with this at all.

title: Perfect combo of sweet and salty!
text: I don't know what magic this is but this popcorn has the same light crunch that fresh popcorn has. It absolutely is amazing and tastes like it was made fresh! It's the perfect mixture of sweet and salty! Tastes amazing!

title: Delicious
text: Not quite as good as the originals, but healthier. Still very tasty though, and I would absolutely buy them again. Everyone that tried some really liked them. I like that they came with a bag that zips up, to keep them fresh longer, without me having to put them into one myself.

title: Best healthy snack I've found so far
text: Not as tasty as the unhealthy cookies these replace. Been eating healthier so I live longer and have better health but I have hated most of the healthy food I've tried. These are actually good, so far the best healthy snack replacer I've found. Very crunchy, still have a little bit of a sweet taste to them. Not bad at all.

title: Great flavor, easy to use!
text: I love the convenience of these and the flavor is amazing! I don't even go out and get coffee since I discovered these! Saves me a ton of time and money.

title: Absolutely revolting... Leaves a nasty taste in your mouth!
text:
My boyfriend tried one when it came in and told me they started off good but within seconds it turns bitter tasting and then that bitter taste lasts for several minutes. So I tried one because I love anything lemon and was hopeful still. He was 100% right - they do start off with a nice lemon flavor and then within seconds they turn bitter and disgusting! I think it's the stevia plus whatever junk they added.

My advice to the company? Lemon tastes amazing on it's own, go with a lemon flavor and light sugar and stick with that. Ditch the fross stevia and other junk in it, these things are revolting as is.

title: Addictive and yummy, a little sticky for dental work.
text:
These are very flavorful and yummy! They have a soft nice texture but they stick to my dental work a bit because of that. Nothing too bad though, it's worth the trouble for good tasting fruit snacks!

These definitely aren't flavorless like some out there, these have a bold good flavor to them!

title: Pricey but taste good. Not overly sweet.
text: These aren't sweet really but they still taste good. I ate one by itself and it has a good flavor/ is very crunchy.  Very fresh and very well packaged. No smashed up pieces. Overall I'm very happy with these, I personally wouldn't pay that much for something like this but if the price doesn't scare you off, they're worth it.

title: Taste great, price isn't so great
text: If you buy these tootsie rolls anywhere else, I think you'll end up paying about $5 a pound so this price point isn't really great. It's charging about double since there are 2 pounds here and that'd cost you about $10 elsewhere. That being said- they are fresh, well bagged, and taste great so if you live in an area where tootsie rolls or scarce or you need to order them by mail then I suppose the upcharge for shipping would be worth it. It's not the WORST deal you could find out there, just not the best one either.

title: Flavorful and high quality
text: The hot pepperoni was the best. I really wish I had more. The other two were also really good. The price is pretty decent when considering how many you are getting. It was really the nicest meat sticks I've ever had. I'm glad I gave them a try; normally the ones you buy at the supermarket are greasy and gross. These were really high quality. I will absolutely continue buying from this brand.

title: Tastier than jawbreakers brand!
text:
These are so much better than the jawbreakers brand! 5 good flavors that all taste amazing! They're flavored on the outside and white centers. Good size of they're not tiny but not too large.

Don't know what happened but the last few jawbreakers brand jawbreakers I had tasted weird and almost like soap! So definitely go with this brand!

title: Tastes pretty good!
text: This isn't the BEST flavor out there but it's not cheap garbage you'd find at Walmart either. It's an upper mid level flavor. We used this in slushes and they turned out really good! We added some vodka and they were perfect then! Definitely don't try with rum, that was terrible. 😂

title: Kind of gritty and the flavor is gross. Nothing like poptarts.
text: These were nothing like regular poptarts and were very gritty and nasty. The flavor wasn't good at all. Not happy with these in the least bit and I got this case of them for free!

title: Kind of pricey for lightly coated and lightly flavored cashews
text: Cashews aren't an expensive nut so I feel like the price point is a little up there for what it is. These are lightly coated and have a very light flavor to them. I'm not happy with them at all really. Someone that doesn't need a lot of sweetness or flavor would enjoy these though.

title: Fit my snocone syrup, work great!
text: These fit my snocone syrup bottles and work great- I love them! Decently made and seem to be pretty sturdy.

title: Revolting tasting!
text: These were so gross we couldn't even finish one. Donated the rest to the food bank in hopes someone else might enjoy them. Neither of us did in our house though!

title: YUM! Love this!!!
text: We had a lot of fun making rice krispies treats among other things with these! They were a huge hit at a bake sale- we gave samples and once people tried the rice krispies treat, they had to buy a tray! For eating with milk, these are great too! Will definitely be buying more!

title: A hotter jerky, tastes okay
text: Not my favorite jerky but it's a decent spicy jerky. It's average in taste, I probably won't buy more of it but someone else might love it.

title: Absolutely REVOLTING. Just gross tasting!
text: This doesn't even taste like food, it's just chemical nastiness! Don't do it!

title: Great versatile frosting! Great for brownies, cakes, smores, etc!
text: We used this on a batch of brownies, on a cake, and in some smores and all of them turned out great! Great quality frosting with a good flavor, we love this stuff!

title: Dunno where they got cheesecake from, doesn't taste like it at all.
text: This doesn't taste like cheesecake at all. Tastes like chocolate chip cookie dough made with bitter chocolate and no sugar in the batter... Very bland and not great. There's no nasty aftertaste like in some of the fiber bars at least but they're still not great. Overpriced tiny little bars.

title: Instructions were confusing to us...
text:
The instructions were very confusing- they called the chocolate chips "topping"and the little tube of chocolate- "filling." Normally the little tubes like this are to be drizzled over things but this one is the "filling."

If you can get past the confusing directions then these are decent cookies!

title: They're good. Not super sweet but good!
text: These are really good but they are semi-bland without having a ton of honey or sugar but they are good quality snack bars and a healthier alternative. Just know that this doesn't taste like a full sugar bar at all and if you're fine with that, you'll love these!

title: SO GOOD!!! Tastes like it's made with fresh cheese!
text:
I don't know what they did to this stuff but you put the cheese powder in and it quickly thickens up to where it's like it's made with fresh cheese! Same consistency and everything! Kraft mac n cheese is always just watery but not this stuff!!

I have a 1,000 watt microwave and it took 4 1/2 minutes to cook 2 of these cups at once so we could each test one out. We first poured the water in the cup to the fill line, then we stirred it, microwaved it, and added the cheese. Stirred it vigorously to mix the cheese well. It seems like the cheese isn't mixing well and it looks lumpy but it sorts itself out and tastes just fine!

Overall I'm VERY impressed with this, it tastes amazing- almost like homemade mac n cheese! Will definitely be getting more!

**Update: Ongoing problem with all of them is I always fill the water line the same and some of them come out pretty soupy. I have noticed if you let it cool though, it gets plenty thick enough. The other problem is that these all boil over while cooking no matter if you leave the plastic top on or take it off. SO put this on a plate or something to cook it so it'll catch the boiling over liquids.

title: We love these!! Very good flavor!
text: The flavor of these is very good and the little shapes are adorable! No kids in this house but us adults love gummies and these all taste great! Good quality snack in a cute little pouch. No complaints at all!

title: Amazing company! These tasted amazing too!
text:
These taste absolutely AMAZING. I'd say if you're a person who loves the crunchy part of a brownie then you'll love these! They don't taste burnt but they are absolutely crunchy and amazing tasting. I had no idea these would taste so good and these didn't last as long as they should have in my house! Will be buying more for sure!

There was a problem with the delivery of these, we didn't receive them sadly but this company made it right and sent out a replacement right away which they didn't have to do at all. They went above and beyond in my books and I'm very happy with them!

title: Nice variety of stuff here!
text: Really enjoyed this variety of fruits and nuts! Very nice range of stuff in this and it all tastes great!

title: Love this stuff!
text: I love this more than lucky charms! Very yummy cereal! It's Frosted Flakes with lucky charm type marshmallows.

title: This seasoning is AMAZING!
text: This is the most fragrant amazing seasoning you'll ever find! I got it in and you can SMELL the seasonings very strongly thru the jar. I have used this on a few different cuts of meat and they all turned out amazing with this! Everyone who's tried my meat loves it with this on it!

title: Has a good flavor
text: The flavor on this one's not too light and not too strong so I like that. Definitely tastes like strawberry watermelon. Happy with these drink pouches and will be buying more.

title: LOVED these!
text: Loved this big bag of candies. Dunno if they're Mike and Ike branded or what but they taste just like them and I loved them! Great quality candy.

title: Amazing great quality stuff!
text:
Was hesitant to try this, I'm a jerky snob and don't like cheaper jerky so never know what I'm getting with a new brand! BUT this one surprised me, it's great stuff! I could barely stop myself from eating as whole little bag in one sitting!

Texture wise, it's pretty soft and easy to chew. It isn't dry at all but not greasy or anything either. The smaller pieces easily lodge between my teeth so I just run my wayerpik on them for a bit and knock the pieces out.

Overall I was very surprised by this and definitely recommend it!

title: This candy box is a lot of fun! Some of it wasn't great though....
text:
SO the long flat "brain bitz chew" bars that look like laffy taffy, they're good up til you taste the weird menthol minty crystals in them! It tastes good upfront but leaves a mint taste in your mouth that is gross for being with sweet candy.

The brain breakerz and sour candy crunch balls are in different packs but what I received were 100% identical in flavor and everything. Both of them have a harder shell you can't just eat at first. If you put it in your mouth for a little bit, you can then bite into it and then the center is sour. But all 3 little boxes plus the bigger brain breakerz box were the same.

Sour chew sticks are my favorite- they're like a sour laffy taffy stick. They are a little harder to chew so if you have something like TMJ, you won't want these- made my jar start popping. :(

The sour nerd like candy- they honestly look like plastic balls and were weird to look at but they actually taste pretty good!

The suckers are pretty good, all good flavors.

Bottom line- this came packaged in a fun box and it was a blast to try all the different things! They have each pack labeled with what level of sour they are which is cool. The only reason I took away two stars is that four boxes with different labels were the same thing really. That issues plus the nasty chew bar that had the mint taste- remove the weird crystals and these things will be perfect! The sour chew sticks would be nicer if they were chewier like laffy taffy rather than really tough and hard to chew. Overall this kit has potential, just needs some fine-tuning!

title: They're not bad but just different. Not what I'm used to tasting in a gummy!
text:
It says these are English style so maybe I can't properly compare these to anything of the sort. But comparing these to regular gummies you'd find in the US- they are NOTHING like that. These have cornstarch in them which makes them not see thru but also kind of adds a texture to them. Regular gummies are perfectly smooth but these have an almost light but not quite gritty texture. It's very weird for me!

Taste-wise I think they taste okay. I was planning on picking out the wine flavor ones as I don't like wine but they actually taste as good as the others. These are lightly sweet and have decent flavors. They require less force and chewing than regular gummies which isn't a bad thing unless you just love the chewing aspect. For people who can't chew with a lot of force, these are great. They seem to be really good quality. Very good thick packaging with a tear top and a resealable bag.

If you like this style of gummy then I'm sure you'll like these! Personally, I wouldn't buy them again but I'm set in my ways and love the chewy gummies. It's not a reflection on the quality of this product, just not crazy about the weird cornstarch stuff in it for the most part.

title: These are AMAZING! And the price point isn't that bad.
text: I got these thinking they'd be like crunchy waffle cones but they're actually slightly softer. Not like mushy soft but a bit softer than a waffle cone, they don't crunch. We had a little taste test party and I tried the caramel vanilla first and instantly was in love! It has a gooey caramel center and the taste of it is just divine! Truly been a while since any food has impressed me this much! The other flavors are all amazing too and everyone will love their own flavors but for me- hands down the caramel vanilla is my fave! I looked at the company store on Amazon to find out you can buy 12 packs of one flavor and a giant box of mini ones! I think this is the beginning of a beautiful relationship, I'll definitely be ordering more of these!!!

title: Great quality chocolate bunnies!
text: Very adorable chocolate bunnies. Definitely quality chocolate, it tastes amazing! I love the individual wrapping.

title: Kinda fancy, definitely nothing lemon about this though! It's a fizzing berry drink.
text:
The most disappointing part is this isn't "lemonade" as there's no real amount of lemon in it. It says citric acid but there's no taste or cloudiness that'd suggest it has any real amount of lemon to it. The company says it's part of a sparkling lemonade line when someone asked them about this so I guess they don't mind confusing people for some reason. I say for sake of confusion- just call it a berry drink!

The lemonade part aside, the presentation of the bottle is great- thick glass, nice lid, easy to open. VERY fizzy drink. It tastes like super fizzy berry drink, not like that La Croix flavorless junk. So if you enjoy berry flavor, you'll love this! They need to work on the packing though... I'd say to shrink wrap it in plastic or something cause the current system is a little crazy- my case was all busted up inside the Amazon box. I didn't detract from that in this review, just an observation/ note for the seller that their current box system isn't gonna work out for shipping.

This comes in at $5.41 a bottle currently and I think mainly you're paying for a fancy glass bottle and then the shipping on a huge case of heavy glass. And I say heavy because I mean I could barely lift the case myself- it's insane! Value-wise though, it's OK but not great. I feel like being in glass bottles just makes it seem fancier but it'd taste the same in plastic. I think in glass they are able to pull off super carbonating it though where plastic might explode.

Overall it's a nice quality drink and the price for a case of 12 huge bottles really isn't terrible. So if you wanna be fancy, go for it! Anyone who enjoys anything berry flavor and lots of bubbles will love this!

title: Decent flavor, kinda hard to use though.
text:
I personally think these would have been better off made a gel and put in a squeeze tube. The ball is kinda hard to turn to get the liquid candy out. It is liquid enough though, you can just squeeze it over your tongue and it comes out though.

Flavor wise- they are actually pretty decent! I'm an adult who doesn't like just nasty sugar flavored generic things so I was glad to find out that these actually have a decent quality flavoring and each of them taste like what their flavor should taste like. They taste very good!

title: These taste amazing!! Nutrition facts say it has 1.04 servings...
text:
I've only ever had apple juice or apple cider so I have nothing to compare this to... But having never had pressed apples- I was very impressed! I chilled these, shook one up, and drank it all pretty quickly. It was so yummy I didn't really wanna wait to drink the rest! The flavor is great and even though there's no added sugar, it's still PLENTY sweet from natural sugars. Which FYI- the sugar content is still fairly high but that's just fruit in general, can't help that. Just saying to drink these as an occasional treat. Overall I'm just very impressed!!!

These come in at about $3.50 a bottle which I thought is kind of pricey considering its apples (aka one of the cheapest fruits.) Each of these bottles says they have around .75 lbs of apple in them which comes to 9 pounds worth of apple that you get. SO depending on the cost of the apples they used... If a person used apples from the store, I estimate it'd run you up to $20 worth of apples. I guess add in glass bottles, labels, shipping, and whatever costs to bottle... I guess I can see the price honestly.

title: Passing off Christmas candy as St Patricks day... Not solid but you do get the advertised 12 oz.
text:
The streamer coming out of this that's wrapped completely around the chocolate says "Merry Kissmas" and is from Christmas. (Hence the red and green color options) Other than that I think the "solid" milk chocolate means it's made out of pure milk chocolate but this thing is definitely hollow. I pulled out the kitchen scale and you get the advertised 12 ounces so I don't feel like that's a scam at all, just a misunderstanding.

Flavor-wise of course, it's the same milk chocolate from Hershey that we know and love! My only complaint is the holiday streamer thing in it- if they're gonna reuse this for different holidays then the packaging and sayings should be holiday neutral in my opinion, otherwise, it's not very giftable at all unless you wanna open it and rip the paper streamer out.

title: Very yummy! Price is a little steep but it is a huge tub of pretzels so maybe it's worth it!
text:
The price is a little steep in my opinion but it is a huge tub so considering how yummy they are, I think it could be worth it if this is in your budget! Recently I reviewed some $50 gourmet pretzels that weren't impressive at all but came in a fancy box... So price doesn't always equal quality but in this case, the pretzels are great and the chocolate tastes nice! I'm not a huge chocolate snob but I can't eat the nasty generic chocolate you find at dollar stores. This chocolate definitely isn't that cheap stuff! May not be GOURMET but it is pretty good!

As far as the people complaining about the seal on top, I heard mine pop up a bit as I twisted the lid. I think shipping loosens them and the company needs to find a way to better seal them. Mine were still plenty fresh and I see no signs that anyone put arsenic in it or anything. Haha. I'm not overly paranoid so I ate them and lived- they're good and plenty fresh too!

title: Good portion size, huge box, very yummy!
text:
Flavor is the same as what I know and love. No surprise there at all. They are YUMMY!! The little squares are a good portion size and they all come in a huge box. Very convenient for snacks to go. With Valentines coming up- they'd make a great little Valentines treat too!

Very pleased with these, perfect 5 stars from me!

title: Pricey, strange almost plastic taste to these
text:
I don't know what I'm tasting but there's a strange almost plastic aftertaste. Other than that the box is presented neatly. The happy birthday thing is strange but it comes off if you don't want to gift it with that on there. The presentation is great- 5 stars for presentation. 2 stars for flavor as they are edible, just not amazing. Price could be more like $20 or $30, the $50 is kind of steep.

Overall I think they're okay but if someone was buying them for me, I'd rather have the $50. I personally think flavor-wise, the Flipz pretzels are MUCH better and at a fraction of the price. Grab a bag of those, put them in a cute box with some other stuff and you have a cute giftbox that tastes better for a fraction of the price.

title: Great quality, fair price.
text:
Great quality almonds. Taste great!

If you love almonds and coconut then you'll love these! If you don't LOVE coconut then I suggest skipping them as the coconut is very prominent in these. I say this because I know some people slightly like coconut or tolerate it- this stuff isn't for those people!

title: Not impressed and I love everything sweet
text:
I love candy but these just weren't great at all. The 3 flavors were edible but the berry one was revolting and of course, that's the one they put like 3 of them in there. It was very bitter and disgusting. The others weren't AMAZING but they were edible.

The package is ridiculous and it's impossible to get the candy out, it feels like a toy puzzle... For kids who need something to fidget with it might be good though.

Overall I think these are pricey for how little you get, the flavor leaves much to be desired, and the packaging is terrible. I won't be buying them again.

title: MOTHS sealed in the bags from the factory -tastes like dollar store milano cookies too
text:
I ate one of these before seeing the moths as I was excited to test them. Luckily the ONE cookie was moth free at least. It tastes like a Milano knock-off. Like the Milano oval chocolate-filled cookies- like that but not as good and WAY overpriced. You get like 10 cookies that are maybe just over an inch big. Small! They then put them in plastic and wrap them in some really loose colored paper to make them look bigger. All of these cookies could fit in your hand if you unwrap them.

The moths- so the cookie tin had the lid on and was taped on from the factory. The tin itself has NO traces of the moths or their poops. But then I open the sealed inner plastic bag that was airtight and 9 of the 10 wrappers had moths, cocoons, and moth poops in them. Just sickening.

title: Tastes really good- the strawberry watermelon is shipping out expired
text: The strawberry watermelon I received is expired. Still, I tested it as it was dated this month and it tastes amazing still! Dates aside it's a great energy drink that doesn't give me the jitters or anything! No nasty bitter taste like some have.

title: Great quality darker/ bitter chocolate
text:
At its current price this is $7.50 a bar which isn't a bad price for the quality you're getting. It's definitely a darker/ more bitter chocolate but if you like dark chocolate then that's not a bad thing. It's not overly sweet tasting. Personally, I couldn't taste caramel that much over the bitterness and the salt. The chocolate is definitely a good quality- not some cheap waxy stuff like you find in the stores.

Overall I'm impressed. I'm not a huge fan of dark chocolate or salted anything but I'm pretty impressed with this! I think I'm going to knock it into chunks and use it for baking and it'll make some amazing chocolate chip cookies I suspect!

title: I feel like I got catfished- that picture is seriously misleading on portion sizes (which are TINY)
text:
SO for starters the chocolate in the picture shows like 9 or 10 pieces- they include a measly 5 squares. Now the chocolate actually DOES taste really good and isn't super cheap tasting so there's that! But you open the box and there's 5 little squares and the box is mostly empty in that one. Then you have the little chips it shows- you get a 1 oz bag of pita chips. They taste good but it's a tiny handful and they're all smushed up. The saltwater taffy box is half full, they all seem to be fresh and taste of good quality- my guess is they're probably name brand like Brachs. the cookies were a single tiny 2 oz bag of Famous Amos cookies- a good name brand but it just seems goofy somehow. The cookies do taste great, it's one of my favorite brands. I dunno though, for the price you'd think it'd have 2 bags of the cookies. Then you have the caramel corn, I weighed it with the bag and it's 3.2 oz and it's not that big of a bag at all! That one's the biggest box! The caramel corn is decent tasting though.

So overall I think this is a horrible value for the small portions. Even if they put some crinkled decorative paper in there- at least it'd feel like they put in more of an effort. You could go to a dollar store and fill a bag with snacks and get far more for the same amount of money so I don't really recommend this gift basket set.

title: Love these!
text:
These arrived in mostly good shape, I was surprised because this kind of candy breaks so easily! But 10 out of 12 came in flawless shape. 2 of them had minor breaks.

The color is vivid and beautiful, the flavor is pretty much sugar flavor like cotton candy is. They're still really good though and I enjoy them a lot! At just over a dollar a lollipop, it's not a bad deal! These aren't "large" by any means though- they're medium sized at best.

title: Amazing! A case is a lot for the common person though!
text: A case of this concentrated stock is a LOT for smaller households so hopefully when I go thru it all I can find it in stores! We LOVE this though- it makes really good flavorful stock! We've used it in many things including a crock pot roast that turned out amazing! Truly a great quality product!

title: Not the best not the worst
text:
These weren't DISGUSTING but they just weren't that great. They definitely taste slightly sweet but they almost taste like unsweetened fake candy somehow. There's no level of sour at all. I don't taste a lot of watermelon flavor either.

Some people might like these but I won't be purchasing more and the ones we have are getting eaten very slowly as no one really loves them in this house.

title: Super fresh peppercorns!
text: You can smell how fresh these are- they smell amazing! We filled our mini grinder and have used this pepper many times now- it's been great on food and in cooking and tastes amazing! Very flavorful quality pepper!

title: Great set of sauces and rub!
text:
I'm not BBQ expert- I'm still learning all of this myself so I'll review this in common people's perspective!
The rub come in a huge bottle and tastes great on any kind of meat you put it on, not just pork! I don't know how to describe the taste honestly but out of all the rubs I've tried- this is easily one of my favorites now! You should definitely try this!

The sauces are all great- I love having a variety as everyone has different tastes. I did a cookout with friends and everyone enjoyed a different sauce but the consensus of everyone was that we all really enjoyed the sauce! I had to send a product link out to a few of them because they wanted to order a set after trying it! So that's definitely something! I'm partial to head country sauce myself (Oklahoman here) but this is a good sauce too! I like to branch out and use others for sake of variety and not burning myself out. I'll definitely be adding a bottle of this sauce to my cabinet every now and again after having tasted it! I personally think the original is the best but each of the sauces brings something different to the table!

Have a cookout and test this set out!

title: AMAZING caramels!
text: These are each wrapped in little brown wrappers that look very homemade and cute. The texture of them is very smooth and slightly sticky. Not tough at all like those store bought square ones in the clear wrappers. The pumpkin spice taste in this is pretty light/ not heavy at all which I love. The taste is just amazing/ very gourmet in my opinion! Definitely worth the price!

title: Amazing flour
text: Made several recipes with them and the flour did great in so of them! This great quality flour results in great quality food that tastes amazing!

title: Bag of messy crumbles
text: We got a bag of messy crumbles... The flavor was okay, had a spicy after kick that was fairly strong. My biggest complaint is there were no pieces in the bag, just tiny crumbles. It was like what you get at the bottom of a beef jerky bag.

title: Loved all of these!
text: Great snack box, all arrived in good shape and tasted amazing! Loved them all! Great quality product!

title: Not bad! Just watch out if you have IBS- sweetened with sugar alcohols...
text:
This has a sugar alcohol- erythritol and it may not do well for people with IBS. That being said, that sweetener is lower on the list of the "tol" artificial sweeteners that are offensive to IBS.

Taste wise these aren't half bad! No sharp sugar free bite to them which is nice. But also no "sweet" candy taste if that's what you are looking for. I don't know where they get "sour" from, these aren't sour at all. I have a lower tolerance to sour things in general and this candy didn't really register as sour for me. These weren't bursting with flavor but they're not bland either, they have some flavor to them and taste okay.

Bottom line, if you're looking for a candy alternative- this could work for you but it's not sweet so I don't know if it'd satisfy your sweet tooth. It's not so gross you have to toss it out at least like some!

title: Yummm!
text: These taste AMAZING! Been giving a cup of it to guests that show up and everyone loves it across the board! Smells and tastes amazing! I pair it with almond milk creamer and it makes it that much better!

If you're a foodie or just want a fun food adventure- grab this box and give them all a try! I enjoyed all of the foods in this box, no duds in my opinion.

Some were just fantastic, some were about average in taste. At any rate it's just a lot of fun sampling all of these snacks I've never seen!

None of which I can find at any stores near me so it's nice to try these for sake of trying something different! None of the snacks were just horrid and inedible. I like some less than others but they were all edible and some were AMAZING! Definitely a fun variety box!

title: Lots of fun, love this!

title: Easy but has a different texture

title: Difficult for me to review as I've never tried crystallized ginger but read on...
text:
SO I love ginger in recipes but I'd never tried ginger chunks like this. The big bag arrived and it smells something like lemon lysol. I don't know what I expected chemical smelling food to taste like but it tastes the same to me. It tastes STRONG and nasty. But I gave this a 5 star rating because a friend told me she had the exact same experience with another brand. So I'm guessing it's across the board, you love it or hate it. The taste is just insanely strong! It's kind of stringy and tough. I just don't like it as is. I got it to try to see if it'd help with some of my digestive issues/ upset stomachs so I think I'll keep the bag and force a piece down here and there and see if it helps.

It does seem like it's good quality, well packaged. I think I'll find some recipes to try it in too. I'd say if you've tried crystallized ginger and love it, this is good quality! But if you've never tried it, maybe try to find a cheaper smaller bag before you jump onto the $20 bag to find out you didn't like it.

title: Overpriced and just not great
text: These have a really weird texture to them, like all of them. i'm not crazy about an of them, especially the nasty apple rings. If you're looking for a good low sugar/ healthier candy- this isn't it. Yuck

title: Pretty tasty!

We've done nachos with them, added ground beef and rotel, put the cheese on tacos, burritos, quesadillas, all sorts of fun creations we've done with these! We even dipped taquitos in them! Just amazing for all of the above! It's been a lot of fun finding creative ways to use these up! Definitely recommend these!

I've had a couple of different jerky flavors from other brands in the past that I threw out from being so gross. At least if you don't LOVE this, it's probably still edible.

On the spices- it doesn't taste spicy at first but by the time I finished two pieces my mouth was heating up! Good level of spice to it which is nice.

text:
I tested the pancakes on my husband. It might have been my cooking technique, but they weren't very appealing to look at. Of course, they have a lot of chocolate in them, so they were brown, not golden, but brown. He soldiered on, though, and found them quite tasty. I think the next time I make them, I'll combine the mix half and half with buckwheat or another pancake mix. I need to try some waffles too.

One of the problems I had, I think, was making the batter too thin. We are at an altitude, so that can be a problem. You may have to experiment a bit to get the consistency right, but as my husband said, these are very tasty pancakes, and healthy too.

title: A more convenient way to use dates
text:
Many healthy recipes call for dates. They add fiber and nutrients as well as complex flavor to otherwise sinful home-baked goodies.

Unfortunately, pits have to be removed. Then they usually need to be chopped up and they are gooey. Experienced date-users don't mind, but I am lazy and find myself substituting easier sweeteners. Enter these convenient jars of deliciousness. Just use what you need, put the lid back on, and save the rest for your next baking session.

I'm enjoying one jar and sending the other to my daughter for Christmas. They are great for gift-giving. (or you can use them to make tons of goodies and then give those.)

I have tried all three in pasta dishes and chili. My husband couldn't even tell they were there. I recommend matching colors. The spinach is best in beefy dishes. I didn't try it in hamburgers, meatballs, or meatloaf, but I think it would be great for that. If you have time and fresh veggies, of course you can make your own puree in the food processor or blender, but this is for those many times when you don't. I plan on keeping a box around. title: Pure and fantastic winter defense in a jar
text:
If you haven't been living under a rock you have probably heard about the health benefits of coconut oil. It softens your hair, moistens your skin, cures your cuticle problems, and smells delicious, which brings up its other virtues. You can cook with it. It's a great substitute for butter or shortening in muffins and other baked goods. I love it on sweet potatoes.

There are many coconut oils on the market. For purity, this one from Viva Labs cannot be beat. It is certified organic and GMO-free. It is, as some have mentioned, hard at room temperature, but it has such a low melting temperature that it dissolves on your skin. If you make your own cosmetics, you will want to add a jar to your kit.

title: I expected better
text:
I am really disappointed with this cookie house kit. I expected much more. I am not a novice to cookie house making. I have built a gingerbread house with my son every Christmas for many, many years. I thought I was up to the task with this. I was wrong.

Problems:
- Pieces don't fit properly leaving gaps
- Slanted sides made gravity your enemy in trying to get the sides to stick to the front and back pieces.
- Build icing isn't sticky enough and doesn't harden quick enough so everything falls apart.
- Not enough mini cookies to cover the roof.

Trying to put this together was an exercise in futility. I finally did it, but it looked AWFUL! The cookie house pieces don't fit the grooves in the base so I couldn't use the base at all. The sides are too short, leaving a hole over an inch and a half in the side of your house. The build icing isn't sticky enough so it doesn't hold. The mini cookies kept sliding off of the roof, the sides kept falling away from the front and back. The sides are slanted, so gravity pulls them down and makes them fall off. I resorted to holding everything together with ribbons and rubber bands...which worked, but the hold was very flimsy. The house fell apart with the slightest movement. I wanted to use the cookie pieces to tile the roof, but there wasn't enough, so it looked dumb.

I did make a cute little cookie, but that was poor compensation for the headache that trying to build the house had become. So, I just broke it down and ate it. At least it tastes good. :D

I expected better. It was very poorly designed and is not worth the trouble. If you want to make a cookie house, buy the Oreos, use REAL royal icing and make gingerbread for your house pieces. You will have more success.
