You wind up with high quality vanilla extract for much cheaper than you can buy it in the store, with no stringent off tastes. I recommend this.

title: Delicious!
text: I wasn't sure what to expect with this, but I found that I really enjoyed it. I've tried it both with water and with milk, and I greatly prefer the latte made with milk. It was creamy, warm, spicy, and very satisfying.  My only issue with it is that the turmeric powder doesn't seem to dissolve completely, leaving a powdery residue that I find a little unpleasant, but that is only when you get to the end of your drink. It's tolerable. At any rate, I enjoy it and will drink it again. I recommend it.

title: Interesting
text: This is a very interesting and fun product. If you like to try new things this is a great way to get a taste of something different. I've been to South Korea and have had many rice cakes that were expertly made by the folks that we visited there. My attempt, using this kit, was less successful, but fun and delicious none-the-less. The failure was mostly that I couldn't get the texture right, from what I remembered. The instructions were easy enough to follow, even though they were only in diagrams. The packages were clearly marked to show how much water to add. Kneading the rice dough is very fun and kind of relaxing. This is great fun to try. I recommend it.

title: Lovely tea
text: I love peach tea. This tea is very delicious served either cold or hot. I highly recommend it.

title: Delicious!
text: Beautiful, crunchy, salty, sweet...I love these. They tick all the right boxes for me for what I enjoy in a snack. I highly recommend these.

title: Don't like it
text: I really don't like this. I found it to taste and feel stale. Not pleasant at all. I do not recommend.

title: These are fine
text: These are good, tasty hard candies. I associate mint flavored hard candy with peppermint candy canes at Christmas time. These didn't quite reach my level of expectation. They were still good, just not quite what I was expecting. I found myself wanting a smooth, creamy Yorkshire mint patty instead. Try if you like.

title: Delicous
text: Makes fried chicken that is perfectly seasoned, and beautifully crunchy. I love it and recommend it.

title: Not what I expected
text: I was expecting this to be nice and crunchy. It wasn't. In fact it seemed a bit stale, both in flavor and texture. Very disappointing. I really don't like it very much.

title: Delicous!
text: These chips are really delicous. Nice and crisp, with just the right amount of salt. It really hits my craving for crunchy/salty things. I love them and recommend them.

title: Tasty, but expensive
text: Date sugar is delicious, but I find it to be a bit expensive. There are so many other more affordable options out there. As an alternative to regular, overly-processed white sugar though, it works great in most things. Great for baking mostly. I tried it in things like, my morning coffee or in a smoothy, but I didn't like it that way as much. It leaves a powdery residue that I find unpleasant in those circumstances. Best to stick with using it in baking.

title: Delicious
text: These are a nice, sweet/spicy treat. Great eaten as is or melted down and coated on apples to make candy apples. Either way, I really enjoy these. They are crisp and crackling hard when the bag is first opened. Don't let them sit around long though, or they begin to get that softish outer skin that hard candy gets sometimes when exposed to air for too long. I do recommend these though.

title: Fantastic!
text: Don't know what to cook for dinner tonight? These packet have got you covered. Just add a protein and a salad and you have got dinner sorted. They are really delicious. Great levels of seasoning in both the seasoning packets and the rice. My only complaint is that the cooking instructions for the rice isn't quite right. Each time we had to add more water and cook it for longer than the instructions called for. Just keep that in mind, but definitely give it a try.

title: Fabulous!
text: I love this tea! The mint is stimulating, and the lavender is soothing. Is that contradictory? Nope, I was surprised at how lovely the combination is. I really enjoy this delicious tea. I highly recommend.

title: Delicious!
text: I am really enjoying this delicious maple cream. So far, I have used it to sweeten my coffee, and stirred into plain yogurt with berries for a lovely, sweet breakfast treat. It would be great, also, used in baked good, on crackers or bread with peanut butter, or stirred into sauces for grilled meats. Lovely. I highly recommend.

title: Wonderful
text: Beautiful, rich, smooth...so many wonderful adjectives to describe this coffee. I really enjoyed it and recommend it.

title: Fantastic!
text: These little rice cake meals are fabulous! The sauce is spicy and delicious. The rice cakes are pillowy and satisfying. We added some leftover pork to this, but you could add just about any meat, fish or veg, to make a nice rounded meal. I have spent some time in South Korea and this really took me back with memories of my wonderful experience there. I highly recommend this, and don't forget to include some Kimchi in the meal. We happened to have made our own. That really rounded out the whole experience for me.

title: Delicious
text: If you are used to regular, bland, supermarket olive oil, you owe it to yourself to try REAL olive oil like this. It has a beautiful, fruity fragrance and a flavor that is so much more complex than generic or national brands. Cook with it or use it as a finishing oil on just about anything. I highly recommend this.

title: Delicious!
text: Love this tea. I love the warm, spicy flavor of ginger. Especially nice with the addition of a little hone and lemon. The K-cups work perfectly in my Kuerig. I highly recommend this.

title: It's great
text: Works great, makes great food. We used it to make cauliflower pizza. Loved it! I highly recommend.

title: Tasty
text: This chili crunch is okay. It is tasty, has a nice spice level, but is very oily. I don't see the use for the oil. A jar of red pepper flakes would provide the same effect in food without the extra oil...and is cheaper. So try if you like. I think it is too expensive.

title: Yummy!
text: These are really delicious. Of course...it's Nutella! The little packages make this suitable for packing in a lunchbag with some graham crackers for a tasty snack. I found maybe a novel use for these. Put them in the freezer. When frozen, take one out, pop out the Nutella and it's like eating fudge. YUM! While these are portable and handy, they are kind of expensive. It would be more cost effective to buy a large jar of Nutella and just pack a bit in a small container to pack in your lunch

title: Delicious
text: This is great! I've been using it to flavor my homemade plain yogurt and smoothies. Very tasty. It needs a little boost of sweetness though, so I add a little honey.

title: Love 'em!
text: These are really fun. They are nice and crispy and make a very satisfying snack. I love them.

title: Delicious
text: This coffee is very good. It works great in my Kuerig machine. I really like that it is trying to reduce plastic waste. It seems that they could compact the package better. The cup comes in a very puffy package. It would be better if it were vacuum packed. The puffy packages just take up so much space. It is annoying.

title: Delicious
text: Wonderful vanilla flavor. We put these in a bottle of rum and make our own vanilla extract. It is delicious.

title: It's okay
text: I don't usually have savory pancakes, but that's what these are. They were tasty and I like them. Obviously, you wouldn't put syrup on these. I used the mix to make little blinis and topped them with olive cream cheese. That was very tasty. I also used the batter (with a little added onion and garlic powder) to coat cauliflower to make cauliflower to make vegan buffalo wings. That was very tasty. There are lots of things you could do with this. I think it would make great crepes too. Give it a try.

title: Stale
text: These almonds were stale. They should be crisp and crunchy. They were not. They were soft and stale tasting. I do not recommend these.

title: Great
text: Delicious noodles. Great for stir-fry or noodle bowls. I recommend.

title: Delicious
text: These are really nice, tasty candies. I love that they are sugar-free, but they don't taste sugar-free. There is no unpleasant aftertaste or sickly overly sweet flavor with these. They are just really good. They provide a way for me to have a little something sweet without feeling guilty.

title: Works great
text: This is a great thickener for all sorts of things, like gravy or fruit pies. Can also be used to coat foods for frying for a nice crispy result.

title: Delicious!
text: This coffee is really good. I really enjoyed it. Very nice, balanced flavor. No off-notes or burnt flavors. Just delicious, rich coffee.

title: Delicious
text: One of the best coffees I've had in a long time. Nice, rich, smooth flavor. I absolutely love it.

title: Tastes great
text: This is a nice addition to smoothies, plain yogurt, or to add flavor to baked goods. I like it, you might too.

title: Delicious
text: These teas are really good. I have enjoyed them all, and don't have a particular favorite. They are great either hot or cold. Give them a try.

title: Not for me
text: I wanted to like these, but I really didn't. They were crispy...that was nice. I didn't like the slight sweetness mixed with the very umami flavor of the seaweed. They just didn't go together for me and really turned me off. I couldn't finish the bag. If they had gone full savory/salty, I think they would have been good. The sweetness didn't belong.

title: Mmmmmmm....
text: This tea is delicious! It has a lovely, warm fragrance of cardamom and spice. It is just the right amount of sweetness, with a nice creamy finish. I love it.

title: Love it
text: These are a nice sweet treat for anyone who is trying to limit their sugar intake. There is no unpleasant aftertaste or lingering, cloying sweetness like with other kinds of sugar substitutes. One is enough to satisfy my craving for something sweet. Don't try to bite it though. It will stick to your teeth and you might pull a filling out trying to get it off.

title: Love it!
text: This makes a wonderful mole sauce for use with just about any kind of meat, or as a topping for tacos. I do recommend that you give it a try.

title: Delicious!
text: This is really good. The ginger flavor is very pronounced, and adds a nice spiciness to beverages. The honey flavor is a bit more hidden, but adds a nice sweetness. I do recommend this. It's something different to sweeten your tea.

title: Delicious!
text: This brewed up a very fine pitcher of cold-brew coffee. I just left it in the fridge overnight. The coffee is very flavorful. It has a lovely balance, but a nice, robust, but smooth coffee flavor. I love it. Easy to use, easy to brew, I highly recommend.

title: Love them!
text: These are delicious! Very addicting. They have a nice peaches and cream flavor. I really enjoyed these. I recommend them to anyone.

title: Delicious!
text: These are really tasty, nicely crisp...I love them. They make a great little Keto snack. Give them a try.

title: Nice
text: This adds a nice flavor to soups and stews. Not so good in tomato based sauces, but great for brown gravy. Give it a try.

title: Fabulous!
text: I love this. It makes really good guacamole, but it is also useful as a seasoning for so many other things. Use it as a rub on steaks before grilling, stir it into soups or stews, or top hard-boiled eggs with it. You can use it to flavor hummus or other dips as well. I highly recommend it.

title: Love, love, LOVE IT!
text: I absolutely LOVE this relish. It is very hot, but also has really great flavor, kind of citrusy. Depending on how you like your heat, I would suggest starting with a very small amount to gauge your tolerance. I use a very small amount, like maybe half a teaspoon stirred into a bowl of chili or topping a taco. It really is potent, but very tolerable in small amounts. I just can't get over how good it is. So much more complex than just heat. I highly recommend that you try this.

title: Delicious!
text: This is delicious! I love it. It makes such a lovely, refreshing drink. I highly recommend.

title: Delicious!
text: Beautiful coffee! Really lovely, rich flavor. Not too acidic. No burnt off-notes. Just really good, balanced flavor. I love it!

title: Love it!
text: Where has this been all my life? I love this spice blend. It is so useful on so many things. I sprinkle it on hard-boiled eggs, scrambled eggs, add it to spaghetti sauce, pizza sauce, soups and stews, and even throw a bit into fresh, homemade dips for chips or fresh veggies. So versatile. I highly recommend this.

title: Lovely
text: The tea is delicious and works perfectly in my Kuerig. I recommend this.

title: Nice
text: This is a nice alternative to sugar in your coffee. The hazelnut flavor isn't as pronounced as I would like it to be, but it still gives a nice sweetness, without an unpleasant aftertaste, or overly sweet flavor of other sugar substitutes. I recommend this.

title: Love it
text: This is great! I've never used it before, and wasn't quite sure what to do with it, but I wanted to try it. I looked up a few recipes and we wound up making Cauliflower crust pizza. OMG! It is delicious! The recipe didn't use this flour, but we added it anyway. It worked great. We are trying to eat less carbs, so this allows us to have pizza without all the carbs. Love it!

title: Wow!
text: I had no idea that pepper can have so many different flavors. When you open the package you are hit with a strong, tantalizing floral fragrance. This pepper smells wonderful! I would have to say that the smell and taste of it reminds me of cardamon, with a little bit of heat. It tastes very good on some things, but not so good on other things. It would be great in chili or curry. It's not so good on scrambled eggs. It's worth trying out.

title: Nice
text: Lovely salt. It is...salty. What else is there to say about it. I don't detect any other flavors, except salt. So, is it worth the extra cost? You decide.

title: Delicous!
text: I love this banana powder. It adds a lovely banana flavor to whatever you put it in. We have used it to make smoothies and to flavor plain, homemade yogurt. I love it.

title: Delicious!
text: I love these. The coffee is really fantastic. Very bold, but balanced flavor that goes down smooth. The tea is warm with lovely spices. The cocoa rich. I highly recommend this.

title: Mmmmmm.....!
text: The first whiff of cloves as I opened this bag was delightful. The cloves smell so sweet. I was a little bit amazed. Most cloves I have used before are very...pungent. Almost too strong. No so with these cloves. They smell sweet, and taste sweet and don't overpower food. I made a clove cake with this, and a pineapple upside-down cake. They were both delicious, and I used slightly more cloves than I usually do with no detriment in flavor. I highly recommend this.

title: Tattes great
text: This makes great fajitas. Chicken, fish, shrimp, pork or beef, it all tastes great with this. Makes a good seasoning for tacos or chili as well. I highly recommend.

title: Love 'em
text: These are basically Corn Nuts. They are salty, and crunchy and so delicious. I love them. I highly recommend them.

title: Taste good.
text: I love all of the flavors in this spice set. They are very good on whatever you put it on. The only complaint I have is that they are a bit too salty. I like to adjust my own level of salt, and this doesn't allow me to do that. At any rate, they are still tasty and I recommend them.

title: Just okay
text: Some of these flavors are really nice. Some I can live without. The Algae one in particular is kind of vile. It's a texture thing, not rally a taste thing. The taste is fine, but the floaty bits of algae is just weird and I don't like it. The rest of the flavors are fine and make a nice, refreshing, healthy drink. Give it a try if you are looking for a way to make drinking your daily water more interesting.

title: Tasty
text: This Jambalaya is delicious. Very easy to make. I do like to add my own chicken or sausage to it to make a tasty meal. I highly recommend it.

title: Love 'em
text: These are wonderful, flavorful rubs. We enjoyed all of them on pork ribs, and grilled chicken. I highly recommend these.

title: Pretty horrible
text: I wanted the to be good, bit, alas, it wasn't. It was just overly sweet and had no fruity flavor at all. It was just  sweet, and red. I wound up throwing the cake I made with it out. Honestly, just make your own icing with butter and confectioner's sugar. It would taste better and cost less.

title: Tastes fine
text: This coffee has a very light vanilla flavor. It works well in my Keurig brewer and tastes great. I recommend.

title: Fabulous
text: Beautiful vanilla flavor. We use these pods to make our own vanilla extract. It goes in a bottle of rum and soaks for a few weeks. This makes a fantastic tasting vanilla extract. Of course, it would be great scraped into ice cream or baked goods as well. I do recommend this.

title: Beautiuful!
text: What gloriously fresh nutmeg! It is just wonderful. We used this on some rice pudding and the fragrance filled the room as it baked. It has a very strong nutmeg flavor, so you might want to start out using it a bit sparingly. Increase your amounts as needed, once you get used to how strong the flavor is. I have never used whole nutmeg before, so I was unprepared for how pronounced the flavor of these nuts are. It will be a game changer in your holiday baking, I can tell you that. I highly recommend this.

title: A little disappointing.
text: This stuff is okay. It does sweeten things, but you have to use a lot more of it to even come close to the sweetness of regular sugar. If you want an alternative to sugar, you may like this. It does have a nice, clean sweetness, it is just that it isn't very pronounced. If you are looking for something with the same sweetness as sugar, you can get there, but may need to use 2 to 3 times a much. Not really sure if that makes the cost worth it.

title: Delicous
text: This makes a wonderfully spicy tea. I use it as kind of a chai base, and mix it with other spices and black tea. I add milk and sugar and wind up with the most marvelously spiced chai tea imaginable. I love it.

title: Fantastic!
text: Beautiful, fragrant cinnamon. This cinnamon is of the highest quality. Use it in whole, stick form to flavor spiced wine for the holidays, or grate it fine and use it in backed goods. It is marvelous, no matter how you use it. I recommend it.

title: Pretty good
text: This is a strong-tasting tonic water. It has quite pronounced bitter notes to it. If you don't like bitter, you won't like this. I can tolerate some bitter, but am not a fan of bitterness that is too strong. In small doses, this stuff is great. It ads a nice fizz and bitter flavor to drinks. If you like bitter, you will love this. Otherwise, just use it judiciously.

title: Save your money
text: This is just a glorified sugar cube. It has absolutely no flavor...of anything. It is pretty, but it is outrageously expensive for being little more than a sugar cube. Really, don't buy this. Your money is better spent on ANYTHING than this.

title: Love it
text: I am really enjoying this milk tea. It adds a nice sweetness to tea. I have been using it with spiced teas to make kind of a chai tea thing. It works great for that. Love it, and highly recommend it.

title: Not worth the price
text: Wow, I can't believe how expensive this candy is. Really? It tastes of nothing. Just plain sugar. For that price it could at least have a flavor added to it, like lemon, or orange maybe. The little sugar "gem" is really beautiful, but is is just sooooooo...unjustifiably expensive! If you have money to burn, go ahead and get it, but honestly, I don't think it is worth it.

title: Delicious!
text:
I love these lovely little cookies! They are crisp, and lightly sweet. This satisfies my cravings for eating something crispy (which I have often). The great thing is that I can eat just 3 or 4, my craving is satiated, and I will have only consumed about 24 calories. Yeah!

The flavor is butter and slightly sweet. I actually don't taste the cinnamon very much. It is very faint. At any rate, I still enjoy them very much and highly recommend for gift giving or for yourself.

title: Neat
text: These seeds work well for thickening up sauces and stews. I've used it a few times now, and have been mostly pleased with the results. The seeds, by themselves don't really taste that good. I tried this in a chicken gravy and it left a weird taste in it that was unpleasant. I also used it in a tomato-based sauce and that worked much better. I recommend using this only in sauces with stronger flavors, like a beef gravy, tomato sauces and the like. The flavor seems to hide well in those kinds of sauces. It's not suitable for lighter flavored dishes, like chowders, chicken or mushroom based sauces.

title: Delicious
text: These sesame seeds are tasty. A very nice addition to bread baking, rice or many other kinds of foods. I highly recommend.

title: Delicious
text: Wonderful chickpeas. We cooked them up and made them into hummus. Fantastic. I highly recommend.

title: What's not to love about it?
text: This is very good coffee. I ask that my coffee be bold, without tasting burnt, and smooth-tasting, without any rank off tastes. This coffee fit both of these criteria. It has a smooth, bold flavor without any off notes or burnt flavors. I love what this company is trying to accomplish, putting more money in the pockets of the growers, and seeing to their other needs as well, such as education and housing. This coffee is a win-win all the way around. I highly recommend giving it a try.

title: Delicous!
text: Pumpkin Spice is my favorite coffee flavor. Eight O'Clock is very cook coffee to start with. Add to that a delicious pumpkin spice to it and it is a winner for me. I have to say that it is maybe a tad heavy handed with the cloves, but overall, it still has a really nice flavor and I enjoyed it very much. I recommend this. If you don't like a pronounced clove flavor, you might want to try Green Mountain Coffee roasters Pumpkin Spice. In my opinion, it is the best bar-none. This one is right up there running a very close second place.

title: Delicious
text: I love me some Earl Grey tea! This tea is really nice. It has a very balanced flavor. The Bergamot is present, but not overpowering. I highly recommend this tea.

title: Delicous!
text: I LOVE these teas. Suck interesting flavors. Twinings is is a familiar name, well-known for their quality teas. I"m so glad they put together this interesting combination of teas and explain the health benefits of each. My favorite is the heart support tea with beetroot and orange. It is delicious with a touch of honey. One thing I love about Twinings teas is that they are never weak, or watery. Their flavors are always brew up strong and well developed. This would be a great gift for any tea lover. I highly recommend.

title: Delicious
text: This is great tasting coffee. Really smooth and rich. I have to say, though, that I was a little shocked at how much you have to use to make a pitcher of iced coffee. It seemed excessive. I followed the instructions, but when I make it again, I will use way less coffee. It almost seems like a waste to use so much. That makes this coffee really expensive to use and not a very good value. If you have money to burn though, it makes a great pot of coffee, cold or hot (and yes, I brewed a pot of hot coffee too). Having the coffee already to go in a filter pouch makes it easy to use. I need to use less coffee though, so I'm taking it apart and scooping the coffee out to my liking.

title: Delicious!
text: This spice rub is very interesting. It has an unusual blend of spices and herbs. It is a little reminiscent of a jerk seasoning, without being spicy hot. We used this to make a fish fry and it was fantastic. We rubbed the fish liberally with the spice rub, then battered it with a beer batter and fried it. So delicious! The fish was really flavorful. We tried it again on grilled chicken, and again, it came out great. IF you want it spicy, add a little cayenne, but it is great just as it is. I highly recommend this.

title: Fantastic!
text: I LOVE these!  Love, love...LOVE! They are crunchy, and sweet, with a little bit of sour. OMG! They are delicious. I just ate them straight out of hand, but they would be good in cereal or on ice cream. I highly recommend these.

title: Great
text: This makes a very smooth cup of coffee. It has a really nice flavor, and the pods are really easy to use. I highly recommend.

title: Pretty delicious!
text: I really like these tasty little nuggets of goodness. They are very flavorful. I used them in salads, and just to snack on. They would also be great as croutons in soups, like tomato and minestrone. I love them and highly recommend them.

title: Delicious!
text: I really enjoyed drinking this coffee. It was delicious. I don't think the bean extract did anything for me. I didn't loose any weight while using it. That was disappointing, but oh well. I enjoyed the coffee any way. Maybe if I drank this for a long period of time I might see some weight loss. I may try again.

title: Yuck!
text:
This stuff is horrible! Just...ugh! Where to start. The worst part about it is the texture. Eating these noodles is like chewing on rubber bands. The noodles are actually tasteless. We followed the recipe to the best of our ability...and here is another BIG issue with this. The cooking directions and recipe are really convoluted and very hard to follow. My husband and I are both experienced, accomplished cooks, and it was a real challenge to figure out the directions.

First of all, The package includes a recipe for VEGAN Fettuccine Alfredo. This VEGAN recipe includes HEAVY CREAM, BUTTER, and PARMESAN CHEESE. Vegetarian...YES! Vegan...absolutely NOT! The recipe made a great Alfredo sauce, it just was NOT Vegan.

Secondly, the recipe includes items that are not in the ingredient list, and items on the ingredient list that are NOT used in the recipe. For instance, it lists broccoli in the ingredient list, but never tells you how to cook it, or use it in the recipe. The surprise ingredient was butter. Butter is not in the list of ingredients, but the recipe tells you to add it with the olive oil.

So, in summary. These noodles are really bad, and the recipe will challenge all but the most experience cooks. Don't buy these. Look elsewhere.

title: Fantastic
text:
These dates are delicious! I don't dislike dates, but I've don't really eat them very often. That changed when I got these dates. I've been having them every morning with my yogurt and granola. I love them.

These dates are really easy to seed. It pops right out without any problem. The dates are dry, and easy to work with. I remember dates being much more sticky and annoying. That's why I've never really eaten them much. Like I said, I love these and am eating them every day now. I highly recommend them.

title: Not a fan
text: I wanted to like this, but I really don't. The texture and taste are just not good. The chocolate flavor is a bit too bitter for me, but the worst part is the texture. It's like eating sand, if you eat it dry, and turns to mush if you try to eat it like cereal with milk. If it were in crunchy nugget form, it would be better. As is, it is hard to eat. I don't recommend.

title: It's great!
text: What's to say? It's salt and pepper. They come in a nice package suitable for gift giving. The flavors are great. I highly recommend.

title: Just Okay
text: These are pretty good spice blends that work well in all kinds of dishes. Overall, I found their flavor to be good, just kind of mild. You have to use much more than what is suggested just to get any flavor out of them. The fajita seasoning was especially disappointing. It tastes mostly of paprika, not chilies or cumin, like you would expect. You have to add cumin, chili powder and a little cayenne to make a nice spicy fajita. These are fine, if you like mild seasoning. But if you like bold flavors, look elsewhere.

title: Gritty
text:
I'm not a fan of this Hot chocolate. I wanted to like it, but it just doesn't deliver. I whisked it really good into hot milk. It just didn't dissolve very well. While I was drinking it, it felt gritty in my mouth, Very unpleasant. At the end, there was a whole pile of chocolate sediment in the cup.

The flavor was mildly chocolaty. Nothing stellar. I don't really recommend it.

title: Very nice
text: I wasn't sure what to expect with these little cakes, but I decided to try them anyway. They are actually quite good. I was pleasantly surprised. They are tasty. I got the chocolate ones. They were lightly chocolaty. The cake texture can only be described as...very tender. What do I mean by that? Well, the crumb holds together...but just barely. Handle them very gingerly or they will fall apart in your hands. The only thing I don't really like about them is the slightly, sickly-sweet after-taste of the artificial sweetener (by that I mean...non-sugar). I think the sweetener is Stevia, which isn't really artificial, per-se, but I absolutely hate the taste of it. To it's credit, the cake only has a slight flavor of it, so it is tolerable. If you want a healthy, sweet snack, this cake is a good candidate that won't ruin your diet. I do recommend it.

title: Nice
text: I really like this tea. I am familiar with turmeric and it's health benefits. Not so much with some of the other ingredients. I was very intrigued about what it would taste like though. It has a very interesting combination of spices and flavors. It's not like anything I have every had before. The lemon, of course, is familiar, but the addition of licorice, turmeric and some of the more exotic Asian spices put a whole different spin on it. I can only describe the flavor as lemony, "warm", and "spicy", but not in a heat sort of way. I did like it, though I probably won't drink it every day. It is definitely something I will drink if I'm feeling sick, or just need a comforting, warm drink on a chilly day. My husband thought that addition of a little sugar or honey might be nice. I tried it straight up and didn't mind it not being sweet. This should definitely be on your list of teas to try, especially if you are a more adventurous tea drinker, or want to try it for the health benefits of the ingredients.

title: Tasty, but mild
text: We made fish cakes with this seasoning (they are like crab cakes). We normally use Old Bay Seasoning. Since this company claims to be similar, we decided to try it. It is similar, but not equivalent. It made tasty fish cakes, but they lacked the heated spiciness of Old Bay. If you want to use this in a crab or lobster boil, add a little cayenne to up the spice factor a bit. I do recommend this though.

title: Okay
text: This curry sauce is very mild and make a pretty good curry. We made a chicken curry with it served over rice. I found it a little bland though, so I added a bit of curry powder to it, and a little red pepper as well. I thought it should be much spicier than it is. Any way you pour it, this is GREAT coffee! I've tried all three, and each one of them is both unique and just...good. All of them have a very clean coffee taste...not muddled with extraneous off-notes.

I tried brewing the coffee in the prescribed method...pour-over (see pictures above)...and can say that this made a great cup of coffee. I also tried opening the little packages and using the grounds in my drip coffee maker. That made excellent coffee as well. I think that you could use just about any method you want to brew this coffee and it would come out good, except that the grind is very fine and may not work for a french press. I honestly don't have the patience to stand over a cup and slowly pour hot water over the coffee while it brews, so I plan on using my coffee maker to brew the rest of it. A word about the ingenious design of the little bags. The little "wings" that pull out from the sides and form a structure that allows you to securely perch the coffee bag on the rim of your cup is just brilliant! They work very well, holding the bag in place until you are done brewing.

I highly recommend this coffee. Try the pour-over method first, and then brew any way you like.

Setting flavor aside, they get points for real ingredients. These are genuine food, not chemicals, which explains the relatively short expiration date.

In terms of consistency and mouth feel, these are the hamburger of jerky... They are clearly ground up, not just dried meat. That's not all bad of course, they are easier to chew than real jerky and they are.

Finally, the bar's size is a healthy 1.5 oz portion. That's about 1/3 of the typical hamburger and without the bun, so these aren't replacing a meal on their own, but it's also way more than most jerky shoves in there for about the same price.

title: Fast, easy, and tastes great!
text:
Boba has taken over the world and everyone wants to be able to enjoy at home. I've tried a few different types of pearls that are available in supermarkets. I've tried raw pearls that I had to boil for over 20 minutes and even then, ended up tasting like powder. Others have been complete milk tea mixes with a sealed bag of pearls that are smaller than what you get in the store and don't taste as good.

The Enzo Original Black Tapioca Pearl is the first "instant" boba pearl that I've tried that actually matches the taste and chewy quality of store-bought boba. Each bag has a good number of pearls and even in their "uncooked" form, they are bigger than other instant bobas that I've tried before.

Pour some boiling water over the pearls and wait for 4 minutes, or place in the microwave for 40 seconds. Drain out the water and you have perfect pearls. The center is cooked and the chewy texture is maintained. Keep a pitcher of milk tea in the fridge and you can have a glass of boba milk tea any time!

Great product.

title: I drink this hot, but find it to be underwhelming
text:
I've always loved fruit teas. They tend to be tangy which I'm normally not a fan of but there's that fragrant fruity smell from the tea that's just refreshing.

The Fruiteza Dried Fruit Water Infusions are essentially slices of dehydrated fruit such as orange, dragon fruit, apple, and pineapple. The concept is great, but in practice, it's not as effective as using fresh fruits. If the steep is too short, then there is not much taste but too long and the tea becomes bitter due to the apple and orange peels.

I really wanted to like this tea but in the end, fresh fruits have their natural juices that mix with the hot water to create much better teas but the challenge is finding the right combination of fruits. Perhaps even mix in some regular tea for some astringency?

title: Something is missing
text:
Oolong is one of my favorite teas to drink. The good ones have this distinct aftertaste and a feel on the tongue that I don't have the vocabulary to describe. To do this review, I searched up terms used to describe tea and I believe the word I'm looking for is astringency caused by tannin. It's that dry feel on the tongue that the tea leave behind.

The Xusmyzm Dragon Oolong Tea was missing that astringency I was looking for. Put in more leaves and the tea is simply bitter with a little bit of the aftertaste, but put in too little and it's not there at all. The best quality Oolong has a good balance between bitterness and the nice aftertaste.

I'm sorry to say that I've had better.

title: One of the cheapest Nespresso Compatible Capsules out there.
text:
Since I got my Nesspresso machine a few years ago, I've gone through many different Nespresso compatible capsules and I've concluded that if possible, purchase the aluminum capsules but if that's not available, plastic with aluminum foil at both ends will work well. Just avoid the all-plastic bottom capsules. The Amora Mixed Pack is the second kind: plastic, with aluminum foil at both ends. As such, here isn't much coffee that leaks into the tray afterward.

So with the operation of the capsule out of the way, we can talk about the coffee itself. This mix pack comes with two levels of darkness: The blue box is 4 coffee beans out of 5 and the black box is 5 of 5. I can attest that for me both capsules are sufficiently dark for me and when topped with frothy milk, the coffee is smooth and has a good espresso taste. Compared to the previous compatible coffee pod that I got, the Amora coffee is much smoother and doesn't taste watered down. That said, if I compare it to a Nespresso original pod, it's still a small step down.

Being one of the cheapest compatible capsules out there, I'm happy with this coffee and I can save the original pods for special occasions... like Mondays.

title: All-plastic pod and diluted taste
text:
These Caffe Mercanti Italian Coffee Capsules come in a box individually pressure wrapped for freshness. They are compatible with Nespresso Original pods, not the new Vertuo pods, but I'm guessing one can tell from the pictures.

I've tried out many, many Nespresso compatible pods and in my experience, all-plastic pods don't work well at all. The discarded pod trays get filled up with leaked coffee in a couple of days while aluminum pods will drop just a few drops of coffee in the tray. So now, I look for pods that are either aluminum pods (original Nespresso, Starbucks and L'OR) or plastic pods with aluminum on both sides (Lavazza and a few other cheaper brands).

The most important factor of course is the taste. As can be seen in my picture, the espresso is dark and produces a good layer of crema. Even the longo looks dark with good crema. The taste though is just not great. It feels watered down and has an odd aroma, almost as if it has some sort of spice in it.

title: Gotta say, it's pretty good.
text:
In the morning, when I can take some time to make coffee, I start with a Nespresso topped with frothed milk, but when work starts and I have little time to step away from the endless meetings, I end up drinking instant.

Of course, I've gone through Folger's as well as Trader Joe's instant coffee, but this is the first time I'm trying the Nescafe brand... at least in this form. My previous experience with Nescafe have been the little 3-in-1 packets that they give you in hotel rooms that already include the sugar and powdered creamer.

This Nescafe instant has a nice taste and is a great alternative to the other instant coffee that I normally have.

title: When you just need boba but the stores are closed.
text:
Instant boba that one can make at home? Yes, please. Who hasn't wanted boba but just couldn't go to the store at that moment? Oh, is it just me?

The Fusion Select boba comes with a bag of powdered milk with flavoring and a separate bag of boba in thick brown sugar syrup. Preparation is very easy. Mix the powder in hot water, drop in the boba, and microwave for 45 seconds to soften the boba. Pour the mixture over ice to cool it down.

As an alternative method, I have been able to mix a little cold water into the boba and warm that up in the microwave. Once hot enough, mix in the powder and add more water, then drop in ice cubes. This allows one to use one cup to make the drink and to minimize the amount of ice necessary to cool it down.

The reason I gave this only 4 stars is that I don't want to give the impression that the Fusion Select instant boba will taste as good as a store-bought drink. The drink is made from powdered milk and flavoring, which means it will not taste like fresh milk. Some of the boba may also taste powdery if they aren't heated for a long enough time. With that, I really liked the taro flavor and the overall experience is still very enjoyable. Of course, kids love this drink as well!

text: Used to be able to get this in smaller cans on Amazon, but not anymore.  This is a great product for ginger ale without HFCS.

title: Good Product
text: Better price than the Vitacost brand.

title: Delicious Pasta
text: I had never heard of this brand as I usually use whole wheat pasta. It was quite a fine pasta with a good texture and taste.

title: Excellent
text: This almond flour is ground finer than most I have used which makes it easier for things like breading and mixing. Works just fine and tastes great.

title: Quality Coffee
text: Love his brand. Even the decaf has body and tastes great! Thanks for making k cups in this.  Yummy!

title: Light and Refreshing
text: For anyone trying to increase their water intake, this is for you. I struggle daily to be hydrated especially in the summer. This is tasty, fizzy, unsweetened and very refreshing. Goes down a lot easier than regular flat water. Hope there are more flavors in the mix because I like it!

title: Wonderful Coffee
text: Bold and full bodied. Wonderful as a mocha or just straight with cream and sugar. I really enjoyed the cup I just had. Can't wait for my next one. I would buy this product.

title: Delish Coffee
text: I've had 2 cups of this this morning and I love it. It is well balanced, not bitter and just plain good.  I never heard of this producer before, but I'll be looking for them again.

title: Pretty Tasty
text: Perfect fruit snack to grab on the go. These are not dried out and hard to chew. Very moist and tender "leather" with a good mixed fruit taste. Individually wrapped for lunch boxes or purses.  I would recommend these highly. Not too sweet, or tart. Really good, middle of the road taste.

title: Not A Spread
text: Calling this a spread is kind of misleading. Even when the oil on top is stirred in, it's pretty liquid in nature. Seems to have a kind of sandy, gritty texture and an odd taste that I suppose is the white chocolate flavor. It is non gmo and does have some good protein in it. Best eaten with a spoon right out of the jar in my opinion.

title: A Nice Spin on Traditional Earl Grey
text: I found this tea to be quite floral and herbaceous. From the second you open the bag, you are captivated by the scents wafting from the tea. Delicious tea. Plenty of tea bags and the outside bag seals so even though the inside bags are not individually wrapped, they stay fresh. I'll be looking for products from this company in the future.

title: Very Weak
text: This is a medium roast coffee, but it tastes like a light roast. It does have a nice hint of cinnamon and other good ingredients like ginseng. Good for someone who drinks black coffee, but I prefer a much bolder body than this has. Had to put the machine on 6 ounce setting and still wasn't that full bodied.

title: Fine Salt
text: This is a very nice, fine salt that is good for a shaker. Has a great flavor and flows nicely.  Not sure what else there is to say about it. It's salt....

title: Very Fluffy
text: I really like this rice. I've used Lundberg for 15 years, but I think this cooks up fluffier in my rice cooker than theirs does. It tasted great in shrimp fried rice and I am betting it has a better price point as well.  I'll be buying this again.

title: Not Very Spicy
text:
If you like Chai with body, this isn't it. Not very spicy, or strong, no matter how long it was steeped. Probably need to use 2 bags at a time for a mug full.

Not overly fond of the packaging either. Once open the inner bag, the tea bags are not individually wrapped and therefore are exposed to the air. If you drink a lot of tea, this isn't a problem, but a box of this might sit in my cupboard for a year before it is all gone. Not a fan of the double bag that has to be separated from it's neighbor.

title: This Has  Possibilities
text: I wasn't sure about this salt, because I'm not a huge fan of sriracha.  It is a fine grain salt and a little bit goes a long way. I made deviled eggs today and used just the faintest bit on the top. Really good. A hit of spice and a little salt. Fantastic! Perfect for the gourmet in your life.

title: So Yummy
text: Perfect snack for a break room. 8 cookies in a sleeve is just right to share with a friend. Lots of filling so they seem to hold up better when dunking in milk. Yummo!

title: Tasty Treat
text: We all know these are yummy. No HFCS, so artificial stuff, so they are a better choice to snack on when you need that little sweet treat.. The little packages are perfect for controlling how much you eat. Also good for a coffee break room in an office.  Very good product.

title: Good Chocolate But Oily
text: This tastes OK, but using it in the Wilton mini fountain is a joke. That thing didn't work worth squat. Impossible to clean and doesn't stay hot enough to circulate the chocolate.

title: Delish!
text: Great variety of tea, coffee and other hot drink cups. Good for someone starting out.

title: Impressed
text: I did not expect to like this coffee. Most of the no name brands are pretty gross. I am pleased to say that this is good stuff. Not bitter, no funky aftertaste. Good black, hold up to cream and sugar. A really good cuppa joe.

title: Not As Advertised
text: Firstly we were supposed to get 4 boxes of cookies. I got one. In a padded envelope that was crushed in shipping.  What was left of the cookies was kind of interesting. I couldn't really tell if they were stale or just sort of semi hard. They  taste like they wanted to be a shortbread type flavor, but they were kind of gummy and not crunchy. Overall not much chance I would buy them.  The ingredients also need to be more clearly listed on the sale page.

title: Yummy!!
text: I don't normally treat myself to chocolate milk these days, but this is well worth it. Shelf stable so you can chill it as you need it For low fat, it still has a richness. Maybe a tad too sweet for my taste, but kids should love it. Great source of protein for those days on the go. A great product I would buy again.

title: Gross About Covers It
text: Oh my...these are quite possibly the worst thing I ever tried to eat. It is the worst flavor combination ever devised and there is nothing good to say. I was hoping for so much more, but these are just, plain, unadulterated GROSS!

title: Deadly Sweet
text: I almost dropped my teeth when I saw the price point on this product. It is high quality honey, no doubt. They really could have skipped the chocolate element altogether. Very long on the flavor of honey, but short on chocolate. As suggested on the jar, I dipped in and grabbed a spoonful to try. Super sweet, sickeningly so, and really nothing decadent about it I'm sorry to say. Will probably work well on toast over top a generous serving of peanut butter, to cut the sweet.

title: Good Taste
text: My Mom loves this coffee. She drinks it black and it has a great taste.

title: Good Tasting
text: I just discovered this and I love it. I'm a landscaper with heat issues and this at least tries to replenish my magnesium and potassium without fake colors and flavors. Has a great taste.

title: Very Good Coffee!
text: Very good coffee!! Nice clean, bold flavor. Worked well in my machine. I would recommend this brand to a friend. Wonderful!

title: Totally Gross
text: Good grief this stuff is so nasty we couldn't even eat it. Unappealing color, no cheese flavor that I could discern and some sort of really gross aftertaste. I'm not even sure my chickens are going to want the leftovers. Truly awful stuff. A good idea, but a disgusting execution.

title: Fun Flavored Coffee
text: We love this. Wish it was year round.

title: Good If You Like It Black
text: Nice light roast coffee. I buy this for my guests that drink it black.

title: Good Tea On The Go
text:
A really nice sized steel bottle for drinks. The enclosed instructions say that this will leak if not kept upright. In my tests it did not leak a drop when turned on it's side. It doesn't have a drink spout at the top though so you do have to unscrew the lid to drink. The bamboo is a nice feel in your hand.

I just brewed a cup of loose tea in this and these were my observations. This is tall and narrow, kind of like a collins glass. I placed my tea in the strainer and poured my water over it until it filled the bottle. After letting it steep, I found that the tea leaves had hydrated to the point that I could not find the little handle of the strainer without fishing around in the hot leaves. So stick the handle up before you pour your water in. Because it is so tall and narrow you will need an iced tea spoon to stir in any sweetener or cream you might want. With the lid on the tea stays nice and hot, but it's kind of pain to have to keep unscrewing the lid to get a drink. If you are on the go though this is a good product to have.

I deducted one star from five for limited instructions and the 2 large glue dots on the bottom of the bottle. Packaging?? Impossible to remove and they are really sticky.

title: Exellent Organic Product
text: Super honey. Great flavor. I'll be using this for my next batch of homemade elderberry syrup. It is a bit pricey, but most organic, raw honey is. Our local honey, when I can get it is double this, so you get what you pay for.

title: SPICY!
text: WOW these are really SPICY!!!! They have great texture and a good gummy bear quality. It's been a long time since I had a red hot and I had forgotten how spicy cinnamon oil is. These are not for the faint of heart.

title: Prepare To Choke
text: These just arrived and I had to try them out. They are kinda dry and made me want to choke. Very small serving and they could use a bit more chocolate on the bottom. They are non GMO, which is probably the best thing I can say for them. Would I recommend them? Probably not.

title: Full Bodied
text: Love this coffee. Full bodied and great flavor.

title: Disappointing Frosting
text: I had really high hopes for this frosting. The ingredients are all clean and the label reads the way you want it to. Unfortunately it tasted really fake to us. Bitter aftertaste. Very difficult to spread. You really have to stir the heck out of it. I tried piping it and that didn't work worth a hoot.  All in all very disappointing. Make your own scratch buttercream. You'll thank me for the tip.

title: Spicy But Delicious
text: These sticks are KILLER spicy. But they have a really good flavor reminiscent of Slim Jims without all the crap and chemicals. Not greasy. Good texture of the meat. No odd bits or gristle. Very good sticks. I would buy these and I'm going to go look for some without the jalapeno.

title: Well Balanced Coffee
text: I ground some of this morning and put it in one of my K cup refillable pods. A very enjoyable cup of coffee ensued. Well balanced. It held up to cream and sugar and still kept the depth of flavor.  Amazon does it again! A winner!

title: Yummy Baking Nuts
text: Perfect size chopped walnuts for baking this holiday season. Fisher Nuts have always been good. These are chopped well, but not too finely and not too chunky. They are also now marked as non gmo which is a big deal for a lot of use these days.

title: Good Quality Nuts
text: Very nice pecans. All whole, no pieces. Made a great pie. Delicious. I would buy these again. Well packaged and easy to seal.

title: Good Coffee
text: Great coffee. Glad to be able to buy it with out having to get a variety pack.

title: Good Coffee, Less Waste
text: Love this coffee. Not so fond of the French and Breakfast Roasts though and wish they would make a different variety pack available.

title: Good Flavor
text: Wonderful, easy tea for those upset tummy mornings.

title: Good Flavor
text: I love the DaVinci Naturals because they have minimal ingredients and no preservatives. The hazelnut flavor could be just a bit more forward in this, but it is still quite good in coffee.

title: Great Vanilla Flavor
text: I get this for my Mom who drinks her coffee black. She loves it and says it is the best vanilla out there.

title: Drink Cold
text: I am kind of on the fence with this water. It really needs to be very cold before you drink it. Even then, just plain, it tastes kind of funky to me. I think maybe for me I like coconut water better with a little fruit flavor. Took some lat night and put some strawberries and mint in it and blended it. That made it palatable. I'm sure it is good if that's what you are used to drinking.

title: Great For Baking
text: These walnuts are great for baking, Pre measured amount and already mostly broken up. Simple to use and they taste great. The best part is the Non GMO seal. Good food!!

title: Yummy!
text: My Mom loves this stuff. She moved to Virginia with me from PA  Dutch Country and this is the only chow chow she will eat. The Southern styles here are way different. So glad for Amazon.

title: Good Product, No Peanuts
text: A really nice mix of very tasty nuts. Just the right amount of salt and no peanuts. Large nuts, not broken pieces. Great snack to keep your energy up. I deducted one star because of the ambiguous labeling about the oils used.  Either, or both is not a good label. Wish they were non GMO oils used, but the nuts are good.

title: Delish
text: We love this stuff for soft pretzels and dipping chicken tenders. Sweet with just the right amount of bite.

title: Great Way To Try Coffee
text: My Mom gets these quite often and really likes the variety of flavors that are available. Always a different mix. A great way to try out coffee without committing to a whole box of the same thing.

title: A Waste Of Good Frosting
text: I made this yesterday hoping for a nice treat. This product is a mix that can be made as either muffins, cake or cupcakes. I made the cupcake version. We do not have to eat gluten free, but I got this because of the minimal ingredients hoping for something that I didn't have to bake from scratch.  Followed the instructions, but intentionally under baked these by 3 minutes so they wouldn't be overdone. Took them out of the oven and they sunk in the middle. Cooled and frosted and tasted. They were dry and crumbly and not very appetizing at all. The almond meal is chunky and kind of gritty. If you baked them for the recommended time, they would be inedible crumbs. Would buy these.

title: Intense Chocolate Flavor
text:
We drink a lot of café mochas here and this is really great for that. It is a very intense cocoa, so I can use less than I was. Makes great hot chocolate as well, but needs a fair amount of sugar in it to not be bitter. Dissolves well and the two pack should last quite a long time.

I am changing my review on this because I have recently read some very bad things about Hershey's and their practices. Fatal levels of lead and cadmium in my chocolate don't make me very happy.

title: Never Fails
text: The only pectin I use. It never fails to set up and you can use way less sugar. Good recipes included and it is easy to make jams, jellies and other goodies.

title: Fantastic Products and Service
text: 5 stars all the way. I had a culturing problem with my first set of grains due to my own stupidity. They replaced them for me and sent a free gift. Excellent service with knowledgeable people. I will not buy cultures from anyone else. Easy to chat with someone when you are stuck.

title: Drainage Failure
text: Another sprouter failure. You can't sprout mucilaginous seed any other way so I have one of these. It is the biggest pain in the butt ever. Small size, small yield and the holes are a nightmare. They don't drain and you have to get a paper clip or a needle to get them cleaned out. It's the pits. Don't waste your money.

title: Very Strong Flavor
text: We have a problem getting any decent olive oil where we live. I thought I would try this. It is OK, but seems very strong to me as if it had been stored in heat. Not good for dipping bread for sure. OK for cooking. Wish I didn't have 2 tins of it to use.

title: Yummy Mixer
text: We love this stuff. Since we moved to the back of beyond, Amazon is the easiest way to get it. Great with a little gin and some lime.

title: Nice Flavor But Not Crispy
text:
I love kale chips. Make them all the time in the dehydrator. They are crispy and wonderful. These, while having a good flavor, are not at all crispy or crunchy. They are kind of gummy in texture which I think comes from all the stuff they added to them to make them Ranch flavored.
I don't think shipping agreed with them either as they are pretty much destroyed. I am eating them with a spoon. :))

title: Good Value
text: I got this to try when my bottle of Texas Super Food ran out. I would say it is very comparable and quite a bit less money. No startling results to report, but I haven't grown a third eye or anything yet so that's a good start.

title: Fun Selelction Of Unique Flavors
text: Great selection of flavored coffees. This a great way to try some different things before you buy a whole box. In fact, who knew there were so many k cup flavors out there in the first place. GMC doesn't carry them for sure. The Martinsons, Cake Boss and Crazy Cup flavors are all really good.  Come of the Guy Fieri ones are good, some didn't appeal to us. What I did find out is that there is some inconsistency in the Crazy Cup flavors. I purchased a full box of the Peppermint Mocha and they weren't nearly as tasty as the ones that came in the sample pack for some reason.

title: No Mintiness At All
text: I got some of this in sample pack and loved it. So I purchased the 22 count pack and I swear it is not the same product. There is no minty flavor at all and it doesn't even taste like the samples I was sent before. There seems to be a lack of consistency in the production line somewhere.

title: Hideously Sweet
text: I've been seeing these in the stores and was curious to try some. There is nothing "cookie" like about these. They are pure honey with some nuts floating around in them. The only way they were palatable was smeared with some natural peanut butter to cut the sweetness. ICK!

title: Great Stuff
text: I use this exclusively because I am the only one that uses milk in my house. This keeps so much longer than fresh milk from the diary case and it is handy to have whenever.

title: Fresh, Fast, Fantastic!
text: We just tried this for dinner. As someone who cooks every day of the week, I am always looking for good, natural, preservative free short cuts. They are harder to find than you may imagine. Made this with a lovely organic pork roast, homemade whole grain tortillas, and some homemade guacamole. Better than most restaurant meals without all the GMO crap and unknown food entities. Awesome!

title: No Hazelnut Flavor
text: This is grossly sweet and does not have much flavor other than being sweet. BLECH!.. Big disappointment. Was hoping for a better product at this exorbitant price.

title: Yucky Sweet
text: This is just really sweet and doesn't have a chocolate flavor at all. I am very disappointed as I have used Monin for many years. YUCK!

title: My Go To Bread Mix
text: I've been using this stuff for years and I love it. Mix it up in the food processor and throw it into the dehydrator to rise. Excellent base mix that can be added to in many ways.

title: To Die For
text: This syrup is to die for and an absolute must for making a Garden of England cocktail.  Absolutely divine. I only wish it was Amazon Prime, because the shipping costs as much as the syrup.

title: Thick??? Thick You Say???
text: Just wanting to add my two cents here so that maybe someone else won't get caught like I did. I have been a customer of Republic of Tea before there was an internet, so I like their stuff. I bought this as a treat because it says "a THICK naturally sweet....". OK. I tried it with one teabag. Not thick. Tried it with 2 and a splash of cream. Not thick. People thick is Bellagio sipping chocolate. This is just tea...

title: Pretty Good, But....
text:
I was really excited to try this being the chocoholic that I am. On the upside, this is a nice sized bar. The eye appeal is good. It is very dark and smooth looking and feels luxurious when you run a finger across it. This has good mouth feel and melts smoothly and is creamy. The ingredients are minimal which is a good thing and the soy lecithin is non GMO which is awesome.

On the downside, I found the way the bar is molded a little strange. The pieces are triangular in shape which requires unwrapping the whole bar and getting a knife to break off a piece. I prefer squares that I can break off one at a time. The taste of this is very exotic with a bit of a bitter finish. I wouldn't recommend it to just anyone. I think it would only be appealing to someone who really enjoys trying different chocolate.

title: Best Rice Mix Ever!
text: This whole grain rice mix is versatile and is an everyday staple at our house. Excellent quality and a good cooked result every time. We love it baked in the oven with chicken!

title: Don't Overbake!
text: I made these this afternoon as a little treat. They are pretty good, but more like a cake square than a brownie. I actually frosted them with some icing. Watch the bake time though. I only needed to bake these for about 17 minutes. Probably could have done 15.

title: Very Good Popcorn
text: I purchased this popcorn and found it to be fresh, excellently flavored and very poppable. Good popcorn. Great taste, fun colors.

title: Yummy!
text: I have been buying this coffee for a long time and it is consistently excellent with a great chocolate flavor.

title: Delicious
text: The price was ridiculous, but it is so hard to find these and they are my husband's favorite.

title: I eat an average of 6-8 of these a day and these are definitely different-almost too sweet but also a slight after taste
text: These are harder and darker than the other chews I've had. I eat an average of 6-8 of these a day and these are definitely different-almost too sweet but also a slight after taste. Ick.  I don't like these-quality control issue, maybe?  They come from Indonesia, but did not come with a list of ingredients.

title: Nope
text: I eat gin gins all the time. These don't taste like other gin gins.  The package is the same, but these were very hard and dark and have a different taste.  There was no packaging so I can't even see what the ingredients were.  Tastes like something was added. I don't like them

text: Love it

text: Flavor not that great

title: Great coffee flavor
text: Love this buttery coffee flavor

title: Ok
text: Ok

title: Excellent
text: I really like the flavor and price vs a real vanilla pod.  Only way to go was excellent in my Creme’ Brûlée

title: Great flavor!
text: These are good,but they do not taste like normal pop tarts! I personally love the taste,but my kids do not like them! I think they are more of an adult pop tart! I love they are non-GMO verified and certified organic! They taste wonderful to me! We just recently switched te kids to an all organic diet,so I am sure it will take a little while for them to get used to it! I highly recommend and I will definetly buy again!

title: Great Taste!
text: My kids absolutely love these! They are really delicious and I am very happy with my purchase! We recently switched to all organic and they love these for a snack! I have 6 kids and they all love them! I highly recommend them! I will definitely purchase again! I love the fact they are non-GMO verified and certified organic! I feel good about feeding these to my children!

title: Good size and as described
text: Its not too large for a small cake and not too small to go unnoticed. It's exactly like the picture

title: Zero Stars for Being so Delicious
text: These are too good - the tangy, fruity outside and the sugary gum inside...delightful! I became addicted to crunching on them. I hold them directly responsible for the 4 lbs I gained in two weeks once I started putting these on my desk.

title: Enticing
text: I work alone for half the day and it's too quiet and boring. The solution? A giant bowl of candy! Now everyone comes by to grab a piece and I force them to talk to me. They get candy, I get conversation, everyone is happy. Since it's a law enforcement facility, they really like the blue wrappers. This bag is huge and the candies were fresh and wrapped properly (unlike some of the other bulk bags on here). Very satisfied with the purchase. Will buy again.

title: Satisfactory
text: Arrived in good condition, no issues at all. Product as expected. My coworkers gobbled them up.

title: Don't go green!
text: These candies are generally good - not too sweet, not too tart, and the flavors taste very natural. The green ones, however, are just atrocious. They don't taste like anything that occurs in nature. Sort of like fermented lime that's been marinated in pine needles soaked in PineSol. Truly awful. There are way too many green ones in the bag, too, the color distribution is not equal. You know how Starburst is stingy with the pink ones? This is the opposite where about 1/3 of the bag are greens. No one in my office will eat them so we're amassing quite a pile of them and short of torture, I don't know what we can do with all of them. Give them out on Halloween to punish bad children...?.

title: Meh
text: I ordered two of these. The lettuce on the bottom was mushy in both. Meager toppings. Helped me resolve to make my own salads from now on. The dressing is tasty so I'm giving it an extra star for that.

title: Violation of the Geneva Convention
text: This meal is so terrible it should be classified as a war crime. I am haunted by the cloying "herb" crust. The memory of the texture of the chicken makes me get into the fetal position and whimper. My Grandma used to smash up all the food on our plates and say, "It's all going to the same place, anyway!" That's what this reminds me of, if my Grandma was also the worst cook in America. Do you like food mysteries? You may enjoy closing your eyes and trying to determine where one ingredient ends and the next begins. To say that this was like bad airline food is an insult to bad airline food. In summary, it's an abomination. Also, the potatoes were brown. Not kinda brown, not a little brown, actually solid brown all the way through.

title: Sounded like a good idea but tastes terrible - just like ...
text: Sounded like a good idea but tastes terrible - just like a diet soda including the weird aftertaste. This wouldn't fool anyone. Inexcusably expensive for 8 oz.

title: Very good.
text: As others have mentioned, there is not much in the way of quantity. This would maybe make two sandwiches or one salad. It's tasty, though, and I already re-ordered it. It's on the sweeter side and didn't have a strong curry flavor. I put it on a bed of lettuce and added some scallions and grapes to stretch it a little.

title: Mamma Mia
text: This is the gold standard in Tuscan oil. Bright, peppery, buttery rich. Only a fraction of green olives make the cut for this production. This price is outrageous, however. You can call Italy to order and even with shipping it will be half this price. I was just in one of their factories yesterday and checked the cost.

title: Too heavy and damaged on arrival
text: These are way to heavy for cake toppers, one astronaut came all scratched up. They are not sturdy. I would not recommend at all.

title: One Star
text: Made with genetically modified ingredients. Tossed them immedialty.

title: Definitely not diet food
text: I wouldn’t wish these upon my worst enemy—they don’t deserve them! These things are highly addictive. Definitely not diet food 😕

title: My weirdo kid loves these
text: As absolutely disgusting as these sounds, they apparently are good. I didn’t try them, but my 12-year-old did, and she loved them. Then again, she used to enjoy apples with ketchup. So, if you have a weird child, or are yourself a weirdo, these may end up being a hit in your house. Bon appetit!

title: No change
text: I haven’t noticed a change in my milk supply. I only do one bag a day, the taste isn’t to bad at first but it’s hard to finish the whole bag. For me it taste more like dry hard peanut butter while chewing it.

title: Love the results this far
text: So we just moved into our new apartment and noticed several ants. We had management bring in the  pest control and spray on Friday. To be on the safe side we baits to insure they are 100% gone. I noticed they were almost all gone this morning (Saturday). Tomorrow morning I will mop and place new traps, I plan to do this every other day. As the pest control guy said that all the other units had to spray in order for the ants to be gone completely. I figure if we keep placing traps we will avoid them coming back to us. Only time will tell but so far I am liking the results

title: Five Stars
text: My favorite flavor of Crio, hands down.

title: I love Crio and this was my favorite flavor
text: I love Crio and this was my favorite flavor...until I found Maracaibo, which is better.  Still, Cavalla is still yummy!

title: Great for a Gin martini!
text: My husband loves to use these for his gin martinis!

title: I thought I had self control.....
text: So, first I would just like to say how delicious these are and I am so glad Amazon suggested them, (they know me so well)... However, I have gone completely off the rails and literally eaten almost all the bags within the last 4 days. Even though they are individually packaged, that didn't stop me. I would definitely recommend these, especially as a subscribe and save item, since they are a little spendy.

title: Super cute, and a great price
text: These were adorable and inexpensive!

title: An Absolutely Decadent Popcorn Treat that Makes an Excellent Gift
text:
While I am not a fan of cakes or baked goods, candied popcorns and nuts are among my favorite of treats. I have received these as gifts and purchased different varieties from artisans around the world.

This toffee popcorn with nuts is absolutely delicious. 1 pound of top of the line ingredients, perfectly crafted and freshly delivered.

This makes a perfect gift for people you are struggling to figure out what to buy them for Christmas - this is guaranteed to fit and they will surely love every bite of this treat. I know I did!

title: Gorgeous Sprinkles that Are Actually Created with Care
text:
These sprinkles go far beyond just looking good - which they do. These white and pink bubbles, dots, and dashes make cookies, cakes or cupcakes standout. This is an amazing topper that will make your desserts pop.

While sprinkles won’t ever be classified as a health food these are actually made free of artificial dyes, soy free, gluten free, and Certified Kosher. There are only 3g of sugar per serving which is a fraction of typical sprinkles - and more importantly they taste AMAZING.

WONDERFUL PRODUCT!

title: Excellent Set of Sauces - Rich Flavor Profiles
text:
This set of sauces makes a gorgeous gift for lovers of sauces, peppers, spices and foodies of all sorts. This comes in a beautiful gift box with confetti as padding - the presentation is superb.

Each of the sauces is very good. They are thick, rich, spicy but not so spicy that they are overpowering. The truffle flavor can be detected as an undertone but is definitely not readily apparent - unless it was on the label I’m not sure I would have recognized it being in the sauce.

The Sriracha Sauce is particularly good on burgers and as a dipping sauce while the Buffalo Sauce is among the best wing sauces I’ve had. Both are excellent and are sure to be thoroughly enjoyed.

Great set that makes an awesome gift.

title: Awesome Sauce!
text:
As a lover of dips, glazes and sauces I was really excited to test this new sauce by Best Foods. While I have yet to try the other flavors we have loved the Creamy Bourbon BBQ!

This can be used as either a sauce or dip but does not work well as a glaze unless mixed with other ingredients.

This is not too sweet and definitely does not have spices that I would feel the need to warn anyone about. The flavor profile is rich, a bit smoky, with hints of bourbon undertones that are not overpowering.

We have used this with great success on pork and chicken - added during the final minutes of cooking. As mentioned earlier, if added earlier as you would a glaze the sauce tends to run off the foods during cooking.

This is also ideal for dipping. We’ve enjoyed it with a host of different dippable foods - fries, poppers, onion pedals, etc.

This is a sauce I definitely recommend and one we will purchase more of in the future.

title: Excellent Sauce for Dipping or Coating
text:
We love trying new sauces, so much in fact, that and unique spices are what we collect on vacation. When out of town, and out of the country, we enjoy visiting markets and eating at different restaurants, always testing spices and sauces looking for something new and unusual.

We have found that it amazing how a certain spice or sauce can completely change the taste of a common food. We enjoy pairing foods and sauces you normally don’t expect together and have discovered wonderful combinations in the process.

This Sweet Thai Chili Sauce by Sauce Brothers is wonderful. While not near as spicy as many Thai sauces, this has a perfect balance between the heat of cayenne with the sweet of sugar, and garlic rounds the flavor profile perfectly.

I have used this sauce on grilled chicken, as a glaze on pork chops and pork tenderloin, as a basting sauce on fish and shrimp, on burgers and on vegetables. I even added a tsp to the inside of an omelette which with the ham, bacon, onion and pepper jack cheese was delicious.

This sauce is incredibly versatile - definitely not limited to only chicken wings, actually I’ve nearly used the entire bottle and have yet to do wings.

This is a product I will certainly keep in stock in our home and wouldn’t hesitate to recommend.

title: A Hearty Breakfast - as a bar in a plastic wrapper?
text:
When I received this product I was skeptical as to whether we would like it. The members of my family are not huge fans of breakfast bars in general. I have struggled for years to get, my now 16 year old, son to eat breakfast during his morning rush before heading out to catch the bus before school.

When this arrived, like all products that are for the family, I placed it upon the table and received feedback from each member prior to tasting.

The box that holds the 12 (1.5 ounce) bars had split during the shipping process therefore the initial presentation to my family wasn’t optimal. I am, by far, the most adventurous of eaters in our family and initial reactions by the others was less than enthusiastic.

The following morning my son and I split one as a test. Now it is hard to exactly describe these bars. The consistency is moist but not greasy although when looking through the wrapper I expected it to be. It is meaty but not tough and chewy like a jerky. After we took the first bite we thought about it and decided it reminded us of the consistency of a breakfast sausage link with the taste of bacon and maple syrup. As we both finished our half bar we were quite impressed with this little treat.

Over the course of the month each member of the family tested this product and while everyone liked it but my son and I remained the biggest fans. After a while I noticed we were down to 4, then the box only had 1 remaining - he had secreted 3 away leaving me the 1 lonely bar... Time to order more.

In regards to nutrition these bars do not pack the nutritional punch that many meal bars do. Each bar has 170 calories, with 110 coming from fat (12g / Saturated 5g), Cholesterol 140mg, Sodium 500mg, Total Carbs 6g (no fiber / Sugar 4g), Protein 9g and minimal vitamins.

My bars had an expiration date that was 10+ months from when I received them and each was sealed perfectly. We experienced no issues in regards to packaging or proper sealing.

We found this to be an excellent tasting, easy to grab and go meal bar. It is more filling than we anticipated and we found ourselves enjoying them far more than we initially thought we would.

This is definitely a product we would recommend trying.

title: Totally worth it for fruit tea fans
text:
When the teas arrived, I was pleased to find them in tins, individually wrapped in a sanitary seal, instead of in small bags.

The teas (and included fruity bits and bobs) are high quality, and the smell and taste is absolute perfection.

I was looking for a good tropical tea both for hot and cold purposes. So, naturally, Tropicana was my first cup.

The tea is as much a delight for the eyes and nose as it is fornthe palette. The blue flecks of cornflower, as well as the red thistle and marigold reminded me of the colors of a Renoir painting. The smell is almost reminiscent of a mango/citrus combination. The taste is more floral than that.

Absolutely delightful and no one ingredient overpowered the others. They combined in a symphony of summer on my tongue.

The next one I tried was Gold Rush. The scent of passionfruit was strong, but not perfumey. It has a smooth floral flavor with a bite of passionfruit on the finish. The peach gets a little lost in this, but if you seek it out you will find it.

I found myself smiling a lot while drinking this and I think a lot of that is due to that passonfruit/floral scent. I sit in the midst of a horrendous ice storm here in Michigan, yet even though I hear the ice pelting my window, my mood has me feeling like I'm somewhere tropical. This is one of my favorites.

The Strawberry Kiwi smells as strong as a Snapple and the blue of cornflower stands out among the black tea. The taste is light, the flavor balanced with the tannins in the tea.

I have yet to try the Blackberry, Raspberry, or Vanilla but the smells and quality of the ingredients is similar in these teas to those flavors I did try.

They include the brewing guide on the bottom of the box, but I think it would also be nice for a measurement chart for those new to loose leaf tea.

All in all, I am extremely pleased with the tea and will absolutely be ordering again. Definitely recommend.

title: These are incredible
text:
Not only are these beautiful and fun to watch, but the tea itself is incredibly flavourful and is not at all like tea that comes from a bag. Once the hot water reaches the seed pod, the process begins immediately. The pod opens and begins to bloom. Within a few minutes it sinks down in the water and opens fully, releasing the tea into the water. Watching the process happen is delightful and the tea that comes from it is much better than the dried tea leaves that I am used to.

The tea brews rather fast, and within minutes it is ready to pour and enjoy. I definitely think this is more fun than using a tea bag!

The pods come in individual packages that are well sealed, so they would make an ideal gift. Each one is different and each of them are named. I really enjoyed this and encourage other tea drinkers to give it a try. i think I might be hooked on this stuff now.

I was able to reuse the same bloom more than once as well, so it is a pretty good deal for the money. I recommend it

This review is based on my experience after using a Tea Beyond Tea Set and these flowering tea blooms. All opinions are my own.
