The bag has a ziploc closure to keep the product fresh. And the pouch stands up for easy storage and identification. I’m very happy with this and plan to reorder when I run out.

title: Putrid 🤮
text: This tasted so bad I gagged. I’ve used sesame and tahini products all my life. This is seriously the worst tahini product I’ve ever used. I thought my taste buds might be off from covid 2 months prior. But husband confirmed grossness level. I threw it out.

title: Beautiful color!
text: True to its name, this steeps a deep, blue color. It smelled fresh upon opening. It had a ziploc closure to maintain freshness and the bag stands upright to store. This is my 1st time using pea flower. It’s supposed to help with lowering blood pressure and maintain skin health. I took 1 star off because this product is the entire bud, not just the petals. So I have to rip the base off of each flower so the petals are loose. I prefer all my tea to be “loose leaf” as I feel it brews a better cup. Still, a very nice product.

title: Solid 4 stars
text: I’ve blended quite a bit of tea with this. Marigold is filled with lutein which helps strengthen your eyes and I like to drink it regularly. I wish there were less buds and more petals. I find myself picking off the petals and just using those. The taste is sweeter, the color more pure. I just prefer it. I don’t think I’ll reorder this again, I’ll look for one with a higher petal content. That said, the quality of the marigold is very good. It comes in a resealable bag and stands upright to store.

title: Fresh, top quality!
text: I’ve been adding this to my daily smoothies. It was completely sealed in this cylinder and upon opening, smells green and fresh. There were no clumps and it’s a fine powder. Just a single teaspoon turns everything a deep, dark green and adds tons of nutrients.

title: I enjoyed both flavors
text: I get that both these flavors tasted crisp, slightly sweet and were enjoyable. I Kept them cold and they both were slightly bubbly. A nice alternative to coffee for a later afternoon pick me up. They both are fortified with minerals and vitamins. I didn’t feel shaky or jittery after enjoying.

title: Lovely to work with
text: This 5lb bag of organic flour is so fresh and soft! It makes delicate pastry and cookies. It seems like it is a top quality product. I’m so happy to be able to bake with it!

title: Fresh!
text: 4 pounds of fresh arrowroot powder! This bag is resealable and stands upright when storing. You can use this instead of flour to thicken sauces and soups. You have to mix 1st with water in a separate container. Then add that to your recipe, for best results.

title: Looks and smells beautiful! 🌹
text: This entire bag is filled with entact rose buds. They are all a rich pink color and smell like, um. ROSES! These are food grade. I’ve been using mine in tea and am very happy with how the flavor infuses into the brew. The bag has a ziploc closure and stands up to store, saving you storage space!

title: Gorgeous color. Very lumpy.
text: We had to use an immersion blender to get the hard lumps out of this. Hand whisking won’t do it. The flavor is sweet and smells lovely too. I wish it was just *slightly* more intense. The real beauty of this powder tho is the color. It’s achingly beautiful. It adds a pure, saturated, organic pink to teas and baked good. It’s like nothing I’ve ever used before and I’m having a lot of fun with it. The pouch has a ziplock closure and stands up for easy storage and identification.

title: So pretty
text: This is just for the print and it’s on thick card stock. The colors are bold and the print is excellent quality. I love the flowy look and how unique this print is. It has an art nouveau feel to it but it’s current.

title: Great flavor!
text: This is nice to have in the pantry to add to cooking, or ice cream or jams. The pieces are about the size of a dime so you can dice the portion to whatever size is appropriate. The ginger is chewy and sweet with a hint of spice. The entire outside is coated with sugar crystals. You may be tempted to snack on the pieces just as they are but after looking at nutrition label, I noticed 1 serving has 80 grams of sugar in it. Yikes!

title: Amazing tea!
text: Wow! This tea is like nothing I’ve ever drank before. Upon opening, you can see high quality ingredients. Bits of lemongrass and licorice, pieces of ginger, while peppercorns and a dusting of turmeric. Once steeped, it’s a relaxing, healing tonic with all the flavors melding perfectly to make your cup an experience! The tin can be washed and reused. The wooden portion spoon is a nice touch and you can reuse it with salt or spices. I’m so happy I tried this!

title: Nice flavor!
text: This came in an amber colored , 4oz bottle. It had a safety seal on it. The flavor is like a medium sweet red raspberry. I used it in ice cream and the ice cream really did taste like raspberries! I like the larger quantity. I have enough to make another batch!

title: Tastes like real cherry!
text: I bake several times a week and am always exploring new flavors in cakes or pound cakes. This flavoring has been fun to use and I really like it. It’s a 4oz bottle which is really nice. So many of the flavors at the store come in teeny 2oz bottles. This should last a while. It’s in an amber colored bottle to prevent breakdown of taste. It actually tastes like cherry too. Not too sour or fake. I plan on ordering this again when I’m done with this bottle.

title: What beautiful flavors!
text: This tea! So beautiful! It’s naturally sweet and I’ve never used honey or sugar while drinking. There are evident pieces of pineapple and berries in it. Everything looks fresh and smells fresh. I use 1.5 tsp for 6-8oz of water. Produces a flavorful and sweet cup of tea. This is blended with white tea donut does have a little caffeine in it. Perfect for mid-day boost!

title: Tastes fresh!
text: This makes a lovely cup of bright, lively hibiscus tea. The color is the intense pink you’d expect. The smell is fresh and earthy. Tastes slightly tannic and tropical and sweet. Makes amazing iced tea too. Looks and tastes like top quality!

title: Makes a decent cup of coffee
text: This is pretty decent coffee. I usually enjoy a French roast with all the oils and dark color. This is a little paler than that and drier. It smells fresh and comes ground for a drip coffee maker. The 100% Guatemalan Orgin is pretty cool and the packaging is charming.

title: Gross!
text: These look appealing and the nutritional content lines up with my lifestyle. They are soft but taste bland, chalky and fake.  Yuck! I would never reorder these and even if I’m starving would be hesitant to reach for one for sustenance.

title: Nice spice
text: Smells and tastes super fresh. The powder is very fine and I don’t see any clumps. Adds warmth and depth to my soups or chili’s. Generous portion will last a long time so I put this in freezer to preserve freshness.

title: So yummy! 🌶
text: Delicious chili oil! 🌶 Full flavored and spicy!  But I really enjoy the heat level. It’s not “blisters on your mouth” hot but you definitely feel the heat. Adds complexity and flavor to ANYTHING!! Eggs, soup, noodles, rice.

title: Makes my stomach cramp!
text: I really love protein shakes. They are incredibly useful to have on hand so you don’t skip a meal. I drink them several times a week. For some reason, this particular shake made my stomach cramp very bad. Especially if I drank it for breakfast on a completely empty stomach. The cramping lasted for a freakishly long time too. They taste great though and are loaded with both protein and fiber. Sometime in the formula just doesn’t jive with me.

title: Fresh and Vibrant!
text: This tumeric is bright yellow and very fine. It smells and tastes fresh and full of flavor. It has a ziplock pouch for sealing and the pouch stands up so storing in the pantry is easy.

title: Cute, extremely sweet!
text: These are toothache inducing sweet.  It very sour and they don’t have a massive watermelon taste. However, they do taste good and the texture is perfect! The sugar over the outside is pleasant and a nice amount. The shape of the candy is precious. The packaging is hip and keeps all moisture out. The individual bags don’t have a ziplock closure, so you’ll have to eat the entire bag! 😸😸😸

title: Good stuff!!
text: I love drinking this before bedtime. I taste predominantly lavender. Then hints of chamomile. Very soft and mild. There’s about 1.5 tsp./ bag. Tastes fresh, smells fresh.

title: Glad we tried it, but won’t reorder.
text: We made this yesterday. As other reviewers have said, it takes a very long time to cook. And the bubbles never *quite* got done. The flavor is awesome though. And it was a fun experience. I will not reorder this product again, but it wasn’t a waste of time.

title: I like the taste.
text: This stuff tastes pretty good. Not fake sweet. Good clusters, and you can see ingredients, so you know what you’re eating. My kids liked it too. Overall, I would order again. And this is a nice choice for those following a low sugar diet.

title: Gorgeous flavor!
text: Tart and full bodied. This is all organic and made in India. The tea is very small pieces and the bag holds about a teaspoon of product. I steeped for about 3 minutes and got a rich red color. Tastes great iced too!!

title: Fun to use!
text: These pens are filled with food coloring and are totally safe to eat. They are fun for kids to use on fondant. Then, I put the fondant onto baked goods. I can’t stress enough how mess-free they are!! Even the smallest of hands can hold the pen, create something, and not have spills everywhere. Nice array of colors and they stay put without bleeding.

title: Yummy!
text: These are yummy! Not as hot as takis or even hot Cheetos. But juuuuuust hot enough to make you want to keep eating! They are grooved/wavy shaped so the seasoning gets coated into the ridges and they are nice and crisp. Also, I noticed they don’t leave a residue on my fingers like hot Cheetos. The box has 9oz of product. Lasts a while for casual snacking.

title: High quality, pricey!
text: Very very cool concept. Peaceful Squirrel picks out 15 awesome, healthy, hip snacks and ships to you in a bright, cheerful box. The second I opened this, my kids POUNCED! That’s why the the box is half-full in my included photo. There’s fruit snacks, protein snacks, salty snacks. Everything label-wise, shows that they all are made with top quality ingredients. Everything was in good shape when it arrived; no smashed or crushed bags/boxes. I took off a star because of the price. $42.00 for 15 snack bags. Making each snack about $2.90. Mind you, a few of the snacks are fruit rolls at .42 oz a pack. So, not cost effective for too many budgets. *this arrived with a reusable tote too. Very cool!

title: ❤️❤️❤️So incredibly flavorful!! ☕️
text: This tea tastes AMAZING!! I love complexity of black licorice and earthiness of anise. I love the warmth of ginger and the zing of lemongrass. This tea hits all notes!! Brews up pale gold in color and is extremely flavorful. I’d say you’d have to enjoy the above mentioned flavors to enjoy this tea. I do, and it’s one of the best I’ve tried. All organic, real ingredients you can see.

title: I’ve decided I like these.
text: With some experimenting, these can really be useful to have and cook with. I found that I like the way they taste when I soak them in oil vs water. I add a little pinch of salt and stir. I let them rest for about 30 minutes. They taste like a mellow red bell pepper after that. I’ve used them in quiche, rice, soup.

title: Lovely flavors
text: Totally fresh and high quality product. This Yerba maté is earthy and rich tasting. I love it alone or steeped with a bit of peppermint. I use about 1.5 tsp per serving so this generous portion will last quite a while. The bag stands to store and has a ziploc closure. This brand makes such awesome teas. Ive never had a bad one.

title: Underwhelmed
text: Just Ok on  flavor. It tastes a little like rice water. It is not sweet. There isn’t an overwhelming flavor of peppermint. It will taste really sad if you only use water. You must use milk/milk substitute for a richness this lacks. In the 80’s, some parents gave carob chips to their kids instead of chocolate. It fooled no one!  This is the carob-equivalent.

title: Surprised with this!
text: I didn’t expect my family to enjoy this since I usually only feed them homemade Mac n cheese. They loved it and asked for more! 1 box only fed 2 people though. It was a main course. Also, this comes with 2 pepper pouches. I only used one and my 8 yr old said it was heavily seasoned. So, start with less and taste. Then season to your liking. Pasta cooked up quickly without too much starchy quality. Cheese sauce was lump-free and silky.

title: Excellent product!!
text: Lovely, full flavors. Sweet at the first taste, gradually gets warmer. So awesome on cornbread and warm yeast rolls. The texture is perfectly smooth. I highly recommend and plan on ordering more because it’s so addictive!!

title: Great flavors!
text: The box these came in was totally thrashed and crushed. If you’re planning on giving as a gift, you’ll need to transfer to a prettier bag or box. That said, All the glass bottles were in pristine condition. Safety sealed and super fresh. I’ve been enjoying all of them. The fajita blend is a lot like the blends of spices I use for enchiladas and tacos. I’ve been using the lemony garlic blend on chops and chicken. No clumping. The shaker holes are big enough to get a decent amount of spice out into your food.

title: Very nice packaging!
text: Nice little gift set. Comes with pink salt, white salt and peppercorns. The products looK and smell fresh. The glass jars are safety sealed and packaged so they won’t break. You’ll need salt and pepper grinders for these!

title: Too fake tasting
text: I had high hopes for these. They are super, sickeningly sweet and fake tasting. No one in my family, not even pre teens with a sweet tooth, could finish them. They have an intense coffee-flavor, coupled with an almost saccharin-like sweetness. Great packaging but absolutely inedible.

title: Top quality all around
text: Great tasting tea. And very nice packaging. Each pouch contains enough for a 10oz cuppa. You can see the chamomile flowers and other citrus pieces. The pouch is fairly easy to open. You can pour contents into infuser or transfer to a teabag and use. I love the flavors. You can definitely taste the citrus zing but it’s mellowed by Egyptian chamomile. I’m enjoying this tea a lot.

title: Not my favorite
text: I only brew a half pot of coffee per day so each one of these packets lasts me for 2 days. When I drink it, my stomach cramps up. I have tried it with cream and it doesn’t help. It just sort of tastes likefolgers. It smells fresh and is evenly ground. The packaging is great too but something on it doesn’t agree with me. I’ve been a coffee drinker for 30 yrs and generally like whole bean starbucksfrench roast. It’s nice to have tiny portions in case I ever run out of my normal, daily roast.

title: Dang these are good!!!
text: I’m, these taste like the crispy edges of chocolate brownies! I absolutely love them. They are light and crumbly and just a few satisfy a sweet craving. The chocolate is more a bitter/sweet. Oddly, none of my children like them! Not sweet enough I guess. I was shocked but secretly happy because I get to enjoy them all and now don’t have to share! 😂😂😂😂 Nice packaging too. The bag stands upright for easy storage and seals completely.

title: I really like these!!
text: Nice pouch of fruit. Nothing was too shriveled or dry. Good variety too. Not too big a serving. I would use 2 of these to toss into a salad. And can def eat 1 all to myself. So, pricewise, it can get a little costly. That said, it’s so nice to have fruit available year round! My 8 yo didn’t like the prunes. 😆

title: Delicious!
text: I love love love this product! It’s so helpful if you are following a keto diet to have a chocolate treat every now and again. It’s not sweet but it is warm-tasting and satisfying and tastes like cocoa. All the chunks are different sizes. And it melts easily over a double boiler or microwave. I let my children all try these too. The teens loved it but the 8yo thought it was gross.

title: hands down, the BEST herbal tea!
text: This tea is astounding! The tin it's shipped in is thick and locks to keep air out. Upon opening, you can smell fresh, sweet berry and hibiscus. There are visible berries and large portions of ingredients. I use 2 tsp for a large mug of water and steep for a few minutes. I don't use sweetner of any kind because this packs so much flavor in it. I've gone thru 2 tins already and am about to order more for the winter. AWESOME! YOU WON'T BE DISAPOINTED!

title: Just ok. Made in Canada.
text: My kids couldn’t stand this. I thought is was ok. It’s very thin in consistency and has a mild cinnamon flavor. I plan on using it for our hot cocoa this winter so we can use it up. I found it odd that the container announced this was a Texas product. It’s actually made in Canada and then packaged and marketed in Texas. So if you are looking for a local-vore product, this is not it. As it has to travel thousands of miles, and into another country to get to you.

title: Looks beautiful.
text: Yes, we know these are shipped in too big a bottle. If they were shipped in a 1 oz container we wouldn't feel so duped. That said, this is a very reasonable price for gold and silver edibles. The clarity of powder is lovely. The fineness of it magical looking as it's dusted on baked goods. I'm giving it 5 stars because of the quality of product and price, not packaging.

title: Pros and cons.
text: Flip top, plastic bottle. Honey is from Mexico and packaged in Texas. A bit overpriced for Mexican Honey considering you can buy twice the amount for same price of boutique honey, locally. Tastes great. Quite sweet.

title: Very pricey!
text: My honey arrived sealed and filled to the top. The jar is small! I think it's way overpriced. This honey is made in Mexico and packaged and distributed in Texas. You won't get any allergy boosts unless it's truly local. The flavor is delicious. Delicate and floral and sweet. The lid screws on tight and mine hadn't shown any signs of crystals.

title: Yummy!!
text: Really rich and pure tasting peanut butter! I was suprised. Spreads easily and has a very smooth consistency. I'd totally order this again.

title: gross!
text: No one in my family of 6 could stomach this. It's really soft and creamy tasting and doesn't taste like citrus or strawberry. I am a fan of emergen c and other pouch drinks. I just couldn't with this.

title: This was pretty gross
text: I didn't like this coffee at all. I drink coffee every day. This had a very chemically-affected flavor. It gave me a tummy ache after drinking it. The grind is coarse and the bag is supposed to seal shut, but didn't work very well.

title: Not my favorite roast
text: These are easy to use, I think I just don't like kona coffee very much. Especially when compared to the other coffees in this line up, like the Rowanda roast. This comes 10 to a box.

title: 5 out of 5 stars
text: I'm so impressed with this entire line up of organic pour overs. Beautiful roasted, balanced and flavorful; sweet caramel and cocoa undertones. It really does tastes like a high end coffee house cup. The box isn't glued strongly together and was falling apart when I received it. But each packet is sealed in a mylar type envelope so the pouch wasn't damaged. I'll be reordering these.

title: What an incredible cup of coffee
text: This is one of the best cups of coffee I've ever had. Maybe the most balanced and flavorful. Never thought it'd come from a pre ground pourover! Pouch is easy to open and smells fresh upon opening. Organic and compact!

title: Makes great coffee!
text: I've been using this in my drip coffee maker. It's really good! I like a French roast normally. Really oily beans and caramel undertones are my favorite.  This coffee smells and tastes really good to me.

title: What a great cup of joe!
text: This is the 1st time I've had a coffee brand track it's origins so transparently. The date it was roasted to where it was grown etc all there on the label. I was so happy after I opened the bag so see shiny, oily, whole beans. They smell Heavenly! I used a butr grinder to grind the beans in a regular drip coffee machine. Beautiful flavors. Undertones of toasty vanilla and cocoa. So good!! I like artisan coffee and I also like Starbuck's french roast. This coffee has a robust dark quality to it that makes it right at the top of my list!

title: Average
text: Upon opening this bag, I noticed a heavy floral, cleanser-like scent. After Ibput begin pantry, I smelled it when I opened up the pantry door. The taste of product was affected as a result. It cooked up fine. But, I needed less water and more cooking time than instructions suggested.

title: Delicious!
text: My entire family loves these. They have 10 grams protein and 7 grams fat so they do a decent job of replacing a meal if needed. The maple isn't too overpowering, just adds a hint of sweetness. Responsibly packed, made in Utah. Expiration date 11 months out.

title: Excellent product
text: Everyone in my family loves these. They are made with the highest quality ingredients and taste so fresh. Mild sweetness from honey, 100% whole grain. Responsible packaging. 2 bars come in each pouch. Made in Utah.

title: Excellent quality
text: I love having powdered buttermilk in the pantry. Especially during quarentine when the store shelves still might not have everything I like, all the time. I use this for biscuits, pancakes and when I make fried chicken. The bag is resealable and stores upright.

title: Tastes great
text: These are a full meal replacement bar. Chewy, with evident sunflower seed flavor. That leads into a sweet cranberry/date flavor. I can be STARVING. Then, eat one of these and my blood sugar balances within 5 minutes

title: Not my favorite
text: No one un my 6 member family likes these. They taste like cheap, made from powder ice tea. They have a strange aftertaste too. The packaging is fantastic and makes you want to hold the can and enjoy it, but the taste isn't there.

title: Made in Italy. Misleading advertising. Tastes great.
text: I like the texture and taste of this oat milk. We drink it straight from fridge. And the package size is perfect for everyone to enjoy a single glass of chocolate milk with no left overs to have to refrigerate. With 25 grams of carbs and 16 grams of sugar per serving, we treat it like a dessert, similar to ice cream. Oats require 80% less water to grow than almonds and are a direct way to impact environment, the packaging touts. **HOWEVER, since this product is MADE IN ITALY, you don't reduce any carbon footprint, or reduce your impact AT ALL. It's produced in Europe, shipped over on a container, trucked to a warehouse, packed in a cardboard box once your order it, then driven to you via ups after you order it. And then you get to dispose of the box and packaging it shipped in. So, don't feel like you're making a positive impact to the world simply by ordering this. If you want yummy, italian oat milk though, here's your product!!

title: Why did I order these? So gross!
text: You know when you eat and little pieces of food get caught in your teeth and you rage til you can floss and rinse your mouth out? The remnants left from every bite of these disgusting things do that. It's totally unnerving feeling meat after the crunch of a chip. They feel extremely processed and massively flavored.

title: Loves me some Jerky!!
text: Super yummy jerky! You can tell a lot of time, thought and passion went into these products. Top quality ingredients, pleading texture and softness, excellent depth of flavor. Not too hot like "omg, what have I done?" But hot enough enough to feel the need to eat the entire bag in one setting. (Um, I might have done that)

title: Here's the cure(ing salt you need!)
text: Made in the USA pink curing salt. With this you can cure sausages, brisket, jerky, even bacon. 1 tsp/ 5 lb of meat. Has sodium nitrate in it and is not intended for table salt. Best by date is about 18 months out.

title: No one will eat it in my family
text: Not a favorite in my family. Everyone thinks it's chalky, flavorless and dry. Even with additional liquid added.

title: Not horrible. Not great.
text: These are ok. They are sort of gritty. The flavors are ok. Not too salty, or phony. I guess if you were a vegetarian,  this would suffice for a salty, crunchy craving. But maybe, just eat a rice cake!

title: I LOVE THESE DRINKS!!
text: This is the yummiest of all the flavors in this line up. Rich and creamy with no strange, fake aftertaste! I am still amazed at how veggies can be crammed in these. 4 grams fiber and 1 net carb. Great for any adult following keto, fun way for kiddos to enjoy a healthful treat.

title: Highest quality
text: Beautiful sea salt. Clean and pure taste. Nice size crystals. Comes in a resealable bag that stands upright for better storage. No iodine in this.

title: Superb!
text: I'm not sure how they got veggies and nutrition and fiber in these with so little carbs and sugar. Some of the best premade nutritional shakes I've had. Not too thick, more like consistency of milk. This vanilla has an almost malt-like flavor profile. I really like it and have 1 a day to replace a breakfast or lunch. The chocolate one is even better than vanilla!

title: Awesome nutrition, yucky flavor.
text: I love these shakes for the veggies, protein and fiber. It's just. this...flavor. It's so weird/fake/sweet that my 4 children refuse to drink it. I still drink it! But I can see what they mean. The chocolate and vanilla choices are more pure tasting.

title: Top quality ingredients, mild flavor
text: Crazy good quality of ingredients. Everything's organic and the spices smells super fresh. The flip top is easy to open and close and "clicks" shut so you don't spill it. Has never clumped in the bottle either. As far as flavor profile, I thought it'd be bolder, hence the 4 the stars. It's quite mild, with zero heat and gives a mellow flavor to anything you want to suss up.

title: Super fresh!
text: I use cumin more than any other spice other than salt. This product is lovely. Smells rich and fresh. The consistency is a fine powder and it mixes or blooms into your recipes with ease and flavor. The bag is resealable and it actually stays shut. It also stores standing upright. All organic. 7 oz bag.

title: I DO NOT SHARE MY BEEF JERKY
text: Why do I love beef jerky so much? Why is it so expensive?? This brand has lovingly created a boutique jerky! You can taste it in every bite. Not super soft jerky, like the kind that skeeves you out because you know "that's not-meat-jerky". But not overly tough like "Bubba-made-this-himself-after killing-it-watch-your-teeth-jerky". Grass fed, hormone free, no nitrates. Just subtle cherry wood smoke flavors, a lil salt and spice and lots of happy. The only bad thing about this jerky, is when you finish the 2.25 oz bag. Then, you cry.

title: These were a waste of $
text: LAME PRODUCT. I really wanted to adore these. I use bay in every soup, stew and savory dish I make. These looked so good in the picture. But upon opening them, I could tell they lacked quality. They are very dry, with no natural oils. Most disappointing is the fact that they aren't fragrant at all. They smell stale and a little like cardboard. They provide no enhancement or depth to any dish you make. Bummer.

title: Lovely Cuppa!
text: What lovely tea! Very delicate and slightly sweet. I don't use sweeteners in my tea ever. But it's nice to enjoy a hint of ginger, lemon and pear. Each box contains 16 individually wrapped tea bags and package has 6 boxes in it. All organic. Expiration date is over 2 years from today's date; nice and fresh!

title: Not my favorite
text: When I received this it was rolled super flat. The package was only about an inch thick. I don't know how that affects the integrity of coffee. The bag is only 10 oz so it doesn't last very long. As far as flavor goes, it's a bit on the acidic, citrusy side for me. I prefer a bit more cocoa/rich chocolate, low acid flavor profile. Grown in Ecuador, 100% arabica beans.

title: Mixed feelings about this product
text: These mustard seeds have a fine flavor to them. You can use them to add to your pickle brine, homemade seasonings,  or crush them and make your own homemade mustard. I gave this product 3 stars because the seeds I received were already 8 months old when I got them! So, the use by date is only 10 months away! Too bad. Also, massive waste in plastic packaging. The bucket was only half full upon opening. I get that the product is shipped "by weight and settles during shipping" but how about simply using a smaller bucket. Takes up a lot less space and uses less plastic.

title: WHAT A GREAT PRODUCT
text: I can't even with these. SO GOOD!! I still don't know how they packed a bunch of veggies into this while keeping sugar low. The chocolate tastes rich with no fake sweetness. The vanilla has a faint malt-like richness, the fruity one tastes EXACTLY like the milk left over after a bowl of fruity pebbles. I thought it'd be my favy, but the chocolate is so extremely well done that I ended up liking that one best. These are great for kids AND for adults who follow a low sugar lifestyle.

title: TOTALLY INSANELY GOOD
text: For sure, without a doubt, 100% the best jarred salsa/hot sauce I've ever enjoyed. It's addictive. Not even kidding. These are both pretty spicy. I'd say above medium, but not 5 alarm. The red one has massive adobo, smoky notes to it. If you mix it with sour cream, it's amazing with fish taco or corn chips. The green is freaking hot. Not zippy like salsa verde. More jalapeno based. I've been using over my eggs in the morning. I'm going to be sad when these are empty. I doubt I could make a homemade version as good as these! I'll reorder for sure.

title: Mixed reviews
text: The kids were split on these. Half liked them, half were grossed out by the floating pieces of coconut. Oddly, they haven't touched them after initial tastings and no one really cared for pineapple flavor. If you grew up with these, I bet you'd like them. But trying to introduce them as an alternative to frenzy pops or refreshing treat might not go over as well.

title: Awesome flavor
text: Awesome, caramel-y flavors, smells gorgeous upon opening too. The beans looked a little dry though. I'm partial to a more oily bean I guess. Makes an insanely good cup of coffee!

title: Very fresh
text: Smells like cocoa powder and coffee. Very fresh and comes in a resealable bag. I swap a few tablespoons of this for white flour in chocolate chip cookies and it tastes amazing!

title: Easy way to eat your veggies!
text: Pretty cool product. Comes with a small scoop. The consistency is like grains of sand, not a powder. Smells JUST like broccoli. I use in my morning smoothies.

title: Not what I expected
text: Wow! Super tart and thick. I have to mix half and half with water to drink this. There is minimal natural sweetness. I am having a hard time bringing myself to drinking these.

title: Superfood!!
text: Love this stuff! I've been adding a massive spoonful to my daily morning smoothie. It mixes in beautifully and I can't detect any weird seaweed-y smell. High in fiber, packed with vitamins. Happy to have this!

title: AMAZON-O'S!
text: These cookies taste fresh and sweet and just like the competition which rhymes with scoreo. I gave 4 stars because the bag is impossible to open. It's not sealable in anyway. I had to transfer mine to a gallon ziploc. That wastes a bag and uses unnecessary plastic; bummer.  And the edge cookies were all crumbled upon delivery. Still, crisp chocolate wafer. Smooth, creamy sweet middle. Amazon-O's!

title: Lovely!
text: Silky, rich flavors. I have enjoyed using this as a substitute for olive oil in my eggs and sauteed veggies. The plastic pour insert was broken upon arrival. All 3 bottles had same problem. Did not compromise flavor, but is a design flaw nonetheless.

title: I didn't like very much.
text: I drink at least 3 cups of coffee every morning and have for 25 years. When I drink this, it makes my stomach cramp! I've brewed this all week long and experienced the same tummy ache. The flavor is so-so. Medium roast. The beans are a little dull in color with not a lot of oils to them. I would never order this again and can't recommend it.

title: WHAT AN AMAZING PRODUCT
text: Every once in awhile I get to try a product on the Amazon Vine Program that I will continue to reorder again and again. This is one of those products. It is so good. SO GOOD!! I have been using it to make smoothies for the last 2 weeks. The warm, vanilla, toasty flavors are evident. The little flax seeds are almost like a teeny boba bubble. The saskatoon berries are mildly tart, the cocoa pieces are mellow and take second stage with the flavors. I only use 2 TBSP per smoothie, the serving size is 3 TBSP. It's a great portion! 7 grams of fiber, 10 grams protein, 5 grams fat. I mix with 1 cup unsweetened coconut milk. Tastes fresh and delicious and makes me super happy every day when I get to drink it!!

title: Not as good as the other ones in this lineup.
text: Of all the oils in this line up, this is my least favorite. The chili is reminiscent of chili powder, not red chilis or jalapenos. So it has a dry, off taste that doesn't balance well with the buttery rich taste of avocado oil. The plastic pour insert was also broken upon opening.

title: Beautiful flavors!
text:
Beautiful creamy flavor. Tastes exactly like a perfectly ripe avocado. I have been using in place of olive oil and like it a lot. Dark glass bottle with a plastic pour insert.
8.5 oz.

title: Delicious!
text: This stuff tastes SO GOOD. Exactly like apple cinnamon oatmeal. Creamy, rich and cinnamon-y. When you are starving and don't have time to make something to eat, this really does a suprising job of totally filling you up and satiating your hunger for several hours. Maybe that's the 7 grams of fiber in it working? The top has a safety seal and there's an extra safety seal under cap. My kids even like it.

title: Pretty good tea
text: Super convenient and easy to use. I made mine a little stronger than directions suggested. Kids and guests drank it all! Mixes up perfectly, amber is color, soft tannic smell, stores neat and clean. Not as delicate or as nuanced as traditional sun tea, but a great product to have on hand!

title: Kids didn't like it. But I did.
text: I like everything about this but my kids and husband do not. They refuse to drink it plain. It blends beautifully with no clumps. I used an immersion blender.  I think this is best for cooking. I made cornbread with it, for example and everyone said it was amazing. Next best application would be to mix this half and half with regular milk. The kids could barely detect it then.

title: Not my 1st choice. Or second. Or third.
text: I wanted to like this, but it's just o.k. The label in the front boasts 27 grams of protein. But if you read the small print, that is for a 3.5 oz serving. The back label clearly states a serving is 2 oz, so that 27 grams of protein is for almost the entire box. TOTALLY MISLEADING. Also, it creates a MASSIVE amount of foam. I attached a picture with my review of the huge stock pot I used to cook 1 box of pasta and the insane amount of foam brimming and spilling over the top. I only filled the stockpot up with 1/3 water. To use any smaller sauce pot would have been a huge, sticky mess. As for flavor, this tastes like lentils 100%. Which is fine but not overly delicious. The pasta does stick together somewhat too. If this is your only choice for pasta, then I guess you'd just put up with it. It's not my only choice for pasta though, so I will be sticking with barilla from here on out.

title: A well-made cup o'joe.
text: All of the bags in this 3 pack were very fresh and smelled rich and aromatic. The beans had a lovely sheen to them and had a great oil content. There were very few "quakers"; unroasted, broken, bad beans. The flavor, to me, was between a medium and bold roast and had low acid. It was never hard on my tummy, even if I drank 2 or 3 cups before breakfast. The bag is small though, and it's a little misleading. All coffee bags are usually12-16 oz and are charged accordingly. These bags are 10 oz each and don't last long. Over all a pleasant coffee experience. Probably my favorite coffee I've been offered thru vine program.

title: Some of the best snacks we've had
text: All my kiddos LOVE these. I admit, I eat them too because they taste so good. There is an evident banana flavor and the sweet sharpness of the dark chocolate comes thru with every bite. The pack has about 6 snack nuggets. Each one has visible grains in it and a chewy, firm texture. Love the amount you get too. Lasts a long time. I will be reordering when this box is almost empty, they are that good!

title: Maybe a little gimmicky
text: This is salt harvested from the San Francisco area blended with a probiotic. It does have a tendency to clump together so it won't shake out of the side freely all the time. Company does not disclose how much probiotic is actually in this. Kinda pricey for little tin too. But tastes just like classic table salt

title: Sweet treat!
text: These are pretty good. They are a little on the sweet side and do have quite a bit of sugar in them, so to me, they are more like a dessert. The coconut flavor comes through and they are pretty creamy. Don't shake before opening! Contents are under pressure and the drink will go EVERYWHERE. Ask me how I know...

title: Tastes fine. Good for shelf stable choice.
text: The broth in this is the real winner in my opinion. Easy to warm up and nice to have a shelf stable choice in the pantry

title: No likey
text:
Not at all spicy. I am from the Pacific Northwest and now live in Texas. I get laughed at for how little spice I can tolerate. This tastes like Mild and I'mnot taking it back.
But the reason I don't like it and can't recommend it is, because it has tomato paste in list of ingredients. So much so that it tastes sweet. Almost like a spaghetti sauce.

title: Great concept and really good coffee!
text: What a clever idea! This has been a fun way to enjoy a fast and flavorful pour over. This has 3 varieties in it. The Kenyan (blue) is my favorite. It's smooth with low acid. The Ethiopian (green) is the lightest and brightest of the bunch. The last one (yellow) is also a medium bodied choice. In my opinion, is a bit higher in acid and has a bit of smokiness to it. 10 per box, so 30 packets altogether. All the coffee has tasted fresh and it's super easy to use this method.

title: Excellent quality!
text: I love this pink sea salt. It's salt, but has some flavor nuances. Looks really pretty in my salt grinder and it's easy to dispense.

title: Excellent all around!!
text: Rich flavor, fresh smelling, not dried out,easy to dispense, massive quantity! This pepper is wonderful!

title: The BEST tasting green tea.
text: THIS IS MY FAVY GREEN TEA! Very mild in flavor. I drink my plain and unsweetened so the nuances shine thru. The tea bags seem to hold the correct amount. There is a slight amount of tea residue that sifts down to bottom of package upon opening. And the package seals shut completely and is stiff enough to sit upright on shelf to locate easily. NO CAFFEINE.

title: I really like these!
text: Ingenious way to enjoy a quality cup of coffee. Sometimes,  I don't have time to wait for the coffee pot to brew or simply just want 1 cup. This is a simple way to get that. Rip the tab off the top, situate the "wings" over your mug and slowly fill with hot water. Just like a traditional pour over, I let my 1st pour "bloom" the grounds. Low acid, full flavor roast.

title: More coffee than cocoa
text: Smells EXACTLY like the flavored powdered coffee from the 80's and 90's. I was suprised at how much coffee scent there was compared with cocoa scent. This is WONDERFUL in chocolate cake where coffee is an ingredient. Magnet keeps tin on fridge if desired.

title: What a fun product to bake with!
text: I sprinkle this on top of quick breads, like banana bread and cookies like snickerdoodles before baking. Great smell, texture and taste! Definitely has a toasty, warm caramel smell. The top of the tin twists so you can use the holes to shake product onto whatever your little heart desires!

title: Totally acceptable, nothing really special.
text: With cream this is fine coffee. I can't drink it black though, too acidic and hurts my tummy. It's ground up upon arrival and smelled fresh.

title: Very sweet
text: Nut based and SUPER SWEET. Too sweet for my liking. The serving size is 1/4 cup. I doubt I could enjoy more than 1/8 cup. Product presents nice, bag seals shut completely.

title: DELICIOUS!
text: This is my favorite seasoning from this company's line up. The onion and sesame take everything to new heights. I actually exclaimed outloud when I took my 1st bite of my avocado toast sprinkled with this. SO GOOD!!!

title: Not my favorite
text: The tomato paste in this makes is VERY sweet. Also, not spicy at all. This tastes more like mild.

title: Ok spice
text: Cool concept. Product is shipped ina plastic bag that is nestled into tin. The tin has 2 shaker sizes. One is hardy and wide, the other is sized for sprinkles. The tin is suprisingly lightweight. The magnet is a thin, light disc glued to bottom. I do not trust it on my fridge, so I have stored mine in my spice rack. Used this on eggs. Lots of pepper and dill. No other predominant flavors.

title: So-so
text: Just okay. Too sweet for me. Flavored nicely. Plastic bottle. Good, chunky consistency.

title: Really well done.
text: Really great flavor! Tastes like a 70% dark chocolate. Not waxy or grainy. This will be awesome in our trail mix. Everyone in the family (kids too) likes it! Love the fact that it comes in a resealable bag.

title: Not the best tasting, but very cute.
text: Cute idea. The biscotti doesn't taste very good. Instead of crispy, it's a bit more cakey. The presentation is nice. Only 7 come in a package.

title: Great tasting.
text: There are only 8 of these in the box. Super easy to use, no mess, no grounds floating around. The coffee is pretty decent. Smooth and full bodied. Wish more came in pack.

title: Not a hit
text: All 5 kids didn't like these very much. The raspberry one is filled with a jam-like center. The cocoa one in my opinion is better tasting. I would not re order these.

title: A grown up pop-tart!!
text: Sooooo good! These are awesome cold, but next level when warmed up. I never feel guilty about the kiddos having them in the morning because they have protein and fiber in them. I like this flavor too. It has a mellow warmth to it and the pastry is soft.

title: Excellent flavor. Ok texture.
text: Smells rich and pure and sweet. Tastes creamy and very chocolatey. There are little pieces of chocolate nibs in this. I could do without those. It feels slightly grainy to me. Doesn't detract from amazing flavor, but it's something to note if you have texture issues.

title: Yummy!
text: Pretty good refresher. Directions suggest 25 grams to each 8oz of water. That's just about 2 tablespoons. I used an immersion blender and everything dissolved perfectly. There are little pulpy seed bits in this, which I LOVE! Very round and flesh and sweet. I took a star off because there is a tiny "vitamin" smell to this. Can't detect it in the taste, but everytime I bring my cup up to drink, I get a whiff of it.

title: We didn't care for this.
text: Tastes like unsweetened cocoa with fluffy, whipped peanut butter inside. Not 1 of my 5 kids liked it. I could tolerate, but would never choose this again.

title: The ultimate superfood
text:
This is a medicinal grade honey with a umf of 20+. So, it doesn't go higher than that. You can apply this to cuts and infections (cover it after) You can also take it orally. Has massive, stable, anti bacterial properties. Tastes verrrry sweet. My husband spreads his on toast every morning. I simply swallow a tablespoon.
Great Job bringing this to the world, Egmont Honey!

title: Pretty good cup of joe
text: Nice, oily and dark beans. Smells fresh, not a lot of quakers (broken or under-roasted beans) The resealable package never worked for me. I just rolled it down and secured it with a rubber band. Tastes ever-so-slightly tinny. You can tell a lot of care went into making this coffee.

title: PRETTY GOOD!
text: Suprised I like this. I usually only buy whole bean coffee. This stuff has a large, round, non-tinny flavor. Smells fresh upon opening and while brewing. We opened the pack and a week later, coffee was still brewing up fresh.

title: Pretty good coffee.
text: My 4 lbs of beans came in a plain white vacu-bag. No logo or anything. The beans smell wonderful! They are not very oily. They are also a medium roast. The majority of the beans were the same color and I found very few 'Quakers' (broken, poorly roasted beans) the coffee is medium bodied. It's pretty smooth. It must have low acid too, because I don't get a tummy ache after 2 or 3 cups. I've never heard of this roaster before. I'm happy to try something new!

title: These taste great!
text: Very well done! These taste great, look nice and shiny and are just the right size to satisfy a lil sweet tooth.

title: Super yummy!
text: Excellent tea! I have to stop myself from guzzling this all down. Nice clarity, and the tannins are soft. Love the fact that I can get an unsweetened product that tastes like my own!

title: No bueno
text: Tastes like a wanna be kitkat only with a stale interior and a very thin coat of chocolate.

title: It's ok.
text: Good for an on-the-go boost. A bit over priced for literally just packets of honey. The packets though are strong and durable and can handle being tossed into a bag or purse with out ripping. I like the subtle nuances of local honey better. This, even though it's organic, tasted rougher and more processed. I doubt I'd ever order this again.

title: Not very good
text: These snack bags of oreos are not that good. You get 1 oz per bag. That is 9 teeny cookies. That is the equivalent of 2 regular sized oreos. That is a terrible value! Some of the cookies were split. They are drier than the larger, classic oreos. It makes more sense to just buy regular oreos that are packaged 2 or 4 per bag. Also, if it matters to you, these are not made in the US. They are imported from Mexico. I will not reorder these.

title: Yuck.
text: I sure wanted to like this coffee. But it's not very good at all. It's appropriate that it's called Green Mountain. Because it does actually taste green. Like it's not mature or roasted correctly. This gives a piney, grassy flavor profile to coffee. Which I find disgusting. Everytime I drink coffee like this, I get a tummy ache. The medium roast and the light roast both have those qualities to it. To be clear, I drink at least 3 cups of coffee daily. Love french roasts,  breakfast blends, even McD's, though not my favorite, is palatable and suffices on the road.

title: Maybe the best tea I've ever had.
text:
This tea is stunning. The flavors are so bright and fresh. The ingredients so real looking and colorful. They all smell like sunshine and cozy days. I tried the "relaxer" package. There are 7 one ounce packages. 1) ginger peach
2)palm beach punch
3)lavender chamomile
4)cocoa mint chill
5)berry pear
6)almond cream
7)mango dreamzzz
All of them have no caffeine.
Each 8oz cup uses only 1.5 teaspoons so this variety pack will last a long time.
These would make a lovely gift too.
I'm just so impressed with these teas and am happy people take such pride in creating these quality products. You can really tell the difference.

title: Very nice cinnamon
text: This organic cinnamon smells vibrant and spicy! Tastes super fresh. The consistency is a soft powder, no clumps and it shakes right out of the container as you'd expect.

title: Great snack!
text: Classic Ritz crackers, buttery and flaky, with creamy peanut butter sandwiched between them. The salt isn't overwhelming. The portions are just enough for an after school snack. My kids have finished these everytime they've opened a pack.

title: Very good! Rich and taste homemade.
text: These totally taste like Gramma made them. There is no fake taste. Just rich, buttery flavor. The "seasalt" is kind of a trip. There are literal salt crystals that "crunch" in each of these candies. I like it, as do my children. They are sort of addictive! Each piece is individually wrapped.

title: Great low carb option
text: I really like dang products. Nice to have a carb friendly option from them. The Adkins bars make my stomach hurt. These do not. I know they are made from higher quality ingredients. They are a little dry, but I absolutely don't care. I just want a bar that gives me what I need. But I still took a star off for that.

title: Our favorite brand.
text: These are my family’s favorite of all the different varieties of roasted seaweed snacks. They are always super crispy, perfectly salted and toasty tasting. They don’t last long in my house! Great price too for a generous amount.

title: There is no raspberry whatsoever in this tea!
text:
Ingredients- #1) Hibiscus #2) Lemongrass #3) Rosehips #4) Orange Peel #5) Licorice Root #6) Raspberry FLAVOR
This is fine tea, but NOT wild raspberry. It tastes very Lemongrassy. And we all now by now the word "flavor" can mean anything. Stash could simply use a flavored oil, not raspberry at all, to enhance this tea. Not worth the price for this misleading product.

title: Bob makes good products, huh?
text: I just used the last of the bags in this order and plan to reorder. A lot of positives to this product. I like the fact that it is unsweetened. I like the fine texture. I like it's sold in smaller bags, placed in a larger box so product stays fresh. I kept mine in the freezer and it lasted quite some time, and was still fresh. I used this mainly for my kids energy/protein bars. Mix with a little nut butter of your choice to make a "base" then add whatever you want-cocoa, sunflower seeds, craisins, choc chips, chex, hemp hearts, flax. Roll them into little portion size balls and freeze til ready to eat. I also added them to yogurt for protein and fiber addition.

title: Bold, tart taste. Beautiful color.
text: Very tart and flavorful tea. I have only made ice tea with this and I drink a quart a day. Very ruby red in color and almost wine-like in taste. I do not use sweetener, but I bet honey, or simple syrup would make it super yummy too.

title: I purchased this a sleep aid and it works beautifully for me
text: I purchased this a sleep aid and it works beautifully for me, but the unexpected benefit of this product is, when I use it before bedtime, I have no pain in my wrists that I attribute to the beginnings of carpal tunnel, and wake up pain free. It took me a few nights to make the connection. I just ordered my 2nd bottle. I have never tried another type of cherry concentrate, so I have nothing to compare this product to. But the feeling of waking up without pain is wonderful!

title: Just ok.
text: I prefer Starbucks French Roast and higher end coffee companies like Cafe Umbria. I thought I might get lucky and like this, since it's less expensive. It was just ok. The beans weren't as oily and deep black. Taste was ok. I won't reorder.

title: Tasty & filling but the consistency is odd, might take some getting used to
text: I like these a lot but my family is not as fond of them. I have been eating one for breakfast every morning for the past couple of weeks & they are as filling as the granola bars I usually eat. The taste is quite good but the consistency is odd. They are not airy, creamy or crispy, there are crushed nuts inside but everything is compressed into a rectangle so there is more chewing involved than with similar bars.

title: Definitely an eye opener. Flavor is somewhere between Donut Shop & Breakfast Blend
text: I can definitely tell the caffeine is there, I normally drink 1 or 2 12oz cups per morning but since I got these I have been sticking with one cup. I'm not super choosey about coffee but I like it strong, black & maybe a little burnt tasting. The coffee in these pods is somewhere between the Donut Shop flavor that I like best & a breakfast blend. It does taste strong like I like & it isn't bitter at all. The pods are a little tougher to pierce than the grocery store brands I usually buy but they have worked fine in my machine.

title: Wake up right now!
text:
I have been working from home for several weeks now & I pretty much go straight from the bed to the computer. Without my usual morning shower & commute to drink coffee before I get started I found myself drinking more coffee during the day. These cups have a "wakeup right now" factor built in. I do not have a second cup of the Red Alert if I have a second cup of coffee.

I'm not sure what roast I am getting. It has a certain flavor that I haven't been able to pin down. I would compare it to a dark, breakfast blend. I brew it on the "strong" setting on my Keurig & drink it black.

title: Classic Oreo taste in a more convenient, less messy form
text: Unless you love the pageantry of unscrewing the cookies & scraping off the cream, these crisps are superior to the classic Oreo assembly. There are fewer broken cookies & the chocolate cookie doesn't cake up in the teeth. The re-sealable packaging works well, I kept a package at work all week & brought the remainder home on Friday still fresh. The mint are otherworldly good. I had to hide those from my family.

title: Delicious & Rich dark chocolate with a lingering, salt flavor
text:
These treats are delicious & decadent at 50 calories each. These are very rich with a lingering, salty taste but not so much of a hit from the sea salt. My family didn't like the dark chocolate as much as the milk chocolate. I took them to work & everyone thought they were delicious but only 1 person ate more than one. They are that rich!
These weren't packed particularly tight & I don't think they traveled as well as they would have them if they were packed better. They look a bit dusty & there is a lot of salt in the bottom of the container that probably started on top of the candies.

title: A bit tart for me but my child loves them.
text: These arrived in perfect condition & my daughter loved them. They are tasty & taste like strawberries but tart to me & there are seeds. They are pricey for a snack but there are a lot in the bags.

title: Delicious & hardy, held up very well in delivery
text: These caramel & chocolate treats are delicious, my household voted them the best candy of the season. Each piece is very large (like a "Chunky" if you remember those). The sea salt is strong but is only on the top so it's only there for the first bite. The chocolate & caramel are very rich & high quality. The container is purposely stacked, not loosely poured, to the top.

title: Arrived fresh, we loved them but shipping took its toll on their appearance
text: These treats are a cookie-like pretzel coated with a delicious chocolate sprinkled with peppermint. The peppermint flavor is subdued, not like a peppermint bark. They arrived very fresh & crunchy but dusty. Ours arrived mostly intact but coated in a fine layer of 'dust' from the broken pretzels. They were nearly gone after two days.

title: Sweet
text: Kids loved it.

title: Good for diabetics
text: Delicious

title: Great for diabetes.
text: My 11 year old granddaughter who has type 1 diabetes enjoyed  it very much with whipped cream on top.

title: fair
text: to much sugar for diabetics

title: great carrot properties...
text:
...but tastes bad like the difference between real whole milk and powdered milk tastes.

I use carrot powder to relieve restless legs and this does the trick. I just wish it tasted better. Read the label--says added Vit. C, but it isn't listed on the ingredients.

I love to suppor small businesses, but I need better quality than this to support this company.

title: a little too salty for me.
text: The flavor is good. Maple and bacon taste. They are not tough to chew like hard tack or jerky. However they are a bit too salty. The bag comes with a 'heater". When air hits it, it warms up and warms the bites if you leave them in the bag for about 5 minutes. The bag is 2 servings, and its a good size serving. Enjoy.

title: tastes terrible.
text: Every other flavor/type of esspreso I've tasted from Nespresso is beyond excellent--even India that basically tastes like the jungle smells--but this decaf tastes terrible to me.

title: Pretty good coffee
text: I do like flavored coffee and the flavors in this box are exactly the flavors that I like except Boston Creme. Boston Creme is nasty tasting. However, Chocolate Glaze is wonderful and doesn't even need sugar--I don't put sugar in my coffee anyway. Jelly Donut tastes a little like raspberry flavor. Cinnamon Swirl tastes just like a cinnamon bun, and French Crewell has a creamy vanilla flavor. There's an Old Fashioned non-flavored, too, but it doesn't taste a good as the flavored coffees.

title: Most delicious decaf coffee around
text: Never did like decaf coffee. It always smelled bad to me and tasted bad--even the most expensive brands. Then I tasted this because I've got tremors and doc said decaf will lessen the tremors. In my search for a good decaf coffee, I was disappointed many times. But this coffee has a great fragrance both before brewing and while brewing. It tastes like regular coffee -- no joke! It is strong. I like strong. A lot of people don't. You can add boiling water to it and lessen its strength, but I really like the fresh brewed full strength flavor of Timothy's decaf.

title: Best tasting coffee
text: I have not tasted better flavor in coffee anywhere. I've tasted $200 per pound coffee, and bargain basement brand coffee. Each of these little aluminum cups is very small, but packed with flavor. I highly recommend it. Loved it! I don't know that I would pay that much for coffee, though, because I drink so much of it every day. I guess that's why the jitter factor was rather high for me.

title: Yummmmmmy
text: All I can say is YUMMMMMMMMMM. The taste of chocolate and mint is a perfect winter flavor. When it cold outside, my drink is either hot chocolate or hot coffee. I can have great tasting hot chocolate with these K-cups. Love it!

title: Really great taste!
text: For medical reasons I've had to switch to decaf coffee. I dreaded it because I've never found a really good decaf coffee. Then I tried Timothy's. Talk about great coffee!! You can't even tell it's decaf it tastes so good. I am so glad I found this!

title: Mmmmm Good
text: This tea is really good. I love lemon flavor and it has a slight lime flavor as well. Follow the directions for a really nice cup of tea. I don't like sugar in my tea and this tastes great without sugar, but some may want to put sugar or a sugar substitute in because the flavor is a bit strong if you steep for 5 minutes like the directions say.

title: Yum!
text:
Yummy!

This is excellent honey. It is darker than the stuff you buy off the shelf, and it is packed with flavor. There is a faint aroma of sorghum/molasses. But it doesn't takes like that. The flavor is honey x10, and that means the flavor is strong. You can taste the difference between the buckwheat honey and clover honey, which is thicker and much lighter in color and flavor.

Strong honey flavor
Viscosity is light -- but this is raw honey, so watch out for sugaring. If that happens, take the top off, pop it in the microwave for 30-45 seconds and stir and stir and stir.
Color is dark and pleasing.

title: but this is really good!
text: This is delicious. I'm not a fan of putting lemonade and raspberry flavors together, but this is really good!

title: The best tasting is the chocolate and toffee bits with almonds
text: What can I say? It's CHOCOLATE! Yummy, melt in your mouth Hershey's Chocolate. The best tasting is the chocolate and toffee bits with almonds.

title: Taste's really good and is so good for you
text: Taste's really good and is so good for you. Goji berries have been used to treat many common health problems like diabetes, high blood pressure, fever, and age-related eye problems. Great way to do that :) Raspberries are good to help prevent gout. Eat dark berries: Darker berries like blueberries, blackberries, purple grapes, and raspberries are great for preventing gout.

title: Five Stars
text: Great to scratch my chocolate lover's itch. Lovely flavors, and good mix.

title: Too dangerous if you are dieting... I did not share even one of them!
text: These chocolates are so good they are very dangerous to have around. When they arrived, I opened immediately. They are like exquisite velvet on your tongue, and melt with fragrant and gentle sweetness. Not too harsh a chocolate flavor. Definitely better than any other chocolate I've tasted. The coffee and cream was heavenly, dark chocolate cream and milk chocolate are to die for. Don't miss out on this excellent and flavorful taste adventure!

title: Really good breakfast
text:
I so much enjoyed this oatmeal. The nuts and grain and cherries blend so well, it is almost like trail mix in a cereal. It's 290 calories, but they are the good, filling kind of calories that stick around and don't disappear before lunch time. Great on the go type of prep (microwave or boiling water) right in the container.

On a cold blustery morning, this cereal gives a sense of comfort. Weird to say, but seriously, I stood looking out the window at a cold, rainy day, eating this cereal and I felt so comforted as it warmed my tummy. Good stuff.

title: Product was delivered quickly
text: The flavor was very bland. It was like it a hard chunk of sugar with less sweetness. I wish I could say it was better. I remember getting Tart n'Tinys as a kid and they were good. These were disappointing unfortunately.

title: Best.Coffee.Ever!
text: I first had this coffee while visiting family in Hawaii and it quickly became my favorite coffee ever! I was thrilled to find it on Amazon as I only had one bag left. If you want to try a yummy, rich cup of coffee that isn't bitter or overly strong- this is the one!

title: ... are disgusting- - the bag went right into the garbage.
