The other tin, our lady of la leche, contains nettle leaf, alfalfa, marshmallow root, fennel seed, fenugreek see and astragalus root. This blend is completely different and not nearly as sweet. It is more herbal and I like it just as much but prefer it for different occasions. They say it helps for lactating mothers but I also just enjoy this on a relaxing evening to be honest.

Each tin provides 30 servings, so for $30 you get a total of 60 servings. I think you can probably get a little bit more out of it depending on how you make up your teas. I like having a lot of different tea blends on hand and like drinking teas so for me this is well worth it to be honest.

title: Delicious and calming
text:
In this bag you get some loose leaf tea which is ok since I have the necessary tools. You don’t need a lot of it to make a nice cup of tea. You let it sit for a few minutes and it is ready to go. This tea is very smooth and delicious which is perfect when your stomach is already a mess, you want something that is comforting and tasty.

This blend contains chamomile, peppermint, marshmallow, lemon balm and fennel seeds. When you just smell it you are not sure but once it is all brewed and ready to go, it is just heavenly and exactly what my stomach needs. My digestive system tends to get upset but the doc can’t figure out what is wrong with it, so finding a herbal remedy that gives me some comfort is always more desirable than taking some pills that often don’t even work. I for one really like this and how much it helps when my digestive system does act up.

title: Delicious and smooth tea
text:
I really like this tea by Purely Plants. It comes in a very nice, resealable bag that allows you to close it back up. Inside it you get 16 pyramid tea bags. I found that you can actually brew it teach bag twice if you want. The second time around it is a bit weaker but it is still as tasty and delicious as it was the first time, just a little weaker. The tea is a bit expensive at $23 for just 16 tea bags, even if you brew them twice and get 32 teas out of it.

The tea itself though is delicious no doubt which is very important to me. I am a big tea drinker and always looking for new teas, even better if they have certain health benefits like in this case to help prepare for labor. This one has borage flower, saffron and raspberry leaf in, all supposed to help getting an expecting mother ready to go into labor.

So I admit, I am not and was not expecting. But the list of ingredients made me curious so I had to get this tea. I am always in the market for trying out new teas and this one got my attention and it was the right choice. This tea is delicious and I am happy to add this one to my rotation of teas.

title: Delicious tea
text:
I really like this tea by Purely Plants. It comes in a very nice, resealable bag that allows you to close it back up. Inside it you get 16 pyramid tea bags. I found that you can actually brew it teach bag twice if you want. The second time around it is a bit weaker but it is still as tasty and delicious as it was the first time, just a little weaker. The tea is a bit expensive at $23 for just 16 tea bags, even if you brew them twice and get 32 teas out of it.

The tea itself though is delicious no doubt which is very important to me. I am a big tea drinker and always looking for new teas, even better if they have certain health benefits like in this case to help new moms. This one has shatavari, nettle, fenugreek, fennel, oastraw, alfalfa, blessed thistle, cardamom seeds and milk thistle. These ingredients are supposed to help milk production, provide iron and vitamins and help lower oxidative stress that could interfere with milk production.

I admit, I am not lactating but saw the list of ingredients and was curious about the tea so I got it and I regret nothing. This tea is delicious and I enjoy drinking it. Since I am not lactating or in “risk” of, it won’t have an impact on me really so I will just enjoy it for what it is and it is delicious and smooth. I like to mix up and expand my tea collection so finding something neat and different is always on my list and worth it to me.

title: Surprisingly delicious - officially a matcha convert now
text:
My first experience with matcha was not great so I was a bit hesitant with this tea, but I love tea and always want to try out new teas. This tea is a finely milled powder. They tell you to mix it into some other beverage or to drink it on its own, so off I went, mixing the small scoop they provide with water to make my tea. It takes about a minute or so to dissolve this but it doesn’t fully dissolve really. It is not gritty though which is great.

I did add a little sugar but this tea is actually on its own sweet which is great. I admit I have a sweet tooth so this is right down my alley. I was pleasantly surprised to see how fantastic this tea was. I think I am officially converted to liking matcha now. This is my second matcha product that I do like and this one is great. It is sweet and has a fantastic flavor. It is pretty smooth . At the end there was some of the powder left in the cup, but I think if I would have added more water into the cup in the first place I would have been ok. All in all this is great. This bag should last a good amount since you use a tiny little scoop and there is a lot of powder in this cup. They attribute a lot of health benefits to this due to the high Vitamin C so this should be a nice boost to your immune system especially.

title: Incredibly delicious - my all time favorite
text:
I have had chamomile tea, but never lavender tea. This chamomile lavender tea by THIDA is probably one of my all-time favorites! In this bag you get 30 tea bags that are all inside a second plastic tea bags. I found that you can actually brew each tea bag twice so you actually could get 60 servings out of this, costing you $11. So I find this is not a bag price at all.

This tea, so lets focus on the important stuff, is absolutely incredible. I have always liked chamomile and lavender fragrance is one of my favorites, so how could I go wrong with this? I absolutely love this tea. I drink a lot of tea and am always looking at new tea to mix things up and this one is a winner in my book. I will be repurchasing this one when I am out because I really like this one so much. I can only recommend it.

This tea helps with sleep, boosts your immune system, helps with muscle spasms, stomach aches, stress, the digestive system and acne. It just has so many health benefits that work well. How can you go wrong with something that tastes incredible and is good for you? And it is not even expensive? Gosh I just can’t say enough good things about this to be honest. You really need to get this tea, especially if you value your health.

title: Delicious tea tht is good for you
text:
This is a very nice slimming and detox tea by Abamec. The ingredient lists contain senna leaf and green tea that help stimulate your metabolism and blood circulation. This is a loose leaf tea so make sure you have one of those tea cups with the insert or some other means to make this tea with. You don’t need a lot of the loose leaf to make a nice tasty tea with it.

This tea is very flavorful and tastes delicious. I really like it a lot. It is smooth and has a fantastic flavor panel between the green tea and senna leafs to be honest. Senna is known to be a natural laxative, but personally I find that it for me it is not strong enough to really affect me much at all but it doesn’t hurt in my opinion. I really enjoy drinking a lot of teas and mixing it up, so what better what than adding a nice healthy tea to the mix that is good for me?

title: Has an aftertaste, wasteful packaging and overpriced but not bad
text:
In this box you get 12 packs of 2 of this orange filled cookies inside, so 24 cookies in total. The orange filling is a gelatinous kind of feeling. These are similar to the Pims cookies if you are familiar with those. The bottom cookie is soft, then you have the filling topped with some chocolate. Overall these cookies are not bad, but they do have an aftertaste to them that initially I wasn’t very fond of. I found though as I “worked” my way through this box I noticed that aftertaste less and less and also minded it less and less. I can’t put my finger on it what it reminds me off but initially I was not a fan of it but after a few of those dual packs didn’t mind as much anymore.

Those little packs are perfect for taking them with you as a snack, but they are rather wasteful in regards to generating waste and being not very environmentally friendly. There is an up and down to everything I guess, the convenience of being able to take a small snack has the downside of generating a lot of waste. All in all not bad, not a really cheap price though since I have seen the regular box in the store from the Pims brand for like $4 which is probably how many are in one of these boxes to be honest. So they are a bit pricey and that aftertaste takes a little getting used to in my opinion.

title: Fantastic body scrub
text:
This is a nice sugar scrub by Joon x Moon. This particular one is their watermelon fragranced one. It comes in a cheap little plastic container which is fine since this is a fairly inexpensive product. You get a total of 18 of these sugar cubes.

They claim one sugar cube is enough for one body scrub. Well I found that using one of these sugar cubes is actually enough for 2 body scrubs, easily. They are a little awkward to use to be honest because of their shape but you can make it work. These smell nicely of watermelon which is why I picked them in the first place. They have a nice exfoliating property to them thanks to the sugar. It actually works quite well. The other ingredients work nicely in getting nice and clean during the scrub in my eyes. I didn’t feel like I was “scrubbing my skin off” or anything but got a nice gentle exfoliation with these sugar scrubs. My skin felt nicely moisturized afterwards, probably because of the aloe and shea butter that they also put in there.

I was pretty impressed on how well they worked and that my skin was not dried out after the shower. I still used body lotion but I didn’t feel like it was necessary. I just followed my usual routine really.

title: Lovely tea that is a great combination of ginger and pear
text:
The only way I usually like ginger is in ginger ale but I think I found another one. In this box you get a total of 6 boxes and each contains 16 bags, giving you a total of 96 bags. All that costs you less than $35, so not a bad deal I think. I also tried using a tea bag twice and that worked perfectly fine so you could actually get double out of each making this an even better deal.

I was not sure what to expect from the ginger flavor since ginger at times can be a bit harsh but I was pleasantly surprised. The tea was exceptionally pleasant and I think it was the perfect addition of the pear to the mix that really did it. This tea is very smooth and lovely really. I for one really like this combination a lot which was a bit of a shock since as I stated the only ginger I usually like is the one in ginger ale but this one is fantastic as well. Ginger has some really good properties so this is a great way to take advantage of them without “suffering” the usual taste that I am not a fan of from ginger. The pear just really masks it beautifully and adds a layer of flavor to it that is just perfect.

I for one am a fan and can only recommend this. It is a great mix to my tea rotation and adds something different to it which is great. I like to mix things up every now and then and this one is perfect in my eyes.

title: Lovely tea but not cheap
text:
This is a lovely green tea with lovely undertones of acai berries and sweet blueberries. That combination makes it a very nice blend that is very smooth and has a nice sweet tone from the blueberries to it.

You get 12 tea bags that are seriously wrapped individually and come in a beautiful box that can be presented on every nice little tea time if you ask me. The tea bags are these nice pyramid tea bags that are biodegradable.

This is a very nice tea but at $12 this is not a cheap tea by any means, more a luxury item. But considering what goes into it, it being all natural, them using the best packaging materials they can trying to have the least footprint possible when it comes to waste. This is one of those teas I use for a special treat. It is super smooth and on the fruity side and definitely very nice but as I said not cheap. The flavor is also on the more subtle side so I did have to steep it a little longer.

title: Horrible sticky mess that did nothing for my face
text:
I have to say I had high hopes for this one, who doesn't at a price tag of $98! But I was sorely disappointed. This repair creams comes in a square little jar and the jar is rather small as well. The fragrance of it was not very impressive to be honest. So sadly that was a let down but not the worst.

When yo dip your finger into the cream you will see it is super heavy and reminiscent of honey almost. It is very difficult to distribute on your face because how sticky and thick it is. I have to admit I did not like how it felt on my skin at all but figured I would leave it to see how my face would feel, you figure at that price tag it should do wonders, right?

Thankfully I did all this at bed time so that should be a saving grace but falling asleep couldn't come soon enough. That sticky feeling kept making me touch my face and it just wouldn't fade. The hope was in the morning my face would be soft, smooth and wonderful. Well sadly that was not the case. It was just the same old. Nothing special, I didn't feel like I did anything to it, so that horrible feeling applying it to my face was for nothing. At that price point, I can not recommend it at all. This is just too expensive and I did not see any benefit from it at all.

title: Delicious but expensive
text:
This is something different. It is a cold brew iced tea that comes with different flavors. It is not cheap if you ask me since one of these will run you $25 and you get in each 10 tea bags. Yes each tea bag will make a half gallon but I still think that is no cheap.

The black thai tropical is very nice. It will energize you since it is high in caffeine. Maui Mango doesn't have caffeine in it and is a lot more chill in my eyes. These are easy to make, just add one of the tea bags to water, put it in the fridge for 2 hours and you will have a nice cold tea ready to go. This is just perfect. I will see if reusing these will work but I doubt it.

These taste very good and are perfect to keep in the fridge for when you are thirsty or for when you need a drink pitcher for dinner or a pot luck or something. I just wish these were a little cheaper since I do really like them.

title: Tastes good but needs some sweetener in my eyes but way too expensive
text:
In this box you get 12 glass bottles with this tea tonic drink. Each bottle is rather small with 8 fluid oz. All this costs you $45, which I found is pretty expensive. In each bottle you get a detox blend of tea with hibiscus, burdock root, rooibos, red clover leaf, dandelion root and leaf, nettle leaf and root and lemongrass. All these are supposed to help your skin from the inside out.

They did not add any sugar to this tea and this tea has 0 calories for the entire bottle, no fat, no sodium or carbs. The taste of this tea is pretty good but I wish it would be sweeter to be honest, but I am a person who does like her sweets. I also like my teas and in my tea range this one is definitely one I would drink, just with sugar of course.

I love this concept of it, but I am not sure how well this detox will work. I have had no negative reactions to it, some gurgling in my stomach however but nothing other than that, for now. But that is with just drinking one for dinner tonight. I am not sure if you would drink these multiple times a day or daily if that would be different but I will find out and update this if I do have a reaction to it.

I do have to say though I find it a bit overpriced at $3.75 per bottle, especially since these are 8 fl oz bottles. These are not even the size of a 12 oz can so for that I have to say the odds of my repurchasing are sadly slim to none. It will also be tough to judge any skin improvements and contribute them to this tea.

title: For manuka honey lovers
text:
This honey is absolutely delicious! I was in Australia and New Zealand a couple of years ago and even down under this Manuka honey is very expensive, so yes I am not shocked by this price. It is still shocking though that such small quantities go for such incredibly prices and with import they add even more.

I use this very sparingly since it is such a precious commodity and treat it like gold pretty much.

title: Really love these, taste delicious, only get few of the flavors but OVERPRICED
text:
I have had some lychee jello cups like these in the past and had to give these a try. I have to say these are really good but have a slight artificial flavor to them, unlike the lychee ones I had in the past. Personally I like the lychee one the best, followed by mango and then pineapple, which are the only ones I got in my bag. They come in these cute little cups. The biggest down side is that you don't really get a whole lot of them in one of these bags and you probably won't even get all the flavors in one bag. I only got 3 out of the 6 different ones but thankfully I got my favorite flavor the most so I am not too upset about it.

Considering how much you get these are a bit expensive if you just get the one bag. But I really like them, just wish they were cheaper.

title: Tastes nicely of Turmeric with a tiny kick
text:
So I had no idea what turmeric tasted like until I drank this turmeric tea some time back and realized I love it. The smell of it is kind of odd and I was like not sure about that, but the taste of it is surprisingly amazing so I had to give this a try with all its promises and I figure another way to drink turmeric. I am not a big coffee or latte drinker but hey, why not.

You can drink this without sugar but adding some if you like things sweeter is definitely not a bad idea. This definitely tastes mostly of turmeric in my eyes and I like it. It has a mild subtle taste of ginger and I didn't find it adds spice, thank goodness. I found I like sipping on this in the morning to get started and switch this one up with my tea every now and then.

The nice thing about this is you do get a little energy boost but no jitters from caffeine if that affects you, it doesn't in my case. The best part however is the turmeric which is known to have anti inflammatory properties. So not only do you get hydrated, enjoy a nice alternative to coffee or tea but also do something good for your body. And in my case where my body has a good amount of arthritis this is a nice added benefit.

title: Delicious tea but not cheap, but tea bags can be brewed twice!
text:
This Recovery Tea is great. It contains cinnamon, licorice root, green tea, red rooibos, milk thistle seed, dandelion root, chamomile, strawberry leaf, raspberry leaf and oatstraw plus natural black cherry flavor. This one definitely tastes of black cherry and I really like that a lot. It is sweet and soothing at the same time and just one of the teas I enjoy a lot right now. I usually make a big one of this one and enjoy it for hours slowly sipping away (like 32 ounces with one tea bag).

You can either brew the tea bag twice like I do or make a huge 32 ounce batch and slowly sip that even when it cools, all depends on what mood I am in really. I love to drink tea and love to have variety and this one is a great addition to my rotation.

title: Big tea lover and can't beat the side effect of helping with heart burn
text:
This Sweet Relief heartburn tea is very nice. Interestingly it is called sweet peach but it contains spearmint leaf, lemon balm, marshmallow root, chamomile, dandelion root, ginger, turmeric and stevia leaf. I guess the "peach" comes in from the natural ginger peach. I have GERD and still get heartburn quite often even with medication which sucks. So having a natural remedy is fantastic. I love drinking this tea when my stomach upsets me and admit it does have a calming effect on my GI tract.

The taste is very nice and does have a flavor that reminds me of hint of peach but you can also taste the other ingredients. I especially like the turmeric which I have found I really like in tea. Not something you find often but something I have taken quite the liking to. I usually brew this tea bag twice to get the maximum out of each bag, and well because I love drinking tea. And even though it has stevia in it, I still add sugar, can't help it I have a sweet tooth. The stevia in it is not enough sweet for me.

title: Absolutely delicious
text:
You get this huge bag of salted caramels that are covered in dark chocolate, a whole 3lbs of it. Each one is individually wrapped which is nice especially if you take these into work to share with your coworkers, which was my intention but now that I had them I may not be able to do that anymore.

I am not a big fan of dark chocolate, but wow these are fantastic. The combination of dark chocolate, caramel and salt is just plain amazing. These are a real treat and for now I will enjoy them by myself, well not much option with this pandemic going on but even without it I am still not sure I would be in a sharing mood, that is how good these are.

title: Incredible maple syrup but expensive, but the real deal is known to be expensive
text:
There is nothing like real maple syrup on your waffles. This syrup is delicious and is perfect for a Sunday morning with waffles and some fantastic syrup. You can tell it is not that watered down cheap stuff that you get from the grocery store.

With that being said, the amount of syrup you get is not very substantial. So make sure you want to spend $12 for 8fl oz. IT is not a lot but the quality is very good. But real maple syrup is not known to be cheap either. That is why this is for special breakfasts only and not just for a quick running out the door waffles but for a nice Sunday morning sit down for an hour breakfast with all the fixins.

title: Who knew I would love stinging nettle tea?
text:
I really like tea from this manufacturer. You don't need a lot of their product to stew a nice cup of tea. I found that their tea quality is very good. I have never had stinging nettle tea all on its own, but had it mixed in in blends in other teas so I was looking forward to see what it tastes just by itself. I did not know what to expect when I tried it. The smell was actually very nice so I was looking forward to see what the tea would taste like. I was not disappointed. The tea it is very smooth and stronger but pleasant taste. I personally really like this tea and am happy to add it into my rotation. I like to mix it up a bit and am always looking to add a new tea into the mix. This one is making the cut. Plus they claim it has benefits for urinary tract and joints. Who am I to argue to actually do something good for my health?

The tea comes in this very nice, aluminum resealable can that you can use for something else when it is empty. The tea should last nicely in it since it really seals tight in it. Since you don't use a lot each time this can should go a long way, so price wise this tea is not bad either. They claim 25 servings but we shall see how long it will go. Plus with it being loose leaf you can adjust how strong you want it.

title: Great quality for a fantastic price
text:
This is a very good loose leaf tea. In this one bag tea you get a lot of loose leaf tea. The tea is very loose though and you may not be able to remove all of it in most of the inserts of those tea cups that you can use to make these teas, but it is not like these loose particles are harmful to you if you drink them.

The tea is very smooth and tastes delicious. You really don't need a lot to make a 12 ounce cup of tea. It takes only a couple of minutes to brew this tea. I personally really like this a lot and like the fact that you don't produce the waste of tea bags. Plus this is the most cost effective way to purchase tea really. It is very high in caffeine which is probably why it is so "energizing". At this price this is a fantastic bargain and the quality is great!

title: Fantastic tasting ranch dressing
text: This is a good ranch dressing. I had it over salad and it tastes great. It is well balanced and has no odd flavors to it. I like that it is not too heavy on herbs to be honest since I like mine more straight forward and less heavy on the herbs department. This is a nice dressing and works well on salads.

title: Delicious apple cinnamon tea
text:
I admit, a lot of times I get teas even if they are not intended for me, like this one. But come on who can resist apple cinnamon tea? In this bag you get 20 pyramid tea bags that can be reused at least 2 to 3 times each. Plus these are bio degradable which is an added bonus. So technically you get like 40 to 60 tea bags for $18, so not too horrible a price but still a bit on the more expensive side.

This tea tastes just like apple cinnamon and is very smooth. It has additional herbs in it that supposedly help with lactation, but they won't hurt you if you are not lactating. It is a very nice blend of licorice root, nettle leaf, raspberry leaf and more that just comes together in this very nice blend. It also contains fenugreek which I actually just found out decreases inflammation and helps with appetite control and lowers cholesterol. So those who are not breast feeding will also benefit from this tea in other ways.

All in all this is a very nice tea and yes even if you are not breast feeding you can still enjoy a nice cup of this tea, or two.

title: Love this hard candy !!!
text: I LOVE this guava candy. You get 2 large bags of this candy in this package for $14. The candy is individually wrapped and are these small little green hard candy. They are nice and sweet and delicious. I personally really like these a lot and am a huge fan. These are fantastic and am glad I found these again. I will definitely be repurchasing these when I am out!

title: Perfect gift for tea lovers
text: This is a perfect assortment of 12 different loose leaf teas. It allows you to sample all kinds of different teas that you don't usually get a chance to try. It makes for a nice little gift for tea lovers. Each tea gives enough for at least a couple of cups depending on how strong you make your tea. I love tea and these are some really nice and unique blends. I haven't yet decided which is my favorite and I hope that if I find some really nice ones that I can order that particular one in a larger quantity. I know they have them just a question of if they have the one I like in a larger quantity.

title: I love coconut but hated this
text: I am a huge fan of coconut and had high hopes for this coconut water. But there is just something I do not like about it. Something about the taste of it I don't like. Also the cap does not seal very well so when you mix it there is a good chance that it will leak so careful with that. I really wanted to love this but I just didn't.

title: Amazing peppermint tea
text:
This peppermint tea loose leaf is very good. I used about a tea spoon for a 16oz tea cup and that was just right in my opinion. I let it steam for about 5 minutes so I didn't have to use too much of the loose leaf and got maximum flavor out of it. This way I get the most out of the bag.

You get a huge amount of 1lb for $15! This is amazing. This will last you forever so make sure you store this properly so the leaves don't go bad on you. The tea tastes amazing of peppermint just like it should. The loose leaf is of high quality. Very nice indeed. I can only recommend it.

title: Love these
text:
This is an interesting little concept. You get these little pouches with pre-made liquid ice tea concentrate. All you have to do is add some cold water to it and you have yourself a nice cold beverage. You can control how sweet this drink is by how much water you add to it. I was not sure what to expect but have to say, I LOVE IT!

This icea tea is fantastic. The one I got has a great peach flavor and it is literally made in seconds. I took mine to work so instead of paying for a soda, I can make myself a nice, healthier beverage in seconds using our water dispenser. These little pouches are small and easy to carry with you. They won't accidentally tear either. Absolutely a fan and will have reorder when i run out. I wish they were a bit cheaper though.

title: This just wasn't for me!
text:
I really wanted to like this. I thought how can you possibly go wrong with anything mango, well I found the answer. This whole fruit powder is how. Some things are just not meant to be and this is it. In its processing it has lost a lot of the fantastic qualities mango has like its nice sweetness. What I got was definitely not light orange, more like a very sad faded yellow. The longer it is exposed to a liquid the more it fluffs up but not in a good way.

When I used it it was very clumpy at first and took forever to dissolve. Then it just started to become some pulpy kind of thing, just odd and weird and not pleasant to drink at all. Maybe using it as a cooking ingredient will work but in a smoothie was just beyond disappointing and I just couldn't stomach it.

title: This just isn't for me - don't care for the flavor
text:
I really wanted to like this Matcha drink but I struggled with it. It claims to have a peach flavor but yeah I couldn't find it. It is green and looks almost like a seaweed kind of drink. It is not very pleasant to look at to be honest but I looked past that. This drink had a pleasant smell so I thought this would probably be good, but sadly I was mistaken. I tried for about a third of the drink but no luck, I just couldn't finish it. Since I wasn't able to finish it I also didn't get any of the supposed benefits this drink claims, at least not from the one third I drank.

Sadly this drink just isn't for me. I had high hopes and thought that maybe the peach flavor would work for me but no luck in that department.

title: Who knew Yarrow Tea would be great?
text:
What I like about this manufacturer, you don't need a lot of their product to stew a nice cup of tea. I found that their tea quality is very good. I have never had wild yarrow tea so I did not know what I expect. I was very excited to try it out. The smell was very nice so I was looking forward to see what the tea would taste like. I was not disappointed. The tea it is very smooth and had a very nice taste to it. I personally really like this tea a lot and am very happy to add it into my rotation. I like to mix it up a bit and am always looking to add a new tea into the mix. This one is making the cut. Plus they claim it has benefits for women's health, GI function and healthy cholesterol. Who am I to argue to actually do something good for my health?

The tea comes in this very nice, aluminum resealable can that you can use for something else when it is empty. The tea should last nicely in it since it really seals tight in it. Since you don't use a lot each time this can should go a long way, so price wise this tea is not bad either. They claim 25 servings but we shall see how long it will go. Plus with it being loose leaf you can adjust how strong you want it.

title: Love this tea
text:
What I like about this manufacturer, you don't need a lot of their product to stew a nice cup of tea. I found that their tea quality is very good. I have never had elderflower tea but I did have elderflower syrup growing up. I was very excited to try it out. The smell was very nice so I was looking forward to see what the tea would taste like. I was not disappointed. The tea it is very smooth and reminded me a lot of the elderflower syrup I used to drink as a kid. You mix the syrup with water and drink it that way, usually chilled and it is fantastic. I personally really like this tea a lot and am very happy to add it into my rotation. I like to mix it up a bit and am always looking to add a new tea into the mix. This one is making the cut and then some to say the least. Plus they claim it has benefits for your immune system and respiratory health. Who am I to argue to actually do something good for my health?

The tea comes in this very nice, aluminum resealable can that you can use for something else when it is empty. The tea should last nicely in it since it really seals tight in it. Since you don't use a lot each time this can should go a long way, so price wise this tea is not bad either. They claim 20 servings but we shall see how long it will go. Plus with it being loose leaf you can adjust how strong you want it.

title: I realize I like Thyme tea
text:
What I like about this manufacturer, you don't need a lot of their product to stew a nice cup of tea. I found that their tea quality is very good. I have never had wild thyme tea, or any thyme really, so I was excited to try it out. I did not know what to expect when I tried it. The smell was actually very nice so I was looking forward to see what the tea would taste like. I was not disappointed. The tea it is very smooth and stronger but pleasant taste. I personally really like this tea and am happy to add it into my rotation. I like to mix it up a bit and am always looking to add a new tea into the mix. This one is making the cut. Plus they claim it has respiratory benefits. Who am I to argue to actually do something good for my health?

The tea comes in this very nice, aluminum resealable can that you can use for something else when it is empty. The tea should last nicely in it since it really seals tight in it. Since you don't use a lot each time this can should go a long way, so price wise this tea is not bad either. They claim 25 servings but we shall see how long it will go. Plus with it being loose leaf you can adjust how strong you want it.

text:

title: Quality Himalayan salt
text: This is a nice high quality Himalayan salt. You will need a salt grinder. I give Himalayan salt to my horses who LOVE it, which started me on actually getting it for myself as well and am I glad I did. It just has a better flavor to it in my eyes. This is a very good price for it.

title: Unique tea with an interesting flavor
text:
This is an interesting tea to say the least. I only tried to brew the tea once but think you can probably brew it twice. There is not a whole lot in one of these pouches so it is a bit on the more expensive side I think. I used about a half a tea spoon for a 16 ounce tea cup and that seem to work well.

When I smelled it I was not impressed and not sure about this tea. Thankfully it tastes a lot better than it smells. I have no idea what Ashwagandha is but it has a nutty earthy kind of flavor that is actually very smooth. It is pleasant but definitely not my favorite. I did enjoy this and will enjoy adding this to my routine to mix it up. It is unlike any tea I have tried, definitely worth trying though and a nice little change to your usual teas in my opinion.

title: Very nice raspberry lemonade tea
text:
This raspberry lemonade tea from Tealyra is very good. I used about a tea spoon and a half for a 16oz tea cup and that was just right in my opinion. I let it steam for about 5 minutes so I didn't have to use too much of the loose leaf and got maximum flavor out of it. This way I get the most out of the bag. I reused the loose leafs once and that worked well and had almost as much flavor as the first time

The tea has a sweet flavor of raspberries with undertones of lemon, just as advertised. It is very good and a nice change to my usual teas I drink.

title: Very smooth raspberry lemon tea
text:
This raspberry lemon from Tealyra is very good. I used about a tea spoon and a half for a 16oz tea cup and that was just right in my opinion. I let it steam for about 5 minutes so I didn't have to use too much of the loose leaf and got maximum flavor out of it. This way I get the most out of the bag. The tea has a sweet flavor of raspberries with undertones of lemon, just as advertised. It is very good and a nice change to my usual teas I drink.

title: Fails on every level for me
text: I really drink a lot of tea but sadly I just did not care for this astragalus tea. This is probably a high quality tea but the flavor was just not for me. In this bag you get 10 tea bags for about $10, so that is a bit on the pricey side, usually you get about 20 bags for $4 for regular teas. Considering I was not a fan of the flavor this is just a no for me. In addition they provide this tea in a plastic bag that is not resealable either. So to me this tea is a fail on all levels, flavor, price and resealing of the bag so therefore delivery of the product.

title: Smooth and delicious tai tea
text:
This white ayurvedic chai tea is delicious. I used about a tea spoon for a 16oz tea cup and that was just right in my opinion. I let it steam for about 5 minutes so I didn't have to use too much of the loose leaf and got maximum flavor out of it. This way I get the most out of the bag. I will try and reuse the leafs and see if I get more flavor out of them.

The tea has a sweet flavor of cinnamon which is probably why i like it so much. It is very good and a definite must have going onwards!

title: Delicious, buttery but expensive
text:
I have never had Pili nuts, nor do I know what they are, I still don't but I ate these and I have to admit these are delicious. They are super smooth and creamy. They are high in protein and have lots of healthy fats.

I actually had them in the morning with my tea and have to say they were actually rather filling on top of being delicious. When you eat them though I would recommend removing that brown skin they still have on them since that one does take away from their flavor.

The bag of almost 3 oz is a bit expensive, probably because these are rare. I would take these as a special treat.

title: Love the taste of black garlic
text:
I really like this garlic salt. I like garlic salt to begin with but this black garlic salt adds a little extra flavor to your food. When you use this keep in mind you are adding salt, obviously, so you have to scale back a bit on how much salt you add to your food. Yes that seems obvious but some people just don't think of it.

The taste difference is subtle but it is there. I find that black garlic has a fuller taste flavor than regular garlic has and just adds a little extra to your food. McCormick is known for quality spices in general so I for one can only recommend this. The only downside by getting garlic salt, you basically pay for buying salt added in vs just buying the pure ingredient, something to consider.

title: Not fully sold on this
text:
I am, after a couple of servings, not sure yet what to think of this skinny shake. It is fairly low in calories, at about 150 calories for one shake, but I am still not 100% sold on how it tastes. Yes it tastes of Vanilla and so far I have only made it with water to get the lowest calories possible, but it is just missing something in my eyes. It is packed with a lot of ingredients good for you such as vitamins and various minerals, but still, the consistency when you make this shake, I am just not sold on it. It is just a tiny tad gritty instead of completely smooth. Also the taste of it is a bit bland and is missing something there. After drinking one I did not feel very sated either but for right now I try to stick to this replacing one meal a day to see what kind of result I can get.

This one is missing the mark just a bit because of the taste but also because of its consistency a little bit. The powder on its own however smells amazing.

title: Love these, great salty-sweet snack
text: These roasted pecans are a delicious snack. They are salted and have honey on them, so it is a nice balance of sugar and salt. I really like to take these to work and snack on them when I get a little hungry. The bag is resealable so perfect for this. My only complaint is that they are chopped so you get these tiny pieces, if they weren't you could get nicer chunks of them but then you would also probably get less of the lovely salt and honey on them. The chop them so you can add them to salads but personally I just love eating them on their own since these are so good.

title: Very nice green tea
text: This green tea does not taste like your average green tea. The smell of it was more like hay but it does not taste like it. It definitely tastes like green tea but with a more herbal flavor to it I think. I like that this company produces 100% organic products. Unlike some green teas I have had in the past this one is very smooth which I like.

title: Not what I expected
text:
I thought this tea would taste different than it did. I thought with the name Guava it would have a sweeter taste but it was more herbal then sweet. It was still a very good tea but definitely not what I expected. It has a lot of beneficial properties like aiding in sleep, helps with lowering cholesterol and anti-diarrhea.

It was a tad on the bitter side but adding a little sugar takes care of that. Since I usually take sugar in my tea this is not a problem at all.

title: Very good variety of chocolate but a tad expensive
text:
Having grown up in Austria I am used to very good chocolate. I have to say this Swiss chocolate did not disappoint. Personally I like milk chocolate the best. In this variety pack you get to sample a few different flavors which is nice.

Since I like the milk chocolate the best I started with that one and I was not disappointed. This one was very good, smooth and creamy. My second favorite was the crunchy caramel with sea salt which was very good as well. How can you possibly go wrong with milk chocolate and caramel? Well the answer is you just can't. The next one was a tie for the white chocolate with bourbon vanilla and the milk chocolate with roasted almonds. Both of these were also very good and to be honest all these 3 very not that far off from the just plain milk chocolate. Personally I am not a fan of dark chocolate so that one got the bottom spot. But in its defense I have to say it was very smooth and not as bitter as dark chocolate can be at times.

I have to say though this chocolate is a bit expensive at 5 bars for $25. That is $5 a bar! Yes this is very good chocolate but I am not sure if I would spend that much on chocolate on a regular basis. For a special treat yes but there is other European chocolate that is just as good but for less than half that price. The price is the only reason why I deducted a star.

title: Delicious but expensive!
text: Having grown up in Austria I am used to very good chocolate. I have to say this Swiss chocolate did not disappoint. Personally I like milk chocolate the best and this one is very smooth and creamy. The chocolate arrived without any issues which is great. This being imported from Switzerland I am always a tad cautious since chocolate can be affected by temperature changes but there were no issues here. I have to say though this chocolate is a bit expensive at 5 bars for $24. That is almost $5 a bar! Yes this is very good chocolate but I am not sure if I would spend that much on chocolate on a regular basis. For a special treat yes but there is other European chocolate that is just as good but for less than half that price. The price is the only reason why I deducted a star.

title: Absolultely delicious!
text:
I know a lot of people love the pumpkin spice, well I am not one of them but I figured I would give this tea flavor a try since it did sound interesting. I have never tried any of those pumpkin spice lattes or anything but I have to admit, this pumpkin spice tea is absolutely delicious! It has hints of cinnamon, star anise and nutmeg which combined with the pumpkin come together to a delicious concoction. I was pleasantly surprised how much I enjoyed this. In addition this tea has some health benefits by providing some vitamins, Calcium and Iron, what more can one ask for?

I can only recommend this tea, and this is from a person who has not fallen for the pumpkin spice craze.

title: A little expensive but absolutely delicious!
text:
I absolutely LOVE this tea. It has an incredible flavor and comes in these cute little pyramid tea bags. The tea bag can be used at least twice and yes I did test that out and the second time the tea was as good as the first time around. I did not test for a third time but will do so in the future.

The tea is a bit on the more expensive side but at least you can reuse the tea bags to bring down the price a little bit. But I really like this tea so I would buy this for special treats.

title: Tasty, just wished I would have gotten milk chocolate covered instead - my mistake though
text:
This dark chocolate covered almonds are a nice little snack. At over 500 calories for the entire pack it is quite a bit of calories though, so make sure you don't eat the entire pack in one sitting. The packs are resealable so it is at least easy to save them for the next snack. Unlike what a lot of reviewers wrote, I did receive all 3 packs in my shipment, so no complaints there.

These are pretty but I am not the biggest fan of dark chocolate. I did notice thought that they offer a large range of flavors and noticed that they have milk chocolate ones, now those would be right down my alley. I probably won't be repurchasing these, but I will try out their milk chocolate covered ones. I liked the quality of these and flavor overall. Even though it was dark chocolate it was not as bitter as some dark chocolate can be. Just because I am not the biggest fan of dark chocolate I can't fault this product. I have let some of my friends who do like dark chocolate and they were loving this, hence my rating for this product.

title: Deliciously good
text:
Yum, yum and did I mention yum? So I admit, I am not a fan of dark chocolate, not at all to say the very least! But this dark chocolate from Dove is actually not bad at all. Do I now like dark chocolate, NO. Would I buy this dark chocolate separately, again NO but in this multi pack I will eat it.

However, the Bourbon Vanilla Dark Chocolate is absolutely AMAZING !!!! I had no idea that dark chocolate could taste like this. It has subtle hints of caramel and vanilla, not sure I tasted the bourbon and some taste of the dark chocolate and combined it was just pure bliss.

And lastly the slated caramel blonde chocolate, again not a fan of white chocolate but unlike with dark chocolate I don't have negative feelings against it. Again this is a winner. The white chocolate carries the salted caramel beautifully and makes you forget you are eating white chocolate all together.

So in this variety box you get 3 full size chocolate bars of each, so just over $2 each. I am not sure if you can get these individually or not. If you can I would just get the bourbon vanilla and maybe the caramel blonde, if not, get the variety mix, pick the ones you like the most and gift the others like I do. But these are some seriously good ones and I am picky with chocolate, having grown up in Austria with access to some of the best chocolate there is and I really liked this a lot!

title: Delicious little snack
text:
I was not sure what to expect from these snack bars, but I was pleasantly surprised when I had these snack bars. The bar itself is a lemon-zest bar that is covered with a blueberry-jam like topping and some frosting. I have to say these two flavors complement each other well and the sweet of the blueberry offsets the sour of the lemon beautifully!

For those who want a high protein snack, well this bar has it and it is gluten free to boot. Considering the size having 190 calories, I found that to be a bit on the higher side but I am guessing that is coming from the sugar since it is pretty sweet, but since I don't mind sweet this hits the spot. I can't say it gives you a full feeling for a long lasting time, but it is a perfect little snack when the hunger strikes.

In this box you get 15 bars for almost $16, so at a $1 per bar that is a decent price in my eyes, better than a super sugar filled candy bar that you get out of a vending machine for the same price or bigger but without any nutritional value.

This bar is nice and chewy but yes it is sweet but I don't mind it and I prefer that over sour or bland. This is definitely a nice little snack that I won't mind grabbing in the future.

title: Packs a punch of caffeine
text:
I am actually a tad odd when it comes to coffee. I LOVE the smell of coffee but overall I don't enjoy drinking coffee drinks unless they are mostly something else with a splash of coffee. BUT I do enjoy eating coffee flavored foods, like pudding or ice cream. So I figured I had to give these CLIF bars a try. They were pretty good I admit. They were a bit strong though and I wouldn't eat them daily but they are definitely very good for a little caffeine pick me up.

These bars are not too big and give you a nice little snack when you need one with a good boost of caffeine as well, especially needed in the mid morning and mid afternoon lull when you really need a special little extra to get going again, you know what I mean. If you read the ingredients, at 60-70mg per bar, and a cup of espresso packing 63mg, you can see this packs a solid punch!

The consistency is a chewy kind of flavor and not very dry, so I prefer that any day over one of those more dry granola bars. I do enjoy the texture and flavor although the flavor can be a tad on the bitter side that coffee can be. All in all a good little snack. Curious what their other flavors taste like now, maybe take some of that bitterness out by covering it with that mild vanilla they talk about.

At about a $1 per bar, these are a decent value for your money since it is right up there of a candy bar but at least you are not stuffing your body with just sugar and preservatives!

title: Heavenly delicious!
text: This chocolate is absolutely heavenly! Especially dark chocolate lovers will love this one, but I have even turned milk chocolate lovers with this one. The chunks of caramels, covered with dark chocolate, dusted with chocolate powder and some sea salt are absolutely divine and I have yet to find someone who does not like these. These are huge pieces and worth the cheat day in your diet, if you are on one, and if you don't have a cheat day I recommend you add one so you can have some of these! Yes they are a little bit more on the expensive side, but they are worth every penny in my eyes.

title: Great alternative to some of those unhealthy versions out there!
text:
First of at 12 for $25, these are priced very nicely especially for getting an organic snack for your kids. Let's face it the crap kids eat every day is getting to a ridiculous point so finding one that is actually not too bad for them is actually nice for a change and not having to sell your first born for it, well can't beat that.

These are easy and quick to make which is as they are intended to. I personally prefer them taste wise over some other mac and cheese that I have come across in the market. Are they like freshly made from scratch ones, NO, but for what you get and how quickly these are pretty darn good so you can't beat that in my eyes. And getting an organic, healthier version on top of everything else, well the answer is clear to me especially if this is for a snack here and there.

I can only recommend these for those looking for a quick, healthy snack.

title: Amazing bite size chocolate
text:
This is my favorite Cocoa K'Choo Milk chocolate product to date. It has 2 different flavors, merry go mousse and totally coconut. Merry go mousse has a melty truffle center that is very good, but the other one is a totally toasty coconut, which is OUT OF THIS WORLD !!! That one is absolutely amazing and is nice and crunchy. I can only recommend this one, especially to fellow coconut lovers. These come in nice little bit size pieces in a bag and you get 2 bags. Perfect as gifts or to bring to a party or just to snack at home by yourself really.

Really really good and trust me I know chocolate, I grew up in Austria and we know chocolate over there :)

title: Very nice chocolate
text:
This is the second flavor of this chocolate I have tried and I admit I like both quite a lot. As a background I grew up in Austria so I am used to VERY good chocolate and yes Hershey's chocolate to me does not even qualify as cooking chocolate. I like milk chocolate that melts in your mouth, nice and creamy. I also prefer no filling overall in my chocolate so since these do come with filling my taste buds to have to adjust for that.

Overall I must say this one is very good. The chocolate itself is a very well done milk chocolate that is maybe a bit on the harder side but it will melt in your mouth just fine. This one has a very nice vanilla filling that complements the chocolate beautifully. I for one thing it is a very nicely done chocolate. Will it replace my all time favorites, no, but will I switch mine up every now and then and add this one to the mix, probably.

title: Yummy chocolate
text:
I grew up in Austria and I am used to pretty damn good chocolate, so my standards are pretty high when it comes to chocolate. I for one wouldn't even use Hershey's chocolate to cook, and yes a lot of my friends do not appreciate me saying that, but sorry that can't be helped. I like nice creamy and sweet chocolate, and Hershey's just doesn't fit that bill, but I digress.

I was a bit hesitant to try new chocolate, but also excited, good thing I didn't read the description too much in detail since I missed the fondant filling part. I am usually not a fan of that at all.

With the stage set, what did I think of this chocolate, all in all actually pretty darn good. The chocolate is milk chocolate so that is a huge plus and very nice and creamy. The first bar I tried had broken pieces so that was a bummer. I was lucky to get these in October so unlike some other customers who had temperature issues, I had no such trouble. The filling was actually pretty good too and yes very sweet, but when I get chocolate, I don't mind that, it is part of the deal if you ask me. I found that the filling flavor (mocha cream) paired really well with the chocolate and I was very happy with this.

Now was this a great deal for the price? At 6 bars for $14 it was actually a bit more than I can get my favorite Austrian chocolates (usually at around $1.50 to $2 a bar). Keeping all that in mind I would probably stick to my usual over this just because I do prefer my usual and the price of it is slightly better overall. If you are looking for a very nice mocha filled chocolate bar though, you can't go wrong with this one. It is just my own personal preference that will keep me to buying me own kind of chocolate.

title: Best Caramels out there !
text:
These are the BEST !!!! A tip for those who are having issues unwrapping them. Yes this is a serious problem, has been always (trust me I grew up with them) and has NOTHING to do with them being bad or anything. This is caramel and it is stick, so it will stick to the wrapper. The wrapper is somewhat coated but it is not 100%. So the trick is, hold it in your hand for a little bit and warm the Carambar up just a little bit. Then unwrap them, trust me it will make a world of a difference!

For the ones claiming they are to sweet, well helloooooo it is CARAMEL which is basically PURE SUGAR with some extra flavor I think! What do you expect? It is sugar and sugar is sweet , so don't buy sugar if you don't want sweet. I love these and grew up with them. I remembered them the other day and was ecstatic when I found that they were here on Amazon! So now I can buy them whenever I want, just have to find the best price deal on them.

These are awesome and I will keep buying them. If you don't like sugar and caramel, well these won't be for you. If you like amazing caramel, well then don't look any further. Europeans know how to make candy, and these are original from France I believe and they know their sweets!

title: Love my garlic powder
text:
I tend to use a lot of garlic powder when I cook so I was very happy with this one. It is definitely better than your generic grocery store brand. You can tell you are getting something better than what your grocery store is trying to sell you to compete with this kind of seller.
It has a great flavor and you can finally taste garlic in your cooking. I LOVE making a sour cream souce with lots of garlic that goes great with oven baked potatoes and this garlic powder is amazing for it !!!

Great find!

title: LOVE THESE
text:
I used to eat these when I lived back home in Austria and they were always too expensive. Finally the price was reasonable and I bought them. They were exactly as I remembered them. Delicious! I even got my friends hooked on them. Sadly the price went up again so I will wait until the price is somewhat reasonable again but the product is fantastic.
For those who never had it, they are somewhat similar to kitkats, just much much better, the chocolate is better and I for one am addicted. Just wish the price would be more reasonable!

title: Yummy and as good as I remember
text:
Love these and wish there were easier available in the US. Grow up with them back in Austria and miss a lot of the chocolate goodies.
Product is as advertised. Shipping to a little longer since it was mailed from Europe but that didn't affect the products at all. Can only recommend this seller

title: Yum!
text: Love these and they are difficult to find in the US

title: YAY MILKA !!!
text: I just love my milka chocolate and am so happy I can get my fix through Amazon!!! Prompt delivery and product was as promised

title: Can't go without my milka chocolate :)
text: Love Milka and it is nice to see I can now get it here in the US without trouble. Price is not horrible all considering !!!

title: Decadent
text:
There is nothing like this. It's something I get for special occasions, like my birthday or to take for a holiday pot-luck. I love this product and which that I could get it without the pricy shipping fee. it's over half the price of the dish and why I usually buy when there is some sort of shipping discount or site wide discount happening.

You will taste nothing better. Highly recommend trying it at least once if you like macaroni and lobster.

title: Great buy!
text: Great value for the purchase. Terrific snack size to take in lunches and tastes great!

title: Great healthy option!
text: People are always looking for healthy meal replacements or snacks, kind bars are great choices. You have to incorporate them based upon your own individual dietary needs. The taste is great, you can see all the ingredients so you know exactly what you are eating and lastly there is no guilt afterwards because you made a good choice. Unlike wasting it on sweets that will only have you craving more. These are nice and filling.

title: Yummy to the last bite!
text: It is like a cookie and a brownie rolled into one.

title: Great healthy choice!
text: If you are looking for a healthy snack then Kind bars are a great choice to consider. I love the Dark Chocolate Cinnamon Pecan because dark chocolate and cinnamon are additionally good ingredients to add to you diet along with all the other natural ingredients. I can always count on not having to worry about chemicals and unnecessary additives that you find in so many other snack foods. I would recommend kind bars to anyone who is looking for that healthy snack alternative.

title: Healthy never tasted so good!
text: The Oats and Honey Bars are very yummy. They have a great flavor and you would have no idea that you are eating a health bar filled with whole grains.  Will definitely be buying these again. Love the product and the value.

title: Great treat!
text: I was looking for a snack that was not high in sugar and these yummy little treats sure did deliver. Whether you count calories, watch carbs or watch your sugar this is a great snack that is low in calories and sugar. They had several flavors but I was partial to vanilla cinnamon flavor with the caramel filling. I will be sure to buy them again.

title: Product not as expected...
text: I would not say that they are exactly crunchy, maybe more hard?  They are absolutely 100% apple pieces but because you can get pieces of the seeds, etc that have been dried with the apple if you bite into one of those pieces it is like biting into a rock. The rest of the apple pieces , maybe if they were a little bit bigger they would be better as a crunchy piece. Otherwise I think I would prefer if they were soft apple bites.  Don’t know that I will buy again.

title: Great snack on the go!
text: These are the perfect size for on the go and lunches. There were four flavors for a good variety. I personally liked the caramel, cinnamon apple and buttermilk ranch the best. The cheddar was okay, just not a personal favorite. They have several different flavor combinations so you can change it up, love that too. Was fresh and stores well. Will absolutely buy again.

title: Healthy meets Delicious!
text: When they said Drizzilicious, they were not kidding. An amazing whole grain rice cake snack that tasted decadent. So if you crave something sweet but don’t want to be unhealthy and eat the candy bar then these would be an awesome choice. Love them and that I can buy in small portions to take with me or in my lunch. Will buy again.

title: Love the variety!
text: Having small portions that you can put in your purse to have on the go or for your lunch is great. Love having the option of 4 different flavors so could alternate choices. All the ingredients were fresh and tasted great. Will definitely buy again.

title: Great alternative to chips!
text: Stacy’s Pita chips are a great healthy choice instead of chips or other snacks. Now in great convenient togo packages you can have a bag ready to put in your lunch or grab for a snack anytime. This is a great buy packed with great flavor. Will be sure to buy again.

title: That’s It Mini bars, great deal!
text: This variety pack is a great offer, cannot be found on That’s It store site. You get 24 of 3 different flavors of the mini bars. If you are looking for a great healthy snack for your kids lunch or something for you to have on the run this is a must have. It is literally fruit in a bar.

title: More than advertised! Excellent Quality Bamboo Stalks!
text: None of my local stores carry any individual bamboo stalks, so when I came across these on Amazon, I had to purchase them.  They provide proper Feng Shui in each area I need them in our home.  Healthy stalks arrived neatly packaged and were easy to separate into the arrangements I needed. After almost 6 months, they've thrived well and have grown taller. These stalks are more than advertised as with proper care, you can expect to have them for years. I will purchase from this company again as I'm very pleased with this order.  Thank you!

title: Yummy and a great price (sometimes)
text: My daughter loves these so much and they are so expensive in the grocery stores. At least at our local one. These were a great deal when they were $20 for 10 big boxes but we know the price fluctuates. I usually wait until I see it at a great price and stock up on my kids favorite snacks. They love the strawberry I love the cookies and cream. These are so good. We haven't received any that were melted or expired so will be continuing to buy them until that happens. I am so happy to be able to get anything and everything from Amazon. Especially during a pandemic.

title: Yummy

title: Great texture! Tastes like cardboard!?
text:
Pros: The texture on these low carb noodles is amazing! Truly wonderful mouth feel. The fact that that they are USDA certified organic is a huge plus for me. Which is why the cons are such a huge disappointment.
Cons: Tastes like cardboard (quite literally)

I followed my own sage advice (which was in a comment in response to a one-star reviewer) and thoroughly washed these noodles under running water first. Then, I put them into a simple bone broth I had made and simmered them for over 10 minutes. To my chagrin and utter surprise, my previously delicious broth now tasted like someone had boiled some cardboard in it. I am not exaggerating or being facetious here - it quite literally tasted like cardboard!

I had only used half the bag of the noodles, so I decided to try frying them. I opted for fresh bacon drippings because they have a strong taste and were handy too, because I had just fried up some organic, preservative-free bacon. I fried the noodles in a small amount of bacon grease for about 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. I added some chopped fresh scallions too. Then I made a favorite Hungarian dish out of it, called Turos Csusza. Very simple dish. Just add 2-3 good dollops of fresh full-fat cottage cheese to the noodles, top off with 1-2 good dollops of full-fat sour cream, add salt and quite a bit of fresh pepper and top off with the bacon (in bits). Even through this is a fairly heavy flavored and textured dish, I could still taste some of the cardboard flavor, though not as bad. But, when I tasted it from the frying pan, before the other ingredients were added, that cardboard taste was still quite pronounced.

Now, the one star reviewer, said that "It tasted like tasteless rubber." If mine had tasted "tasteless", I would have given this product 5 stars. I fully expect shirataki pasta to have little to no taste. And the other two reviewers loved this pasta. So, I have to wonder if perhaps my batch had some old, stale oat fiber put into it, accidentally? The batch number is 150701, at least that's what it is on the other 5 bags in the box. I don't have the bag I opened anymore. I ordered the 6 pack.

Any input from the seller would be welcome, as I would really like to get a good batch and try again.

Update, Jan. 12, 2017: I have tried buying this product 3 more times. Twice from different sellers, in the hopes of getting a different lot no to sample. No luck. Even though the orders were weeks, and even months apart (June 2, June 9, June 18, August 10), I just kept getting the same lot number. On the first couple of orders, I kept trying them, but after experiencing no change in the problem, I just returned the others unopened. I wish it had worked out, because the texture is great.

As long as this product stays in the $10.99 or less range, I will keep buying Healthworks cacao for the savings. However, the packaging is not as good as the Navitas packaging. Ideally, this product should be in a dark, opaque container. Light should not be getting through because light, heat and air degrade the product. So, if you don't use your cacao up quickly, then be sure to store it in an opaque container, or somewhere where light can't get at it. I store it in a [[ASIN:B00167XN14 Planetary Design Airscape 64oz Chrome]] (smaller than this one) which I bought at my local health food store. I put some plastic wrap and then a piece of aluminum foil on top of the cocoa so it doesn't get sucked through the air valve of the insert. You push the insert down against the food and all the air gets pushed out. The container itself is stainless steel, so it definitely keeps the light out. Works great for many different things. This cacao is one of them.

The reason I put plastic first and then foil is because:
a/ I don't like aluminum touching my food. b/the plastic wrap is too soft and would not let the air valve release when it's time to remove it. The more rigid, and creased surface of the aluminum foil solves that problem.

title: An Ode to the Drink of the Gods...
text:
This Mango Nectar is perfection! It deserves the highest praise, and I feel compelled to be the one to give it.

First, it must be understood that this is a true delicacy and thus it is to be sipped and savored slowly, not gulped down indiscriminately like a can of coke. If you really want to get the most out of this true little slice of heaven, you have to address it unhurriedly , preferably with your eyes closed. It is best served refrigerated and I like to drink it straight out of the can, because even the can feels good, with its slim line and nice heft. It's actually quite a bit heavier than one expects... So, can or glass, take a sip and gently roll it around on your tongue, like you would a fine wine. Feel the thick richness of the nectar, dancing its dance of subtle, rich flavors in the hiddenmost recesses of your taste glands. Remember to breath gently through your mouth and nose too, to get the full effect of the subtle hues of this amazing fruit's aromas. Notice the tiniest little hint of bitterness - it really rounds out the "feel" of the mango. It no doubt comes from the pulp and, without it, this juice would not be nearly as delectable as it is.

Does this sound like poetry to you? Perhaps it seems like it is a somewhat overdone description of a product that is, after all, "only a fruit juice", right? Well, I invite you to try it yourself and see if it is not deserving of every accolade I have ascribed to it and many others I may have missed.

I am having one now and I must add, though it is probably fairly obvious, I feel it enhances my imagination and my creativity too... :)

title: Smoothest honey we have ever tasted
text: My husband Robert started using the Manuka honey [[ASIN:B000VK08OC Wedderspoon Raw Organic Manuka Honey Active 16+, 17.6-Ounce Jar]] when he was having digestive problems. We decided to try this honey as well, when we saw it came from the same producer. We also liked the idea that the Beechwood honey is purported to be so rich in minerals. Well, this turns out to be the best tasting honey either of us has ever tried. I don't eat it that often, just now and then as a treat - only because I don't need the extra calories. My husband, on the other hand, has no such concerns holding him back and he has this honey on toast at least once a day. He, like me, loves the full, smooth flavor. Robert's stomach used to rumble all the time before he started using these two honeys (Beechwood and Manuka), now all has been silent for months. He looks a lot healthier too. Knowing that it is organic, raw and chock full of nutrients just adds further to our enjoyment. Highly recommended!

title: Delicious, medicinal honey
text:
Granted, this honey is on the pricey side, but I have to say it's more than worth it. My husband had been trying all kinds of ways to tame his ulcerative colitis for months, but the only thing that worked was this raw organic manuka honey. The only other things he used with it were a product call Sera Vera and some probiotics. He still needs to watch his diet somewhat, but he has not had loose stools or blood in his stools since he went on this raw organic Manuka honey and Sera Vera routine. Now, if he eats something that does not agree with him completely, he will get gas but no blood or diarrhea. This is a very big relief for both of us. We really wanted to avoid having him go on meds. That is just a vicious circle and we were aiming at curing rather than just controlling symptoms. We seem to be headed in the right direction as we are adding more and more foods back into his diet slowly and he is starting to gain his weight back. He loves the taste of the honey and not only eats it on its own, but also on toast several times a day. It has helped heal his gut, it stimulates his appetite, and it satisfies his cravings for sweets, which is great, because he is not eating any sugar at all right now, because sugar depresses the immune system.

I have tasted the honey too and I love the taste. I am so glad we found this wonderful resource.

title: So simple, so addictive... (no longer....)
text:
These are the best potato chips I have ever tasted. And I'm not a potato chip person.

These chips are super crispy, taste great and, best of all: they use sea salt for seasoning, which, unlike sodium, is actually good for you!

This product is made by FritoLay and, for some reason, they never advertised it properly. So now, the large economy bags are no longer made and you can only buy these small bags at places like Quizno's and Subway. Unfortunately, they usually only have the flavored ones available at these places. And, although the flavored ones are also crispy and taste good too, most all of them have undesirable additional ingredients like MSG - in plain sight, or in hidden form "Autolysed Yeast Extract", "Yeast extract", "Natural Flavor", etc. There are many pseudonyms for MSG, many ways to hide it legally. There are entire books written on the subject!

So, I was real happy to see this product available through Amazon.com. And at a reasonable price, too! If you are into potato chips, I highly recommend you try this one!

Update: 11/11/09 - I have had to update my previous glowing review. The chips I received in this order are the ones made in Canada and there is a definite difference in the texture and taste of these chips. Much less crisp, mealier mouth feel. This also affects the taste, as do the not-so-occasional overcooked chips in each bag. Also, the sell-by date is about 2-3 weeks from when I got them. Not cool... The US made chips are waaaay better. By a very long shot! I used to rate these 5 out of 5, now they're down to 2 stars.

title: Formula change makes product worse
text: Stride used to be a great gum. It was one of the only gum products I could chew because I am very sensitive to sugar alcohol.  The ingredient profile use to be wonderful.  It was also one of the most expensive gums on the market but I was willing to pay a few cents extra for better quality ingredients.  A few years ago they changed Stride to Stride 2.0.  It wasn't as great as gum as before.  They replaced the xylitol with the Sorbitol and Mannitol.  In 2016 they revamped the product again and while they reintroduced xylitol, they added maltitol, one of the cheapest sugar alcohols.  Maltitol has horrific side effects that includes an upset stomach, cramping, and smelly gas. Maltitol also has a huge influence on blood sugar.  Maltitol syrup has a glycemic index of 52, which approaches that of table sugar at 60. Mondelez International keeps changing the formula of stride to make more profit by putting in cheaper sugar alcohols. The latest change in September 2016 was the last straw for me. I will no longer be buying this brand.

title: The only 160 kcal chocolate ice cream of which we know
text:

We still hate Amazon shipping for this product. See other recommendations where we've explained our experiences with AMZN shipping --- which is so close to unacceptable we'd punt were it not we really like this product.

title: We love Arctic Zero
text: The low glycemic, non dairy, non gluten product hits the spot. It's not ice cream. It just has the attributes we want in ice cream without all the down sides. You don't end up a sticky gloppy mess with a gummy taste in your mouth, you don't get stomach aches, it tastes very good, and you don't avoid the scale for a week after eating a whole pint by yourself. What is not to like?  See other review in Arctic Naturals for issues (severe) with Amazon shipping of this product, which is abnormally poor.

title: What's not to like about Arctic Natural non-dairy gluten free low glycemic idx product
text:
It's perfectly fine. There's no bad taste in any of their products. If you don't try to eat it rock hard (which the directions clearly point out you should avoid) and you don't try to eat it when it's melted (just don't, take my word for it), it's great.

It meets all our requirements: it's really cold, it is somewhat sweet, there is no terrible aftertaste, it doesn't leave a gummy residue on the tongue, it doesn't hurt your stomach afterwards, and if you eat two of the pints you can't feel anything in your mouth for a really long period of time due to the cold.

Amazon's shipping leaves so much to be desired for this product it's hard to know where to begin. IT SUCKS. DO NOT ACCEPT THE PRODUCT IF AMAZON:

- loses it and tries to deliver it after it has melted. if you find that anything has separated or if the product looks dwindled at all on arrival, that is due to the product not being kept properly frozen during shipping. the product is no longer any good. demand a refund.

- delivers it and the covers have fallen off - again - not safe. just demand a refund.

Also you can never tell when the product might be arriving given how Amazon reports tracking it. So, you might suddenly get it a week before it is forecasted to arrive or at any time really. That hardly works for a frozen item which must not be allowed to melt and to then re-freeze. It is no longer safe to eat if this happens.

Amazon has also delivered partial orders where some arrived in a timely manner, some went missing for 3-4 days (again, do not eat it) and some never showed up where I've given up on trying to get a refund thru Amazon.

We wish Arctic Zero would ship via someone else. Amazon is doing a terrible job with this product. But we love the product. Even better would be if they started to use more of the muscle building and vitamins, etc. materials useful for athletes. And if there's a way to reduce the amount of the 2nd ingredient - sugar - as that is a pretty gross 2nd ingredient to have in a product. If they could pull this off I'd try to buy the company.

Second: it’s weak....
Third: it grinds chunky and weird. You get big chunky bits. And I know all about coffee grinds, I used to be a barista at an actual cafe (not a chain). I know what I’m doing.
Fourth: I think the “sheen” of the beans is somehow manufactured, not the actual production of healthy oily beans and that’s why it doesn’t grind correctly. As if they were old dry stale beans and they lather them in some oil at some point before packaging.

I even tried to just make cold brew out of it because you go through a lot of beans to make a good batch......and it’s disgusting. I tried a percolator too. There’s just no win for this coffee.
I think all the good reviews are a mix of people who maybe got a good batch, false reviews, people who just don’t care if coffee tastes like crap because it’s so cheap and maybe at some point they were making good coffee and due to immense pressure to make more......they have failed roasting standards.

I’m tossing the bag.

title: No Diacetyl Added!  Good news for Popcorn lovers
text:

If you eat your microwave popcorn while it is still hot, you have a good chance of being satisfied. When you wait until it is cold, then you tend to get that greasy taste in the mouth.

In this case, the cold taste in your mouth is the butter flavor. But, many popcorns have that same result if eaten cold.

The package says 3 minutes in the microwave.. But, this depends on the microwave wattage. I am comfortable to get a bag popped at 2:30 minutes.

The taste is good, and this bag is a nice quick snack.....even if you do eat the whole thing....Rizzo
