Brown and/or saute the shrimp, pour the glaze and it is ready. This dish calls for a pound of shrimp, and the servings is enough for a small size family; with moderate portions.

The meal is easy to prepare, with wholesome goodness. Try these other dishes from Good Earth: [[ASIN:B00434KONW Good Earth Restaurant Favorites, Tuscan Chicken with Penne Pasta, ]] or [[ASIN:B00434FSOC Good Earth Restaurant Favorites, Mediterranean Chicken with Angel Hair Pasta, )]]

Next, it's simple, brown the chicken in seasoned flour bag, brown for few minutes. Then, add the seasoning, milk, water, and sauce.

They will appreciate you for reading the directions, opening the box, and mixing it all in the chicken. Try this one also. This isn't meant to be enough for a dinner/meal, so you hearty eaters can open a can of vegetables and there you have a meal.

One note on cooking the pasta. Make sure the water covers every piece of pasta, otherwise you may get a hard end on the ziti.

Take this for lunch on the go. Eat it for a quick dinner and you have a tasty meal. There are only 6 grams of fat, and 2g of saturated fat, and 230 calories. Total carbs are 56g and 15g of protain.

Nonrefrigerated!

Quick and easy prep time, and tasty!.......Rizzo

title: Review for Homestyle Healthy Request Harvest Tomato With Basil
text:
It appears that under the review of this product there are reviews for a bunch of other flavors of Campbell's Soup, so let me stress that my review is for Campbell's Home Style Healthy Request Harvest Tomato with Basil only.

I love this soup, with the small reservation that they apparently can't make soup without sugar in it. Thanks so much, Campbell's, from all of us who are (1) watching our weight or (2) have diabetes, both situations existing in our household. Given that, I do use this soup occasionally as a treat to make a nice "quick and dirty" chicken cacciatore. Take chicken parts (bone in or bone out) and put in the oven seasoning with pepper (if you like it; I don't) and a mixture of parsley, garlic, and onions. Brown it slightly on both sides. In my oven that takes about 30 minutes. You want to spend the majority of your cooking time with the chicken cooking IN the soup. Pour a can of this stuff on; make sure all the pieces are covered. Add a can of mushrooms and some slices of Bell pepper. Turn over every fifteen minutes and baste the chicken with the tomato each time so the pieces are re-covered. Cook until 180 degrees inside. You will notice the only salt on this is from the soup. This is good for a low-salt diet.

Voila. Before cooking buy yourself salad veggies for a big green salad and a nice loaf of crusty French or Italian bread. Dip the bread in the sauce for a nice nostalgic Italian-American experience. ALMOST like my mom used to make.

title: Not Much Satisfaction Out of This One
text:
I still have two of the three packets of this popcorn left because the first experience was so bad I'm not sure if I want to try it again.

We have a big convection microwave that is of less wattage than most microwaves (900 watts vs. 1000-1200 I see on others). It usually takes much longer to heat things in it. Nevertheless, I followed the instructions to the letter, placing the popping bag direction side up on the center of the carousel. The microwave was on high, and I set it for 3 minutes (the max as stated by the instructions) and listened as it popped. Or, actually, didn't pop. After three minutes, only a few pops had been heard and the bag even hadn't started to expand. So I extended the time by one minute and stayed by the microwave. There still were few popping sounds, and then the horrible scent of burnt popcorn enveloped the kitchen. Immediately shut off the microwave and attempted to pull the bag out, only to have it split open and spill some of the butter topping on the kitchen floor. (And that stuff was slippery; I immediately wiped up the floor and still almost fell when I stepped on the same spot the next day.) Only a few kernels had popped after 3 1/2 minutes and most of it remained kernels swimming in butter sauce. The burned smell took two days to dissipate. I'm not sure I want to try it again, but if I do and it comes out better, I will re-evaluate my review.

title: Heavenly
text:
I have been hooked on Jolly Rancher watermelon candies since high school (that's 40 years this year!); they were in the only vending machine in the school...next to the gym. A classmate offered me one and after that I saved up a quarter to get them whenever they appeared. Later on you were able to buy bags of watermelon only candy in the grocery store. Then a few years back Jolly Rancher stopped this practice and only offered the mix of five original flavors. Well, the apple was sorta edible, the others less so, especially the cherry...if you were raised in the early 1960s like I was, you'll remember that EVERY med for children (except for Liquiprim, which was bubble-gum flavored), liquid and chewable was cherry flavored. And the cherry flavor Jolly Rancher tastes exactly like all those awful cough syrups, liquid antibiotics, and whatever else you had to swallow when you were sick. Talk about bringing back bad memories!

More recently I had been buying my watermelon Jolly Ranchers at a candy store called Fuzziwigs, but it closed. I was reduced to filching watermelon candies out of mixed bowls at events (my last three came out of the candy bowl the fire department had set up at the Home Show). And then I searched on Amazon...

title: Take it from a local boy - DO NOT BUY
text:
I was on a 13 day restricted sugar/restricted calorie diet and ordered these with as a cheat day reward. I held the package, not even daring to open it, until my cheat day. It was absolutely not worth it. Please, do not buy this product if you want authentic li hing candy.

As a local Hawaii boy living on the mainland, i was happy to hear of a local company selling li hing products on Amazon. I grew up in Hawaii and fondly remember when we had crack seed shops with scents so wonderful that I’d start salivating at the smell of li hing. However, these candies were an overwhelming disappointment. I hoped that just had one bad candy, so I opened three of the others to see if the first bag was just a fluke. Unfortunately all of the bags that I’ve opened had the same unpleasant aspartame taste. Yes, aspartame is a listed ingredient but since it’s so low on the ingredients list, I never anticipated that it’s presence would be so overwhelming. Additionally, the candies themselves are the generic equivalents of the name brand candy. Imagine off brand candy seasoned with aspartame li hing and you’ll know exactly what these candies taste like.

So Amazon isn’t the answer to our every desire, especially niche ones like local Hawaiian candies. I’ve since placed an order with a mom and pop crack seed shop in hawaii, so fingers that it’a worth it!

title: Shake Well Before Eating
text:
Confession time first, to give my evaluation a bit of context. I've been using microwave popcorn for years and am happily still doing so. There are a list of things on the label that are not important to me but do matter to a lot of people so let me repeat them here. This popcorn is listed as dairy free, non GMO, gluten free, peanut free, tree nut free, preservative free, kosher, no artificial flavors, and zero trans fat. There is a label on the package that I think says it's Certified Vegan but that label is so tiny I can't swear to it. Curiously enough, given that list, the popcorn is not organic.

All that aside, how does it taste? My first sample was the white cheddar popcorn and it was an interesting experience. At first the popcorn seemed pretty bland to me and I couldn't detect any cheddar taste at all. The deeper I got into the bag the better the popcorn tasted though and by the time I got to the bottom, it was quite flavorful indeed. A moment's thought made it clear what was going on. The seasoning had settled to the bottom of the bag. The next time I turned the bag upside down several times, shaking it repeatedly each time. Sure enough, the flavor was more evenly distributed that time. I do like the taste of the cheddar popcorn and am happy to snack on it. The only seasoning on their regular popcorn seems to be salt though and it does taste bland to me. I'll pass on the regular flavor myself though others may like it.

The other thing of note is the portion size. There are only 80 calories per bag but the bags are a bit small. It would take two of them to make a sufficient snack for me. I'm a big guy though with a big appetite so the portion size might work better for other people than it does for me.

title: A Nice Alternative To Coffee Or Soda
text:
My liquid routine is pretty straightforward and has been for a long, long time. Coffee with breakfast. Soda with lunch. Water the rest of the day then either water or soda with supper depending on my mood. While I like grape juice and apple cider I don't go out of my way to buy them and haven't had either in quite a long time. So trying this strawberry juice was a bit of an experiment for me, one that I'm glad I tried. After a couple of days of drinking this juice I was surprised to find myself reaching for one of these bottles instead of a soda for lunch. I was even more surprised at breakfast this morning to realize I wanted some of this juice instead of coffee. That was a bit of a shock but it turns out I didn't miss the coffee at all. :)

Strawberries have always been one of my favorite fruits and this is a nice way to get that flavor. Even better, given what I've been hearing about strawberries and pesticides recently, this juice is 100% organic and additive free. There is an aftertaste that takes a little getting used to but that's often the case with liquids. Coffee was definitely an acquired taste in my younger days and shifting between diet and non-diet coke always takes some time to adjust. All in all, I am really enjoying this product.

title: Stevia Issues To Keep In Mind
text:
First, let me say I am using this product several times a day and I like it a lot. For anyone thinking about buying it though there are a couple of things to keep in mind - the taste and the packaging.

If you've never used stevia before the taste may take some getting used to. It took me several days to get used to it the first time I bought stevia. That shouldn't be a surprise though. The same thing happens with things like Coke and Diet Coke. If I've been drinking one for a while, it takes me a bit to get used to the different taste of the other. These days I've long since gotten used to stevia and I wouldn't use any other sweetener.

Another issue is the difference in taste between various brands of stevia. The local organic food co-op in my town bottles their own and that's what I started with. Once, when they ran out, I bought a commercial brand from Walmart. Sadly, the taste was so bad that I couldn't use it. The second time my co-op ran out of their own brand, I bought Kal Pure Stevia Extract Powder. It tasted different from the local brand but I quickly got used to the new taste and had been buying it for a while. This time I went from the Kal Stevia to One Organic and I didn't notice any difference in the taste at all. The upshot of all this is that if you buy stevia for the first time, or buy a new brand for the first time, give yourself a few days to get used to the taste before deciding if you like it or not.

The packaging of One Organic is something else I've seen people comment on. Rather than a bottle or some solid container like other brands use, this one comes in what seems to be a sturdy bag. That is not an issue for me. I simply put the bag in an air tight container on my kitchen counter and that works just fine.

Finally, there are a couple of other things I like about this product. That's the price and the fact that it is pure organic stevia without any additives.

title: Tastes like the sea, but is believed to have great health benefits.
text:
Recently, I have heard people talk about the health benefits of sea moss. Supposedly, it gives you energy, contains several minerals (i.e., iron, potassium, zinc, copper) and vitamins (i.e., vitamin, B1, B2, B6, folic acid, vitamin C) that are beneficial to the body. Based on the benefits, I decided to try Holistic Bin Naturals’ Organic Sea Moss. Inside of the resealable bag are three colored samples of dehydrated/dry/raw/Caribbean Blend, sea moss: light brown, blue and purple. I then watched several videos on preparation. These are the steps that I suggest taking:

Step 1: Prepare a clean bowl.
Step 2: Wash/rinse the sea moss (I did it 3 times) to remove residual sand (there wasn’t a lot).
Step 3: Add spring water to the bowl (until it is almost to the top).
Step 4: Cut a fresh, clean lime and squeeze the juice into the water. (Several sea moss aficionados suggest using lime to cut the ocean/sea taste.) Place lime halves in the water. (**Beware: Still tastes like something from out of the sea, but after a few uses, you get used to it.)
Step 5: Allow to sit for 48 hours (on my counter covered in plastic). It will expand and fill the bowl.
Step 6: Then blend into the desired consistency. I blended mine until it was the consistency of apple sauce or baby food, before placing in clean mason jars and refrigerating.

While this still tastes a little like the sea, taking about a tablespoon a day is supposed to give me more energy. I guess we will see in time how effective it is.

As a matter of fact, they taste so good that my family has trouble sticking with a single serving size (3 graham crackers for 150 calories). There are approximately 16 servings in a bag, which will cost you about $13 (for a 16 ounce bag). Kind of expensive, some would say, but worth it. These are the perfect combination of sweet and salty. They are crunchy and crispy. You hit the chocolate first, followed by the crunchy cracker, with salt as a finisher. Believe it or not, you can’t eat just one. I definitely think these are worth trying. I’d highly recommend them.

I created a dessert station and used this glitter toothpicks to top my cupcakes and various other foods during the festivities. These were perfect. They are well made.  They can also be used for a 50th anniversary or retirement. I'd recommend them.

title: A small amount goes a long way.
text: I’m not a big breakfast person, but my husband is, and one of his specialties is waffles. He makes a delightful waffle that has bananas and vanilla extract added to the batter. Adding just a teaspoon of Grandma’s Choice Pure Vanilla Extract to the batter added just the right amount of flavor. The waffles were delightful. This extract is very aromatic. It is gluten and GMO free, made of 35% alcohol and is purported to be made from Madagascan Vanilla Beans. At a little over $17 for 8oz, it is comparably priced to others on the market. I always found that vanilla extract/flavoring is expensive, so this one is no different. You can add this extract to desserts (i.e., cookies, cakes, ice cream) or dishes (i.e., sweet potato casserole). Overall, this is a great vanilla extract that will be a wonderful addition to any cook or baker’s pantry. I’d recommend it.

title: A lovely hostess or housewarming gift.
text: This is a delightful gift set for any honey lover. I liked the presentation, four small (4.4 oz) jars in a cute little box (with cutouts). Each jar contains a sample of a different honey: sweet clover, wildflower, raspberry blossom and buckwheat. You can use the honey as a sweetener (i.e., for tea), in recipes or as a condiment (on toast, drizzled atop friend chicken or biscuits). Regardless, this is a great little gift for any honey lover or as a housewarming/hostess gift.

title: Provides you with a lovely cup of tea!
text: T2 Lemongrass and Ginger Tea is tasty, with or without sugar. It smells great. The lemongrass is the dominant flavor. There are several healing properties for using lemongrass and ginger. Lemongrass is known for helping with digestion, boosting metabolism, regulating blood pressure, and relieving menstrual pain. Ginger provides pain relief and soothes an upset stomach. Both are ingredients that most people can benefit from. This loose tea is large and coarse.  The good thing is that because it is large, the ingredients don’t go through the strainer, like it would with smaller tea mixtures. I only wish this mixture had come with a resealable container. I had one, but it would have been nice had it come with one. Regardless, T2 seeps well and provides an aromatic fragrance. And if you drink this tea before bed, it provides you with a decent night sleep. I would recommend it, especially if you are a tea drinker. 4.5

title: I'd love some and so will you.
text: This is the second Lovesome brand item that I have tried and it definitely won’t be the last. This grape juice tastes great. It is made from concord grapes, and although it says unsweetened, it is sweet. But while you are satisfied with the tastes, it is good for you (i.e., no added flavors or colors). While I think the whole family will love this juice, I can definitely see kids loving it and demanding more. I’d highly recommend it.

title: I love me some Lovesome!
text: The Lovesome Raisin Bran cereal is great (imagine saying this in your best Tony the Tiger voice). This is the second Lovesome product that I have tried (their grape juice being the first). I have found that this brand is just as tasty as others (on the market), if not more so. This raisin bran has large/fat flakes with plump raisins. And not just a few raisins, but more than a few, in each mouthful. It also remains crunchy, even after adding milk. But this could be because my bowl never lasts long enough to even get soggy. And finally the cereal itself is made of 100% whole grain wheat and each serving is 190 calories (1 grams of fat; 20 grams of sugar, 5 grams of protein and 10.8mg of Iron). This cereal is great for breakfast and as a snack. And for the cost (less than $3 for a 18.7 ounce box), you can’t beat it. I’d highly recommend it.

title: A healthy snack!
text: I’m a big nut fan, especially of cashews and almonds. So I found Fisher’s Oven Roasted Almond Cashew Blend to be quite tasty. The nuts are (oven) roasted and seasoned with sea salt (and I didn’t think they were too salty). While I am not sure why it was important to say “never fried” on the package (I’m not sure that I have ever had fried nuts or even knew they could be), just placing that on the container made me think that these nuts are healthier. So I don’t feel as guilty. Besides, almonds and cashews are a good source of vitamin B and monosaturated fat. To solidify that point, Fisher’s Almond Cashew Blend does not have any oil added; any artificial ingredients; has not been genetically modified (GMO); or contain any preservatives. This 9oz container is a natural blend of nuts and holds approximately 9 (1/4 cup) servings. Each serving is about 160 calories, and contains 1.5g of saturated fat and 0% transfat. And finally, I was delighted that I didn’t have a ton of broken pieces in my container (99% of my nuts were whole). Overall, I enjoyed this blend and do not anticipate that it would be around long. Even as I write this review, I find myself munching on them. 4.5 stars

title: Sweet Heat! A sinful blend of nuts and fruit.
text: Amazon’s new Wickedly Prime – Organic Sprouted/Fiery Mango trail mix is very tasty. The 10.5 ounce bag is full of a delightful mix of nuts (almonds, cashews, sprouted pumpkin & sunflower seeds)  and fruit (goji berries, raisins, currants and spicy mango pieces). And to top it off, it includes a kick of habanero (hence the heat). This mix is perfect for vegans, or for those who want to be organic or gluten free. Every handful allows you to experience an explosion of flavors and textures. And when compared to other trail mixes on the market, this one is comparably, especially when you consider the ingredients. So for those who enjoy these types of snacks as fuel (protein or iron) or fun, they will devour it.

title: Eight common spices that are sure to please.
text: Usually I purchase my spices at the local farmers marker and sometimes the grocery store. I have purchased a variety of brands from McCormick to the store brand. I am usually pleased. But I am also like a lot of other people and forget to refresh my spices, especially those that I don’t use very often. I am sure that I have some that are old and the flavor isn’t as intense. So when offered these, I jumped on it. After all, it is a nice collection of some pretty basic (staple) spices. The eight included are curry, cayenne, ginger, cinnamon, cumin, turmeric, paprika and chili powder, which I find most people use. The containers are small (1 ounce) and stackable.  I like that the quantity is small because even the most basic cook will definitely use an ounce of spice within two years or before it loses its potency. I like that they are stackable because they take up less space in your spice cabinet. The retail price is around $24, which means that each container costs about $3. This seems comparable or a little cheaper than what you can purchase at the store, so why not just order it. Overall, I would recommend this 8 pack. It is useful and convenient. 4.5-5 stars

title: The real issue is not if I like them, but if my friend that I sent them to did.
text: I met my childhood friend when I was 10 years old. I remember us playing on the playground, having sleepovers, chatting about boys, talking while away at college, etc. And now years later, after husbands and kids, at almost 50, we still keep touch. She lives in Kansas and I live in HotLanta. So this Mother's Day, I decided to surprise her with some flowers, a kind of special thanks to her for always being there. Of course, she was surprised and pleased (see picture). She said that the sunflowers were beautiful (unfortunately you can't really see them in the photo that she took), and that since some of the flowers hadn't fully opened yet, she was sure to enjoy them over the next few days. I however, wished they had been a little fuller. Perhaps she should have cut the stems a little shorter, which would have made them fill out the vase more but regardless, that was a negative I found about this particular bouquet. Simply stated, I thought they could have been fuller. BUT on the positive side (there were definitely more positives than negatives), Amazon made it super easy to order; they delivered them on time and in good condition. Overall, she was pleased so I guess I am too.

title: Super convenient and a healthy snack.
text:
I love cashews, so these Orchard Valley Harvest snack bags are perfect.
Definitely convenient for those who want a snack, are dieting or want something extra for their lunches. You can use them in recipes or in salads.
Cashews (with sea salt) are tasty and these are no exception. Just the right amount of salt.
I like that these are individually packaged which allow you to grab and go. Each bag contains 8, 1 ounce individual bags nuts (pieces and halves). This means that there is no need to place any in a baggie or stop yourself from reaching into an open can. We all know that cashews, like pistachios can be addictive.
These are also great to curb the appetite. And priced at just a little over $10, each serving will cost you a little over $1.30. Which isn’t bad for a healthy snack (although I wish the portions were larger). I highly recommend this product.

title: Minor is major in flavor!
text:
This is my first experience with Minor products and I believe is a great alternative to bouillon cubes or canned broths.
A small amount of this liquid/puree (or perhaps I should describe it as gravy-like) goes a long way.
You can add it to sauces, soups or make a thicker gravy.
I added a bit to my meatloaf and it just intensified the flavor.
I also added it to my turkey burger recipe and it was great.
While some may think that it is on the expensive side, it lasts for a while. I use mine sparingly.
And an added plus is that this product comes with a small insert that includes recipe ideas.
I highly recommend it.

title: 11 Ounces of Goodness.
text:
I received this sample of Nature Valley Toasted Oats (Blueberry) Muesli, via Amazon, and allowed my hubby to try it. This bag of Nature Valley Toasted Oats is approximately 11 ounces and contains toasted oats, pumpkin seeds, dried blueberries and nuts. The directions: you simply mix ½ a cup of oats to ½ a cup of milk. My husband, who is lactose intolerant, used vanilla rice milk instead. He heated the mixture in the microwave for about 2 ½ minutes and declared it to be “at the top of his list” in terms of flavor. He further proclaimed that it was extremely tasty and the perfect treat for breakfast. Over a five day period, he was able to eat the whole bag with no complaints. He even tried it cold, leaving it out overnight which allowed the Muesli to absorb the milk and enjoyed that as well.

While my husband loved the taste, he gives this product “4” stars because of the price point ($12). At about five servings, this ends up being a little more than what he normally pays for other comparable brands. Per serving, he feels other brands are more economical.

title: A decent option.
text: While I didn’t like this flavor as much as the French Vanilla, it will do in a pinch. What I did like is the convenient pump container. It’s concentrated and a small amount goes a long way. I like that it allows you to select just the right amount of creamer without all the hassle. The package is small and doesn’t take a lot of space, which is great for the home or office. This container and handy pump feature will work perfectly in a break-room or kitchen in a small office. My only complaint is usually when I use liquid creamer, even the concentrated ones, especially the French Vanilla, I don’t have to add any additional sugar, but I found with the Hazelnut flavor I seemed to need either an additional shot of creamer or more sugar…which of course defeats the purpose since you want to take advantage of the fewer calories. But overall, while Hazelnut may not be my favorite flavor, I can honestly give this product 4 stars.

title: A nice variety of chocolates and truffles. 3.5
text:
This is a nice assortment of chocolates/truffles. There is a little bit of everything from milk chocolate, to Raspberry creme, to salted almond. There is definitely enough of a variety that a true connoisseur of chocolates will find something they like. These candies are individually wrapped and slightly bigger than a midget Tootsie roll. This 1lb bag is attractive and colorful. And the package includes a guide on the back that tells you which colors are associated with which flavors.....and it is also written on each piece of candy.

This bag of chocolates costs about $25. And while this is a little pricey, it is definitely cheaper than Godiva or even a couple of bags of Lindt chocolates. While I do not think that the Seattle chocolates are as sweet, smooth or even as creamy as Lindt/Lindor or Godiva, they are a decent alternative if you don't want to do a Hershey mix (which always works in a pinch).

In conclusion, while Seattle chocolates are a little expensive and not as tasty as some of the premium chocolates I prefer, they are a decent alternative and would make the perfect gift for a chocolate lover. And since this is Christmas, these would make a wonderful stocking stuffer or Secret Santa gift.

title: Know yourself
text: Basically coffee is a habit, but it is also a comfort.  Understanding that, too, is a comfort.  All of us are creatures of  habit, but some habits evolve. Nespresso is my current highest order.  I like to note habits and try to decipher them.  Animals’ habits are more interesting because they are not thought out which to me makes me think they are instinctual and thus based on survival.  Mine are more logic and mundane.  My pets have all tended to drink water before peeing, which makes sense because if the pee before they drink water then if they can’t find water later they will sooner find themselves dehydrated.  I, on the other hand, always eat a York chocolate mint before drinking my morning coffee.  I didn’t use to do that because I put a dash of Havana Club rum or Amaretto de Serrano in it.  But I stopped putting booze in my coffee because one drink inevitably lead to another later in the day and it interfered with my thinking and writing.  But then my coffee was too bitter and I took up the habit of eating a mint to cover up the bitterness of the coffee.  All this transpired without me consciously realizing it, so perhaps my wiring is not all that different from that of my lower orders of animals.

title: Cheap, quick, easy

I see some reviewers complaining about the sodium, which astounds me because....this is instant ramen. Of course it's going to have high sodium. That being said, this has less than some. I'm actually on a high sodium diet per my doctor, so it's not a problem for me - so I added a little extra chicken bullion to up the flavor, along with a tsp of Huy Fong chili garlic sauce. I'm normally kind of "meh" on ramen cups. But the veggies really add a lot to this cup, and throwing in a little extra bullion helps as well. The price fluctuates heavily on amazon, but if you can get this at a good price (.40 to .70 a cup), it's a great value in my opinion compared to your regular, smaller ramen cup that is just noodles and broth.

This isn't a health food - don't kid yourself. It's a quick, easy, cheap meal or big snack. It's pretty tasty. That's just what it is. So don't go in expecting this to be something it's not - though why you'd expect an instant ramen cup to be super healthy, I do not know.

title: Tastes just like the cups for me, very easy, less waste than cups
text:
I'll be honest....I love these things. When you're lazy, but hungry, and hungry for something like right now....easy mac is there. These clock in at a way cheaper price than you'll ever get for the cups and you generate a lot less trash. They taste the same to me. Just add water. If I have it, I'll do 1/3c water and 1/3c milk or 1/3c water and fill the 1/3c measuring cup half way with water, then the rest with half and half. It's a little richer that way. I nuke for 4 mins in my crappy 900 watt microwave. Then I add in a tiny sprinkle of seasoned salt, some black pepper, and chow down....after it cools a moment, anyway. You could added a little shredded cheese immediately after it's done microwaving, or even tear up a kraft single into smaller pieces and mix it in as it melts if you want it ultra cheesey. Usually I'm lazy and just eat it with seasoned salt and pepper.

Sometimes I make it for snacks or a light meal, sometimes I use it as a side to a meal for one, whatever. Or you can get more creative if you have leftover cooked chicken or bacon bits (real bacon!) and throw it in there. Chicken with sundried tomatoes in there is good. Oddly, something my mother made in my childhood was mac n cheese with some canned tuna and sweet green peas added at the end. You could add a bit of those. It sounds weird, but it's really good, cheap, and easy if you like tuna, and it can make it more of a meal.

title: Tastes like regular chocolate!
text:

It tastes like regular chocolate - the better kind, not cheap hersheys that has that oily feel and so sweet it's gross.
I was very hesitant. But then they had a sale with a coupon code for 50% off so I decided to give it a go. I got the Milk Chocolate and it is so delicious. My only complaint? The ingredient of soluble corn fiber. Since it's soluble, and it's corn, I assume it has a higher Glycemic index scale rating. If you are watching carbs and doing net carbs, a lot of people don't believe in netting off specifically "soluble fiber" because you still seem to absorb it.

HOWEVER, this is still a much better alternative sugar and carbs wise to regular chocolate, and it tastes just as good. I don't know if it's a good or bad thing that it doesn't have sugar alcohols - it means you can binge on it and eat a whole bag without worrying about a massive impending butt explosion! I have eaten as much as 3 pieces at once and had absolutely zero gastrointestinal issues, since there's nothing in it that would do that.

Overall, very pleased with my purchase. Not sure if I'll pay full price for it as it is currently (just not in my budget), but if it goes on sale again and I have it in my budget, I'd jump on it.

title: Easy and delicious!
text:
EDIT DEC 2018:
They seem to have reformulated this a bit. It's pretty spicy now. It's weird - it's labeled as mild. It is not mild. Especially compared to their Tikka Masala, which is labeled as medium, but is much less spicy than this. I don't get it. It's still good, but honestly, I throw in some heavy cream or yogurt to smooth it out if I make this with just chicken. I now tend to make this in the instant pot - just toss in the paste, water (a tad less than called for), butter, chicken, turn the pot on for 10min and let it do most of the way NPR. Makes for very tender chicken. If I want to make rice in there too, I'll do 5 mins, then QR, add in the little metal covered pot with the rinsed rice/water on a trivet over my butter chicken, 5 more mins and 10 min NPR, then QR. Easy one pot meal. Only about 2 mins of prep work.
-------------------------
Original review:
It's actually pretty amazing how delicious this is, especially when it's so simple to cook! It tastes like it came from a restaurant and at a fraction of the cost. It's spicy, spicy enough to make my nose run, but not so spicy that it hurts - it's just right.
Here's how I cook it:
Slice an onion up, throw it in the pot.
Throw chunks of peeled carrot into the pot.
Put 1 to 1 1/2 lbs raw chicken, cut into chunks, in the pot.
Pour 1 cup water, and butter (3 teaspoons? I don't remember, it's in the directions) into the pot.
Empty paste package into pot, make sure paste is broken into chunks - it will "melt" when it heats up.
Then simmer for 25mins or so with lid on, stirring thoroughly every 5 mins or so to make sure all the paste chunks dissolve and that the meat is cooked evenly.

Tip: It may look like you need more water at first, but the chicken will release juices. You probably do not need more water. If you find your curry is TOO thin, either you can simmer it with the lid off until water evaporates and gives you the desired consistency, or, if you want to speed it up (or prevent any veggies in there from turning to mush from simmering too long), you can:
Take pot off heat, pour liquid from pot into a non-stick frying pan - the bigger around, the better. Heat the liquid in the pan till it's simmering. Let it simmer till it is the desired consistency, STIRRING CONSTANTLY (VERY IMPORTANT!!! - it only takes two or three minutes, so keep stirring or it will burn), then just pour it back in with your chicken. Very easy.

Great curry paste, so easy, and you can just pair it with rice (rice cookers are AWESOME) or some naan, if that's your thing, or rice AND naan for some mega carbohydrates!

These seeds are nice and toasted, great taste, and are a pretty decent size seeds to pop into your mouth!!! I don't think I'll ever do back to David's pumpkin seeds. These seeds actually have something to chew with or without the shell. I love them!!!!

title: Great flavor!!!!
text: I absolutely love this flavor!! Had to buy in bulk because I fly right through them. I hope they never discontinue them.

title: Dr. Smoothie to the Rescue!!!
text: I love this stuff!!! I am a lap-band patient and rely on smoothies for nutrition.  I use banana whey protein to mix in this smoothie. It tastes a lot like a piña colada! I have lost 50 pounds drinking this stuff in place of snacks. It only takes a little bit of the concentrate, water, banana whey and ice!!  Seller was fast with shipping! I would definitely order again!!

title: Addicting!!!

title: Too cute to pass up..
text: I love Jelly Bellys and accidently came across this item.  This was too cute too pass up! I have Jelly Bellys stored in it and it's placed in my kitchen. So when my niece comes over she gets a kick out of using the little "shovel" to get jelly beans! Now it's a treat whenever she comes over to Auntie's house!!

title: Jelly Belly

I admit that its been a treat to taste flavors such as Cold Stone, super fruit which as pomegranate and acai flavors, and soda flavors. I cannot remember the other flavors but they all tasted yummy. text: Tiny bag of chocolate for the price.

text: Love this mix!!!! Easy to make and delicious.

text: Not good, not bad

title: Refreshing
text:
Great single serve bags for a nice refreshing non caffeinated tea.

Will often seep these in a concentrated batch and use to make iced tea. Very bright and tasty.

title: Great for agua de Jamaica!
text:
Beautiful flavorful tea!

My mom and I use this to make agua de Jamaica and it was bright and tasty. Love the resealable bag for freshness.Would purchase again!

title: Strawberry milk flavor!
text: Flavor reminds me a lot of nesquik strawberry milk, it's very easy to drink especially when cold. Doesn't have an aftertaste or odd consistency. I'll often have this to supplement breakfasts or for a quick snack when running errands.

title: Salt chunks are too large
text: The chunks of salt in this rub are waaaaay too big. At least for my taste. I tried this on some chicken thighs and found the salt chunks really unpleasant. Even with a lighter hand, the chunks are just way too concentrated in a small area. The rub smells and looks good, I'll probably grind it finer myself and add some more seasoning to dilute it a bit, but way too salty on its own.

title: Comparable to name brand, an easy breakfast
text: Breakfast is my least favorite meal so I usually opt for quick and light meals. This cereal with some milk is a very easy breakfast for someone that doesn't really like breakfast. A little higher in sugar than I'd like but not too bad. Comparable to name brand. Calories and protein are decent, definitely better than most other sugary cereals. I would purchase again.

title: Great!
text: Easy to use in recipes. I've added this to soups and pasta. Super easy to dissolve/melt into recipes that need a Parm flavor. I keep the bag in the fridge to maintain freshness. I think the price is fair for how much I usually use per recipe, and the size of the bag.

title: Grittiness/sandiness
text: Similar to Nutella, but has a pretty bitter finish and a sandy texture. The chocolate makes it edible but I wouldn't purchase this again.

title: This powder will last me forever!
text: Very little is needed to make/add to broths. I use this when making japanese curry, or japanese flavoured soups. Very easy to use, and if stored correctly will seriously last so long! The flavor is light but pairs well with japanese dishes. Very convenient powder base.

title: Tastes similar to pace
text: This cheese sauce tastes a lot like pace to me, it's pretty good for what it is. I think if you try it thinking it will taste like nacho cheese you may be disappointed. It's a zesty flavorful sauce that's good on tacos or as a dip, although it is a bit thin for dipping. Light spice.

title: Not my favorite
text: I don't usually mind snacks that aren't very sweet, but these just weren't that appealing to me. They're kind of dry and messy. The flavor pack I chose maybe wasn't the best, but the blueberry flavor smelled pretty artificial and the taste didn't make up for it. They're pricier than my normal snacks so I'm not sure I'd try these again.

title: Great for diy scalp treatments
text: I mix this powder with some glycerin to make a diy scalp treatment. No discernable scent, it doesn't dissolve completely but it can get mostly smooth in a mixture. Need very little for one use so this packet will last me a long time! The bag it comes in is resealable but I would still transfer it to a more air tight container to keep it fresh longer.

title: Socks are kind of random but I love the snacks
text: The socks are kind of an interesting thing to add, I think stickers or something would've been better. But the snacks in this pack are great. The topokki, ramen and kimchi were all really tasty/easy to make.not the most nutritious foods but definitely Satish cravings.:)

title: Not as much protein as soy
text: I usually go for soy or cashew when it comes to milk alternatives, but was curious to try this. The flavor isn't sweetened at all and reminds me a bit of almond milk. It's not as thin though and has a nice creaminess to it. I like the papery type containers these come in. I'm not sure I'd buy this again though, soy milk has more protein and a little more affordable for me. Worth a try if you're avoiding soy though!

title: Decent price for bulk organic dates
text: Dates are sweet and large. We keep them in the freezer so they keep longer since it is kind of a lot to go through. The box actually freezes pretty well! I can get them cheaper at my local bulk grocery store, but the price isn't bad for a little over 4lbs.

title: Light flavor but tasty
text:
Ive recently started trying to drink teas in the morning to wean myself off of coffee and have been experimenting with different teas to find a good caffeine level. This tea doesn't make me feel jittery or anxious which usually happens when I drink coffee or even some stronger black teas. It's very mild caffeine wise, and I've even had 2 cups/bags in a day and been fine. The flavor is mild and light, I don't love the blueberry scent/flavor but would appreciate more of a green tea flavor.

The bags are pretty fragrant and well packaged. One of my favorite thing about these teas is the little paper holder tab you can slip into the edge of your mug to secure your tea. A small detail but really makes a difference. Overall I enjoyed this tea and I think I'd like to try the yuzon one next.

Hope this review is helpful!:)

title: Great light boost!
text: The flavor doesn't quite read black cherry to me, it's almost more fruit punch, especially when diluted. The taste is pretty good either way. I don't really like coffee so I'm always looking for ways to add a little caffeine to my day while avoiding coffee. This is great for a light boost. Each squeeze is only 60mg of caffeine, which is perfect for me since I prefer less caffeine. Faster to drink thank a green/black tea, and helps me get more water in. Love it!!

title: Light on the lemonade flavor
text: Was hoping this would be a little more tart, but it's a very subtle lemonade flavor. When more concentrated more of the watermelon flavor comes out and can taste a little too artificial (like pink jolly rancher). I usually go pretty diluted when I use this though, about one squirt for 20oz of water. I think it helps me get a little more water in, especially when I'm craving a flavored drink with meals.

title: Delicious!
text: We received these in perfect condition, with every stick in tact. I've eaten several and they've all been really tasty. Very pretty gift with the assorted flavors/styles!

title: Sickly sweet
text: Ive tried a similar brand's grapefruit flavor and was hoping this would be a close match. It's not. It's sickly sweet and salty. Really needs to be diluted. The monkfruit and stevia is way too strong for my liking. I have tried the matcha flavor for this brand and really like it, I'd recommend the matcha flavor if you prefer less sweet flavors.

title: Love this flavor
text: I tried the grapefruit flavor for this brand which I really did not like, but I love this matcha flavor. It's a vanilla matcha that's not too heavy on the vanilla flavor sweetener. Easy to drink in the morning since it's not sickly sweet. I usually split a pack into two servings. Dissolves easily into water. I'm a little sensitive to caffeine and half a serving is great for me. Just a little bit of a kick without any jitters. Really happy with this flavor!

title: Great spice in a nice resealable bag
text: I've used Spice Way brand spices in the past and the pouches last me a good while. The poaches are also really great quality so they don't break or pop open on their own. Helps keep my spices nice and fresh longer.

title: Creamiest non dairy creamer
text:
I've tried quite a few non dairy creamers from the grocery and hadn't found one I liked. A lot of them don't have the right consistency/texture or flavor I like. This one is probably the best one I've tried so far, although I'm not sure it's yet available at a normal grocery store.

It's creamy, smooth and has a sweetness that's not too artificial or sickly sweet. I only used about a tbs of it in my morning coffee 12-14is oz of coffee) and it was great!! I've learned non dairy creamers have to say "unsweetened" on them in order to truly have less/no sweetener so I was expecting it to have some sweetness.

The product itself also comes with more than I thought. Definitely a good amount of creamer for daily coffee drinkers. I've had no issues with the container as far as leaks or spills as well.

A great new creamer to try, I'd def recommend!:)

title: Will last forever!!
text: This block is huge! And from how concentrated this miso paste I'm seriously going to have this forever. Ive cut it into portions and put it in Mason jars and frozen to ensure freshness. Ive used it to make chicken, salad dressings and soup. A little goes a long way, great addition to have in my pantry!

title: Great in cold brew
text: I received these in the whole bean form so I coarsely grind these and use them for cold brew. While I admit I'm not a coffee connoisseur, I can tell if a coffee is good or bad. The flavor of this is definitely pleasant and flavorful. I always drink my coffee black or with just a bit of half and half and this coffee is enjoyable this way. The price is more expensive than the brand I normally buy, but I do normally buy bulk at my local grocery store so I suppose the price difference makes sense.

title: Greta flavor for cold brew
text: I received these in the whole bean form so I coarsely grind these and use them for cold brew. While I admit I'm not a coffee connoisseur, I can tell if a coffee is good or bad. The flavors of these are definitely pleasant and flavorful. I think my favorite has been the one in the rainbow bag, although I think the honey flavoured one has the best aroma. I always drink my coffee black or with just a bit of half and half and this coffee is enjoyable this way. The price is more expensive than the brand I normally buy, but I do normally buy bulk at my local grocery store so I suppose the price difference makes sense.

title: Great snack!
text: Appreciate that they don't add extra sugar to their cranberries! They're definitely sweet and tasty enough on their own. We add them to salads and trail mix, and keep them in the fridge to stay fresh longer.:)

title: Depends what you're looking for, very sweet
text: I wouldn't drink these everyday, they are very sweet. But occasionally I want a sweet treat and these are perfect for that! They're easy to make and obviously cheaper than going to a coffee shop. I love caramel, the taste is a little artificial but I don't mind.

title: Great for controlling extra sugar and calories!!
text: I really like this powder to add extra protein and flavor in smoothies and oatmeal. I like that it's not very sweet so I can have it as is or add my own amount of sweetness to control my sugar intake. It mixes into foods pretty easily. My favorite way to have it is in a smoothie with vanilla protein, milk and a banana.:)

title: Great on roasted vegetables
text: Really great seasoning for roasted vegetables. The lemon zest in the seasoning helps give a nice bright flavor to dishes which is great in case you don't have herbs on hand. Shaker is easy to hold with a lid that isn't flimsy!

title: Kinda pricey but tasty
text: These cookies are a little smaller than I thought they'd be. They're pretty thin and only 2 come in a pack. The texture of the cookie is light and airy. I've tried the lemon and the chocolate and I definitely prefer the lemon. They're the perfect amount of sweetness and 2 in a pack is pretty nicely portioned out so you don't accidentally eat too many. I like the thin line of lemon jelly in the cookie. The chocolate ones are also good, I just don't really care for dark chocolate so they're a little much for me.

title: Better in bulk
text: I buy gum almost every time I go to the grocery store so having a pack in bulk just makes sense. I don't care for the fruity flavors so the minty variety works for me. Now I'll have a pack for my purse, car and backpack haha

title: Fruity and wonderful!
text: Very fragrant and fruity even just smelling through the packaging! I love the way it smells, and it tastes even better! Perfect for when I want a no caffeinated tea, but something that's still bright and interesting. The packaging is super cute too!

title: Much easier and flavorful than plain ginger teas
text: I like drinking ginger teas and this is a nice variation to switch it up a bit. It's a bit sweeter and has a softer flavor than a pure ginger tea that can at times feel too strong and spicy. Great for those that can't have caffeine also!:)

title: Tasty!
text: I don't normally get sugar added cranberries to minimize my sugar intake, but I decided to give these a go anyway. These seem a bit juicier and flavorful than the normal brand I buy. I'm sure that's due to the added sugar. Haha they are definitely tasty, I'll just be mindful about how many I eat!:)

title: Nice bold taste but needs better packaging
text:
Flavor is great, it's nice and bold. We tried it after about 12-15hrs of brewing. Love that it's already grounded at a coarseness meant for cold brew. I think it really makes a difference.

The only think I think could use some improvement is the packaging. The bag arrived leaking coffee and it doesn't seem like I was the only one this happened to. If they could make the packaging more secure, that'd be awesome!

title: Very peppery
text: I wouldn't consider this "ready to drink". On its own it's not very palatable. The flavor j received had a strong peppery taste that I can't just sip on. May work better with alcohol, but definitely has a distinct taste I'm not sure I like.

title: Was sent the citrus ginger by accident, it's tasty, but has a lot of sugar!
text:
I ordered the cherry rhubarb but I received the citrus ginger instead.

The flavor is pretty good, not too gingery and reminds me a lot of tang. Slight carbonation. Pleasant flavor. Less caffeine than normal energy drinks so I didn't get jittery or anxious. Just a nice little boost.

The only thing I don't really like is that it has a lot more sugar than I thought it would. 20g per can! That's as bad as soda!! Gonna have to watch out for that.

title: Sweetened tea flavor, mild caffeine.
text:
The flavor wasn't what I expected since the label mentions coffee. It tastes more like a sweetened tea or I suppose a very watered down coffee. Lightly carbonated. I don't mind the flavor, I think it's pretty good when it's chilled.

I'm somewhat sensitive to caffeine and usually only have one cup a day. I drank half of one of these and was fine and was also able to drink a full one in a day without any jitters or anxiety. Much milder than other energy drinks I've tried which I like. I'm happy with the type of boost it gives me.

title: Pricey but refreshing!
text: Ugly drinks are definitely pricier than other brands but the flavor is always great. I've tried this lemon lime, black cherry and the energy grapefruit flavors and they've all been great. They have the right amount of flavor without tasting too overpowering.

title: Very easy, quick, yummy snack!
text:
I've tried the adult versions of these which are very similar to these. These are just a bit smaller, have less protein and to me, they taste like they have less pea protein and have better flavor and texture because of this. The strawberry banana flavor tastes just like a strawberry banana yogurt, just a healthy/cleaner version of it.

The top of these is also designed to be easier for kids to open on their own, the adult versions are smoother and a bit smaller.

Great snacks for hiking or to have in the car! Chilled or to temp, they're still very good.

title: Very expensive for what it is
text: This hibiscus tea is just that, an unsweetened, lightly carbonated hibiscus tea. It's good, but I'm not sure it's THAT good...I personally love hibiscus tea, but I still wouldn't be able to justify the price.

title: These remind me a lot of nature valley
text: Kinda remind me of nature valley because of how crunchy these are. These are a bit denser and more filling, also not as sweet. I like that they're scored, very easy to share or even just eating on your own it makes less of a mess because of the smaller pieces. I didn't find that much of a difference between the flavors, but they are good snacks.

title: Reminds me of gogurts!
text: Tastes like berry gogurts to me! With a bit of plant protein taste and texture. Very easy to get down, they taste good chilled (although they don't get that cold and will freeze if put in freezer), these can be consumed room temp also so they're easy to toss in my backpack for a hiking snack!

title: Great for people that don't like normal energy drinks!
text:
I don't really like coffee, and I try not to drink energy drinks because of all the sugar and additives. This stuff really is just sparkling water with caffeine in it. It's great!

There is a slight aftertaste (probably from the caffeine) but it's barely noticeable, and I think I only noticed because I've tried a bunch of different grapefruit sparkling waters from different brands, so I could taste something a little different. My brother couldn't pick up on anything when he tried it though.

Very easy to drink, but has a lot of caffeine. Or at least for me! I usually split it between two days or give someone else in my house the other half haha. Drinking only half helps keep me from getting too jittery or anxious. Definitely made me feel more alert with just half though.

These are around $2 for each one which is pretty competitive considering how expensive energy drinks are nowadays. But I'm definitely a fan of these, and will make sure to try the other flavors!:)

title: Awesome!
text:
I generally dislike breakfast foods but have been trying to gain weight so I've been forcing myself to eat eggs for breakfast because they're higher in protein. I get burnt out of eggs soooo fast though, I kind of dread eating them.

I've also tried to make my own protein oatmeal at home by mixing protein powder into my oatmeal but it always thickens up too much and my protein powder flavors always come off too dessert like for the morning to me anyway. (Still on the hunt for protein in powders that aren't sickeningly sweet).

This protein oat meal is great! I had it with 1/3 of a cup of low fat milk which added another 3g of protein, so in total it was 15g of protein.(My usual egg breakfast is 2 large eggs plus some cheese which is around 15g of protein also). The oatmeal itself was pretty thin (which is how I like my oatmeal) and super easy to eat. The pea protein is barely noticeable IMO. I seriously ate one packet in a matter of seconds. I think I could easily eat 2, which would be amazing! Breakfast is always the hardest meal for me to get enough protein in. I love that it feel like a pretty "light" breakfast also. That's another reason I have hard time eating enough in the morning, because I don't like feeling weighed down with heavy breakfasts.

This is light, easy and gives me the protein and calories I need in the morning. If you're someone that likes to eat for volume, I'm not sure this would feel like enough, but if you're someone that's just trying to get some quick calories in easily in the morning and kind of hate breakfast like me, I'd definitely recommend these! I really like this stuff and will definitely be repurchasing!!

title: Spicyyy
text: You get a lot of peppers in this container. These peppers are really spicy so you definitely don't need to use much at all in recipes! These will last me a long time for sure. Haha

title: These aren't much different from the original flavored ones
text:
I was expecting the chocolate ones to taste/look different than the originals, but they're really not that different. It has very little chocolate.

It's also interesting the peanut and chocolate ones are so much higher in protein? Very crunchy. They are still pretty good, just wish the different flavors were more.... different.

title: Delicious!
text:
Ive gotten so burnt out from chocolate/vanilla/pastry flavored proteins, these are such a nice change of pace!

Initially the pea protein seems a little strong, but i got over it quickly, the flavor of this is really tasty. It's tropical, but not too sweet. Piña colada is one of my favorite flavor combos and this reminds me a lot of that!

The packaging is very convenient and secure, easy to throw into my backpack for a hiking snack.

The only thing that I didn't like about this product is that it doesn't seem to get very cold. I kept it in my fridge and it was chilled, but not super cold. I tried putting it in the freezer to give it more of a slushee feel but then it completely froze over. I mean, they're still really good slightly chilled and I've even had them room temp out of my bag, but I wish they could just get really nice and cold.

Really love these though, will definitely try more of their flavors!:)

title: Tastes like sugar free rockstar with strange aftertaste
text:
I was hoping these energy drinks would be completely unsweetened because they're advertised as "zero sugar", but I am seeing more and more often companies are just using that to mean artificial sweetener or sweeteners like monkfruit like this product. I should've read the ingredients before ordering.

The taste is really similar to rockstar/monster energy drinks but the monkfruit is really similar to artificial sweetener which give it an over the top sweetness. ..not a fan. It also looks pretty similar to these energy drinks in color too! There's also a strange after taste/scent to these drinks which I'm now realizing is probably the *vitamins* in the drink. But these have no "melon" taste at all, definitely more artificially flavored.

The caffeine in these does hit, and I didn't necessarily feel jittery but it does make you feel more "up".

The price isn't bad, considering how expensive most energy drinks are but the flavor just isn't very appealing to me. But if you're someone that likes rockstar or monster and doesn't mind the super sweetness these might not be too bad for you!

title: Not as creamy as I thought it'd be and a little expensive
text:
I tried this creamer with my cold brew and I didn't experience any clumps.(I shook the bottle before using so I'm not sure if that helped).

I will say this is creamier than alternative plant milks. It just doesn't seem as creamy as when I use half n half, but that's definitely okay. Definitely unsweetened! It's also pretty convenient since you don't have to buy and add the butter or MCT oil separately. I also really like the packaging and how it's resealable. I hate when creamers just have the flipped out opening.

The price is pretty high for these creamers though, at more than $10 per bottle. I'm not sure if the convenience would be worth it to me, but the product itself isn't bad. Hope this review is helpful!

title: Does not taste good
text:
I'm not really a picky eater and especially not with fruits or vegetables but this "breakfast" was just not appealing to me.

It comes in a baggy, pre made, so I squeezed it into a plate, it has the consistency of a thicker oatmeal, with coconut pulp squares throughout. It has a weird smell to it which I'm not Sure if it has to do with it being packaged up like this, or maybe it's the cauliflower? It's a little bit of a sharp sour smell... But I didn't want to judge off the smell alone so I warmed it up in the microwave for a minute per one of their instructions and gave it a try.

It's just not for me....the consistency is that of the coconut pulp bits, in a mushy mixture. The flavor is kind of bland but still off putting with an attempt of being covered up by the cinnamon. My boyfriend said it tastes like tomatoes....idk.

This also only has 3g of protein and isnt very much food considering it's all plant based. Id imagine it would digest pretty quickly and would have me feeling hungry again soon after. Seemed like it'd be cool to try, but I didn't like it.

title: Pricey, has strong pea protein flavor
text:
I was really excited for this product because I like having pb sandwiches as snacks somewhat regularly and thought it'd be cool to have a higher protein peanut butter.

The first thing I went to check was the size and price of this item. It's the size of an average peanut butter jar, but it's a lot more expensive. Not very competitive with other pb powders, or healthier pb's.

Secondly, the consistency of this product is thinner than average. I had it room temp like I leave many of my peanut butters but this was very runny at that temperature. It was difficult to put 2tbs (the serving size) in a sandwich without it running out the sides.

And finally the flavor wasn't my favorite. It's definitely not as sweet as something like jiffy or skippy, which is fine, but it has a pea protein after taste. Which if you haven't had it is a bit dry and dusty tasting. I think it's manageable with other flavors, but with the peanut flavor, the dusty/Sandy flavor is emphasized.

For the 10g of protein I think I'd rather just have a small shake instead or keep looking for other higher protein snack options, this wasn't my favorite.:/

title: Was sent ginger not lime
text: I was sent the singer flavor not the lime unfortunately. The ginger flavor was alright, but I noticed it had a bit if warmth to its flavor and then read it has hints of rum. I think this drink would taste more refreshing without it.  Kind of confusing to have rum flavoring also since these are nonalcoholic.

title: Really tasty! But our packaging was really bad
text:
My boyfriend and I run through sparkling water at our house so I was super excited to try these out. I've tried Dasani's black cherry and ugly waters cherry and this one is definitely my favorite. They have just a hint of cherry flavor that makes this water really tasty. Ugly water has a lot of flavorful and almost tastes like medicine. I prefer waters that keep most of the water/ carbonation flavor simple and just a little bit of flavor for taste. The price is more expensive than other brands however. More than $1 a can. Pretty expensive, hence knocked star.

Our packaging with these items was pretty bad though. I initially got a notice I was going to receive these late which was fine, but when I received these the next day, they came in a large ziploc brand plastic bag with only 11 cans, many of which were dented. Bummer. I don't believe the shipping is the seller's mistake but I just thought i'd mention it.

Hope this review is helpful!

title: Tastes like rice cakes trying to be unhealthy
text:
The texture of these is not similar to pork rinds at all in my opinion. They're much softer, and remind me of veggie chips, but with a rice cake flavor.

Every flavor except for the original comes with a dusting of flavored powder, none of which I liked very much...it makes the "pork rinds" taste even drier.

The price of these is is also pretty high.

For such a small bag, the price and amount of calories, isn't worth it to me.

I don't think id try these again.

Hope this review is helpful!

title: Delicious!
text:
I received this package with one of the containers broken unfortunately, so I was unable to try the cream colored blossom flavor. :( It wasn't a big mess, but it looked like one of the jars had cracked very close to the lid.

The rest of the jars were fine and I was able to try the rest. This set is super tasty! A really great set for honey lovers, with every flavor being unique. I like to eat these spread over sourdough as a nice sweet treat. The vanilla bean and the blossom homies are my favorite, but they're all great.

Wish the price was a little more affordable though. They're great tasting honeys but at $12 a piece it does seem quite expensive.:( I could definitely justify $8-10 a piece for these though.

title: Delicious!
text:
Our household doesn't drink soda or juice but we often have sparkling waters and iced green tea in the fridge.

This tea has been a delightful addition to our drink rotation! I added one bag to a large pitcher and left it overnight. The tea itself is a bright yellow color, but the flavor is Soo good. It's just slightly sweet but the pineapple flavor really comes through. The pitcher was gone by the end of the day!

We love this flavor and it's been helping us stay hydrated during these hot days. The tea is a little pricey, but pretty comparable to sparkling water/other tea prices so I don't think its too bad. :)

title: Delicious!
text:
Really tasty!

I took these hiking the other day and they were awesome. They're a different texture compared to regular granola or trail mix. They have a nice crunch but also have a little bit of chewy thanks to the raisins. There's different sized chunks but for the most part, you get several large chunks, which I like
I hate opening up snacka and seeing a bunch of crumbs. Flavor is great also, not too sweet and zero artificial flavors.

Wish they sold bigger packages of these because the singular packs are kinda pricey. But still pretty happy with these!

title: A nice blend of tropical flavors, although a bit pricey
text:
This mix is sweet and tasty. I like the tropical blend over the regular m&m and chocolate mixes. The pumpkin seed is an unexpected addition to this blend but I like it! Bag tastes nice and fresh, and the resealable packaging will keep it fresh longer.

You get a nice amount too, will last me a while for sure. However I do think this is a bit more expensive than it would be in stores, hence the reduced star.

title: Pricey
text:
We usually buy our spices in bulk so this was quite a price difference for us. I was hoping to taste a noticeable difference in quality (flavor or scent) but I don't think the difference could justify the price.:/
I refilled my average/small pepper grinder and used up about half the bag.

I do like that they offer resealable bags for the packaging though!

title: Nice flavor, but pricey
text:
My boyfriend and I usually buy bulk coffee from our grocery store so the price difference is almost twice as much for these bags. (Each bag is only half a pound).

But, I used this to make cold brew and really enjoyed it! It actually is a bit on the finer side of grind to make cold brew, but would work great in a French press or espresso machine.

Really nice warm, nutty flavor. Surprisingly "fresh" tasting for a prepackaged brand!

title: Bright and flavorful
text:
Really nice bright color and flavor. Not watered down, you get pure tomato flavor. I added 2 cans of this to my turkey chili, lightly smashing the tomatoes before. Tasted great!

Comes in pull top kids, but u found it difficult to pull completely off. Not sure why.

title: Has a nice sweet taste, but could be a little more flavorful.
text:
This sauce contains carrots which give it a little bit of sweetness and lighter color. Texture isnt very thick, a little more liquidy than most store bought sauces I think.

You probably could use this straight out of the container, but I tried that and thought it needed some more flavor to it. It's not a "bad" sauce, but it wasn't my favorite so I don't think id be inclined to repurchase, considering it's more expensive than other brands whose flavors I like a bit more.

title: Really tasty but I wouldn't buy for the caffeine content
text:
This granola is super yummy. It reminds me a lot of cocoa pebbles in flavor, with the addition of little white chocolate/vanilla squares. I add this in with plain yogurt and it's delicious!:)

It doesn't actually contain much caffeine for the amount you'd be eating though. It's also a little pricey.

title: Decent
text:
Not as flavorful as other curry powder blends I've tried but not bad. I like how bright of a curry it produces, probably a higher amount of turmeric in it.

Packaging is basic plastic packaging.

I'd consider repurchasing this if it was a good deal!

title: Lid came broken:(
text:
I've tried this oil in the regular and lime variation.

Like the like, this chili oil is pretty fragrant, along with having a red color to it. Despite how strong the chili scent is, I don't think the oil added any extra flavor or heat. I think this one is my least favorite of the three because I think this one will be used the least with what I normally cook.

My main issue with this bottle is that it came with a defected cap so when twisted open, the whole thing came off making it unable to reseal.:( Will have to find another container to put it in so it doesn't turn sooner..

title: Great!:)
text:
Fragrant and flavorful with a beautiful bright color!

I keep mine in the freezer to prevent bugs from getting in.:)

title: Not as flavorful/potent as other brands I've tried
text: This brand of rainbow peppercorn wasn't as flavorful as other brands I've tried...it honestly didn't taste any spicier or more potent than regular fine preground pepper which is strange since usually grinding it fresh makes things more potent....

title: Great flavor and seem to really wake me up
text:
This coffee has a great bold taste that my boyfriend and I both like. We usually prepare our morning coffee in a french press and occasionally I'll make cold brew although I haven't tried it with this brand.

In the french press it tastes great though! I'm also not sure if it's just me, but this brand also seems to be more caffeinated than the brands I usually buy...I definitely get that caffeine KICK, so be aware of that if you're caffeine sensitive!

title: Not as flavorful as I expected...
text:
I tried this sauce with some chicken, spinach, sun dried tomatoes and rotini. I usually add extra spices/ cheese to store bought sauces just out of habit, so I did the same with this. I tried it before hand and didn't think this sauce was as flavorful as I thought it'd be, so personally, I'm not sure that I would purchase it again considering the price.

It's not bad, it's just not great enough for me to repurchase.

title: Aren't as tasty as the regular chocolate chip flavor
text: I tried these in the regular chocolate chip flavor and much preferred those to these. These seem a bit drier IMO. Also dinged another star because I think these are priced pretty high per pack.

title: Great flavor, just wish they were in 100% olive oil
text:
I added these sun dried tomatoes to my pasta and they were great! Flavorful, and had a nice texture. Definitely better than dry sun dried tomatoes which can be a bit chewy.

These are marinated in olive AND canola oil however, which may be a problem for some. I personally cook with canola oil pretty regularly so I don't have an issue with it.

These came package very well also, they had thick bubble wrap around them so I received these in perfect condition!:)

title: If you like sparkling water you'll like these!
text:
I'm not a fan of coffee or sugary energy drinks but occasionally I like having something to give me a caffeine boost. I generally do go for matcha or other caffeinated teas so I was already pretty interested in the idea of a sparkling matcha.

I was a bit apprehensive about the mint flavor, even though u do like mint, I wasn't sure how *minty* this would be. To be honest, it's not really that minty, if I hadn't known it was mint, I might've just confused this for a floral/herbal/tea flavor without having to specify mint.

I actually really like the taste and love that it's not sweetened. Chilled, these are great!

The amount of caffeine in these is also awesome. Coffee makes me really anxious so that's another reason I avoid it but this helped me feel more alert without the small sense of panic I get from coffee haha so definite plus.

The case is a bit pricier than I'd like so I'm not sure how often I'd actually purchase these, but I'm definitely getting these again!

title: Pretty dry and not super tasty
text:
I like the idea of caffeinated snacks because they're a little easier to have on the go and feel more satiating than coffee.

Wasn't sure what to expect from the pumpkin spice, but I was pretty underwhelmed with the flavor. Not really as sweet or as spicy as I'd like.

I also found these to be pretty dry. I'd definitely need a glass of water to get these down well. For the amount of caffeine in them, I think I'd probably just go with the cup of coffee or tea.

title: Nice big bag of cashews!
text: This nice large bag is perfect for keeping at your desk or taking on a family road trip. The bag is a pretty good deal for the amount you get! Cashews are lightly salted and they make a great snack.:)

title: Yummy!:)
text:
These cookies are really tasty. They remind me a lot of chips ahoy cookies flavor wise.

There's two servings per bag and half a pouch is enough to satisfy my sweet tooth.

These seem like much better alternatives to regular cookies since they're so low in sugar. You wouldn't know it from how good they are!

The only think I don't really like is the price. At 4 something per pouch, I do think these are pretty pricey. (Hence the docked star)

title: Delicious!!:)
text:
Really tasty tea! It's not too spicy, but offers a nice amount of spice with just a hint of chocolate and a bit of a marshmallow flavor. It's like the most refined tasting version a snore you could ask for. Haha

The pouch isn't very big so there aren't a ton of uses in it, but you could maybe get 6-10 dependent on how much you use at a time. (I tend to use a tbs or so at a time). But this tea is really great as a little treat and offers up a little bit of caffeine as well. I'll definitely be getting this again, love it!!:)

title: Peach isn't my favorite but I like the mint
text:
The peach flavor isn't my favorite. But I generally don't like peach flavored things so it could just be me.my boyfriend prefers this to the mint.

I've tried this drink in the mint flavor and I actually really like that one but this one just doesn't taste right to me. It's still tolerable but not something I would pick out.

The carbonation is nice. I think if you're someone that enjoys sparkling waters, you'd like this. Not very sweet, and just feels pretty light and much "healthier" than most other energy drinks.

title: Great for pan frying!
text:
I wanted to try a healthier oil with a higher smoke point for my fried eggs in the morning instead of using canola.

This avocado oil seems to be a great option. It has a very high smoke point, and as far as I can tell, has a neutral flavor, perfect for whatever recipes you'd want to use. The oil is green which is kind of interesting to see on my eggs, but there is no weird smell or taste accompanying it. My eggs came out great and didn't stick to my pan.;)

The bottle this comes in is a nice size with opaque green glass. I like that it's a bit smaller so it easy to fit in my shelves. The opening/dispenser also works well to pour nicely without leaking.

Happy with this oil so far!:)

title: Hot sauce that's actually hot!!
text:
Really flavorful sauce!

We tried Peri Peri in Ireland a few years ago and I remembered liking their chicken accompanied with these sauces. These don't taste ultra processed or cheap. The price is a bit higher than other sauces but I think it's worth the price because these are definitely higher quality sauces.

The hot is actually pretty hot so don't underestimate it! The lemon herb also has a bit of a kick but would be great for people that can't handle as much spice.

Great sauces! The only thing I would change about these is the bottle. They're pretty tall so they're kind of cumbersome in the fridge.

title: Fragrant lime scent!
text:
I've been wanting to try Avocado oil for a while since I've been hearing a lot about it's health benefits compared to other oils. I pan fry my chicken pretty often so I want something that has a high smoke point.

This oil works well, doesn't have a bad/strong flavor. Has a nice lime scent when you cook with it although I will admit I don't notice that much of a difference as far as flavor goes.

No complaints though! Bottle is glass and pours easily without leaking or being messy.

title: Awesome! Medium is actually pretty spicy!
text:
I tried these sauces in Ireland a few years ago and remembered liking the sauce! They don't have periperi in the US.

The set comes with a medium and a lemon and herb. Both are super tasty and obviously taste great on chicken but can be use with other stuff too. I out it on tacos the other night 😋 the medium has a decent amount of kick, and the lemon and pepper is very mild but still very good.

You get two very nice large hot sauces in glass bottles. The bottles are quite tall though so they're kind of awkward in the fridge. But definitely great sauces!

title: Very large bag, flavorful and fragrant!
text:
I didn't expect this bag to be as big as it is! One of these bags would last a family a long time, let alone a single person!

As soon as you open the bag, its wonderfully fragrant. Leaves aren't too small where they make a mess in a tea strainer.

Great price for this large amount of loose leaf tea!!:)

title: Doesn't taste very good:/
text:
Pretty bland coffee. I'm not a huge coffee drinker so it's hard to impress/dissatisfy me with coffee drinks. I thought this coffee was pretty meh. For a dark roast it isn't actually that bold or flavorful.

My boyfriend who IS a big coffee fan said he didn't really like this very much easier. Leans into tasting burnt versus having much flavor.

For the price, we'd rather buy bulk from our local grocery store.

title: Delicious!!
text:
This pomegranate juice is super tasty and delicious. Very fresh, sweet and tart like pomegranates without all the work!:)

Like many juices, it has quite a bit of sugar, one bottle of these has 34g! I tend to have these as a sweet treat and will only drink half at a time. Even though they're only a little more than 8oz, it's more than enough to satisfy a sweet craving.

title: Not ceremonial grade matcha so has a bit of a grassy taste
text:
I'm a big fan of matcha drinks so I thought I'd give this a try to use with the Keurig at work.

I brewed mine with 6oz. Setting and added a little cold water after to cool it down like I do with most of my drinks.

The latte is milky, sweet (but not too sweet). It's pretty good and a nice change from coffee. However, the matcha definitely has a bit of a grass taste that lower quality matcha tends to have. The milky and sweetness of the latte helps it but the after taste is still noticeable.

Overall I think it's what id expect from a kcup matcha latte. Not bad, I think it's worth a try if you like green tea lattes.

title: "healthier" tasting rice crispies
text:
My boyfriend (who has a big sweet tooth) and I tried these rice crispy treats. There are 3 flavors, a strawberry, churro and mint chocolate chip.

My favorite by far is the churro. Cinnamon sugar is my go to sweet so that's not surprising, but I definitely enjoyed this one the most out of the other flavors. My boyfriend liked all three but said he likes the churro flavor the most too.
