This comes in a typical glass bottle with a reducer top so it comes out in a controlled manner.

HOW WE USE THIS
We used this half and half with water and some scallions, toasted sesame oil, fresh grated ginger, rice vinegar and a touch of honey to make a nice dipping sauce.

FLAVOR
This is like the fine wine compared to a box wine (other soy sauces). It is really clean tasting yet complex too. It brings our recipes to a whole new level. A little goes a long way.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This is like a fine wine compared to other soy sauces and similar products we have tried.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. This shoyu sauce is fantastic. We will definitely buy it again. It really is delicious.

title: Great Addition To Winter Time Tea (With A Caution)
text:
I have a tough time with elderberries. I got two bushes after my friend showed me how to use them and the deer have been merciless with them. I finally put in a bunch more bushes and was about to harvest them but we had a rain. When I went outside, there was not a berry left. I got this juice powder to tide me over until next year.

HOW THIS COMES
This comes in a plastic thick package that protects freshness of the powder. It reseals with a zipper top.

HOW I USE THIS
I use this powder by having it in a mug with a teaspoon of juice powder, a squeeze of lemon and honey with hot water like I would use for tea. I also mix a teaspoon of this with lemon ginger tea which I love the extra kick the elderberry gives it.

TASTE
This tastes nice. It has occasional bursts of flavor as the tiny particles are reconstituted by the hot water.
Adding honey to this makes it a perfect combination of flavors.
CAUTION
If you are not really familiar with elderberries, there is something you need to know. If they are bitter, add lemon. But if you take more than a small spoonful you may find yourself with cramps and the runs. Elderberry can be a purgative which means they will clean you out- not in a bad way, but pretty intensely. Some are more sensitive than others, but you need to be aware of this when using elderberry anything.

THE BOTTOM LINE
Having this powder is great. I love having the ability to add the juice powder to my teas or have it straight like a tea when I want to.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. This is not quite the same as my elderberries the rain and animals got this year, but it is a decent substitute until I try again next year.

title: Not Bad For Lip Balms, Lipsticks, Or Similar But Not A Fan Of For Cooking
text:
When it comes to cooking, I am pretty choosy when it comes to flavorings. We cook with a lot of natural foods so most of the time artificial flavorings don't appeal to us. Let's take a look.

HOW THIS COMES
This comes in a flat box which is easy to store. All of the flavoring bottles are laying down in the box and well marked.

HOW THESE SMELL
Honestly almost all of this smell artificial and none of us were that crazy about them for food use.

Despite them not working out for cooking, I have to say that they are not too bad when it comes to lipstick or lip balms which I make. I have not experimented with them in bath products or soaps yet. I will probably try a few for kitchen liquid soaps that I make. They also might be nice for washing dishes with if you make your own dish soap.

THE BOTTOM LINE
Although I am not fond of these for cooking or baking, they do work out well for lip balm or lipstick and also for kitchen dish soap or liquid hand soaps.

MY RATING
THREE STARS. These are good for the uses I listed above, but for cooking, not so much.

title: I Prefer For Baking Than Smoothies or Coffee

When it comes to adding nutrients to food, I find that it works best if I combine like with like. These are primarily grains and some spices. That means for me, I am picky on what I put this in.

HOW THIS COMES
This comes in a resealable zipper topped foil bag.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This is a powder. It has turmeric in it and ginger too. The other powders are not as flavorful, but these make it a bit flavored.

HOW I USE IT
I put this in baked goods or perhaps even sauces that won't be tainted by ginger or turmeric flavor. I also put this in quinoa or other vegetable dishes. I also use it to help thicken sauces.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This is a nice additive, but I prefer to add it to baked goods, quinoa dishes, or sauces and savory things.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS. This is nice. I am not over the moon crazy about it, but it isn't bad in the right places. I definitely would not have this in coffee or smoothies, however.

When I saw this bag of ginger, I was so excited, I started shouting about it to the rest of the family. You see, there is a very special reason that a bag of ginger this size would be absolutely valuable to have on hand. Let's talk about it.

I use this for baking, herbal antibiotic blend, and poultices too.

This large bag of ginger is very valuable to have. Our whole family uses this for ginger baths which greatly help against illness as well as other uses.

FIVE STARS. This stuff is fantastic. I find that little is needed to do the job as it is more potent than others we have used.

title: Fantastic Garlic- Strong Flavor
text:
I have been an avid user of garlic for a long time. My family has grown it, we have dried it and we have freeze dried it too. There are many different types of garlic so each turns out a bit differently too.

HOW THIS COMES
This comes in a resealable package.

ODOR

IS IT GOOD?
You don't need much. This is very good intense garlic. It has a bit of a toasty flavor, but after drying my own garlic, I will say that some types of garlic will do that when they are dried. When put into food, the flavor is fantastic. My family loves this.

This is a great quality garlic. It is a nice flavor, works well in food or for therapeutic purposes.

FIVE STARS. This saves me from having to do as much garlic this year to dry for the coming year's use.

title: UPDATE~Makes Great Creamy Vanilla Similar To Madagascar Beans
text:
UPDATE- I have tasted the vanilla made with these really nice beans and I am very happy with it. I used some of these beans in bourbon and also in organic vodka and both results were great. 2 quarts for the 30 beans turned out well, but if you want REALLY dark vanilla, I would go with 1 quart for the 30 beans. Plan to wait at least 6 months for really full flavor)
-------------------
ORIGINAL REVIEW

These beans, the planifolia vanilla beans, are a bit different than some of the others. They tend to be grown in Papua New Guinea and they are more of a creamy floral bean than some of the others. These are what you use to get a more traditional vanilla flavor.

HOW THESE ARE SHIPPED
These come vacuum sealed. They had no mold on them. The ends are on the beans.

HOW I USE THESE
I take both ends off of the beans and then I carefully score the one side of the pod with a very sharp knife from one end to the other. I carefully scrape out the contents into a canning jar (1 quart wide mouth) and then put in the beans one by one along with their contents.

Once I have filled up the jar with the beans, I pour either organic vodka or a really good clean bourbon over the beans. I put them in a dark place carefully covered with the lid and shake them once in a while. After about six months, I test. If it seems done, I use it. If not, I wait longer.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This set of vanilla beans makes a nice vanilla. It has good flavor and is a bit more mellow than other beans, but it is a solid performer.

MY RATING
I give this five stars. It performed well for me. I already have a decent vanilla and it has not even been a month yet. If these come a bit dry, that is okay. They will plump up with the alcohol soaking and the flavors will be released.

title: The Guys LOVE This Stuff In Their Coffee
text:
I have one guy in the house who is a chai fanatic. The others are not as into chai much at all. I was not sure if I should get this mixture or not, but I am glad I did.

HOW THIS COMES
This comes in a glass jar as shown. It does not have a shaker top on it.

FRESH?
This smelled VERY fresh.

HOW TO USE
The recommendation is to use about a 1/2 tsp of powder in your drink. The guys like more of 1/4 tsp or possibly 1/3. 1/2 was a bit much. I roast our own coffee, so they don't like to bury the flavors.

HOW DOES IT TASTE?
I have to say, I am not a huge coffee drinker, but after tasting theirs, I will definitely use it in my decaf when I get back to having it again in the future. I am on a coffee hiatus right now. This stuff really does add a great dynamic to coffee. Adding milk creates another dimension yet.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This stuff is great for coffee. It is a bit expensive, but if you save it as a treat and use it for special days, it will last longer. If you really love it and want it daily, well, it is still cheaper than having it made for you at a coffee bar.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. This stuff is delicious in coffee, and one of the guys is going to test it in his chai. Why? I don't get it either, but he is having fun with it. I prefer it in coffee.

title: BEAUTIFUL To Look At Weak Flavor- Need Additional Bag Or Tea
text:
I always wanted to use some blooming tea. This was the perfect opportunity.

HOW THIS COMES
This comes in a tube can with a tight fitting lid. Inside each ball of flowers are in a vacuum sealed bag.

HOW TO USE
You are supposed to put very hot water (under boiling) over the top of the ball of floral tea just covering it. You wait and then 5 minutes or so later, the tea blooms and is ready to drink.

AROMA
There is not much fragrance to the tea.

TASTE
The tea is also extremely weak.

WHAT I DID
I got some dragon pearls or cherry blossom green tea and put it in a small bag with the hot water next time when I put in the floral ball and the tea was much better.

THE BOTTOM LINE
The tea is beautiful, but alone it is not much flavor or aroma, which is part of the attraction of tea. I found putting another bag of tea that I made or bought in with it helped a lot.

MY RATING
Alone this tea is beautiful but not much flavor, so I am giving this 3 stars. I really wish they had a bit more flavor. No matter how little water I used, it still had faint flavor to it.

title: I LOVE The Honey, But The Plastic Container Bag Is A Bit Too Thin
text:
I have used containers just like this for a few items including guacamole and soft cheese blend. I am used to using them. Let's take a look.

HONEY QUALITY
The honey quality of this honey is exceptional. I love the flavor of it. I want to mention here that we only use honey- no refined sugars. We also use maple syrup. So I can tell good honey from not so good. This is GREAT honey.

PACKAGING
The packaging of this honey is a great idea, but the plastic used is just a little bit too thin. It makes it hard to control while pushing out the honey. If it were just a bit thicker, it would be easier to control. This is so thin, I get concerned about a hole being poked in it before the honey is all used up. The other packaging like this I have used is tougher plastic but still allows you to roll it up at the end to get as much as possible.

This plastic flops over too easily. It makes it hard to stand up and keep anywhere.

THE BOTTOM LINE
I LOVE this honey but with that the blastic squeeze part of the packaging had a little tougher plastic on it. That would make it just about perfect. As it is it flops over and is so thin I am concerned about accidental leaks.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS- only because of the packaging. The honey itself is FIVE STARS.

title: A Bit Weak, But Natural Taste, Sweetener Brings Out Flavor Better
text:
I have been waiting what seems to be FOREVER for Frontier Herbs to get in their infamous raspberry flavoring. I LOVE that stuff. Unfortunately they have been out of stock a long time. Let's take a look at this one.

BOTTLE
This comes in an amber plastic bottle. It is not glass. It has a seal that has to be broken on top and a screw on cap.

FLAVOR
The flavor of this is somewhat weak. I did notice, however that adding honey to the flavoring (or rather putting the flavor into the honey before recipe) really does increase the flavor some.

SCENT
The scent of this is not quite as strong as expected, but it does not taste like chemical or severely artificial.

WHAT I USE THIS FOR
I have used this both fresh and for baking. I added it to some apple crisp I made and put it in the honey prior to using on the apples. I also made a cranberry relish that is fresh with pineapple, orange, cranberry and honey along with raspberry flavoring. It is not quite as nice as the other flavoring from Frontier, but it is a good substitute until the other comes in.

THE BOTTOM LINE
Although weak in flavor, this is still more natural tasting and does have increased taste when mixed with honey I like it until I can get my usual again.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS. This is the best substitute I have found for my usual natural raspberry flavoring from Frontier Co-op/Herbs. I like it both in baked items as well as fresh, but it is not as good as I expected. I still like it though.

title: Made The Traditional Way, A Solid Ceremonial Matcha
text:
I have an official old school matcha tea set. I decided to put this to the test.

HOW THIS COMES
This comes in a brown tin and has a foil bag inside to keep the tea fresh.

COLOR OF THE POWDER
The color of the powder is a bright green as it should be.

HOW I PREPARED THIS
I prepared this using about 170 degree water. I used two chasaku scoops (bamboo) which were scant to put in the water. The water went into a warmed bowl and I used a warmed and primed Chasen (bamboo whisk) to froth the tea.

FLAVOR
Although this did not have quite the sweetness of other matcha I have had, it was good solid matcha and pleasant to drink.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This is a good solid ceremonial matcha. When prepared the traditional way, the taste and color were up to where they should be and enjoyable.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I like this matcha. It is good. Although it is not quite as nice as the Encha brand, I do like it a lot.

INSTRUCTIONS
If you are unsure how to make matcha, the company has an address on the back of the label that you can go to online with excellent instructions for both traditional and more moderns ways to make matcha.

PHOTO
I could not get a good photo of the matcha since my bowl is more on the darker side, so I did not post one.

title: Not As Good As Fresh, But Close - Drink This Alone For Best Benefit
text:
I have been drinking and making my own fresh wheatgrass juice for some time now. I am familiar with how it tastes and performs. This past year I could not get fresh wheatgrass so I opted for this dried powder. Let's take a look.

HOW THIS COMES
This comes in a moisture proof resealable bag.

HOW TO USE
I use a teaspoon or so in a 4 oz glass of water. I sometimes mix it in with fresh apple juice, but that is it. Wheatgrass juice is best taken ALONE, not in smoothies or with other things. The power in this food is by itself. It is highly cleansing and full of nutrients. Mixing it greatly reduces its effectiveness and also causes gas and digestive upsets in many people.

DOES IT HELP?
The reason this is so good is that this is wheatgrass JUICE powder. That is the best way to get this. Wheatgrass powder is ground up wheatgrass. This is FAR better. I do notice a boost taking this which is not exactly like fresh, but way better than not taking it.

TASTE
This tastes fine to me. I am used to drinking fresh which many people can not tolerate. This powder is actually a little more mild than fresh.

KEEP COOL
I keep this in the refrigerator and find that it lasts longer if I do that. I only use this in the late fall, winter, and spring time when greens are scarce. It helps a lot. In the summer when fresh greens are plentiful in the yard, I don't tend to use it as much.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This is an excellent substitute for fresh wheatgrass juice. It is easy to make, when used with a milk foamer or mini blender it blends well.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I am glad to have a source for this juice powder. It really helps a lot in tough times when I am unable to get the greens I need. This pulls me through.

title: Fresh Nicely Colored Tumeric (WARNING)
text:
I use turmeric for a variety of things. I needed some fresh turmeric so I got this. Let's take a look.

HOW THIS COMES
This comes in a sealed foil package with a zipper closure on top.

WHAT IS THE TUMERIC LIKE?
The turmeric smells fresh and is a good solid yellow orange color.

HOW I USE THIS
I use this for:
-supplements (put in gel caps)
-Indian cooking
-pickles during canning season
-dye
-chai tea

You will want to keep this in a dark container. If you keep this in the foil bag, protect it from air and light by making sure it is closed. This is a great turmeric. I like that it is organic. It smells fresh and performs well.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I like this. I really enjoy the smell of fresh turmeric. I am glad I got this.

title: Impressive Cheese Wiz Substitute!  I Really Like This
text:
I used to be vegan so I am well acquainted with vegan substitutes for cheese. Some are good, some are not as good. Let's take a look.

HOW THIS COMES
This comes in two canning jars with screw off lids (reusable if you can food or vacuum seal freeze dried or dried foods).

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
I have to say that this tastes like a more real natural form of Cheeze Wiz. It does not taste icky, but it tastes more real and delicious. It is a great cheese sauce for chili (I make a great vegan chili), vegetables, and even as a chip or vegetable dip. I also use this for cheese sauce over my grass fed burgers too. I can not have much cheese so this is nice for me.

DOES IT GIVE ME PROBLEMS?
So far, this has given me no bad gas or other reactions. I have not had any issues with digestion.

DOES IT TASTE GOOD?
I have to say with vegan or even with grass fed meats this is delicious. I love having the alternative to cheese for me. I have to very strictly reduce my cheese consumption so this is a happy product to have handy.

DOES IT TASTE LIKE CHEESE?
Honestly, no, this does not taste like cheese. It is more like Cheese Wiz but I prefer this one as I don't like Cheese Wiz. It does have a taste of pepper to it and a bit of a zip too- not much just enough to make it interesting. If you are really into cheese, you will probably not love this. If you are vegan, really miss cheese, or are needing gluten free, this is one of the better substitutes I have used over time.

THE BOTTOM LINE
Whether vegan or even if you are like me and eat paleo but have to avoid milk products, this cheese substitute is fantastic. I really do like it.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. This is great sauce. It has some texture now and then from vegetable fibers, but it does not bother me because I know it is made from vegetables. I definitely would be open to buying this more in the future and have on hand so I don't feel left out with the rest of the family when they go all cheese happy.

title: A Little Salty, And Broken In Pieces, But SO GOOD!
text:
As someone who follows paleo most of the time, finding crunchy snacks is not always easy. Then this came along..

HOW THIS COMES
This comes in a box with three small boxes which have shrink wrap on them.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. These are expensive because the ingredients are expensive and specialty but they are SO GOOD.

title: Great For Keto, Paleo, Or Gluten Free Baking

This comes in a zipper topped bag.

PERFORMANCE?
This is very good flour. The taste and performance is great. We like it.

If you are looking for a good coconut flour, this is a good one. It smells fresh and performs well.

FIVE STARS. Having this around is important and this brand is a good performer. I put it on a glass container once opened so that it will stay fresh.

title: Could Not Make It Through Winter Without This, Not As Crazy About Packaging
text:
When it comes to winter, having fresh greens is sometimes difficult. During the past year when shopping abilities have been greatly hindered due to the frustrations of the world situation, having fresh greens has become even more important. This powder is the perfect answer for me.

This comes in a zipper top package. It is supposed to be a quick composting substance that it is made from.

The powder is bright green. Keep in mind this is the JUICE powder, not the barley greens ground whole. That is a big difference.

This tastes great as barley green powder should. I love it.

I put a heaping teaspoon in my mini cordless Pop Baby blender and mix it with cold water then I drink it first thing in the morning.

I can not begin to tell you the difference this makes. It gives me energy, calms stress, and helps my body not to slump during the day either. I have a much brighter attitude when taking this powder.

THE BOTTOM LINE
Although I would prefer a more solid package that I can depend on over time, this powder saves the day for me this winter. It really has been great to have.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS although the packaging I am not as enthusiastic with. It might compost easily but I want to protect my investment in the powder over time too. Time will tell on that.

title: Like The Powder, The Packaging Could Be Better
text:
I use kale all winter long. Due to the issues with kale in the stores in the winter either being out of stock or not the same as home grown, I have made my own freeze dried kale for winter use for a few years now. This powder was intriguing. Let's take a look.

CONTAINER
The first issue I have with this is the container. It is in a cylinder which has a foil seal on it. Once the seal is removed, all that is left is a foil lined cardboard cover that fits pretty tight, but this container is not going to withstand moisture for long. I wish it was sealed a little better like a plastic fitting cap or something.

KALE POWDER
The powder itself is pretty decent tasting . It is not bitter, and it does meld well with smoothies. Let's be honest here. It is kale. It is not going to thrill people who don't like greens much. If you are used to kale, this is a decent powder and of good quality.

DOES IT WORK?
We had to go without greens for a few days. Having constant sources of greens all summer long from the garden to nothing was a bit rough on me. I was desperate. I remembered the kale powder and quickly using my Pop Baby Personal cordless blender, I whipped up some kale powder with a tiny bit of my home made freeze dried green smoothie mix which contains our own kale as well as our own fruits.

I tasted it before the smoothie mix and the kale powder was good. I liked it. I added the smoothie mix then and the results were great. Within an hour I was feeling MUCH better and my body started to relax.

DOES IT BLEND EASILY?
Yes, I have had no issues of this not blending easily in my little Pop Babies personal blender. There are not lumps and problems. Over time if not used right away, the container might let in moisture and that could be a problem but for now, it is fine.

THE BOTTOM LINE
Although the container is not as good as I would like, the powder quality is great. I use this daily and will until it is gone. There are 23 servings if you use a TABLESPOON at a time in about 8 oz of liquid.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS only because of the container. The powder alone is 5 star rating.

title: Paleo or Raw Foods Diets Can Use This- Even Antifungal- Great With Tahini
text:
I tend to follow raw foods and antifungal diets. Finding ingredients that are clean is not always easy. When I saw this, I was very excited.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
FLAVOR
This has a raw cocoa flavor. It is not like toasted chocolate, but has a nice light chocolate flavor. It is bitter which I love.

POWDER
The powder seems to be clean and well ground.

HOW DOES IT PERFORM?
This performs very nicely in raw candy recipes using honey and tahini. It is my favorite quick snack.

ANY PROBLEMS?
I tend to be sensitive to mold. I had no reactions to this powder.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This is a fantastic ingredient to have on hand. If you want to have some raw cocoa powder that has been tested to be free of mycotoxin (fungals) which is hard to find, this is a good choice. It is going to have a bitter edge (think dark chocolate), but it is really smooth and flavorful for me.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I love this powder. It is different than others I have tried. I would probably buy this again as I like to have raw cocoa when I can. The flavor is so smooth and nice. I like it.

title: PERFECT DELICIOUS Way To Take Wholesome Food When You Need Small Footprint
text:
One of our kids is off to school far from home. Due to all of the restrictions, quarantine, and inability to get out and get their own stuff, I wanted a way to pack the most wholesome food into the smallest space. Then I saw this box.

WHAT ARE THESE LIKE?
These are small packets of fruit leathers. They are great flavors such as mango, apple, pear, and raspberry. Inside each package is a very moist fruit leather that is in strings almost like string cheese. They are soft and easy to eat.

HOW DO THEY TASTE?
It is easy to eat these and they are so delicious it is hard to pick a favorite. They are not overly sickening in flavor, but they are rich in flavor. One of us likes each of these as the favorite- so we all have different favorites. I like the raspberry one best.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This is a great way to bring fruit with you, especially if you are traveling. It is not only good for children, but adults as well. The string makeup of the leather makes it fun to eat like string cheese which appeals to the kid in you.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I will be buying these again. They only have fruit in them and I love that! We are sending our secondary ed student with a way to eat healthy during quarantine which they have to endure when they get there.

title: We Don't Usually Like Most Dark Roast Coffee, But This One Isn't Bad
text:
I know, you are probably reading my title thinking that this is medium roast, so why am I carrying on about dark? Let's take a look.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
BAG?
This is a 5 lb bag. It does breathe and it has a roll down top with a wire strap to keep it in place.

BEANS
This is whole bean.

ROAST?
This is listed as medium roast, but honestly, it is dark. The dark roast is not as rough as many of them are. IT still has some depth to it. If you like dark roasts, give this a try. It might give you the best of medium and dark in one cup.

FLAVOR
We grind to each batch of coffee, and we have had this as espresso, pour over coffee, hot brew coffee, and Espresso Lungo . It has a flavor of dark chocolate and a bit more depth to it than most darker roasts. It is not burned tasting, thankfully. Adding some cream and sweetener brings out the depth of nuance with this coffee.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This coffee is not bad. It is not our favorite, but I have to drink organic coffee, and this gave me no issues. The roast is a bit on the darker side for us, but it is still decent.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS. I wish this was a bit lighter roast (a true medium) but as it is we will still drink it up. If you like darker roasts, you will probably LOVE this. Try it.

title: DELICIOUS Quick Meal- Unusual Grain, Lots of FLAVOR
text:
I have had a lot of unusual grains, but this pilaf was one of my new favorites.

WHAT IS IT LIKE?
This comes in a plastic sealed bag. You use the entire thing. IT smells spicy but not hot.

HOW TO MAKE?
They recommend 1 1/3 cups of water with this, but I used 2 cups and liked it better.

HOW DID IT TASTE?
I used olive oil to make it and also added fresh tomato, onion, pepper, and cilantro. It was fantastic. Eveyrone loved it.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This has two batches of this pilaf in the box. One fed four of us well with added vegetables. It is delicious, spicy without being hot. We love it.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS> I would buy it again.

title: Too Expensive For What You Get
text:
I have used pour over coffee for a long time now. I thought these would be nice for the road.

COFFEE ENVELOPES
These come sealed in envelopes that keep them fresh.

POUR OVER STAND
These stands fold out and don't always fit a lot of cups or mugs that we have. When I find one that does it is okay.

BAG
The bag of coffee sits pretty low in the mug. That means you need a tall mug and you only fill it part way with water to get the coffee you want without dragging the bag into the water.

FLAVOR
The flavor is pretty good, but not WOW. My husband likes it. I am mediocre about it.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This coffee seems like a good idea on the road and for some it might be. Finding the right mug so the bag is not dragging in the liquid and getting the frame to fit right, is not easy at first, but it is an okay method of doing coffee on the road.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS. My husband likes it. It is handy at times and better than some restaurant coffee.

title: Best Black Vinegar Yet - NO SUGAR
text:
I have done this review 2 times and it keeps disappearing. To put it briefly, I have used black vinegar for years. I have had trouble finding black vinegar that does not have sugar in it. This one is perfect.

WHAT DO I USE THIS FOR?
I use this for a variety of Thai and Asian recipes and especially like to make a crispy tofu recipe with it.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This vinegar is smooth, rich, no severe acid bit to it and it has no sugar.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS I would buy this again and I hope I don't have to write this review again! As much as I love this vinegar it would be nice If I could just tell you about it once. (grin)

title: This Did NOT Work In The Coffee Maker, And Was Not A Hit At Our House
text:
I have a family member who has to be off of caffeine for a while so in addition to myself who also avoids it much of the time, I thought this would be a great idea.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This is a finely ground coffee substitute. It has the smell of toasted, almost burned, figs. It also has a starchy chickpea smell to it. It comes in a foil lined zipper pouch.

HOW TO MAKE?
It says that this will work in all coffeemakers. You can also steep it for 3-5 minutes and strain.

DOES IT WORK?
This was a disaster in my coffee maker- I tried it in two of them. It plugged them both up and they would not work. Thankfully it did not ruin them, only made for a frustration and no beverage to speak of. As for steeping, it is much better that way. I put it in a tea bag style bag for easy steeping.

HOW DOES IT TASTE?
This stuff is not at all like coffee. Honestly, it made one of us nauseous, and the other person kept curling their lip saying "EWwww." I was not a fan of it myself. I am not sure if it is the chickpeas or what, but it just made me not want to drink it.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This is not a great coffee substitute for us. It did not work in coffee makers as stated for us, and it really did not appeal in flavor to anyone in our household who are usually very open to try new things.

MY RATING
TWO STARS. Someone out there might like this, but it is not anyone in our family. We eat naturally and are very open to try new things, but this was just not a hit for us.

title: Good Solid Genmaicha Tea from Japan- I Prefer It Fixed Differently, However
text:
I love Genmaicha tea. It is delicious especially on those chilly days when you just want something warm with a bit more oomph than green tea. Let's take a look.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This tea comes in white plastic bag with mylar lining. There is a zipper closure on top. The tea itself has green tea leaves, roasted rice, and matcha powder in it.

HOW TO FIX THIS?
The directions recommends 140F for only a few moments,, but I prefer to put a Tablespoon in a Tea Strainer, pour water that is 175F over top of it and let it set for 2-3 minutes.

COLOR?
This turns a really pretty light green/ golden chartreuse color.

HOW DOES IT TASTE?
This tea is more subtle than some of the Genmaicha teas that I have had. It is still delicious, however, and it is smooth without bitterness. It is warming and filling. My entire family likes it. It is great for those days when you want t nice tea that is rich but still light at the same time if that makes sense. I like the way we fix it a bit better. 140F just seemed to make the tea overly light. You could try it at 160 and see what you think and move it up or down from there.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This tea is delicious. It has a nice blend of rice and green tea. The flavor is good yet light. It is not bitter and is smooth. My whole family enjoyed it.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. This is a nice organic tea to have. I would probably buy it again.

title: OMG I LOVE THIS STUFF!  NO SUGAR! (I Seriously Ate This Out Of The Packet At First)
text:
I know that I did all caps there, but I am really excited. We have used wasabi for years, but suddenly we were not able to find any without sugar or sorbitol in them.

WHAT ARE THESE LIKE?
These are perfect 1 person packet. You can definitely share this if you don't eat much wasabi. The packets are easy to tear open and they come packed in a plastic bag inside a nice box where you can store them if you like.

HOW DOES THIS TASTE?
OMG this is so amazing. The lack of sweetness is fabulous. It has a very fresh radish flavor, and if you want to sweeten it, you can. We all love it.

IS IT REALLY HOT?
This is a bit hotter than some wasabi that I have had, but it lacks that icky bitterness that some wasabi has which I am thrilled about. The hot if you go easy on it is refreshing and adds the perfect hot to fish or ice cream.

WHAT WE USE IT FOR
We not only use this for sushi, but we use it to put in mayonnaise. It is fantastic for tuna. We also love to put a tiny bit of this on GREEN TEA ICE CREAM. Yes, that is what I said. It is fantastic. The spicy adds a twist to the ice cream and counteracts the sweet in it.

THE BOTTOM LINE
I can not tell you how excited my family is to have this. We all will use it and enjoy every second of it. I kid you not when I say I opened a pack and kept eating little bits all night when we first got it. It is THAT GOOD.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. This is fantastic. I love that it is not sweetened, but if you really want you can sweeten it yourself. No bitterness, just very fabulous hot radish flavor.

title: Great Fruity Smell, Soft, And Perfect For Making Vanilla Extract
text:
Making vanilla extract is something I have done for some time. I have used both Madagascar Bourbon beans and also Tahitian beans. Let's take a look at these.

WHAT ARE THESE LIKE?
These beans come in a vacuum sealed plastic bag. The beans smell wonderful, fruity, and are soft with a great flavor to it.

HOW TO USE THESE?
Good vanilla extract works best with about 5 beans per cup of alcohol, at least 40 proof. I used an organic vodka which enhances the lovely fruity vanilla flavor.

DOES IT WORK WELL?
It takes some time to get vanilla to its best, but already this is getting dark and fragrant. I will have to wait a few more months before I can even think of using this.

THE BOTTOM LINE
If you want to make Tahitian vanilla extract, these beans are great quality. They flavor up the alcohol nicely and color it up well too.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. These are some of the nicer Tahitian vanilla beans I have used. I like how fresh they are.

title: Not A Bad Pu-erh, But Not The Best I Have Had Either
text:
I like Pu-erh once I found some that I could have without reactions to it. This is a sachet version vs the cake. Let's see how it worked out.

WHAT ARE THESE LIKE?
This Pu-erh tea comes in sealed bags. There are 3 boxes in the set. The sachets are like pyramid shape for better steeping.

HOW TO USE?
The way I used this is to heat the water to 210F. I pour it over the sachet, and quickly pour it off. Then I pour about 9 oz of the water on the sachet and let it steep about 2 or 3 minutes. I taste it and if it is done, I take the sachet out. If it needs more, I let it sit a minute longer.

FLAVOR?
The flavor of tea is good. It is not WOW, but it is good. It is not as intense as the Pu-erh from the aged cake that I have. I would call this middle level to light quality.

CAN YOU USE MORE THAN ONCE?
I can use a sachet twice, but the 2nd time it is lighter considerably. It is okay and a basic decent tea, but not WOW.

THE BOTTOM LINE
If you like to have Pu-erh tea but need to have it on the go, this is a great option. The process is easy, the flavor is decent, and it is not overwhelming or fussy tea.

MY RATING
FOUR stars. I like it, it is decent, but it is not one of my favorite Pu-erh teas. Everyone in the house likes it, and will drink it, but it is not the first Pu-erh they reach for. Having it to take with me when I am not home or to send through the mail as a care package to family who travels, is a great option.

title: Awful- Like It Was Burned And Not Too Easy To Use Either
text:
When I saw these, I thought it would be a great idea to try them out. Let's see what happened.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
These come in little packets which are sealed so you can travel with them. You open the package, prop it over a mug and then pour water over the top for pour over coffee.

HOW DOES THIS PERFORM?
This is hard to get to sit well over a mug. Either they are too big or they are too short and the bottom drags into the coffee that is poured. They are good in theory, but I found that the effect of the pour over was not that great. I let them bloom and all, they just were not great.

SHAPE
The problem if I got this to sit properly on a mug, it had to be a tall mug, because to fit the proper amount of coffee in the mug, the bottom drags too low, so you have to stop too soon leaving the coffee too strong.

FLAVOR?
OMG this was so awful that my husband who would drink almost ANY coffee, threw it away. He really did not like it at all. It tasted burned and there was nothing redeeming about it.

THE BOTTOM LINE
Although this was good in concept, the flavor and performance fell short for us. We had to throw the coffee away.

MY RATING
1 Star. It really was awful coffee. I have been doing pour over coffee for years. I know how it should be and this was horrible. Maybe it was a bad batch, but for the price, it should be better than this.

title: Ezpensive For What It Is, But You Can Get A Few Brews From Each Sachet
text:
I love jasmine. Sometimes, however, it is not as good as others. Let's see what this was like.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
SACHET
This comes in a nylon netting sort of sachet in a pyramid shape allowing for better water flow than traditional bags.

HOW IS THE JASMINE SCENT/FLAVOR?
The jasmine scent/flavor is really nice. It is natural and not enhanced tasting.

HOW IS THE TEA FLAVOR?
The tea is nice, but not WOW. I actually perfer to have Harney Tea's Dragon Pearl Jasmine tea over this one. The raw Pu-erh is nice, but not as good as I had expcted. It is not bad though and we all liked it.

CAN YOU BREW IT MORE THAN ONCE?
I found you can get two brews out of a sachet, although the 2nd one will need to be in the water longer. Pay attention the the temperature on the box. This one needs to be 195F in 9 oz of water or so, and the brew time is 2-3 min the first time and about 5 minutes the 2nd time.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This tea is good, but I am not sure it is worth the price tag. I would prefer a different tea in terms of jasmine. It is okay, but not my favorite.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS. I think this is too expensive for what you get. Only 12 bags means you only get 12 cups of tea unless you brew a 2nd time which is not quite as nice.

title: I AM IN LOVE WITH THIS!  If You Are A Tabbouli Fan, Listen Up!
text:
I have been avoiding wheat for various reasons doe to sensitivities. It is August when I am writing this which means our tomatoes, cucumbers, green onions and parsley are at their peek. That means it is Tabbouleh time! I spell it all different ways because it is spelled all different ways. LOL.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This is so tiny, I thought they must be nuts of they think I am going to like it in Tabbouleh. It is just about as small as teff, if you have had that. If not, well it is bigger than sand, which is not saying much.

HOW DID I COOK IT?
We cooked it on the directions, and left it in the pan to absorb water. I find you can put a tiny bit more in it than called for. Ours absorbed it all up. If you notice, the grain is already parboiled so it takes very little cooking.

HOW DID WE MAKE THE TABBOULI?
I put tomatoes, olive oil, fresh mint, parsley, cucumber, onion, olive oil, lemon juice, and real salt in the food processor and chopped it up stopping before it was total mush. Then I mixed it in with the grain and let it sit for about 10 minutes.

HOW DID IT TASTE/PERFORM?
OMG I am in LOVE with this stuff. It is more like using the fine bulghur which is often used for tabbouli. The flavor is fabulous. The addition of the fresh vegetables and all rounds it out perfectly. We made a huge pan of this, and it was all gone very quickly.

THE BOTTOM LINE
I want to buy this in bulk, man. It is fabulous stuff. I have been on the antifungal way of eating (similar to paleo or keto) and this grain opens up tabbouleh in a whole new way.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I will buy this again no question. It feels nice to be able to have tabbouleh again and not be concerned about having reactions or problems from wheat. I am really really thrilled about this. I think it even tastes better.

title: O. M. G.  Seriously.  These Are AMAZING
text:
We eat natural foods. We eat organic and do not have sugar cane or corn syrup. That means my snacks are limited compared to the rest of the world. Then I saw these.

WHAT ARE THESE LIKE?
These come in a box with 12 little boxes inside. Inside each box is a cello wrapped cardboard tray of 3 dates.

HOW DO THESE TASTE
OMG seriously, these are some of the best dates I have EVER had. This is the most fantastic snack box I could ever ask for.

DOES THE FAMILY LIKE THEM?
I had to hide these, does that tell you anything? The family went nuts over these.

USES?
These are great to pack in lunches, take on the road with you, or just cram in your mouth until you get sick before the rest of the family finds them. HAHA

THE BOTTOM LINE
The quality of these dates is exceptional. I love the way they are packaged so you only have to worry about 3 being open at any given time. They are easy to bring with me and fantastic to motivate healthy snacks of the rest of the family. The price is high, but for what you get it is worth it.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I wish they were a little cheaper, but honestly these are so high quality they really do merit a try if you are unsure. Just keep in mind they are addicting, so be prepared to hide them.

title: An Acquired Taste, Sort Of Like Lime Peel And Bitter Orange Peel Flavoring
text:
I love exploring different foods from around the world. Calamansi fruit is not something I have had before, so I decided to check it out. Let's see what happened.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
PACKAGING
The packaging is interesting. There is a nice twist top on this which allows you to open it, dilute or use straight and then shut it up again and save it for another use.

THE CONCENTRATE
The concentrate is very unique. I would say it is reminiscent of Yuzu if you ever had that, but not quite as fruity It is similar to the peel of lime with bitter orange. It is concentrated, so the idea is if you are going to drink it you dilute it first. Full strength is like espresso vs coffee.

HOW I USED THIS
We had some swordfish steaks that we wanted to grill, so I got the calamansi concentrate and put it on the fish. If you open it, you have to use it in 3 days or so, so I used the whole thing, knowing I would forget to use the rest if I didn't. After I soaked the steaks in the juice, I added some garlic, chives, liquid aminos (soy sauce substitute), and salt and pepper.

We grilled the fish and served it with a thawed pea salad that had mayo in it and fresh veggies and a salad. the fish was really good. That added bitter twist seemed to take away from the fishy taste that swordfish sometimes can have. It really did add some depth.

THE BOTTOM LINE
Although this is a bit on the bitter side for me, it does make some nice marinades and I plan to use it next to make muffins when the weather allows in the future (it is hot now). This is handy to have and a new and different taste if you like citrus type flavors.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS. This has a lot of bitterness to it and is an acquired taste. I like it and will use it, but so far don't LOVE it. I have not found the perfect place to use it yet although I am trying. I hope to update if I do.

HOW DID I USE IT?

title: OMG  THESE ARE AMAZING!  My Entire Family (Non-Paleo) Loves Them
text:
When I got these, I was hoping for an alternative for potato chips which give me trouble, but I can not help eating when stressed. Let's take a look at these.

WHAT ARE THESE LIKE?
These are 6 flavors of potato chip like snacks which are truly made out of chicken slices. They are in a foil bag, and when you open the bag, be sure to shut it tightly and eat within a could of days, or they can get soggy in the air.

HOW DO THESE TASTE?
These chips are FANTASTIC! I can not have sugar and none of these has sugar cane at all in them. The ingredients are very wholesome and the flavors are all fabulous. My favorite chips are the Buffalo and the Vinegar and Sea Salt chips.

TEXTURE
The texture of these is fabulous. They are very thin and crisp and do feel iike potato chips.

ARE THEY GREASY?
These are a little greasy, but not bad at all til you get to the bottom of the bag. They are rich though so you will only want to eat a few at a time. They are so irresistible.

ARE THE WAFFLE ONES WEIRD?
I am singling these out because they sound horrible. They have maple syrup on them and I have to say they do remind me of waffles and syrup! The whole family was fighting over these!

THE BOTTOM LINE
This collection is fantastic. If you are not sure which ones to get, get this one to start with and find out. Although every single one of these was delicious, we all had different favorites. Be sure to eat them within a couple of days of opening by clipping them shut or they will get soggy from humidity.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. These are so delicious, I plan to buy more. The family all fought over them after laughing at me when I told them what they were. They were not laughing once they tasted them.

title: I Am TOTALLY CRAZY About This Powder
text:
I used to live near an Asian Market. It was so delightful to get kaffir lime leaves to make many Thai dishes including my own curry pastes. However, a combination of moving away and irregular shipping schedules made it really hard to get the lime leaves fresh along with the galangal root that we love to use. I decided to try this powder, as frozen leaves lost their zip.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This powder comes in a very small plastic envelope that has a zip closure on it. The powder is bright green and has that beautiful fragrance of kaffir lime leaves to it. It is very very fine powder.

HOW DID I USE THIS?
I made a fabulous shrimp curry soup in my Philips Soup maker the other night. It has shrimp, coconut milk, thai red curry paste, onion, pumpkin cooked up, and instead of vegetable broth, I used a can of the unsweetened Campbells Sweet potato foundation soup in a can.

Instead of stopping there as I do in the winter, I added a half teaspoon of the lime powder and some fresh Thai basil I am growing. I also put some lemongrass in it from our garden as well.

DID IT TASTE GOOD?
The family raved about it the entire time they ate the soup. Everyone loved it, myself included.

THE BOTTOM LINE
If you love to cook Thai food but have restrictions to ingredients, this powder on hand makes a HUGE difference. I highly suggest having a bag. It is exactly what I have always wanted.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I will probably buy this again, and again, and again..well, you get the idea.

title: If You Can Not Have Cream, This Is A Decent Sub, Not Quite As Good As Nutpods
text:
I have been using non dairy creamers for a while now, but I can not have sugar. I have been using Nutpods which have been delightful to use especially when it comes to foaming up for a latte or other drinks. Let's see what this is like.

HOW DOES IT COME?
This comes tightly wrapped in plastic in a set of two as in the picture with the listing. It tells you to put in the refrigerator right away.

WHAT THIS LUMPY?
It was close to 100 degrees all week that this was delivered. I opened it up and it was perfectly fine- thick like cream.

DOES IT WHIP UP?
I have a great milk foamer that turns my Nutpods into almost shaving cream consistency. This creamer also foamed way up too. It was not quite as thick, but it was nice. It foamed up better warm than cold.

HOW DOES IT TASTE?
This tastes like butter and whey, actually. It has a cream flavor a bit, but my daughter took one swig and said, "Butter- like having butter in coffee". Since that is what this is, that is a good thing, right? There is no flavor other than creamer. It does allow the flavor of the coffee to show through.

DOES IT WORK WELL FOR HOT AND COLD COFFEE?
We have made this both ways. I like it best foamed up warm in my foamer. Then I blend it up in a bit of hot water, and take the cold brew coffee and mix it up with that. I add the ice and the creamer foamed to the blend and it is a nice thick cold coffee drink. It is also good foamed and warm with hot coffee, but it has been hot out since I got these, so I tend to avoid the heated stuff more than just trying it once.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This creamer is surprisingly good. It has a bland flavor so that the coffee stands out, but it adds to the creamy texture and health too.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. This is not quite as nice as Nutpods, but it is a nice change. I would buy it again. I like to change it up now and then. We also have organic raw milk which is fabulous in coffee, but I can only have it once in a while. This is a nice alternative now and then.

OTHER USES
I have also flavored this with vanilla and honey and it made a nice blend that way too if you tend to like flavored creamers.

title: Good Solid Sea Salt For Cooking And Salt Scrubs
text:
We have only used sea salt for years. We do not use any other salt unless forced to do so on rare occasions. Let's see what this one is like.

WHAT IS THIS SEA SALT LIKE?
This sea salt comes in a thick plastic bag which is resealable. That means you can take salt out of it and put it in a container and seal this back up protecting it from moisture.

HOW DOES THIS PERFORM?
This sea salt performs very well. It has good solid flavor and you don't need a lot either.

HOW DO I USE THIS?
I not only use this in cooking and seasoning in the kitchen, I use it for salt scrubs too. This type of salt works well for fine scrubbing, similar to what you might see in a hand scrub or face scrub. It is not for body as it is too fine.

THE BOTTOM LINE
For a good solid performer which is concentrated so you don't need tons, but adds good flavor to food and texture to scrubs, this is a good one to use.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I have been happy with salts I have gotten from this company so far. The quality seems to be good and performance is good too. I recommend this and would purchase it again.

title: Great For Cold Brew Coffee Lattes (Paleo) and Cold It Whips Up!
text:
Despite our kids thinking this was a bit too sweet, I thought it might make a nice creamer. Let's see what happened.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This milk product comes in a screw top container which is best kept in the refrigerator to be cold. It comes in a nice box for storage until you use them all up. The cap twists off and you can refrigerate the rest if you don't drink it all, but you will.

HOW DOES IT TASTE?
It is a little bit rich with an extra bit of stevia than I tend to like, but it is not repulsive like some stevia products. The flavor is very marshmallow in nature with vanilla. I really like it. Despite the kids saying it was a bit too sweet, they drank it all up.

HOW DOES IT PERFORM IN COFFEE?
My favorite way to have this is in a large glass of cold brew coffee. I use concentrated coffee and then I put in a whole container of this stuff. The result is fabulous for a hot summer day. The coffee offsets the sweetness of the milk drink.

THIS WHIPS UP?
If you warm this up, it won't whip, but if you want to put this in cold coffee, you can whip it up with a hand whip and it gets really thick and foamy making it even nicer in cold brew or cold coffee.

PALEO/GRASSFED
I love that this works for me. I have to avoid milk that is not from grassfed sources due to problems I have with digestion. This is perfect for me when I want to skip the Nut Pods for a day or two and have something different yet still within my limits of paleo type eating requirements.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This is a really delicious drink. I love that it is grassfed in nature, and it has no sugar added. The stevia is a little bit heavy, but not repulsive like others I have had. The flavor is great and makes a fabulous cold latte.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I would buy this again- and hoard it for summer time coffee. The family is liking it now that they tried it with coffee, well those who drink coffee, anyway.

title: Um, WHERE'S THE SUMAC?
text:
The whole point of getting this za'atar was to get za'atar blend. What I got instead was disappointed. Let's take a look.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
Za'atar is a blend of toasted sesame seeds, za'atar which is an herb when using the original (as this brand says they do) which resembles a very intense French Thyme with a twist of Greek Oregano in flavor) as well as sumac. There is also supposed to be salt and oil in this blend. One of the most important spices in the blend of za'atar which this brand claims to have in it is sumac. Yet, despite in the listing that it is supposed to have it, on the jar, there is no mention of sumac, nor is there any in the jar.

HOW DOES THIS TASTE?
To be honest, without the sumac, this is just a bunch of intense herb grown on dry ground and harvested to be intense with some toasted sesame seeds in it. It is okay, but nothing thrilling.

WHAT IF YOU ADD SUMAC?
I just so happened to have some extra sumac laying around and it is important to note that sumac has a pungent puckery zip that it adds to the blend which turns it into something special. Once I added the sumac, it was much better. Sumac is a large part of Za'atar so to have it missing is significant.

HOW DO I USE THIS?
I use this on eggs, salads, in blends of vegetables, roasted eggplant, basmati rice dishes, dips, oil and bread, and steamed veggies. So far that is what we have used it with. The herb in this is very good quality intensity, but without the sumac, I would not like it. With the sumac that I added, it is much better. It takes quite a bit of sumac to balance the intensity of the herb.

THE BOTTOM LINE
I am very disappointed in this jar of Za'tar. I am thankful that I happened to have some good quality sumac in my spice shelf that I could blend with part of the jar. Without the sumac, it is too much. With added sumac, it is really nice.

MY RATING
My rating is two parts:
Quality of the herb/sesame in the jar 5
Quality of the blend minus the sumac 0.

So, my overall rating is 2 stars. Should this have been an oversight on the part of the company, and they start making it with sumac again, then consider trying it. As it is now, I just can not recommend it unless you REALLY like the flavor of thyme/greek oregano blends and sesame seeds.

title: I Am In AWE Of This Tea- Let Me Tell You Why (PAIN)
text:
I have been having a really hard time lately with severe nerve pain. Some days are worse than others, but today and yesterday have been pretty hard to cope with. Today, I tried everything I could think of and nothing was helping more than a few moments. I decided to sit and have a cup of tea with my husband who is on break from jobs today.

WHAT IS THIS TEA LIKE?
This tea comes in a woven paper bag. The tea is VERY finely cut. It does not smell too wonderful in the bag, and each bag is carefully wrapped in a foil wrapper to keep it fresh.

HOW DID WE MAKE IT?
I used this tea in a Ninja Coffee/Tea machine. I opened 3 bags and made a half a carafe of tea which is about 3 large mugs full of tea.

HOW WAS THE TEA?
OMG The fragrance of this tea is AMAZING. It really comes to life when brewed. I brewed this at the herbal temperature which would be full boil temperature of around 210 to 212. The taste was spectacular. The fruity flavor was very pronounced but natural tasting. The Holy Basil/Tulsi herb has a peppery taste to it which compliments the peach/mango flavor perfectly.

HOW DID I SWEETEN IT?
We used honey to sweeten the tea which brought out the fruit flavor perfectly.

WHY AM I IN AWE OF THIS TEA?
Let me tell you- when I had a cup of this tea, halfway through the mug, I noticed I was experiencing a cut in pain of about half. By the time 15 minutes had gone by, I had been experiencing greatly reduced pain. It was so helpful that I found myself able to go into the garden, dig up some dirt, plant tomatoes, and even pull up old cages which would have been impossible earlier.

This pain free feeling lasted for HOURS. I think it worked perfectly in tandem with the migraine tablet I took (OTC) and gave me an afternoon of bliss.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This tea not only tastes good, but it really seems to help with stress and reduced pain for me on a very difficult day. I would buy this again and will have it in the house from now on.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS! I am so happy to have this around. It really did take the edge off. God knows I could use that on days like I have had of late. Hopefully it will continue to help over time.

title: Took Our Gluten Free Biscotti from Good to WOW (Along With Cassava Flour)
text:
We have been making our own gluten free biscotti for a few months now because it is impossible to find biscotti that is gluten free and does not have sugar cane or corn derived sugar in them. They were kind of dry and crumbly no matter what we did. Then we added a bit of cassava flour and this xanathan gum. It changed EVERYTHING. These biscotti are also good for using for paleo diet too which is a plus.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This comes in a package which has almost two cups in it- not quite. Since it is only used a teaspoon at a time per cup of flour, this will last a while. The powder is white and the package is re-sealable.

HOW DID WE USE THIS?
We made our own biscotti recipe by merging some biscotti recipes and then incorporating King Arthur Gluten Free Baking Mix (no rising agent) into it instead of flour, and making part of the substitution almond flour too. They were just a bit too crumbly although good.

WHAT CHANGES DID WE MAKE?
We added a cup of cassava flour and 2 teaspoons of this xanathan gum to the recipe and although at first the dough seemed REALLY sticky and almost gooey, it is amazing how the biscotti turned out. PERFECT. The consistency is absolutely perfect. They are dry, yet stay together and are lightweight as well.

THE BOTTOM LINE
For our biscotti recipe this has been a complete game changer. It took away the crumbly nature of the biscotti and turned it into a more typical texture of biscotti, keeping it tender enough to chew, but dry enough to dunk WITHOUT FALLING APART!

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. This will stay in our cupboard from now on. We might reduce the cassava flour, but this xanathan gum is going to stay about the same. It is fabulous for gluten free diet or paleo recipes.

title: FABULOUS Addition To Gluten Free Biscotti
text:
We have to have gluten free in our home. We also need to have sugar free, but we can use honey or maple syrup. Trying to make biscotti has been a challenge. Until now. Let's take a look.

WHAT DID WE NEED THIS FOR?
We needed this to add to a biscotti recipe where we substituted King Arthur Gluten Free Baking Mix (you can get it from BJs or probably even on Amazon) for regular flour along with a little bit of almond flour. We use toasted almonds in the biscotti too and honey as the very slight sweetener. The problem is that the biscotti fell apart and crumbled no matter what we did to try to alter ingredients. Then we added this..

WHAT DID THIS DO?
We added 1 cup of cassava flour to our recipe and along with 2t of xanathan gum, the biscotti went from good but crumbly to WOW- PERFECT!

HOW IS THIS PACKAGED?
This comes in a plastic re-sealable bag. There is enough for at least 6 loads of biscotti,, as I plan to use about 3/4 c or even as little as 1/2 of a cup the next time.

THE BOTTOM LINE
When added to the gluten free baking mix by King Arthur Flour along with xanathan gum, our biscotti went from good but very crumbly to PERFECT.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS FOR THIS STUFF! Having it has really improved our gluten free baking so far. I would buy this again for sure. It is worth it.

title: This Is One Of My Favorite Drinks
text:
In the afternoon I like to have a quick pick me up. Sometimes it is barley green juice, sometimes it is magnesium, and sometimes it is this drink. Let's take a look.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This comes in little envelopes. The product is a powder that easily empties into a tiny blender that I bring with me when I want to have it handy. It is cordless. This powder makes a great mermaid blue/green color.

HOW DOES IT TASTE?
I love the flavor of this. To me it is like having a lemonade almost in the middle of the day. It is not sickening sweet, but refreshing.

DO I FEEL ANY DIFFERENT?
Honestly, I don't feel much different, but it does not give me any problems and I find it refreshing.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This is a great packet to bring with me when I need to go out for the day, or if I need a boost in the day at times. I prefer it in a cordless little mini blender, but it does stir well too.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I would buy this again. It is nice to have around and the color- it is just plain fun to have. I don't tend to like spirulina alone that much so this is a feat to make me LIKE it in a drink this simple.

title: Great Powder We Developed Blue Moon Smoothie (recipe included)
text:
When our son was very young, I first got a small bag of blue spirulina and green spirullina to experiment with. We used to have a variety of blue drinks. It has been a while and when I saw the opportunity to get some more, I jumped at it. Let's see how it worked out.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This powder is a beautiful bright blue powder, a cross between cyan and bright denim. It is ground very fine and it comes in a black plastic jar, but the powder is also in a foil bag inside the jar. The idea is to open the corner and roll it back down when not in use and keep it in the jar to keep it from contamination.

IS THERE A TASTE?
There is a bit of a sweet taste to this when used with fruit. It does not have the bitter edge associated with green spirulina.

HOW DID WE USE IT?
We used this by making what I named a BLUE MOON SMOOTHIE

Blue Moon Smoothie
4 frozen bananas broken in pieces
16 oz of coconut water
8 ox mango juice concentrate (or 1 c frozen or fresh mango)
1 c unsweetened almond milk
1/2 tsp blue spirulina

Put all of this in a VITAMIX. If you have only a blender, then cut recipe in half.
Process on high for about a minute or so. Drink. Serves 3 very large glasses for
3 people or 4 smaller glasses.

HOW DOES IT TASTE?
This tasted fabulous. The family really loved it. The combination of all of the ingredients seemed to showcase the sweet factor of the blue spirulina.

THE BOTTOM LINE
I have only used this for smoothies because we love it so much, but this powder is great to have on hand. It is expensive, so it is an investment, but it is a fabulous treat to have on hand. We all loved the color and the taste in the smoothie.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I am so happy to have this again! I wanted to take a photo to show you, but we drank it up so fast, I forgot until it was gone today. To make it thicker, less liquids should be used.

title: My Family Went NUTS Over This Blend - and NO SUGAR ADDED!
text:
Do you know how hard it is to find a BBQ blend with no sugar added? Well, I suppose you would only know that if you did not want sugar in it. Anyway, when I found this, I did not expect much. When we actually used it..

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This comes in a foil bag that is resealable. It has spices mixed in it and no sugar added. the powder is brick red color and the smell is heavenly.

HOW DID WE USE IT?
We used this for a rub. We had chicken legs and rubbed the spice on the legs and let them sit for a bit and then put them in the smoker we have.

HOW DID IT PERFORM?
The entire family went nuts over this blend. The taste was fabulous. It is the perfect balance of flavor and spice. It is not too hot and not too spicy, yet it is loaded with flavor too. We don't mind heat or spice, but I wanted to point that out for anyone who does.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This spice blend is fabulous if you love BBQ but you can not have sugar or don't want it. It makes a great rub, and also would be fabulous in a marinade or sauce too. It makes great seasoning for popcorn or potato chips too.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. This is a winner and I would buy it again for sure. The whole family feels that way and that is not always the case in my house. We all don't always agree on things like this.

title: Delicious Twist on Pepper- Much Better Than Just Black
text:
We have a pepper grinder. Sometimes just black pepper gets a bit boring so I decided to try this one.

WHAT IS THIS :LIKE
This pepper mix has a variety of different colors of peppercorns. That means that there are nuances in flavor of the pepper.

HOW DOES THIS GRIND UP?
This grinds up very well. It comes out in nice pieces with a variety of flavor

HOW DOES IT TASTE?
This is WAY nicer than just black pepper. We all loved it. It really wakes up food.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This is a fabulous blend of peppercorns. It provides a variety of flavors and colors to food. It grinds well and tastes great.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I would buy this again. It is a perfect change from just black pepper. I love it.

title: Absolutely Delicious Especially With Thai or Mexican Cooking
text:
We are foodies at our house. We love to have international foods and unusual healthy eating. Let's take a look at this oil.

WHAT IS THIS OIL LIKE?
This oil comes in a tall skinny bottle with a small footprint which is great for not taking up storage space. It has a controlled pouring insert in it so that when you pour, it does not come flying out all over your food. The scent is delightfully LIME but not fake that makes you want to run.

HOW DO WE USE IT?
This oil is spectacular on a variety of things. We have used it on:
-steamed vegetables
-mashed potatoes
-thai stir fry
-mexican style shephards pie (uses sweet potatoes instead of white and mexican spices in veggies)
-salad dressing

HOW DOES IT TASTE?
This stuff tastes great, especially if you are out of fresh limes and want to dress up some food. A little goes a long way so you can probably even mix this half and half if the lime is a bit overpowering to you. To us it is perfect.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This oil ROCKS. It has a great lime flavor which dresses up all sorts of our favorite foods and salads.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I would buy this again for sure. It is great to have in the house, especially in winter when fresh is at a premium.

title: A Perfect Way To Introduce Elderflowers To Winter Diet
text:
Elderflowers are a great way to build immunity especially for the lungs. Having it available for winter is perfect. Let's take a look.

WHAT IS THIS TEA LIKE?
This tea comes in a great tin that seals pretty well. Inside the tin are a couple of foil bags also sealed. You only have to open one at a time and they have loose tea inside.

INGREDIENTS?
There are just elderflowers in this tea. Nothing else.

FLAVOR?
The flavor of this is a fragile flower flavor with a bit of a sweet hay type flavor to it. I actually can drink this without honey which is not usual for me. It is a nice fresh taste and it is delicious.

OTHER USES
I plan to make an elderflower cordial which is a bit more intense of a process. The flowers are cooked in water and then sweetened with honey to make a good syrup to put into drinks, or gentle flavored cakes and desserts. I plan to use it for mineral water.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This tea comes sealed well for freshness, and tastes delicious as a tea. I use it in the winter and it is handy to have in such a fresh container. I can not wait to try it for cordial too.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I like this and will use it through the entire winter

title: My Husband Who Doesn't Normally Reach For Matcha Liked This
text:
I love matcha tea. I have my own little tiny hand blender that uses batteries (I can not take the traditional one to coffee shops or on the go) and I make matcha when I need a boost and zen out at the same time. My husband, on the other hand, is more of the coffee guy. I tested this on him. Let's see what happened.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This matcha comes in little foil envelopes. The idea is that you use one in a cup of water to drink, or smoothies. Although I would not use ceremonial matcha for smoothies- it seems somehow almost sacrilegious if I might use that word loosely.

HOW DOES THIS LOOK COLORWISE?
This when made up has a deep green color. It is not the brightest green matcha I have had, but it is pretty good color.

HOW DOES THIS WHIP UP?
This whips up very well with a nice foam on it.

HOW MUCH IS IN A PACKET?
There is about a full teaspoon in the packet.

HOW MUCH WATER?
We used this by mixing the matcha in a small bit of 175 F water and then once blended and foamy added the remainder of water to fill a 10 oz cup.

WAS IT BITTER?
This was not bitter, but had a nice vegetal flavor to it.

WAS THIS CREAMY?
This was definitely on the creamy side.

CAN YOU USE LESS?
If you don't mind rolling down the packet, I personally will only use HALF of a packet for me as I need to be careful with the caffeine in matcha. I bring a little tiny plastic zipper top bag to put the rolled packet in when I am using a half measure. I prefer it that way. My husband liked it richer.

WHERE TO KEEP THIS?
I always keep my matcha powder in the refrigerator until I am ready to use it. I find that it stays fresh longer.

HOW TO USE?
Although they say you can use this hot or cold and in smoothies, ceremonial matcha I find is best enjoyed as it is tradtionally fixed- in hot water about 175F and whisked in well. This one will do well in the other applications, but I just prefer it traditionally. Perhaps this summer I will have a different opinion on that. If so I will try to remember to update.

DID MY HUSBAND LIKE IT?
Despite him being more of a coffee guy, he really did like this. He said that it was rich, but he liked the boost he got from it and he would drink it again (shortly after asking for a cup of coffee this morning HAHA).

THE BOTTOM LINE
A decent quality ceremonial matcha, this is not bitter, has a pretty decent flavor and the color is good (but still not the brilliant bright green I am used to with Encha brand, but it is still good.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS, although I will say that if I have Encha in packets I would reach for that first, but this one is a decent choice as well. It is pretty good.

title: I REALLY Needed This This Winter- Tastes Surprisingly Good Too
text:
I have a high need for greens. My body is designed so that I do best with a lot of greens and other fresh produce over any other cooked or protein foods. I have had a difficult winter with quick ways to get my greens due to things out of my control, so when I found this powder, I was very excited.

WHAT IS THIS POWDER LIKE?
This powder is a bright green powder. It smells like greens. It comes in a foil lined zip pouch with paper on the outside.

HOW MUCH DO YOU TAKE?
The recommended dose of this is 1/8 of a cup of powder and I use it in 8 oz or so of water in a cordless small blender. That leaves me with a very smooth green drink with great foam on top.

HOW DOES IT TASTE?
Surprisingly, this powder is well balanced in flavor. It does not have too much of the bitter green taste, and it is well balanced with fresh flavors that make it feel like a treat to drink it instead of a chore.

DOES IT MAKE A DIFFERENCE?
I have to say that this stuff really does make a difference. I get a burst of energy, it lifts the winter doldrums and blah feeling and helps me build up energy again as I wait for spring.

THE BOTTOM LINE
When it comes to helping me through winter, greens are essential. Sometimes it is hard to find greens in the store, or circumstances prevent me from getting to the store. This powder is fabulous to have on hand. It makes it easy to get greens in my diet and helps me through the rough months of winter. I love the flavor too!

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I will buy this again no doubt. This stuff is one of the best green powders I have had and I will try to keep it on hand especially in the winter or while waiting for greens to grow in the garden.

title: This is DELIGHTFUL To Have On Hand When I Want To Have Unusual Tea
text:
The first time I discovered Butterfly Pea Flower Tea, I was thrilled beyond words to find a tea that was actually blue purple! It is GORGEOUS. When I found out that there was a powder available, of course, I had to get it. Let's take a look.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
Because of the nature of this powder, it comes in a metallic bag which is housed inside the plastic jar. I just cut the edge off a corner so I can keep it fresh as long as possible.

HOW TO MAKE IT
I know that it says you can bake with it and put it in smoothies, but honestly, I just love to sit down and have a hot cup of steaming purple blue tea. I simply take a teaspoon of this powder, heat the water to about 200 degrees F and then I fill the cup only partially full.

I bring out my matcha hand whip and I whip the powder well in the glass. Once it is foamy, I pour the rest of the cup full of the hot water.

WHAT KIND OF CUPS?
I have these gorgeous clear tea cups which are completely housed in gold metal with enamel work on it. They have a matching spoon. This tea fills the cup with the most beautiful denim blue liquid that makes the gold and enamelwork stand out.

HOW DOES IT TASTE?
If you have never had it, this tea is not sweet at all. I think it reminds me of vegetable bouillon. It is good enough to put a bit of honey in it, but I tend to like it without anything in it.

FUN TRICK
I think if you put a drop of lemon in the tea, it will turn purple.

THE BOTTOM LINE
Although you might prefer to use this in smoothies or baking, I prefer to drink this powder. It has no caffeine in it and it is easy to mix with a whisk matcha style.

MY RATING
I love this powder. It is a FIVE STAR rating from me. I am considering trying my hand at blue tea ice cream the way that green tea ice cream is made.

title: We Had To Fight Our Cat For This
text:
I was not too keen about having to get my tuna fish in a plastic container, but I was willing to give it a try. After all, it is very difficult to get tuna fish with only water and sea salt. Let's see what happened.

HOW IS THIS PACKED?
This comes in a plastic container with a lid. The inside is sealed with another plastic seal. Inside is tuna fish.

HOW DOES IT TASTE?
Surprisingly, this tastes fabulous. It is perfect. The quality was great and the taste of the tuna came through perfectly. There was not too much salt and the flavor was strong too, but in a good way.

DID WE LIKE IT?
I shared this with the family but just as I was offering bites, our cat popped up and did a swan dive to get one of the bites. She went NUTS with this tuna. She wanted to eat it all, but I managed to get us all a taste and everyone liked it very much.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This tuna is great. No additives and just water and sea salt make this a perfect choice for my family. Even the cat went nuts for it. When we gave her the container with the remains in it after she dive bombed for a spoonful,, she licked it for an hour.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I would consider buying this again. It was very good.

title: HOT But Tolerable If You Like Hot Sauce
text:
It is getting difficult to find hot sauces that are good but don't have sugar in them. We were thrilled to find this one. Let's take a look.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This hot sauce is not just ghost pepper, but it has habanero and cayenne in it too. The blend is mashed and then combined with vinegar, lime, and butter flavor with a touch of onion. It comes in a large squeeze top container.

HOW DOES IT TASTE?
Some ghost pepper stuff is so hot that if you smell it you sear your nose and lungs. This is not like that. Yes, it is hot, but the FLAVOR of the peppers comes through. THAT we love. We grow all of these peppers, so I know how hot they can be. The blend in this bottle, anyway, is well balanced. You can put it in things to give it a boost, or use it alone, just a tiny bit unless you are really into hot.

HOW DOES IT WORK ON FOOD?
My husband got a really bad sort throat and cold and he started using this daily. He swears it helped his throat. It tastes really good and has a creamy consistency to it. We all seem to like it.

THE BOTTOM LINE
One of the best ghost pepper sauces we have had, this one is HOT but the flavors shine through. Just use it sparingly unless you have a mouth made of iron.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I love that this does not have sugar in it. I love that the flavor still comes through despite the heat. This is a winner!

title: A Bit Too Burned Tasting For Us, But Works For That Type of Taste
text:
We tend to like Espresso with a lot of nuances or flavor. Some people like it with a heavy duty burned taste. Let's take a look.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This Espresso fits in the Nespresso machine. NOT THE K CUPS LIKE A KEURIG. I had someone tell me that they tried to use these in a Keurig so I thought I would point that out. They come in several boxes so they are easy to bring to work or keep near the machine.

HOW DO THESE PERFORM?
Although this makes espresso okay, the taste just isn't like we like espresso. It tastes a bit too dark- very dark- almost burned tasting. No one in the family is very fond of this- not even those who don't mind dark roast. For anyone who loves very dark roasts, this would probably be fine.

THE BOTTOM LINE
Although this flavor was a bit too burned for anyone in our family to like, if you happen to love very dark roast, you will probably like this. It works in the Nespresso machine if you have one. Also, if you happen to have a Keurig cup that allows you to make your own coffee, you can open and empty these into that as well.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS. It works, it just isn't a favorite taste of ours. A bit too dark.

title: Made Both With Boiling Water or Microwave For Testing
text:
We have a family who is very interested in trying out healthy foods, especially those that would appeal to younger kids. Let's see how these worked out.

WHAT ARE THESE LIKE?
These come with noodles, some powder in a cup, a packet of powdered sauce, and then a peel back top that you use to put them in the microwave to cover the container while it cooks.

BY USING BOILING WATER
For those who do not have a microwave, does this work with boiling water? Yes. We used boiling water, stirred the cup two times and let it sit for about six minutes. It did cook through just fine.

USING MICROWAVE
We used the microwave to fix this as well. It cooked just fine.

TASTE TEST
We have a variety of tasting results for this stuff. Half of those who tasted it thought it was "okay, but not greaT" and they have eaten very healthy most of the time.
