The one who did happen to like it was one of the kids who is not as apt to eat as healthy as the others. That the particular kid is about 7 years old. He tends to be VERY fussy and loved this. Go figure!

THE BOTTOM LINE
Although this was not a huge hit with everyone, all liked it okay enough and the fussiest was crazy about it. It worked out well with both boiling water as well as microwave, so if you don't want to use a microwave, you can still use these.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS. These were good. I did not mind them. The rest of the adults and kids I tried this on were okay with them, but the fussy kid- that was the surprise. He does not like much of anything! He LOVED these! If I were to serve these I would add a few tiny pieces of fresh green onion, shredded carrot (tiny shred), or thawed frozen green peas. Except the fussy kid- he likes them as they are.

title: Like A Bit Of India Came To My House!  I LOVED This
text:
We have eaten in authentic Indian restaurants and then also in restaurants which have been more toned down for the American palette. Good Indian food is not always easy to find in the US. Let's take a look at this freeze dried meal..

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This comes in a box which lists the ingredients- NO SUGAR! HOORAY!. And it has a foil packet inside which is sealed to protect the food inside which was freeze dried. We use a lot of freeze dried food, and it is important to keep the air and moisture from hitting it.

HOW TO PREPARE?
You can prepare this a variety of ways, but I chose to pour boiling water over top of it in a bowl- just covering the mixture. I mixed it up and let it sit COVERED with a plate. 5 minutes or so later..

WHAT DOES THIS TASTE LIKE?
..the food was ready. WOW. It was SO GOOD. The blend was PERFECT. It is very hot like so much of Indian food, but it was perfectly balanced. The texture was perfect and it was one of the most enjoyable packaged Indian meals I have had in a very long time. This was fantastic.

THE BOTTOM LINE
For an excellent quality Indian meal which is hot, but perfectly balanced with spice, this is top notch. It is freeze dried, so you have to give it some time to re-hydrate, but it is delicious - like a little bit of India coming to the house for a moment.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. This was fantastic. I would buy it again in a minute. Some packaged Indian meals taste bland or just don't sit right with me. This one was fabulous from start to finish and no problems with digestion either. I have raved about this one ever since eating it. It is really delicious. It tastes quite freshly made too which is hard to find in a package.

title: WOW- I Did Not Expect To LOVE This, But I DO! (Includes Soup Maker Recipe)
text:
When I ordered this, I was prepared to have the usual reaction I have to Campbells Soup- EWWWwww. I got it anyway, vowing to give it to someone that loves Campbell when it did not work out for me. Well, THAT ain't happening..

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This comes in a flat well wrapped with a cardboard base to it for easy storage and carrying. The cans are easy pop tops and it does come with a recipe idea. The soup itself is fantastic. It has a tomato twist to it with just enough spice to make it sort of reminiscent of Chipolte, but not overbearing at all.

HOW DOES IT PERFORM?
I made this in my Phillips Soup Maker using one can of the soup, another can of water to rinse it out,
Here is what I did:

GREEN PEA SOUP
1 can Campbells Sweet potato soup
1 can of water rinsing out residue into container
1 large onion chopped
1 lb bag of green peas quickly thawed under hot water
I also put in some cumin, smoked paprika, and a touch of lime

I turned on the creamy soup option and in 10 minutes we had the best green pea soup I have ever had. Even my fussy husband was marveling at how good it was. The soup was PERFECT in this.

THE BOTTOM LINE
For a sweet potato soup that is not boring, this is a great base to make a lot of soups out of. If you have a Phillips Soup maker, 1 can plus another of water will make the perfect bast for many different soups you can make in their cookbook. It will also perform well in regular soup making.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I LOVE THIS STUFF. I am so happy to have it. THAT was a total surprise as I tend to not like Campbells Soup. I am thinking of using this in a twist of New England Clam Chowder next..

title: BEST CAKE I EVER HAD
text:
I have had to change to the antifungal diet which is very similar to Keto or Paleo. What is hard at times is the lack of being able to eat cakes or whatever. I got a recipe from a keto baking book for cake and was able to use this almond flour for the cake. Let's see what happened.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This flour comes in a blue and white plastic resealable bag. It is creamy off white in color and has a faint scent.

HOW DOES THIS PERFORM?
I used a powerful mixer to mix this cake and what I got was the most wonderful light cake I have had in the keto/paleo/antifungal world. It also was delicious.

THE BOTTOM LINE
For excellent flour substutition to make cakes or other baked/cooked items this flour works well for me. I would buy it again.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I am ready to make another one of those amazing yellow cakes again. I baked it in cast iron and it was fantastic!

title: OMG! YOU HAVE NO IDEA HOW EXCITED THIS MAKES ME!
text:
I know, you are probably thinking- honey? Why would someone be THIS excited about honey? Well, let me tell you why..

WHY I WANT SOMETHING LIKE THIS
A long time ago, I was able to regain health after debilitating situation by completely eliminating all cane sugar and refined sugar from my diet. That means that honey, date, and maple syrup are all that I can have. When my husband and I go out to dinner, we like to have tea. When they don't have honey, it is awful- tea is enhanced by honey.

PACKAGING FOR HONEY
The problem is that even if they don't have honey at restaurants for their tea, bringing packets of honey has been a problem. They tend to be very thin plastic and are easily pierced so they leak. It is not pretty.

WHY IS THIS SPECIAL?
This honey is packaged in a very sturdy poke proof way that you have to tear the top off of it and it will even stand up on the table while you get ready to use it. There are 10 packets in a box so you have to be judicious on how you use it.

WHAT DO WE USE IT FOR?
Now when my husband and I go to our favorite restaurants, I can tuck a packet of honey in my purse and we can both split the package between us for having tea. It has really made us so happy. I am totally thrilled about this. While we are getting ready to use it, it stands upright and does not tip over. Again, BRILLIANT.

HOW DOES IT TASTE?
This honey has a great taste to it. It compliments the tea very well. We can also use it for any other things we might need it for- coffee, smoothies on the go, or any other thing that needs a touch of sweet.

THE BOTTOM LINE
If you are like us and really want to have honey but some restaurants just don't carry it, this stuff is worth having. We only use it when going out, but it makes a frustrating experience into a special one again.

MY RATING
FIVE HUGE STARS. I REALLY LOVE THIS STUFF! Having it has made going out to dinner a pleasure again. I don't have to try to figure out how to bring honey in my purse anymore!

title: The Night Of The NIGHTMARE Chicken
text:
I was so looking forward to using this spray. We LOVE grassfed ghee and to have this oil available was a treat. The experience, however, was a nightmare.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This comes in a metal container with a plastic sprayer on top. The nozzle is VERY find, which seems to be the opposite of what you would want with ghee, which tends to be thick or lumpy at minimum.

HOW DOES THIS WORK?
I was out of butter and was making a chicken which needed to be sprayed with ghee/oil prior to crisping it. I was under time pressure but figured I had plenty of spray, so no problem. Yeah, right.

I sprayed the first spray and it went everywhere, then the 2nd spray was a tiny stream and after that, nothing. Nothing at all. I pounded it, pushed it and was having a small fit in my kitchen.

I finally had to smash it over and over to get one last spray out of it which coated the chicken briefly and then supplement with coconut oil.

DID I GET IT TO WORK?
My husband and I worked on this thing and it is not going to spray ever again, I am afraid. It is awful because this is DELICIOUS stuff.

THE BOTTOM LINE
If the sprayer worked on this oil, it would be high stars. Because it was such a frustrating experience, forget it. This should have had a bigger spray nozzle.

MY RATING
ONE STAR. I can not even get the oil out to rate the oil more than the brief sprays I had from it. It has fantastic potential, but needs a new design.

title: These Things Are EVIL
text:
I have to be careful what I eat. I tend to be on a Paelo/Keto style eating program but for years I have had to go without the usual snacks that others take for granted. One of those things is cheese puffs.

WHAT ARE THESE LIKE?
I am not really supposed to have beans or lentils, but these seemed like a once in a great while treat. They come in bags which are sealed well. They are not hard to open, and they are what I like to call "lunch size". The puffs themselves are about the size of a large marble and they are airy and light just like cheese puffs. They are cheddar flavor.

HOW DO THESE TASTE?
At first, everyone is struck by the odd flavor of these. There is almost a bitter twist at the end, and you are not sure if you like them or not. Then you try another, and another and before you know it, half the bags in the stupid box are gone and you are groaning to yourself, "WHY did I open these stupid things?"

Okay, maybe I am weird and that it just MY scenario. My evaluation of these, however, is THEY ARE EVIL.

DOES ANYONE ELSE LIKE THEM?
So, after I was battle with where to hide the rest of these evil snacks, my daughter ( the one who eats a lot of things) came in and wanted to know when she could have a bag. I quickly pulled a bag out of the box and handed it to her. Before she could grab it, I opened it and handed her two puffs. Then I ran from the room, shut the door and ate the rest.

She told me that they were kind of weird tasting at first, so that is all I needed to hear to not give her more. By the time she was done chewing the two I gave her, she wanted more. I fed them to her through the crack in the door shutting it quickly so I could eat the rest like Gollum with "my precious"

By the time she had chewed these she was shouting, "HEY, I THOUGHT YOU WERE GOING TO GIVE ME A WHOLE BAG!"

I felt bad so I went out to the box and pulled a bag out. I handed it to her... before she could grab it, POOF- open and three more in her hand, back behind the closed door I went stroking the bag of "My Precious" as I ate more of them.

Yes, these are evil.

THE BOTTOM LINE
At first I was not sure I liked these, but as time went on, they worked their evil magic and I was eating them, like a LOT. They do not foster sharing and made me a very selfish person, wanting to keep them all to myself. What can I say? I was deprived of snacks like this for a long time..

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. If they can get my family THIS excited over BEANS then I suppose they deserve some sort of award, right?

title: This Makes A Nice Dusky Chili Flavor
text:
My family loves spices, so let's see what this is like:

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This comes in a large container that is easy to use either to shake out or spoon out. The powder itself is darker brown in appearance than other chili powders. It has a deep dusky chili smell which is different than other chili powders.

HOW DOES THIS PERFORM?
Believe it or not, this makes not only fantastic chili, mexican food, or other spicy things, but it also works to keep ants away! If you put this around the outside of a planter outside, or a pathway of ants, it will help deter them.

As food additive it is delicious. We always add a touch more smoke and lime to wake it up even more.

THE BOTTOM LINE
For a nice dusky chili powder that works well in food and even as ant repelling tool, this is a nice container to have on hand.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. This is a nice chili powder and I am glad to have it. I would consider purchasing this again.

title: Smells Great, A Bit Bitter In Flavor
text:
When it comes to tea, my family has a wide variety of tastes that we enjoy. We are careful to use the proper temperature for our teas and we are glad when we find a good one. Let's see what this one was like.

WHAT IS THIS TEA LIKE?
This tea comes in a great tin. There are two windows in the container. The top snaps down with a heavy duty metal closure and the tea is kept fresh nicely. The tea itself is a green tea with jasmine petals in it .

AROMA?
This has a nice jasmine aroma. There is a green tea aroma too.

FLAVOR?
When brewed at 175 as instructed, the tea is nice, but it has a bit of bitterness in it that I am not fond of. I have quite a few jasmine teas and when brewed at the proper temperature, they do not have this level of bitterness in them. The jasmine flavor is not very strong when brewed either.

THE BOTTOM LINE
When brewed as instructed, this nicely scented tea is not as smooth or flavorful as I would have liked. It has a twist of bitterness in it which makes it something I probably won't reach for very often. I prefer Harney Dragon Pearl Jasmine tea which I will most likely use regularly over this one.

MY RATING
THREE STARS. It is not horrible, it just isn't great either.

title: A Bit Sharp On The Vinegar, But Great Mustard-Love The Seed Chunks
text:
My family is filled with mustard fanatics. They will eat mustard on just about anything. I have even seen one of them make a mustard sandwich. I decided this was a good product for us to try out, so here we go..

WHAT IS THIS MUSTARD LIKE?
This mustard is a bit more liquid than other spicy brown mustard brands that we have used. It has the brown mustard seed particles in it which we all love- there are actual chunks of seeds in here, again which we all love. The flip top dispenser allows for good distribution of mustard for sandwiches- not too much or too little.

HOW IS THIS MUSTARD TO USE?
Well, the bag was barely opened, when the mustard vultures took over. They immediately ran to the mustard and took some. The consensus is this. Delicious, but a little strong with the white vinegar. They would prefer either less white vinegar or using apple cider vinegar instead. AFter tasting, I have to agree.

FLAVOR?
The flavor is a great full rounded flavor. If the vinegar was a touch less intense, it would be perfect.

THE BOTTOM LINE
For a great mustard with well rounded flavor that uses extra vinegar to cut through rich foods, this is a really nice mustard. It squeezes out easily and has chunks of mustard seed which really thrilled my family.

MY RATING
Four stars- more like four and a half- because of the vinegar being just a bit too strong with this mustard.

title: Great Olive Oil Taste We Like This Stuff
text:
We use olive oil constantly, so having nice quality oils around for us is a must. We use olive oil instead of butter most of the time, so we not only use it in cooking, but as a cold spread or dressing as well. Let's take a look at this oil.

WHAT IS THIS OIL LIKE?
As with most extra virgin olive oils, this oil has a very intense flavor with that wonderful little bite at the end sort of what we call an olive burn. It does not really burn like hot sauce, but it just has a burst of olive bite at the end which is delightful and bursts at the back of the throat. The bottle is my favorite size of bottle. It is tall has a small footprint and does not take up a ton of room on the counter.

HOW DOES THIS PERFORM?
This olive oil is wonderful. It has a fantastic burst of olive flavor that makes it perfect for dipping bread or vegetables in. It is also wonderful for salad dressing, and I especially love it on potatoes instead of sour cream and butter. A pinch of black pepper on top and this is really great on most vegetables too. We use this oil a lot.

HOW IS THIS OIL PACKAGED?
The packaging for this oil was well done. It is in a box that is solid and protects the bottles well. It also is a good box for gift giving.

THE BOTTOM LINE
For a great duo of extra virgin olive oil bottles this is a great addition to our household. It has fantastic flavor, nice olive bite, and works well in any application we use it for cold or hot.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. We like this stuff. It is a good solid performer. I especially love the bottle- it is the perfect size for our small counter space. Having it in two bottles means that one remains sealed while we use up the first one so it stays fresh longer.

title: From Keurig to Cold Brew (Yes, Cold Brew), This Is Great Coffee.  Let Me Explain
text:
Some people in my family are really into coffee. Others like it now and then, and then there are those who really are not that interested. Let's see how this coffee fared in my family.

WHAT IS THIS COFFEE LIKE?
This ORGANIC coffee comes in a case of boxes which have 12 pods each in them. They are designed for Keurig. They have the foil on the top and are the typical size of Keurig coffee. The coffee says medium roast, but we all agree it is more of a dark roast.

HOW DID WE PREPARE THIS COFFEE AND HOW DID IT TASTE?
KEURIG
We first tested this out in the Keurig. Amazingly, it was fast, dark, and everyone seemed to like it. That means EVERYONE. This includes those in the family who are not that fond of coffee and usually pass. I am talking in terms of flavor here and viscosity.

COLD BREW
Yes, I said cold brew. We have the Ninja Intelligent coffee maker. That means you can make it in any size container from mug to pitcher. You can make it hot or cold brew. In this case, it uses some warmth to extract, so it does work on the herbs.

We made it a number of ways. We peeled off the top, emptied the coffee into the metal mesh filter, and then we made both an XL mug, and then a small mug of cold brew. There was plenty of space left in the mug when it was done.

We boiled water in our temperature controlled tea kettle, and we put it at boiling 212F. When done, we poured the boiling water over the coffee in the mug making it plenty hot for the very cold days we made it on.

The flavor was good. The verdict of the family is that they preferred the cold brew over the Keurig as far as flavor and balance of herb and coffee. It was less bitter, and did balance the smoothness and coffee/herb experience.

BITTER AFTERTASTE?
We only drink organic coffee. I have problems with any other kind as I am very sensitive to chemicals. This coffee did not have the usual aftertaste of non-organic coffee. As far as the herb part goes, it was the least amount of distinctive herb taste of any of the brewed coffee/herb combos I have had. The aftertaste was minimal compared to most others.

WHAT ABOUT ENERGY?
My family is all pretty in tuned with their bodies. This particular coffee does seem to even out the energy flow when you have it. In other words, you don't get the race and then crash that you do with other coffees. Everyone seemed to agree that it did make for a more even flow of energy throughout the day/evening when they used it no matter HOW it was prepared.

WHAT IF YOU ARE SENSITIVE TO CAFFEINE?
If you are the type who is very sensitive to caffeine, I personally would tell you to move on to another type. This coffee might extend the caffeine rush into a more even energy flow, but the members of the family who are sensitive to the caffeine did feel a bit of a rush and heart pounding, so they are not having it anymore. The others seem unaffected in a negative way so far.

WHAT ABOUT RECYCLE?
If you are really into recycling, you can take the lid off, separate the cup from the filter from the top and put them in the correct places for recycle.

THE BOTTOM LINE
For a great cup of organic coffee that is on the dark side of roast, this is an interesting option. For those not sensitive to caffeine, this coffee seems to make a more even flow of energy after consuming. Those sensitive felt too much of a rush despite the herbs and are avoiding it. It made up well both in Keurig and in cold brew.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS for those who can handle caffeine and energy herbs. It is versatile and made up well in both ways, but we all prefer the cold brew if we are at home with it.

title: As Long As You Cook These Long Enough They Are Great Meaty Pasta
text:
We always love new types of pasta. Let's take a look at these..

WHAT ARE THESE LIKE?
This pasta is like thick pasta dough curled around like when you take a paper towel cardboard tube apart and uncurl it a bit. They are substantial in that they are not thin noodles.

HOW DO YOU PREPARE?
You cook these for 13 minutes in boiling water and strain them when done. We have had them with Puttanesca sauce, and we have had them with a butter, garlic lemon sauce with shrimp. Both of the dishes were really delicious. We all ate it up.

HOW DO THEY TURN OUT?
These are meaty noodles. They are the kind of pasta that you use when you want a filling meal. They really have a nice taste and make a great dish with sauce or casseroles since they hold up under baking too.

COUNTRY OF ORIGIN
Italy

THE BOTTOM LINE
For meaty noodles that hold up well to boiling or in casseroles, these noodles were a winner with our family.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS We would buy these again.

title: PERFECT For Travel For My Husband
text:
We only drink cold brew coffee. It is not as harsh on our systems, and for my husband to make the change due to health issues, he can not go back to hot brew- just does not like it. Recently he had to go on a business trip. Let's see how this coffee helped him out.

WHAT IS THIS COFFEE LIKE?
This coffee is cold brew concentrate. It is in little cups, but in our house, we don't have any coffee machines that would use pods, so we simply open up the top and pour it into a large mug hot water like you would get for hot tea.

HOW DID THIS COFFEE PERFORM?
This coffee was very impressive for my husband. Where he was staying had no access at all to cold brew. He could tuck the box of these in his carry bag and would use one for a large mug of very hot water to heat it up. He was so thrilled- said it was smooth, no trace of bitterness, and very flavorful. The pod was strong enough to put in a large mug and not taste too weak.

THE BOTTOM LINE
If you like to have cold brew coffee, but have to travel to an area where they don't have cold brew access, or work at a place where there is no access, this is a perfect way to take your coffee with you. It is smooth, not bitter, and well balanced.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. This really solved a difficult problem and we would gladly buy it again to have on hand.

title: If You Are Not Able To Have Grains But Can Have Quinoa/Brown Rice- GREAT STUFF
text:
Sometimes life gets so hectic that someone who lives a natural lifestyle has a hard time finding healthy foods to prepare in a hurry that is still healthy and meets dietary requirements for limited eating. This is a great thing to have in the food cupboard.

WHAT IS THIS FOOD PRODUCT LIKE?
This comes in packets. Each packet has already cooked quinoa, brown rice, and vegetables, all organic. There are 8.5 oz in each packet. You tear the top off and then either microwave it or cook it on top of the stove.

HOW DOES THIS PERFORM?
This stuff is great to have on hand. I don't particularly like it as it is, because it is a bit boring. I add a cup of frozen organic mixed vegetables and then a cup of water, and put it on top of the stove mixed in with two packs of this stuff and warm it up quickly. It only takes a few moments. Then I add some spices and herbs and BAM- good to go. My husband loves it and he tends to be picky.

THE BOTTOM LINE
For a quick way to have a gluten free meal that can also be friendly to an anti-fungal diet, this is a great emergency food to have on hand. It can be brought to work and prepared as well.

MY RATING
Five stars. I would definitely buy this in the future. It is a wonderful handy pack of food to have on hand. We like it a lot.

title: Do You Know What It's Like Getting A Man To Stay On Paleo?
text:
When my husband was afflicted with one of the most severe cases of eczema I have ever seen, I told him he had to go on anti-fungal eating program (similar to paleo). He was not amused. However, his body was in such horrible shape, we had to do something. Do you have any idea how hard it is to get a man to stay on PALEO type diet? Pancakes? Waffles? Toast? LEt's see how this mix helped.

WHAT IS THIS MIX LIKE?
This mix has an interesting mix of ingredients. It is a rather small bag. The combination of cauliflower, almond flour, cassava, arrowroot, tapioca, and psyllium makes for a nutritional powerhouse as well as an interesting texture.

There is a zip pull opening so that you can reseal when it is opened. The smell is rather odd for those who are used to having traditional baking mixes. It is even further away from whole grain mixes if you are used to using those. You can smell the cauliflower but I was determined to test this, so I pushed through. There is enough for about three decent sized batches of pancakes, waffles, or biscuits.

HOW DOES THIS MIX PERFORM?
This mix performs surprisingly well. My husband thinks he will eat anything, but in reality he is a very picky eater. There is always something he does not like about most anything paleo/anti-fungal. When I made this mix into pancakes, I used a recipe on the web site from the company (listed on the package) and I put in a little bit of cooked pumpkin we had left.

The pancakes were a bit moist on the inside, but that was due to the addition of pumpkin which the recipe did not call for. Without the pumpkin, these made surprisingly good pancakes. The recipe needed a bit more liquid, however and I changed the recipe to be a little more liquid in makeup.

DID MY HUSBAND LIKE THEM?
I braced myself for the barrage of complaints. Surely he would hate these, as he was not fond of my soup from the previous night. To my utter shock, his comment was, "This is really good. I like these" Wow. He was all set to think it was our usual baking mix we made using tapioca flour, and I let him talk for a while.

Then I blurted out, "This is cauliflower". His face was a quick study of expressions- revulsion, curiosity, wonder, and then a smile. "Well, this is really good"

We put maple syrup on them.

I plan to use this baking mix one more time on Thanksgiving so we can have some biscuits. I will update with any new results if it adds to the review in the future.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This mix is for those who really miss baking mixes, but can not have grains for whatever reason. As pancakes, they were perfect with or without pumpkin added and served with pure maple syrup. I have to say we were pleasantly surprised.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. If this can make my husband like it, I am all for it. I think we will be buying this again.

IN CASE YOU WERE CURIOUS ABOUT THE ECZEMA
Just to let you know, I took the worst case of eczema I have ever seen and by getting my husband to go with the anti-fungal (similar to paleo) diet and using essential oils and homemade lotions and serums, we saw the eczema go away leaving only two tiny patches on his back when he is stressed. The rest of his body is normal as long as he eats this way. It took about six to eight months but it did work and he has been free for a couple of years now.

title: If You Don't Mind The Enhancement This Is Great London Fog Tea
text:
We love to use frothy milk in our house. We regularly go the latte route with coffee and it is a lot of fun. We also love tea. However, we did not know what London Fog was until we got this tea. Let's take a look at how you can enjoy foamed milk with your tea in a new way..

WHAT IS THIS TEA LIKE?
This tea comes in sachets (not bags so there is more brewing space). It is in a plastic case which snaps shut keeping all of the flavor/scent inside. The smell is luscious. When you open it, there is the earl grey factor, but then there is a caramel vanilla accent that blends beautifully with the lavender in the tea.

HOW DID WE MAKE THIS?
I added three bags to a pot of tea. That made it perfect. We then used our milk frother and whipped up some almond milk (at the time of this post Aldi has some amazing organic almond milk that whips up like shaving cream). We put the tea in the cup and then added the foamed milk on top with honey to sweeten.

HOW DID WE ENJOY IT?
The tea brewed up perfectly. We brewed it at about 190 degrees, not doing it at boiling. That seemed to work best for this tea. The taste was delightful.

THE BOTTOM LINE
For an unusual treat that truly does have a caramel vanilla twist to the lavender laced earl grey style, this tea is great fun to have around. We love to do it in the same manner of the lattes we have with organic coffee sometimes. It is delicious and even the kids like it.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS although the vanilla flavor does taste a bit too unnatural despite them saying it is natural flavor. We have had other london fog style teas and this one has the extra boost of caramel vanilla that does not seem quite as pure, but it is still really good and I am not taking off any stars for it.

title: Absolutely FANTASTIC Beef Jerky  I Can Rarely Eat Jerky
text:
I was not sure what to expect when I ordered this beef jerky, but figured I would let everyone else eat it if I couldn't. I was pleasantly surprised.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This jerky comes in a sealed bag. It has a moisture absorber inside the bag. There is a zip closure on the bag too. The beef is very thinly shaved, and is quite tender.

HOW DOES THIS TASTE?
The flavor of this is fantastic. I have to say I love this stuff. It is delicious. No sugar either- WOW! I can actually chew it too without any problems. My family member with TMJ can even chew it. The flavor is a bit of spice kick but not overly salty or chemically at all. GREAT stuff. If you like black pepper, it is that kind of kick, not really hot peppers.

THE BOTTOM LINE
For a great beef jerky that you can chew without stress on the body and no sugar, this stuff is a great treat. I almost never get the chance to eat jerky. This has changed all of that.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I am really happy to have found this. Makes great presents for Christmas too.

title: I Think My Family Is Addicted To This
text:
When I ordered this, I was not sure what to expect. As someone who does not have sugar cane or corn derived sweeteners in the home, it is difficult to find a good premade product that fits in our household. This is a winner! Let's see what this is like.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This mayonnaise is fabulous. It is made primarily of Avocado oil with the twist of smoky zip from chipolte and lime. It is just sweet enough with the coconut sugar to make it taste good, but not overwhelm. It is not sweet by any means. It comes in a plastic jar with a wide mouth.

HOW DOES THIS PERFORM/TASTE?
This stuff is delicious. We have had it on burgers, hot dogs, salads, and even air fried shrimp as a dip! It is just enough zip to be good but not HOT or overwhelming.

ADDICTING
This is perfectly balanced. My family is RAVING about this stuff all of the time. The avocado oil is wonderful- not just the usual oils they use for stuff like this.

ANY COMPLAINTS?
One complaint- white vinegar is too harsh. I would prefer apple cider vinegar- it would be even better.

THE BOTTOM LINE
For a great paleo friendly mayonnaise that is health oriented WITHOUT REFINED SUGAR, this is an excellent condiment. It can be used for dressing, sandwiches, and even dips. We LOVE this stuff.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS Great stuff. Whole family is addicted to this! Big change from the rolling of eyes I was met with when I first showed it to them.

title: I LOVE THESE THINGS!  Great for Diets
text:
When it comes to stress, I like to have things to chew on that won't break my teeth and are not sweet or fattening. These olives are just what I was looking for!

WHAT ARE THESE OLIVES LIKE?
These olives come in a set of packages that have four cups in each package- total of 24 in a box. They are covered with a foil that you peel back and inside the cup is a small handful of green olives without any liquid in the cup. That means you can eat them almost anywhere and not worry about spilling. The cup and foil top are easy enough to dispose of when done as well.

WHAT DO THESE TASTE LIKE?
These olives are delicious. They are the perfect balance of flavors- not too salty or vinegary, but just right. They do not have that chemical type taste that some brands of green olives can have.

HOW ARE THESE TO EAT?
I have to say when I am stressed, I pull out a pack of these and munch away. I really really enjoy these and have hidden them from the rest of the family who were more than glad to consume them too. They are great to tuck in my bag on the way out, if I am going on a trip and we took them on our anniversary weekend. They were great to have on hand.

THE BOTTOM LINE
For a snack that won't pack the pounds on or break your teeth, these are fantastic. Just enough in one package to munch on, I plan to buy these again and have them on hand. I have loved having these around.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS! I LOVE these things.

title: Olives Rarely Get Gobbled Up :Like These Have - Fantastic Olives and Garlic is Perfect
text:
Rarely does my entire family go berserk over a food product. We all have different tastes and preferences. This pack, however, was exceptional and a huge hit at our house.

WHAT IS THIS PRODUCT LIKE?
First of all, this pack of six arrived smashed. I was upset at first until I discovered that only one of the jars was completely broken making it look like all of them. We still had five jars left. These olives are very large green olives. They are in simple green olive brine and each has a huge chunk of garlic in it.

HOW DOES THIS TASTE?
These olives did not last in our house. They have a fabulous garlic taste to them, yet it is not overwhelming like some garlic is. They seemed to have picked the garlic with the olive which makes for a more mellow garlic flavor.

JARS
These jars are glass. They have quite a few olives in them, however, so you can make them last.

WHAT DID WE USE THEM FOR?
We mostly ate them as snacks, but we did chop them for mashed potatoes, salad, and gazpacho.

FINAL NOTE
Olives in my family tend to last in the jar for quite a while. People will have them once in a while, but not that often. These jars were blown through in only a few weeks. Not bad for five jars. We have one left. I am guarding it carefully. MINE! MINE!

THE BOTTOM LINE
For a great olive that is big for snacks, martinis, and even chopped in a variety of egg salad, veggies, or mashed potatoes, these are really fantastic to have in the house- if you can keep them there. If you or anyone in your family likes garlic, these will probably not last long in your house. They sure were popular in ours.

MY RATING
Five stars, although having them arrived with a severely smashed jar was upsetting, it has nothing to do with the rating of the product.

title: If Not For the Corn Syrup, It Would Be Perfect - Extra Strong Vanilla Flavor
text:
Since we have made many of our own things in my house, I am aware of how they are put together. I rarely like store bought vanilla having made our own for years, but thought I would check this out. We do not like sugar in vanilla, but if I remember correctly, I believe it can only be called vanilla if it has sugar of some sort in it. We prefer ours without it.
Let's see how this measured up..

WHAT IS THIS VANILLA LIKE?
There are different types of vanilla beans. Madagascar is a fuller more intense fragrant version of vanilla which is what this is. It takes quite a few vanilla beans to get this level of vanilla flavor. The makers of this vanilla really did not skimp on the vanilla beans. It is strong, fragrant, and almost as good as our homemade vanilla which we make VERY strong. I would say it is the closest thing commercially to what we make at home.

HOW DOES IT PERFORM IN RECIPES?
This is great vanilla. You don't need a ton to get that flavor. It is well worth having.

THE BOTTOM LINE
For intense vanilla flavor, this is nearly as good as homemade extra strong that we make. It is great to use fresh or in baking.

MY RATING
Five stars. If it did not have corn syrup in it, it would be perfect.

title: Aspartame and Kool Aid Type Flavor and Smell Made This A Thumbs Down For The Entire Family
text:
When I opted to try this out, I could not find a list of ingredients anywhere. I just knew that it did not contain sugar so I was willing to try it out. Our family loves flavored waters, so it was worth a try.

WHAT IS THIS STUFF LIKE?
This stuff comes in a little box, Inside the box are narrow sealed packets which fit into a purse or pocket pretty easily. The idea is that you put a packet into a bottle or glass of water and "VOILA" You have flavored water.

WHAT DOES IT SMELL LIKE?
This smells like Kool Aid - the unsweetened kind that people dye wool with.

MY FAMILY HATES IT
When I suggested that my family try this, they all looked at me and asked if I was crazy. We all severely dislike aspartame. I never would have gotten this if I had known it had aspartame in it. The flavor is awful. Not one person in the family was even interested to drink it. They all refused.

THE BOTTOM LINE
If you are averted to aspartame, walk on by. The flavor/smell is like that of unsweetened Kool-Aid in the raspberry lemonade flavor. It is handy to carry, but if you get sick or hate it, it does not matter. No one in my family liked it and we all give this a big thumbs down.

MY RATING
1 star. This is awful stuff.

title: My Family ABSOLUTELY LOVES THESE!  They Accomplished The "Impossible"
text:
Because I tend to follow a paleo style diet much of the time, having this snack around was very interesting to me. Let's see how these measure up.

WHAT ARE THESE LIKE?
This set of nut packs are really cool. There are 24 packets which are foil lined. They are sealed well. The idea is that you open them up on the go and eat them, both for kids and adults who like a small snack during the day. They fit in the pocket, purse, and are easy to take with you. The packets stay sealed well too.

WHAT IS INSIDE?
Inside each pack there is an assortment of nuts:
Dry Roasted cashews
Dry Roasted Almonds
Macadamia
Pistachios
Cranberries (sweetened with liquid cane sugar and coated with sunflower oil)
Rasins (coated with sunflower oil)

FRESHNESS
The contents is very very fresh. I am quite impressed.

WHAT IMPRESSES ME MOST
What impresses me most is that whoever made this up was SMART. Each packet (we have opened quite a few)
has almost exactly the same contents. Sometimes with mixed nuts, you are lucky to see one kind of nut in packets
or sometimes you see so much of one, you wonder if you will ever get a good mix.

That is not the case with these nuts. There is one macadamia in each packet. There is a perfect balance of nuts and fruit
EACH AND EVERY TIME.

That in itself gets this FIVE STARS

TWO DRAWBACKS (NOT DEALBREAKERS)
Two drawbacks of these packets don't deter me from buying them.
1. The packets can be tough to open, so you might have to give help to kids or get shears for yourself
2. I wish they did not have cane sugar sweetened cranberries in here- fruit juice or other means would be perfect.

THE BOTTOM LINE
Despite the difficulty opening some packets, and the cane sugar in the cranberries, I love these. The packets are PERFECTLY balanced in content and the product is very FRESH. I would buy these again no question!

MY RATING
FIVE STARS My whole family loves these. Great for travel too and kids.

title: Nice Fruity Blend Flavor, Not Overwhelming Rooibos But Prefer They NOT Add Sugar To It
text:
When it comes to tea, my entire family loves to have a wide variety of flavors. Let's see how this tea measures up.

WHAT IS THIS TEA LIKE?
This tea comes in a top notch container. It has windows on the sides so you can see how much is left in the container without having to open it. The container is a very tight shutting container which has a spring loaded closure. The seal at the top makes it so that this tea will stay fresh longer. The tea itself is very fruity in nature and it does cover up that rooibos flavor which sometimes I don't like. The instructions are clear on the side and ingredients are listed.

HOW DOES THIS TEA TASTE?
This tea has a wonderful flavor. It is very fruity with a tart that balances the sweet nicely. I do find that a touch of honey brings out the flavor best, however.

THIS HAS SUGAR IN IT
I would have preferred that this company use cranberries that do not have added sugar in them. Many people can not have sugar, and in the case of some are not able to have sugar cane. The sugar seems to come from the cranberries so it would be easy to substitute and let US decide what kind of sweetener we want to use.

THE BOTTOM LINE
For a fruity tea that is not overwhelmed with rooibos flavor but still is caffeine free, this tea is a nice choice. I would prefer it did not have sugar in it, however, and that is enough to make me not buy it in the future.

MY RATING
Four stars for this. The sugar factor in the cranberries is a turn off for me. But it is still a good tea and has decent flavor.

title: The Chai Snobs In Our Family LOVE This Tea
text:
I have a few CHAI FANATICS in my family. I mean FANATICS!! They LOVE chai tea, but they are also Chai snobs. They are very particular about chai and I hear a running evaluation of every chai they come across, including the ones they make themselves out of herbs and tea. Let's see how this one measures up.

WHAT IS THIS CHAI TEA LIKE?
This chai comes in a fantastic tin. Unfortunately, it arrived to us leaked with tea all over, despite being sealed, but most of the tea was still left inside. There is a spring clip on the top which holds the top shut tightly so that air does not get in and it stays fresh. There is also a great window on the side so you can see how much tea is left without opening it up. This black tea mix has huge cardamom pods in it. There are whole cloves and pink peppercorns too. The smell is fantastic.

HOW DOES THIS BREW UP?
As soon as this arrived my chair fanatics snatched it and ran. They made tea from it and went wild over it. They talked of it being very spicy and having layers and depth to it which they love in their chai. Neither of them found the caffeine level to be too high. I have tasted this and it was delicious if you like chai. I am not a big chai fan, but I did like it.

THE BOTTOM LINE
For an excellent spicy chai with lots of layers of taste, this is a good choice. It has whole spices in it as well as fresh ingredients. The container closes tightly to keep it fresh.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. That is hard to get in this chai fan household.

title: Nice Peach Tea, Make Sure To Brew Correctly
text:
Our family of tea lovers went at this one as soon as we got it. Let's see how things turned out..

WHAT IS THIS TEA TIN LIKE?
First of all, this tea has a wonderful container. I mean WONDERFUL. It has a spring top to it which keeps the lid down tightly. There is a rubber/silicone type ring around the inside to keep it sealed well. The tin is high quality and thick. There are two windows up the side so you can see the tea through the window to tell when you are running low. Great feature.

The ingredient list is simple- white tea, moringa leaves, rose buds and natural flavors.

HOW IS THE TEA (INCLUDING BREWING CAUTION)?
The tea itself having white tea in it needs to be brewed carefully. I use the temperature gauge that I have and when the water reaches 175 degrees in the teapot, then I put the tea in the water (in the mesh brewing cup I have). I found that 3 or 4 minutes is plenty or it can get a little bitter edge to it.

The tea itself is nice with a peach taste to it, but if you are used to artificially flavored peach drinks or drinks that are more like peach syrup than juice, this might be a bit weak for you. It is more like white tea with an essence of peach to it.

ANY PROBLEMS?
We did not have any problems with this tea. Sometimes if they say natural flavor, I can have a bad reaction, but this did not seem to cause problems for me.

APPROVAL?
My entire family seemed to really like this tea, which is unusual because everyone is very different in their preferences.

VALUE?
This is a bit expensive for tea, but the container you get with it is really premium quality. Perhaps they can sell "refill" bags at a reduced price to keep customers coming back.

THE BOTTOM LINE
For a great tea that has a wonderful tea tin container, this tea keeps fresh, and is pleasant to drink. Just be sure to brew it at the correct temperature.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS. I like this tea as did everyone in the house. I just did not go nuts over it. It is a good solid tea that tastes nice. I tend to blend it with a pinch of other teas to brighten up the flavor a bit. I prefer [[ASIN:B005CPRM72 Spicy Peach Herbal Tea | GINGER SWEET PEACH 6 Ounce Tin by TIESTA TEA | Caffeine Free | Loose Leaf Herbal Tea Relaxer Blend]] as far as the Tiesta Tea peach flavors go.

title: FABULOUS Container, The Ginger Sweet Peach Tea Is Relaxing And Unique
text:
My family loves tea. There is nothing like having a few teapots set up and making a couple of different teas and sitting around the table having family time. Let's see how this tea measures up..

WHAT IS THIS TEA CONTAINER LIKE?
First of all, this tea container is fantastic. The top seals with a tight metal spring closure. There is a ring inside that seals it to keep it fresh. The tin itself is very thick and high quality. There are two little windows in the sides of the tin that allow you to see how much tea is in the container which is a great feature.

WHAT IS THE TEA LIKE?
The tea itself is a lovely fresh smelling peach. It has a rooibos base to it and a variety of fruits, flower parts, and even ginger in it. There is pink peppercorn which gives a nice spicy twist to the tea. When brewed, the intense flavor becomes more subdued. It is not overly artificial tasting and seems to be a nice smooth tea.

HOW DOES THE TEA AFFECT US?
This tea is indeed a nice relaxing tea. It does cause us to be a bit tired and restful, so it is not one that you want to have in the early morning when you want to get going.

ANY BAD SIDE EFFECTS?
I can not drink some teas. For instance, some of Teavana teas have so much artificial stuff in them that I get a headache and sometimes digestive upsets. This tea did not give me any problems like that.

ANYTHING I WOULD CHANGE?
They really should do a better job of listing ingredients in one place. They are all over the container. Also, they should offer a refill option so that you can continue to use the same container- maybe they do, but I just was not aware of it.

THE BOTTOM LINE
For a tea with a fantastic container that can be used over and over, this tea is relaxing and tastes nice. Not artificial tasting or cloying, we found this tea to be enjoyable and delicious.

MY RATING
Five stars, although the container ingredient list should be a bit better- not enough of an issue to take off a whole star though.

title: For Foam Like SHAVING CREAM From Almond Milk And Non-Dairy Substitutes, This Stuff Is AMAZING!
text:
I don't get to drink coffee that much (can not have the caffeine) but when I do once a week or so, I love to have a latte with lots of foamy milk. I found an almond milk that had the best foam out there, but it was discontinued and I was very frustrated. After examining the ingredients, what was unique about the almond milk I liked is that it was the only one that listed Locust Bean Gum on it.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
Locust Bean Gum is tasteless and does not really smell like much. It is a white powder. I keep it in a glass jar with tight fitting lid. The idea is that you use it for thickener.

HOW DO I USE THIS?
When I have almond milk that I want to froth up with my fantastic [[ASIN:B006LMVOFG Capresso 204.04 frothPLUS Automatic Milk Frother, Silver and Black]] , followed up by my [[ASIN:B01BKA11B0 Cafe Casa Milk Frother 2 Speed Handheld Drink Mixer - Latte Maker - Stainless Steel - With 2 AA Batteries Included (Silver)]] into a wonderful foam, I will do the following:

-Put the milk into the lowest fill line of the [[ASIN:B006LMVOFG Capresso 204.04 frothPLUS Automatic Milk Frother, Silver and Black]]. I will put it on the warm setting and let the milk foam while it warms up. If it is not frothy enough then..

-I take out the [[ASIN:B01BKA11B0 Cafe Casa Milk Frother 2 Speed Handheld Drink Mixer - Latte Maker - Stainless Steel - With 2 AA Batteries Included (Silver)]] and add a TINY pinch of this locust bean gum- I mean very tiny. I then froth with this Cafe Casa frother and what I get is almost shaving cream consistency foam.

ANY DRAWBACKS?
The only drawback is that you have to make sure you only use a little tiny bit as this really works fast and is highly concentrated.

DOES IT WORK WITH ONLY ONE FROTHER?
I use two frothers because I like the fine bubbles of the Capresso, but I like the more volume that I get from the Cafe Casa. The two together with the locust bean gum can take a very small amount of milk and increase the volume about five fold or so. Even if I add a little honey it does not seem to affect the ability to foam at all.

THE BOTTOM LINE
If you use any of the nutmilks, or other non-dairy substitutes, a tiny dusting of this locust bean gum can take you from weak foam to shaving cream style foam in a short time using a frother.

MY RATING
FIVE stars for this. I know there are other uses, but I really love having this handy for those days that I want some high volume foam that sticks around for a while and does not vanish quickly.

title: Great Potential, Great Ingredients, Coffee Adds Bitter Twist That No One Seemed To Like In Our Family
text:
My family is all about the natural easy to use stuff. When this overnight oats mix came across our path, we jumped at the chance to try it. Let's see how this worked out for us.

WHAT IS THIS OVERNIGHT OATS MIX LIKE?
This mix comes in a box with four cello bags of mix. That means there is about a cup of mix in a bag. The idea is that you put this into a jar and cover it with milk, or almond milk etc. and shake it and leave it overnight. There is a nice blend of oats, dried fruits, seeds, and coconuts in this blend. There is also COFFEE.

HOW DOES THIS PERFORM?
This mix did not absorb as much liquid as we expected it to. We put about a cup of milk into the jar with the cup of dried mix. Having done overnight oats a lot in the past, they usually absorb a LOT of liquid. This blend did not. It was still very watery. However, it smelled great, so we tried it. The liquid was thick anyway, so we didn't mind.

FLAVOR?
TASTE 1
I had two different tastings of this. One was our daughter who LOVES oats - especially overnight oats. She took it with her overnight and said she did not like it. I could not believe she was saying it was just not something she ever wanted again. Could not explain why except that it was not very good. She used a nice vanilla almond milk with it.

TASTE 2
This time my husband and I tasted it. I saw exactly what our daughter meant. It smelled great. It tasted..bitter. I think it was the coffee in it. This time we made it with almond and toasted coconut milk. We are not big on having super sweet stuff, so that was not the problem. The fruits added a nice depth, but at the end, the bitter twist was almost repulsive. It was not QUITE that bad, but it just was not pleasant.

THE BOTTOM LINE
When making this, although we all enjoy coffee now and then, this mix seems to be hindered by the addition of the coffee. With great aroma, the taste is kind of ruined by the bitter twist at the end. Great idea, just would prefer one without the coffee, or at least a different coffee that is not so bitter.

MY RATING
Three stars. The fruits and oats and seeds were nice, but the coffee just seemed to ruin the blend for us enough to make us not want to eat it any more.

title: Out Of Four People, A WIDE Variety Of Reactions  (Read On For Each Person's Reaction)
text:
I don't know how to rate these. My entire family tasted these and each one of us had a different reaction. So, I will list the different reactions and perhaps that will help you know if you might like these or not. My rating is an average of these reactions.

WHAT ARE THESE LIKE?
These Runas are in cans which are packaged in a box and clear wrap. The idea is that they are naturally sweetened and more natural in nature. Each can has 12 oz of drink in them. There is 0% juice in these cans.

DO THESE HAVE SUGAR IN THEM?
Unfortunately, these have cane sugar in them, so I am not as fond of them. If you avoid cane sugar, you won't want these.

HOW DO THESE TASTE?
PERSON 1
This person is myself. I do not like cane sugar, and prefer to drink my teas straight without a lot of sweetener. If I want anything, it would be a touch of honey. I find that sugar most often brings out bitterness of some teas.

My reaction? Honestly? It made me want to throw up. I really hated the taste of this. The tea itself is bitter in nature, but the sugar added made it taste even worse. Kind of like adding sugar to lawn water. I really did not like this and felt as if I could try it without sugar, I might possibly like it a little better. The pineapple was overtaken by the bitterness and sugar taste. It is not heavily sweet, I just felt the sugar made it worse.

PERSON 2
This person eats occasional sugar and has had an energy drink here and there. Person 2 prefers things not as sweet but will eat or drink things that I won't touch.

Person 2 did not like this energy drink. They thought it was bitter and really did not like it or want it.

PERSON 3
Person 3 is an energy drink fanatic. Person 3 drinks more natural energy drinks whenever possible and also eats a lot of fast food, excessive starches and even junk food en masse.

Person 3 was so excited about this drink that they took the entire bunch and has been blowing through it. REALLY loves this and will probably continue to buy it if they can find it.

PERSON 4
Person 4 eats more healthy and tries to watch what they put in their mouth. They don't tend to drink a lot of energy drinks, but will try a lot of new things and is not opposed to sugar in smaller amounts. Person 4 loves flavored water like Poland water, etc, even if it is bitter, they don't seem to mind.

Person 4 said that they did not mind these but probably would not seek them out. They said they were "pretty good" but not WOW. If they had one handy, they would drink it.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This drink was polarizing. Out of four people that tested it, only one was fanatical about it and really loved it. One more could take it or leave it and two others did not like it.

MY RATING
Due to the wide variety of reactions to this, I gave it four stars. It was a big hit with the one, not bad for the other and the last two did not like it, so it is hard to rate such a wide reaction.

If you like energy drinks and are trying to avoid chemicals, this might really strike a cord with you.

title: Great For Those Who Can Not Chew Whole Almonds And For Doing Body Cleanse Programs
text:
We are fans of all kinds of nuts in our house. One of the problems with almonds is that they are a bit too hard for some of us to chew, so we like to have nuts that are easier to chew available.

WHAT IS THIS PACKAGE OF NUTS LIKE?
This package comes in a re-sealable bag. You have to cut it open, at least I did because it did not tear off correctly. Inside of the package are sliced almonds. They tasted very fresh. There are not other additives in the almonds.

WHAT DID WE USE THEM FOR?
We are a fan of fruits and nuts and yogurt, so we used these almonds in yogurt. We also used them in coconut ice cream. I found them especially helpful on a cleansing program I was on this week where I needed a handful of nuts to chew once a day. These were PERFECT. I can take them with me or leave them home.

THE BOTTOM LINE
Portable, and convenient, these nuts are easier to chew than whole nuts for people who have trouble chewing whole almonds. It is a great way to dress up yogurt, ice cream, or just have a portable source of nuts for certain restricted diets and eating programs.

RATING
Five stars- I really was thankful to have these for the cleansing program I was doing. I would definitely buy these again to have on hand.

title: Handy To Have Around, These Nuts Where A Hit In Our House
text:
One thing that I find that is handy to have is chopped nuts. Making cookies, or even having a quick yogurt fruit bowl, it is always a nice feature to have some chopped nuts available when in a hurry.

WHAT IS THIS PACKAGE LIKE?

These nuts are chopped to a nice size. They tasted fresh and I did not encounter any shells or hard pieces. There were not any bitter pieces either.

WHAT I USED THESE NUTS FOR
These nuts were handy to use for yogurt and fruit. The family enjoyed using them as a quick way to add crunch to our yogurt and fruit bowls.

If you find yourself in a hurry quite often, having a bag or two of these nuts handy will cut down on preparation time when making things that require chopped nuts. Yogurt, cakes, cookies, or other recipes would make use of these nuts nicely. They also are good right out of the bag as a snack.

FIVE STARS for this nuts. I see nothing wrong with them and found them to be handy.

title: Confessions Of A Green Tea Hater (Former)
text:
(WARNING- This is an in depth review of Encha matcha tea. I am writing this for those who like me are researching and wanting to buy the best matcha as an investment. I am purposely going into detail to provide information to help with buying decisions. If you prefer a short summary, see section marked THE BOTTOM LINE)

THIS REVIEW WAS DONE ON PRODUCT PURCHASED AT FULL PRICE BY ME AS REGULAR CUSTOMER
--------------
I have to be honest with you, I really am not a green tea fan. I just don't like it. Flavored, unflavored, it did not seem to matter. I tried everything to make green tea just right and most of the time, I am just not a fan. There is a blend of green and white jasmine tea I do like, but that is not pure green, so probably does not count. So what am I doing trying matcha? Let me tell you.

MATCHA EXPERIENCE
Some time ago I came upon a tea company who has teas I love. So, they had matcha on sale and it was STILL expensive. I decided to look into matcha. I researched and studied what to look for and made only trying Japanese matcha my goal.

I tried a few here and there, but they were bitter, icky tasting, and made me wonder why anyone would bother spending money on that stuff- let alone a LOT of money. I found a little tin of PREMIUM organic GO MATCHA at a store on clearance, so I bought it. It was only $5 and the date was very fresh, and it was from Japan. No one in our area has a clue about stuff like this, so they did not buy it. Is that what matcha is supposed to taste like? Blech.

WHAT IS ENCHA MATCHA LIKE?
I am not one to let things lie until I have explored them to my satisfaction, so I continued to try matcha and more and more I was becoming turned off. I put the temperature between 170 and 160 and was careful to measure, and then I would froth it just right and drink it- blech. I only tried premium or ceremonial quality - if that was high end, I would hate to see low end.

I decided to give matcha one last try and purchased the Encha. When I opened the package, I was greeted by what I had thought was a myth. This stuff is a beautiful spring green powder that borders on neon in color. Now THAT is what I heard matcha was supposed to look like! The powder is fine and the fragrance is actually wonderful. It is reminiscent of Japanese Green Magma and some other green drink supplement powders I used to buy from Swanson Vitamins over the years.

HOW DOES THIS MATCHA PREPARE?
First let me tell you how I prepared this matcha.
- I heated water to 160 degrees
-I put 1/4 tsp in a cup (I like matcha a bit weaker at this point than the usual 1/2 tsp)
-I poured about 4 oz of water over the top of the matcha (no, I did not sift)
-I used the [[ASIN:B01BKA11B0 Cafe Casa Milk Frother 2 Speed Handheld Drink Mixer - Stainless Steel - With 2 AA Batteries Included (Silver)]]
-I sipped the tea rather quickly

Sometimes I pour a bit more water over top, sometimes not. It depends on my preference for weaker tea that day.

This matcha is delightful. Because I tend to use a bit less powder than recommended, the foam on top is less, but still very nice. The tea itself is delightful. No lumps, no problems at all mixing with the water, and the flavor- WOW. I have to say that this matcha blows all of the others I have tried out of the water. It is amazing.

WHAT DOES THIS MATCHA TASTE LIKE?
This matcha has a flavor that is most reminiscent of Japanese Green Magma made from young barley leaves- the original Japanese powder in the glass jar. It has a beautiful balance between sweetness and green, but it is a good green, not bitter. In fact, there was absolutely NO bitterness at all in this tea. The balance of astringency and green is perfect. Absolutely PERFECT. When I was done, my mouth was not feeling like someone sucked the water out of it, and it did not linger in a bad way like so many matchas tend to do to me. It was more of a pleasant memory that brings a smile to my face.

HOW DOES THIS TEA AFFECT ME?
I have a problem with caffeine, which includes in tea as well as coffee. I tend to avoid it. It makes me hurt and sometimes buzzes me so badly that I just have to avoid it and only have it once in a while. This tea, however, has an interesting effect on me. It brings about an ability to focus all day and adds an extra boost of peace and grounding that is elusive much of the time. I know that it is the L-theanine, but this is the first tea that I have experience this level of balance with.

I might not end up having it daily over time, but I sure am enjoying it now! The results are really nice.

THE BOTTOM LINE
I have to say that NOW I understand the reason why people go nuts over matcha tea. This tea is top of the line, there is no doubt about that. It turned me from a green tea resister to a green tea lover and that is HARD to do. The color is brilliant bright green, the aroma and flavor are perfect balance of sweet greens and astringency, and the powder blends into water perfectly. I have to say that the focus and grounding I get from this is amazing and I will probably keep buying this regularly. It is really amazing stuff.

RATING
I would give this ten stars if I could. I will update if anything changes or I have any more to add about this amazing tea.

title: Re-seal These Easily, We Love Them On Yogurt And Frozen Desserts
text:
My family eats a lot of nuts and seeds. We LOVE all sorts of nuts from walnuts, to almonds, as well as pecans. One of the things that we enjoy using nuts for is yogurt or desserts.

This package of nuts is uniformly small pieces of pecans. It is a re-sealable bag which you have to cut open at first and they you re-seal it afterward to keep the nuts fresh after you open it. title: First I Thought We Made A Mistake, But Boy Was I WRONG- This Is The Best Coffee We Have EVER Had
text:
My husband and I have access to some of the best coffee we have ever tasted anywhere. Our local coffee shops are exceptional for the most part and quite often we are amazed at how much better it is than anything else.

Recently, we saw a promotional on this Wake Up America coffee claiming that it was the best coffee anywhere on the planet. We were open to take the challenge to see if this coffee was really THAT good. After all, we truly do have some of the most amazing organic coffee in our area. It is pretty hard to top.

WHAT IS THIS COFFEE LIKE?
Keep in mind this is a FULL POUND of organic fair trade coffee, unlike many other brands which sell 14oz or some even 12 oz. This coffee was really dark smelling when it was opened. The whole beans smelled almost too dark for my taste. I thought we really made a mistake. The smell was nice, but just not as WOW as I had hoped. Then we ground it.

HOW DID WE GRIND THIS COFFEE?
We ground this on a coarse grind which is closer to a medium coarse in a burr grinder

HOW DID WE MAKE THIS COFFEE?
We brewed this coffee with spring water in a [[ASIN:B01N0CLJLH Bialetti Cold Brew Maker]]. We filled the basket about half full of coffee grounds which amounts to about a quarter of a pound. We then poured the spring water over top of it and then waited overnight. We heated up the coffee and diluted it about half and half with water- perhaps a little less.

Once we emptied out the pitcher, we re-filled the container one more time up to the top with spring water waiting another night. We often get a slightly weaker concentrate but one that is just as good and we can add that to the refrigerator bottle that we keep the concentrate in. This will last almost a week depending on if both of us are drinking it daily or not.

HOW DID THIS COFFEE TASTE?
I have to say, I was not prepared for the coffee we were treated to. We heated up the coffee with up to half and half ratio with water and then we put it in the Vitamix with a square of Kerrygold butter, a tablespoon of [[ASIN:B00LLLXRVG MCT Oil (Medium Chain Triglycerides) 2 Bottles x 16 fl oz]] , and about a tablespoon or more of honey added. The whole solution fills the Vitamix halfway.

We whizzed it quickly and the result was the most decadent coffee we have ever had. We drink all of our coffee made this way so we were comparing it across the board with the same preparation time. It is smooth, full bodied, FLAVORFUL- WOW.

OMG I am serious. This beats any other coffee we have had to date- even ones I have rated on Amazon or locally obtained that I really liked. This was the smoothest, most beautiful tasting coffee EVER. And each time we make it, it continues to be the best we have ever had.

Truly, they were not lying when they said that this was the finest coffee on the planet. Well, maybe not planet, but at least anything we have ever had does not reach this point.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This whole bean coffee does not smell particularly different, but boy does it taste better than any other coffee we have made. We prepared it cold brew style and bulletproof after we heated it up and the results astounded us. It is not as dark as it smelled at first. We would buy this coffee any time we are able. It is really truly fantastic stuff. I can not rave enough about it. I would even drink this black cold or hot, and I rarely find a coffee I can say that about.

title: UPDATE- From Yuck To Yay!
text:
UPDATE AT THE END- Things have changed with this. One of the family has completely changed in reaction to this and I finally got my taste back!
---------
ORIGINAL REVIEW

Green tea can be a difficult thing to evaluate. There are quite a few factors that affect how the green tea tastes. Temperature, time steeping, water quality, etc, can alter the way a tea tastes. When I picked this tea to evaluate, I was very excited to try it out this match green tea. However, sometimes things don't always turn out as you plan..

WHAT IS THIS TEA LIKE?
Each tea bag comes individually wrapped in a foil packet. When you open it up, it has an off center square shape to it which resembles a pyramid some. That allows for better tea steeping.

HOW DOES THIS TEA TASTE?
That is where this review gets difficult. The day before this tea arrived and for almost two weeks now, I have been very sick so I have lost the ability to smell and taste. My entire family has tested this tea out and their assessment is that it is bitter and awful. My husband, a big tea fanatic who loves green tea of all sorts could not even finish his which is rare for him. The kids could not finish theirs either but that is not as uncommon for them, despite their liking some green teas.

I can not add my own observations at this time as I still am far from having the ability to smell or taste. Was this the tea, or was the water too hot? Was the steeping time too long? They say it wasn't. I can only go by their word.

Because I can not add my own experience to this yet, but my family reacted so negatively, at this point, I am rating 3 stars. I will adjust rating and review in the future when I am FINALLY able to taste again.

THE BOTTOM LINE
Individually packaged in foil, this tea is definitely green tea with matcha. The bag allows for good steeping, but the flavor to my entire family was bitter.

UPDATE TO ORIGINAL REVIEW (2-16-17)
I finally got my taste back and was able to add my evaluation to this tea and what has happened is interesting. Our teenage daughter who did not like this, suddenly is in love with it! And I find it to be pretty good too. It is not flavored, and it can be bitter if it is brewed too hot or too long, but I find that if I take the time to be sure I brew it right, it is a pretty nice tea. It is not my favorite, but it is nice.

CHANGED RATING
I have changed this from a three star to four star based upon the change of our daughter who hated this tea at first and my own experience which was decent. It is nice to go with a meal too.

title: Ditch Starbucks, This Is Cream Of The Crop- Seriously.  Also the ULTIMATE Bulletproof Coffee too.
text:
Wow. All I can say is that in our household, we have explored some of the best coffee that there is out there. We have tried some of the ultimate quality right down to the decent quality. We are very particular about the flavor of coffee, and the cleanness of it. I have a problem with pesticides, so it is important for me to have clean coffee.

The IOne Love coffee is one of the very best we have ever had. As I said, this rivals coffee that is twice the price or more that we have had. I have had it in the pods, pre-ground, and whole bean which we ground. Made in a Bunn coffee maker it was fantastic, but made with a French Press- WOW. Medium grind in a french press is the ultimate treat.

This coffee is not only smooth, but has the perfect balance of fruity flavor with caramel when made as bulletproof coffee. (That means blending in a Vitamix with kerrygold grassfed butter, honey, and MCT oil and blended on high). It is the ultimate coffee. I do not get headaches from it (I don't drink coffee constantly so it is important to me to have good coffee when I do).

The aroma of this coffee is also fantastic, it matches the flavor.

I can not rave about this coffee enough. It is delightful and we are not steady customers. It is truly wonderful stuff and costs less than some of the *snobby* high priced local roasts that we have had which are really nice too.

I highly recommend this. It beats Starbucks by a lightyear- seriously.

This is coming from someone who did not even like coffee and refused to drink it for years until I had to test the Bunn coffee maker (phase brew). I have learned to find some of the most wonderful coffee now as I don't really have it constantly like my husband does. He raves about this one too. He absolutely loves this coffee no matter how it is prepared.

title: I Can Not Keep This In My Cupboard- It is SO Good!  (includes brewing info)
text:
This is one of my favorite teas. When I want something sweet but not a full dessert, I will often make this tea. The caramel flavor is perfect with the tea and one bag is just strong enough for a regular mug (not large, but about 8-10 oz or so of tea) honey makes the flavor pop and the whole family (who rarely agree on flavors) grab this whenever I would buy it, making it run out faster than any other tea I have purchased the last few years.

I do want to stop here and say, I don't prefer sweet desserts. They can be somewhat sweet, but I tend to like hints of sweetness and smokiness in flavors. This tea has both. If you are the type who binge eats caramels from the wrapper, you probably won't like this tea. If you like subtle more interesting nuances in things, you might like this.

I did want to say that I have a difficult time with many flavored black teas. What I love about this one is the combination of teas- Mate, black, cocoa shells, etc. For some reason this one does not bother my stomach and I seem to do very well with it.

Another plus is that you can brew it at the temperature that it comes out of the electric kettle- it can take 208 degrees for 5-6 minutes. It is not fragile like green or white tea can be so it does not get really bitter as easily if you do not brew at the right temperature. I tend to let the water get to just under full boil in the kettle though- I find it does tend to make the tea a bit smoother and taste better for whatever reason. Perhaps the black tea needs the lower temp.

Our local store stopped carrying this flavor, however, so I have not had any from this stock from Amazon so I can not comment on this shipment (as with all food batches can vary), but I plan to try it soon.

title: Beats Jennies Coconut Macaroons!
text:
I have been a bit disappointed with one of my favorite snacks the last year or two- Jennies Coconut Macaroons. For some reason they just have not been as good as I have experienced for the last decade or more that we have enjoyed them. I was disappointed as so many companies have compromised the original purpose of making non sugar laden snacks, including using carob in place of chocolate.

Jennies used to have both- using honey instead of sugar.

Well, this past Christmas I got a package of Oskri Coconut bars. I was not sure what to expect as the ingredient list is pretty simple- Brown Rice Syrup and Coconut!

When i opened the first bar, it was complete excitement. These bars are DELICIOUS.

Not as overwhelmingly sweet like Jennies, these have a delicious sweetness that is subtle but fulfilling. The bars are wrapped and very easy to eat. Moistness is wonderful and the flavor is delightfully simple!

I liked these so much that not only did I end up getting a subscription of them, but I found out my mother did so too!

These are wonderful simple bars if you want a nice snack that is not overly sweet yet satisfying. I highly recommend them.

title: Raw Food Brownie Home Run!
text:
I don't like chocolate. In fact, I avoid it almost all of the time, with the exception of an occasional tiny spot of raw cacao nibs in raw coconut macaroons that I make in the dehydrator.

I got a box of assorted PURE bars and the chocolate brownie was in it. I decided to taste it and I have to say, I am shocked. I have never tasted anything so delicious and decadent before that actually makes me like chocolate.

These brownies are moist, dense, filling, and addictive without being too sweet or overbearing. The flavors are perfectly balanced and the dates are not dominant like they are in so many raw desserts.

One of these bars is filling and satisfying without the weight in the stomach of cooked food or grains. This bar is supposed to be all raw, and although it has some rice protein in it, I am not sure how they do it, but it is fabulous. I don't have any reactions or problems with it. I find cooked foods to be too heavy for me and I tend to react badly.

Although I will probably not buy these again, because I have to avoid cocoa- it gives me problems even in raw form. I highly recommend the PURE CHOCOLATE BROWNIES if you love chocolate and want a raw decadent treat without having anything cooked and no sacrifice of flavor or texture. If I could eat cocoa regularly, I would definitely purchase these absolutely.

Worth every cent.

title: FINALLY I FOUND YOU!
text:
About 18 years ago when on vacation, I found this marvelous halvah bar that did not have any refined sugar in it. It was made with honey, but the flavor and texture was marvelous. Unfortunately, I have looked for the company and could never find their products in the US.

FINALLY it is here! My mom bought some of these and gave us a bunch and it was divine to taste them once again. A different texture than the Joyva halvah, it is still superior and we love it. It still has no refined sugar (and one of the rare products with NO SUGAR CANE IN ANY FORM) and we hope Amazon carries them for a long time to come. We can not use sugar cane in any form and have been very upset with the so called natural foods people who have caved to the pressure of $ and started using sugar cane in their products. HOORAY FOR CAMEL! They still use decent ingredients in their products.

First off I would like to say that I do like Chai tea and the spicier the better. I was interested to try this one because of the added Turmeric. I've been drinking it with a dash of canned coconut milk, but you could also do half & half or almond milk. Today, I brewed it in the cup and blended it in the Vitamix with the coconut milk, 1/4 teaspoon honey, and some vanilla bean, dash of cinnamon. My current favorite way to eat them is to prepare the gel and add it to a glass of water with a splash of citrus juice. So simple but so satisfying. What I also love about these is that they help eliminate acid reflux or indigestion. Just amazing how this little food can do so many things.

title: Tasty and refreshing
text: These aloe Vera drinks from Goya are really good. Not overly sweet, and of course, theyre not your typical soft drink. Tasty and refreshing with real mango flavoring. Delicious!

title: Tasty and refreshing
text: Yeah, these aloe Vera drinks from Goya are really good. They're not overly sweet, but tasty and very refreshing. Real coconut flavor. Delicious!

title: Tasty
text: These are delicious. All three flavors in this pack are good. Add them to drinks or smoothies - or as I do, grab a spoonful for an occasional random snack.

title: Grain free granola
text: I love granola and my wife hates carbs. This grain free granola suits us both. It's very tasty. I tend to grab it by the handful for an occasional snacl while my wife pours milk over it to eat it like cereal for breakfast. Very good.

title: Tasty and healthy dried berries
text: Dried berries - great for smoothies. Not overly sweet, but flavor is good. Dried state means a better shelf life.

title: Delicious!
text: Delicious! Rice Kristie treats with chocolate flavor! These treats are individually wrapped in single servings. Toss a couple in a lunchbox, purse or briefcase. These are good!

title: Tasty and healthy nutritional suppliment
text: Tasty sugar substitute that's actually good for you. Has all the sweetness of sugar and can be substituted 1 for 1. There is a slight "date" taste that may influence where you'll want to use this, but it is lower on the glycemic index than sugar, so could be a viable solution for those with concerns.

title: Tasty and healthy nutritional suppliment
text: Freeze dried kale powder. This is a very fine powder that readily mixes in with smoothies, or soups, etc. The flavor is there, along with color. An easy way to add healthy ingredients to various recipes.

title: Tasty and healthy nutritional suppliment
