title: Full flavored single sourced coffees
text: Three varieties of single source coffee. Coffees come in metal tins with screw on lids to maintain freshness. This is more of a light to medium roast. Flavor is full, open and clean. Low acidity. Recommended.

title: Tasty and refreshing
text: I really wasn't sure what to expect from this aloe Vera drink, but boy was I pleasantly surprised. The pineapple flavoring is far more dominant than you would expect. However, there's not an "acidy" element with it. It's just a refreshing pineapple drink that could also be used as an interesting "base" for mixes. Recommended.

title: Tasty Cinnabon coffee -
text: Tasty Cinnabon coffee with caramel flavoring. These pods work perfectly with keurig systems and the results are absolutely delicious!

title: Tasty favorite packaged for lunchboxes
text: Delicious Keebler fudge stripe cookies, but in a smaller size, packaged in individual servings for lunch boxes, purse or just a carry around fun snack. Definitely recommended.

title: Tasty and healthy
text: Shelf stable celery powder. This feeeze dried powder is a healthy adder for soups and smoothies, etc.

title: Tasty and healthy
text: One ingredient - organic blueberries! Blueberries are a great healthy and tasty additive for various deserts, smoothies, cooking batters, etc. The result is tasty and healthy - full of antioxidants. And they're shelf stable (fresh blueberries don't last very long).

title: Tasty and healthy nutritional suppliment
text: Tasty and refreshing sparkling water includes healthy suppliments. The suppliments are generally light, but they're there, and you can benefit from them while enjoying this drink. Recommended.

title: A healthy snack
text: Apple cider vinegar is healthy, but I don't consider it very tasty. If your tastes are similar to mine, these gummies are a way to make it more palatable. That being said, you can actually taste the vinegar in these. It's not overwhelming, but it's definitely there. Otherwise, a nice healthy snack.

title: Smooth and tasty
text: Melt in your mouth delicious. These melt easily into a smooth milk chocolate that's great for coating things (cookies, candies, strawberries, etc)

title: Low carb and tasty
text: Not really granola, but a tasty substitute with seeds and nuts. At only 3 grams of carbs per 1/4 cup serving, it's a healthy snack for anyone watching their carb intake.

title: Healthy ingredients - okay flavor
text: Decent flavor, (not like a sugary soda). Has healthy, natural ingredients (fruit purees provide flavoring...) and it is refreshing. Not sure I'll be ordering any more (especially considering the price).

title: Flavorful peppercorn
text: Flavorful white pepper. Perfect for cooking - works well with various pepper mills. Mccormick is a well known brand for spices (been using their products for years) and these peppercorns won't disappoint.

title: Tasty and refreshing
text: Unique taste is refreshing without being too sweet. This sparkling drink with lemon and ginger is augmented with a minty freshness. Definitely unique.

title: Delicious on salmon
text: I had no idea what to expect. But I like salmon and my wife does not. Several online comments suggested this so I thought I'd give it a try. Turns out, my wife and I both like it! It's a bit of a citric flavor - not unlike lemon, but with a slight bite. It's actually quite good. I'll be trying it on other dishes now that I know what it is.

title: Quality ingredients - prebiotics - natural vinigars
text: This variety pack comes with a nice variety of flavors, all natural ingredients. Sweetened with organic coconut nectar - it supports digestive health.

title: Quality seasoning from Lawry's
text: Great way to spice up a dish. The dried ground cayennes used are hot - and full of character. Definitely a part of any well stocked spice pantry. Lawry's is (of course) a well known brand - known for its quality seasonings. Recommended.

title: Convenient and flavorful
text: Tasty dried garlic. I like to use this in soups and stews - or even as a light sprinkle over a roast. Pretty much anywhere fresh garlic would be appropriate. And the flavor is there... it's a convenient way to always have a touch of garlic at the ready.

title: Fresh and full of flavor
text: Excellent! Fresh vanilla beans, perfect for cooking, making e tracts, etc. These beans are vaccuum sealed for freshness and come ready to use. Full of flavor and aroma. Nice!

title: Full bodied decaf
text: Nice smooth and balanced brew. Bold and flavorful - decaffeinated with a Swiss water wash process. I sometimes blend this with regular caffinated coffee to control my caffeine intake - it's full bodied flavor allows me to do that without sacrificing taste. Nice!

title: Tasty and healthy nutritional suppliment
text: I actually enjoy the taste of these. They really do remind of strawberries and cream. But the real benefit comes from the nutritional support. Whether dieting or dealing with a medical condition, these provide a tasty way to assure you're getting the nutrition you need.

title: Tasty and refreshing
text: I really like these things. They're odd in that they seem to have a very fine "film" that forms a bubble, and inside is delicious fruit juice. I sometimes top ice cream with them, but mostly I just grab a few spoonfuls for a quick refreshing snack.

title: Great taste - but lumpy
text: Flavor was great, but no matter how much I shook it, the result was lumpy. It almost seemed like it had curdled. I couldn't enjoy it.

title: Tasty and refreshing
text: Natural energy drink. With vitamins (A, B6, B12, C, D) along with green tea caffeine extract, ashwaganda, etc. It's low calorie (10) and low carb (1 g) refreshment. The mango flavor that I got is tasty and refreshing.

title: Sweet and refreshing
text: These things are delicious! I've tried them in ice cream and teas, and thier sweet release of juice in a pleasant "burst" is great. I found myself just grabbing a spoonful and eating them directly out of the tub whenever I'm wanting something sweet and refreshing. Recommended!

title: Nice sampler - some examples bitter/acidic
text: I found this sampler to be nicely diverse, although they all (so far) seem to be a medium roast with a bit more bitterness and acidity than I normally like.

title: Nice breakfast brew
text: This Etheopian coffee is shown as ethically sourced and sustainably grown, being 95% sourced from local growers. I very much appreciate these sentiments. As for the flavor, I would say it's not necessarily "bold", but rather full and rich. Low acidity makes it a great breakfast brew.

title: Pleasant vanilla taste
text: These drinks are a great way to suppliment a diet to assure you're getting all the nutrients you should. The flavor isn't heavy, it's actually a pleasant vanilla taste. Recommended

title: Organic low calorie drink
text: Organic ingredients, sweetened with erithrital and stevia, it's 5 calories per serving.  Recommended.

title: Healthy alternative to pasta
text: Pour some low carb tomato sauce on top for a keto, or gluten free spaghetti - use meat free sauce for a vegan course. However you top it, it's a healthy alternative to pasta.

title: 3 tins of whole bean coffee - great for gift giving
text:
Three metal tins of coffee beans packaged fresh (within 48 hours roasting). Variety of coffees include light and medium roasts named for various national parks - (Grand Tetons, Olympic, and Acadia)

Organic and Fair Trade Certified, this box of 3 tins of coffee would make a great gift for any coffee lover.

title: Pleasant night time drink and sleep aid
text: Taste is good - ingredients include melatonin and chamomile. Two items I've used as sleep aids in the past. Magnesium included - another ingredient needed for proper sleep. There's only 2 mg of melatonin (I often take 5 mg), but with the other ingredients, it makes for an effective sleep aid and a pleasant drink before bed.

title: Tasty ginger ale like health drink
text: Tasty ginger ale like health drink. Not too sweet - includes prebiotics and refreshing flavor.

title: Giftable sweets - excellent!
text: Excellent - tasty treats in a giftable package. Very nice!

title: Tasty and refreshing
text: Very refreshing! There's a good bit of flavor here, with a blend of sugar alternatives (monk fruit, stevia, blue agave). Flavors include ginger and lime - everything is organic. 25 calories - 4 net carbs. Electrolytes and antioxidants - very good! Recommended.

title: Mixes well - nice coffee adder
text: Boost complete nutritional drink from powder. Great vanilla taste - I tend to mix a little in my coffee. Nice!

title: Refreshing kombucha - tasty
text: Most people know that kombucha is good for your gut... being fermented tea means it's full of probiotics and such. But kombucha is a bit of an acquired taste. That's where the Koe kombucha comes in. It's got a lighter, more refreshing taste about it than some other brands. I am very pleased with this - it may well be my favorite kombucha. Nice!

title: Healthy and refreshing - definite Stevie taste
text: Refreshing and healthy. Stevie aftertaste is definitely there, if you like that, you'll probably like this drink.

title: Calming effect
text: Taste is okay - it grows on you. It does seem to have a calming effect. At this price, I can't say I'd recommend it.

title: Healthy ingredients - tastes okay
text: The ingredients listed are certainly healthy, but it seems lacking in flavor (a bit watered down?). Price is fairly high for what you get.

title: A little goes a long way
text: Highly concentrated... This is the kind of flavoring you measure by the drop. The taste is good and can be used for most any applications. Works great for gummies.

title: 3 flavors - nice desert type brew
text: 3 flavors in this bundle - chocolate, vanilla, and caramel. All 3 full bodied and tasty for those that enjoy flavored espresso. Completely compatible with my delonghi nespresso machine. Recommended.

title: Organic and flavorful
text: 3 varieties in this bundle. All 3 full bodied and flavorful. Completely compatible with my delonghi nespresso machine. Organic - recommended.

title: Simple way to a tasty low carb desert
text: My wife's mixed her own mug cakes before. It's a quick and easy path to a tasty desert. These prepackaged low carb versions make it that much easier. Mix in water and microwave - 90 seconds in the microwave and you have a quick low carb desert. Cinnamon flavoring is good. Recommended.

title: Tasty and refreshing
text: This is really good. Kombucha is a healthy drink that usually has a vinegar taste that takes some getting used to - but this doesn't. It's actually very tasty and refreshing. The fruit juice is the prominent flavor - very enjoyable.

title: Nice non alcoholic sparkling white wine
text: Non alcoholic sparkling wine - nice option for those limiting alcohol consumption. To my unsuffisticated palate, it provides a nice, not too sweet taste that could go most anywhere a sparkling white would be appropriate.

title: Tasty low carb snack
text: Tasty snack - only 6 grams of net carbs per bar (49 calpores). They taste great, though being made with rice puffs instead of oats leaves them with a rice cake type flavor.

title: Great on ice cream or just eaten by the spoonful
text: I love these things. They're like pea sized bubbles floating in juice. When you bite into them, they collapse and release another blast of fruit juice. I've been putting them on ice cream, but mostly just eat them by the spoonful. Delicious!

title: Tasty healthy snack
text: Concentrated fruit formed into a "strip" of a snack. It's flexible and chewy - tasty, healthy snack.

title: The perfect thirst quencher - natural and tastes great
text: I first tried coconut water because I heard it was good for you. Then I discovered that it actually tastes great and is very refreshing. This pure coconut water is the perfect thirst quencher. Recommended.

title: Refreshing cold brew
text: Very tasty cold brew. Refreshing and flavorful. Recommended.

title: Great cookies - for keto or otherwise
text: It's hard to believe they've kept the carbs so low and still managed a great cookie. I think the secret may be in the blend of sweeteners. It tastes like a cookie... a good cookie! If you're looking for it, you might detect a hint of the stevia taste, but otherwise you'll simply enjoy these. Definitely recommended for those watching their carbs.

title: Soft pretzel taste in a great crunchy snack
text: These grain free pretzels are really good! They have the crunch and texture you expect from a pretzel, with a flavor that's similar to a soft pretzel. It must be the yeast listed in the ingredients, but these are tasty and a very satisfying snack. Recommended.

title: Medium dark roast - full and rich - intensity level 8
text: This coffee is rich and full bodied. Intensity level 8, it's like a premium medium dark roast. The coffee is sustainably sourced and comes in biodegradable pods. Work perfectly in my nespresso machine.

title: Full and rich flavor
text: Wonderful espresso pods (lungo) that work perfectly in my Delonghi nespresso machine. The taste is full and rich, low acidity. Recommended.

title: Flavorful and refreshing - anti-inflamatory properties
text: I've been using turmeric for inflammation for some time. This tasty drink adds ginger and flavorings to make a tasty and refreshing drink with those benefits in place. Flavorful and refreshing. Recommended.

title: Tangy Chai tea
text: Just a bit of a tangy flavor - this Chai tea has ginger and pepper along with a mango flavor. It's tasty and provides a metabolism boost. Very good.

title: Decent chips - strong spicy flavor
text: Decent tortilla chips. The salsa Verde flavor is fairly hot and spicy - it overwhelms the base flavor of the chip. There's 18 grams of carbs and 4 grams of fiber - so 14 grams of net carbs is probably too high for a snack for most keto diets (a serving is about 28 chips).

title: Organic and healthy
text: Not much in the way of flavor, but seems to be a great additive to "upgrade" other dishes to something more healthy. Ive been adding in small quantities to various recipes... Wash it clean, soak it and add as desired.

title: Great after dinner brew
text: Nespresso pods never dissapoint. These flavored pods are rich and bold... low acidity. Numerical intensity ratings aren't listed, but some are listed as delicate and others intense. Make a great after dinner brew.

title: Smaller cubes - tasty and crunchy addition to your salad
text: Full of flavor. I like the smaller size of the cubed croutons - they work well blending in a salad with a dressing. Sealabe container - simply pour on your salad and reseal.

title: A delicious burst of natural flavor
text: These pearls are definitely something different. But they are delicious! Their description is pretty accurate - it's like bubbles you can bite into for a burst of flavor. In this case, that flavor is fruit juice. I wasn't certain what to do with them - I tried putting them over ice cream - delicious! But mostly, I ended up just pulling the tub from the fridge and grabbing a spoonful at a time. Definitely recommended.

title: Classic butter cookies - great gift
text: These are classic butter cookies - they're tasty, nor too sweet. The texture is like an old fashioned treat. Definitely giftable.

title: Convenient iced latte style drink right from the fridge
text: Tasty - sort of an iced latte type of drink. Ready to drink makes it convenient right from the fridge. The various flavors are subtle in their differences, and all are very similar. Recommended.

title: No calories - no carbs (keto friendly)
text: Nice light flavor - no sugars, no calories, no carbs (keto friendly). My wife likes this - she keeps a bottle in her purse for on the go. Recommended

title: Organic - full rich taste
text: I was first attracted to Artisan coffees when I saw they had organic pods for my Nespresso machine. Those are excellent brews - now this whole bean version falls right in line. Organic, with a full rich taste. Smooth and low acidity. This is good coffee!

title: Smooth breakfast brew - low acidity
text: I always lean toward organic coffees. This one has a nice smooth taste with low acidity - as a medium roast should. It makes a perfect breakfast brew. Nice!

title: Tasty and refreshing - coconut and fruit flavors
text: Tasty and refreshing. Low carbs makes it keto friendly. The energy comes from caffeine and B vitamins. The taste is light - including a dominant coconut taste.

title: Apple juice with tart cherry juice - tasty and refreshing
text: Very simple - apple juice with tart cherry juice (contains potassium sorbets for freshness). That's it. The flavor is dominated by the tart cherries, which I really like. This is a healthy drink that's both tasty and refreshing.

title: All 4 snacks are fresh and tasty - delicious!
text: Nice gift box that most anyone would enjoy. The packaging is nice - appropriate for gifting. The snacks themselves are exceptional! Fresh and tasty. All 4 items are first rate, but the dried mangoes in particular, are simply delicious. Definitely recommended.

title: Zero calories - energy from caffeine and B vitamins- tasty
text: Light, refreshing zero calorie drink. The grapefruit flavor is good - there's no sugar and no carbs - no protein either. It's sweetened by Stevia and the advertised "energy" comes from caffeine and B vitamins.

title: Smooth - full bodied - excellent!
text: This coffee is excellent! Smooth, full bodied without being bitter or acidic. It's the perfect breakfast brew - and it's organic, too. Highly recommended!

title: Simple, tasty and refreshing
text: Simple is good. This is basically just black tea with apple juice. It's "sparkling" so its been carbonated, which makes it seem more like a soda than a tea... but it's not overly sweet like soda, but tasty and refreshing like a tea should be. Organic and healthy - very good!

title: Smooth, rich - great breakfast brew
text: Smooth, rich taste with low acidity and bitterness. This medium roast makes a great breakfast brew. Recommended.

title: Healthy and refreshing drink
text: Nice refreshing drink. Healthy too, antioxidants infused, no artificial sweeteners. Recommendee.

title: Great taste - includes caffeine and be vitamins
text: Black Cherry is my favorite flavor. This comes with caffeine and be vitamins, so it's a really easy way to step away from surgery sodas and still get your caffeine. My wife likes to keep one of these in her purse. Handy... and tasty. Recommended.

title: Organic ingredients and probiotics
text: If you like kombucha, you'll like this drink. It's not too sweet and it is refreshing. A quick rundown of the ingredients shows lots of organics and includes probiotics. Recommended.

title: Tasty fruit blend - organic and refreshing
text:
Mango splash! The list of ingredients includes various organic fruit juices, (including mango, of course), sesame seed minerals (whatever that is), collagen and monk fruit. Provides antioxidants, collagen and electrolytes. Nice.

And it tastes great (be sure to shake well)

title: Zesty ranch flavor
text: These almonds are fresh and tasty. The flavoring (ranch) is described as "zesty" and that's a very accurate description. The zesty flavor dominates and enhances the almond flavor. If you like a cool ranch flavoring, you'll love these almonds.

title: Excellent flavor
text: Excellent flavor. I've tried it in several cocktails, and have even enjoyed it enhancing my coffee. Strong alcohol content, but it only takes a dash or two...

title: Healthy supershake
text: Healthy drink with caffeine from coffee, natural fiber, grass fed protein and organic greens. The taste is primarily that of coffee, but it's not an overwhelming flavor. Overall, the taste is good, but not the primary reason for recommending this - its more about the health benefits of drinking this "super shake".

title: Raw New Zealand honey - tasty!
text: Raw premium honey from New Zealand. The taste is somewhat floral in nature and I'm sure reflects its origins. Very tasty... recommended.

title: Healthy brew to boost imunity for nespresso users
text: Works properly with my DeLonghi nespresso machine. The tea is full of beneficial nutrients to improve immunity, such as root chicory and turmeric, providing vitamin c, d, etc. It's a tasty brew that's not too sweet and caffeine free.

title: Coffee is delicious - tin is a bonus
text: Green Mountain is a well known brand for us coffee lovers. These k cups are full flavored and ready for use in a kuerig style machine. The plus comes with the tin they're provided with - suitable for gifting, for storing coffee what-have-you. Coffee is delicious... tin is a bonus.

title: True medium roast - smooth full flavor
text: This is a true medium roast coffee with low acidity. Organically grown is a big thing for me when it comes to coffees. The fact that this one is so smooth and full flavored makes it a great brew. Recommended.

title: Healthy ingredients, but doesn't taste very good
text: I'm sure this is a very healthy drink - but it just doesn't taste very good to me. With cabbage, broccoli, etc. It's one of those things that tastes like it'll come back to haunt you later. I'm sure it's healthy, but I can't recommend it.

title: Tasty and appropriate for gifting
text: These are tasty shortbread treats. Two boxes with two flavors - one is macadamia and the other is wild lime and coconut. Each box contains 10 packs of two cookies each. The flavors are somewhat subtle rather than overwhelming and the packaging presents well for gifting. Recommended.

title: Dark roast decaf - bold flavor, recyclable pods
text: This decaffeinated coffee is a dark roast with a bold flavor. The coffee itself is organic and it comes in recyclable pods.

title: Tasty - organic - easy to dispense
text: Very tasty - pure organic honey. The flip lid makes it easy to dispense, (though I did get a little sloppy on first use.) Recommended.

title: Sweet - tasty - zero calories
text: This flavoring from Splenda is good. The strawberry watermelon flavor is tasty and refreshing. Overall, the flavoring is a bit sweeter than I like, but my wife enjoys it and there's zero calories.

title: Refillable containers - great clean water - no plastic
text: Great idea. These aluminum bottles are filled with Britta filtered water... I love drinking clean chilled water from aluminum containers, it keeps the water so refreshingly cold! The great thing, thought, is that I also have a Britta filtered pitcher, so I can simply refill these and reuse them... the ultimate in recycling and no disposable plastic! Nice!

title: Light and fragrant organic tea
text: Light and fragrant, this organic tea offers a pleasant afternoon or evening drink. A very slight sweetness means you can drink as is or sweeten to taste.

title: Excellent iced coffee
text: Green Mountain makes great coffees, and this iced coffee with vanilla flavoring is excellent. Works perfectly with the standard Keurig machine. Recommended.

title: Deliciously sweet
text: These are great tasting capacinoes - as my adult daughter describes "deliciously sweet!" It's a capacino with sweetener already in. The pods are compostable and work perfectly in a standard kuerig machine.

title: Tasty non dairy drink
text: Being somewhat lactose intolerant, I'm always on the lookout for non dairy alternates. This oat milk drink is good. It's not too sweet and has a nice latte-like flavor. The fact that it's plant based, vegan, etc, makes it a healthy and tasty alternative that doesn't upset my stomach.

title: Tasty non-dairy drink
text: Being somewhat lactose intolerant, I'm always on the lookout for non dairy alternates. This oat milk drink is surprisingly good. It's not too sweet (a good thing) and has a nice espresso/mocha flavor. The fact that it's plant based, vegan, etc, makes it a healthy and tasty alternative that doesn't upset my stomach.

title: Bold, rich and flavorful - certified organic
text: This is a robust, full bodied Cuban espresso. The folks at Artisan coffee never fail to deliver. This bold brew is rich and tasty, certified organic and  it comes in compostable pods. Delicious!

title: Great tasting hot chocolate from your Nespresso machine
text: In addition to being a coffee lover, I also have a penchant for chocolate. This hot chocolate drink is good! (It'll be even better in the dead of winter). And the fact that it comes in nespresso pods that I can just drop into my machine means I can get great tasting hot chocolate without any fuss. Recommended.

title: Plant based energy - 50 calories - 11 grams of carbs
text: Refreshing drink with a boost of natural energy derived from plants (caffeine from green coffee and green tea). Contains beet sugar and other natural flavors for 11 grams of carbs. It tastes good!

title: Good flavor - refreshing - plant based
text: Refreshing drink with a boost of natural energy derived from plants (caffeine from green coffee). Contains beet sugar and British Rasberry for 11 grams of carbs. It tastes good!

title: Tasty and refreshing
text: This "Dr Better" is a tasty and refreshing substitute for classic Dr Pepper, sweetened with pure cane sugar and no artificial flavors - and it tastes great. It's close enough to the classic drink taste that you'll forget you're drinking a substitute. Recommended.

title: Refreshing and healthy herbal drink
text: Tasty herbal drink. Has a light fruity flavor with a hint of ginger. The calorie count is 50 and there's 13 grams of carbs. No caffeine - no gluten - there is sugar (13 grams of cane sugar). Refreshing and healthy.

title: Attractive and functional
text: Attractive canister designed for ground coffee. As such, it seals with the screw on lid, but also has a center "plug" in the lid that's rubbery and can be lifted for quick access. To me, that makes this canister useful for many other uses as well (I'm thinking as an oversized sugar bowl). Attractive and functional.

title: 2 varieties of light roast - both are exvellent
text:
I like this approach to coffee for several reasons. 1st - sustainability and organic. Great for both personal and environmental health. 2nd - supports smaller growers. 3rd - its great coffee.

The idea of 2 separate brews to try is great! Both are excellent brews, both are light roasts and the differences between the 2 are subtle, but noticeable and introduce the coffee lover to these subtleties. Both are low acid and flavorful and either would be recommended - but together, there's an added dimension to fine tuning your favorite brew.

title: Great breakfast brew
text: A nice medium roast. Flavor is full and a bit "nutty"... acidity is low - no real bitterness. Would make a great breakfast blend.

title: Swiss water decaf - rich and full flavor
text: Swiss water wash is definitely the preferred method for decaffineation. It's clean and involves no chemicals. As such, this decaf delivers a full and rich brew without the caffeine you'd otherwise have to deal with. I like to take a quality decaf like this and blend it with my caffinated coffee to reduce and control the caffeine and this decaf is rich enough to compete with fully cafinated brews. Nice!

title: Rich and full bodied - nice medium roast
text: This medium roast delivers a full and full bodied brew and is rich enough to compete with a dark roast. Makes a nice breakfast brew. Nice!

title: Rich and full - great breakfast brew
text: Nice deep tones like a dark roast, but smooth and low acidity like a medium roast. The flavor is rich and full.  Makes a great breakfast brew.

title: Tasty and refreshing - low carb
text: Tasty and refreshing. Half tea and half lemonade - these drinks are sweetened with monk fruit, leaving only 5 calories and 1 gram of total carbs per serving making it suitable for keto or most any dieting regiments.

title: Smoothie in a frozen pop
text: These are healthy frozen treats. The ingredients include fruits and veggies. The taste is not super sweet, but is sweet enough to be enjoyable. Zero fat, 30 calories, 8 grams of carbs and 1 gram of fiber.

title: Tasty granola and berry breakfast
text: This is an interesting product. When you first open it, it has the obvious oats and grains, but there mixed in with some powdery looking substance. I poured in some almond milk and mixed it up. This did turn into a mix that wasn't exactly smoothie like (it has granola as it's first ingredient, afterall). But it proved to be tasty, with a fruity taste and crunchy granola texture. It does taste good... and it's certainly easy. Great to have around for a quick breakfast or snack.

title: Excellent vanilla flavor - non dairy creamer
text: This is a tasty coffee creamer. It's made with almond milk, coconut oil and vanilla beans, so there's no dairy products involved. As any good creamer, it see.ed to "tame" the coffee a bit. The vanilla flavoring is good... I snuck some into my wife's morning coffee instead of her usual creamer to see if she'd notice the difference... first sip and her initial comment was: "ooh... that's good!"

title: Tasty fruit drink - natural and organic
text: Tasty fruit juice - all organic blueberry, grapes. This provides associated health benefits as well. Might be a little pricey, but it's quality ingredients are immediately apparent.

title: Tasty and refreshing - great for keto dieters
text: This is a tasty and refreshing drink. Not exactly like the lemonade I grew up with (for one thing, there's no pulp), but still refreshing, none the less. They're sugar free and since they use monk fruit for sweetener, the taste doesn't appear to suffer as a result. 1 gm of carbs makes it ideal for keto dieters (or anyone else, for that matter).

title: Sweetened with monk fruit - 5 calories and 1 gm of carbs - refreshing and only 1 gm of carbs
text: This is a tasty and refreshing drink. Not exactly like the lemonade I grew up with (for one thing, there's no pulp), but still refreshing, none the less. The fact that they're sugar free is important to my wife and since they use monk fruit for sweetener, the taste doesn't appear to suffer as a result. Only 5 calories and 1 gm of carbs makes it ideal for keto dieters (or anyone else, for that matter).

title: An excellent healthy snack
text: These are quite tasty. They're not overpowering with flavor like Doritoes, but rather enjoyable with a pleasant Parmigian taste. As such, they are a much healthier (and to me), a much better tasting snack treat. But for a keto diet, you should know that they tout 7 gms of carbs per serving, but there's 3 servings per bag. I can easily consume a full bag of these in one sitting without much thought. As long as you're aware of that, these are an excellent healthy snack.

title: Fine organic powder - ready to use and tastes great
text: Organic ginger powder ready to use. We've been using it mostly for drinks, making tea and adding to smoothies. It's fine enough to blend easily and it tastes great. Will be ready for our next stir fry.

title: A good strong Italian espresso in compostable pods
text: A good strong italian espresso, moderate in both bitterness and acidity. The flavor is full with character and the pods are compostable. I did have one get hung up in my machine when I was trying to eject it, not sure what that was all about.

title: Rich bold flavor - sealed in its own canister
text: Rich bold flavor sealed in its own canister for freshness. This dark roast is ground and displays appropriatte acidity and suitable for a great after dinner brew.

title: Full flavor sealed in metal tin
text: A true medium roast - a decaf full of flavor with minimal acidity, sealed in a metal canister to preserve freshness even after its opened. Great for an evening cup of Joe without losing any sleep.

title: Great after dinner brew
text: Full bodied flavor. Fresh medium roast - and organic. Smooth and rich - great after dinner brew.

title: Rich and smooth
text: Nice medium roast. Flavor is rich and full, acidity is minimal. Great after dinner brew.

title: Nice vanilla flavored powdered creamer
text: Tasty French vanilla flavored creamer in powdered form. Readily mixes in hot coffee without clumping and imparts a nice vanilla flavoring while "taming" the coffee's bite.

title: Tasty drink - organic ingredients
text: Very tasty - all organic blueberry and sauvignion blanc juice. Contains the health benefits in a tasty drink.

title: Smooth and balanced - an excellent breakfast brew
text: This medium roast blend of whole beans is done right. The brew is smooth and balanced and the flavor full and 5asty. Not too acidic or bitter, this makes an excellent breakfast brew.

title: Tastes great in milk (including almond milk)
text: I first tried this organic coco powder by putting some in my morning coffee. It was nice... but then I tried mixing it in a cup of warm almond milk. Wow! It was great! They describe it as spicy, but I didn't find anything overbearing about it, it's taste is pleasant. In milk, it really tastes good.

title: Smooth and rich - an excellent brew
text: Excellent brew! Medium roast whole beans, done properly. The taste is smooth and rich - not too acidic, it's great for breakfast or an after dinner drink. Recommended.

title: Sweetened with Stevia and 1 gram of sugar - light and refreshing
text: Sweetened with Stevia and 1 gram of sugar, is a light and refreshing coconut water beverage packaged for kids. It's certainly healthier than soda, and just sweet enough to appeal.

title: Pleasant flavorful brew
text: A different kind of brew. When you first open it, the aroma you notice reminds me of a popular flavored pipe tobacco I used to get (with coffee smell replacing the tobacco part). After brewing, I was pleasantly presented with a smooth a tasty brew, well rounded, low acidity. It's a pleasant after dinner brew.

title: Smooth, well rounded brew
text: Smooth and well rounded taste. This medium roast is fresh and flavorful, not bitter or too acidic, it's a great breakfast brew.

title: A healthy drink that tastes great
text: Very refreshing, all natural ingredients. The pineapple tastes great (real pineapple). Sweetened with natural (non sugar) sweeteners like Stevie, monkfruit and erithritol. A healthy drink that tastes great.

title: Smooth and flavorful - moderately acidic and full of character
text: This is an excellent coffee. I've had the pleasure of trying several of the Tresso coffees, and I think this may be my favorite. Smooth and tasty, moderately acidic (just enough for character). The bag says it's European processed - I'm not sure what that means, but it results in an excellent brew. Recommended.

title: Smooth and pleasant brew - somewhat acidic
text: This is called a medium roast using a yellow honey. According to the label, it has to do with sun drying (as opposed to being flavored with honey). They describe fruity notes, and I agree. There is a fair amount of acidity, but still generally a smooth and pleasant brew.

title: Tasty and refreshing - health benefits as well as concerns.
text: This is a tasty and refreshing Yerba mate drink. Theres lots of stated health benefits,, such as: It's said to boost energy and mental focus as well as being rich in antioxidants. On the down side, some research says its made from leaves where too much can be carcinogenic. The amount of consumption required for it to be a concern is way more than anyone would likely consume, but still something to consider. It is tasty and refreshing.

title: Great for kids
text: Seems fairly sweet to me, but otherwise very good flavor. I think kids would love it.

title: Convenient and tasty - keep one in your purse or pocket - great tea anytime
text: If you like Arizona tea (which I do), you'll like this drink. It's a handy "mio-like" container that you can toss in your purse or pocket, then squirt it into plain water, and suddenly you've got Arizona tea. This is green tea with honey and ginseng, the taste is good and the delivery is convenient.

title: Smooth rich flavor - true medium roast
text: Smooth rich coffee - accurately labeled as medium roast. The beans are moderately dark with little "oiliness" in appearance. Flavor is smooth and rich, with just a hint of bitterness. Recommended.

title: Light and refreshing - natural and organic
text: Having tried various flavors, I'm becoming a big fan of Honest tea. Natural, organic, no ingredients that you can't pronounce. And they taste great - cool and refreshing. This variety pack has 3 different flavors to try. Light and efreshing!

title: Smooth cinnamon roast
text: Nice smooth and moderately bold flavor. The beans appear to be a medium dark roast and would serve as a tasty breakfast blend or a nice after dinner brew. Nice!

title: Healthy and flavorful - unique and refreshing fruit juice
text: This is really good fruit juice - loaded with antioxidants and no added sugars, it's still sweet and tasty (very fruity tasting). Definitely recommended.

title: Refreshing and healthy drink
text: Great tasting and refreshing. Simple, natural ingredients. Not too sweet.

title: Great for baking and breading for low carb recipes
text: Great for low carb diets. I've used this for everything from bread to breading pork chops (I mix with Parmigiano and egg). It tastes great - adds a slightly nutty taste and low carb too.

title: A lot of character - full intense flavor with some chocolaty bitterness
text: This has the appearance of a medium dark roast. As a brew, it's exactly as they describe in the product description. It has a full bodied flavor, with a bit of chocolate like bitterness - much like you'd get from a good espresso. In spite of this, acidity is relatively low. This coffee has a lot of character.

title: Great full flavor in medium roast decaf.
text: Organic Peruvian coffee - decaffeinated with Swiss water wash method, keeping all the harmful chemicals out and all the flavor remains. This is the proper way to decafinate coffee. Recommended.

title: Pure and natural organic green tea - refreshing and great taste
text: Just great tasting green tea and some lemon along with malic acid. This organic drink is light and refreshing - pure and natural.

title: Great taste - refreshing organic tea
text: I've tried several of the "Honest" teas. They're all light and refreshing - but the mango flavored is my favorite. Just a hint of flavoring along with organic cane sugar brings out the delicious taste of the tea. All organic, it's a great refreshing drink

title: Refreshing tea - great refreshing taste - organic
text: This is great tea. All organic, it's pure and refreshing. Great light taste - reccommended!

title: Dark and oily - great tasting coffee
text: Great dark roast. Full bodied and full flavored without the acidity. The beans are beautiful, dark and oily, just like a dark roast should be. Great tasting coffee!

title: Fresh and full flavored medium roast
text: Smooth and full flavored medium roast. Low acidity - perfect for a fuller bodied breakfast brew.

title: Nicw medium roast - great breakfast brew
text: This whole bean coffee from Rwanda is a true medium roast. It's organic with a taste thats smooth and pleasant,  low in acid with a slight hint of bitterness. Great for a breakfast brew.

title: Bold dark taste - compostable pods
text: Bold dark roast from Uganda. The taste is pure dark roast with a deep rich flavor and a slight hint of bitterness. The pods themselves are compostable and eco friendly- they work flawlessly with my nespresso machine.

title: Great flavor from a light roast
text: I'm normally more of a darker roast kind of a guy, but heard good things about this coffee and wanted to give it a try. It's good - surprisingly full flavored and nicely balanced. It's organic (that's important to me) and all sourcing info and dates provided. A great light roast!

title: Refreshing light taste with antioxidants
text: These are great tasting drinks. Suptle peach flavor without overwhelming sugary taste. They're refreshing and enjoyable, with the added benefit of providing antioxidants as you might get from wine (these do not taste like wine).

title: Full dark and robust
text: This is full bodied medium-dark roast coffee that shows visible signs of the roast with oily dark appearance. The flavor is full and dark, robust and toasty. Very nice!

title: High quality energy drink/mineral water
text: As you might expect from Perrier, these are high quality energy drinks that include Yerba mate, green coffee and a pleasant tangerine flavor. They do have caffeine (similar to a cup of coffee). The flavor is not overpowering, and the taste is essentially an effervescent mineral water with a light refreshing flavoring.

title: Rich and flavorful - a great coffee
text: Listed as a medium dark roast, these beans even look rich and flavorful, almost like a dark roast. The flavor is rich, smooth and pleasant. A great coffee. Highly recommended.

title: Rich and full flavor in compostable pod
text: Nice rich and smooth flavor. These pods are fully compatible with nespressp machine and deliver a great tasting espresso in a compostable pod. My only nit is the lack of marking on the pods makes keeping track of which is which in a storage rack is difficult. Otherwise, great product!

title: Rich Columbian brew in compostable nespresso pods
text: Nice full bodied nespresso. I tend to drink regular drip coffees in the morning and the richer nespressos in the evening. This Columbian coffee comes in compostable pods - they function as they should in my machine and provide a good rich flavorful brew. Would prefer some kind of marking to distinquish the individual pods when organized in my pod rack, otherwise, these are great. Recommended

title: Flavorful Columbian brew without the caffeine
text: Nice full bodied decaf for nespresso. I tend to drink regular drip coffees in the morning and the richer nespressos in the evening. Thats when it pays to keep high quality decaf available. This Columbian decaf comes in compostable pods - they function as they should in my machine and provide a good rich flavorful brew without all the caffeine. Recommended

title: Medium roast organic - nice flavor from Peru
text: I'm not sure what "shade grown" is supposed to do for coffee, but this Peruvian organic medium roast does come off with a nice full and pleasant taste. As a medium roast, I typically expect a slightly darker bean and a hint of visible oiliness  this seems a little light in this regard, but the flavor still comes through. Recommended.

title: Don't care for the taste - way too pricey
text: The ingredients are of good quality, but the taste turned me off. I don't know if its the rose petals or the aloe, but it seems more perfumy than refreshing. And of course, at this price, its difficult to justify anyway.

title: Quality ingredients, light refreshing taste - way too pricey
text: These have a slightly sweet flavor that hints of mango. The mind rejuvenation thing aside, this is a plenty refreshing drink. But the ingredients, while commendable in their healthy considerations, to me, just don't warrant this kind of price.

title: Great flavor in convenient squirt bottles
text: My wife loves this stuff. She keeps it in her purse at all times, then when we're out, and she gets water, out comes the Mio. A quick squirt and she's drinking a tasty flavored beverage. Its highly concentrated, so the containers can be small, but still flavor a lot of water. Definitely recommended.

title: Light and refreshing
text: Full of organic ingredients (including organic cane sugar), its a light, refreshing drink that perks you up like a tea. The flavor is more "delicate" than I expected and that adds to its refreshing taste. Kinda pricey, but otherwise recommended.

title: Smooth rich flavor
text: This is good rich coffee. The color and "oiliness" suggest a medium-dark roast and the flavor is smooth, rich and fruity, without bitterness. Nice! Recommended.

title: Nice medium roast "everyday" espresso
text: Nice moderate intensity espresso (intensity level 6). The flavor is brighter than some (as you would expect from a medium roast) and makes an excellent "everyday" espresso. The crema is nicely formed and even presents well. Capsules work perfectly in my machine. Recommended.

title: Healthy alternative to creamer - has a coconut taste
text: This organic coffee creamer is based in coconut. It offers a healthy alternative to ordinary creamers providing mct's as does most coconut oils. This creamer has a coconut taste, and will flavor your coffee accordingly. It's a pleasant taste, but if you dislike coconut, you likely won't like this.

title: Chocolate milk in a can - rich and creamy taste - lactose free
text: I wasn't sure what to expect from "Draft Chocolate Milk" in a can. But what I got, was rich, creamy chocolate milk! It tastes great. It even has a little head of foam on it when you pour it in a glass. Thats likely a result of the food grade nitrous oxide they use in proccessing. The description is a little confusing because it mentions coffee, but there's no coffee listed in the can's ingredients... I think it must be a generic write up that didn't get completely updated, because they have other offerings that are coffee based. Lactose free for easy digestion... It's good!

title: Pure blueberry extract - excellent taste
text: The flavor is excellent. I love blueberries and this is pure blueberry - properly ripened, with all the goodness and nothing artificial. My only complaint is that the bottles are so small (you'll want more).

title: Light refreshing taste in a canned kombucha
text: This is a nice kombucha. A refreshing alternative to soda pop, it claims to have no sugar... of course, there was some amount of sugar to facilitate the fermentation, but there's no sugar remaining after that. The taste is good, served up in cans in 8.5 oz servings. Recommended.

title: Smooth, full body flavor - ethically sourced organic
text: Ethically sourced - organic. The things to look for in premium coffee. This coffee has the darker, slightly oily appearance of a medium dark roast and the flavor to match. Its smooth, low acidic and full bodied. Definitely recommended.

title: Velvety smooth - intensity level 8
text: This is the one. Velvet is an appropriate name for this brew. Intensity level 8, its got a bold, rich flavor- yet its smooth... low acid, nice cream. Definitely recommended!

title: Full bodied and bold - Italian espresso with nespresso convenience
text: I don't know if there really is such a thing as an "Italian taste" in espresso, but if there is, this would be it. To me, it seems well suited to the cuisine of fine Italian dining. The taste is full bodied and bold, while mild to moderate in acidity and only a hint of bitterness. Of course, it fits the nespresso machine perfectly. Recommended.

title: A true medium roast - a smooth and pleasant morning brew
text: Made a pot of this coffee this morning. Right off the bat, I ripped open the bag was immediately greeted by a rich coffee aroma. A closer look showed beans that are a true and proper medium roast (lighter color and less oily in appearance). The resulting brew was excellent - with a smooth and earthy flavor, low acidity... this is a pleasant morning brew. Nice!

title: Flavorful half calf
text: This coffee is smooth and low in acid. With a dark roast you'll see beans that are dark and only and a medium roast will have beans that are lighter and dryer. This is called a "medium dark", but I'd say it leans a little toward medium. Beans are fresh, taste is good and full - and feature reduced caffeine. Recommended.

title: Organic and tasty - vanilla flavored
text: Organic coconut cream and almond milk. Vanilla flavored and no sugar added. This plant based creamer is ideal for keto diets with 0 carbs. The flavor is good, too. My wife normally just uses a little almond milk in her coffee, but I know she loves vanilla, so today I surprised her with some of this. She really enjoyed it. Recommended.

title: Rich dark roast flavor - biodegradable pods
text: This is a premium dark roast coffee with a bold and dark taste (intensity 10). The flavor is full bodied, just as described. The pods fit perfectly in my DeLongie Nespresso machine and are biodegradable. They're formulated for espresso sized drinks, but I tried on lungo setting anyway, it still retained its rich dark flavor. Recommended for lovers of a rich dark roast espresso.

title: Moist and tasty - keto friendly
text:
These are tasty cookies. Excellent for keto dieters. This uses allulose along with monkfruit for sweetening. Allulose is not something I had heard of, so I did a little research. Its apparently derived from fructose, but is a simple sugar that won't be absorbed, therefore, it doesn't spike sugars, (low glycemic index). Its low calorie and with no fermentation in the gut, it doesn't cause bloating. Nice!

As for the cookies, they were easy to make, add an egg, some vanilla, and some butter. Mix it up and scoop it out, you're ready to bake. The label says 12-15 minutes, I set my timer to 14 minutes and it was probably too much. The cookies themselves were charred on the bottoms... but still moist and cake like in the center. The taste and texture was good. We'll be buying some more of these.

My one complaint - the label has fine printing that's light and difficult to read. I had to take a picture, the zoom in on that to read it.

title: Dark roast espresso infused with ginseng - intensity 9/10
text: Nice bold nespresso biodegradable pods with ginseng. The coffee itself is full bodied (intensity 9/10) and the pods themselves work perfectly with my nespresso machine. The benefits of ginseng are many - heart and brain function, antioxidant properties, etc. Infusing ginseng into a nespresso pod is a great idea. Recommended.

title: Full bodied flavor - thick crema - l- theanin and green tea for focus and clarity
text: Nespresso coffee pods with Arabica beans infused with green tea and l-theanine for focused and clarity. This dark roast coffee (intensity 9/10) is full bodied and flavorful. Infusing with green tea and l-theaninw is a great way to get the benefits of those items while enjoying your espresso. Pods are biodegradable and function perfectly with my nespresso machine. Nice full crema from this brew... recommended.

title: Full bodied - smooth - zero acidity - biodegradable pods
text:
I have to admit, this is probably the smoothest, least acidic coffee I've ever had. There is absolutely no bitterness what-soever. The taste is still rich and boasts of all the familiar claims... full bodied, earthy, chocolate overtones, beautiful thick crema... and in this case, they're all actually present. There is absolutely no acidity (that I can discern) and I can honestly say that its one of the finer coffees I've had. However, at these prices, you have to ask yourself if its worth it. Would I pay $35-$50 per cup for coffee? No... but if you're willing to spend that kind of money, this may be the coffee for you.

Another point in its favor is that it comes in biodegradable pods... an important consideration, as far as I'm concerned. And the pods function perfectly with my nespresso machine. I'm thrilled to have been able to give it a try, but for the price, I'd certainly return for more, time and again.

Perhaps I'll reserve this for particularly special occasions... an anniversary? (My wife enjoyed it too)

title: Unique taste - salt & seaweed - source of trace minerals - organic
text: These are different. Its actually popcorn with sea lettuce seasoning in it (sesame flavored). They have a very unique taste... you can definitely taste the seaweed and salt. They do include important trace minerals from the seaweed and they're certified organic.

title: The smell is amazing! This is the real deal!
text: the see e vanilla beans smell amazing! I love vanilla (who doesn't?) And these are the real deal! My wife plans on using them for homemade vanilla extract, which should turn out great, if the beans are any indication. Highly recommended!

title: Full flavor - intensity 9/10 - includes probiotic
text: Great idea. Probiotics infused into a nespresso pod. Strong coffees can sometimes cause digestive issues... why not include the digestive support right in the coffee itself. I can't say for certain that its the result of the digestive support in the coffee, but I can say that I haven't had any digestive issues while consuming this. I can also speak to the flavor and packaging. The taste is good. Its a dark roast with intensity rating of 9/10. I also like the fact that the pods are biodegradable rather than the usual aluminum. My only nit is I wish they would print the information about the coffee on the cover of the pod so I can tell them from others in my storage bin.

title: Full flavor with half the caffeine
text: Good flavor with half the caffeine. I drink a lot of coffee, enough that I often resort to reduced caffeine blends to avoid sleeping problems. This coffee provides a ready made solution. Its a dark roast and as you'd expect, its beans are dark and shiny (plenty of oils on the surface of the beans). The flavor is full and enjoyable. Recommended.

title: Tasty Earl Grey with Saffron - organic!
text: Classic Earl Grey tea but with an added twist - saffron. This tasty tea is a delight first thing in the morning... with a full, fresh, clean taste and the added benefits of saffron. My wife and I both enjoy this tea. An important feature for us is that its certified organic. Recommended.

title: Great taste - natural flavors (bits of spple, second, etc.)
text: This is a tasty treat! Granola always tastes like oats (which is why I like it), but this also has tastes of apples, almonds and a nice honey. These aren't just flavors, there's little bits of apple and almond in there. This would be great on top of yogurt, except that I keep reaching in for "one more little handful". Great taste!

title: Strong intensity 12 - good flavor - in biodegradable pods
text: It says extra strong and they're right! Intensity level is 12. The flavor is good - complex for such a strong blend. There's a hint of bitterness - typical of a strong blend. The capsules are biodegradable - always a plus, in my book. My only nit is that I wish they would label individual pods so I can tell the various flavors/intensities apart inside my pod case.

title: A decent snack with good flavor - approximates pork rinds
text: These are not pork rinds, but a close approximation. The flavors are good and in fact, if your a little put off by that pork rind smell, these could by a good choice. The texture, like the taste, is a close approximation, though just a little heavier. The bags in this 3 pack are not all that big and it seems the price may be a little high for what you get. All in all, a decent snack.

title: Great sugar substitute - No unpleasant aftertaste
text: Only slightly less sweet than regular sugar, it makes a great substitute since its zero calories and almost no carbs. (Suitavle for keto diets). Unlike other sugar substitutes, this leaves no unpleasant aftertaste. I use it in my morning coffee (and I'm picky about my coffee)

title: Delicious herbal iced tea - simple - refreshing
text: This is a great herbal tea. I wouldnt call it strong or bold, the flavor is actually light and somewhat delicate - and very refreshing. I like to put a touch of sweetener in (erythritol). The packages come as oversized tea bags that you simply drop into a pitcher of water. Almost immediately you'll see the steeping action as the water starts turning a beautiful deep red shade. Come back a little while later to enjoy a delicious refreshing treat. Nice!

title: Compostable pods work perfect, taste great! Guilt free nespresso!
text: Wasn't sure what to expect from these nespresso compatible coffee pods in compostable material. Where Nespresso brand pods are sluminum, which I assumed would be needed for proper pressure induced coffees, but apparently not. These pods performed well... exactly as they're supposed to, and the resulting coffee came out delicious, nice crema- the whole bit. Add the compostable consideration, and its guilt free nespresso all the way! Recommended!

title: Spoon for spoon - a direct substitute for sugar
text: They got it right! I've been using erythritol in my coffee for awhile now, and it's pretty good... not quit as sweet as regular sugar, but low on the glycemic index, so no sugar spikes! My wife uses monkfruit, which is extremely sweet and also healthier than sugar. This sweetener is a combination of the teo, and it does sweeten like sugar, spoon for spoon... it evenooks like sugar, but of course, much healthier. Recommended!

title: Rich and aromatic blend - this is good coffee!
text: This is excellent coffee. You can spot a medium roast right out of the bag by its "dryer" look, even my grinder can tell the difference... oiler dark roasts stick to the bottom. But they've got this medium roast right. The rich aroma hits you when you open it and remains through the brew. Rich and chocolaty notes, with minimal acidity. I like a good coffee... and this is good coffee!

title: Bad experience - leaky lid and product seemed spoiled
text:
I was looking forward to trying this juice - pomogranites are obviously loaded with all sorts of nutrients and this juice has nothing extra added. But the package arrived with one of the 2 bottles with a leaking cap and about a third of the juice had leaked out into the surrounding plastic wrap. The paper labels and the cardboard insert were covered in mold. That leaky jar went straight into the trash. I cleaned off the outside of the second jar and scraped off the label, (without breaking the seal on the lid) then put the jar in the fridge for a few days, just to make certain there would be no problems before opening it. Today, after careful inspection, I opened that 2nd bottle and poured myself a glass. First off, it was very cloudy (all the photos show it as somewhat clear), then when I took a sip, it tasted like it may have gone bad... including a hint of a vinegar taste.

It seems like it should be a great product, and I hate to give a negative review, but my experience was very bad. That second bottle is heading for the trash now, too. Perhaps they should rethink their packaging? I don't know. But I can't recommend this product based on my experience.

title: Super sweet- a little goes a long way
text: This stuff is really sweet - a little goes a long way. But at zero calories, this is perfect for anyone watching their weight. You can put it in your coffee or in a recipe. Too much and you'll tastes the stevia but in proper "small" amounts, its great.

title: smooth and rich flavor - very low acidity - nice!
text: The description says medium roast, but the bag says dark. The beans themselves are dark and oily, attesting to the dark roast descriptor. Im generally a medium roast person due to acidity, but i have to say, this decaf provides a smooth and rich tasting brew with very low acidity. This is excellent coffee. Highly recommended.

title: Great aroma - mild flavor
text: The flavor is good, but not overwhelming. Upon first opening, I was greeted by the wonderful scent of cinnamon, then took a pinch to taste, and found it to be rather mild. I think this would be great from cooking and topping breads and cereals.

title: A healthy "creamer" - mct powder that's vitamin fortified
text: Packed with organic nutrients and coconut materials oil, this is a healthy way to supplement your morning coffee. My wife normally takes liquid mct oil and almond milk in her coffee, and she likes the flavor of this "creamer". I normally take my coffee black and when I tried adding this, I didn't care for the taste. Theres no question in my mind this is a healthy product, but if you normally drink your coffee black, you may not care for the taste.

title: Healthy ingredidients - excellent flavor - recommended!
text: These snack bars are very good. The ingredient list shows mostly healthy seeds and nuts (flaxseed, sesame seed and chia seed) along with the primary "nut" (cashews for some flavors, almond for others.) All of these ingredients are organic. Additionally, there is organic cane sugar syrup, cassava syrup and sea salt... these, of course give it a slightly sweeter taste. The sweetness is definitely not overdone and merely serves to enhance the other flavors. As such, the total carbs per serving (1 bar equals 1 serving) is a reasonable 12 grams (cashew flavored) and 10 grams (almond flavored). With 3 grams of fiber, that brings the net carb count down to 9 and 7 grams respectively. Not great for a keto diet, but not terribly bad, either. Considering the healthy ingredients and the exceptional flavor, I definitely recommend these snack bars.

title: Nice and meaty - makes great tomatoes soup/pouree
text: I like to use roma tomatoes for tomato soup. I've got a great recipe and these tomatoes are nice and meaty, so the resulting soup is nice and thick. They're tasty, too.

title: Works great as a cooking spray - tastes great and healthy
text: This is a great substitute for cooking spray. I spray it on my "griddle skillet" and it does a fine job of keeping meats or burrito wraps from sticking. Instead of loads of chemicals, im getting a small bit of healthy avocado oil. Tastes great and good for you.

title: nice steaks - tender and tasty
text: I wasn't sure what to expect from these pre packaged steakz... especially since I had them delivered and couldn't pick them out for myself. But I have to say I was pleasantly surprised. These were Nicely marbled, not too much or too little... they were tasty, tender, they grilled up nicely. I couldn't have picked out nicer steaks if I had picked them out personally.

title: Sweet, juicy - and organic.
text: I really like kiwi, I really am clumsy when I try to peel it. These kiwi pieces are excellent! Sweet, juicy... and they're ready to eat! On top of all that, they're organic... I'll definitely be ordering more of this!

title: Very tasty
text: Very tasty granola snack with tastes of coffee and chocolate. The label describes it as organic and the list of ingredients are generally good... it does contain soy lecithin, if that's a concern. Serving size is listed as 1/4 cup - Carb count is 21 grams, with 3 grams of fiber... considerably high if you're doing a low carb diet.

title: Excellent blend of various flavored peppers
text: I'm not a pepper expert, but I know enough to know theres subtle differences in the various colors. When you have a mix like this, you get a complex blend of peppery flavors that really brings food to life. This is good stuff... and it looks good in a glass pepper mill, too. Definitely recommended.

title: No acidity, just smooth rich flavor
text: This is some good, flavorful coffee. It seems like decafs often lack more than just caffeine, but this is a full bodied coffee. The beans seem to ha e a slight bit of an oily appearance, which suggest to me a medium roast or darker, but theres no excess acidity - just rich flavor. Recommended.

title: Tasty cinnamon - similar price to big brands
text: Ahh cinnamon, one of my favorite spices. I use it on oatmeal, on dehydrated apples, on baked goods and sometimes just buttered toast. As for taste and the quality of the grind, etc. I'd say this Happy Belly cinnamon is on a par with the big brands, although, looking at the price, it looks like it's not any cheaper (more than some). I recommend it, but it may not be cheaper than the big brands like as generic would.

title: Healthy suppliment for a keto based (low carb) diet
text: My wife has been having a lot of success with the keto diet. An important part of her strategy is to suppliment her own nutritional needs (and fat intake) with healthy stuff like this mct oil. It's derived from coconut oil and is in liquid form - this makes it easy to simply add to her morning cup of coffee. She loves it... and the results of her efforts are unmistakable. Recimmended.

title: Sturdy metal pod drawer - looks good and holds 4 sleeves of pods
text: Nice coffee pod holder - perfectly suited for nespresso originals. There's four rows, each row holds 10 pods (1 sleeve) for a total of 40 (4 sleeves). Its made  with a sturdy steel top and screening for the sides and bottom. The drawer slides smoothly for quick access to your favorite nespresso brews, and it's sturdy enough to support a coffeemaker or accesories on top, so it doesnt use up any extra counter space. Nice.

title: It tastes good - but its unbelievably sweet!
text:
This monk fruit extract is unbelievably sweet! I threw out the first cup of coffe I put it in... then tried using an 1/8th tspn in a second cup and it was still sweeter than I like it. When I had too much in there, there was a bit of an aftertaste, but that seemed to go away with more normal use. Mixing it into my coffee took a little stirring, but did blend in with a little effort. It should do well in recipes.

Overall, I'd say the taste was good, but i dont know how you'd accurately convert from sugar... it literally takes a "pinch" (a very small pinch). Since it's so much sweeter than sugar, a very minor change in your "pinch" could result in very major changes in your sweetness level. It would definitely take a lot of trial and error to get used to using it.

title: Subtle nutty flavor for your favorite recipe
text: These sesame seeds are a great addition to your favorite stir fry.... My wife has been using them in home made bread... I like to sprinkle some in my salad. They add a subtle nutty flavor. Tasty.

title: Not very hot - tastes good
text: As a "medium" salsa, I was expecting this to be a bit hotter. I tried the mild too, and both are tasty, but this one is only slightly hotter than the mild. Maybe that's a good thing, I dont know, but I was expecting more heat. Otherwise, it's got a good flavor.

title: Definitely, mild - not very chunky
text: This is a tasty salsa... definitely mild and not very chunky, but the taste is there. If you like a milder salsa, you will like this. If you're looking for something spicy, you may want to look elsewhere. I like it

title: Tasty tiny treats - chocolate with honey almond nougat
text: These Toblerone tiny chocolate bars are a tasty treat. 3 flavors, milk chocolate, dark chocolate and white chocolate... all three enhanced with honey almond nougat, none of them are strictly pure chocolate. I had not had white chocolate in years, simply because I've always found it just too sweet.... but in this format, these are really tasty without overwhelming sweetness. Very good!

title: Nice rounded flavor - minimal carbs
text: This pasta sauce from Happy Belly is actually really good. It's not overly spicy or garlicky- it's meat flavored instead and nicely rounded in flavor. My wife's on a low carb diet and this suits her nicely (8 gr of net carbs). For dinner tonight, we made some shiritake noodles alongside some zucchini noodles... then topped it with this sauce and sprinkled some parmesan over everything. Excellent! (Even the wife liked it!)

title: Decent coffee - slight bitter taste
text: These beans are definitely a light roast... you can tell by the not so shiny appearance (oils come out more with a longer roast). The flavor was good... but there seemed a slight bit of bitterness... One of the reasons i like light roast is the smooth non-bitter taste. This coffee is smooth... but the bitter taste let me down. Overall, it's a decent coffee...

title: Tasty treat - 9 net carbs per serving
text: These are actually pretty good. They're not overly sweet and that's probably why theres not an overpowering stevia aftertaste (only a very slight one). My wife loves Lily's dark chocolate for her lower carb sweets and I suspect these would be even better if dark chocolate were used instead of milk chocolate. As it is, each serving (2 pieces) is 9 net carbs. Not bad...

title: Fresh whole peppercorns - perfect for spicing up your favorite recipes
text: Fresh, whole peppercorns properly sealed at a reasonable price. These are perfect for my pepper mill and nicely spice my recipes. Nice!

title: Turmeric and black pepper - natural anti inflamatory
text: I finally discovered turmeric for my arthritic back pain. It works as a natural anti inflammatory agent and when combined with black pepper, it absorbs more efficiently. These capsule contain 700 mg of turmeric along with 5 mg of black pepper. A winning combination (I normally take 600 mg turmeric with 5 mg black pepper).

title: 2 ingredients - almonds and flax - healthy nut butter
text: This is a tasty, healthy spread. It's got 2 ingredients, almond and flax... and that's how it should be. (No extra preservatives or chemicals with names you cant pronounce). It does seperate, just like pure peanut butter, and you do need to stir it before use, but that's not a big deal. If you're expecting a peanut butter taste, you may be disappointed, it has a taste of it's own. Personally, I like it. I tried it on a sandwich of whole grain bread, with some honey and it made a great healthy alternative to the old standard p.b.&j.

title: Smooth rich flavor - aluminum pods
text: Wow! They call this Satinato and that's a great name for it. It's that smooth. No bitternesswhatsoever. Just rich coffee taste. The aluminum pods work flawlessly in my machine and the intensity rating of 6 seems right on the mark. Highly recommended!

title: Rich medium roast - fresh whole beans
text: Nice rich medium roast coffee. I always like to see a little shine on coffee beans that I'm about to grind. It means theres still plenty of the flavorful oils in the beans and a good sign of freshness. After brewing, you might even see a slight hint of that oil on the brew itself. That's what we have here. Great coffee - recommended.

title: Tasty flavored salt
text: This flavored salt is actually very tasty. I used some yesterday on some dehydrated kale. It really made my little snack special. Very nice!

title: Rich arabica - full flavor - intensity of 10
text:
It's 100% arabica with an intensity level of 10. I've been drinking a couple of these per day, for a couple of days, now. It is good coffee and even with the high intensity level, it seems to still be smooth - I like my nespresso in the form of latte macchiato and this coffee comes off as full and rich.

The pods are plastic with foil over both ends (instead of the aluminum of the nespresso pods). But I dont think that makes any difference, my machine have been handling them flawlessly (so far).

I did try a straight espresso (lungo, actually) using one of these pods and the results were still good. Still rich in flavor... intensity typical of a 10... and slightly bitter (as I expected it would be without the milk). The natural crema was nice and thick. Recommended.

title: Organic cocoa powder - nothing else - tasty!
text:
The ingredients list says "organic cocoa powder". That's it... nothing else. That's as it should be! Its package says its non-gmo, vegan and vegetarian friendly, etc. All the right things. It's a very fine powder and when I tried mixing some in my coffee, it mixed right in... no pockets or bubbles to break up, no gritty ring around my cup. And it's tasty!

My wife's doing the keto diet thing and the low net carbs makes it a perfect additive for flavoring her homemade treats. Recommended!

title: Rich and sweet. Individually wrapped squares
text: Good candy... delicious milk chocolate with toasted coconut. It gives it a nice little crunch... sweet and rich. Individually wrapped squares. If you like chocolate, you'll like these.

title: Smooth - pleasant - medium roast
text: Okay, I'm one of those people that starts my day. Everyday, by making a pot of coffee. I've learned over the years that "breakfast blend" usually means mild, smooth, not acidic, etc. Its usually a "pleasant" cup of coffee. And that's exactly what we have here. I suppose that if you wanted something stronger, you could just use more coffee, but I doubt the "pleasant" nature of this roast could be altered. I like it... and I definitely recommend it.

title: Great seed mix - spicy fiesta flavor okay
text: This seed blend has all the earmarks of a healthy and tasty snack. Suitable for topping a salad or as I like to do, just grabbing a handful for a snack. The label lists 5 ingredients and spices... I have to say, the ingredients are great, but the spices are a bit much for me. I'm sure this is personal preference at play, but the "spicy fiesta" flavor strikes me as having a bit of a chipotle taste... perhaps some cumin in there, theres definitely a hint of jalapeno. I'm sure this will be enjoyed by many, but for me, this particular flavor may end up serving as a salad topping rather than a standalone snack.

title: Keebler snack cracker packs!
text: Keebler classics! Who doesnt like a Keebler snack cracker? This box is full of 50 packages in 3 different flavors... cheese crackers with peanut butter, club crackers with cheddar and toast with peanut butter. All packed for a quick drop in your purse or somebodies lunch pail. Good stuff!

title: Relaxing, all natural tea
text:
Had some of this last night. The "relax" flavor is pretty tasty. It includes a whole host of various natural ingrediants, including apple, hibiscus, carrots, orange, lemongrass, eucalyptus, etc. There's nothing caffeinated, and in fact, this warm brew actually did seem rather relaxing.

The only bit would be that some of the "bits" were rather large. My tea diffusers are only about an inch round and it was a little clumsy squeezing this tea in. Otherwise, nice relaxing tea.

title: Made for some tasty chicken salad
text:
Wasn't sure what to do with chicken in a can, so I did what I often do with tuna in a can - make a power salad!

First, I popped the top and forked out the chicken, shredded it and mixed in some mayo and pickle relish to get chicken salad. Then I spooned that on top of some cut up romaine. Added some ground chia seed and flaxseed, then topped with shredded cheddar. It was great!

So this is basically just white meat chicken... no chemicals or preservatives. It says its cooked in the can to preserve nutrients. It tasted good... I'd recommend it!

title: Honey and strawberries together - how great is that?
text:
Just got this in and had to give it a try. Two of my favorites, honey and strawberry... how can you go wrong!

This stuff is good... I checked the ingredients: honey, strawberry juice concentrate, strawberries and other natural ingredients. I'm not sure what the other natural ingredients may be, but this list looks pretty clean as far as processed foods go. And of course, Smuckers is brand where you expect good things

This stuff is good! Use it anywhere you would use honey (toast, biscuits, etc)

title: Smooth and tasty - good medium blend

I'm sipping a cup right now as I write this. Good stuff!

title: Sugar free - keto friendly - great taste
text: Okay, first let me admit I'm not exactly a connoisseur of beef jerky. We occasionally grab some when going on a long drive, and that's usually on a whim (usually in a gas station or roadside reststop). I mainly got this because its sugar free and keto friendly. But I have to say, this is really good Jerkey! The flavor is a little strong and the wife wasnt so sure about it... but that flavor is also very good. I've been grabbing little tastes of it here and there for two days now. And enjoying every bite! Most things labeled sugar free seem to have some diminished flavor, but not this. I'd recommend it...

title: Plenty sweet - Stevia aftertaste
text: I mainly got this for my wife who's on a keto (low carb) diet. It promised to be a good a substitute for honey. It does have a honey like flavor, but it also has that stevia aftertaste. If that stevia aftertaste doesnt bother you, youd probably like this honey substitute. I dont like it and my wife only tolerates it. I have to give this 3 stars. Again, if you're okay with stevia, you'll probably like this... it just wasnt for us.

title: Good flavor - healthy choice
text:
Well, I decided to make the chocolate chip cookies... then while they were baking (since the oven was already hot) decided to make the artisan bread... then while that was baking, decided I may as well do the chocolate cake/brownie thing too.

All 3 went pretty much as the directions suggested. Wherever milk was called for, I used almond milk... and where sugar was needed (brownies) I used Swirve. Otherwise, everything according to directions.

The cookies were good, slightly soft and chewy and the chocolate chips were good. The overall sweetness was slightly lacking, but still enjoyable.

The Artisan cake was simalarly good... not much rise (if any) and the bread was dense. Put a few dabs of butter on it and it wasnt bad.

For the chocolate cake - I chose to do the brownie recipe. I baked for 30 minutes at 350. I normally like brownies chewy, these were more cakelike... moist and airy. Still, the flavor was good.

My wife's been on a keto diet and these are a little high in carbs for her liking. But she ate half servings and did just fine. For the record, she really enjoyed these. (Having limited her intake of such things for awhile, now... these were all a treat for her.

For me... I wouldn't say they tasted great... but I would say they were all good. Worthy of a try. If you're doing the keto thing, half servings may be in order. Either way, probably a healthier choice that sugary snacks.
