I purchased this because I had gone through the dried lemon verbena leaves from my sister's northern California garden and enjoy a couple of cups every day after lunch.  I will not repurchase this brand because of the less than stellar flavor, finely chopped leaves and stems, and cost since only one can was received.

title: High percentage of the peanuts are smaller
text: I was expecting The Peanut Shop of Williamsburg Hot Habanero Chile Pepper Nuts to be the same sized large peanuts as The Peanut Shop of Williamsburg peanuts which are lightly salted or unsalted which I purchase in the larger cans.  They are not.  A few are, but a majority in the can are smaller, even rounder in shape.  I've looked at photos on this website of the nuts received by others and have to say that mine are well coated with the hot habanero pepper powder, so they are truly hot, just like the habanero pepper.  Fortunately, I had already eaten a meal, so my innards should not suffer too much, and I take this as a forewarning that they are best consumed with something to help coat the digestive tract.  I'm thinking of using some from this can to make a peanut pie as I think the spices would greatly improve a pie that tends to be very sweet.  This is not a can of peanuts that I will share with the kids because their palates simply won't be able to handle the heat which compliments yet sometimes overwhelms the flavor of the roasted peanuts.  They are not oily.  I just purchased the three can package of The Peanut Shop of Williamsburg Hot Nuts which includes a can of this variety with one each of two other types.  I store opened cans of peanuts in the refrigerator to maintain their freshness.

title: Large anchovies, 8 in a can
text: The label says this can provides about 2 servings of 6 pieces each, however the tins I received contain between 8 and 9 anchovies.  Now this might not be a big deal but if you are purchasing them to put atop a cracker as a tasty appetizer to accompany your cocktails, get extra cans because you'll have less than you planned for.  There is a lot of olive oil with rolled anchovies, each surrounding a caper and I found an extra caper in a couple of the cans.  I saw more can than anchovies and that was not pleasant, but the fish did taste good.

title: Ignore the package portrayal of pistachios
text: I've loved pistachio nuts since tasting my first red one as a kid.  I could not get enough of them and when I discovered pistachio ice cream, that became my flavor of choice.  I looked at the packaging images of these Wonderful Pistachios, Roasted and Salted, 1.5 Ounce Bags, and thought what I was looking at was clear cellophane displaying the nuts inside the bags.  My bad.  The nuts are images created of nuts and not images of nuts.  Yes, these tasted pretty good, even better than that, however, not a single one resembled the images on the bags.  The portion is a good size, even enough to share a few if you're feeling generous, but they are not uniformly sized specimens and they are not consistently roasted.  I'm happy to have purchased this box of 9 individually portioned bags but I'll likely not repurchase and will instead get pistachios which I can actually see to check the quality.

title: Electric Moka performs to the max with this coffee
text: I have an electric Moka machine in which I'd been using the Illy Classico Medium Roast, 100% Arabica Bean Signature Italian Blend, and after depleting the first can, purchased this grind to see if there is a difference.  There is such a miniscule difference that I'll purchase whichever has the better price on the day that I need to order.  I tend to enjoy a thick cup of moka brewed Illy coffee in the late morning and use about a third less coffee than most Italians use and I do not tamp it down.  I also don't close the lid until the coffee starts to appear in the top chamber and it seems to brew faster.

title: A morning favorite
text: I first purchased a smaller bag of ground Kicking Horse Coffee, Kick Ass coffee and liked it so much for the first cups of the day that I purchased this larger bag of whole beans so I can use it in every coffeemaker in the house and share it as well.  It's rich and not overly acidic so it's a great coffee to get the day kicked off.  The beans are not overly oily, yet they are a definite dark roast.  The Indonesian/South American blend is successful in producing easy to drink coffee which doesn't leave the mouth with a coffee film for hours like some other dark roast beans can do  I love coffee but am not keen on coffee breath.

title: Easy drinking
text: Get your Arpeggio capsules from Nespresso and you will be so very happy.  For some unknown reason, these are in a perfect box but some of the capsules are crushed and unusable.  There may be coffee in the box and not in the capsule.  The actual coffee is perfect, easy-drinking, rich, aromatic and it produces a deliciously thick crema, so you want to enjoy each and every capsule that you receive.  Arpeggio is one the top selling varieties and once you've tasted it, you will understand why.

title: Mild canned salmon with bones and skin
text: The large chunks of salmon are packed really well into these 5 serving cans and if the rest of the case is in a similar condition, I'll be happy.  With no added salt, I taste the salmon and nothing but the salmon and I mean all parts of it.  The dog enjoyed a few bits of the skin as I prepared it for us humans and since calcium is a pro for our nutrition, we didn't share with her.  The cans require a can opener, they are not a pull-tab top.  Mine was packed with the top down and therefore since the cans are a little wider at the top than the bottom, the water in which the fish is packed covers more of the salmon.  The interior of the cans are a dark slate color, there is no obvious coating, and there is nothing that addresses BPA on the attached paper label.  The fish was, "pulled from the icy cold Alaskan waters," and they were, "cooked and packed fresh from the boat."  It is indeed a mild wild salmon.  I tried to trace the fish online at their website but the code on the cans is not valid.  It's best by date is 08/20/2022 and about half of the cans have a single tiny dent which is not a big deal for me.  The price changes like crazy on this product so I'd suggest tracking it to see the trend.  There is also a variety with added salt which as of this minute is more affordable.

title: Test bag of ground coffee was a success
text: I first purchased a 10 ounce bag of ground Kicking Horse Coffee, Kick Ass, Dark Roast coffee to see how I liked it before purchasing a larger bag of the whole beans.  I've found the coffee to not be as oily as dark roast coffees I usually prepare, but the flavor and low acid for the roast made for a successful experience and I did purchase a new bag of beans.  I've prepared it by a number of methods and each one was tasty, full-bodied and the aroma was titillatingly inviting.  This is a good selection for the first cup or two of the day and I think folks in an office environment would benefit from sharing a pot of the brew.

title: Finely ground meal has so many uses
text: I've read that corn is actually a vegetable, a whole grain, and a fruit.  Whatever it is, finely stone ground corn meal is a delicious product for yummy cornmeal mush, coating your pizza pan, sprinkling on your loaf of bread before putting it into the oven, or my personal favorite, creating a skillet of corn bread loaded with corn niblets and jalapenos.  I'm becoming a fan of Palmetto Farms after first enjoying their corn grits.  I also love the muslin in which they market the corn.  I put the grits and meal in the freezer in airtight bags to keep them fresh and keep a small amount in the refrigerator in a glass jar.

title: Fresh tasting seeds
text: I've never used the McCormick Culinary series products until this bottle of Mustard seeds and I'm not sure what is the difference between this and the usual bottles of McCormick spices that I purchase, but I like this product.  The seeds are in good shape, the flavor is as expected and the price is competitive for larger amounts of spices and herbs.  It works well not only in everyday uses in individual meals but is very good for producing a jar of mustard to use as a condiment.  I combine mustards and have found this to be a good addition.  I had a question about the best by date which I could not locate and the representative at McCormick was very helpful in deciphering the code for me and confirming that the product was usable.  I've frozen some of the seeds for later use.

title: Difference between this and the Culinary Cumin?
text: I don't know what the difference is between the two available products by McCormick.  Perhaps they are changing the labels for the 14-ounce containers to a Culinary line?  Nevertheless, if you need a lot of cumin, McCormick offers a good quality of the ground cumin seeds.  I don't need this much for my household and should have learned from a previous purchase of a 16-ounce bottle I had to discard by another company because it deteriorated ultra quickly, but the price was great when I purchased this bottle, and since three of us were sharing its contents, it made sense.  We use cumin regularly alone and in home-prepared spice blends so this provided an ample supply at a fraction of the cost of smaller bottles.  Is it as good as the Penzeys Spices ground cumin I usually use?  Possibly.  Is it as good as the cumin seeds I purchased at a local Indian market and ground myself when I'd run out of the Penzeys Spices?  Better.

title: Tastes similar to unsprouted quinoa
text: truRoots is a familiar brand that I have enjoyed for many years.  Usually, I purchase larger packages of the products but decided to try the truRoots Whole Grain Sprouted Quinoa, Certified USDA Organic, Gluten-Free, 12-Ounce Bag to check out a sprouted version of quinoa which I've been preparing for decades.  The seeds are very clean, a definite positive and they cook well.  I personally saw little difference in taste or digestion as compared to other quinoa, just know that this one was a real hit in this household and I'll repurchase.  It was as great as leftovers as the initial meal because I saved some rather than dressing it all at once.

title: Reduced acid in a rich and flavorful coffee
text: Until recently, I much preferred a very strong and rich coffee over a milder one, demonstrative of well into the second crack of the beans during roasting.  I had not drunk Illy coffee for years and during the years that I drank it, I selected the Intenso.  I recently purchased a single can of ground Illy Espresso Ground Coffee, Medium Roast, Classic Roast as a test to see how it compared to other coffees I've been drinking and with an offer at a lower price for the espresso grind, I selected that option.  I've been brewing it in my electric DeLonghi Alicia Moka machine that's many years old and it's provided a delicious cup of coffee each time.  The flavor of the beans fills the entire mouth without bitterness or any cloying feel.  I taste the coffee and the taste lingers without turning bitter.  It is not a medium roast as any other but is much richer and expressive of the beans' oils and flavor profile as described by Illy.  I like it so much that I've just ordered a six-pack of the whole beans so that I can enjoy the coffee in any of the coffee brewing options in my home and there are many.  I also am now a fan of the cans which have so many repurposes that I am as eager to receive the cans as their contents.  As a little note, when you open the vacuum-sealed can, be sure to position the can away from yourself since the contents are under pressure.  That's a small price to pay to receive fresh coffee and at the price, it's critical.  It's not as important with whole beans, but for a fine ground coffee, well you can imagine what might happen if you've shaken the can before opening.

title: Minimal oil and water in tasty tuna
text: I prefer albacore tuna to all others but have recently been eating more skipjack.  Reading about the Wild Planet albacore persuaded me to order some and I'm sure glad I did since it is very tasty.  My preference was albacore in water until I thought about how it sometimes is dry.  When I read that some people complained about there no being a lot of oil but oil and water, I decided that this was the option for me.  If I'm cooking with tuna, I generally use the olive oil in which it is packed but if I'm making a tuna salad, I drain it unless it is already dressed in the package.  In other words, when I drain a can of Wild Planet albacore in EVOO, I don't feel like I am washing valuable olive oil down the drain.  A single can makes a really good salad which I find makes at least two servings since I typically add onion, celery, and other assorted vegetables.  I generally also add a little dijon mustard to a light amount of rich mayonnaise.  I also add a touch of lemon juice or vinegar, pepper or jalapeno, and sometimes rinsed capers if I'm craving salt.  That makes a solid salt, fat, acid, and heat which achieves perfection in tuna.

title: Crispy, crunchy, light and a little hit of salt
text: Rice and almond-based crackers are perfect as a snack or as a lunch addition with a protein of choice.  I love all of the Blue Diamond Almond Nut Thins I've tried, regardless of size or variety.  Having a single serving portion ready to grab and go makes it easier but if I purchase a standard-sized box, count out the portions right away and store the portions in an airtight container, I can grab one just as easily.  If I don't do that, I will eat one after another because they are that good, and counting the number of crackers that go into my mouth until I get to my portion doesn't always work.

title: Good for digestion
text: Do you ever have one of those days when your belly needs TLC?  These GoGo squeeZ Fruit & VeggieZ on the Go, Apple Yellow Carrot Banana pouches can come to the rescue.  I first purchased a pack of three varieties of the GoGo squeeZ fruit pouches and could see why the kids love them so.  I now keep some in the freezer and refrigerator for "those days" when my digestive system needs help or I simply have no appetite.  I then ordered the GoGo squeeZ BlastZ Fruit Pouches on the Go, Black Cherry Surge, and thought I'd found heaven because I love cherries and they are a little tart.  Now I have the most comforting to the system in this pack which includes vegetables and a strong banana presence, the variety that I know the kids will love even more than the others.  Fortunately, with 48 in the box to start, I won't have to make another purchase too soon.

title: Attitude adjustment after the first squeeze in every pouch
text: I purchased a carton of the GoGo squeeZ BlastZ Fruit Pouches on the Go, Black Cherry Surge with every intention of sharing them with the kids but after having one, immediately decided to send them some instead of sharing.  Unfortunately for me, they are no longer available, so I guess I will have to bite the bullet and deliver half to them after all.  I see why they are called "BlastZ" because the first taste is a little tart cherry bite that wakes up the tongue and immediately makes me want to squeeze more into my mouth.  These are delicious, full of fruit flavor, invigorating, and a general boost to the mood.  Cherries are a gift from nature and these pouches are a perfect way to enjoy them mixed in with apples and other fruit.  The consistency is similar to the apple cranberry sauce I made last week, but I left the skin on the apples so these are smoother.  I hope they are not removed from the GoGo squeeZ product line because they are really good for so many reasons.

title: I love mustard
text: It's true, I am a mustard lover and have been one since I first tasted it as a very young person.  Our tastes change as we age but this one taste I never tire of and I suspect that I'll enjoy it until my days are done.  Grey Poupon Dijon is a classic mustard and there have been many who have tried to imitate it throughout the years but most of us recognize the jar, labeling, logo, and triggered memories of television commercials.  I purchased this case of large jars, figuring that even if one or two were damaged in transit, I'd have plenty to enjoy and share.  My case arrived perfectly intact despite there being no cushioning inside the box, the case being packed upside down, and the box showing signs of wear even from a short transit time.  My purchase took advantage of an incredible Amazon price because the best by date is a mere three weeks from today, but I don't care because mustard lasts and lasts if it's in sealed jars which are kept in a controlled environment. I've discovered that I can keep one of these 24-ounce jars in my refrigerator and a small jar of mayo since I use mustard every day and rarely touch the Hellman's or Duke's.  Now if only I could find the Grey Poupon coarse style mustard at this great price, I wouldn't have to make my own!

title: Terrible, just terrible
text: If I had no conscience or self-control, I would eat the entire 1 pound bag of Blue Diamond Smokehouse Almonds in a single day.  Instead, I must count out a portion size, place them in a beautiful little dish and enjoy them one by one to savor the delicately smoked flavor coating the perfectly roasted almonds.  I have no idea why, but they are even tastier in the resealable bag than when I eat them from a can like those that I have consumed for decades.  The listing states that these are gluten-free, however, I see nothing on the bag, so if it's important to you for health reasons, it might be advantageous to contact Blue Diamond for verification.  The 16-ounce bag is not as available as the 14 or 25-ounce bag, so when I repurchase, I'll be looking for the best value per ounce.  I routinely make Spiced Glazed Nuts and Pretzel Mix using a recipe by David Lebovitz as well as many other candied or spiced nuts, but I have to admit that there is something about the Blue Diamond Smokehouse Almonds that makes them a perfect accompaniment for a nice refreshing cocktail.

title: Can is a no
text: The oil is fine but the can is so poorly designed that I wish I'd read the reviews and looked at customer photos prior to purchasing the La Tourangelle, Avocado Oil, 16.9 fl oz.  I was unsure about whether the product was spoiled so I went to the company website and searched for information.  I sent an email to the company but have yet to hear back.  I finally opened the spout which was a feat in itself and poured out a sample to test.  The color is a beautiful, rich avocado green and the texture on the body is great.  I'm aware of using it in the kitchen, however, which is unfortunate because I purchased it as a food product, not a skincare product.  The spout poured into the top of the can rather than into a spoon, so it took some maneuvering to actually test the oil.  I'll have to find a bottle in which to store it since I am not interested in tainting the oil again by its puddles in the can.

title: No need to be left out now
text: My Dutch processed cocoa of choice is Cacao Barry Cocoa Powder 100% Cocoa Extra Brute, 2.2 lb which I purchase from Amazon.  Since Gerbs cocoa powder is also Barry Callebaut, but it's prepared for sale in an allergen-free environment and I was able to purchase it for a great price, I tried a bag.  I love Barry Callebaut cocoa and chocolate products, so the reddish-brown fine cocoa powder is perfect for those who have sensitivities.

title: Aluminum capsules work as well as the Nespresso originals
text: My preferred Peets capsule used to be the red one but since I've transitioned from the genuine Nespresso capsules on a daily basis to the Peets of all varieties, I think this one has surpassed as my favorite.  I first have a Vertuoline coffee and for my second of the morning, pop one of these into my Original Line Nespresso machines.  Peets coffee beans are roasted well and sent out while they are fresh.  I've been drinking Peets coffee since my first cup in Berkeley in the 1970s but don't enjoy the Peets shops in northern Virginia as much as I did in California.  Since I'm drinking Nespresso on a daily basis now, I was happy to discover the Peets capsules shortly after they were introduced to the public.  Like Nespresso capsules, these are recyclable if you turn them back over to Peets for the process.

title: Fingers and Highlanders are both reviewed
text:
FINGERS: These are cookie sticks, not fingers. When Alexa announced that my fingers were out for delivery, I was taken aback until I recalled ordering the Walkers shortbread cookies. Walkers knows how to make nice cookies for having with a cup of tea and the "fingers" are the shape that's best suited for dunking. They are also great for dunking in melted chocolate as a base for crystallized ginger or some almond slivers if you're so inclined. You don't have to spill the beans and let folks know that you didn't actually bake the shortbread yourself because they will be so impressed by how cute they are on a plate. If you purchase the package of 6 little boxes, you can always wrap a ribbon around one and present it as a quick gift, perhaps with a little box of tea. Be forewarned, though, that even though the box is petite, it's not intended as a single treat. Each cookie is a mere 100 calories and I wouldn't call that terrible for a treat that's not overly sweet.

HIGHLANDERS: Oh wow, I don't even care that each of the several boxes of these arrived in its own plastic envelope with no other padding or protection and some arrived broken. They are that good. Round, thick, a little salty, a little flour like, a little buttery, and a nice edge of sweetness from the demerara sugar. What I received are baked on the lighter side, not even brown, so they are not as hard as some shortbread cookies. I purchased these to share but since they are broken, I'm transferring the broken ones to my own cookie jar and repackaging the whole cookies into tins for distribution. If you need 6 intact cookies, I'd recommend buying two packages.

title: An awful conundrum
text: The delicious cherry tomatoes inside of the cans were grown in Italy and packaged in heavy tomato juice with sea salt.  They are not organic and there is no added basil leaf.  They are wonderful to use with other ingredients and include the juice like with garlic, onions, herbs and spices, olive oil, mushrooms and/or olives.  Pine nuts are a yummy addition, especially if they have been slightly toasted.  They can be drained and roasted to make them even sweeter and use the juice for something else.  The problem I had, however, was deciding which can to open first since each and every one of the package of 6 was dented.  I had to determine whether to start with the one that had its top crushed which necessitated taking a can opener to the can's bottom, open the one with the smushed bottom half, or begin with one which had assorted dents around the entire can.  The tomatoes were not harmed in the denting of the cans, but I never would purchase these at a normal retail price in their condition.  I won't be purchasing them again without physically examining them in person.  I prefer crushing my own cans after they are empty to make more room in the recycling bin and not being surprised by receiving a case of damaged metal containers.

title: Original blue Royal Dansk steel can still holds the best Danish butter cookies
text: Ok, so you can wait until the holidays and purchase Danish butter cookies from a big box store, local pharmacy, grocery store, or even office supply store and you will likely get them in seasonal tins and they will typically weigh a pound or be a 5 pound can.  I am partial to the original Royal Dansk tin in the 24-ounce size and am not attracted to the winter-themed designs of packaging.  Since I reuse the tins, this is important and because the cookies are tempting once the lid is removed, I find this to be the perfect size for nibbling and sharing.  It's not unusual for people to become attached to their Danish cookie tins because they can hold so many things and they are actually comforting to hold onto by those who may need something for reassurance that things will be okay.  Many use it as a sewing kit, others to hold screws and nuts, some keep their medications safely contained in this, and people have been known to even use these as containers for their own homebaked butter cookies.  If you purchase the cookies for delivery, be prepared that some may be crumbled and some tins may even be dented if they are packaged with harder, heavier items.  When I order a single can from Amazon, it tends to arrive intact, so I reorder.  Butter cookies are not difficult to make but these old standby cookies make a good last-minute gift for most people unless they have gluten or lactose intolerance or if they have eliminated carbs from their diet.  They are tasty, won't break your teeth, go well with any beverage, and offer an exercise in decision making when you open the can and are greeted by the assortment of shapes and textures.  If you don't care about the physical can, Kelsen is indeed the same manufacturer.

title: Mushy texture with loads of mayonnaise, light chunkless tuna and itty bits of vegetables
text: From the title of my review, you probably wonder why it earned 4 stars.  I am not a mayonnaise fan and I do not put sweet things in my tuna salads.  I add a bit of dijon mustard or lemon juice, sometimes even include cumin if I'm in the mood.  I give these perfectly packaged tuna and cracker "snacks" because I know the youngest ones in my family who are pre-school age will love them.  They are non-meat eaters who occasionally eat and really love seafood, just like me.  They like tuna but not when it's spicy, preferring sweeter, creamier mixed salads like this product.  The cans are an ideal size for snacking or for taking to school for lunch in the hopefully not too distant future.  For myself, I like chunks of tuna, not this smoother spread like tuna.  On the other hand, when consumed with some grape tomatoes and hot peppers on the side, it's good and I won't turn up my nose but will enjoy it.  I see a lot of potential for these little packages which are easy to transport and don't require refrigeration unless they are opened and not fully eaten.  Since it's a small amount, it's likely that this is a rare occurrence.  It would also be an option for those who have minimal teeth for chewing.

title: Variety provides something salty and crispy for everyone's taste
text: Utz products are reliable.  Once you've had a chip, you know what to expect and their quality control is good.  Where problems arise is when they are stored in the heat, thrown around, or eaten after their best by date.  If you happen to come upon a vendor in your local retail store, you'll notice that potato chips are turned over very quickly on the shelves.  It's not unusual to see them leave with bags of expired products that have been replaced by fresher products.  Vending machine folks restock the machines with bags just like those in this Utz Jumbo Snack Variety Pack of 60 Individual Snack Bags sold by Amazon.  This is not a good option to select if you intend to hold on to the contents for months because they simply will taste nasty awhile after their best by date.  Typically, in boxes like this one, the popcorn and pretzels have a best by date that's a couple weeks later than the potato chips, so if they are just for you at home, you could focus on the potato chips first and save the freshest for last.  Any way you consume them, these are salty snacks, some are saltier than others and some are crisper, but they are pretty consistent.  I wouldn't want to survive on these snacks alone for my daily nutritional requirements, but as a little crunch accompanying a simple healthy lunch or enjoying a single bag with a beer isn't terrible.  In the old days when we gathered together in the same room, perhaps even at the same table, we sometimes opened a bag or two of each, combined them in a big bowl, then enjoyed them with a cocktail.  It was not uncommon to have one of these with fruit or cheese and skip the crackers.

title: Inharmonious assembly of ingredients
text:
None of the six bags we received in our box include clusters of any kind, but rather grains of oats and everything else that is included in the fruit and nut blend. Having this in small doses such as in a little cup for a snack, a topping for yogurt, ice cream, or mixed into plain cooked oatmeal, it is okay but sometimes you only get the oats and a residual fruit or nut bit. It's not granola that we select for pouring in a bowl with some milk. We're at the point of saving the majority of oats in a jar in the refrigerator for use in bread dough because the texture when it's free of the fruit or nuts is unappealing. It is not a winner in this household but it's not so bad that it won't eventually be consumed.
EDIT: I've raised my rating because by transferring the bag contents into a jar, we have discovered that you can shake it before consuming and get a better mix of the blended ingredients. The lack of overpowering sweetness also is a definite positive. It's been growing on me and I personally now rather like the granola a lot with milk, either cow or almond. It's chewy and doesn't get soggy in the bowl.

title: More creamy than gritty grits
text: I've been eating grits all my life and always have them on hand.  I most often prepare them for breakfast using milk, water, butter, a hint of salt and add freshly ground pepper to the cooked grits which most often have a fried egg on top.  I also add hot sauce or salsa if I'm in the mood.  Sometimes, I use grated cheese instead of an egg but it's usually the egg.  Preparing a larger batch than what's necessary is my usual approach because they store well in the refrigerator for reheating the second and/or third day.  I typically use coarser grits than the Palmetto Farms brand but was very curious about these so I purchased a bag.  Wow, these are delicious!  The grind is uniform and the dry grits are beautiful.  Cooked, they are smooth and are much better than the coarser grind for meals like shrimp and grits.  Cheesy grits are outstanding, especially when topped with a fiery hot sauce.  I personally don't add much salt while cooking and I have yet to add salt when eating these because I love the corny taste.  I also love the cotton bag which has so many uses.  I've already ordered another bag.

title: I'm now ruined for others
text: I'm a fan of Cento products and have been for many years.  It's not difficult to find their products in brick and mortar stores but not all products are available everywhere.  I'd never purchased the San Marzano Organic Peeled Tomatoes prior to this six-pack, purchasing the non-organic tomatoes in the past but when I was able to pick up this order at a really good price, I selected this option.  First of all, the cans are BPA free so there is o taste of anything other than what was canned in Italy.  Secondly, these tomatoes are packed in tomato puree so they are perfect for making sauces, soups, and the traditional Italian gravy.  There is a lovely addition of a basil leaf that provides a hint of summer in whatever you make with the tomatoes.  As they cook, the peeled tomatoes meld into a beautiful sauce and there are no stringy textures or seeds to disrupt the texture.  I personally find tomatoes to have a salty taste by nature and with the minimal amount of salt added to tomatoes prior to canning, I limit what I add while cooking.  These tomatoes are true beauties which enhance my culinary skills.

title: Cool beans!
text: These high protein snacks are absolutely terrific.  The textures of both the fava beans and green peas complement each other and the flavor is mild yet existent.  They are not overly salty and have a hint of sweetness which adds to the balance between the flavors and the natural tastes of the legumes.  I shake the bag prior to opening each time I serve them to marry the contents and assure that every serving receives an equal amount of each.  There is a warning on the bag which states, "This is a whole food product that may contain an occasional hard kernel."  I wish popcorn wore this warning because I've chipped a tooth on a popcorn kernel but all my teeth have remained intact while eating the GOOD bean protein snacks.  Purchasing the assortment has allowed us to try each of the options and they all are quite good, slightly different but equally tasty and crispy.  They are a new favorite in my household and are in the purchase again column.

title: 8 varieties but most were classic potato chips, 2nd order was better
text:
EDIT: I'm updating my original review and upping the star rating by 1 because my second order was so much better than the first. The assortment was more balanced with a full 40 bags in this carton. Again, there were more plain classic Lays Potato Chips, but at least this one had 4 of the Sour Cream & Onion Ruffles and at least 3 of all others. All bags are sealed and have a best by date of August 25, a month from now, just as I'd expected.

ORIGINAL REVIEW: The box is quite cute with a "snack BOX" by Frito-Lay graphic on the ends and the numerous Frito-Lay brand logos on the sides. It's amazing to see just how many of the snack products are under this roof and there are more than what's on the box. Unfortunately, inside we found 39, not 40 perfect bags of chips and most of them are Classic Lays potato chips or original Fritos corn chips. Had we wanted the classic chips, I would have selected the Classic assortment and not the Party Mix. It's also annoying to be shorted on the number of bags. For the record, the three Ruffles snack bags in our box are of the Sour Cream & Onion and there was a single bag of Barbeque potato chips. The quality of the products is as to be expected, no stale or opened bags. For that, this gets 5 stars, just not for the assortment we received.

title: Like a vending machine in a box with no buttons to push
text: I haven't typically purchased Frito Lay chips, selecting others for the past years but was tempted by this box which would quickly arrive at our door during these times when it's not as easy to get to the store and do my impulsive buying there.  Enter this Sweet & Salty Snacks Variety Box, Mix of Cookies, Crackers, Chips & Nuts,  in a huge number of 50 assorted choices, and I couldn't resist.  There was a full assortment in the box we received with not one variety in the majority.  I regularly bake cookies, but there's something about pulling out a serving-sized bag of those which I haven't baked and which may not be as healthy or nutritious as mine.  Also, I have to check the package because some actually contain 2 servings, not just 1, so I personally don't open one when I'm alone or I will eat it all.  I had no idea that these companies are in the Frito Lay family so I investigated and found so many more.  My only wish in this box would be that there would have been more nuts because at least we get some protein with those.  These plant cases are not for retail sale but we are fortunate to have them offered for home consumption.  The chips don't last as long after packaging as the other selections, so we are eating those first.  I'm investigating other assortments of just chips.

title: The jar contains good, whole large cashews with hint of salt
text: I ordered a large jar of these Planters Fancy Whole Cashews from on sale after trying the Planters Macadamia nuts which I also purchased on sale, both from Amazon.  The macadamia nuts were great, so I purchased several more jars that were not very good before this jar of cashews shipped.  I was nervous and a little excited because, during the time I waited, I read the reviews of recent purchases were not the best but not the worst.  Fortunately, the jar I received contains very nice, mostly whole well toasted, not very salty and not overly oily cashew nuts.  Despite the weather not being very warm and the jar traveling for only a day from it's the point of origin, the jar was a little warm which made me realize that it's not a great idea to order nuts during warm weather.  I'm happy that I was able to take advantage of this offer when I did so that we can enjoy this very large jar of rich nuts which we keep in the refrigerator as we do with all of our opened nuts to maintain freshness.  I would purchase these again.

title: Rich Sumatra in a larger bag than you'll find in the local stores
text: Sumatra is a very rich, darkly roasted coffee as packaged by Starbucks.  For some reason, the bag I received has been roasted a little more than the usual bag of Starbucks Sumatra.  I won't hold that against them because I am mixing it with a Cuban coffee for a blend that is more palatable and I am reminded why it's best to not purchase ground coffee unless you have to.  If you can, purchase the Sumatra beans and it will taste so much better.

title: Minty, chewy, wrapped for pockets
text: You can't go wrong with a huge box of Mento chewy mint candies for a gathering, a gift for masses, or to keep in a bin and pass out to those whom you see fit for a little sweet or breath freshener.  The only problems I've experienced with these are that some are not a whole candy and some even have a mint and a half in the same wrapper.  I've encountered a few that were harder to chew so I have been very careful.  This is important these days because you certainly don't want to make an emergency visit to the dentist.  For those who are accustomed to the Mentos gums, these look just like the gum, so don't get confused by the two and swallow the wrong one.  The five-pound purchase arrives in a box containing two securely packaged bags.

title: Risky purchase, the nuts vary from great to barely edible
text: I purchased a jar of the Planters Macadamia nuts and thought they were quite the tasty nuts in a small, easy to open and close plastic container which would prevent the risk of overindulgence.  Because they were not very salty and each nut in the jar was crisp and enjoyable, I purchased another four jars over a period of a couple of several days as the price was reduced.  Unfortunately, after the first jar, the others have been disappointing.  The nut sizes range from tiny to robust, the textures vary from nut to nut, some are so dark that I wonder about whether they should even be consumed.  The jar I opened yesterday ended up as part of a cookie batch which turned out pretty good but they were not as great as usual.  It seems that unlike the first jar we received, the remaining jars will not be the tasty nuts we enjoyed with a cocktail.

title: Not up to Blue Diamond of my past purchases
text: This bag of whole natural almonds is terrible.  I've never purchased Blue Diamond almonds online but I have purchased their products in stores in various states over decades of times and have always liked the products from assorted almonds to almond milk to nut crackers.  I was first surprised to cut open the bag and find that the ziplock seal was separated from the bag.  That was no big deal because I normally put larger bags of nuts into smaller bags and store them in the freezer for baking.  When we tasted a few nuts, we both looked at each other and made faces of displeasure.  They are dry, tasteless, and have what I would even consider to be a little rancid.  We each had about five nuts just to be sure and there was absolutely no doubt that these are not good almonds.  They are simply not good and I am happy that I opened the bag and tasted them prior to adding them to the food processor.  Looks like I'll have to order the Club size bag from an actual "Club."

title: Versatile and unexpectedly good taste
text: I am a cheese lover.  I have tried and love so many different types of cheese that I would be hard-pressed if I had to select only one for that desert island exile should it ever materialize.  Actually, I had never tried (to my knowledge) any packaged cheese product in a can or a bottle until I purchased a bottle of this Old Fashioned Cheese Jalapeno Squeeze Cheese on a whim last month.  Since I also love hot stuff, I thought I could squeeze it onto tortilla chips if in a bind.  Shocker to me, I've really found this product to be quite the treat in numerous applications.  I've had it on bread, vegetables, chips, rice, mixed into eggs, and even straight onto the tongue.  Perhaps it's the times now, but for whatever reasons, I've enjoyed this bottle of cheese stuff even though I still don't know whose votes selected it as the "best."  I've kept it in the refrigerator because I was not sure if it was shelf-stable once opened and I didn't want to take a chance.  The texture and viscosity have remained unchanged but it takes a minute longer to warm the bottle in the hands before squeezing out the cheese and jalapeno mixture.

title: Hot, sweet and bit of sour
text: I love the YumEarth Organic Hot Chili Lollipops, but that's not a surprise.  I've been purchasing, enjoying, and gifting YumEarth products for many years.  I used to auto-ship the five-pound assorted lollipops to my Dad who loved them more than any person I know.  Having received my first order of these tasty treats, I must say that they are my favorites of all due to their complexity of tastes in a single lollipop.  The heat is forward and I find that if I use the tip of my tongue, I get more heat than sweet.  Mango is one of my favorite flavors in the YumEarth regular pops, so purchasing this box was sensible.

title: Tasty even if they are not in chip form
text: The small containers of Pringles may not travel well even if their journey is a very short distance.  Mine took only a day from preparing for shipment to arrive at my door, impressive for these questionable delivery times. I had cottage cheese ready to have with these flavorful perfectly uniform chips for lunch, a reminder of my often daily high school lunches of days passed.  Instead of putting the cottage cheese on the chips, however, much of the chips in our cups had to be sprinkled on top of the cottage cheese because a majority of the chips were not intact.  Pringles are typically good in small quantities and since it's tough to not eat an entire can at a time, I thought these would be a healthier alternative for us in the hopes of avoiding over-consumption.  We like the Sour Cream & Onion flavored Pringles the best, the Original ones the least.  Sure, they are not overly good for you nutritionally, but they add a little something tasty, and even if you receive Pringle crumbs or pieces like we did, the crunch and flavor are enjoyable.  The disappointment lies in being prepared to bite into a chip and find nothing to bite, just chew.  I'll continue to purchase Pringles on occasion but will wait to get them in person where I can hear what to expect is inside the containers.  I find these less salty than other savory snacks and the light flavor coating is not oily or cloying.  Unlike potato chips which are sliced and oddly shaped, these are a manufactured potato product developed to be uniformly shaped.  Even the containers have been designed for uniformity.

title: Unlike others
text: I'd never tasted any Umpqua Oats but had what I thought was a brilliant idea.  Order a pack for myself and one for my favorite people so we could have a virtual breakfast where we tried something new to us.  The video call began as we started heating water in our respective homes and I set a timer with Alexa for three minutes.  We all heard her ding and we removed the lids to expose what looked like uncooked thick flattened oats.  They looked perfect and there was a slight cover of liquid oat "juice" from the "cooked" oatmeal.  The smell was appetizing and the appearance was good yet not like any other instant type of oatmeal.  Eating the oatmeal was an incredibly tasty surprise.  It's not too sweet, and the vanilla flavor was the top note.  The little bits of toasted almonds were so much better than slices which I'd expected because they added to the bite of the oatmeal.  My favorite people added almond milk to their cups but I ate mine as is.  I'll buy these again.

title: Weak peppermint taste in a darkly infused brew
text: I purchased a single box of Taylors of Harrogate Organic Peppermint Herbal Tea, 20 Teabags from Amazon Warehouse because I was out of peppermint tea and it was the right price.  I've had Taylors of Harrogate products many times over the years and was confident that this would be enjoyable.  Unfortunately, despite the best by date is exactly a year from today, this infusion tastes very weak and provides no aroma that typically floats from the cup as the peppermint rehydrates.  There is an ample amount of mint in each teabag, more than many, and it is packaged securely in a foiled paper wrapper.  The style of hang tag is unusual and very smart because the string is not exposed to anything other than the mint and paper teabag.  You gingerly pull it out being careful to not tear the bag and then you are rewarded with a longer than most string.  There is no glue, no staple, nothing other than the very white paper, string and peppermint.  I am disappointed that the peppermint provides little pleasure as the beverage is consumed and would not repurchase.  I'll add some lemon verbena to my next cup to see if that enhances the mint.

title: Disappointing macaroons and non-collectible tin
text: We had such high hopes for these Manischewitz Coconut Macaroons but even higher hopes for the collectors tin.  Like others experienced who have already reviewed this product, it was not worth the wait for us.

title: whoa, Nelly, these are some minty mints
text: Curiously strong Altoid peppermints are delish and flavorful.  So are their ginger variety.  The Altoid Wintergreen small mints are quite good, but maybe because they are so tiny, they don't send me.  The Altoids Arctic curiously cool peppermints, on the other hand, send me into the ozone because they are so bright in flavor that my sinuses instantly are cleared.  They are oval in shape and smaller than a standard Altoid and much larger than an Altoid smalls.  I ordered a package from Amazon Warehouse with a best by date of only a month from now, but let me tell you that as soon as I opened the sealed cellophane in which they are packaged, the minty aroma hit me and the person who was standing six feet away from me and the package.  As a bonus, the tins in which these live is reusable and much cuter than the others.

title: In my go bag
text: The kids love these.  I find the caps in their van when I'm a passenger.  Because I enjoy applesauce but don't go through an entire jar without it growing mold, I was shopping to replenish my stash of small cups of unsweetened applesauce.  To my surprise, I had an epiphany that I, too, might enjoy having these little packages in my own refrigerator and freezer, so I ordered this package instead.  They are delicious, tart enough and not very sweet, full of fruit flavor, have a smooth texture, and they will be easier to eat if I become sick.  They definitely need not be refrigerated but I like them cold, especially when I need to be cooled down.

title: Best impulse buy in days
text:
I'd never tried the Chicken of the Sea Infusions Tuna in the basil variety or any of their infusions at all but impulsively ordered a box of six last week. I had the first of the pack today and was extremely satisfied having it with fresh vegetables, cottage cheese and a sprinkling of freshly ground black pepper. I emptied the entire container of very large chunks of skipjack including the olive oil/basil infusion and needed to add no dressing to the meal. The basil flavor was not overpowering and surprisingly fresh in taste on the palate, unlike some basil concoctions these days. I decided to add no acid-like balsamic vinegar or lemon juice because I wanted to get the true effect of the product. It needed nothing more. The fish was not strong in flavor and it was moist in texture but not overly oily. For a single serving, this is perfect. I sometimes hesitate to open a can of tuna because I know it will have to be consumed within a couple of days. With this one, there is no forecasting to consider, you open it, eat it and you're done. The spork in the lid interior is a nice addition which can be used when you consume the tuna or saved for a later picnic.

EDIT several months later. I've turned a lot of people on to the Tuna Infusions and we have a general consensus after purchasing dozens of these boxes in assorted varieties. The lemon variety is awful. Toddlers liked it for the first couple of bites and then stopped eating while the adults hated it. The taste is just fake and overpowering, period. The Thai flavor is especially good when added to a rice or grain meal with some added cruciferous vegetables. The smoked style was almost as bad as the lemon tuna, and was only purchased once. The basil tuna was a tie with the Thai style because it was good with grains or rice and also delicious on a salad with parmesan cheese and a little lemon or vinegar. These are easy to transport, eat, enjoy, and the containers are recyclable. Don't forget to rinse out before placing it in the bin.

title: Even better than the lollipops
text:
My Dad loved YumEarth lollipops so I sent him a huge box of them from Amazon on Subscription on a regular basis for years. He always carried some in his shirt pocket and brought bags of the lollipops to doctors, pharmacists, gas station attendants, grocery store clerks, and folks at the casino. He had two every night before bed while reading. I can not see them without thinking of Dad and the joy the suckers brought to him. I took a chance on the YumEarth Organic Pomegranate Hard Candies and I must say that I struck gold. Not having my father's naturally good luck, I wasn't sure if I'd like these as much as he liked his lollipops, but I love them. My favorite flavor of the suckers was always the pomegranate and these are even tastier. The diameter is small but they are thicker, more suitable for hard candy without a stick. I'm not a fan of the paper sticks, even in the YumEarth varieties, so these are a natural winner for me.

ADDENDUM: I since purchased a box of the peppermint variety and they are even better than the pomegranate! They are a bit larger and the wrapper slips off easier, so I can get it into my mouth faster. The peppermint is very strong, "stark" as my Mother would have said. She would not have liked these because they are a burning peppermint, not a sweet candy flavor, making them more desirable for my liking. I've recently purchased peppermint tea and a few types of peppermint candies and gums. This is the strongest, most flavorful of all.

title: Elegant flavor and texture in a soft cheese
text: One of my favorite cheeses of all time, Humboldt Fog, a goat milk cheese by Cypress Grove is beautiful to look at and delicious on the palate.  You might say it looks like brie with a horizontal central ribbon of mold, but that would be wrong.  With a subtle ash accent, there is no hint of "blue" in this aromatic cheese that pairs with rich fruit or nothing at all.  It's great on a sturdy cracker but it's also terrific on a thin baguette slice.  I find the texture to be interesting in that it typically is not as runny as a ripe soft cheese.  It's expensive but I love this cheese and enjoy knowing that it's available at Whole Foods.

title: Couple of minutes
text: I like the look of the little chewing gum pieces and the ingredients are all fine but the flavor of the cinnamon gum is not impressive. Rather than revealing the bag each time it is opened, I transferred the contents into another airtight container with a flip top for quicker access and storage. This pack doesn't take up much space because the pieces are so small. The reason I don't grab one of these first is because the flavor simply doesn't last. I now only chew one when I take the dog out in the evening. By the time I take the filled bag to the trash, the gum gets deposited as well. That total time is always under 5 minutes.

title: Earthy delicate soft runny cheese
text: I purchased this cheese from Whole Foods on a whim and I am so glad that I took the chance.  Left at room temperature for about thirty minutes, the small rectangle that I served was perfect, having a minimally runny texture in the center which was an exquisite accompaniment to the freshly picked apples which were crisp and sweet.  If you like soft white rind cheeses and you enjoy a rich buttery umami flavor, I think you will appreciate this one.  We did!

title: Mild coffee with caffeine removed
text: My favorite part of the Maxwell House coffees is the canister because I like the way it fits in my hand.  I wish a little scoop was included but added one I'd saved from something else.  The decaf is rather mild and not a coffee I want to drink every day but I see why my parents liked it.

title: Refillable smaller bottle size fits in a handbag
text: I usually purchase Mentos chewing gum in the bag or the more available 50 piece bottles.  When I saw this smaller option, I ordered a package and love the smaller size.  Not only do I chew this gum daily, but I reuse the plastic bottles for storing many little crafty things.  The seal is not waterproof but it is pretty airtight.  Think about it, the chewing gum stays fresh for well over a month after it is opened, so I don't hesitate to put goodies inside.  The wrapping is easy to remove and the adhesive peels off of the lids without leaving any residue.  I may have to order another one of these if only to use the smaller plastic containers for travel.

title: Check it out
text: My favorite chewing gum is Mentos.  One piece lasts as long as I want it to last, but I don't chew for an hour at a time.  There are so many options of the gum available that I recommend you decide on the container size you want, flavor, amount of containers you want in one shot, then take a look at the offerings.  The prices are inconsistent, but I always purchase from Amazon directly and they have always arrived fresh, intact and with a best by date of months in the future.  My hardest decision is which flavor to chew at any given time.

title: High quality cocoa powder improves a recipe
text: Stella Parks is correct, this is a great cocoa powder for baking.  It is superior to most others I've used in my decades-long baking experience and is the product I'll continue to purchase.  Baking her easy chocolate olive oil cake with another brand for a test run produced a good cake, one I wanted to bake again, but I wanted it to have a more pronounced chocolate depth since the cocoa powder is the only chocolate included.  Take it from me, this powder knocked the cake up a few notches, as that was the only difference between the two cakes.  Because it costs more, I had a tendency to keep it for the more complicated recipes, but after this weeks test, I must admit that it is worth the added price to gain in a tastier final product.  It really is that good.

title: It's the best for a free Haggadah.  But it's not free.......
text:
I bought so many bundles of Maxwell House Coffee with The Marvelous Mrs. Maisel Limited Edition Passover Haggadah by Maxwell House Coffee as a "free bonus" that my head is spinning. There were assorted varieties and prices, but the one thing they had in common was that the Haggadahs each arrived within a couple of days and cost a majority of the total purchase price. Days or weeks later, I've received or am awaiting receipt of the coffee orders of the bundles and they each cost a few cents. I mean less than a dime and some are less than a nickel. As an example, my credit card was charged four cents for a canister of coffee and over six dollars for a "free" Haggadah. For this headache, I should have reduced my rating from five stars to one but I just can't do that because I'm enjoying the Haggadahs and the coffees.

As a Haggadah honoring Midge, this is a five star product, but otherwise, it's nothing special. The paper is sturdy and the printing is done well, even the faux wine stains. Yes, the sketches are not extraordinary and the kids are not included, but then they aren't included in most episodes of the Amazon series either. Nobody else sits at the seder table adorning the cover, but, maybe they just haven't arrived yet or Amazon did not understand that the market for this particular product. would expect more as opposed to less. If you remember from the first episodes, of the series Midge's brisket was often used as a bribe to get a spot in the comedy club, but the recipe does not compare with my own mother's recipe which is the best in the world and if I were to still eat brisket, would be the recipe I would follow. The Haggadah looks just like the photos provided, it provides a service you can follow on Pesach, or you can just keep it and wonder why you spent so much time trying to get your hands on one or more. Most of us have not purchased enough Maxwell House Coffee in the bundle when it was available to provide a copy for each person at our seder tables, but then again, most of us already have the truly free Maxwell House Haggadahs which come inside the five pound boxes of Manischewitz matzohs which are often free with a minimum purchase in grocery stores. As for me, I've enjoyed hunting for the assorted Maxwell House Coffees to try and have been reminded of decades past when I wanted to save my mother's empty cans. I never purchased a can or canister until this collaboration and for that I'm grateful because the coffee is not terrible. On the other hand, the Amazon series is terrific, so I'm enjoying both parts of the bundle purchases and look forward to sharing them with family and friends.

The Amazon stickers which are slapped onto the Haggadahs are awful, really terrible. For this, I have reduced my rating by a star. Use a hair dryer and try to carefully remove it if it bothers you as it does me. On one Haggadah, I had to remove it from the actual pages in addition to the cover because it was positioned so poorly.

title: A nice, thick cup of coffee, just like Alfred Peet said coffee should be
text:
Peet's now offers very sleek aluminum capsules for Original Line Nespresso machines which are manufactured by JDE (Jacobs Douwe Egberts) and contain nonspecific Arabica coffee that was roasted in France. Each box was made of mixed board from responsible sources, and the packages are distrbuted by Peet's in Berkeley. The capsules look really good, perhaps even more visually enticing than Nespresso's own capsules. They weigh in at 7 grams each before brewing, just like my Nespresso capsules and I've had no problem running these through any of my Nespresso machines. I've heard of people becoming excited when they open a box containing coffee capsules for Nespresso machines and smell the contents. I don't want to smell the coffee because I want it to be sealed within the capsules where they will remain fresher and likely will produce more crema. These are indeed hermetically sealed and there is no coffee aroma until the capsule is punctured and the hot water releases the coffee liquid into the cup. The flavor profile of the Crema Scura which is rated as a number 9 is not like the Arpeggio or Envivo Lungo, the Nespresso number nines. It tastes like Peet's espresso coffee, a flavor that brought me back to my days in San Francisco, when I would drive to Berkeley to purchase a bag of coffee that was roasted in house. I would enjoy a cup of fresh brewed coffee for free with purchase of a pound of beans, something unheard of at that time. When I tasted Peet's Aged Sumatra, I savored the longlasting after taste that lingered long after the coffee cup was emptied. When I moved from the Bay Area, I ordered my Peet's coffee from California or had people put a bag or three in their suitcase when they came to visit. My own suitcase always smelled of Peet's coffee because I was charged with bringing it back East for the friends who had tasted it in my home. Now, it's available in grocery stores, big box stores and restaurants, just like Starbucks products and a gazillion other coffees. Just check out the Jacobs Douwe Egberts list of products to see a few that I'm sure you'll recognize. The price of these capsules is two cents more than Nespresso Arpeggio or Ristretto but three cents less than the Darkan or Kazar which are my personal favorites. They have a distinct flavor which some may consider "burnt," but I call a full mouth earthy flavor. I will supplement my usual purchases from the Nespresso Boutique or mail order with these, knowing that I can enjoy a nostalgic cup of Peet's coffee from my Nespresso machines, but they will not take the place of my Nespresso coffees. Being that they are aluminum, I suspect that Nespresso will be able to accept these for recycling. If not, I'll wait to purchase more Peet's capsules until I can take them into my local Peet's stores for recycling.
I just added a photo of the capsule brewed as a Lungo in my Inissia.

title: Smokey, not very spicy, a drier version than Reuben's Carolina variety
text: I'm working my way through the Louisville Vegan Jerky offerings, having started with Reuben's Smokey Carolina BBQ first taste that wowed me.  Tod's Smoked Chipotle jerky is a drier, less spicy protein filled treat that is very good, but not as good as Reuben's variety.  This one is best consumed with a beverage which can enhance the smokey flavor and moisten the dryer texture, let's say a nice hearty beer or glass of single malt scotch with an ice cube.  The bag contains three servings and I easure out a serving or I will eat the entire bag.  It's best if refrigerated after opening, but honestly, I'm not worried if it's not in my household because it won't make it three days.

title: No kidding, it's better than all that
text: I did not purchase my first bag of Louisville Vegan Jerky in the Smokey Carolina BBQ variety from Amazon but because it is so incredibly good, feel the need to post a review for others to learn from my experience.  The soft texture is squishy, shape is like squiggly worms and the flavor is tasty with vinegar tones.  It does not stain my fingers because I lick them clean.  I've made plenty of jerkys myself but this one is far better than any I've ever tasted.  With other purchased veggie products, I've experienced a funny aftertaste, but that is absent with this one.  My teeth had a gentle workout, tongue danced and my digestive tract is content.  The bag seals perfectly and  it's just as easy to open so I can slip out a little satisfying piece when I pass it in the kitchen.  It will never make it to the refrigerator because it will not last long and I won't share.  Must buy more.

title: Refill your canisters from this bag of tasty chewy morsels of minty flavor
text: Mentos Pure Fresh gum is totally addicting and I have to monitor the number of pieces I chew in a day.  I've been enjoying the 50 piece canisters of the Peppermint variety for a couple of years, reordering when I'm down to my last canister.  I'm now enjoying my first chew  of Spearmint from a resealable bag of 120 pieces.  Because I have saved every one of the plastic canisters I've ever purchased, I immediately filled two and sealed one with tape to maintain the freshness.  In my experience, these have not gone stale even if I have not chewed for a few days and the pack of 50 extended into a second month.  As for the Spearmint variety, this does not have the "burn" which I love from the Peppermint, it is a lighter, more airy minty taste.  Peppermint is outstanding for stomach issues, the spearmint extends more into the nasal areas and feels like it's freshening my breath even more.  The taste lasts beyond the time I spend chewing a piece and the texture holds up without hardening or becoming more tough.  I love the bag option and intend to continue purchasing this style of packaging.

title: Expand your horizons for a treat
text: I was surprised by the viscosity of the Kevala Organic Black Sesame Tahini, as it was thinner and less sticky than I'd exected.  It was similar to a chocolate syrup, less thick than the tahini jproducts I've used in the past.  It did mix more easily, I just had to be sure to keep the liquid inside the jar and avoid spilling it as I stirred.  The first taste was outstanding, a little bitter and full of sesame flavor.  I've used this in baking, but love it spread thinly on a toasted cinammon bagel in the morning.  I have to be sure to use a butter knife because I simply cannot resist licking each and every speck of black from the knife.

title: Baby loves these
text: I'd read about Bamba peanut snacks and was happy to find them available from Amazon, knowing they would be at my door quickly. It's important these days to expose infants to foods slowly and systematically in order to identify sensitivies, and we wanted our seven month old to try peanuts. These look like cheese puffs in shape, however they have no cheese. They are about half peanut in composition. Having a new tooth and sufficient gnawing action, we  gave them to babyafter cutting the puffs into slices of about 1/4". Of course, we tried them first and they are a hit with us all. They are crunchy initially and soften with saliva and chewing. They are not salty and leave little residue on baby's fingers,face or clothes.

title: Container is the best part of the product
text: Its container is the best part of the OLLY kids smoothie powder in chocolate.  It is only half filled with product, but I can use the larger plastic jar which includes a spot for its scoop in the lid.  Unfortunately, the nearly five year old who adores anything chocolate simply dislikes this, no matter what we do with it.  It does mix well and since I don't like to waste things, I will drink this mixed into my smoothies.  I, too, am not crazy about the taste.

title: Too bad, so sad
text: Less than 10 in the bag were intact, the rest was crispy crumbs. There was a single clump that almost broke my teeth, I don't understand how that could be.  I'm not kidding, it was like biting into a pebble, doesn't work. They are salty, umami, crispy and not worthy of the calories. Would not look at them in the pantry or on the grocery shelf.

title: Rich, full of flavor
text: Much easier than preparing a demi glace, she loved using this little gem of a tub. I am a big fan of the More Than Gourmet products I've used, having purchased my first six pack of the Vegetable stock many years ago. This is a thicker concoction since it requires less added liquid for a rich sauce.

title: Perfect portions of my favorite soft shell almonds
text: I have been purchasing the Wickedly Prime soft shell almonds since I first noticed them among the other types of nuts offered by the Amazon brand.  I'd been satisfied with the deluxe mixed nuts, almonds and cashews, was less wowed by the regular mixed nuts.  Since I'd been purchasing soft shell almonds for almost twenty years, I was familiar with their price points and knew the price here was great.  Because I really love these nuts, I find the act of cracking them open with my fingers and popping them into my mouth a calming action, and know that the almonds are healthy, even with their light coating of salt. The only problem is that I have a hard time eating just a portion.  To help control myself, I weigh out a portion and try to stay away from the bag.  With these individually portioned bags, I can eliminate the scale and get right into enjoying the almonds.  They are really great in taste, texture and are not too salty. The only negative is that these cost more than the pair of one pound bags I usually buy every two months. Otherwise, the almonds are exactly the same.

title: Small package makes 4 cups of delicious stock
text: I've been using the More than Gourmet vegetable base for more than ten years, so was eager to try the classic seafood stock.  Unlike their demi glace products which use a small amount of water, this same sized itty bitty 1.5 ounce cup reconstitutes into 4 cups of stock.  I don't use a lot of salt in cooking, so because there is enough in this stock, I added none to the seafood stew I made.  I know there is wine in this product, but I did add a little more during the last few minutes.  This worked beautifully with the saffron I used, garlic, and no other additional herbs or seasonings.  It's delicate flavored on its own, better than what I've made myself, a lot less time consuming, leaves less of an odor in the home, saves time in cleaning up and takes up less space in the garbage.

title: My system reacted poorly
text: I find the bottle graphics to be appealing, more appealing than the effects I experienced with the ProNourish French Vanilla nutritional drink.  The initial taste was good, likely due to the fact that I love vanilla, but I found it to be excessively sweet.  That was not terrible, but the belching and stomach ache I experienced after finishing a morning bottle for breakfast was not good.  It took at least an hour for the nausea I experienced from the vitamin and chemicals to subside and even longer for the belching to stop.  I tried a second breakfast serving but experienced the same effects.  Perhaps mixing this with banana and ice in a blender would improve it, but other products, many of which are also manufactured by Nestle as is this one, are more palatable out of the bottle.  Whether or not this is a low FODMAP meal replacement, the negative effects outweigh the benefits to my digestive system tomorrow if I can't stand how it makes me feel today.

title: Pack them in food provisions or grab and go, they're quite good
text: We've been eating pea based snacks for many years, purchasing them in Asian markets before they became popular in this style of snack.  It's a snack that begins with a crunch but becomes soft as mush in mouths with budding or disappearing teeth as the case may be.  Toddlers love them because they can be gummed, provide a good flavor, and this variety offered by Amazon's Wickedly Prime comes in individual packages which are perfect to include in his or her food pack for the nanny or school.  The bags are opened simply but they will tear if you give it to a younger toddler who may not be as interested in holding the bag as they are in getting out the crisps.  They are not overly salty, allowing the pea flavor to emerge, and they are not so green in color as to become unappealing to those who are not enthusiastic about consuming green vegetables.  I've had better, but these are really good, especially at about a half a buck for a single bag.

title: No stove or water required
text: For the practicality of having pasta with a minute and a microwave, this is a fine offering.  Now boxed dried pasta takes only a few minutes once the water is boiled on the stove, but this product eliminates that requirement.  You can cook a pound of pasta al dente and keep it in the refrigerator or freezer as I usually do, but you can take this to the office and have lunch for yourself and a friend if you want, not needing a stove or water.  Add sauce, olive oil or whatever you want, and you can enjoy this form of carbohydrates.  I won't be using this pasta for my homemade mac and cheese, but for a quick meal, it's a smart product.

title: Specifically formulated for sweet dough, good for others, too
text: I purchased this from Amazon because I usually bake a yeasted bread every few days, typically using active dry yeast. So many recipes use instant yeast and after repeatedly converting the recipe amount to use the yeast I already have, I elected to purchase this instant yeast that is formulated specifically for dough with sweeteners, as are the chocolate babkas I've been baking. There is definitely a difference in the rise when using this gold labeled SAF yeast. I've also used it in a honey wheat bread and no knead Dutch oven baked bread, both loaves had an excellent rise and great flavor. I have put a half pint sized jar of this yeast in the fridge and have the remainder stored in a vacuum sealed bag in the freezer. The package I received was manufactured about four months ago, so it will easily last for the remainder of its two year expected life at the rate I'm baking.

title: Meal is a good coating for oven baked proteins in a hurry
text: This is the second Barney & Co. product I have recently tried and I love them both.  Being that they are gluten free and processed in a facility free of peanuts or other allergens, they can be enjoyed by more people than California almonds processed in facilities where they could be exposed by cross contamination to allergens.  I used this meal as a coating for pieces of cod that I oven baked and hey were really tasty.  Since we eat almonds regularly, this meal is now a staple in our pantry.  I know, I can grind some almonds, but this makes using it a quicker endeavor and on those days when I simply don't have the time, this is a good one to keep on hand.

title: Ground perfectly for baking purposes
text: What makes this California almond flour different that others is that it is processed in a facility free of peanuts, so those with allergies can comfortably use this one.  I had not been familiar with Barney & Co, but now have tried to of their almond products both which I really like.  I use this flour in assorted recipes in addition to other flours, but also have used it in interesting fruit and nut bars that are wheat flour free.  I keep this in a sealed container in the refrigerator because the oils in the nuts can become rancid.

title: Chewable and full of flavor
text: Every time e are in a grocery store, he looks at beef jerky and laments that he can't chew it. I thought that this one just might work for him since it is described as extra tender and I was right. When he ate the first bite, he was hooked and was only concerned with the sodium content. Suffering from celiac disease, he has to be extremely careful and will only eat foods clearly marked as gluten free. When soy sauce is listed as an ingredient, that usually included wheat as an ingredient. It's the same with smoked foods since they often are contaminated with wheat products in the smoking process. This beef jerky is perfect for his taste, too, with a little bit of spiciness and would be perfectly complemented by an ice cold gluten free beer.

title: Caramel milk chocolate is sweet, caffeine is clearly a component
text: I like the simple, cute packaging for the Awake Chocolate bars, especially the owl.  The bars are separated into sections that easily break apart, so you don't get messy when wanting only a bite or two of a caramel filled bar.  I respond to the caffeine but am not a huge fan of the sugary flavor, so I expect that I would prefer the dark chocolate version to this milk chocolate with caramel variety.  I usually love caramel, but think the milk chocolate just makes it too sugary sweet.  These are not gourmet single origin chocolate bars, they are vehicles by which one can experience a heightened state from caffeine and sugar and in that regard, they are great.

title: well, maybe
text: He had me laughing when he said he liked the picture on the can more than he liked what was in the can.  As he ate the half can of chicken with wild rice soup, I reminded him that the chicken was roasted to which he replied, "And?"  In other words, it did not make much of an impression on him and he was not tempted to sneak the second half of the soup remaining in the can.  This was prepared in the microwave, not on a the stove, but I doubt that it made a difference since it was only heated, not overheated.  I think I've spoiled him recently with other packaged prepared soups which he found more appealing in taste and texture.

title: Vegetable soup for grownups
text: When I served this Wickedly Prime Minestrone Soup the first time, he asked for a grilled cheese sandwich, too.  I told him to get his protein from the sausage bits that were in his bowl of soup and he grinned.  The seasonings and sausage make this version different than the typical packaged prepared minestrone and he likes it.  The shelf stable easy to tear open box holds two servings unless you are so hungry that you have to eat the entire box.

title: Soft and sweet, juicy flavor
text: I use several of the Wholesome Organics sweeteners but had never tried their candies until now. I'm happy the bag is small because they are indeed sweet, more so than I'm comfortable giving to a small child. It is very soft, very cute, very pretty red in color and very juicy when eaten, and I've discovered that I only want one or two at a time. I also find that I need to brush my teeth to remove the residual red candy from in and around my teeth. Even drinking a cup of hot tea after eating these can't dissolve all the sweetness.

title: Good soup
text: I'm really impressed with the Wickedly Prime line of soups. The black bean is tasty, flavorful, aromatic, and a cup of it fills me up with a salad as a chaser. The box contains two servings and does not take up much space, for travel it's great cause you can open it with no tool and drink it out of the box if necessary. When inside, simply transfer to a pot for heating on a stove or bowl/cup to heat in the microwave. No need to add a thing but I can't help myself. It's delicious when topped with a dollop of yogurt or sour cream and avocado chunks. The chipotle flavor is mild, but my personal taste leans towards heat. This is not a creamy soup, it is more watery with bits of vegetables to chew.

title: A little different
text: We usually don't have more than a couple packaged prepared soups in the pantry. I freeze portions of homemade soups and have three or four waiting to be reheated at any given time. The Wickedly Prime soups are really good pantry staples, each is packaged with two servings and requires only reheating for an immediate meal. This one is especially good for the times you're not feeling great because he says it's soothing. It's loaded with sodium, I wish that was not the case.  Not as good as my Mom used to make, but it's good for him. The pasta is more interesting than typical noodles and even though it's not as pretty as the picture, he likes it. title: Aromatic spices enhance creamy soup
text: Flavorful, creamy, perhaps the most complex packaged soup I've tried, this was perfect for a quick, hot lunch on a day I was not feeling great. It awakens the taste buds by being aromatic, ginger and curry coming forward as the apple tames a butternut squash. The coconut flavor completes the soup that is now on my list of pantry staples. The small box serving for two is quick to open, just fold the top flat, tear the top at the perforation and squeeze to pour out the soup.  A six pack takes up very little space, so that's the way I'm going.
